translations.translation: zuru atyanta karuNAmaya, parama dayAlu allAhako nAmabATa |
sArA prazaMsAharU allAha kai nimti chan jo sampUrNa jagatakA ‘raba’ (pAlanakartA) hun;
jo atyantai karuNAmaya ra parama dayAlu chan;
jo badalA diine dinakA mAlika hun |
hAmI kevala timrai upAsanA garchauM ra timIsita nai sahAyatA cAhanchauM |,
hAmIlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAU;
tI vyaktiharUko mArga (dekhAU) jo timrA kRpApAtra bhae; tI vyaktiharUko mArga hoina jasamAthi timro prakopa bhayo; na pathabhraSTaharUko mArga nai |
alipha0 lAma0 mIma0 |
yo (allAhako) kitAba ho, yasamA kunai sandeha chaina, (yo) mArgadarzana ho allAhako bhaya rAkhne (yastA) vyaktiharUkA lAgi
jo gaiba mAthi ImAna lyAu~chan; namAja kAyama gardachan ra hAmIle unIharUlAI jejati pradAna garekA chauM tyasabATa kharca gardachan |
ra (he muhammada (sa.)!) jo timImAthi avatarita tathA timIbhandA aghi avatarita (granthaharU) mAthi AsthA rAkhdachan ani Akhirata (paraloka) mAthi vizvAsa gardachan,
tinIharU nai AphnA ‘raba’ ko tarphabATa satmArgamA chan ra tinIharU nai saphala hunechan |
kAphira (avajJAkArI) harulAI saceta garAe pani nagarAe pani tinIharU kunai hAlatamA mAnnevAlA chainan |
allAhale tinIharUkA manamastiSka evaM zravaNazaktimAthi sila lagAi diekA chan ra tinakA A~khAharUmA pardA pareko cha | ra tinIharUkA nimti kaThora yAtanA raheko cha |
ra mAnisaharUmadhye (kehi) yastA pani chan jasale hAmI allAha ra Akhiratako dinamAthi ImAna lyAekA chauM bhanchan jabaki tinIharU (vAstavamA) AsthAvAna hoinan |
tinIharU (Aphno vicAramA) allAha ra mominaharUlAI dhokA diirahekA chan tara (yathArthamA) AphaiMlAI dhokA diirahekA chan jasako tinIharUlAi anubhUti chaina |
tinIharUko mana–mastiSkamA eka (kisimako) roga lAgeko cha jasalAI allAhale ajha bar3hAidie ra tinIharUkA lAgi tinIharUle rAkheko jhuThoko badalA dukhada yAtanA raheko cha |
ra jaba tinIharUlAI dhartImA vidhvaMsa naphailAuna bhanincha taba tinIharU bhanchan– “hAmI ta sudhAraka hauM |"
jAnI rAkha! vAstavamA tinIharU nai vidhvaMsa phailAuneharU hun tara tinIharUlAI yasako anubhUti chaina |

ra jaba tinIharUlAI bhanincha ki jasarI (anya) mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAekA chan timIharU pani tyasarI nai ImAna lyAU taba tinIharU javApha dinchan– “jasarI mUrkhaharUle ImAna lyAe, ke hAmIharu pani tyasarI nai ImAna lyAune?" jAni rAkha! vAstavamA mUrkha tinIharU nai hun tara tinIharUlAI yasako jJAna chaina |

ra jaba tinIharu (munAphikaharu) mominaharUsa~ga bheTachana taba bhanchan– “hAmIle ImAna lyAi sakekA chauM” ra ekAntamA AphnA zaitAna (durjana) harUsa~ga bheTdA bhanchan– “hAmI ta vAstavamA timIharUsa~gai chauM (ra) hAmI unIharUsa~ga kevala ThaTTA garirahekA chauM |”
allAha tinIharUsa~ga parihAsa garirahekA chan ra tinIharUlAI uddaNDatAmA (andho bhaI) yatAuti barAli rahana chUTa diirahekA chan |
yI tI vyaktiharU hun jasale mArgadarzanako saTTA pathabhraSTatA kharida garekA chan | tinIharUko vyApArale na ta kehI nAphA diyo ra na tinIharUle sIdhA mArga nai pAuna sake |

tinIharUko upamA (yasarI bujhauM ki) eka vyaktile Ago bAlyo; jaba tyasa (Ago) le usako varipariko vAtAvaraNa prakAzamAna garidiyo taba allAhale usako A~khAko jyoti samApta pAridie ra uusalAI yasto a~dhyAromA chADidie jasamA usale kehI pani dekhna sakdaina |
tinIharU bahirA hun; lATA hun; andhA hun ra kunai hAlatamA (satmArgamA) pharkane chainana;

athavA (tinIharUko upamA yasarI bujhauM ki) AkAzabATa bhayaGkara varSA bhairaheko cha ra andhakAramAthi andhakAra chAeko cha ra tyasamA garjana tathA bijulIko camaka cha; meghagarjanako kAraNa mRtyuko bhayale gardA tinIharU AphnA kAnaharUmA au~lAharU ghusArirahekA chan, tara allAhale avajJAkArIharUlAI Aphno gherAmA liekA chan |

(camakale tinIharUko hAlata yasto bhairaheko cha ki mAnauM) chiTTai nai tinIharUko A~khAko jyoti bijulIko camakale khosera laijAne cha | jaba–jaba prakAza phailincha tinIharU tyasamA hiMDna thAlchan ra jaba tinIharUlAI a~dhyArole chopdacha taba tinIharU rokinchan | allAhale cAhemA tinIharUko kAna tathA aA~khAharU khosna sakchan | nissandeha allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
he mAnava! AphnA tyasa ‘raba’ ko upAsanA gara jasale timI ra timIbhandA aghikA mAnisaharUko sRSTi gare, AzA cha ki timIharU (narakabATa) bacna saknechau |

(unai hun) jasale timrolAgi dhartIlAI bichyaunA ra AkAzalAI chAnA banAe ra AkAzabATa pAnI barSAe ani tyasabATa timIharUko bharaNa poSaNakA lAgi phalaphUlaharU utpanna gare | ataH jAnI–jAnI (kasailAI) allAhako samakakSI nabanAU |

ra yadi timIharU hAmIle AphnA dAsamAthi avataraNa gareko granthako bAremA sandehamA chau bhane timIharU yasa (kuraAnamA bhae) jastai euTA mAtra sUraha (racanA garI) lyAU ra yadi satyavAna hau bhane allAhabAheka AphnA anya sahayogIharUlAI pani AhvAna gara |
yadi timI yaso garna sakdainau ra nizcita rUpamA timI yo kadApi garna sakdainau; bhane tyasa AgosaMga DarAU jasako indhana manuSya evaM DhuGgA hunechan | yo kAphiraharUkA lAgi tayAra pArieko ho |

ImAna lyAune tathA satkarma garneharUlAI zubha sUcanA deU | vAstavamA unIharUkA lAgi yastA bagai~cAharU chan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | tyasa (bagai~cA) bATa kunai phala tinIharUlAi khAna dii~dA bhannechan– “yastai kisimakA phalaharU hAmIharUlAI yasaaghi (saMsAramA) pani pradAna garieko thiyo |” ra, tinIharUlAI mildojuldo (arU phalaharU) diinecha | tinIharUkA lAgi tyahA~ pavitra joDI hunechan ra tinIharU tyahA~ sadA sarvadA rahanechan |

allAha kunai upamA dina saGkoca mAndainan cAhe tyo lAmakhuTTe vA tyasabhandA pani tuccha cijako kina nahos | AsthAvAnaharU yo upamAlAI satya ThAndachan ra AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa Aeko mAndachan tara kAphiraharU bhandachan– “yasa upamAbATa allAhako manasAya ke ho?” vAstavamA (allAha) yasabATa dherailAI pathabhraSTa pArdachan ra dherailAI satmArga dekhAu~chan ra unI yasabATa avajJAkArIharUlAI mAtra pathabhraSTa pArdacha |

ja–jasale allAhasita dRr3ha pratijJA garisakepachi tyasalAI bhaGga garchan; juna sambandhalAI allAhale joDne Adeza diekA chan, tyasalAI viccheda garchan ra dhartImA vidhvaMsa phailAu~chan tinIharU nai (vAstavamA) ghATAmA rahanechan |

timIharU kasarI allAhako inkAra garna sakchau jabaki timIharU nirjIva hu~dA unale nai jIvana pradAna garekA thie? punaH unaile timIharUlAI mRtyu dinechan ani pheri jIvita pArnechan | ra, antataH punaH unaikahA~ timIharU pharkera jAnuparnecha |
unai (allAha) hun jasale timro lAgi dhartIkA sampUrNa (vastuharU) sRSTi gare ani AkAzatira pharkI saTIka tathA santulita sAtavaTA AkAza nirmANa gare ra unI nai sampUrNa cijakA jJAtA hun |

ra, (tyasa avasaralAI) smaraNa gara jaba timrA pAlanakartAle phariztAharUlAI bhane– “ma dhartImA pratinidhi (khalIphA) banAunevAlA chu |” taba phariztAharUle bhane– “ke tyasalAI niyukta garchau jasale tyahA~ (dhartImA) vidhvaMsa ra raktapAta maccAune cha jabaki hAmI timro prazaMsAkA sAtha tasbIha (mahimAgAna) garchauM ra timrai pavitratAko varNana garchauM?” allAhale bhane– “ma tyo kurA jAndachu juna kurA timIharU jAndainau |”
ra, allAhale AdamalAI sabai (vastukA) nAmaharU sikAe ani tI vastuharU phariztAharUsamakSa prastuta gare ra bhane– “yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane malAI yI vastuharUkA nAma batAU |”
phariztAharUle javApha die– “timI pavitra chau | hAmIlAI ta tyati mAtra jJAna cha jati timIle hAmIlAI sikAekA chau | nissandeha timI nai sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chau |”

allAhale bhane– “he Adama! unIharUlAI tI nAmaharU batAU |” jaba Adamale unIharUlAI tI nAmaharU batAe taba allAhale bhane– “ke maile timIharUlAI bhaneko thiina ki ma AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA gaiba (adRzya) ko jJAna rAkhdachu, sAthai je timIharU vyakta gardachau tathA je lukAu~dachau tI sabai jAndachu?”

ra, (tyasa avasaralAI) smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle phariztAharUlAI bhanyauM ki AdamalAI sajdA gara taba “iblIsa” (zaitAna) bAheka sabaile sajdA gare | usale inkAra evaM ghamaNDa garyo ra kAphira (avajJAkArI) harUmA sAmela bhayo |
ra, hAmIle bhanyauM– “he Adama! timI ra timrI patnI dubai svargamA basa ra jahA~bATa je cAhanchau aghAuJjela khAU | tara yo vRkSanira najAnU natra bhane timIharU atyAcArI Thaharinechau |”

antataH zaitAnale dubailAI tyahA~bATa bahakAyo ra juna (sukhamaya) avasthAmA dubai thie tyasabATa nikAlI chADyo | ra, hAmIle bhanyauM– “yahA~ (svarga) bATa orla | timIharU dubai (mAnava ra zaitAna) eka arkAkA zatru hau | ra, timIharU dhartImA nizcita avadhisamma basnu evaM jIvikopArjana garnucha |”
ani Adamale AphnA ‘raba’ bATa kehI zabdaharU sike (ra, unIsa~ga kSamAyAcanA gare) | allAhale unalAI kSamA gare | nissandeha unI kSamAzIla tathA parama dayAlu chan |

hAmIle bhanyauM– “timIharU yahA~ (svarga) bATa orla | mero tarphabATa timIharUkA nimti mArgadarzana pugepachi ja–jasale mero mArgadarzanako pAlanA garnechan tinIharUkA lAgi na kunai bhaya hunecha na tinIharU duHkhI nai hunechan |”
ra, jasale avajJA garchan ra hAmrA zloka (Ayata) harUlAI mithyA Thahara garchan tinIharU nai narakabAsI hun jahA~ tinIharU sadA–sarvadA rahanechan |
he isrAIlakA santAnaharU ho! maile timIharUmAthi gareko kRpAdRSTi evaM upakArako smaraNa gara; malAI dieko vacana pUrA gara; ma timIharUlAI dieko vacana pUrA garnechu ra kevala masita DarAU |

ra, maile avataraNa gareko (grantha) mAthi ImAna lyAU jasale pahiledekhi nai timIharUsa~ga bhaeko granthaharUko puSTi gardacha | ataH sabaibhandA pahile timIharU nai yasalArI asvIkAra garne nabana | ra, tuccha mUlyamA merA (amUlya) AyataharU nabeca ani kevala mero bhaya rAkha |
satyalAI asatyasita namisAU ra jAnI–jAnI satyatAlAI nalukAU |
namAja kAyama gara, jakAta deU ra (mero sAmu) jhukneharUsa~ga timIharU (pani) jhukne gara |
ke timIharU arUlAI satkarmako upadeza dinchau ra svayaMlAI cAhi~ birsanchau jabaki timIharU Izagranthako adhyayana garchau? ke timIharU bujhdainau!?
dhairya ra namAjabATa sahayoga prApta gara | nissandeha namAja atyantai kaThina kArya ho tara Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi kaThina hoina;
jasale AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga bheTne ra pharkera unaikahA~ jAne kurAmA vizvAsa rAkhchan |
he isrAIlakA santAnaharU ho! maile timIharUmAthi gareko mero upakArako smaraNa gara ra maile timIharUlAI saMsArabAsIharUmAthi pradhAnatA pradAna gareko thie~ |
ra, tyasa dinako bhaya rAkha jaba kohI kasaiko na kAma Aunecha ra na kasaiko kunai siphAriza svIkAra garinecha, na kasailAI jarivAnA liera choDinecha ra na tinIharUlAI kunai sahayoga nai garinecha |

ani, smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle timIharUlAI “phiraaunI” bATa mukta garyauM | tinIharUle timIharUlAI kaThora yAtanA diera satAu~dathe | timrA chorAharUlAI mAridinthe ra chorIharUlAI jIvita chADidinthe | ra, yasamA timIharUkA 'raba' ko tarphabATa kaThina parIkSA thiyo |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle samudra cirera timIharUkA lAgi bATo banAyauM ra tyasabATa timIharUlAI sakuzala pAra garAidiyauM ani tyahI~ timIharUko A~khA sAmunne phiraaunIharUlAI curlummai DubAidiyauM |
ra, smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle vAcA anusAra (sandeSTA) mUsA lAI cAlIsa dina–rAtakA lAgi DAkyauM | tyasapachi timIharUle bAcchAlAI (upAsyako rUpamA) grahaNa garera AphaimAthi ThUlo atyAcAra garyau |
timIharU kRtajJa hunechau ki bhanera hAmIle timIharUlAI yasa (mahApApa) pazcAt pani kSamA garidiyauM |
ra, smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle mUsAlAI grantha evaM ‘phurkAna’ diyauM yasa AzAmA ki timIharU satyamArgamA hi~Dna saka |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba mUsAle AphnA mAnisaharUlAI bhane– “he merA samudAyakA mAnisaharU ho! nizcaya nai timIharUle bAcchAlAI upAsya banAera AphUmAthi ThUlo anyAya garekA chau tasartha timIharU AphnA sRSTikartAtarpha pharka ani Aphno (aparAdhI mAncheharUko) hatyA gara | timIharUkA sRSTikartAko dRSTimA timIharUko bhalAI yasaimA cha |” ani unale timIharUlAI kSamA garidie | nissandeha unI atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ra, smaraNa gara jaba timIharUle bhanekA thiyau– “he mUsA hAmI allAhalAI sAkSAta nadekhesamma timImAthi kadApi vizvAsa gardainauM ra herdAherdai timIharUmAthi bajrapAta bhayo |”
(timIharU) niSprANa bhaepachi punaH hAmIle timIharUlAI jIvita tulyAyauM tAki timIharU kRtajJa hoU |

ra, hAmIle timIharUmAthi bAdalako chAyA~ pAryauM ani timIharUkA lAgi ‘manna’ ra ‘salvA’ (avatarita garyauM ra bhanyauM)– “khAU yI pavitra bhojanaharU jo hAmIle timIharUlAI pradAna garekA chauM | (timrA pUrvajaharUle hAmro kRpAko anAdara gare ra yasto garera) tinIharUle hAmro kunai aniSTa garenan baru Aphnai kSati gare |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle Adeza diyauM ki yasa bastImA praveza gara ra jahA~bATa cAhanchau aghAuJjela khAU ani dvArabhitra sajdA gardai ani “hittatun” (mApha pAU~) bhandai praveza gara | hAmI timrA pApaharU kSamA garidinechauM ra sukarmIharUlAI ajha baDhI dinechauM |
tara atyAcArIharUle tinIharUlAI bhanieko kurAlAI pherabadala garidie | ani hAmIle avajJAkAritAko kAraNale tinIharUmAthi AkAzabATa prakopa avatarita garidiyauM |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba mUsAle Aphno samudAyakAnimti pAnI mAge taba hAmIle bhanyauM– Aphno laurole caTTAnamA hAna | ani, tyasabATa bAhravaTA muhAna phuTe ra pratyeka samUhale A–Aphno ghATa cine | (Adeza bhayo)– “allAhadvArA pradatta khAdyAnnabATa khAU, piU tara dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAu~dai nahiMDa |”

ra, smaraNa gara jaba timIharUle bhanekA thiyau– “he mUsA! hAmI ekai kisimako khAnAmA kadApi santoSa garna sakdainauM | AphnA svAmIsa~ga hAmro lAgi jamInakA upajaharU sAgapAta, kAMkrA, lasuna, dAla ra pyAja umAridine prArthanA gara |” mUsAle bhane– “ke timIharU uttama vastuko ThAu~mA eka tuccha vastu cAhanchau? (tyaso bhae) kunai zaharamA jAU, timIharUle mAgekA vastuharU pAunechau |” antataH tinIharUmAthi apamAna ra daridratA thopariyo | ra, tinIharU allAhako prakopamA gherie | tinIharUle allAhakA AdezaharUlAI namAnekAle tathA anAhakamA sandeSTAharUko hatyA garekAle tinIharUko yo durdazA bhayo | yo tinIharUle garne garekA allAhako avajJA ra sImA ullaGghanako pariNAma thiyo |

nissandeha momina, yahUdI, IsAi, tathA sAbI (nakSatrako pUjA garne) harUmadhye jo kohI allAha tathA AkhiratamAthi ImAna lyAunechan ra satkarma garnechan tinIharUkA lAgi tinIharUkA raba kahA~ pratidAnako vyavasthA cha | tinIharUlAI na kunai bhaya hunecha; na tinIharU duHkhI nai hunechan |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle timIharUsa~ga vacana liekA thiyauM ra ‘tUra’ (pahADa) lAI timIharUmAthi uThAekA thiyauM ra (Adeza diekA thiyauM ki) juna grantha hAmIle timIharUlAI diekA chauM tyasalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samhAla; tyasamA je cha tyo samjhirAkha tAki timIharU (allAhako prakopabATa) bacna saknechau |
tyasa pazcAt timIharU (Aphno vAcAbATa) bimukha bhayau | yadi allAhako kRpA evaM dayA timIharUmAthi nabhaeko bhae timIharU pahile nai barabAda bhaisakne thiyau |
ra “sabta” (zanivAra) ko niyamalAI ullaGghana garne AphnA jAtikA tI mAnisaharU (ko vRttAnta) bATa avagata nai chau | ani, hAmIle pani tinIharUlAI bhanekA thiyauM– “tuccha bA~dara bhaihAla |”
ra, hAmIle yasa (ghaTanA) lAI tyasa samaya tathA bhaviSyamA Aune sabaikA lAgi zikSAprada ra Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi upadeza banAyauM |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba mUsAle AphnA mAnisaharUlAI bhane– “allAhale timIharUlAI gAI jabaha (vadha) garne Adeza dinchan |” tinIharUle bhane– “ke timI hAmIsita ThaTTA gardaichau?” mUsAle bhane– “ma mUrkha ra ajJAnIharUko jasto kurA garnabATa bacna allAhako zaraNa cAhanchu |”

tinIharUle bhane– “timI hAmronimitta AphnA pAlanakartAsita prArthanA gara ki unale tyo (gAI) kasto hunu parcha bhanne kurA spaSTa pArUn |” mUsAle bhane– “allAha bhandachan— tyo (gAI) na bUDho hos na (kalilo) bAcchI baru madhya Ayuko hos | ataH timIharU tyahI gara jasako Adeza dii~daicha |”

tinIharUle bhane– “timI hAmronimitta AphnA pAlanakartAsita prArthanA gara ki unale tyasa gAIko raGga kasto hunuparcha bhanne kurA pani hAmIlAI batAidiUn |” unale bhane– “allAha bhandachan— tyasako raGga paheMlo hos jasako camkilo raGgale herneharUlAI prasanna tulyAos |”

tinIharUle bhane– “hAmronimti Aphno pAlanakartAsita tyasa gAIkA ke–ke vizeSatAharU hunuparcha bhanne kurAlAI spaSTa pAridinakA lAgi prArthanA garideU kinabhane hAmIlAI sabai gAI ustai–ustai lAgchan ra allAhale cAhemA hAmI tyo bheTTAuna saknechauM |”

unale bhane– “allAha bhandachan— tyo gAI na kAmamA lagAieko hos; na kheta jotne ra na khetamA siMcAi garne kAmamA nai; sadde hos ra tyasamA kunai dAga nahos |” tinIharUle bhane– “timIle balla satya kuro spaSTa pAryau |” antataH tinIharUle tyasalAI vadha gare jabaki tinIharU yaso garne mAnasikatAmA thienan |

ra, (smaraNa gara) jaba timIharUle ekajanAko hatyA garI ApasamA jhagaDA tathA eka–arkAmAthi doSAropaNa garna thAlyau | tara, timIharUle juna kurA lukAirahekA thiyau allAha tyo prakaTa garnevAlA thie |

ani hAmIle bhanyauM– “ukta lAzalAI tyasa (vadha garieko gAI) ko euTA cokaTAle hirkAU (U jIvita bhaihAlnecha) | yasarI allAhale murdAlAI jIvita pArI timIharUlAI Aphno camatkAraharU dekhAu~chan | AzA cha timIharU viveka prayoga garnechau |”

tyasapachi timIharUko hRdaya kaThora huna pugyo DhuGgAjastai vA tyobhandA pani kaThora; baru kehI DhuGgAharU yastA pani hunchan jasabATa kholAharU bagirahekA hunchan; tinIharubATa pAnIko dhArA niskancha ra kehI allAhako bhayale jharirahekA hunchan | ra, allAha timIharUko kriyAkalApabATa anabhijJa chainan |

(he muslimaharU ho!) ke tinIharu (isarAIlakA santAnaharU) le timIharUko kurA mAnne chan bhanI ajhai pani AzA gardaichau jabaki tinIharUmAjha euTA yasto samUha cha jasale allAhako vANI sunera bujhisakepachi pani jAnI–jAnI tyasamA pherabadala garidincha?

AsthAvAnaharUsa~ga bheTa hu~dA tinIharU bhanchan– “hAmIle ImAna lyAisakekA chauM |” ra, ekAntamA ApasamA bheTdA bhanchan– “ke allAhale timIharUsamakSa (taurAtamA) spaSTa pArekA kurAharU musalamAnaharUlAI batAu~chau jasale gardA unIharUle timrA pAlanakartAsamakSa timraiviruddha yasalAI tarka peza garna sakUn? ke timIharU buddhi prayoga gardainau?”
ke je tinIharU gopya rAkhchan ra je prakaTa garchan allAhalAI tI sabai kurA thAhA cha bhanne kurAko tinIharUlAI hekkA chaina?
ra, yinIharUmadhye kohI yastA ajJAnI pani chan jasalAI Izagranthako bAremA mithyA AzAbAheka kehI thAhA chaina | ra, yinIharU anumAna mAtra garirahanchan |

ra, barabAdI cha tI mAnisaharUkA nimti jo Aphno hAtale dharma–vidhAna lekhchan ani tuccha lAbha prAptiko lAgi “yo allAhako tarphabATa Aeko ho” bhanchan | tinIharUko hAtale lekhieko (dharma–vidhAna) tinIharUkA lAgi barabAdIko cija ho ra tinIharUko yo Arjana pani tinIharUkA lAgi barabAdIko kAraNa ho |

tinIharU bhanchan– “hAmIlAI (narakako) Agole kimArtha chuna sakdaina; choihAlyo bhane pani kehI dinako lAgi mAtra |” (he muhammada sa.!) sodha– “ke timIharUle allAhasita kunai vAcA garekA chau jasako allAhale ullaGghana garne chainan vA allAhako bAremA tyo kurA bhandaichau jasako jJAna timIharUlAI cha~dai chaina?”
nissandeha pApa kamAune ra kukarmamA lipta rahane mAnisaharU narakabAsI hun; (tyahA~) tinIharU sadaiva rahanechan |
ra, ImAna rAkhne tathA satkarma garne vyaktiharU svargamA praveza garnechan; tyahA~ unIharU sadaiva rahanechan |

ra, tyasa (kurA) ko smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle isarAIlakA santAnaharUsa~ga vacana liekA thiyauM ki timIharU allAhabAheka anya kasaiko upAsanA garne chainau, AmA–buvA, nAtedAra, anAtha tathA dIna–duHkhIharUsa~ga sadvyavahAra garnechau, ra mAnisaharUsita mITho bolne, namAja kAyama garne ra jakAta cuktA garnechau tara timIharUmadhye kehI vyaktibAheka sabai vimukha bhae ra timIharU ta vimukha huneharU nai hau |

ra, tyasa kurAko smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle timIharUsa~ga dRDha vacana liekA thiyauM ki timIharU (ApasamA) raktapAta garne chainau tathA AphnA mAnisaharUlAI gharabATa niSkAsita garne chainau | timIharUle yasalAI svIkAra garekA thiyau jasako sAkSI timIharU AphaiM hau |

pheri timIharU nai hau jo Aphantako hatyA gardachau; Aphnai euTA samUhalAI tinIharUko gharabATa niSkAsita gardachau ra tinIharUmAthi pApa evaM atyAcAra gardai tinIharUviruddha (tinakA zatruharUlAI) sahayoga puryAu~chau | ani tinIharU bandI bhaera timIkahA~ Au~dA timIharU phidyA (harjAnA) tirera tinIharUlAI mukta pani garAu~dachau jabaki tinIharUlAI niSkAsita garnu nai timIharUkA nimti avaidha thiyo | ke timIharU Izagranthako kehI aMzamAthi AsthA rAkhdachau ani kehI aMzaprati kuphra (anAsthA pradarzana) garchau? timIharUmadhye jasale yasto garcha usako lAgi yasabAheka arU ke sajAya~ huna sakcha ki sAMsArika jIvanamA tyo apamAnita hos ra mahApralayako dina atyanta kaThora yAtanAtarpha hutyAiyos? ra, allAha timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbATa anabhijJa chainan |
yinIharU tinai hun jasale Akhiratako sATo sAMsArika jIvana kharida garekA chan | ataH na tinIharUko yAtanA kama garinecha ra na tinIharUlAI sahayoga nai prApta hunecha |

ra hAmIle (timro mArgadarzanako lAgi) mUsAlAI grantha pradAna garyauM | ra, tyasapachi anavarata rUpamA arU IzadUtaharU paThAirAkhyauM ra unIharUmadhye marayama–putra IsAlAI spaSTa camatkAraharU pradAna garyauM, ani pavitra AtmA (jibraIla) dvArA unalAI sahAyatA garyauM | tara, (timIharUko yo ke cAlA ho ki) timIharUsamakSa kunai rasUla timro cAhanA viparIta kunai kurA liera Au~dA timIharUle jahile pani aTerI garyau ani kehI rasUlaharUlAI jhUTho Thahara garyau ra kehIko ta hatyA nai garidiyau |
ra, tinIharU bhanchan–“hAmro hRdaya kholamA (banda) cha |” baru tinIharUko kuphrako kAraNale tinIharUmAthi allAhako abhizApa pareko cha | tyasaile tinIharU biralai ImAna lyAu~chan |

ra, aba tinIharUsamakSa allAhako tarphabATa juna grantha Aeko cha tyasasa~ga tinIharUko kasto vyavahAra cha jabaki yasale tinIharUsita rahekA granthaharUko puSTi gardacha? ra, jabaki yasako AgamanapUrva tinIharU (sadhai yasaidvArA) kAphiraharUmAthi vijayako prArthanA garne garthe? tara, jaba tinIharUsamakSa tyahI cija Ayo taba tinIharUle tyo cinera pani tyasalAI satya mAnenan | tasartha allAhako dhikkAra cha avajJAkArIharUmAthi |

ati tuccha cha tyo mUlya jasako sATomA tinIharUle svayamalAI bece | allAhale avataraNa gareko granthalAI tinIharUle kevala yasa jiddIpana (ra DAhA) ko kAraNale asvIkAra garidie ki allAhale AphnA upAsakaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhe usaimAthi Aphno kRpAle avataraNa gare | ataH tinIharU prakopamAthi prakopako zikAra bhae | ra, kAphiraharUkA lAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA raheko cha |

ra, jaba tinIharulAI allAhadvArA avatarita granthamAthi ImAna lyAuna bhanincha taba tinIharU bhanchan– “hAmI ta tyasai granthamAthi ImAna rAkhchauM juna hAmImAthi avataraNa bhaeko cha |” tinIharU tyasabAheka anya (grantha) lAI mAndainan jabaki yo (kuraAna) pUrNarUpamA satya ho | yasale tinIharUkahA~ pahiledekhi vidyamAna granthaharUko puSTi gardacha | sodha—“yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane yasaaghi kina (Aphnai vaMzajamA AekA) allAhakA sandeSTAharUko hatyA gardai AekA chau?”,
ra, mUsAle timIharUsamakSa spaSTa pramANaharU liera Ae pani timIharUle (AphUmAthi) atyAcAra gardai unako (choTo avadhiko) anupasthitimA bAcchAlAI pUjya banAyau |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle timIharUsa~ga vAcA liekA thiyauM ra ‘tUra’ (pahADa) lAI timIharUmAthi uThAekA thiyauM | ra, Adeza diekA thiyauM (ki) juna (grantha) hAmIle timIharUlAI diekA chauM tyasalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samhAla ra tyasamA je cha tyo rAmrarI suna | tinIharUle bhane– “hAmIle sunyauM (tara) avajJA garyauM |” tinIharUko kuphrako kAraNale bAcchole tinIharUko manamA sthAna liisakeko thiyo | bhanideU– “yadi timIharU momina hau bhane timIharUko AsthAle diirahekA Adeza kati narAmrA chan!”
bhanideU– “yadi allAhakahA~ Akhiratako ghara (svarga) anya mAnisaharUkA lAgi nabhaI kevala timIharU kai lAgi ho ra timIharU (Aphno dAbImA) satya chau bhane mRtyuko kAmanA garera dekhAU |”
tara tinIharUle AphnA hAtale paThAekA kukarmaharUle gardA kahilyai pani mRtyuko kAmanA garne chainan | allAhalAI atyAcArIharUko bAremA rAmrarI thAhA cha |

timI pAunechau ki tinIharU anya mAnisaharUbhandA baDhI bA~cirahana lAlAyita chan | baru muzrika (bahudevavAdI) harUbhandA pani baDhI | tinIharUmadhye pratyeka vyakti hajAra varSasamma bA~cna cAhancha jabaki Ayu jati lAmo bhae pani usalAI (allAhako) yAtanAbATa bacAuna sakdaina | tinIharU je garchan tI sabai allAhale dekhirAkhekA chan |

(he muhammada sa.!) bhanideU– “jo jibraIlako zatru ho,(usale thAhA pAirAkhos ki) unale allAha kai AdezAnusAra yasa (kuraAna) lAI timro hRdayamA avatarita garekA hun jasale pahiledekhi vidyamAna granthaharUko puSTi gardacha | yo AsthAvAnaharUkA lAgi mArgadarzana tathA zubha–sUcanA ho |”
jo kohI allAha, unakA phariztAharU ra unakA rasUlaharU tathA jibraIla evaM mIkAIlako zatru ho, allAha pani (tyastA) kAphiraharUkA zatru hun |
ra (he muhammada sa.!) hAmIle timImAthi spaSTa AyataharU avataraNa garekA chauM jasako inkAra kevala dUrAcArIharU garchan |

ke yo satya hoina ki jaba–jaba tinIharUle kunai pratijJA gare taba–taba tinIharUmadhye kai kunai samUhale tyasalAI bhaGga garyo | yathArthamA tinIharUmadhye dheraijaso (mero pratijJAmA) vizvAsa nai rAkhdainan |

ra, jaba tinIharUkahA~ allAhako tarphabATa ekajanA rasUla Ae jasale tinIharUsa~ga rahekA granthaharUko pani puSTi gardathe taba ahle–kitAbaharUmadhyeko euTA samUhale allAhako granthalAI piThyu~pachADi yasarI phyA~kidiyo ki mAnauM tinIharUlAI kehI thAhA nai thiena |

tinIharU tyasa (jAdU–mantara) ko pachi lAge juna sulaimAnako zAsanakAlamA zaitAnaharUle peza garthe | ra, sulaimAnale ta kahilyai kuphra garekA thienan baru zaitAnaharUle kuphra gare ani mAnisaharUlAI jAdU sikAe | ra, (tinIharU tyasa kurAko pachi lAge) juna ‘bebIlona’ mA hArUta ra mArUta (nAmaka) duI phariztAharUmAthi avatarita garieko thiyo jabaki tI dubaile kasailAI pani tyasako zikSA diMdA bhanne garthe– “hAmI (timIharUkA lAgi) kevala parIkSA hauM | ataH (yasalAI sikera kahilyai) kuphra nagarnu |” yadyapi tinIharU tI dubai dUtaharUsita yasto (jAdU) sikdathe jasako mAdhyamale pati–patnIko sambandhaviccheda garna sakiyos jabaki tinIharU allAhako anumati binA kasailAI pani kunai hAni puryAuna sakdainathe, tathApi tinIharU tyo kurA sikdathe juna tinIharUkA lAgi hAnikAraka thiyo; lAbhadAyaka thiena | tinIharUlAI rAmrarI thAhA thiyo ki jo tyasa (jAdU) ko grAhaka banyo paralokamA tyasakA lAgi kunai hissA hune chaina | kati tuccha cha tyo cija jasako sATo tinIharUle AphUlAI bece | Aha! tinIharUlAI yasako jJAna bhaidieko bhae (kati jAtI) |
yadi tinIharUle ImAna lyAeko ra bhaya rAkheko bhae allAhako tarphabATa rAmro pratidAna pAune thie | tinIharUlAI yasako jJAna bhaidieko bhae (katti besa hunthyo) |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! (muhammada (sa.) sita kurA gardA) “rAenA” nabhana baru yasako saTTA “unjurnA” bhana ra sunne gara | kAphiraharUkA lAgi kaSTamaya yAtanA raheko cha |

ahle kitAba (granthavAhaka) vA bahudevavAdI josukai madhyekA asvIkAra garneharUle timImAthi timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kunai bhalAI avataraNa hos bhanne kadApi cAha~dainan | tara, allAha jasalAI cAhanchan Aphno dayAko lAgi rojdachan | ra, allAha parama udAra dAnakartA hun |
ra, juna AyatalAI hAmI haTAu~chauM vA bhulAu~chauM tyasako pratisthApanamA tyobhandA rAmro vA tyastai Ayata lyAu~chauM | ke timI allAha sampUrNa kurAko sAmathrya rAkhdachan bhanne kurA jAndainau?
nissandeha AkAzaharU ra dhartImA allAha kai zAsana cha ani allAhakA atirikta timro kohI pani saMrakSaka–mitra ra sahayogI chaina bhanne kurA ke timIlAI thAhA chaina ra?
ke timI AphnA rasUlasa~ga tyastai prazna garna cAhanchau jasto yasabhandA pahile mUsAsita garieko thiyo? ra, jo kohI ImAnako saTTA kuphralAI a~gAlcha U satmArgalAI nizcita rUpamA gumAuna pugcha |

ahale kitAbamadhye dheraijaso sAmu satyatA spaSTa bhaisakepachi pani (timIharUprati raheko) DAhAko kAraNale timIharUle ImAna lyAisakepachi timIharUlAI punaH kuphratirai pharkAuna cAhanchan | allAhako Adeza naAesamma yinIharUlAI kSamA garideU ra choDideU | nissandeha allAha sampUrNa kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
ra namAja kAyama gara ra jakAta deU | svayamako lAgi jejati satkarma garera paThAune chau tI sabai allAhakahA~ pAunechau | nissandeha timIharU je garchau allAhale dekhirahekA chan |

tinIharU bhanchan– “(yahUdiharuko vicAramA) yahUdI vA (IsAIharUko vicAramA) IsAI bAheka aru kohI svargamA praveza garna sakdaina |” yI yinakA kAmanA mAtra hun | bhana— “yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane AphnA pramANaharU prastuta gara |”

kina nahunu; jasale Aphno anuhAralAI allAhasamakSa samarpita garcha ra jo satkarmI pani cha, usako pratiphala usako pAlanakartAkahA~ raheko cha | tathA yastA vyaktiharUlAI na kunai trAsa hunecha ra na unIharU duHkhI nai hunechan |

yahUdIharU bhanchan– “IsArIharUko kunai AdhAra chaina” ra IsArIharU bhanchan– “yahUdIharUko kunai AdhAra chaina” jabaki tinIharU dubai Izagranthako adhyayana garchan | tyasaigarI tinIharU jastai jJAna nai nabhaekAharU pani (AphU satyamA raheko kurA) bhanchan | juna matabhedamA yinIharU pha~sekA chan mahApralayako dina allAhale yinIharUbIca tyasako phaisalA garidinechan |

ra, tI vyaktiharUbhandA ThUlo atyAcArI arU ko holA jo allAhakA ghara (masjida) harUbhitra unakai japa gardA bAdhA puryAu~chan ra tI gharaharUlAI dhvasta pArna cAhanchan? tinIharU ta tyahA~ praveza pAune yogya nai thienan; barU (praveza garihAle pani) DarAI–DarAIkana | tinIharUkA lAgi saMsAramA apamAna ra paralokamA kaThora yAtanA raheko cha |
ra, allAha kai hun pUrva evaM pazcima | ataH jatAtira anuhAra pharkAu~chau tyasaitarpha allAha hunchan | nissandeha allAha aparampAra evaM sarvajJa chan |
unIharUle bhane— “allAhale choro banAekA chan |” (hoIna) unI pavitra chan | baru AkAzaharU evaM dhartIkA sabai cijaharU unaikA hun ra sabai unakA AjJAkArI hun |
(allAha) AkAzaharU evaM dhartIkA sRSTikartA hun | ra, jaba unale kunai kAryako nirNaya garchan taba ‘hoos’ mAtra bhanera tyasako Adeza diepachi tyo huna pugcha |

ajJAnIharU bhanchan—“allAha svayaM kina hAmIsa~ga kurA gardainan vA hAmIkahA~ (unako) kunai camatkAra kina Au~daina?” yinIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUle pani yastai kurA garekA thie | yinIharU sabaiko manovRtti samAna raheko cha | hAmIle AsthAvAnaharUkA lAgi nizAnIharU spaSTa pArisakekA chauM |

(he muhammada (sa.)!) nissandeha hAmIle timIlAI nitAnta satya (dharma) diera (svargako) zubha–sUcaka tathA (narakako yAtanA bAre) sacetaka banAera paThAekA chauM | narakamA jAne mAnisaharUko sambandhamA timIsa~ga kunai sodhapucha garine chaina |

ra, timIsa~ga yahUdI ra IsArIharU kadApi khuzI hune chainan jabasamma timI tinIharU kai dharmako anusaraNa garne chainau | bhanideU– “nissandeha allAhale pradAna gareko mArgadarzana nai vAstavika mArgadarzana ho", ra yo zikSA Aisakepachi pani yadi timIharUle tinIharUko kuabhilASAko anusaraNa garyau bhane allAhabATa bacAune kohI saMrakSaka–mitra tathA sahayogI hune chaina |
tI vyaktiharU jasalAI hAmIle grantha pradAna garyauM, ra jo tyasa granthako yathocita adhyayana garchan, tinIharU nai tyasamAthi ImAna lyAu~chan ra yasalAI asvIkAra garneharU nai ghATAmA chan |
he isarAIlakA santAnaharU ho! maile timIharUmAthi gareko kRpAdRSTi evaM upakArako smaraNa gara ki maile timIharUlAI saMsArabAsIharUmAthi pradhAnatA pradAna gareko thie~ |

ra, tyasa dinako bhaya gara jaba kohI kasaiko katti pani kAma Aune chaina ra na kasaiko jarivAnA svIkAra garI chADinecha ra na kasaiko kunai siphArizale phAidA puryAunecha ra na tinIharUlAI kunai sahAyatA nai garinecha |

ra, (yAda gara) jaba ibrAhImakA pAlanakartAle kehI kurAharUdvArA unako parIkSA lie ra unI tyasamA saphala bhae | (ani, unakA pAlanakartAle) bhane– “ma timIlAI mAnavajAtiko aguvA banAunevAlA chu |” ibrAhImale nivedana gare– “ani merA santAna ni?” unale bhane– “mero vAcA atyAcArIharUkA lAgi hoina |”

ra, (smaraNa gara) jaba hAmIle yasa ghara (kAabA) lAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi kendra evaM zAntisthala banAyauM | ra, (bhanyauM–) “makAme ibrAhIma” (ibrAhIma ubhine ThAU~) lAI namAja paDhne sthAna banAU | ra, hAmIle ibrAhIma evaM ismAIlasita hAmro gharalAI “tavApha”, “eatikApha”, “rUkUa” tathA “sajdA” garneharUkA lAgi pavitra rAkhne vacana liyauM |

ra, (smaraNa gara) jaba ibrAhImale prArthanA gare– “he merA pAlanakartA! yasa (makkA) lAI zAnti kSetra banAideU ra yasakA nivAsIharUmadhye allAha evaM AkhiratamAthi ImAna rAkhneharUlAI phalAhAra pradAna gara |” (allAhale) bhane– “ma kAphiraharUlAI pani kehI dinasamma lAbhAnvita hune maukA dinechu tara antataH tinIharUlAI narakako yAtanA tira ghaceTnechu ra tyo ati narAmro ThAu~ ho |”

ra, (smaraNa gara) jaba ibrAhIma tathA ismAIla yasa gharako jaga uThAirahekA thie ra bhandai thie– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmro tarphabATa svIkAra gara | nissandeha timI nai sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chau |”

“he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmI dubailAI Aphno AjJAkArI banAU ra hAmrA santatimadhyebATa euTA yasto samudAya banAU jo timro AjJAkArI hos | ra, hAmIlAI upAsanAko vidhi sikAideU ani hAmro taubA (prAyazcita) svIkAra gara | nissandeha timI taubA svIkArakartA, parama dayAlu chau |”

“he hAmrA pAlanakartA! timI unIharUkA lAgi unIharUmadhyebATa euTA rasUla paThAU jasale unIharUlAI timrA AyataharU paDhera sunAUn; grantha tathA tatvadarzitAko zikSA diUn ra unIharUlArI zuddha pArUn | nissandeha timI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chau |”
ra, ibrAhImako dharmabATa mUrkhabAheka ko vimukha huna sakcha ra? nissandeha hAmIle unalAI saMsAramA cayana garekA thiyauM ra unI AkhiratamA pani satkarmIharUmadhye hunechan |
jaba (ibrAhImakA) pAlanakartAle unIsa~ga bhane– “AphUlAI samarpita garideU |” (ibrAhImale) bhane– “maile sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartAsamakSa AphUlAI samarpita garidie~ |”

ra, yasai (dharma) ko upadeza ibrAhImale AphnA santAnaharUlAI diekA thie ra yAakUbale pani– “he merA santAnaharu! allAhale timIharukA lAgi yo dharma rojekA chan tyasaile timIharU AjJAkArI (muslima) rahekai avasthAmA mRtyuvaraNa gara |"

ke timIharU yAakUbako mRtyuko belA upasthita thiyau? unale AphnA santAnaharUlAI sodhekA thie– “timIharU mero mRtyupazcAt kasako upAsanA garnechau?” tinIharUle bhane– “hAmIharu tapAIMko Izvara ra tapAIMkA pUrvajaharUH ibrAhIma, ismAIla evaM ishAkakA Izvarako upAsanA garnechauM juna eka mAtra Izvara hun | ra, hAmIharu unaikA AjJAkArI hauM |”

tyo euTA ummata (samUha) thiyo juna bitisakyo | unIharUko karmako phala unIharUlAI nai prApta hunecha ra timIharUko karmako phala timIharUlAI nai | timIharUsa~ga unIharUle garne karmabAre kehI sodhine chaina |

ra, tinIharu bhanchan– “yahUdI bana vA IsAI ani mAtra satyamArga pAunechau |” bhanideU– “hoina, hAmI ibrAhImako dharmamA nai rahanechauM jo (eka mAtra allAhako bhaktimA) ekAgra thie ani muzrika (bahudevavAdI) harUmadhye thienan |”

(he AjJAkArIharU ho!) bhana– “hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM allAhamAthi ra tyasa (grantha) mAthi juna hAmItira avataraNa gariyo ra tyasamAthi pani juna ibrAhIma, ismAIla, ishAka, yAakUba evaM (yAakUbakA) santAnaharUmAthi avataraNa gariyo ani juna mUsA evaM IsAlAI pradAna gariyo tathA juna anya sandeSTAharUlAI unakA ‘raba’ ko tarphabATa pradAna gariyo | hAmI yinIharUbIca kunai vibheda gardainauM | ra, hAmI unai (allAha) ko AjJAkArI hauM |”

timIharUle ImAna lyAejhaiM yinIharUle pani ImAna lyAemA yinIharUle satmArga prApta garnechan ra vimukha bhaemA vidrohI Thaharnechan | ataH timIharUkA lAgi allAha nai paryApta chan | ra, unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |
allAhako raGga grahaNa gara | ra, allAhakobhandA rAmro arU kasako raGga huna sakcha ra? ra, hAmI unaikA upAsaka hauM |

bhana– “ke timIharU allAhako sambandhamA hAmIsita jhagaDA garchau jabaki unI hAmrA pAlanakartA hun ra timIharUko pani | ra, hAmro lAgi hAmrA karmaharU chan tathA timro lAgi timrA karmaharU | ra, hAmI ta zuddha hRdayakA sAtha unakai bhaisakekA chauM |”

(he yahUdI ra IsAIharU ho!) ke timIharU ibrAhIma, ismAIla, ishAka, yAakUba tathA yAakUbakA santAnaharU yahUdI vA IsAI thie bhanera bhandachau? (he nabI sa.!) bhanideU– “timIharU baDhI jAndachau vA allAha?” ra, allAhabATa prApta ‘sAkSI’ lukAune vyaktibhandA ThUlo atyAcArI arU ko holA? ra, allAha timIharUle garirahekA karmaharUbATa anabhijJa chainan |

tyo euTA samUha thiyo juna bitisakyo | unIharUkA karmako phala unIharUlAI nai prApta hunecha ra timIharUko karmako phala timIharUlAI nai | timIharUsa~ga unIharUle garne garekA kArya bAre kehI sodhine chaina |
mUrkha mAnisaharUle bhannechan– “unIharUlAI AphUle grahaNa gareko kiblAbATa ke kurAle vimukha garAyo?” bhanideU– “pUrva ra pazcima allAha kai hun | unale jasalAI cAhanchan sIdhA mArga dekhAu~chan |”

ra, yasarI hAmIle timIharUlAI madhyamArgI samudAya banAyauM tAki timIharU mAnisaharUko sAkSI bana ra rasUla timIharUko sAkSI banUn | yasaaghi timIharUle grahaNa gareko kiblAlAI hAmIle yo jAnnako lAgi mAtra nirdhArita garekA thiyauM ki ‘kasale rasUlako anusaraNa garcha ra ko vimukha huncha’ | vAstavamA yo ati kaThina thiyo tara unIharUkA lAgi kaThina thiena jasalAI allAhale satmArga dekhAe ra allAhale timIharUko ImAnalAI kadApi khera phAlne chainan | nissandeha allAha mAnavaprati atyanta snehI ra parama dayAlu chan |

(he nabI sa.!) timIle ghari–ghari AkAzatira anuhAra pharkAera hereko hAmIle dekhirahekA chauM | nizcaya nai hAmI timro anuhAralAI timIlAI mana parne “kiblA” tira nai pharkAi dinechauM | tyasaile Aphno anuhAralAI masjide harAma (kAabA) tira pharkAU | (he AsthAvAnaharU ho!) timIharU jahA~sukai bhae pani Aphno anuhAra (namAjamA) tyasaitarpha gara | ahle–kitAbalAI yo (kiblA parivartana) tinIharUkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa Aeko ho ra nitAnta satyamA AdhArita ho bhanne kurA rAmrarI thAhA cha | yinIharUle je garirahekA chan allAha tyasabATa anabhijJa chainan |

ra, timIharUle ahle kitAbakA sAmu junasukai pramANa lyAe pani tinIharUle timro kiblAko anusaraNa garne chainan ra na timIharUkA lAgi sambhava cha ki tinIharUkA kiblAko anusaraNa gara | ra, na tinIharUle ApasamA ekaarkAko kiblAko anusaraNa garnechan | ra, yadi timIharUle yasa zikSAko avataraNakA bAvajuda pani tinIharUko cAhanAko anusaraNa garyau bhane nizcaya nai timI pani atyAcArIharUmadhye hunechau |
jasalAI hAmIle (Aphno) grantha pradAna garyauM tinIharUle yasalAI AphnA santAnaharU jhaiM cindachan tara tinIharUmadhyeko euTA samUhale jAnIjAnI satya lukAu~daicha |
yo satya timIharUko pAlanakartAko tarphabATa ho tyasakAraNa timIharU sandehakartAharUmadhye kadApi nahunU |

pratyekako lAgi euTA dizA cha, tyataitira tyo pharkane gardacha | tyasaile satkarmaharUmA agrasaratA dekhAU | jahA~sukai bhae pani allAhale timI sabailAI ekatrita garnechan | nissandeha allAha sampUrNa kAryaharUko sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

ra, timI jahA~sukaibATa niske pani (namAjamA) Aphno muhAra ‘masjide harAma’ (kaabA) tarpha pharkAU | nissandeha timrA ‘raba’ ko tarphabATa yo bilakulai satya (nirNaya) ho ra allAha timIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUbATa anabhijJa chainan |

ra, (he sandeSTA!) timI jahA~sukaibATa niske pani (namAjamA) Aphno muhAra ‘masjide harAma’ tarpha pharkAU | ra, (he musalamAnaharU ho!) timIharU jahA~sukai bhae pani tyasaitarpha Aphno anuhAra pharkAU tAki mAnisaharUkA lAgi timIharUviruddha kunai tarka bA~kI narahos | jahA~samma yinIharUmadhye atyAcArIharUko kurA cha tinIharUko bhaya narAkha, mero mAtra bhaya rAkha tAki ma timIharUmAthi Aphno varadAna pUrA garU~ ra AzA cha ki timIharU satmArga pAunechau |

jasarI hAmIle timIharUkA lAgi timIharUmadhyebATai ekajanA rasUla paThAyauM jasale timIharUlAI hAmrA AyataharU sunAu~chan ra timIharulAI zuddha pArchana ra timIharUlAI Izagrantha tathA tatvadarzitAko zikSA dinchan ra tI kurAharU sikAu~chan juna timIharU jAndainathyau |
ataH malAI samjhirAkha ma timIlAI samjhanechu | maprati kRtajJatA prakaTa gara ra kRtaghnatA nadekhAU |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! dhairya evaM namAjabATa sahAyatA prApta gara | nissandeha allAha dhairyavAnaharUkA sAthamA chan |
allAhako mArgamA mArineharUlAI murdA nabhana | unIharU jIvita chan tara timIharUlAI yasako anubhUti hu~daina |
nizcaya nai trAsa, bhoka, dhanamAla, jyAna ra phalaphUlako hAni–noksAnIdvArA hAmI timIharUko jA~ca linechauM | ani, dhairyavAnaharUlAI zubha–sandeza sunAideU;
jasale saMkaTako samayamA bhanne garchan– “innA lillAhi va innA ilaihi rAjiUna |” (hAmI allAha kai hauM ra unaitarpha pharkera jAnechauM |)
yinai hun tI mAnisaharU jasamAthi allAhako baradAna tathA dayA hunecha ra yinIharU nai satmArgamA chan |

nissandeha ‘saphA’ ra ‘marvA’ (pahADaharU) allAhakA cinArIharUmadhyekA hun | allAhako ghara (kAabA) ko ‘haja’ tathA ‘umarA’ garneharU yI dubaibIca dagurchan bhane unIharUmAthi kunai Apatti chaina | ra, jasale svecchAle kunai satkarma garcha usale tyasako pUrA pratiphala pAunecha | nissandeha allAha guNagrAhI evaM sarvajJa chan |

allAha dhikkArchan ra dhikkArneharU pani dhikkArchan yastA mAnisaharUlAI jo hAmIle avataraNa garekA khullA pramANaharU ra mArgadarzanalAI lukAu~dachan | jabaki tyasalAI hAmIle mAnava jAtikAlAgi granthamA spaSTasa~ga varNana garisakekA chauM |

tara, jo taubA (prAyazcita) garchan, sudhAra garchan ra (lukAiekA kurAharU) spaSTasa~ga varNana garchan tyastA mAnisaharUko prAyazcita ma svIkAra garnechu | ra, ma prAyazcita svIkArakartA evaM parama dayAlu chu |
juna mAnisaharUle kuphra gare ra kuphra kai avasthAmA mRtyuvaraNa gare tinIharUmAthi allAha, phariztAharU tathA sampUrNa mAnavajAtiko dhikkAra cha |
unIharU tyasa avasthAmA sadA–sarvadA rahanechan | na tinIharUko yAtanA kama garinecha na ta tinIharUle kunai avasara nai pAunechan |
ra timIharUkA Izvara euTai Izvara hun | unIbAheka kohI upAsya chaina | unI atyanta karuNAmaya evaM parama dayAlu chan |

AkAzaharu tathA dhartIko sRSTimA, rAta evaM dinako ekapachi arkoko Avata–jAvatamA, mAnisaharUkA lAgi lAbhadAyaka sAmagrIharU liera samudramA hi~Dne DuGgAharUmA, AkAzabATa allAhale barSAekA pAnImA jasabATa unale murdA bhUmilAI jIvita pArchan ani dhartImA dherai prakArakA jIva–jantu phailAu~chan tathA hAvAko bahanakriyAmA ra AkAza evaM pRthvIbIca niyantraNamA rAkhiekA bAdalamA nizcaya nai buddhimAnaharUkA lAgi nizAnIharU chan |

ra, kehI mAnisaharU yastA chan jo allAhabAheka arUlAI unako samakakSI ThaharyAu~chan ra tinIharUsita yasarI prema garchan jasarI allAhasita mAtra garnuparne ho jabaki AsthAvAnaharU allAhasitako premamA ati dRDha hunchan | kati jAti hune thiyo– juna kurA yAtanA dekhepachi atyAcArIharUle thAhA pAune thie, tyo ahile nai unIharUle thAhA pAekA bhae ki sampUrNa zaktikA mAlika allAha hun | ra, allAha kaThora daNDadAtA pani hun |
tyasa dina anusaraNa garine (aguvA) harU AphnA anuyAyIharUbATa virakti pradarzana garnechan | tinIharU sabaile yAtanA dekhnechan ra tinIharU bIcako sambandha chinnabhinna hunecha |

anuyAyIharUle bhannechan– “pheri (saMsAramA) pharkina pAe hAmIharU pani tinIharUsita tyasarI nai virakti pradarzana garne thiyauM jasarI tinIharU hAmIharusa~ga gardaichan | yasarI allAhale tinIharukA karmaharUlAI pazcAttApa banAera tinIharUlAI dekhAunechan ra tinIharU narakabATa umkana pAune chainan |
he mAnava! dhartImA rahekA vaidha (halAla) evaM pavitra vastuharUmadhyebATa khAU ra zaitAnakA padcinhaharUko anusaraNa nagara | nissandeha tyo timro khullama—khullA zatru ho |
usale timIharUlAI kevala pApa ra azlIla kAryaharU garna ra allAhako bAremA timIharUlAI jJAna nai nabhaekA kurAharU bhanna lagAu~cha |

ra, jaba tinIharUlAI allAhadvArA avatarita dharmako anusaraNa garna bhanincha, taba tinIharU bhanchan– “hAmI ta tyasaiko anusaraNa garnechauM jasamA AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI pAekA chauM |” ke tinIharU AphnA purkhAharU kai anusaraNa garnechan cAhe tinIharUle katti pani buddhi napuryAekA hoUn ra na satmArga nai prApta garekA hoUn?

ra, kAphiraharUko upamA yasto cha ki euTA goThAlole janAvaraharUlAI DAkdacha ra tI janAvaraharU goThAloko pukAra, karAi ra cicyAIbAheka arU kehI sundainan | yinIharU bahirA hun, lATA hun, andhA hun tyasaile ta kurA bujhdainan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! hAmIle pradAna garekA pavitra khAnekurAharU khAU | ra, timIharU allAha kai upAsanA garchau bhane unIprati nai kRtajJa hoU |

allAhale timIharUkA nimti mRta jantu, ragata ra suMgurako mAsu ra tI kurAharu juna allAhabAheka arU kasailAI samarpita garieko hos | tara, jo bAdhya cha tyasale avajJAko manasAya narAkhI ra sImA nanAghIkana prayoga garcha bhane usalAI kunai pApa lAgne chaina | nissandeha allAha atyantai kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

nissandeha juna mAnisaharU allAhale Aphno granthamA avataraNa garekA AdezaharUlAI lukAu~dachan ra thorai sAMsArika lAbha prApta garnakA lAgi tyasako bheMTa caDhAu~chan tinIharUle Aphno peTamA Ago mAtra bharirahekA hunchan | mahApralayako dina allAhale na tinIharUsa~ga kurA garnechan ra na tinIharUlAI cokhyAunechan | ra, tinIharUkA lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA raheko cha |
yI tI mAnisaharU hun jasale satmArgalAI choDera pathabhraSTatA ra kSamAlAI choDera yAtanA molekA chan | yI mAnisaharUle AgomA jalne kasto dussAhasa garchan ta!
yasako kAraNa yo ho ki allAhale yasa granthalAI satyakA sAtha avataraNa gare tara yasa granthako bAremA matabheda garneharU yasako virodhamA (satyatAbATa) dherai TADhA pugisake |

satkarma yo hoina ki timI Aphno anuhAra pUrva vA pazcimatira pharkAU, baru satkarma yo ho ki mAnisaharU allAha, Akhiratako dina, phariztAharU, Iza–grantha tathA nabIharUmAthi AsthAvAna hoUn | sampattiprati moha hu~dA–hu~dai Aphanta, anAtha, garIba, baTuvA ra maganteharUlAI diUn ani dAsamuktiko lAgi kharca garUn, namAja kAyama garUn, jakAta adA garUn, vAcA garemA tyasa vAcAlAI pUrA garUn, saMkaTa, vipatti tathA yuddhako avasthAmA dhairya garUn | yinIharU nai saccA hun ra yinIharU nai Izabhaya rAkhneharU hun |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUmAthi hatyAko mAmalAmA kisAsa (hatyA–daNDa) anivArya garieko cha | svatantra vyaktile hatyA garemA tyahI svatantra vyaktiko prati–hatyA garinecha; dAsale hatyA garemA tyahI dAsako ra strI aparAdhI bhaemA tyahI strIko | tara, mRtakako bhAIbandhule hatyArAlAI kSamA garna cAhemA niyamapUrvaka pratihiMsAko badalAmA artha–daNDa lAgU garnupardacha ra hatyArAle rAmrosa~ga arthadaNDa tirnupardacha | yo timrA ‘raba’ ko tarphabATa eka prakArako chUTa tathA dayA ho | jasale yasapachi pani sImA ullaGghana garcha usako lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA raheko cha |
he buddhijIvIharU ho! kisAsa (hatyAko barAbara DhaMgale badalA linu) mA timIharuko lAgi jIvana cha, AzA cha ki timIharU satkarmI bannechau |

yadi timIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyu najika Aeko cha ra kehI dhana sampatti choDdaichau bhane AmA—buvA tathA nAtedAraharUkA lAgi sAmAnya tarIkAle vasIyata garnu timIharUmAthi anivArya garieko cha | yo allAhasa~ga bhaya rAkhneharUko kartabya ho |
ani jasale vasIyata sunera pachi tyasamA pherabadala garcha, tyasako pApa tyasai pherabadala garnevAlAlAI lAgcha | nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

yadi kasailAI vasIyatakartAmAthi pakSapAta vA jyAdatI gareko zaGkA lAgyo ra usale unIharUbIca milApatra garidiyo bhane usalAI kunai pApa lAgne chaina | nissandeha allAha atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUmAthi siyAma (brata) anivArya garieko cha jasarI timIharUbhandA aghikA mAnisaharUmAthi anivArya garieko thiyo | AzA cha ki timIharUbhitra Iza–bhaya utpanna hunecha |

(bratakA dinaharU) gintIkA kehI dinaharU hun tasartha yadi timIharUmadhye kohI birAmI cha vA yAtrAmA cha bhane tyasale tyo saMkhyA anya dinaharUmA pUrA garnupardacha | jasale siyAmako sAmathrya rAkhcha (tara brata rAkhdaina) unIharUle ‘phidayA' tirnuparcha | (pratyeka dinavApata) ekajanA garIbalAI khAnA khuvAunu pardacha ra kasaile AphUkhusI baDhI puNya garcha bhane tyo usaiko hakamA rAmro hunecha | tara, timIharUle bujhne ho bhane timIharUkA nimti siyAma rAkhnu nai ucita huncha |

ramajAnako mahinA tyo mahinA ho jasamA kuraAna avataraNa gariyo; yo mAnava jAtikAlAgi mArgadarzana ho ra yasamA satmArgako lAgi ra satya tathA asatyabIca pharaka chuTyAune spaSTa pramANaharU chan | ataH timIharUmadhye jasale yasa mahinAlAI pAu~cha usale anivArya rUpamA yasako brata rAkhos ra jo birAmI cha vA yAtrAmA cha usale arU dinaharUmA brata rAkhI tyasako gantI pUrA garos | allAha timrolAgi suvidhA cAhanchan; timIharUlAI kaSTamA pArna cAha~dainan tAki timIharUle saMkhyA pUrA gara | ra, unale juna sIdhA mArga timIharUlAI dekhAekA chan tyasakA lAgi allAhako stuti gara | AzA cha ki timI kRtajJa bannechau |

(he sandeSTA!) merA bhaktaharU mero viSayamA timIlAI sodhchan bhane (bhanideU)– “ma najikai chu ra pukArnevAlAle malAI pukAremA usako pukAra svIkAra garchu | ataH unIharUle mero pukArako uttara diUn ra maprati AsthA rAkhUn tAki unIharUle satmArga pAuna sakUn |”

timIharukA lAgi siyAmakA rAtaharUmA AphnA patnIharUsa~ga sahavAsa vaidha garieko cha | unIharU timIharUkA lAgi pozAka hun ra timIharU unIharUkA lAgi pozAka | allAhalAI thAhA cha ki timIharU AphaibATa kapaTa garirahekA thiyau tara allAhale timIharUmAthi dayA gare ra kSamA sameta gare | aba timIharU AphnA patnIharUsa~ga sahavAsa gara | ra, allAhale timIharukA lAgi je lekhekA chan tyo prApta gara ani bihAnIko seto rekhA (rAtako) kAlo rekhAbATa spaSTa nahounjela khAnapina gara | ani, rAta (ko Agamana) samma rojA rAkha | ra timIharU patnIharUsa~ga sambhoga nagara jaba masjidamA eatikAphamA basekA chau | yI allAhakA sImAharU hun | ataH tyasako nikaTa najAU | yasarI allAha AphnA AyataharU lAI mAnavajAtikA lAgi spaSTa rUpamA bayAna gardachan tAki unIharU (kukarmabATa) bacUn |

timIharU ekaarkAkA sampatti anAhakamA nakhAU ra tyasalAI nyAyakartAharU samakSa yasa uddezyale peza nagara ki timIharUlAI mAnisaharUko sampattiko kunai aMza jAnI–jAnI anyAyapUrNa DhaGgale khAne avasara prApta hos |

(he muhammada!) mAnisaharUle timIsita candramAko (ghaTdo baDhdo avasthAharU) bAremA sodhdachan; bhanideU– “tyo ta mAnisaharUkA lAgi miti nirdhAraNa garne tathA hajako samaya thAhA pAune mAdhyama ho |” ra (tinIharUlAI yo pani bhana ki) gharamA pachADibATa praveza garnu satkarma hoina baru satkarmI tI hun jo (avajJAbATa) bacdachan | ani gharabhitra DhokAbATa praveza gara ra allAhasa~ga DarAU tAki timIharU saphala huna saka |
ra, allAhako mArgamA timIharU AphUviruddha yuddha garne mAnisaharUsa~ga yuddha gara tara jyAdatI nagara | nissandeha allAha jyAdatI garneharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |

ra, (yuddhAvasthAmA) tinIharUlAI jahA~ pAu~chau tyahI~ hatyA gara ra timIharU pani tinIharUlAI tyahA~bATa nikAla jahA~bATa tinIharUle timIharUlAI nikAlekA thie kinabhane phitanA (upadrava) hatyAbhandA pani jhan ghAtaka huncha | ra, pratiSThita masjida (kAabA) najika tinIharUsa~ga yuddha nagara jabasamma tinIharU timIharUsa~ga tyahA~ yuddha gardainan | yadi tinIharU timIharUsa~ga yuddha garchan bhane tinIharUko hatyA garideU | yastA avajJAkArIharUko yahI sajAya~ ho |
yadi tinIharU (yuddhabATa) rokinchan bhane allAha atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chana |

ra, tinIharUsa~ga yuddha gara yahA~samma ki upadrava bA~kI narahos ra dIna (dharma) kevala allAhakA lAgi hoos | yadi tinIharU vidhvaMsabATa rokinchan bhane atyAcArIharUbAheka kasaimAthi kunai prakArako kAravAhI nagara |

pratiSThita mahinAko badalA pratiSThita mahinA nai huncha | ra, sampUrNa pratiSThita vastuharUko sammAna eka samAna cha | ataH jasale timImAthi (yI mahinAharUmA) jyAdatI garcha timIharU pani usalAI usale gareko jyAdatI barAbara nai javApha deU ra allAhako bhaya rAkha ani jAnirAkha, allAha bhaya rAkhneharUkA sAthamA chan |
ani, allAhako mArgamA kharca gara | ra, AphUlAI Aphnai hAtabATa barabAda nagara | sAthai uttama DhaMgale rAmrarI kAma gara | nissandeha allAha uttama DhaMgale kAma garneharUlAI prema gardachan |

ra, allAhakA lAgi haja tathA umarA gara | yadi timIharU gheriyau bhane upalabdha janAvara tyahI~ kurabAnI (balidAna) gara | kurabAnIkA janAvaraharU kurabAnI sthalasamma napugesamma Aphno TAuko muNDana nagarAU | ra, timIharUmadhye jo birAmI cha vA jasako TAukomA kunai samasyA cha usale phidayA (badalA vA kSatipUrti) ko rUpamA siyAma (brata) rAkhos vA sadakA (dAnadakSiNA) vA bali deos | ra, jaba timIharU surakSita avasthAmA hunchau tyatibelA jo hajakA sAthai umarAbATa pani lAbhAnvita huna cAhancha usale kSamatA anusAra kurabAnI garnupardacha ra jasale kurabAnI garna sakdaina usale hajakA dinaharUmA tIna dina ra pharkepachi sAta dina siyAma (brata) rAkhnu pardacha | yI jammA dasadina bhae; yo (chUTa) unIharUkA lAgi ho jasako gharabAra masjide harAma (kAabA) ko najikamA chaina | ra, allAhako bhaya rAkha ra jJAta hos– allAha kaThora daNDadAtA hun |

hajakA mahinAharU prakhyAta chan tasartha jasale yI mahinAharUmA hajako nizcaya garcha usale hajakA dinaharUmA na sambhoga garos, na anaitika kArya garos ra na laDAi–jhagaDA nai garos | timIharUle juna puNya karma garnechau allAhalAI thAhA huncha | (hajakA lAgi) sAmala (bATA–kharca) liera jAU ra sababhandA utkRSTa sAmala ‘takvA’ (Izabhaya) ho | ra, he buddhimAnaharu ho! mero avajJAbATa baca |

timIharUle AphnA pAlanakartAko anugraha khojdA kunai Apatti chaina ra ‘araphAta’ bATa pharkadA ‘mazare harAma (mujadalphA)’ mA allAhalAI yAda gara | unalAI yasa kAraNale yAda gara ki unale nai timIharUlAI satmArga dekhAe jabaki timIharU yasabhandA pahile pathabhraSTa thiyau |
ra, tyasapachi arU mAnisaharU prasthAna garekai ThAu~bATa timIharU pani prasthAna gara ani allAhasa~ga kSamAyAcanA gara | nissandeha allAha atyantai kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

ani, (hajakA) sabai rItiharU pUrA garisakepachi jasarI timIharU AphnA pUrkhAharUko samjhanA garne garchau tyasarI nai vA tyasabhandA pani baDhI allAhalAI yAda gara | mAnisaharUmadhye yastA pani chan jasale bhandachan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI sampUrNa bhalAI saMsAra mai deU |” yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi paralokamA kunai aMza chaina |

ra, unIharUmadhye kohI yastA chan jo (prArthanA gardai) bhandachan– “he hAmrA raba! hAmIlAI saMsAramA bhalAI pradAna gara ra paralokamA pani bhalAI pradAna gara | ra, hAmIlAI narakako yAtanAbATa bacAU |”
yinIharU nai hun jasale AphUle gareko karmako phala pAunechan ra allAhale cA~Dai nai hisAba linechan |

ra, yI gantIkA dinaharUmA allAhako khUbai stuti gara tara jo hatAra garI duI dina mai pharkancha usakA lAgi kunai pApa chaina ra jo ajha baDhI rahancha usalAI pani kunai pApa chaina | yo kurA bhaya rAkhne mAnisaharUkA lAgi ho | allAhako bhaya rAkha ra jAnirAkha– “unaikA sAmu timIharU ekatrita garinechau |”

mAnisaharUmadhye kohI yasto pani cha jasako kurA timIlAI sAMsArika jIvanamA khUbai rAmro lAgcha | ra, usale Aphno manako kurAlAI satya tulyAuna allAhalAI sAkSI banAu~cha jabaki U ThUlo jhagaDAlu cha |
tara, jaba usalAI sattA prApta huncha taba U dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAuna ani khetI evaM (mAnava tathA pazuko) vaMzalAI vinAza pArna sakriya rahancha; ra allAhale vidhvaMsa mana parAu~dainan |
ra, jaba usalAI allAhasa~ga bhaya rAkhna bhanincha taba usako ghamanDale usalAI pApamA lipta pArdacha | usako lAgi naraka nai paryApta cha | ra, yo ati narAmro bAsasthAna ho |
ra, mAnisaharUmadhye kohI yasto pani cha jo allAhako prasannatA prAptikA lAgi svayaMlAI (allAhasamakSa) becidincha | ra, allAha upAsakaharUprati atyantai snehI chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! islAmamA pUrNarUpale praveza gara | ra, zaitAnakA padacinhaharUko anusaraNa nagara | nissandeha tyo timro khullama-khullA zatru ho |
spaSTa zikSAharU timIkahA~ Aisakepachi pani yadi timI bahakiyau bhane jAnirAkha allAha atyanta prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
ke tinIharU yasa pratIkSAmA chan ki allAha ra phariztAharU pani tinIharUsamakSa bAdalako chAnAmA prakaTa hoUn ani phaisalA nai garidiUn? antataH sArA mAmalA allAha kai sAmu peza garinechan |

(he mummada sa.!) isrAIlakA santatilAI sodha, hAmIle tinIharUlAI kastA kastA spaSTa nizAnIharU pradAna garekA thiyauM bhanera | jasale allAhako baradAna pAera pani tyasalAI parivartana garcha usale jAni rAkhos ki allAha yAtanA dinamA ati kaDA chan |

kAphiraharUkA lAgi sAMsArika jIvana zobhanIya banAieko cha ra yastA mAnisaharU AsthAvAnaharUko upahAsa garchan jabaki allAhako avajJAbATa bacneharU nai mahApralayakA dina avajJAkArIharUbhandA ucca sthAnamA hunechan | ra, allAha jasalAI cAhanchan apAra jIvikA pradAna gardachan |

(zurumA) mAnava euTai ummata (samudAya) thiyo | ra, allAhale nabIharUlAI zubha–sUcaka tathA sacetaka banAera paThAe | ani, unIharUmArphat satyamA AdhArita grantha avataraNa gare tAki mAnisaharUbIca vidyamAna matabhinnatAko bAremA nirNaya garna sakUn | yasako virodha pani tinIharUle nai gare jasalAI satya jJAna diisakieko thiyo | tinIharUle spaSTa nizAnIharU pAisakepachi pani kevala paraspara atikramaNa garne uddezyale satyalAI choDera bhinna mArgaharU apanAe | ra,juna mAnisaharUle imAna lyAe tinIharUlAI allAhale Aphno anumatibATa tyasa satyako bATo dekhAe jasamA mAnisaharUle vibheda garekA thie | allAha jasalAI cAhanchan sIdhA mArga dekhAu~chan |

ke timIharU svargamA tyasai praveza garnechau bhanne ThAnekA chau jabaki timIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUko jasto saGkaTa timIharUmAthi Aekai chaina? unIharU ThUlA–ThUlA kaThinAI tathA duHkhamA pilsie ra yasarI ghacghacyAie ki tyasa samayakA rasUla ra unakA sAthamA rahekA AsthAvAnaharUsameta cicyAuna puge– “allAhako sahAyatA kahile Aune ho ta?” suna, nizcaya nai allAhako sahAyatA najikai cha |

(he muhammada sa.!) mAnisaharUle timIlAI sodhdachan ki unIharUle ke kasto dhana kharca garUn? bhanideU–“dhana–sampattibATa je kharca garchau tyo mAtA–pitA, nAtedAra, anAtha, asahAya evaM baTuvAharUkA lAgi hos |” jejati bhalAI timI garchau allAha tI sabai jAndachan |

timIharUmAthi yuddha anivArya garieko cha jabaki yo timIharUlAI apriya cha ra huna sakcha timI euTA kurA mana naparAU tara tyo timIharukA lAgi rAmro hos | ra, huna sakcha timIharU euTA kurA mana parAU tara tyo timIharukA nimti narAmro hos | ra, allAha jAndachan baru timIharU po jAndainau |

(he muhammada sa.!) mAnisaharU timIsa~ga pratiSThita mahinAmA yuddha garnu kasto cha bhanI sodhdachan | bhanideU– “tyasamA yuddha ThUlo (pApako) kurA ho tara mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa roknu, allAhakAsAtha kuphra (avajJA) garnu, masjide harAma (jAna) bATa roknu ra tyahA~kA bAsIharulAI tyahA~bATa niskAsita garnu allAhako dRSTimA tyasabhandA pani ThUlo (pApako) kurA ho | ani, phitanA (utpAta) hatyAbhandA pani ThUlo (aparAdha) ho |” ra, yinIharU timIharUsita nirantara yuddha garirahanechan; yahA~samma ki sAmathrya pugemA timIharUlAI timIharUko dharmabATa nai vimukha pAridinechan | ra, timIharUmadhye jo pani Aphno dharmabATa niskancha ani kuphra kai avasthAmA tyasako nidhana huncha, tyastA mAnisaharUkA karmaharU loka tathA paraloka dubaimA nirarthaka hunechan | tinIharU narakamA jAneharU hun jahA~ sadAsarvadA rahanechan |
nissandeha juna mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAe, hijarata (basAIsarAI) gare ra allAhako mArgamA jihAda gare tyastA mAnisaharU nai allAhako kRpAkA ummedavAra hun ra allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM dayAvAna chan |

(he muhammada sa.!) mAnisaharUle timIsa~ga raksI evaM jUvAbAre sodhchan | bhanideU– “yI dubaimA ThUlo pApa cha | ra, mAnisaharUkA lAgi kehI phAidA pani chan tara tinakA pApaharU tinakA lAbhabhandA dherai nai baDhI chan |” ra, unIharU timIsa~ga kuna sampatti kharca garne bhanera sodhchan | bhanideU– “juna baceko cha |” yasaprakAra allAha timIharUkA lAgi Aphno Adeza spaSTa pArchan | AzA cha timIharU viveka prayoga garnechau |

loka tathA paraloka (dubaikA mAmalAharU) mA | ra, unIharU timIsa~ga anAthaharUko bAremA sodhdachan | bhanideU– “jemA tinIharUko sthiti sudhrincha tyahI rAmro ho | ra, yadi timIharU unIharUlAI milAera rAkhna cAhanchau bhane unIharU timrA bhAIbandhu nai hun | ani, allAha bhalAI garne ra anaitika karma garne (dubai) lAI rAmrarI jAndachan | ra, allAhale cAheko bhae timIharUlAI kaThinAimA pArne thie | nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |”

ra, muzrika strIharUsa~ga tinIharUle ImAna nalyAunjela bihe nagara | nissandeha AsthAvAna dAsI, muzrika strIbhandA zreSTha hunche cAhe tyo (muzrika) timIharUlAI ati priya lAgos | ani, tyastai muzrika puruSaharUsa~ga tinIharUle ImAna nalyAunjela (AsthAvAna strIharUko) vivAha nagara | momina dAsa cAhi~ muzrika puruSabhandA zreSTha huncha cAhe timIharUlAI tyo (muzrika) ati priya hos | yinIharUle narakatarpha bolAu~chan jabaki allAha Aphno anujJAbATa svarga evaM kSamAtarpha Amantrita gardachan ra unale AphnA zikSAharU mAnisaharUkA lAgi spaSTa rUpamA batAu~chan jasale gardA tinIharUle upadeza grahaNa garUn |

ra, unIharU timIsa~ga rajasvalAko bAremA sodhdachan | bhanideU– “yo eka prakArako apavitratA ho |” ani, rajasvalAko avasthAmA strIharUbATa alaga basa ra tinIharU pavitra nahounjelasamma tinIharuko najika najAU | jaba tinIharU pavitra hunchan taba tinIharUkahA~ tyahA~bATa AU jahA~bATa jAne allAhale timIharUlAI Adeza diekA chan | nissandeha allAha dherai taubA (prAyazcita) garne tathA saphAsugghara rahaneharUlAI mana parAu~chan |

timrA patnIharU timIharUkA nimti khetI hun | jasarI cAhanchau Aphno khetImA jAU ra Aphno bhaviSyako cintA gara | ra, allAhako bhaya rAkha ani jAnirAkha timIharUle allAhasa~ga bheTnu cha |” ra, AsthAvAnaharUlAI zubha sUcanA deU |
ra, timIharU satkarma, vaphAdArI, Izabhaya tathA mAnisaharUbIcako sambandha sudhArne kAryalAI chADnako lAgi allAhako nAmalAI Aphno kasamako bahAnA nabanAU | allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

binA manasAyakA nirarthaka kasamaharUkA bAremA allAhale timIharUko pakaDa garne chainan | tara hRdayale nizcaya garekA kasamaharUmA bhane unale timro pakaDa garnechan | allAha kSamAzIla evaM sahanazIla chan |
AphnA patnIharUsa~ga alaga basne kasama khAneharUkA lAgi cAra mahinAsammako samayasimA cha | yadi unIharU pharkinchan bhane allAha kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ra, yadi unIharUle talAka (vivAha–viccheda) ko nizcaya garchan bhane jAni rAkhUn allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

talAka pAekA strIharu tIna paTaka rajasvalA nabhaesamma AphUlAI rokI rAkhUn | yadi unIharU allAha evaM AkhiratamAthi AsthA rAkhchan bhane allAhale unIharUkA garbhAzayaharUmA sRSTi garekA cijalAI lukAunu unIharUkA lAgi vaidha chaina | yasa avadhimA unIharUkA patiharUle sambandha sudhArne irAdA garemA tinIharUle unIharUlAI phirtA line baDhI adhikAra rAkhchan | mahilAharUlAI pani puruSaharUjastai sAmAnya niyama anusAra adhikAra cha | tara puruSaharUlAI unIharUmAthi eka zreNI uccatA prApta cha | ra, allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

talAka duI paTaka mAtra huncha | tyasapachi yA sAmAnyataH (strIlAI dAmpatya jIvana mai) rokirAkhnu parcha vA ucita tavaramA vidA garidinu pardacha | ra, (vidA garemA) timIharukA lAgi tinIharUlAI dieko kunai cija phirtA linu vaidha chaina | (tyasto paristhitimA mAtra phirtA linu vaidha cha) jaba dubailAI allAhakA sImAharU kAyama rAkhne kurAmA sandeha huncha | ani yadi timIharUlAI unIharUle allAhakA sImAharUlAI kAyama rAkhna sakdainan bhanne Dara cha bhane patnIle kehI diera alaga bhaemA dubaimAthi kunai pApa chaina | yI allAhakA sImAharU hun; yasako ullaGghana nagara | ra, jasale allAhakA sImAharUko ullaGghana garchan tinIharu nai atyAcArI hun |

patile pheri (tesro paTaka) talAka diyo bhane tyo mahilA aba usakA lAgi vaidha hune chaina sivAya yasako ki usale kohI arUsa~ga vivAha garos ani pheri tyasale pani usalAI talAka deos | ra, dubailAI allAhako sImA kAyama rAkhne kurAmA vizvAsa cha bhane punaH bihe garemA kunai pApa lAgne chaina | ra, yI allAhakA sImAharU hun jasalAI unale jJAnIharUkA lAgi spaSTa pArekA chan |

ra, timIharUle strIharUlAI talAka diemA ra unIharUko ‘iddata’ pUrA huna lAgemA ki ta sAmAnya niyamAnusAra rokihAla (dAmpatya jIvanamA rAkhirAkha) ki ta sAmAnya niyamAnusAra bidA garideU | tara, unIharUlAI hAni puryAuna ra atyAcAra garne uddezyale naroka | yasto garneharU svayaMmAthi atyAcAra garchan | allAhakA AdezaharUlAI khyAla–ThaTTA nabanAU ra allAhale timIharUmAthi garekA kRpA ra unale avataraNa garekA grantha evaM tatvadarzitAlAI yAda gara | allAha timIharUlAI yasaiko upadeza dinchan ra allAhako bhaya rAkha ani jAnirAkha– allAha hareka cijakA jJAtA hun |

ra, timIharUle AphnA strIharulAI talAka diepachi tinIharUle Aphno iddata (avadhi) pUrA garI yadi tI dubai sAmAnya niyamAnusAra vivAha garna rAjI chan bhane Aphno (hunevAlA) patisa~ga bihe garna cAhemA naroka | yo upadeza timIharUmadhye allAha evaM AkhiratamAthi AsthA rAkhne sabailAI diincha | yo timIharUkA lAgi ziSTa evaM pavitra tarIkA ho | ra, allAha jAndachan; timIharU po jAndainau |

jasale dudha khuvAune avadhi pUrA garna cAhanchan tI AmAharUle AphnA zizuharUlAI duI varSasamma dUdha khuvAUn ra dUdha khuvAune AmAharUko khAnA ani lugAphAToko jimmevArI sAmAnya niyamAnusAra zizuko bAbumAthi rahancha | kunai pani vyaktilAI tyati mAtra uttaradAyitva bahana garna diinu pardacha jati usale garne sAmathrya rAkhdacha | na ta AmAlAI usako zizuko kAraNale duHkha diinecha ra na ta bAbulAI usako zizuko kAraNale duHkha diinecha | ra, (pitAko mRtyu bhaeko avasthAmA) tyo (jimmevArI) vArisa mAthi Au~cha | ra, dubaile ApasI samajhadArI evaM sallAhamA dudha chuTAuna cAhemA pani unIharUprati kunai Apatti chaina | ra, yadi timIharU AphnA zizuharUlAI (anya strIko) dUdha khuvAuna cAhanchau bhane yasamA pani kunai Apatti chaina yadi timIharUle nizcita gareko sAmAnya niyamAnusAra strIharUlAI bhuktAnI garchau bhane | ra, allAhako bhae rAkha | ani, jAnirAkha– “allAha timIharUle garekA sabai kAryalAI dekhirahekA chan |”

timIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyu huncha ra AphUpachADi patnIharU choDcha bhane tI jIvita rahekA patnIharU cAra mahInA dasa dinasamma parkhiUn | ra, iddata (nirdhArita avadhi) pUrA garepachi unIharUle Aphno lAgi sAmAnya niyamAnusAra je garemA pani unIharUmAthi kunai doSa lAgne chaina | timIharU je gardachau allAha tyasako khabara rAkhdachan |

timIharUmAthi kunai doSa lAgne chaina ki timIharU (iddatako antarAlamA) strIharUlAI sAGketika rUpamA biheko sandeza deU vA yasalAI manamA lukAera rAkha | allAhalAI rAmrarI thAhA cha ki timIharu tinIharuko samjhanA garnechau | tara timIharU gopya rUpamA kunai pani vacana tinIharUlAI nadeU | tara sAmAnya niyama anusAra kurA garnu beglai ho | iddata pUrA nahuJjela vivAhako nizcaya nagara ani jAnirAkha allAha timIharUko manakA kurA jAndachan | ataH unako bhaya rAkha | ani, jAnirAkha– nissandeha allAha kSamAzIla evaM sahanazIla chan |

strIharUlAI chunu (sahavAsa garnu) vA mahara nirdhAraNa garnubhandA pahile nai talAka diemA timIharUmAthi kunai Apatti chaina | tara, unIharUlAI kehI sampatti avazya deU | sampanna vyaktile Aphno sAmarthya anusAra tathA garIbale Aphno sAmarthya anusAra sAmAnya niyama mutAbika diUn | satkarmIharUmAthi yo jimmevArI ho |

yadi timIharUle chunubhandA pahile tara ‘mahara’ nirdhAraNa garisakepachiko avasthAmA unIharUlAI talAka dinchau bhane timIharUle nirdhArita ‘mahara’ ko AdhA tirnuparcha; yo beglai kurA ho ki strIharUle svayaM choDidinechan vA hAtamA biheko bandhana hune (pati) le namratA apanAunechan (pUrA mahara dinechan) | ra, timIharU namratA apanAU, yo IzaparAyaNatA anukUla cha | ra timIharUbIca ekalAI arkomAthi juna zreSThatA prApta cha tyo nabirsa ra je timIharU garchau allAha dekhirahekA chan |
namAja ra vizeSa rUpamA bIcako namAjako rakSA gara | ra, allAhakA sAmu pUrNa bhakti evam vinayakA sAtha ubhine gara |
trAsadIpUrNa avasthAmA paidala vA savAra jasarI sambhava cha namAja adA gara ani jaba nizcinta hunchau taba allAhalAI tyasarI yAda gara jasarI unale timIharUlAI sikAekA chan juna timI jAndainathyau |

ra timIharUmadhye jUna mAnisaharuko mRtyu (ko samaya) hoos ra AphUpachi AphnA patnIharu choDna lAgekA hoUna, (unIharule) patnIharUkA lAgi gharabATa nanikAlI eka varSasamma khAnA–kharca diine antima Adeza (vasIyata) garun, pherI tinIharU (patnIharu) svayaM niskanchan ra sAmAnya niyamAnusAra Aphno lAgi kehI garchan bhane tyasako lAgi timIharUmAthi kunai doSa chaina | ra, allAha atyanta prabhutvazAlI evam tatvadarzI chan |
ra, talAka pAisakekA strIharUlAI sAmAnya niyamAnusAra khAnAkharca dinu Izabhaya rAkhneharUmAthi anivArya cha |
yasa prakAra allAha timIharUkA lAgi AphnA AdezaharU spaSTa rUpamA batAu~chan | AzA cha timIharUle viveka prayoga garnechau |

ke timIharUle tI mAnisaharulAI dekhenau jo hajArauMko saMkhyAmA bhaetApani mRtyuko Darale Aphno gharabAra choDera bhAgekA thie? ani, allAhale bhane– “mari hAla |” allAhale tinIharUlAI punaH jIvita pAre | nissandeha allAha mAnisaharUprati udAra chan tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU kRtajJa chainan |
ra, allAhako mArgamA yuddha gara ra jAnirAkha ki allAha sarvazrotA evam sarvajJa chan |

kohI cha jo allAhalAI sarvazreSTha RNa deos ani usalAI allAhale kaiyauM guNA baDhAera phirtA garUn? ani ghaTAunu tathA baDhAunu dubai allAha kai hAtamA cha ra unaitarpha timIharU pharkAera laginechau |

ke timIharUle sandeSTA mUsApachi isrAIlakA santAnaharukA aguvAharUlAI dekhenau jaba unIharUle AphnA eka nabIsa~ga bhane–“hAmro lAgi euTA zAsaka niyukta garideU tAki hAmI allAhako mArgamA yuddha garauM |” sandeSTAle bhane– “ke yo sambhAvanA chaina ki timIharUmAthi yuddha anivArya gariepachi timIharUle yuddha nagara?” unIharUle bhane– “hAmI allAhako mArgamA yuddha kina gardainauM jabaki hAmIharu Aphno gharabArabATa nikAliekA ra santAnaharUbATa vaJcita gariekA chauM?” ani jaba unIharUlAI yuddhako Adeza diiyo taba unIharUmadhye kehI mAnisaharUbAheka bA~kI sabai vimukha bhae | ra, allAha atyAcArIharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |

ra (unIharUkA sandeSTAle) bhane– “allAhale tAlUtalAI timIharUkA lAgi zAsaka niyukta garekA chan |” unIharUle bhane– “unalAI hAmImAthi kasarI zAsana prApta huna sakcha? zAsanako baDhI hakadAra ta hAmI hauM ra unalAI ta prazasta sampatti pani pradAna garieko chaina |” sandeSTAle bhane– “allAhale unalAI timIharUmadhyebATa cayana garekA chan ra unalAI baDhI jJAna evaM zArIrika sabalatA pradAna garekA chan | allAha jasalAI cAhanchan Aphno rAjya pradAna gardachan ra allAha sarvasamRddha evaM sarvajJa chan |”

ra, unIharUkA nabIle bhane– “tyasa zAsakako nizAnIsvarupa timIharUsamakSa pAlanakartAko tarphabATa tyo sanduka Aipugcha jasabhitra timIharUkA lAgi zAnti–sAmagrI ra mUsA evam hArUnakA santatile choDekA vastuharUko zeSAMza hunechan jasalAI phariztAharUle samhAlekA hunechan | nissandeha, timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane yasamA timIharUkA nimti nizAnI cha |"

ra, jaba tAlUta senAharUlAI liera prasthAna gare taba unale bhane– “nizcaya nai allAhale euTA nadIdvArA timIharUko parIkSA linechan | ani jasale tyasabATa pAnI piunecha usako masa~ga kunai nAtA rahane chaina ra jasale tyasabATa cAkhena uhi mamadhyeko ho | tara eka aJjulI piemA kunai Apatti chaina |” tara, unIharUmadhye kehI vyaktibAheka sabaile tyasako pAnI khubai pie | tAlUta evaM unIsa~ga ImAna lyAekA mAnisaharUle nadI pAra garepachi bhane– “Aja jAlUta evaM usakA senAharUviruddha yuddha garne zakti hAmImA chaina |” tara, unIharUmadhye allAhasa~ga sAkSAt hunecha bhanI vizvAsa rAkhneharUle bhane– “katipaya sAnA samUhale allAhako AjJAdvArA ThUlA samUhamAthi vijaya prApta garekA chan ra allAha dhairyavAnaharUkA sAtha chan |”

ra, unIharU jAlUta evam usakA senAviruddha yuddhako lAgi tayAra bhaepachi prArthanA gare– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI baDhIbhandA baDhI dhairyatA pradAna gara ra hAmrA pAuharUlAI aTala pAra ani kAphira (avajJAkArI) harUko viruddhamA hAmIlAI sahayoga pradAna gara |”

antataH unIharule allAhako AjJAbATa tinIharUlAI parAjita gare ani dAUdale jAlUtako vadha gare | allAhale unalAI zAsana tathA tatvadarzitA pradAna gare ra je cAhe unalAI sikAe | allAhale mAnisaharUlAI ekaarkodvArA parAsta garI nahaTAeko bhae dhartImA vidhvaMsa phailine thiyo | tara, allAha mAnava jAtiprati udAra chan |
yI allAhakA AyataharU hun jasalAI hAmI satyakA sAtha timrosAmu paDhera sunAu~daichauM | nizcaya nai timI IzadUtaharUmadhyekA hau |

hAmIle yI IzadUtaharUmadhyebATa kehIlAI anya kehI IzadUtaharUmAthi zreSThatA pradAna garekA chauM | yinIharUmadhye kohIsa~ga allAhale svayaM kurAkAnI gare bhane kohIlAI anya haisiyatamA uccasthAna pradAna gare | ra maryama–putra IsAlAI hAmIle spaSTa nizAnIharU pradAna garyauM ra ‘rUhul–kudusa’ (pavitra AtmA) dvArA unalAI maddata garyauM | ra, yadi allAhale cAheko bhae tinIharUle rasUlaharUpazcAt spaSTa nizAnIharU pugepachi ApasamA jhagaDA garne thienan | parantu, tinIharUbIca matabheda bhayo ani tinIharUmadhye kehI AsthAvAna bhae bhane kehIle kuphra (anAsthA pradarzana) gare | allAhale cAheko bhae tinIharU ApasamA jhagaDA garne thienan | tara, allAha je cAhanchan tyo gardachan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! hAmIle timIharUlAI jejati rojI pradAna garekA chauM tyasamadhyebATa tyasa dinako AgamanapUrva nai kharca gara juna dina na kunai prakArako kinabeca hunecha; na mitratA ra na siphAriza nai kAma lAgnecha | kAphira (avajJAkArI) harU nai (vAstavamA) atyAcArI hun |

allAha– unIbAheka kohI upAsya chaina; jIvanta evam cirasthAyI chan | unalAI na uMgha lAgcha na nidrA nai | AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sampUrNa vastuharU unaikA hun | ko cha jasale unIkahA~ unako anumati binA siphAriza garna sakos? unI tinIharUkA agADi ra pachADikA sabai kurA jAndachan | ra, tinIharUle allAhako jJAnako kunai pani aMza allAhale nacAhesamma prApta garna sakdainan | unako prabhutva AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI sabaimAthi cha | ra tinIharUko saMrakSaNale unalAI thakita tulyAu~daina ra unI ucca tathA mahAn chan |

(islAma) dharmamA kunai jabarajastI chaina | pathabhraSTatAbATa mArgadarzana spaSTa rUpamA alaga bhaisakeko cha | ani nizcaya nai jasale tAgUta (sImA ullaGghanakArI) lAI asvIkAra garyo ra allAhamAthi ImAna lyAyo tyasale yasto bharapardo sahArA samAtyo jo kahilyai TuTne chaina | ra, allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

allAha AsthAvAnaharUkA saMrakSaka hun | unI tinIharUlAI andhakAraharUbATa nikAlI prakAzatarpha lyAu~chan ra kAphiraharUkA saMrakSaka cAhi~ tAgUta ho, jasale tinIharUlAI prakAzabATa nikAlI andhakAraharUtarpha DoryAu~cha | tinIharU narakamA jAneharU hun | tinIharU sadA tyasamA rahanechan |

ke timIle tyasa mAnisa (namrUda) ko bAremA vicAra garenau jasale ibrAhImasa~ga unakA pAlanakartAko sambandhamA vAdavivAda gareko thiyo yasakAraNale ki allAhale usalAI rAjyasattA pradAna garekA thie? jaba ibrAhImale bhane– “merA pAlanakartA tI hun jasale jIvana tathA mRtyu dinchan |” taba usale bhanyo– “ma pani jIvana tathA mRtyu dinchu |” ibrAhImale bhane– “allAhale sUryalAI pUrvabATa udaya garAu~chan; timIle pazcimabATa udaya garAera dekhAU |” ani tyo kAphira Azcarya cakita bhayo | ra, allAha atyAcArI samudAyalAI mArgadarzana garAudainan |

athavA (udAharaNakolAgi) tyasa mAnisalAI hera jo euTA yasto nagara hu~dai prasthAna gareko thiyo juna nagarakA gharaharU chAnAsahita bhatkera ghopTo parekA thie | unale bhane– “yasa nagarako vinAzapazcAt yasalAI allAhale kasarI jIvita pArlAn?” ani allAhale tyasa mAnisalAI ekasaya varSasammakA lAgi mRta tulyAe | punaH unalAI (jIvita pArI) uThAe | ani sodhe– “timI (tyasa avasthAmA) kati samayasamma rahyau ta?” usale bhanyo– “ekadina vA ekadinako kehI aMzasamma (raheM holA) |” allAhale bhane– “hoina, timI ekasaya varSasamma (mRta avasthAmA) rahyau | timro khAdya ra peya padArthatarpha hera | tinIharU saDekA pani chainan | tara, Aphno gadhAtarpha dRSTi lagAU (tyo ta saDisakeko cha) | timIlAI mAnisaharUkA lAgi nizAnI banAuna hAmIle yasto garekA hauM | ra, (gadhAko) haDDIharUtarpha hera | hAmI kasarI tinIharUkA DhA~cA khaDA garchauM ra tinIharUmA mAsu caDhAu~chauM!” jaba sabai kurA unakA sAmu spaSTa bhae taba tyasale pukArdai bhanyo– “nissandeha, allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan bhanne kurA maile thAhA pAe~ |”

ra, jaba ibrAhImale bhane– “he merA mAlika! timI kasarI mRtalAI jIvita tulyAu~chau bhanne kurA malAI dekhAU |” unale bhane– “ke timIlAI vizvAsa chaina?” ibrAhImale bhane– “ho, cha | tara mero AtmasantuSTikA lAgi mAtra yo nivedana gareko hu~ |” allAhale bhane– “cAravaTA paMkSI samAta | tinIharulAI AphUsita helamela garAU | tyasapachi tinIharUmadhyekA pratyeka bhAgalAI hareka pahADamA rAkha, ani tinIharUlAI DAka | tinIharU timItarpha dagurdai Aunechan | ra, jAnirAkha allAha ati prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |”

allAhako mArgamA Aphno dhana–sampattI kharca garneharUko (kharcako) udAharaNa tyasa dAnAko jasto cha jasabATa sAtavaTA bAlAharU utpAdana hunchan; jasakA pratyeka bAlAmA sayavaTA dAnAharU hunchan | ra, allAha jasako lAgi cAhanchan baDhottarI pradAna gardachan | allAha sarvasamRddha evaM sarvajJa chan |

juna mAnisaharU allAhako mArgamA AphnA dhana–sampattiharU kharca garchan ra kharca garepachi na upakAra jatAu~chan ra na kaSTa nai dinchan unIharUko pratidAna unIharUkA mAlikakahA~ cha | ra, unIharUlAI na kunai prakArako Dara hunecha na unIharU zokagrasta nai hunechan |
euTA mITho vacana ra kSamA tyasto sadakA (dAna) bhandA uttama cha jasapachi kaSTa diiyos | ra, allAha nispRha evaM sahanazIla chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! Aphno sadakAlAI upakAra jatAI tathA kaSTa diI tyasa vyaktijasto naSTa nagara jo mAnisaharUlAI dekhAunako lAgi dhana kharca garcha ra allAha evaM AkhiratamAthi ImAna rAkhdaina | usako (kharcako) udAharaNa yasto cha jasto euTA caTTAna cha jasamAthi mATo (jameko) cha ra jaba tyasamAthi musaladhAre pAnI parcha taba (sabai mATo bagera) caTTAna cillo huncha | tinIharUlAI kamAekA (puNya) madhye kunai aMza pani prApta bhaena | ra, allAha kAphira mAnisaharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAu~dainan |

ra, (yasako viparIta) juna mAnisaharUle allAhako prasannatA prApta garna tathA AphUlAI (satyako mArgamA) sthApita garnakA nimti Aphno sampatti kharca gardachan unIharUko udAharaNa ucca sthAnamA raheko yasto bagaiMcAjasto cha jasale musaladhAre varSA bhaemA dobbara phala dincha ra musaladhAre varSA nabhaemA sAmAnya varSA tyasako nimti paryApta huncha | ra, timIharUle je garchau tyo allAhale dekhirahekA chan |

ke timIharUmadhye kasaile yo kurA mana parAuna sakcha ki phedahu~dai nadI bagirahekA khajura tathA aMgurako euTA bagaiMcA hos, (yasako atirikta) usako lAgi tyasamA sabai prakArakA phala hoUn; ani U bUDhyaulI avasthAmA hos; ra usakA santAnaharU ahile kamajora (athavA sAnA–sAnA) hoUn; yasa avasthAmA tyasa bagaiMcAmA euTA agniyukta huNDarI Aera usalAI jalAos | yasarI nai allAha AphnA nizAnIharU spaSTa rUpamA varNana gardachan tAki timIharUle manana garnechau |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUle Arjana garekA cijaharUmadhye ra hAmIle timIharUkA nimti bhUmibATa utpanna garekA vastuharUmadhye uttama vastuharU kharca gara | ra, kharca garnalAI yasto kharAba vastu nachAna juna timI svayaM linakA lAgi tayAra hune chainau | yo arkai kurA ho ki tyasalAI A~khA cimlera liIhAla ra | jAnirAkha allAha nispRha evaM prazaMsanIya chan |

zaitAnale timIharUlAI nirdhanatAbATa tarsAu~cha ra nirlajjatAkA kAmaharU garnakA lAgi prerita garcha jabaki allAhale Aphno tarphabATa timIharUlAI kSamA evaM kRpAko vacana dinchan | ra, allAha sarvasamRddha evaM sarvajJa chan |
unale jasalAI cAhanchan tatvadarzitA pradAna garchan | ani, jasalAI tattavadarzitA pradAna gariyo usalAI ThUlo sampatti diiyo tara buddhimAnaharU mAtra upadeza grahaNa gardachan |
ra, timIle juna kharca garchau athavA je bhAkala garchau allAhalAI tyasako rAmro jJAna cha | ra, atyAcArIharUko lAgi kohI sahayogI hunechaina |

timIharUle jAhera garera dAna garchau bhane yo rAmro ho tara yadi timIharUle tyasalAI gopya rAkhchau ani nirdhanaharUlAI dinchau bhane timIharUkA lAgi yo jhan rAmro ho | ra, allAhale timrA pApaharU mApha garidinechan ra juna kArya timIharU garchau allAha tyasako jAnakArI rAkhdachan |

(he nabI sa.!) mAnisaharUlAI satmArgamA lyAi ubhyAune jimmevArI timro hoina | baru allAhale nai jasalAI cAhanchan satmArga dekhAu~chan | ra, jejati dhana timIharU kharca garchau tyasako phAidA timIharUle nai pAunechau | timIharU allAha kai prasannatA prAptikA lAgi ta kharca gardachau ani timIharU juna sampatti kharca garchau timIharUlAI pUrNarUpamA pratiphala pradAna garinecha | ra, timro haka kadApi mArinechaina |

(dAna) vizeSa rUpamA tI nirdhanaharUkA lAgi ho jo allAhako kAryamA gheriekole jIvikopArjanakA lAgi pRthvImA kunai bhAgadauDa garna sakdainan | unIharUko svAbhimAnale gardA anabhijJa mAnisaharUle unIharUlAI sampanna ThAndachan | timIharU unIharUko lakSaNabATa unalAI cinna sakchau | unIharU anunaya–vinayakA sAtha mAnisaharUsa~ga mAgdainan | timIharU je–jasto dhana kharca garnechau tyasalAI allAha avazya nai jAnnechan |

jasale AphnA dhana–sampattiharU rAta ra dina, gopya tavaramA tathA dekhAera kharca garchan tyastA mAnisaharUko pratiphala unIharUkA pAlanakartAkahA~ raheko cha | tinIharUlAI na kunai bhaya hunecha ra na tinIharU zokagrasta nai hunechan |

tI mAncheharU jasale byAja khAnchan, (cihAnabATa) yasarI uThnechan jasto ki zaitAnale choera usalAI baulAhA banAeko hos | yasto yasa kAraNale hunecha ki tinIharUle bhandathe– “byApAra pani ta byAja jastai ho |” jabaki byApAralAI allAhale vaidha ra byAjalAI avaidha ThaharyAekA chan | ataH jasale AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa Adeza prApta bhaepachi yasa kAryalAI tyAgdacha usale jejati pahile khAyo, tyo khAyo | ra, tyasa mAnisako mAmalA allAhako hAtamA cha | ra, juna mAnisaharU (yasa byAja khAne kAryatarpha) pheri pharkanchan tinIharU narakabAsI hun jahA~ tinIharU sadA–sarvadA rahanechan |
allAha byAjalAI meTAu~chan ra dAnamA abhivRddhi garchan | ra, allAhale kRtaghnaharU evaM pApIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |

nizcaya nai juna mAnisaharU ImAna lyAu~chan, satkarma garchan, namAja kAyama garchan ra jakAta dinchan unIharUkA nimti pAlanakartAkahA~ pratidAna cha | ra, na unIharUlAI kunai Dara hunecha ra na unIharU zokagrasta nai hunechan |
he ImAna lyAekA mAnisaharU ho! allAhako bhaya gara ra yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane bA~kI byAja parityAga garideU |

yadi timIharUle tyaso garenau bhane sAvadhAna! allAha evaM rasUlako tarphabATa yuddhako Adeza cha | ra, yadi timIharU taubA (prAyazcita) garchau bhane timIharUkA lAgi timro mUladhana cha~daicha | na timIharU kasaiko haka hanan garnechau na timro haka nai hanan gariyos |

yadi timro RNI abhAvagrasta avasthAmA cha bhane tyasalAI suvidhAjanaka avasthAsammakA lAgi avasara deU ra yadi timIharU dAnasvarUpa chuTa dinchau bhane timIharUkA lAgi jhan rAmro hunecha, yadi timIharU jJAna rAkhdachau bhane |

tyasa dinako bhaya gara juna dina timIharUlAI allAhatarpha pharkAera laginecha | ani pratyeka mAnisalAI juna usale kamAeko hunecha tyasako pUrNarUpamA pratiphala pradAna garinecha ra tinIharUprati kunai anyAya garine chaina |
