he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharU kunai nirdhArita avadhikAnimti ApasamA RNako lenadena gardA tyasalAI lekhne gara | ani, lekhanadAsale timIharubIca nyAyapUrvaka lekhos | ra, kunai lekhanadAsale tyasarI lekhna asvIkAra nagaros jasarI allAhale usalAI sikAekA chan | baru usale lekhos | ra, jasako haka cha, tyasa RNa line mAnisale lekhAos ani usale AphnA pAlanakartA– allAhako bhaya garos tathA tyasamA kunai kamI nagaros | tara tyo mAnisa jasalAI haka prApta cha; yadi abujha vA kamajora cha vA svayaM lekhAune sAmarthya rAkhdaina bhane usako abhibhAvakale nyAyapUrvaka lekhAos | timIharUkahA~ mAnya sAkSyaharumA, puruSaharUmadhye duIjanAlAI Aphno sAkSI banAune gara; duIjanA puruSa upalabdha nabhaemA ekajanA puruSa ra duIjanA mahilA (lAI sAkSI banAU) | tAki unIharUmadhye kunai ekale galtI gareko khaNDamA arkole smaraNa garAuna sakos | ra, sAkSIharUlAI jahile bolAu~dA pani unIharUle asvIkAra nagarUn | RNa sAno hos vA ThUlo, timIharUle tyasako avadhI tokera lekhna alchI nagara | allAhako dRSTimA yo tarIkA baDhI nyAyasa~gata cha ra yo sAkSyalAI jhan ThIka rAkhne tathA zaGkAbATa pani bacAune tarIkA ho | a~, hAtAhAtI vyApArika lenadena garincha bhane nalekhemA pani timIharUmAthi kunai Apatti chaina | tara vyApArika mAmalA taya gardA sAkSI banAU ra lekhanadAsa tathA sAkSIlAI kunai kaSTa nadiiyos | yasto garemA yo timIharUko tarphabATa avajJA Thaharnecha | ra, allAhako bhaya rAkha | allAha nai timIharUlAI yI kurAharU sikAu~dachan ra allAha pratyeka cijakA jJAtA hun |

ra, yadi timIharU yAtrAmA chau ra timIharUle kunai lekhanadAsa bheTirahekA chainau bhane dhitosvarUpa kehI vastu rAkhera mAtra vyavahAra gara | ra, timIharUmadhye kohI arkomAthi bharosA garcha bhane jasamAthi bharosA garieko ho usale amAnata (nAso) phirtA garos | ra, AphnA pAlanakartA allAhako bhaya rAkhos | ra, timIharU sAkSIlAI lukAune nagara | nizcaya nai sAkSI lukAune mAnisako hRdaya pApI huncha | ra, timIharUle garne garekA sabai kAryaharU allAha jAndachan |

AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA rahekA sampUrNa cija allAha kai hun | ra, timIharUle manamA rAkhekA kurA prakaTa gara vA gopya rAkha, allAhale timIharUsa~ga tyasako hisAba linechan | tyasapachi mAtra unale jasalAI cAhanechan kSamA garidinechan ra jasalAI cAhanechan daNDa dinechan | ra, allAha sabai cijamAthi Aphno niyantraNa rAkhdachan |

IzadUtale AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avatarita (cija) mAthi ImAna lyAekA chan ra mominaharUle pani (vizvAsa sthApanA garekA chan)| yinIharU sabai allAha, unakA phariztAharU, unakA granthaharU evaM unakA rasUlaharUmAthi AsthAvAna bhae | (unIharUle bhane)– “hAmI allAhakA rasUlaharUbIca kunai bhedabhAva gardainauM |” ra, unIharUle bhane– “hAmIle sunyauM ra AjJApAlana garyauM | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmI timIsita kSamA yAcanA garchauM ra timItarpha nai hAmIharU pharkanucha |”

allAha kunai pani mAnisamAthi usako sAmarthyabhandA adhika jimmevArI diMdainan | usale kamAeko pUNya usaiko lAgi ho ra usale baTuleko pApa (ko daNDa) usaile bhognuparnecha | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmI birsanchauM vA galtIle kukarma garchau bhane hAmIlAI kerakAra nagarnU | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmImAthi tyasto bojha narAkha jasto timIle hAmIbhandA aghikA mAnisaharUmAthi rAkhekA thiyau | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmImAthi tyasto bojha narAkha juna sahana garne zakti hAmImA chaina | ra, hAmIprati namratAko vyavahAra gara; ra kSamA gara ra hAmImAthi dayA gara | timI hAmro svAmI hau | ataH kAphira mAnisaharUviruddha timIle hAmIlAI sahayoga pradAna gara |
alipha0 lAma0 mIma0!
allAha– jasabAheka kohI upAsya chaina; jIvanta evaM cirasthAyI chan; jasale jagat–vyavasthA samhAlekA chan |
(he muhammada sa.!) unale timImAthi bilakula satyakAsAtha yo grantha avataraNa gare jasale AphUbhandA pahilekA granthaharUko puSTi gardacha ra allAhale taurAta tathA injIla pani avataraNa gare |

mAnavajAtiko mArgadarzanako lAgi yasa (kuraAna) bhandA pahile (allAhale taurAta tathA injIla avataraNa gare) ani ‘phurkAna’ (kasauTI) avataraNa gare | nizcaya nai allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI asvIkAra garneharUkA lAgi kaThora yAtanA cha | ani, allAha prabhutvazAlI chan ra (pApIharUsita) badalA linevAlA chan |
nissandeha pRthvI tathA AkAzamA raheko kunai pani cija allAhabATa ojhelamA chaina |
unai hun jo garbhAzayabhitra AphUle cAheanusAra timIharUko zarIrako AkRti banAu~chan | unIbAheka anya kohI upAsya chaina | unI prabhutvazAlI ra tattavadarzI chan |

(he nabI sa.!) unai hun jasale timImAthi grantha avataraNa gare jasamA kehI AyataharU 'muhakamAta' (saTIka spaSTa) chan juna granthako mUla AdhAra hun ra kehI AyataharU ‘mutazAbihAta’ (aspaSTa) chan | ani juna mAnisaharUko hRdaya vikRta chan tinIharU utpAta maccAuna ra tyasako manaparI artha lagAuna ‘mutazAbihAta’ AyataharUko pachi lAgchan jabaki tI AyataharUko vAstavika artha kevala allAhalAI thAhA cha | ra, jJAnamA dRDhatA rAkhneharu bhandachan– “hAmIle yinIharumAthi ImAna lyAyauM | yI sabai hAmrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa hun |” ra, vAstavamA buddhimAnaharU mAtra upadeza grahaNa garchan |

(tinIharU prArthanA gardachan) “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI timIle mArgadarzana pradAna garepachi hAmrA hRdayalAI TeDho napAra ra hAmImAthi Aphno junAphabATa dayA pradAna gara | nissandeha timI ta mahAnadAtA hau |"
"he hAmrA pAlanakartA! nizcaya nai eka dina timIle sampUrNa mAnisaharUlAI ekatrita garnechauM jasako AgamanamA kunai sandeha chaina | nissandeha allAha vAcA toDdainan |"
nisandehaH anAsthA pradarzana garneharuko sampatti tathA tinIharUkA santAnaharU allAhako dA~jomA kadApi kunai kAma lAgne chainan | tinIharU nai narakako indhana hun |

(tinIharUko durgati tyasarI nai hunecha) jasarI phiraaunakA anuyAyI evaM tinIharUbhandA pahilekA (mAnisaharU) ko durgati bhayo; tinIharUle hAmrA AyataharUlAI jhuTho Thahara gare ani allAhale tinIharUkA pApaharUko kAraNale tinIharUlAI samAte | allAha kaThora daNDa–dAtA chan |
kAphiraharUlAI bhanideU– “cA~Dai nai timIharU parAjita hunechau evaM timIharU ekatrita garI narakatarpha laginechau, ra kasto nikRSTa sthAna ho tyo!”

timIharUko nimti tI duI (paraspara yuddharata) dalaharUmA zikSAprada nizAnI cha, jasako bIcamA muThabheDa bhayo | euTA dala allAhako mArgamA yuddha gardathyo bhane, arko cAhi~ kAphira (pakSako) thiyo, jo muslimaharUlAI AphnA A~khAle AphUharUbhandA duIgunA (ThUlo) dekhiraheko thiyo | ra allAha jasalAI cAhanchan usalAI Aphno sahayogabATa zakti pradAna garchan | nizcaya nai yasamA dRSTivAn mAnisaharUkA lAgi ThUlo zikSA raheko cha |

mAnisaharUkA lAgi tinIharukA mana parekA vastuharU (madhye) strIharU, putraharU, sunacA~dIkA thAkaharU, chAniekA ghor3AharU, pazuharU ra khetIko moha–mAyA zobhAyamAna banAi diieko cha | yI ta kSaNika sAMsArika jIvanakA sAdhanaharU mAtra hun, ra uttama bAsasthAna ta allAhakahA~ nai raheko cha |

bhanideU—“ke ma timIharUlAI tyasabhandA uttama vastuko bAremA jAnakArI diU~? (suna) Izabhaya rAkhne mAnisaharUkA lAgi unako pAlanakartAkahA~ bagaiMcAharU chan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan, jahA~ unIharu sadA rahanechan ra (tyahA~) pavitra patnIharU hunechan evaM allAhako prasannatA (sameta) raheko cha, ra allAha (AphnA) bhaktaharUmAthi dRSTi rAkhne garchan |”
yI tI mAnisaharU hun jo bhanchan—“he hAmrA mAlika! nissandeha hAmIle ImAna lyAauM, ani timI hAmrA pApaharUlAI kSamA pradAna gara ra hAmIlAI narakako yAtanAbATa bacAU |”
tinIharU dhairyavAn, satyavAn, AjJAkArI, dAnazIla tathA rAtakA antima kSaNaharUmA kSamAyAcanA garne (mAnisaharU) hun |

“allAhabAheka kohI pUjya chainan” bhanne kurAko sAkSI svayaM allAha, phariztAharU evaM jJAnavAnaharU dinchan | unI nisApha kAyamakartA hun | unIbAheka kohI pUjya chaina | unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tattvadarzI chan |

allAhako dRSTimA islAma mAtra dIna (dharma) ho tara juna mAnisaharUlAI Izagrantha pradAna garieko thiyo tinIharUle jJAnako AgamanapazcAta ekaarkAmAthi atyAcAra garne uddezyale matabheda gare, ra jo allAhakA AdezaharU asvIkAra garcha (tyasalAI thAhA hunuparcha ki) nissandeha allAhale zIghra nai hisAba linevAlA chan |

(he muhammada sa.!) aba kAphiraharU yadi timIsa~ga vAda–vivAda garchan bhane bhanideU–“maile ra merA anuyAyIharUle AphUlAI allAhaprati samarpita garidiekA chauM |” ra, Izagrantha pradAna gariekA mAnisaharUlAI ani (Izagrantha pradAna nagariekA) nirakSara mAnisaharUlAI sodha—“ke timIharUle AphUlAI (allAhaprati) samarpita garekA chau?” yadi tinIharU AphUlAI samarpita garchan bhane tinIharU satmArga pAunechan, ra yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane timro jimmevArI sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho | ra, allAha bhaktaharUmAthi rAmrarI dRSTi rAkhdachan |

juna mAnisaharU allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI asvIkAra garchan, nabIharUko anAhaka hatyA garchan ra nyAya–nisAphako Adeza dine mAnisaharUko pani hatyA garchan yastA mAnisaharUlAI duHkhada yAtanAko zubhasUcanA sunAideU |
tI unai mAnisaharU hun jasakA karmaharU loka evaM paraloka duvaimA akAratha bhae ra tinIharUko kohI sahayogI hunechaina |

ke timIle IzagranthakA kehI aMza prApta bhaekA mAnisaharUlAI dekhenau? jaba tinIharUlAI Izagranthatarpha Amantrita garincha tAki allAhale tinIharUbIca nirNaya garUn taba tinIharUmadhyeko euTA samUha vimukha bhaera bAhirincha |

yasto yasa kAraNale bhaeko ho ki tinIharU bhanchan– “kehI dinabAheka agni (naraka) le hAmIlAI chune chaina |” vAstavamA unIharUle racekA jhuThA dhAraNAharUle unIharulAI unIharuko dharmako viSayamA bhramamA pArekA chan |

tyasa samaya tinIharUko avasthA kasto hunecha jaba tinIharUlAI hAmIle yasto dina ekatrita garnechauM jasako AgamanamA kunai sandeha chaina? ra, pratyeka mAnisalAI usako kamAiko badalA pUrA–pUrA pradAna garinecha ra tinIharUprati anyAya garine chaina |

bhana (prArthanA gara)– “he allAha! rAjyakA svAmI! timI jasalAI cAhanchau rAjya pradAna gardachau evam jasabATa cAhanchau rAjya khosdachau ra timI jasalAI cAhanchau sammAna pradAna gardachau ani jasalAI cAhanchau apamAnita gardachau; bhalAI timrai hAtamA cha | nizcaya nai timI sabai kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachau |”

timI nai rAtalAI dinamA tathA dinalAI rAtamA praviSTa gardachau | ra, timI nirjIvaharubATa sajIva evaM sajIvabATa nirjIva nikAldachau ani timI jasalAI cAhanchau anagintI dhana–sampattI pradAna gardachau |

AsthAvAnaharUle AsthAvAnaharUlAI choDera avajJA garneharUlAI AphnA saMrakSaka mitra kadApi nabanAUn | ani, jasale tyaso garnecha allAhasa~ga usako kunai sambandha rahane chaina | ho, yo chUTa cha ki timIharU tinIharUbATa hune kunai noksAnIbATa joginako lAgi yasto gara | allAha timIharUlAI svayaM (unI) sa~ga DarAuna saceta gardachan | timIharU allAhatarpha nai pharkera jAnucha |

(he nabI sa.) bhanideU– “timIharUle manamA bhaekA kurAharU cAhe gopya rAkha vA prakaTa gara allAhalAI tyasako jJAna cha ra unI AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA rahekA (cija) harUlArI pani jAndachan | ra, allAha sabai kurAko sAmarthya rAkhdachan |”

tyasa (mahApralayako) dina pratyeka mAnisale AphUle Arjana gareko puNya evaM AphUle gareko sabai pApaharUlAI Aphno sAmunne upasthita bhaeko pAunecha | usale AphU ra Aphno kukarmabIca lAmo dUrI bhaidieko bhae hunthyo bhanne kAmanA garnecha | ra, allAha timIharUlAI AphUbATa DarAu~chan ra allAha bhaktaharUprati ati snehI chan |

(he sandeSTA!) bhanideU– “yadi timIharU allAhasa~ga prema garchau bhane mero anusaraNa gara | allAhale timIharUsa~ga prema garnechan ra timrA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnechan | allAha atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |”
bhanideU— “allAha evaM IzadUta (muhammada sa.) ko AjJApAlana gara |" yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane nissandeha allAha avajJAkArIharulAI mana parAu~dainan |
nissandeha allAhale Adama ra nUha ra ibrAhImakA santAnaharU ra imarAnakA santAnaharUlArI sampUrNa mAnavajAtikA lAgi cayana garekA thie |
yI eka arkAko baMzamadhyekA hun ra allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

(smaraNa gara) jaba imarAnakI strIle bhanekI thiin– “he merA pAlanakartA! maile mero garbhamA raheko zizulAI sabai kAryabATa mukta garera timrailAgi arpaNa garekI chu | ataH mero tarphabATa svIkAra gara | nizcaya nai timI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chau |”

tara jaba unIkahA~ chorIko janma bhayo taba unale bhanin– “he merA mAlika! makahA~ ta chorIko po janma bhaecha!” unale ke janmAekI chin bhanne kurA allAhalAI rAmrarI thAhA thiyo | “ra, chorA jasto chorI ta hu~daina | ra, maile tyasako nAma maryama rAkhekI chu | ani ma unalAI ra unakA santAnaharUlAI tiraskRta zaitAnabATa (surakSita rAkhna) timro zaraNamA arpaNa garchu |”

ani unakA pAlanakartAle unalAI rAmrarI svIkAra gare ani unalAI rAmrarI hurkAe | ra, jakariyAlAI unakA abhibhAvaka banAe | jaba–jaba jakariyA unako kakSamA praveza garne garthe taba–taba unIsamakSa khAdya–sAmagrI ApUrti bhaeko pAu~the | unale sodhe– “e maryama, yo timro nimti kahA~bATa Au~cha?” unale bhanin– “yo allAhako tarphabATa ho | nizcaya nai allAha jasalAI cAhanchan usalAI anagintI jIvikopArjanakA vastuharU pradAna gardachan |”
tyatikhera jakariyAle AphnA pAlanakartAlAI pukAre ra bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA! Aphno junAphabATa malAI caritravAna santAna pradAna gara | nissandeha timI nai prArthanA sunnevAlA chau |”

jaba unI prArthanAlayamA ubhiera namAja paDhdai thie taba phariztAharUle unalAI batAe– “allAha timIlAI yahayAko zubha–sUcanA dinchan jo allAhako euTA vANi (kalimA) ko puSTikartA, saradAra, saMyamI sandeSTA evaM satkarmIharUmadhyekA hunechan |"

jakariyAle bhane— “he merA pAlanakartA! malAI kasarI putra huna sakcha jabaki malAI buDhesakAla lAgisakeko cha ra merI patnI bA~jhI bhaisakekI china?” javApha milyo– “yastai hunecha, allAha je cAhanchan, tyo garchan |”

jakariyAle bhane– “he merA mAlika! mero nimti kunai nizAnI nirdhAraNa garideU |” allAhale bhane– “timro nimti nizAnI yo ho ki timI mAnisaharUsa~ga tIna dinasamma saGketabATa mAtrai kurAkAnI garna saknechau | yasa avadhimA AphnA pAlanakartAlAI atyadhika smaraNa garnU; sA~jhabihAna unako stuti garnU |”
jaba phariztAharUle bhane— “he maryama! nizcaya nai allAhale timIlAI cayana garekA chan; pavitratA pradAna garekA chan ra saMsArabharikA mahilAharumadhyebATa timIlAI nai cayana garekA chan |"
"he maryama! AphnA pAlanakartAko AjJAkArI tathA anuyAyI bana ra sajdA gara evaM rukUa garne (nihurine) harUsa~ga rUkUa gara |”

yo adRzya sUcanAharUmadhyeko ho juna hAmIle ‘vahya’ (prakAzanA) dvArA timIlAI batAu~daichauM | ra, jaba tinIharU maryamako saraMkSaka ko hunecha bhanI nirNayako lAgi ciThThA nikAldai thie taba (he muhammada sa.) timI tyahA~ thienau ra unIharU ApasamA jhagaDA gariraheko belA pani timI tyahA~ thienau |

(smaraNa gara) jaba phariztAharUle bhane– “he maryama! allAhale timIlAI Aphno euTA ‘kalimA’ (vANi) ko zubha–sUcanA dinchan jasako nAma masIha maryama–putra IsA hunecha | unI loka evaM paraloka dubaimA sammAnita hunechan ra (allAhako) najikakA mAnisaharUmadhye hunechan |"
"ra, unale kokrobATa ani ThUlo umeramA mAnisaharUsa~ga kurAkAnI garnechan | ra, unI satkarmIharUmadhye hunechan |"

maryamale bhanin– “pAlanakartA! makahA~ kasarI putra hunasakcha jabaki malAI kunai puruSale choeko pani chaina?” uttara Ayo –“yastai hunecha | allAha je cAhanchan, sRSTi garchan | jaba unI kunai kurAko nirNaya linchan taba bhanchan “bhaihAla” ani tyo huna pugcha |”
ra, allAhale IsAlAI grantha, tattvadarzItA, taurAta tathA injIlako jJAna dinechan |

ra, unI isarAIlakA santAnaharUkA nimti IzadUta hunechan | (IzadUta bhaera isarAIlakA santAnaharUkahA~ Aepachi unale bhane) – “ma timIharUsamakSa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa euTA camatkAra liera Aeko chu | ma timIharUsamakSa mATobATa carA jasto euTA AkRti banAera tyasamA phukchu ani tyo allAhako AjJAle carA bhaihAlnecha | ra, ma allAhako AjJAle andhA evaM kuSTharogIharUlAI niko pArchu ani allAha kai AjJAle mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArchu ra, ma timIharUlAI batAuchu juna timIharU khAnchau ani juna timIharU AphnA gharaharUmA thupArchau | yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane nizcaya nai yasamA timIharUkA nimti nizAnI cha |

ra, ma merosAmu raheko yasa ‘taurAta’ ko puSTikartA hu~ ra kehI vastuharUlAI vaidha tulyAuchu juna timIharUkA nimti avaidha gariekA thie ra ma timIharUsamakSa timro svAmIko tarphabATa camatkAra liera Aeko chu | ani allAhako bhayarAkha ra mero AjJApAlana gara |
nissandeha allAha mero pani ‘raba’ (pAlanakartA) hun ra timIharUkA pani raba hun | ani, timIharU unakai upAsanA gara | yahI sIdhA mArga ho |

IsAle unIharUko ‘kuphra’ (avajJA) mahasusa garisakepachi bhane– “allAhako mArgamA ko merA sahayogI bannechan?” havArIharUle bhane– “hAmI hauM allAhakA sahayogI | hAmIle allAhamAthi ImAna lyAekA chauM ra hAmI AjJAkArIharUmadhye hauM bhanera timI sAkSI basa |”
“he hAmrA mAlika! timIle jejati avataraNa garekA chau tyasamAthi hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM ra hAmIle IzadUta (IsA) ko anusaraNa garyauM | ataH sAkSIharUmA hAmIlAI lekha |”
ra, unIharUle (isarAIlakA santAnaharUle) gopyarUpamA SaDayantra race ani allAhale pani gopyarUpamA jukti gare | ra, jukti garneharUmA allAha nai uttama chan |

jaba allAhale bhane– “he IsA! aba ma timIlAI niyantraNamA linevAlA chu | ra, timIlAI AphUtira uThAunevAlA chu; asvIkAra (kuphra) garekA mAAnisaharUbATa pavitra pArnevAlA chu ra timrA anuyAyIharUlAI mahApralayako dinasamma kAphiraharUbATa ucca rAkhnevAlA chu | pheri timIharU maitarpha pharkera Aunechau | tyasabelA ma timIharUbIca bhaeko matabhedaharUko phaisalA garnechu |”
ani kuphra garekA mAnisaharUlAI ma yasa loka evaM paraloka dubaimA kaThina yAtanA dinechu ra tinIharUko kohI sahayogI hune chaina |
ra, juna mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare tinIharUlAI allAhale pUrNa badalA pradAna garnechan | ra, allAha atyAcArIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |
yI AyataharU tattvajJAnale bharipUrNa upadeza hun juna hAmI timIharulAI sunAu~daichauM |
IsAko udAharaNa allAhakahA~ Adamajastai cha | unalAI allAhale mATobATa banAe, tyasapachi unale bhane– “bhaihAla” ani unI bhaihAle |
yo mUla satya timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa ho | ataH timI sandehakartAharUmA sAmela nahoU |

yo jJAna timrosAmu Aisakepachi jasale timIsa~ga yasabAremA kutarka garcha usalAI bhana– “AU hAmI A–AphnA santAna tathA strIharUlAI bolAauM ra timI ra hAmI svayaM pani AauM ani milera prArthanA garauM ki jhuThAharUmAthi allAhako abhizApa hos!”
nissandeha yI satya ghaTanAharU hun | ra, allAhabAheka kohI pUjya chaina ani nizcaya nai allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane allAha yastA bidrohIharUsita rAmrarI paricita chan |

bhanideU– “he ahle kitAba! euTA yasto kurAtarpha AU jo timI ra hAmIbIca samAna cha– tyo yo ho ki hAmI allAhabAheka kasaiko upAsanA nagarauM ra unIsa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAauM | ra allAhabAheka hAmImadhye kasaile pani anya kasailAI pAlanakartA naThAnos | yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane, bhanideU– “timIharU sAkSI basa ki hAmI AjJAkArI (muslima) hauM |”
he ahle kitAba ho! timIharU ibrAhImako sambandhamA kina tarka–vitarka garchau jabaki taurAta evaM injIla ta ibrAhImapazcAt mAtra avatarita gariekA hun? ke timIharU viveka prayoga gardainau?

hera! timIharUle tI kurAharUmA vAda–vivAda garisakyau jasako timIharUlAI jJAna thiyo | aba tI kurAharUmA kina tarka–vitarka gardaichau jasabAre timIharUlAI kunai jJAna chaina? ra, allAha jAndachan tara timIharU jAndainau |
ibrAhIma na yahUdI thie na IsAI nai | unI ta eka ekAgracitta AjJAkArI (muslima) thie | ra unI kadApi muzrika (bahudevavAdI) harUmadhye thienan |
ibrAhImasa~ga sarvAdhika nikaTa tI mAnisaharU hun jasale unako anusaraNa gare ra (aba cAhi~) yI nabI (muhammada sa.) tathA AsthAvAnaharU hun | ra, allAha mominaharUkA saMrakSaka–mitra hun |
ahlekitAbaharUmadhye euTA samUha timIlAI kunai na kunai tarIkAle pathabhraSTa garna cAhancha | tinIharUle AphailAI pathabhraSTa gardaichan tara tinIharUlAI tyasako anubhUti chaina |
he ahle kitAba ho! timIharU allAhakA AyataharUlAI kina asvIkAra gardachau jabaki timIharU svayaM sAkSI chau?
he ahle kitAba ho! timIharU satyalAI asatyamA kina misAu~chau ani jAnakArI hu~dAhu~dai pani satyalAI kina lukAu~chau?
ahle kitAbako euTA samUhale bhanyo– “mominaharUmAthi avataraNa bhaeko (grantha) mAthi bihAna ImAna lyAU ani sA~jha napardai inkAra garideU tAki unIharU vimukha hoUn |”

(tinIharU ApasamA bhanchan)– “ra, timIharU AphnA sadharmIharUbAheka anya kasaimAthi vizvAsa nagara |” (he sandeSTA! tinIharUlAI) bhana– “vAstavamA mArgadarzana kevala allAhako mArgadarzana ho |” (yahUdIharU paraspara yo pani bhanchan–) “kadAcita yasto nahos ki timIharUlAI prApta cija arU kasailAI prApta hoos vA unIharUle timIharUviruddha timrA pAlanakartAsamakSa peza garnako lAgi Thosa pramANa phelA pArUn |” bhanideU– “kRpA ta allAhako hAtamA raheko cha | unale jasalAI cAhanchan usalAI pradAna gardachan | ra, allAha byApaka evaM sarvajJa chan |
unale jasalAI cAhanchan Aphno dayAkonimti cayana garchan ra allAha mahAn anukampAvAlA chan |

ra, ahle kitAbamadhye kohI yastA chan jasamAthi timIle bharosA garera dhana–sampattIko thupro nAsosvarUpa diyau bhane tinIharUle timIlAI pharkAune chan tara tinIharUmadhye yastA mAnisaharU pani chan jasalAI eka dInAra mAtra nAsosvarUpa diyau bhane pani timI tinIharUkA sAmu DaTera khaDA nahouJjela tinIharUle pharkAune chainan | tinIharUko yasa anaitikatAko kAraNa yo ho ki tinIharU bhanchan– “ummI (gaira–yahUdIharU) bAremA hAmIharUlAI kunai pakaDa hune chaina |” ra, tinIharU jAnibujhIkana allAhabAre jhuTho kurAharU garchan |
Akhira kina tinIharUlAI pakaDa hunechaina? jasale allAhasa~ga gareko vAcA pUrA garnecha ra kukarmabATa bacnecha tyo nai allAhako priya hunecha | allAha Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI prema gardachan |

juna mAnisaharU allAhasa~ga garieko vAcA evaM AphnA kasamaharU tuccha dAmamA becchan tinIharUkA nimti Akhirata (paraloka) mA kunai aMza chaina ra mahApralayako dina allAha na tinIharUsa~ga kurA garnechan na tinIharUtarpha dRSTi lagAunechan ra na tinIharUlAI zuddhatA nai pradAna garnechan | tinIharUkA lAgi dukhada yAtanA raheko cha |

ra tinIharUmadhye euTA samUha yastA mAnisaharUko pani cha jo Izagrantha paDhdA AphnA jibrAharUlAI laTapaTAera paDhchan tAki tyasalAI timIharUle granthako aMza ThAna jabaki tyo granthako aMza bhane hoina ra tinIharU yo allAhako tarphabATa ho bhanchan jabaki tyo allAhako tarphabATa hoina ra (yasarI) tinIharU jAnI jAnI allAhabAre jhuTho kurA bolchan |

kunai vyaktiko lAgi yo zobhanIya hu~daina ki usalAI allAhakA tarphabATa grantha, tatvadarzitA evaM izadUtatva prApta bhaepachi U mAnisaharUsa~ga allAhalAI choDI Aphno upAsaka banna bhanos baru tyasa vyaktile ta mAnisaharUsa~ga timIharU saccA ‘rabbAnI’ (prabhusevaka) bana po bhannuparcha jasto ki yasa granthako zikSA ho juna timIharU svayaM paDhchau ra paDhAu~chau |

ra, tyasa vyaktile timIharUlAI phariztAharU tathA nabIharUlAI ‘raba’ banAU bhanera kadApi bhanne chainan | ke (eka nabIle) timIharUlAI AjJAkArI bhaepachi kuphra garne Adeza dina sakchan bhanne kurA sambhava cha?

ra smaraNa gara, allAhale sandeSTAharUlAI vAcA garAekA thie– ”maile timIharUlAI grantha evaM tatvadarzItA pradAna garepachi yadi timIsamakSa arko rasUla Aera timIsAmu raheko (zikSAko) puSTi garchan bhane timIharU avazya unImAthi ImAna lyAunU ra avazya unalAI sahayoga garnU |” allAhale sodhe– “ke timIharUle yasa kurAlAI svIkAra garyau? ra, ke yasa sambandhamA maile lieko vacanako mahatvapurNa jimmevArI vahana garchau?” nabIharUle bhane– “hAmIle svIkAra garyauM |” allAhale bhane– “tyaso bhae timIharU sAkSI basa ra ma pani timIharUkAsAtha sAkSI basnechu |”
yasapachi jo Aphno pratijJAbATa vimukha hunchan tinIharU nai avajJAkArI hun |

ke tinIharu allAhako dharmalAI choDI kunai anya dharmako cAhanA garchan ta? AkAza evaM pRthvImA rahekA sampUrNa vastuharU icchApUrvaka vA anicchApUrvaka allAhako AjJAkArI chan ra sabai unaitarpha pharkAine chan |

bhanideU– “hAmI allAhamAthi ra AphUmAthi avatarita zikSAmAthi, ibrAhIma, ismAIla, ishAka, yAakUba evaM (yAakUbakA) santAnaharUmAthi avatarita zikSAmAthi ra mUsA, IsA evaM (anya) nabIharUlArI unIharUkA pAlanakartAbATa pradAna gariekA kurAharUmAthi AsthA rAkhdachauM | hAmI unIharUbIca bhedabhAva gardainauM | ra, hAmI allAhakai AjJAkArI hauM |”
ra, jasale islAmabAheka anya kunai dharma grahaNa garna khojcha usako dharma kadApi svIkArya hune chaina ra U AkhiratamA ghATA behorneharUmadhye hunecha |

ImAna lyAepachi kuphra garneharUlAI allAhale kasarI mArgadarzana garchan ta jabaki rasUla (muhammada) satya hun bhanne tinIharU svayaMle sAkSI diisakekA thie ra tinIharUsamakSa spaSTa nizAnIharU AisakekA chan | allAha atyAcArI mAnisaharUlAI satyamArga dekhAu~dainan |
yasa pravRttikA mAnisaharUko badalA yahI raheko cha ki tinIharUmAthi allAha, phariztAharU evaM sampUrNa mAnavajAtiko abhizApa hunecha |
tinIharU sadhaiM tyasai avasthAmA rahanechan; na tinIharUko yAtanA ghaTAinecha ra na tinIharUlAI tyasabATa avakAza nai diinecha |
tI vyaktiharubAheka jasale tyasa (kuphra) pachi prAyazcita garI Aphno sudhAra garchan | ani nissandeha allAha kSamAzIla evaM dayAvAna chan |
juna mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAepachi kuphra gare pheri kuphramai bar3hdai gae tinIharUko taubA kadApi svIkAra garine chaina | vAstavamA tinIharU nai pakkA pathabhraSTa hun |

juna mAnisaharUle kuphra gare ra kuphrakai avasthAmA mare, tinIharUmadhye kasaile Aphno sajAya~bATa bacna pRthvI barAbarako suna TakrayAe pani tyo svIkAra garine chaina | yastA mAnisaharUkA nimti duHkhada yAtanA raheko cha | ra, yinIharUko kunai sahayogI hunechaina
timIharU tabasamma puNya prApta garna sakdainau jabasamma AphnA priya vastuharUmadhyebATa kharca gardainau | ra, timIharU juna vastu kharca garchau allAha tyo rAmrarI jAndachan |

isrAIla (yAakUba) le taurAta avatarita garinuaghi AphUmAthi harAma (avaidha) ThaharAekA vastuharUbAheka isrAIlakA santAnaharUkA lAgi sampUrNa khAdya–sAmagrI halAla (vaidha) thie | bhanideU– “yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane lyAU taurAta ra paDha tyo |”
tyasapachi pani jasale allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garchan tinIharU nai atyAcArI hun |
bhanideU– “allAhale nitAnta satya bhanekA chan | ataH timIharU ekAgracitta bhaera ibrAhImako tarIkAko anusaraNa gara, ra unI bahudevavAdIharUmadhyekA thienan |”
nissandeha pahilo (prArthanA) ghara juna mAnavajAtikA nimti nirmANa gariyo tyo tyahI ho juna makkAmA cha; juna sampUrNa mAnavajAtikA lAgi sarvamaGgalamaya evaM mArgadarzanako kendra ho |

yasamA spaSTa nizAnIharU chan; (jasto ki) ibrAhImako bhakti–sthala | ra, jo yasamA praveza garcha U pUrNa zAntimA huncha | mAnavajAtimAthi allAhako yo haka raheko cha ki jo tyahA~samma pugna samartha cha usale tyasa gharako haja (tIrtha) garos | ra, jasale asvIkAra garcha, (usale jAnos ki) allAha saMsArabAsIharUbATa nispRha chan |
bhanideU– “he ahle kitAba ho! timIharU kina allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI asvIkAra gardachau jabaki timIharU je gardachau allAha svayaM tyasamA sAkSI chan?”

bhanideU– “he ahle kitAba ho! timIharU AsthA sthApanA garisakekA vyaktiharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa kina rokchau? timIharU yasamA truTi khojdachau jasako sAkSI timIharU svayaM chau? ra, allAha timIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUbATa anabhijJa chainan |”
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timIharU ahle kitAbamadhyeko kunai samUhako kurA mAnchau bhane timIharUlAI timro AsthApazcAt pheri kuphratira pharkAunechan |

timIharU kasarI kuphra garna sakchau jabaki timIharUlAI allAhakA AyataharU paDhera sunAinchan ra timIharUkA bIca unakA rasUla upasthita chan? allAhalAI dRr3hatApUrvaka aMgAlne vyaktilAI nizcaya nai sIdhAmArga dekhAinecha |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! jasarI allAhasa~ga DarAunu parne ho tyasarI nai unako bhaya rAkha | ra, timIharUko mRtyu nahos tara muslima bhaeko avasthAmA |

ra, sabai milI allAhako DorIlAI baliyosa~ga samAta ani vibhAjita nahoU | ra, allAhale timIharUmAthi gareko anukampAlAI smaraNa gara jaba timIharU paraspara zatru thiyau, ani unale timIharUko mana milAe | tasartha timIharU unako kRpAle dAjubhAi bhayau | ra, timIharU agnikuNDako taTamA thiyau; ani unale timIharUlAI tyasabATa bacAe | allAha yasarI timrolAgi AphnA nizAnIharU spaSTarUpamA varNana garchan tAki timIharUlAI satmArga prApta hos |
timIharUmadhyebATa euTA yasto samUha avazya hunuparcha jasale bhalAItarpha bolAos, sukarmako Adeza deos ra duSkarmabATa rokos | ra, yI nai mAnisaharU saphala hunechan |
ra, timIharU tI vyaktiharU jhaiM nahoU jo spaSTa nirdezanaharUko Agamana pazcAt vibhAjita bhae ra matabhedamA aljhi rahe | yastA vyaktiharUkA lAgi kaThora yAtanA cha |

tyo dina kehI anuhAraharU ujyAlA ra kehI anuhAraharU kAlA hunechan | ra, kAlA muhAra bhaekA vyaktiharUlAI sodhinecha– “ke timIharUle ImAna lyAepachi kuphra garyau? tasartha Aphno ‘kuphra’ ko badalAmA yAtanAko svAda cAkha |”
ra, ujyAlA muhAra bhaekA vyaktiharU allAhako dayAko chatrachAyA~mA hunechan | unIharU sadA tyahI~ rahanechan |
yI allAhakA AyataharU hun juna hAmI timIlAI ThIkasa~ga paDhera sunAu~daichauM ra allAha saMsArabAsIharUmAthi kunai atyAcAra cAha~dainan |
ra, allAhakai hun AkAzaharU evaM pRthvImA rahekA sampUrNa vastuharU ra sampUrNa mAmilAharU allAhakahA~ nai peza garinechan |

timIharU uttama samudAya hau jasalAI mAnavajAtikA nimti paThAieko cha | timIharU satkarmako Adeza dinchau; duSkarmabATa rokchau ra allAhamAthi ImAna (AsthA) rAkhchau | ahle kitAbaharUle ImAna lyAeko bhae tinIharUkA nimti rAmro hune thiyo | tinIharUmadhye kehI AsthAvAna chan bhane adhikAMza cAhi~ avajJAkArI |

sAmAnya kaSTa dinubAheka tinIharUle timro kehI bigArna sakdainan | tinIharUle timIharUsa~ga yuddha gare bhane timIharUtarpha Aphno piThyU~ pharkAunechan | (tyati belA) tinIharUlAI kunai sahayoga prApta hunechaina |

allAha vA mAnisaharUle zaraNa dieko avasthAbAheka jahA~sukai rahe pani tinIharU tiraskRta garie | tinIharU allAhako prakopako bhAgIdAra bhae ra tinIharUmAthi dazA–hInatA thopAriyo | yasto yasa kAraNale bhayo ki tinIharU allAhakA AdezaharUlAI asvIkAra gardathe ra sandeSTAharUko anAhaka hatyA gardathe | yo tinIharule gareko avajJA evaM sImA ullaGghanako badalA ho |
tinIharU sabai samAna chainan | ahle kitAbaharUmadhye euTA samUha (satmArgamA) kAyama cha | tinIharU rAtako samayaharUmA allAhakA AyataharU pATha garchan ra sajdA garchan;
allAha evaM ‘Akhirata’ ko dinamAthi ImAna rAkhdachan; satkarmako Adeza dinchan; duSkarmabATa rokchan ra bhalAikA kAryaharUmA agrasara rahanchan | yinai mAnisaharU satkarmI hun |
ra, yinIharUle kunai satkarma gare pani tyasako kahilyai upekSA garine chaina | ra, allAha AphUsa~ga bhaya rAkhneharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |

nissandeha kuphra (avajJA) garne vyaktiharUko sampatti tathA santAnaharUle allAhako dA~jomA tinIharUlAI kadApi kunai lAbha puryAuna sakdainan | tinIharU narakabAsI hun | tinIharU tyahA~ sadAsarvadA rahanechan |

tinIharU yasa sAMsArika jIvanamA jejati kharca gardaichan tyasako udAharaNa yasto cha jasto ki batAsa calcha jasamA atyantai cisopana huncha ra juna svayaMmAthi atyAcAra garneharUko khetImA calcha ra tyasa (khetI) lAI naSTa pArcha | (yasto garera) allAhale tinIharUmAthi anyAya garenan apitu tinIharU svayaM AphUmAthi nai anyAya gardai AekA chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! AphnA mAnisaharUbAheka anya kasailAI Aphno bhedI nabanAU | tinIharUle timIharUlAI barabAda pArna kunai kasara bA~kI rAkhne chainan | timIharUlAI kaSTa puryAune kurAharU unIharUlAI mana parcha | tinIharUko zatrutA tinIharUko mukhabATa prakaTa bhaisakeko cha ra tinIharuko chAtile lukAekA dveSa tyo bhandA pani bhayAnaka cha | yadi timIharU viveka prayoga garchau bhane hAmIle timIharUkA nimti AphnA nizAnIharu spaSTa rUpamA bayAna garidiekA chauM |

yo ta timIharU hau jo tinIharUlAI prema prakaTa garchau, apitu tinIharUle timIharUlAI rUcAu~dainan jabaki timIharU sabai IzagranthamAthi AsthA rAkhdachau | ra, tinIharU timIharUlAI bheTdA bhanchan– “hAmI AsthA rAkhchauM |” tara alaga hu~dA timIharUpratiko krodhale auMlA Tokchan | bhanideU—“timIharU Aphno krodhamA AphaiM mara |” nissandeha allAha hRdayamA lukeko bhedalAI pani jAndachan |

timIharUko bhalAI hu~dA tinIharUlAI narAmro lAgcha ra, timIharUmAthi kunai saGkaTa AemA tinIharU Anandita hunchan | ra, timIharUle dhairya dhAraNa garyau ani Izabhaya rAkhyauM bhane tinIharUko SaDyantrale timIharUlAI kunai hAni puryAuna sakdaina | nizcaya nai allAhale tinIharUle garirahekA sampUrNa kriyAkalApaharUlAI gherirAkhekA chan |
ra, (he muhammada (sa.)! tyasa kSaNalAI smaraNa gara) jaba timI bihAnai Aphno gharabATa niskera AsthAvAnaharUlAI yuddhako morcAmA tainAtha gardai thiyau | allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

jaba timIharUmadhye duI samUhale (yuddhamA bhAga linabATa) sAhasa gumAune niyata gare jaba ki allAha unIharUkA saMrakSaka mitra thie | ra, AsthAvAnaharUle kevala allAhaprati nai bharosA rAkhnupardacha |
ra, ‘badra’ mA jaba timIharU ati kamajora thiyau, allAhale timIharUlAI sahAyatA gare | ataH allAhasa~ga DarAU | AzA cha ki timIharU kRtajJa hunechau |
ra, (smaraNa gara) jaba timI AsthAvAnaharUlAI bhandai thiyau– “ke timIharUkA lAgi paryApta chaina ki timrA pAlanakartAle tIna hajAra phariztAharU avatarita garera timro sahAyatA garun?”

nissandeha, yadi timIharU dhairya dhAraNa garchau ra Izabhaya rAkhchau ra (yasai avasthAmA) zatruharUle AkramaNa gare bhane timrA pAlanakartAle tyasai belA vizeSa cinha bhaekA (tIna hajAra mAtra hoina) pA~ca hajAra phariztAharUdvArA timIharUlAI sahAyatA garnechan |
ra, yasalAI allAhale timIharuko lAgi zubha–sUcanA banAe tAki yasabATa timIharUkA hRdaya nizcinta hoUn | ra, sahAyatA ta tinai allAhako tarphabATa Aune garcha jo prabhutvazAlI evam tatvadarzI chan |
(tatvadarzI allAhale avazya sahAyatA garnechan) tAki kuphra garneharUko euTA samUhalAI kATUn ra unIharUlAI yasto apamAnajanaka parAjaya bhogAUn jasale gardA tinIharU asaphala bhaI pharkiun |
(he sandeSTA!) timIlAI yasa mAmilAmA kunai akhtiyAra chaina; cAhe allAhale tinIharUlAI mApha garUn vA yAtanA diUn kinabhane nissandeha tinIharU atyAcArI hun |

ra, jejati AkAzaharUmA chan tathA jejati pRthvImA chan sabai allAhakai hun | unI jasalAI cAhanchan kSamA garchan ra jasalAI cAhanchan yAtanA dinchan | ra, allAha atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! baDhAI–caDhAI byAja nakhAU ra allAhako bhaya rAkha tAki timIharUlAI saphalatA prApta hos |
ra, tyasa agniko bhaya rAkha juna kAphiraharUkA nimti tayAra garieko cha |
ra, allAha evam IzadUta (muhammada (sa.)) ko AjJApAlana gara tAki timIharUmAthi dayA gariyos |
agrasara hoU AphnA pAlanakartAko kSamAdAna evaM tyasa svargakA nimti juna AkAzaharU ra pRthvI jatikai phailieko cha ra juna Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA nimti tayAra pArieko ho |
jo nirdhanatA evaM sampannatA sabai avasthAmA kharca garchan; jasale krodhalAI dabAu~chan ra mAnisaharUlAI kSamA garchan | ra, allAha sukarmIharUlAI mana parAu~chan |

ra, unIharUle kunai azlIla kArya garemA vA AphaiMmAthi anyAya garemA allAhalAI smaraNa garera AphnA pApaharUkA lAgi kSamAyAcanA garchan | ra, allAhabAheka kasale pApalAI kSamA garna sakcha ra? ra, unIharU jAnIjAnI Aphno kukarmamA haTha gardainan |

yastA mAnisaharUko pratidAna unIharUkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kSamAdAna ra yastA bagaiMcAharU hunechan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadAsarvadA rahanechan | satkarmIharUkA nimti yo kati rAmro pratidAna ho!
timIharUbhandA pahile dherai udAharaNaharU bitekA chan tasartha dhartImA ghumaphira garI hera asatya Thahara garneharUko kasto pariNAma bhayo!
yo mAnavajAtikA nimti (satyako) varNana ho ra Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA nimti mArgadarzana evaM upadeza |
na hatAza hoU na santApa nai gara | yadi timIharU momina hau bhane timIharU nai sarvopari hunechau |

yadi timIharUlAI kunai AghAta pugeko cha bhane tyastai AghAta aru (virodhI) vyaktiharUlAI pani pugisakeko cha | ra, hAmI mAnisaharUbIca yI dinaharU pAlaipAlo pherirahanchauM | ra, tAki allAhale tI mAnisaharulAI jAnun jo AsthA rAkhchan ra timIharUmadhyebATa sAkSI banAunu cha | ra, allAha atyAcArIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |
ra, tAki allAhale mominaharUlAI pRthaka pAruna tathA kAphira (avajJAkArI) harUlAI naSTa pAruna |
ke timIharUle svargamA tyasai praveza pAunechau bhanne ThAnekA chau jabaki allAhale timIharUmadhye jihAda garneharU tathA dhairyadhAraNa garneharUlAI rAmrarI jAnekai chainan |
ra, timIharU mRtyu Aunuaghi nai yasako kAmanA gardathyau | aba ta timIharUle AphUsamakSa tyasalAI khullA A~khAle dekhisakyau |

ra, muhammada (sa.) kevala rasUla hun | unIbhandA pahile pani rasUlaharu bitisakekA chan | ke unako mRtyu bhaemA vA unako hatyA gariemA timIharU ulTo pAu pharkanechau? ra, jo ulTo pAu pharkanecha tyasale kadApi allAhako kehI bigArna sakdaina | ra, allAhale kRtajJaharUlAI pratidAna dinechan |

ra, allAhako anumatibinA kunai prANI marna sakdaina, (mRtyUko) nirdhArita samaya lekhieko cha | ra, jasale saMsAra mai pratiphala pAune uddezyale kArya garcha hAmI tyasalAI saMsAra mai pratiphala dinechauM ani jasale Akhirata (paraloka) mA pratiphala pAune uddezyale kArya garcha hAmI tyasalAI paraloka mai pratiphala dinechauM | ra, kRtajJaharUlAI hAmI badalA dinechauM |

ra, katipaya yastA sandeSTAharU bite josita milera dherai dharmaniSThaharUle yuddha gare | ani, allAhako mArgamA unIharUmAthi jejati kaSTaharU Ae tyasabATa unIharU na hatAza bhae na durbalatA nai dekhAe ra na ghu~DA nai Teke | ra, allAha dhairyavAnaharUlAI mana parAu~chan |

ra unIharUko prArthanA yo mAtra thiyo– “he pAlanakartA! hAmrA pApa evaM hAmIle garekA kAryaharUmA bhaekA sImA ullaGghanakA nimti kSamA gara ra hAmrA kadamaharUlAI jamAideU, ani kAphira (avajJAkArI) samudAyaharUko viruddhamA hAmro maddata gara |”
ani allAhale unIharUlAI yasa saMsArako pratiphala die ra paralokako sarvottama pratidAna pradAna gare | ra allAha sukarmIharUlAI prema gardachan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUle kAphiraharUko AjJApAlana garyau bhane tinIharUle timIharUlAI ulTo pAu pharkAune chan ani timIharU noksAna uThAunevAlA hunechau |
apitu allAha timIharUkA sahayogI hun ra unI sarvottama sahayogI hun |

hAmI cA~Dai nai kAphiraharUkA hRdayamA ravApha hAlnechauM kinabhane tinIharUle yastA cijaharUlAI allAhako sAjhedAra banAekA chan jasako kunai pramANa allAhale avataraNa garekA chainan ra tinIharUko bAsasthAna naraka ho | kati narAmro cha atyAcArIharUko bAsasthAna!

ra, tyatibelA allAhale timIharUsa~ga gareko Aphno vacana pUrA gare jaba unako AdezamA timIharUle tinIharUko hatyA gardaithiyau; yahA~samma ki timIharUle sAhasa gumAyau ra (diieko) AdezamA ApasamA matabheda garyau ra allAhale timIharUlAI timIharUle cAheko (yuddhabATa prApta) cija dekhAepachi timIharUle avajJA garyau; timIharUmadhye kohI yo saMsAra cAhancha ra kohI paralokako abhilASi cha | taba timIharUko parIkSAkA nimti allAhale timIharUlAI tinIharUbATa bimukha (parAsta) gare | ani timIharUlAI kSamA pani gare | allAha AsthAvAnaharUprati ati kRpAlu chan |

ra, (tyasa samayako smaraNa gara) jaba timIharU kasailAI herdai naherI chiTo–chiTo uklirahekA thiyau jaba ki allAhakA rasUla pachADibATa timIharUlAI bolAu~dai thie | ani timIharUbATa gumekA cijaharUle gardA ra timIharUmAthi AiparekA bipatale gardA timIharU zokAkula nahoU bhanera allAhale timIharUlAI duHkha mAthi duHkha die | ra timIharUko pratyeka kAryabATa allAha avagata chan |

ani allAhale tyasa duHkhapazcAt timIharUmadhye euTA samUhalAI nizcintatA pradAna gare jasale gardA unIharU laTTha pare | tara Aphno jyAnako cintA bhaeko arko samUha allAhako bAremA vibhinna kisimakA asatya, ajJAnatApUrNa anumAnaharU garna thAlyo ra bhanna thAlyo– “yasa kAryasaJcAlanamA hAmro pani kehI adhikAra cha ra?” bhanideU– “sampUrNa adhikAra allAhasa~ga cha |” vAstavamA tyo samUhale Aphno hRdayamA juna kurAharU lukAi rAkheko cha tyo timIharUsamakSa prakaTa garne chaina | tyo samUha ApasamA kurA gardA bhandacha– “yadi yasa adhikAramA hAmro pani kehI aMza bhaeko bhae hAmI yahA~ mArine thienauM |” bhanideU– “timIharU A–Aphno gharabhitrai bhae pani ja–jasako mRtyu nirdhArita thiyo tinIharU A–Aphno mRtyusthalatarpha pugne thie |” (yasto yasa kAraNale gariyo ki) jejati timIharUko manamA cha allAhale tyasako jA~ca garUn ra jejati timIharUko hRdayamA cha tyasalAI zuddha pArUn | ra, allAha manakA kurAharU rAmrarI jAndachan |

timIharUmadhye juna mAnisaharUle yuddharata duI dala bheTa hune dinamA piThyU~ pharkAe, vAstavamA tinIharUkA kehI kamajorIharUkA kAraNa zaitAnale tinIharulAI pachADi pharkAeko thiyo | allAhale unIharUlAI kSamA pradAna gare | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM sahiSNu chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! tI kuphra (avajJA) garneharU jhaiM nabana jasale yAtrA vA yuddhako uddezyale niskekA AphnA sAthIbhAiharUko bAremA bhane– “yadi unIharU hAmIsa~ga rahekA bhae na marne thie na mArine thie |” tAki allAhale yasa kisimako kurAlAI tinIharUko manamA pazcAttApako kAraNa banAUn | vAstavamA allAha nai jIvana pradAna garchan ani mRtyu dinchan | ra, timIharU je garchau tyo allAhale dekhirahekA chan |
ra, timIharU allAhako mArgamA mAriyau vA maryau bhane tinIharUle je jammA garirahekA chan tyasako tulanAmA allAhako kSamAdAna evaM kRpAdRSTi uttama cha |
ra, timIharU mara vA timIharUlAI mAriyos, (dubai avasthAmA) timIharUlAI ekatrita garI allAhakahA~ nai laginecha |

(he muhammada (sa.)!) timI allAhako kRpAle nai unIharUprati udAra rahekA chau | yadi timI krura evaM kaThora hRdayI bhaeko bhae yinIharU timro variparibATa titaravitara hune thie | yinIharUlAI mAphi deU; yinIharUkA lAgi kSamAyAcanA gara ra kAmamA yinIharUsita sallAha line gara | ra, jaba timI kunai kAryako dRr3ha saGkalpa gardachau taba allAhamAthi bharosA gara | nissandeha allAha bharosA garneharUlAI mana parAu~chan |

allAhale timro sahAyatA garemA kasaile pani timImAthi prabhutva prApta garna sakdaina; ra unale timIlAI asahAya choDemA unI bAheka timIlAI sahayoga garne ko cha ra? AsthAvAnaharUle kevala allAhaprati bharosA rAkhnupardacha |

ra, kunai pani sandeSTAle beimAnI garnu sambhava chaina | ani, jasale beimAnI garcha tyo beimAnIkAsAtha mahApralayako dina (allAhasamakSa) hAjira hunecha | ani pratyeka vyaktilAI usako Arjanako pratidAna pUrNarUpamA pradAna garinecha ra unIharUmAthi kunai anyAya garine chaina |
ke allAhako cAhanA mutAbika kArya garne vyakti allAhako Akroza bokI pharkane vyakti saraha huna sakcha? ra usako bAsasthAna naraka ho, ani kati nikRSTa sthAna cha tyo!
tI mAnisaharUkA lAgi allAhakahA~ beglAbeglai darjA rahekA chan | ra, allAha tinIharUle garirahekA sabai kAryaharU dekhirahekA chan |

nissandeha allAhale AsthAvAnaharUmAthi ThUlo upakAra gare jaba unIharUmAjha unIharUmadhyebATai euTA yasto rasUla paThAe jo unIharUlAI allAhakA AyataharU paDhera sunAu~chana; unIharUlAI zuddha pArchan ra unIharUlAI Izagrantha evaM tatvadarzitAko zikSA dinchan | yathArthamA tinIharU yasaaghi spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA thie |

timIharUmAthi kaSTa pugdA yo kahA~bATa Ayo bhanchau jabaki yasako duIgunA kaSTa timIharUle (badrako yuddhamA zatruharUlAI) puryAisakekA chau | bhanideU— “yo timIharU kai tarphabATa Aeko ho |” nissandeha allAha hareka cijako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
duI samUhabIca muThabheDa bhaeko dina timIharUko juna noksAnI bhayo tyo allAhakai anumatile bhayo ra (yasa yuddhako uddezya yo thiyo ki) AsthAvAnaharU ko hun bhanI allAhale pattA lagAUn |

tathA (yo pani ki) unale munAphikaharU ko hun bhanI pattA lagAUn | ra, jaba tinIharUlAI bhaniyo– “AU, allAhako mArgamA yuddha gara vA pratirodha gara |” taba tinIharUle bhane– “hAmIlAI yuddha hune kurAko jAnakArI bhaeko bhae hAmI avazya timIharUsa~ga hune thiyauM |” tyasa dina tinIharU ImAnako anupAtamA kuphrasa~ga baDhI nikaTa thie | tinIharU mukhale manamA nabhaekA kurAharU garthe | ra, allAha tinIharUle manamA lukAekA kurAharU rAmrarI jAndachan |
yI tinai hun jo svayaM basirahe ani AphnA dAjubhAiharUlAI bhane– “yadi unIharUle hAmro kurA sunekA bhae unIharU mArine thienan |” bhanideU– “yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane svayaMlAI mRtyubATa bacAU |”
allAhako mArgamA mAriekAharUlAI mRta naThAna | baru unIharU jIvita chan; AphnA pAlanakartAkahA~ bharaNapoSaNa pAirahekA chan |

unI (zahIda) harU allAhale pradAna garekA udAra anugrahamA Anandita evaM prasanna chan | ra, unIharUbhandApachi rahekAharU bAre zahIdaharUlAI zubha sUcanA prApta bhairahancha ki unIharUkA lAgi pani kunai Dara evaM cintAko kuro chaina |
unIharU allAhako kRpA evaM anugrahamA ramAirahekA chan ra nizcaya nai allAha AsthAvAnaharUko pratidAna khera phAldainan;
tI vyaktiharU jo ghAite bhaera pani allAha evaM rasUlako AhvAna svIkAra gare, tinIharUmadhye jasale satkarma gare evaM Izabhaya rAkhe tinIharUkA nimti ThUlo pratidAna raheko cha |

yI tI vyaktiharU hun jasalAI mAnisaharUle bhane– “zatruko ThUlo samUha timIharUviruddha ekatrita bhaeko cha; tinIharUsa~ga DarAU,” taba unIharUko ImAna jhan baDhera gayo ra unIharUle bhane– “hAmrolAgi allAha nai paryApta chan ra unI nai sababhandA rAmro kAryasAdhaka hun |”
ani unIharU allAhako kRpA evaM vaibhavakA sAtha pharke ra unIharUlAI kunai hAni–noksAnIle pani choena | ra, unIharUle allAhako cAhanA pani anusaraNa gare | ra, allAha ati anugrahI chan |
tyo zaitAna ho jasale AphnA sahayogI mitraharUdvArA tarsAu~cha | ataH yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane tinIharUsa~ga naDarAU; kevala masa~ga DarAU |

juna mAnisaharU kuphramA sakriyatA dekhAu~daichan tinIharU timIlAI cintita nabanAuna | tinIharUle allAhako kehI pani bigArna sakdainan | allAha tinIharUkA lAgi paralokamA kunai aMza rAkhna cAha~dainan | ra, tinIharUkA lAgi ThUlo yAtanA cha |
jasale ImAnako saTTAmA kuphra kharida gare tinIharUle allAhalAI kunai pani hAni puryAuna sakdainan | ra, tinIharUkA lAgi pIDAdAyaka yAtanA cha |

ra hAmIle dieko chuTalAI avajJAkArIharUle Aphno lAgi kadApi uttama naThAnUn | hAmI ta unIharUlAI yasa kAraNale chuTa diirahekA chauM ki unIharU pApamA jhan baDhun | ra, unIharUkA lAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA cha |

hAla timIharU juna avasthAmA chau tyasa avasthAmA allAhale AsthAvAnaharUlAI chADne chainan yahA~samma ki unale pavitra (mAnisaharU) bATa apavitra (mAnisaharU) lAI chuTyAun | na ta allAhale timIharUsamakSa gaiba (adRzya vAstavikatA) prakaTa garne chana | parantu allAhale AphnA IzadUtaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanchan, (yasako lAgi) rojdachan | ataH allAha tathA unakA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAU | ra timIharUle ImAna lyAyau ra Izabhaya rAkhyau bhane timIharUkA lAgi atyantai ThUlo pratidAna cha |

ra, allAhale Aphno udAra anukampAbATa pradAna gareko dhanamA jasale kanjusyAi~ garchan tinIharUle Aphno lAgi tyasalAI rAmro naThAnUn | yo tinIharUkA lAgi nikRSTa cha | juna dhana tinIharU kanjusyAi~ garera bacAu~daichan mahApralayako dina tyasalAI tinIharUko lAgi toka (galAko bhArI) banAinecha | ra, kevala allAhakai lAgi AkAzaharU evaM dhartIkA sampUNa sampatti | ra, timIharUle jejati garirahekA chau tyasabATa allAha pUrNarUpamA avagata chan |

allAhale tI mAnisaharUko bhanAi sunisakekA chan jasale bhane– “allAha nirdhana chan ra hAmI dhanI chauM |” ra, tinIharUle bhanekA ani nabIharUko akAraNa hatyA garekA kurAko hAmI abhilekha rAkhnechauM | ra, hAmIle bhannechauM– “la, jvalanazIla agniko yAtanA cAkha |”
yo timro Aphnai hAtale agADi paThAeko (karmako) kAraNale ho | ra allAha AphnA sevakaharUmAthi anyAya gardainan |

tI vyaktiharU jasale bhane– “allAhale hAmIlAI tabasamma kunai rasUlako kurA namAnne nirdezana diekAchan jabasamma nIjale hAmIsamakSa yasto balidAna lyAu~dainan jasalAI agnile bhakSaNa garos |” bhanideU– “mabhandA pahile timIharUsamakSa spaSTa nizAnIharUkA sAtha ra timIharUle bhane jastai rasUlaharU AekA thie, ani timIharU saccA hau bhane unIharUko hatyA kina garyau?”

pherI yadi tinIharUle timIlAI mithyA Thahara garchana bhane timIbhandA pahile AekA dherai rasUlaharUlAI pani mithyA Thahara garieko thiyo jo spaSTa nizAnI, Iza–bhASya (sahIphA) ra prakAzamaya granthaharUkA sAtha AekA thie |

pratyeka prANIle mRtyuko svAda cAkhnucha | ra, timIharUlAI timro pUrNa pratidAna mahApralayako dina nai pradAna garinecha | ani jasalAI narakabATa bacAiyo ra svargamA praveza garAiyo tyo nizciya nai saphala bhayo | sAMsArika jIvana ta kevala dhokAko sAmagrI ho |

timro dhana tathA prANamA timro parIkSA avazya hunecha | ra, ahle–kitAbaharU tathA anekezvaravAdIharUbATa dherai kaSTaprada kurAharU sunnechau | tara, yadi timIharUle dhairya dhAraNa garyau ra Izabhaya rAkhyau bhane nissandeha yo ati sAhasI kArya hunecha |

ra, (smaraNa gara) jaba allAhale granthavAhakaharUsita vacana lie ki timIharUle yasalAI mAnisaharUmAjha spaSTa rUpamA bayAna garnechau ra lukAune chainau | tara tinIharUle tyasalAI piThyU~pachADi phyA~ke ani tuccha mUlyamA tyasalAI bece | kati narAmro cha tinIharUle garne yo vyApAra!

jo AphnA kAryaharUmA magna chan ra AphUle gardai nagarekA kAryaharUko prazaMsA cAhanchan tinIharU yAtanAbATa bacna saphala hunechan bhanne timI kadApi naThAna | ra tinIharUkA lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA cha |
ra AkAzaharU evaM pRthvIko zAsana allAha kai lAgi raheko cha ra allAha sampUrNa kurAharumAthi sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
nissandeha AkAzaharU evaM pRthvIko sRSTi ra rAta evaM dinako pAlaipAlo AunejAne kramamA buddhimAnaharUkA lAgi nizAnIharU rahekA chan;

jo ubhi~dA ra basdA ra sutdA allAhalAI smaraNa garchan ra AkAzaharU evaM pRthvIko saMracanAmAthi manana garchan | (unIharu bhanchana) "he hAmrA pAlanakartA! timIle yI sabai vyartha sRSTi garekA chainau | timI pavitra chau | ataH hAmIlAI narakako yAtanAbATa bacAU |"
"he hAmrA pAlanakartA! timIle jasalAI narakamA homyau tyasalAI apamAnita garyo | ra, atyAcArIharUko kohI sahayogI hunechaina |"

"he hAmrA pAlanakartA! ekajanA AhvAnakartAle hAmIlAI AsthAtarpha bolAu~dai gareko hAmIle sunyauM—“AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi ImAna lyAU |” tasartha hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmrA pApaharUlAI kSamA gara ra hAmrA nikRSTatAharU hAmIbATa samApta pAra | ani, dharmaparAyaNaharUsa~gai hAmIlAI mRtyuvaraNa garAU |"

"he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI tI sabai cija pradAna gara jasako vacana timIle AphnA rasUlaharuko mAdhyamabATa hAmIlAI diekA chau, ani mahApralayako dina hAmIlAI apamAnita nagarnU | nissandeha timI Aphno vAcA toDdainau |"

ataH unIharUkA pAlanakartAle prArthanA svIkAra gare– “ma timIharUmadhye kasaiko karma nirarthaka tulyAu~dina cAhe tyo puruSa hos vA mahilA | timIharU paraspara eka arkAbATa hau | ani jasale mero mArgamA hijarata gare; gharabATa nikAlie; jasalAI mero mArgamA yAtanA diiyo ani jasale yuddha gare tathA yuddhamA mArie, ma unIharUkA pApaharU samApta pArnechu ra unIharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunechu jasako talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan | yo pratidAna allAhako tarphabATa ho ra sarvottama pratidAna allAhasa~ga nai raheko cha |"
(he muhammada sa.!) zaharamA anAsthA pradarzana garneharUko ghumaphirale timIharUlAI bhramamA napAros |
tyo ta alpakAlina mojamajjA mAtra ho | pachi yinIharUko bAsasthAna naraka hunecha | ra kati nikRSTa bAsasthAna ho tyo!

tara AphnA pAlanakartAko avajJAbATa bacdai jIvanayApana garneharUkA lAgi bagaiMcAharU chan jasako talatira nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadAsarvadA rahanechan | allAhako tarphabATa yo Atithya ho | ra, jejati allAhasa~ga cha dharmaparAyaNaharUkA lAgi ati uttama cha |

ra ahle kitAbamadhye kehI vyaktiharU yastA pani chan jo allAhamAthi ra timImAthi avatarita ra unIharUmAthi avatarita kurAharUmAthi ImAna rAkhchan; allAhako sAmunne vinamra rahane garchan ra allAhakA AyataharU tuccha mUlyamA vikrI gardainan | yastA mAnisaharUko pratidAna unIharUkA pAlanakartAkahA~ raheko cha | nissandeha allAha cA~Dai hisAba linevAlA chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! dhairyadhAraNa gara | dhairyadhAraNamA pratispardhA gara ra (allAhako mArgamA) eka arkolAI saghAU | ra, allAhako bhaya rAkha, AzA cha ki timIharU saphala hunechau |

he mAnavaharU ho! AphnA tyasa pAlanakartAko bhaya rAkha jasale timIharUlAI euTai jyAnabATa sRSTi gare ra tyasai jyAnabATa usako joDI banAe ani tI dubaibATa dherai puruSa tathA mahilAharU bistAra gare | tyasa allAhako Dara rAkha jasako nAma liera timIharU paraspara hakaadhikAra mAgdachau, ani AphantaharUko (haka hanan) bAre pani DarAu | nissandeha allAha timIharUkA nirIkSaka hun |
anAthaharUko dhana–sampatti unIharUlAI phirtA gara | ra Aphno narAmro dhanasita unIharUko uttama dhana nasATa | ra, anAthaharUko dhanalAI Aphno dhanamA misAera nakhAU; nizcaya nai yo mahApApa ho |

yadi timIharUlAI anAthaprati nyAya garna nasakielA ki bhanne Dara cha bhane timIharU AphulAI mana parekI strIharUmadhye duI–duI, tIna–tIna vA cAra–cAra janAsa~ga bihe gara | tara, yadi tI patnIharUbIca nyAya garna sakdainau bhanne AzaGkA cha bhane euTImA mAtra sImita rahu vA timro adhInamA rahekI kunai dAsImA | anyAyabATa bacne yo nikaTatama upAya ho |
ra, mahilAharUlAI unIharUko mahara khuzI manale dine gara | ani yadi unIharUle AphUkhuzIsAtha tyasabATa kehI dina tayAra hunchan bhane tyasalAI saharSa upabhoga gara |
ra, allAhale timIharUkAlAgi jIvanayApanako sAdhana banAeko sampattilAI timIharUle vivekahIna anAthaharUlAI nasumpa | tara unIharUlAI tyasabATa khuvAU, pahirAU ra unIharUsita mITho bolI bola |

biheko umera nahunjela anAthaharUko parIkSaNa gardai gara | ani jaba timIharUlAI unIharU hoziyAra bhaisakekA chan banne kurAko AbhAsa huncha bhane taba unIharUko dhanasampatti unIharUlAI sumpideU | tinIharU bAliga bhaihAllAn bhanne Darale hatAramA ra jathAbhAvI kharca garera unIharUko sampatti nakhAideU | (anAthako saMrakSaka madhye) jo Atma nirbhara cha tyo tyasa dhanabATa bacos ra jo garIba cha usale sAmAnya calana anusAra tyasabATa upabhoga garos | ra, tI anAthaharUko sampatti unIharUlAI sumpane belAmA kehI vyaktiharUlAI sAkSI banAU | ra, hisAbakitAbakA lAgi allAha nai paryApta chan |

AmA–bAbu evaM nikaTatama nAtedAraharUle choDeko dhana sampattimA puruSaharUko aMza raheko huncha ra mAtApitA evaM nikaTatama nAtedAraharUle choDekA dhanasampattimA mahilAharUko pani aMza raheko huncha | cAhe tyo thorai hos vA dherai; hissA nirdhArita cha |
ra, yadi aMzabaNDAko samayamA anya nAtedAra, anAtha tathA nirdhanaharU upasthita hunchan bhane tyasabATa unIharUlAI pani kehI deU ani unIharUsa~ga mITho bolI bola |

mAnisaharUle yo samjhera DarAunu parne ho ki yadi tinIharUle AphU pachADi vivaza, durbala santAnalAI chADera gaekA bhae tinIharUko (avasthA prati) cintA rahanthyo | tasartha tinIharU allAhako thaya rAkhnupardacha ra nyAyocita kurA garnupardacha |
ja–jasale anAthaharUko sampatti anyAyapUrvaka upabhoga gardachan tinIharU vAstavamA Aphno bhu~DImA Ago bhardachan | ani, tinIharU narakako danka~do AgomA hominechan |

allAha timrA santAnaharUko sambandhamA timIharUlAI nirdezana dinchan— ekajanA puruSako aMza duIjanA mahilAko aMza barAbara huncha | yadi duIbhandA baDhI chorIharU nai chan bhane unIharUle sampattiko duI tihAI pAunechan | ra, euTI mAtra chorI chin bhane unakolAgi AdhA sampatti rahekocha | mRtakako kunai santAna cha bhane mRtakakA mAtApitAmadhye pratyekalAI mRtakale chADeko sampattiko chaiThau bhAga prApta hunecha | tara, santAna chaina ra uttarAdhikArI kevala AmA–buvA nai hun bhane AmAko aMza eka tihAI hunecha | ra, mRtakako dAjubhAi tathA didIbahinI chan bhane AmAko aMza sampattiko chaiThauM bhAga hunecha | (yI aMzabaNDA mRtakako) vasIyata pUrA garepachi ra usamAthi raheko RNa cuktA bhaepachi mAtra kAryAnvayana hunecha | timIharUkA mAtApitA ra santAnaharUmadhye timrolAgi ko baDhI lAbhadAyaka hunecha bhanne kurA timIharUlAI thAhA chaina | yI allAhadvArA nirdhArita aMzaharU hun | nissandeha allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

timrA patnIharUle choDeko sampattimA unIharUkA kunai santAna nabhaemA timIharUlAI AdhA aMza hunecha | tara unIharUko santAna bhaemA unIharUle choDeko sampattimadhye timIharUlAI cauthAI bhAga hunecha | yo unIharUle gareko vasIyata pUrA garepachi ra unIharUmAthi raheko RNa cuktA bhaepachi mAtra kAryAnvayana hunecha | yadi timI (puruSa) harUko kunai santAna nabhaemA timIharUle choDeko sampattimA timrA patnIharUlAgi cauthAI bhAga hunecha | tara, santAna raheko khaNDamA unIharUlAgi AThauM bhAga hunecha | yo timIharUle gareko vasiyata pUrA bhaepachi ra timIharUmAthi raheko RNa cuktA bhaepachi mAtra kAryAnvayana hunecha | yadi kunai puruSa vA mahilAko mAtApitA vA santAna (jIvita) chaina tara ekajanA dAju yA bhAi athavA ekajanA didI yA bahinI mAtra cha bhane yasto sthitimA dAju–bhAi vA didI–bahinI harekalAI chaiThauM bhAga prApta hunecha | tara, dAjubhAi vA didIbahinIko saMkhyA ekabhandA baDhI cha bhane unIharU sabaile eka tihAImadhyebATa aMza pAunechan | yo vasiyata pUrA garepachi ra RNa cuktA bhaepachi mAtra kAryAnvayana hunecha; kasailAI hAni napugos | yo allAhako Adeza ho ra allAha sarvajJa evaM sahanazIla chan |

yI allAhale nirdhAraNa garekA sImAharU hun ra jasale allAha evaM rasUla ko AjJApAlana garchan allAhale unIharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunechan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | tyasamA unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan ra yo ThUlo saphalatA ho |

ra jasale allAha evaM unakA rasUlako avajJA garcha ra unale nirdhArita garekA sImAharUko ullaGghana garcha, allAhale usalAI narakamA homnechan jahA~ U sadAsarvadA rahanecha | ra, usakolAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA rahekocha |

timrA strIharUmadhye vyabhicAra garneharUbiruddha AphUmadhyebATa cArajanA puruSa sAkSI banAu | yadi tinIharUle sAkSI die bhane tI patnIharUlAI gharabhitra najarabanda garI rAkha yahA~samma ki yA tinIharUko prANa jAos yA allAhale tinIharUkAlAgi kunai bATo nikAlUn |

ra, timIharUmadhye juna duIjanA vyabhicArako doSI pAiemA tI duvailAI kaSTa deU | ani yadi tinIharUle taubA (prAyazcita) garchan ra AphUlAI sudhArchan bhane tinIharUlAI choDideU | nissandeha allAha taubA svIkArakartA evaM parama dayAlu chan |

allAha kevala tI mAnisaharUko taubA svIkAra garchan jasale ajJAnatAko kAraNa kukarma garekA hunechan ani tatkAlai taubA garchan | yinIharUkai taubA allAhale svIkAra garnechan | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, tI mAnisaharUko lAgi taubA (ko prAvadhAna) nai chaina jo duSkarma gardai jAnchan yahA~samma ki tinIharUmadhye jaba kasaiko mRtyuko samaya Au~cha taba bhandacha– “aba maile taubA gareM |” ra, na (tinIharUko lAgi taubA cha jo kAphira bhaekai avasthAmA marchan | yastA mAnisaharUkAnimti hAmIle duHkhadAyI yAtanA tayAra pArekA chauM |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! jabarajastI strIharUko vArisa bannu timIharUkAlAgi vaidha chaina | ra timIharUle dieko (maharako) kehI aMza phirtA line uddezyale unIharUlAI hairAna pArnu (pani) vaidha chaina | tara yadi unIharUle khullamakhullA azlIla kArya gare bhane (yo arkai kurA ho) | ra, unIharUsa~ga nyAyocita vyavahAra gara | kunai strI timIharUle mana naparAeko khaNDamA huna sakcha allAhale timIharUlAI mana napareko cijamA prazasta bhalAi sRjanA garidiUn |

ra, yadi timIharU ekajanA patnIko sthAnamA arkI patnI lyAuna cAhanchau ani pahilo patnIlAI prazasta dhanasampatti diI rAkhekA chau bhane tinIsa~ga kehI pani phirtA naleU | ke timIharU unImAthi mithyA Aropa ra khullamakhullA pApa garera tyo sampatti phirtA linchau?
ra, timIharU tyo kasarI lina sakchau jabaki timIharU ekaarkAbATa Ananda liisakekA chau ra unIharUle timIharUsa~ga dRDha pratijJA pani liisakekA chan?
ra, tI mahilAharUsa~ga kadApi vivAha nagara josa~ga timIharUkA pitAharUle vivAha garekA thie | atItamA je bhayo, bhayo | nizcaya nai yo azlIla evaM ghRNita kArya ra narAmro calana ho |

timIharUkAlAgi avaidha chan timIharUkA AmA, chorI, didI–bahinI, phupU, sAnIAmA ra ThUlIAmA, bhatijI, bhAnjI, dhAIAmA, dhAIdidIbahinI, sAsu ra timrA tI patnIharu josa~ga timIharUko sahavAsa bhaisakeko cha, tinakA tI chorIharU jo timrA pAlanapoSaNamA chin | tara, yadi timIharUko tinIharU (tI chorIkA AmA) sa~ga sahavAsa bhaeko chaina bhane (unIharUlAI talAka diepachi unakA chorIharUsa~ga vivAha garna) kunai pApa chaina | ani, timIharUkA sahodara chorAharUkA patnIharU (buhArI) ra ekaisAtha duIjanA didI–bahinIsa~ga vivAha pani avaidha cha | tara atItamA je bhayo bhayo; nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

ra, kasaiko dAmpatya jIvanamA rahekA mahilAharU pani timIharUkA nimti avaidha chan | tathApi (yuddhabATa) timIharUko adhInamA AekA mahilAharUko kurA beglai cha | yo timIharUkA nimti allAhadvArA anivArya garieko kAnUna ho | yI bAhekakA mahilAharU timIharUkA lAgi vaidha chan yasarI ki timIharU dhana kharcera (mahara diera tinalAI) prApta gara; vivAhako bandhanamA bA~dhera, kAma vAsanAko uddezyale hoina | ani timIharUle unIharUsita dAmpatya jIvanako Ananda liyau ata: unIharUlAI anivArya rUpamA mahara pradAna gara | tara mahara nizcita bhaisakepachi paraspara sahamati mA thapaghaTa gardA kunai pApa hune chaina | nissandeha allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, timIharUmadhye jasale svAdhIna AsthAvAna mahilAsa~ga vivAha garne sAmarthya rAkhdaina U timIharUko adhInamA rahekA AsthAvAna dAsIharUsa~ga vivAha garos | ra allAha timIharUko AsthAlAI rAmrarI jAndachan | timIharU sabai ekaarkA madhyekai hau | ataH tI dAsIharUkA saMrakSakako anumati liera tinIharUsa~ga bibAha gara ra niyamAnusAra tinIharUko mahara pani bujhAU tAki tinIharU vivAhako paridhibhitra surakSita rahUn ani vyabhicAramA lipta nahoUn sAthai lukicorI gopya sambandha kAyama nagarUn | vivAhapazcAt dAsIharUle vyabhicAra garemA tinIharUlAI svAdhIna mahilAharUkAlAgi nirdhArita daNDako AdhA hunecha | dAsIharUsa~ga vivAhako yo anumati timIharUmadhye tI mAnisaharUkolAgi ho jasalAI pApamA lipta hune AzaGkA huncha | tara timIharUle dhairya ra saMyamatA apanAyau bhane timIharUkAlAgi ati rAmro hunecha | allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

allAhako manasAya timIharUsamakSa (Aphno niyama) spaSTa rUpamA bayAna garnu cha ra pahilekA (sadAcArI) vyaktiharUko rIti anusAra timIharUlAI hiMDAunu cha ani timIharUko taubA svIkAra garnu cha | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |
ra allAhako cAhanA ta timIharuko taubA svIkAra garnu ho| tara AphnA kuabhilASA anusaraNa garneharu timIharUlAI (satmArgabATa) dherai TADhieko dekhna cAhanchan |
allAha timIharUko bojha halukA pArna cAhanchan | ra mAnava kamajora nai sRjanA garieko cha |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharU ApasI sahamatibATa vyApAradvArA hAsila bhaeko dhana vAheka eka-arkAko dhanasampatti anucita DhaGgale nakhAU ra na AtmahatyA nai gara | nissandeha allAha timIharUprati ati dayAlu chan |
ani jasale anyAya ra atyAcArapUrNa DhaGgale yasto garcha hAmI cA~Dai nai tyasalAI narakamA homnechauM ra yo allAhakAlAgi sajilo kArya ho |
yadi timIharU ThUlA pApaharU jasabATa timIharUlAI rokincha, bacnechau bhane hAmI timIharUkA (sAnAtinA) doSaharU kSamA garidinechauM ra timIharUlAI sammAnajanaka dvAramA praveza garAunechauM |

allAhale timIharUmadhye kehIlAI arkokehImAthi juna zreSThatA pradAna garekA chan tyasako kAmanA nagara | puruSaharUko lAgi unale Arjana gareko aMza cha ra mahilAharuko lAgi unale Arjana gareko aMza cha | ra allAhasita unako kRpAko yAcanA gara | nizcaya nai allAha hareka kurAko jJAna rAkhdachan |

ra, hAmIle mAtA–pitA tathA anya nAtedAraharUle choDera gaeko sampattimA tyasako uttarAdhikArI nirdhAraNa garidiekA chauM | ra josa~ga timIharU pratijJAbaddha chau unIharUlAI pani tyasako aMza deU | nissandeha hareka cija allAhako dRSTimA cha |

puruSaharU mahilAharUko abhibhAvaka hun kinabhane allAhale ekalAI arkomAthi pradhAnatA pradAna garekA chan ra yasa kAraNale pani ki puruSaharU Aphno sampatti kharca garchan | ani satkarmI mahilAharU AjJApAlana garchan, gopanIya kurAko rakSA garchan jasako rakSA allAhale garekA chan | ra juna mahilAharUko bAremA timIharUlAI avajJAko AzaGkA cha unIharUlAI samjhAU; ra (namAnemA) unIharUlAI occhayAnamA eklo choDideU; ra (ajhai namAnemA) kuTa ra yadi AjJApAlana garna thAlchan bhane unIharUviruddha kunai bahAnA nakhoja | nizcaya nai allAha ati mahAn ra sarvocca chan |

ra, yadi timIharUlAI pati–patnIbIca phuTa parne AzaGkA hancha bhane patiko nAtedAraharU madhyebATa ekajanA ra patnIko nAtedAraharUmadhyebATa ekajanA madhyasthakartA niyukta gara | yadi duvai sudhAra cAhanchan bhane allAhale unIharUbIca melamilApako bATo nikAlidinechan | nissandeha allAha sarvajJAtA evaM sarvadraSTA chan |

ra, allAhakai upAsanA gara; kasailAI unako sAjhedAra nabanAU | ani, mAtApitA, nAtedAra, anAtha, dIna–dukhI, chimekI–nAtedAra, birAno–chimekI, sAthIbhAI, baTuvA tathA timro adhInamA rahekA dAsa–dAsIharUsa~ga sadvyavahAra gara | allAha yastA vyaktilAI manaparAu~dainan jo ghamaNDI ra ahaGkArI chan |

jo vyaktiharu kanjusyAi~ garchan tathA arulAI pani kanjusyAi~ garne Adeza dinchan ra allAhale Aphno kRpAle jejati pradAna garekA chan tyasalAI lukAu~chan | ra, hAmIle yastA kRtaghnaharukAlAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA tayAra pArirAkhekA chauM |

ra, (allAha tinIharUlAI pani mana parAu~dainan) jo Aphno sampatti mAnisaharUlAI dekhAunakAlAgi kharca garchan ra yathArthamA na allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhchan na AkhiratamAthi nai | ra, jasale zaitAnalAI sAthI banAyo (usale yAda rAkhos) tyo ati nikRSTa sAthI ho |

yadi unIharUle allAha tathA Akhiratako dinamAthi ImAna lyAekA bhae ra allAhale jejati pradAna garekA chan tyasabATa kharca garekA bhae tinIharUko ke bigrane thiyo ra? ra, allAha tinIharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |
nissandeha allAha kaNa barAbara pani anyAya garne chainan | baru eka puNyalAI allAhale kaiyauM guNA baDhAi dinechan ra Aphno tarphabATa (ajha) ThUlo pratidAna pani pradAna garnechan |
ke avasthA holA jaba hAmI hareka ummata (samudAya) bATa sAkSI khaDA garnechauM ra (he muhammada sa.!) timIlAI yinIharUsamakSa sAkSIko rUpamA ubhyAunechauM?!

tyasa dina kAphiraharU tathA rasUlako avajJA garneharU tinIharulAI dharatImAtA puriera tsalAI barAbara garidie bhae besa hunthyo bhanI kAmanA garnechan | ra, tinIharUle allAhabATa kunai kurA lukAuna sakdainan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharU nazAmA bhaeko avasthAbATa AphUle bhanne kurAharU bujhna sakne avasthAmA napharkuJjela namAjako nikaTa najAU ra apavitratAko avasthAmA pani snAna nagaruJjela | tara, baTuvA bhaekomA beglai kurA ho | ra birAmI hu~dA vA yAtrAvasthAmA raha~dA vA zaucAlayabATa pharkepachi vA strIsita sahavAsapazcAt pAnI upalabdha bhaena bhane zuddha mATolAI sparza gara ani tyasalAI anuhAra ra hAtaharUmA dala | nissandeha allAha kSamAzIla evaM kRpAvAna chan |
ke timIharUle tI mAnisaharUlAI dekhenau jasalAI Izagranthako euTA aMza pradAna garieko cha? tinIharU svayaM pani pathabhraSTatA kharida garirahekA chan ra timIharU pani bATo birAU bhanne cAhanchan |
jabaki allAha timIharUkA zatruharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan ra timIharUko saMrakSaNa tathA sahAyatAkAlAgi allAha nai paryApta chan |

katipaya yahUdIharU zabdaharUlAI tinIharuko vAstavika sthAnabATa pherabadala garidinchan ra bhanchan– “samianA va asainA” (hAmIle sunyauM tara avajJA garyauM), “vasmaa gaira musmain” (timIharU suna tara nasunnegarI ) ra jibro baTArdai ra dharmamAthi kaTAkSa gardai “rAenA” bhanchan| yadi tinIharUle– “samianA va ataanA” (hAmIle sunyau~ ra AjJApAlana garyau~) bhanekA bhae ra “ismaa” (suna) ra “unjurnA” (hAmItarpha dhyAna deU) ‘bhanekA bhae tinIharUko hakamA rAmro ra ucita hune thiyo | tara tinIharUmAthi tinIharuko avajJAko kAraNale allAhako abhizApa pareko cha | ani tinIharU kamai ImAna lyAu~chan |

he ahle kitAba ho! hAmIle anuhAraharUlAI bigArera pachADi pharkAunuaghi athavA ‘sabta’ vAlAharUjhai tinIharUlAI sarApnubhandA aghi nai tyasa pustakamAthi ImAna lyAU juna hAmIle avataraNa garyauM ra jasale timIharUsa~ga pahiledekhi nai raheko pustakako puSTi gardacha | ra, allAhako Adeza lAgU bhaerai chADnecha |

AphUsita kasailAI sAjhedAra banAune kArya (zirka) lAI allAhale kadApi kSamA garne chainan tara yasabAhekakA anya pApa jasako lAgi cAhanechan kSamA garnechan | jasale allAhasita (kasailAI) sAjhedAra banAyo usale vAstavamA euTA ThUlo pApako saMracanA garyo |
ke timIle svayaMlAI cokho bhanne vyaktiharUlAI dekhenau jabaki allAha jasalAI cAhanchan pavitratA pradAna garchan | ra, tinIharUmAthi rauM barAbara pani anyAya garine chaina |
hera, yinIharU kasarI allAha mAthi mithyAropaNa gardaichan? yahI kurA ta spaSTa pApa hunakAlAgi paryApta cha |

ke tI mAnisaharUlAI dekhenau jasalAI Izagranthako aMza pradAna garieko thiyo? tinIharU jibta (mUrti) tathA tAguta (zaitAna) mAthi AsthA rAkhchan ra kAphiraharUbAre bhandachan– “mominaharUbhandA baDhI ta yinIharU nai satmArgamA chan |”
yinIharU nai hun jasalAI allAhale zrApita garekA chan ra jasamAthi allAhako zrApa parcha usako kohI sahayogI timIle pAune chainau |
ke zAsanasattAmA tinIharUko kunai sahabhAgitA raheko cha? raheko bhae tinIharUle mAnisaharUlAI rattibhara pani kehI dine thienan |

ke yinIharU mAnisaharUsa~ga yasa kAraNale irSyA gardaichan ki allAhale tinIharUlAI Aphno kRpAbATa pradAna garekA chan? ani hAmIle ta ibrAhImakA santAnaharUlAI grantha evaM tatvadarzitA pradAna garyau~ ra unIharUlAI mahAn rAjya pani pradAna garekA thiyau~ |
ani, tinIharUmadhye kehIle tyasamAthi ImAna lyAe tara anya kehI vimukha bhae ra narakako danka~do Ago tinIharUkAlAgi paryApta cha |

jasale hAmrA AyataharUlAI inkAra gare tinIharUlAI cA~Dai nai agnimA homnechau~ | jaba–jaba tinIharUkA chAlA DaDhnechan hAmI tyasako ThAu~mA arko chAlA utpanna garnechau~ tAki tinIharUle yAtanAko svAda cAkhUn | nizcaya nai allAha sarvazaktimAna evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, jasale ImAna lyAe ani satkarma gare tinIharUlAI hAmI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunechau~ jasako talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan | tyasamA unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | tyahA~ tinIharUkAlAgi pavitra joDIharU hunechan ra hAmI unIharUlAI saghana chahArImA praviSTa garAunechau~ |

(he AjJAkArIharU ho!) allAhale timIharUlAI amAnata (nAso) harU tinIharukA adhikArIharulAI sumpane ra mAnisaharUbIca phaisalA gardA nyAyakAsAtha phaisalA garne Adeza dinchan | allAhale timIharUlAI ati uttama upadeza diirahekAchan | nizcaya nai allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvadraSTA chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! AjJApAlana gara allAhako ra AjJApAlana gara rasUlako ani timIharUmadhye adhikAra prApta vyaktiharuko | timIharU allAha evaM AkhiratamAthi ImAna rAkhchau bhane timIharUbIca kunai viSayamA vivAda hu~dA allAha evaM rasUlatarpha preSita gara | yo nai uttama ho ra yasaiko pariNAma rAmro hunecha |

ke timIle tI mAnisaharUlAI dekhenau jo timImAthi avatarita grantha evaM timIbhandA pahile avatarita granthamAthi ImAna rAkhne dAvI ta garchan tara AphnA muddAharU liera nirNayakAlAgi ‘tAgUtaharU’ (sImA ullaGghanakArIharU) samakSa jAna khojdachan, jabaki tinIharUlAI tAgUtaprati anAsthAko Adeza diieko thiyo tara zaitAna tinIharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArera satyamArgabATa TADhA laijAna cAhancha |
ra, jaba tinIharUlAI allAhale avataraNa gareko (granthako Adeza) mAnna tathA rasUlatarpha Auna bhanincha taba munAphika (kapaTI) harUlAI tarkera gaeko timIle dekhchau |

(he muhammada (sa.)!) tyattikhera tinIharUko ke avasthA hunecha jaba svayaM tinIharU kai hAtabATa bhaekA kriyAkalApale gardA tinIharUmAthi kunai prakopa Aiparnecha? taba timIsamakSa allAhako kasama khA~dai Aunechan ra bhannechan hAmro uddezya ta bhalAI tathA melamilApa mAtra thiyo |

yI tinai mAnisaharU hun jasako manamA rahekA bhedaharUlAI allAha jAndachan | tasartha (he muhammada (sa.)) unIharUko vAstai nagara ra upadeza dine gara | ani, tinIharUko antaramanamA prabhAva pArne kurA gara |

ra, hAmIle hareka rasUlalAI allAhako Adezabamojima unako AjJApAlana gariyos bhanne uddezyale mAtra paThAekA chau~ | (he muhammada (sa.)!) AphUmAthi atyAcAra gareko belA tinIharU timIsamakSa AekA bhae, allAhasa~ga kSamAyAcanA garekA bhae ra IzadUtale tinIharulAI kSamA garna prArthanA garekA bhae tinIharUle allAhalAI ati kSamAzIla evaM karuNAmaya pAune thie |

hoina, timrA pAlanakartAko kasama! jabasamma ApasI jhai–jhagaDAmA tinIharUle timIlAI nyAyadhIza banAu~dainan ra timIle gareko phaisalAprati Aphno manamA dvividhArahita sthiti pAu~dainan tathA pUrNarUpale samarpaNa gardainan tabasamma tinIharU AsthAvAna huna sakdainan |

ra, hAmIle tinIharU svayaMlAI vadha garna vA Aphno ghara tyAgna anivArya gareko bhae tinIharUmadhye kehIle mAtra garne thie | tinIharUle AphUlAI diieko AdezAnusAra karma garekA bhae yo tinIharUkAnimti uttama tathA sudRDhikaraNako kAraka hune thiyo |
ra, tyaso bhaeko bhae hAmIle tinIharulAI pakkai AphnotarphabATa mahAn pratidAna pradAna garne thiyauM |
ra, pakkai tinIharulAIlAI sidhA mArga pani dekhAune thiyauM |
ra, jasale allAha tathA rasUlako AjJApAlana garchan unIharU allAhale kRpA garekAharu arthAta nabI, satyavAdI, zahIda evaM satkarmI mAnisaharUsa~ga hunechan | ra, kati rAmrA chan yI sAthIharU!
yo varadAna allAhako tarphabATa ho ra yathArtha jAnnakAlAgi allAha nai paryApta chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! Aphno surakSAko lAgi sadaiva satarka rahane gara ani yuddhako lAgi niskadA yA ta vibhinna dalaharUmA vibhakta bhaI yA ekatrita bhaI niskane gara |

ra yasamA kunai saMdeha chaina ki timIharUmadhye kohI yasto pani cha jo jihAdabATa bhAgne garcha ani timIharUmAthi kunai saGkaTa AipardA tyasale bhancha– “maprati allAhako ThUlo kRpA bhayo ki ma tinIharUsa~ga upasthita thiina~ |”
tara timIharUlAI allAhako varadAna prApta hu~dA, mAnauM timIharUsa~ga usako kunai ghaniSTa nAtA nai chaina, usale bhannecha– “ma pani tinIharUsa~gai bhaeko bhae apAra saphalatA prApta garne thie~ |”

ataH sAMsArika jIvanamAthi Akhiratako jIvanalAI prArthamikatA dineharUle allAhako mArgamA yuddha garnupardacha | ra jasale allAhako mArgamA yuddha garcha ki ta u zahIda huncha ki ta vijaya prApta garcha |ani unIharUlAI hAmIle cA~Dai nai ThUlo pratidAna dinechauM |

Akhira timIharU ke kAraNale allAhako mArgamA ra tI durbala puruSa, mahilA tathA bAlabAlikAharUkAlAgi yuddha gardainau jo prArthanA garirahekA chan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! yasa nagarabATa hAmIlAI nikAla jahA~ kA bAsindAharu atyAcArIharU rahekA chan ra hAmrolAgi Aphno tarphabATa samarthaka banAu evaM hAmro lAgi Aphu kahA~bATa sahAyaka pradAna gara |”

AsthAvAnaharU allAhako mArgamA yuddha garchan bhane kAphiraharU ‘tAgUta’ (ati avajJAkArI zaitAna) ko mArgamA | ataH timIharU zaitAnakA sahayogIharUsita yuddha gara | vAstavamA zaitAnako dAupeca ati nai kamajora huncha |

ke timIle AphnA hAtaharUlAI rokera rAkha; namAja kAyama gara; jakAta deU bhanera Adeza diiekA mAnisaharUlAI dekhenau? ani jaba tinIharUmAthi jihAda anivArya gariyo taba kehI vyaktiharU jasarI allAhasita DarAunu parne ho tyasarI nai mAnisaharUsita DarAuna thAle baru tyobhandA pani baDhI | ra, bhane– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmImAthi timIle yuddhalAI kina anivArya garyau; kina hAmIlAI kehI dinakAlAgi thapa maukA dienau?” (he sandeSTA sa.!) bhanideU– “sAMsArika lAbha thorai cha ra Izabhaya rAkhneharUkAlAgi Akhirata nai uttama cha | ra, timIharUmAthi rauM barAbara pani atyAcAra garinechaina |”

timIharU jahA~sukai basa, mRtyule timIharUlAI gA~jne nai cha, cAhe tyo majabuta killA nai kina nahos | tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA bhaemA yo allAhako tarphabATa ho bhanne garchan ra kunai saGkaTa AiparemA bhanchan– (he muhammada (sa.) “yo timrai kAraNale Aeko ho |” bhanideU, yI sabai allAhakai tarphabATa AekA hun | Akhira yinIharUlAI ke bhaeko cha ki kunai pani kurA bujhdainan?

timIharUlAI je-jati phAidA pugcha tyo allAhako tarphabATa ho ra timIharUmAthi juna saGkaTa pani Au~dacha tyo timrai (kartUtako) kAraNale ho | ani, (he muhammada (sa.!) “hAmIle timIlAI mAnisaharUkAlAgi rasUla banAera paThAekA chauM | ra (yasako lAgi) allAhakai sAkSya paryApta cha |”
jasale IzadUtako AjJApAlana garyo nizcaya nai tyasale allAhako AjJApAlana garyo; ra jo vimukha bhayo hAmIle timIlAI tyastAharUmAthi rakSaka banAera paThAekA chainauM |

ra tinIharU bhanchan– “hAmI ta pUrNa AjJAkArI hauM |” tara, timIsa~ga chuTTiepachi rAtamA tinIharUmadhye euTA samUhale timIle bhanekA kurA viruddha saDayaMtra garchan | ani allAha tinIharUle garne garekA sabai saDayaMtralAI lekhirahekA chan | tinIharUko ciMtai nagara ra kevala allAhamAthi bharosA gara | ra, bharosAkAlAgi allAha nai paryApta chan |
ani ke tinIharU kuraAnamA ciMtana manana gardainan? yadi yo allAhabAheka anya kasaiko tarphabATa bhaeko bhae tinIharUle yasamA dherai virodhAbhAsaharU pAune thie |

ra, tinIharUsamakSa zAnti vA DarabAre kunai khabara pugdA tinIharU tyasalAI phailAidinchan | yadi tinIharUle IzadUta tathA Aphno AdhikArika vyaktiharUsamakSa puryAekA bhae, mAmilAko tahasamma pugneharUle satya–tathya jAnne thie | ra, yadi timImAthi allAhako varadAna evaM dayA nabhaeko bhae kehI vyaktiharUbAheka timIharU sabai zaitAnako anuyAyI banne thiyau |

ataH (he sandeSTA!) allAhako mArgamA yuddha gara | ra timI AphubAheka kasaiko uttaradAyI chainau | ra, AsthAvAnaharUlAI (yuddhako lAgi) protsAhita garne gara | AzA cha ki allAhale kAphiraharUko zaktilAI parAsta garnechan | ra, allAha sarvAdhika zaktizAlI tathA kaThora daNDadAtA chan |
jasale kunai rAmro siphAriza garcha tyasamA usako euTA aMza hunecha ra jasale narAmro siphAriza garcha tyasale tyasamA barAbara aMza pAunecha | ra, allAha sabai kurAko sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
ra, timIharUlAI AdarapUrNa abhinAdana (salAma) garincha bhane timIharU tyasabhandA ajha rAmro tarIkAle vA samAna zailImA abhinAdana gara | nissandeha allAha sampUrNa karmako hisAba rAkhdachan |

allAha– jasabAheka kohI upAsya chaina, unale timIharUlAI tyasa mahApralayako dina avazya ekatrita garnechan jasa (ko Agamana) mA kunai sandeha chaina | ra, allAhako kurAbhandA baDhI satya kasako kurA huna sakcha ra?

timIharUlAI ke bhaeko cha ki munAphika(kapaTI) harUko sambandhamA timIharU duImata chau jabaki allAhale munAphikaharU (buddhi) lAI tinIharukA kukarmaharUko kAraNale ghopTo pAridiekA chan? ke timI allAhale pathabhraSTa pArekAharUlAI satmArga dekhAuna cAhanchau? jasalAI allAhale pathabhraSTa garidiekA chan tyasakAnimti timIle kunai mArga prApta garna sakne chainau |

munAphikaharU ke cAhanchan bhane timIharU pani tinIharUjhai kAphira hoU tAki tinIharU tathA timIharU sabai samAna bana | ataH tinIharUmadhye kasailAI allAhako mArgamA hijarata nagaruJjela mitra nabanAU | yadi tinIharU bimukha hunchan bhane tinIharUlAI jahA~ bheTchau tyahI~ samAta ra vadha gara | ra, tinIharUmadhye kasailAI Aphno saMrakSaka–mitra tathA sahayogI nabanAU |

a~, tinIharUsa~ga yasa Adezako kunai sambandha chaina jasasa~ga timro sandhi bhaisakeko cha | tyasarI nai tinIharUsita pani yasa Adezako sambandha chaina jo timIsAmu yuddhabAre khinna bhaera Au~chan; jo na timIharUviruddha laDna cAhanchan na Aphno samudAyaviruddha nai | allAhale cAheko bhae tinIharUlAI timIharUmAthi prabhutva pradAna garne thie ani tinIharU timIharUviruddha yuddha garne thie | tara, tinIharU timIharUbATa TADhA rahanchan ra yuddha gardainan ani timIharUsa~ga samjhautA garna cAhanchan bhane allAhale timIharUkAlAgi tinIharUviruddha (yuddha garne) kunai mArga khulA rAkhekA chainan |

timIharUle kehI yastA munAphikaharU bheTTAunechau jo timIharUbATa ra AphnA samudAyabATa pani surakSita rahana cAhanchan | tara jaba upadrava garne samaya pAu~chan taba tyasamA saMlagna hunchan | ataH yadi yinIharU timIharUbATa TADhA raha~dainan ra timIharUsa~ga sandhi gardainan ani AphnA hAta rokdainan bhane jahA~ bheTchau tinIharUlAI samAta ra vadha gara | yastA mAnisaharUviruddha hAmIle timIharUlAI spaSTa prabhutva pradAna garekA chau~ |

AsthAvAnako yo kAma hoina ki usale kunai mominako hatyA garos, bhulacukako kurA beglai cha | ra, jasale bhulacukamA kunai mominako hatyA garcha usale euTA momina dAsalAI mukta garnupardacha ani tyasako parivAralAI raktamUlya tirnupardacha | tara unIharUle mApha garchan bhane tyo beglai kurA ho | parantu yadi hatAhata bhaeko vyakti timro zatru samudAyako mAnche rahecha ra tyo momina rahecha bhane timIle ekajanA momina dAsalArI mukta garnupardacha | ra, yadi U kunai yasto samUhako vyakti ho josa~ga timro sandhi bhaeko rahecha bhane usakA nAtedAraharUlAI rakta mulya dinuparcha ra ekajanA momina dAsalArI pani mukta garnuparcha | ani, jasale dAsa pAudaina usale nirantara durI mahinAko rojA (vrata) rAkhnupardacha | yo allAhako tarphabATa prAyazcitako svIkRti ho | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, jasale jAni jAni kunai mominako hatyA garcha, tyasako pratidAna naraka ho jasamA U sadAsarvadA rahanecha | ra, usamAthi allAhako prakopa tathA dhikkAra rahekocha | ra, allAhale usako lAgi kaThora yAtanA tayAra pArekA chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharU allAhako mArgamA prasthAna gardA jA~ca–bujha garne gara | jasale timIharUlAI salAma garcha usalAI jhaTTa ‘timI AsthAvAna hoinau’ bhanera nabhana | timIharU sAMsArika lAbha cAhanchau bhane allAhasa~ga pracUra sampatti raheko cha | pahile timIharU pani tyastai (kAphira) thiyau, ani allAhale timIharUmAthi kRpA gare | ho, jA~cabujhabATa kAma line gara | nizcaya nai timIharU je garchau allAha tyasabATa avagata chan |

AsthAvAnaharUmadhye kunai kAraNabinA gharamai basneharU ra allAhako mArgamA dhana tathA jIujyAnale jihAda garneharU samAna huna sakdainan | allAhale binA kAraNa basirahaneharUmAthi Aphno dhana tathA jIujyAnakAsAtha jihAda garneharUlAI eka zreNI ucca pArekA chan | ra, sabailAI allAhale rAmro pratidAnako vacana diekAchan | tApani jihAda garneharUlAI tyasai basirahaneharUko tulanAmA mahAna pratiphaladvArA zreSThatA pradAna garekA chan |
allAhakahA~ unIharUkAlAgi ucca zreNI cha ra kSamA ani dayA pani | ra, allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

nissandeha, jasale AphUmAthi atyAcAra garchan tinIharUko AtmAlAI samAtera phariztAharU sodhchan– “timIharU kuna avasthAmA thiyau?” unIharU bhanchan– “hAmI dhartImA kamajora ani vivaza thiyauM |” phariztAharU bhanchan– “ke allAhako dhartI vizAla thiena ra ki timIharU anyatra ‘hijarata’ garna saka?” tinIharUko bAsasthAna naraka ho | ra, kati narAmro ThegAnA ho naraka!
sivAya tI vivaza puruSa, mahilA tathA baccAharU jo upAya garna sakdainan ra jo niskane kunai mArga pani pAirahekA chainan |
AzA cha, allAhale unIharUlAI kSamA garidinechan | ra allAha dherai mApha garne tathA kSamAzIla chan |

ra, jo allAhako mArgamA gharabAra choDera niskanecha usale dhartImA bAsakolAgi dherai sthAna pAunecha ra prasasta suvidhA pani | ra, jo kohI allAha evaM IzadUtakA lAgi gharabAra choDera niskancha ra (bATomA) usako mRtyu huncha bhane allAhakahA~ usako pratidAna nizcita cha | ra, allAha kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
