ra jaba timIharU yAtrAmA niskanchau taba namAz2a kasra (cAra rikatako namAz2aharU duI rikata) garera paDhdA kunai Apatti chaina, yadi timIharUlAI kAphiraharUdvArA satAine zaMkA huncha bhane | nizcaya nai kAphiraharU timrA spaSTa zatru hun |

ra, (he sandeSTA!) jaba timI AsthAvAnaharUsa~ga hunchau ra unIharUlAI (yuddhako avasthAmA) namAz2a paDhAuna khaDA hunchau taba unIharUko euTA gaNa satarka tathA hatiyAra baddha bhaerai timIsa~ga ubhiyos ani sajdA (namAz2a) pUrNa garepachi unIharU pachiltira gaera khaDA houn | ani arko samUha Aera timIsa~ga namAz2a paDhos jasale namAja paDheko chaina | ra, unIharU satarka tathA hatiyAra baddha rahun | kAphiraharU cAhanA cha ki timIharU AphnA hatiyAra evaM sarasAmAnabAre aceta hoU ki tinIharU timIharUmAthi akasmAt AilAgun | yadi timIharUlAI varSAko kAraNale apThyAro cha vA timIharU birAmI chau bhane AphnA hatiyAra alaga rAkhdA timIharUmAthi kunai doSa chaina | tara Aphno satarkatA banAi rAkha | nissandeha, allAhale kAphiraharUkAlAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA tayAra pArekA chan |

ani namAja pUrA garepachi ubhieko, baseko tathA Dhalkieko avasthAmA allAhalAI smaraNa garne gara | ra, nizcinta bhaepachi purA namAja kAyama gara | nissandeha AsthAvAnaharUmAthi samayako pAlanAkA sAtha namAja anivArya garieko cha |

ra (zatru) mAnisaharUlAI lakheTnamA nirbalatA na dekhAu | yadi timIharU kaSTa bhogdaichau bhane tinIharU pani timIharUjhaiM kaSTa bhogdaichan ra timIharU allAhasita tyasa kurAko AzA rAkhdachau jasako AzA tinIharU rAkhnadainan | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |
he sandeSTA! hAmIle timImAthi satyakAsAtha grantha avataraNa garekA chau~, tAki timI allAhale batAeko tarikAnusAra mAnisaharUbIca phaisalA gara ra vizvAsaghAtIharUko pakSadhara nabana |
ra, allAhasita kSamAyAcanA garne gara | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ra, svayam Aphaisa~ga vizvAsaghAta garneharUko pakSamA vAda–vivAda nagara | nissandeha allAha vizvAsaghAtI evaM pApIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |

tinIharU mAnisaharUbATa lukAuna cAhanchan, tara allAhabATa lukAuna cA~hadainan | tinIharUle rAtamA allAhale mana naparAeko kurAbAre parAmarza gardA pani unI tinIharUsa~gai hunchan | vAstavamA allAhale tinIharUle garekA sabai kAryalAI gherekA chan |

a~! sAMsArika jIvanamA aparAdhIharUko pakSamA tarkavitarka garne timIharU nai hau tara mahApralayako dina allAhasamakSa tinIharUko pakSamA tarkavitarka garne ko hunecha? vA tinIharUko kAryasAdhaka ko hunecha?
ra jo vyaktile pani kunai kukarma vA svayaMmAthi atyAcAra garcha ani allAhasita kSamAyAcanA garcha bhane usale allAhalAI ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu pAunecha |
ra, jasale pApa garcha tyasako bhAra tyasaimAthi Aunecha | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |
ra, jasale kunai galtI vA pApa garcha ani tyasako doSa kunai nirdoSamAthi lagAu~cha usale nizcaya nai euTA ThUlo lAJchanA tathA prasTa pApako bojha uThAu~cha |,

(he sandeSTA!) yadi timImAthi allAhako varadAna evaM dayA naraheko bhae tinIharUmadhye euTA samUhale timIlAI pathabhraSTa garne saGkalpa garisakeko thiyo tara tinIharUle AphUlAI nai pathabhraSTa pArdaichan; timIlAI katti pani hAni puryAuna sakdainan | allAhale timImAthi grantha tathA tatvadarzitA avataraNa garekA chan ani timIlAI timIle najAnekA kurA sikAekA chan | ra, timImAthi allAhako ThUlo varadAna cha |

munAphikaharUkA adhikAMza gopya sarasallAhaharumA kunai bhalAi hu~daina | a~, jasale dAna garna, bhalAIko kArya garna vA mAnisaharUbIca sudhArakA kAma garna protsAhita garcha usako gopya parAmarza bhalAIko kArya ho | jasale allAhako prasannatA prAptiko lAgi yasto garnecha hAmIle usalAI ThUlo pratidAna pradAna garnechauM |

ra, jo sIdhA mArga spaSTa bhaepazcAt IzadUtaviruddha kaTibaddha rahancha ani AsthAvAnaharUko mArgabAheka arU kunai mArgako anusaraNa garcha, hAmI tyasalAI tyasai mArgamA lagAune chau~ juna mArgatira usale svayaMlAI lagAune cha, ra usalAI hAmIle narakamA homnechauM | ra kati narAmro ThegAnA ho naraka!

nissandeha allAhale zirka (AphUsita kasailAI sAjhedAra banAine ) kAryalAI kadApi mApha garne chainan | tara yasabAhekakA anya pApa jasako lAgi cAhanechan kSamA garnechan | jasale allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra banAyo U pathabhraSTatAmA dherai TADhAsamma pugyo |
tinIharU allAhalAI choDI kevala devIharUlAI pukArdachan ra yaso garera kevala vidrohI zaitAnalAI upAsya pukArdaichan |
usamAthi allAhako zrApa pareko cha ra usale ta bhaneko cha– “ma timrA bhaktaharUbATa euTA nirdhArita aMza avazya nai hatyAunechu |

ma tinIharUlAI pathabhraSTa garerai chADnechu, tinIharUlAI manokAMkSAko mohajAlamA phasAunechu tathA tinIharUlAI Adeza dinechu ani tinIharUle janAvaraharUkA kAna cheDnechan | ra, ma tinIharUlAI Adeza dinechu ani tinIharUle allAhale garekA saMracanAmA pherabadala garnechan |” ra, jasale allAhalAI choDI zaitAnalAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAyo U spaSTa noksAnamA paryo |
zaitAnale tinIharusa~ga vAcA garcha ra AkAMkSAko jAlamA aljhAu~cha, tara, tinIharusa~ga zaitAnale gareko vAcA dhokA bAheka kehi hoina |
tinIharUko ThegAnA naraka hunecha ra tinIharUsa~ga tyasabATa muktiko kunai upAya hune chaina |

ra, jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare tinIharUlAI tyastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunechauM jasako talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan; jahA~ unIharU sadA–sarvadA rahanechan | yo allAhako satya vacana ho | ra, ko allAhabhandA baDhI Aphno vacanamA satya huna sakcha?

na timIharUko AkAMkSAharu pUrNa hunecha, ra na ahlekitAbako AkAMkSAharU nai | duSkarma garnele tyasako sajAya~ avazya nai pAunecha, ra tyasale allAhako viruddhamA Aphno lAgi kunai samarthaka evaM sahAyaka pAune chaina |
ra puruSa hos vA mahilA jasale pani ImAnako avasthAmA satkarma garchan tinIharU svargamA praveza garnechan ra tinIharUmAthi ratibhara atyAcAra garine chaina |

ra, dharmako hisAbale tyo vyaktibhandA rAmro ko huna sakcha jasale satkarma gardai allAhako sAmunne AphUlAI samarpita garayo; ra ekacitta ibrAhImako tarIkAko anusaraNa garyo; ra ibrAhImalAI ta allAhale Aphno mitra banAe |
ra, allAhakai hun jejati AkAzaharU evaM dhartImA chan ani allAhale sampUrNa cijalArI Aphno gherAmA liekA chan |

ra, tinIharUle timIsa~ga mahilAharUkobAre dharmAdeza sodhdachan | bhanideU– “svayaM allAhale timIharUlAI tinIharUkA bAremA dharmAdeza dinchan ra pahiledekhi nai yasa granthamA rahekA AdezaharU pani timIharUlArI smaraNa garAu~chan juna tI anAtha strIharUko bAremA cha jasalAI timIharU nirdhArita haka diMdainau tara tinIharUsa~ga vivAha bhane garna cAhanchau ani tI asahAya baccAharUko bAremA ra yo pani ki anAthaharUsita nisApha gara | ra, timI junasukai bhalAi garchau tyasalAI allAha rAmrarI jAndachan |

ra yadi kunai mahilAlAI unako patile durvyavahAra garne vA vAstA narAkhne AbhAsa huncha bhane yasamA kunai doSa chaina ki duvaile paraspara samjhautA garUn, ra samjhautA nai uttama huncha | ra lAlaca ta mAnava prakRtiko anupama aMza ho | ra, yadi timIharU sada vyavahAra garchau ra Izabhaya rAkhchau bhane allAha timIharUko kAryabATa avagata chan |

ra, timIharUle cAhera pani patnIharUbIca pUrNa nyAya garnai sakdainau | ataH timIharU ekaitarpha purai najhuka yasarI ki arkIlAI cAhi~ asahAya avasthAmA choDideU | ani, yadi timIharU sudhAra gardai garchau ra allAhako bhaya rAkhdachau bhane nizcaya nai allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ra, yadi pati–patnIbIca sambandha biccheda huncha bhane allAhale duvailAI Aphno samRddhidvArA Atmanirbhara tulyAunechan ra allAha ati udAra evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, allAhakai hun jejati AkAzaharUmA chan ra jejati pRthvImA chan | timIharUbhandA pahilekA granthavAhakaharUlAI ra timIharUlAI pani hAmIle allAhasita bhaya rAkhne Adeza diyauM | pheri pani timIharU kRtadhna banchau bhane (smaraNa rahos ki) AkAzaharU evaM pRthvImA rahekA sampUrNa cijakA mAlika allAha nai hun ra allAha nispRha evaM svayaM prazaMsanIya chan |
ani, allAhakai hun jejati AkAzaharU evaM pRthvImA chan, ra kArkayasAdhakako rupamA allAha nai paryApta chan |
he mAnava! yadi allAhale cAhemA timIharUlAI lagne chan ra arUlAI timIharUko sthAnamA pratisthApita garnechan ra allAha yasako pUrNarupale sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
jo yasa saMsArako bhalAi cAhancha (usalAI smaraNa hos ki) allAhakahA~ nai loka evaM paraloka (duvai) ko bhalAi cha | ra, allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvadraSTA chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhakAlAgi sAkSI bandai nisApha kAyama garnevAlA bana, yadyapi tyo svayaM timIharU, timrA AmA–bAbu vA nAtedAraharUkai viruddhamA kina najAos | dhanI hoUn vA garIba allAha nai duvaikAlAgi adhika hitaiSI chan | ataH timIharU AkAMkSAko anupAlanamA nyAyako mArgabATa nahaTa | yadi timIharUle satyalAI baMgyAyau vA satyatAbATa vimukha bhayau bhane (jAni rAkha) jejati timIharU gardachau tyasabATa allAha avagata chan |

he ImAnavAlAharU ho! allAhamAthi, unakA rasUlamAthi, unale AphnA rasUla (muhammada sa.) mAthi avataraNa gareko granthamAthi ra yasabhandA pahile avataraNa gareko granthamAthi ImAna lyAU | ra, jasale allAha, unakA phariztA, unakA kitAba, unakA rasUlaharU ra Akhiratako dinako inkAra garyo U pathabhraSTatAmA dherai TADhA pugyo |

nissandeha tI mAnisaharU jasale ImAna lyAe ani kAphira bhae; pheri ImAna lyAe pheri kuphra gare ani pheri kuphramai baDhdai gae, allAha tyastA mAnisaharUlAI kahilyai na kSamA garne chan, ra na tinIharUlAI satmArga nai dekhAune chan |
munAphikaharUlAI duHkhadAyI yAtanAko zubhasUcanA deU |
jo mominaharUlAI choDI kAphiraharUlAI Aphno mitra banAu~chan | ke tinIharU kAphiraharukahA~ pratiSThA cAhanchan? vAstavamA sampUrNa pratiSThA ta allAhako lAgi nai cha |

ra, unale yasa granthamA timIharUkAlAgi (Adeza) avataraNa garisakekA chan ki timIharU jaba allAhakA AyataharUko inkAra tathA upahAsa garieko sunchau taba tinIharUle arkai kurA na garesamma tinIharUsa~ga nabasa, natra timIharU pani tinIharU jastai hune chau | nissandeha allAha sabai munAphika tathA kAphiraharUlAI narakamA ekatrita garnechan |

yI munAphikaharU timIharUbAre pratIkSAmA rahanchan | timIharUlAI allAhako tarphabATa kunai vijaya prApta bhaemA tinIharU bhanchan– “ke hAmI timIharUsa~ga thienauM?” ani, kAphiraharUlAI (vijayako) kunai aMza prApta bhaemA tinIharU bhanchan– “ke hAmIlAI timIharUmAthi saprabhutva prApta thiena ra hAmIle timIharUlAI mominaharUbATa bacAekA thienauM?” allAhale mahApralayakA dina timIharUbIca phaisalA garnechan | ra, allAhale kAphiraharUkAlAgi AsthAvAnaharUmAthi prabhutvako kunai bATo bA~kI rAkhne chainan |

nizcaya nai munAphikaharU allAhasita dhokebAjI garchan jabaki allAhale tinIharUlAI dhokAmA rAkhne chan | tinIharU namAjakAlAgi ubhiMdA alchI gardai ubhinchan; kevala mAnisaharUlAI dekhAunakAlAgi | ani, tinIharU allAhalAI kamai smaraNa garchan |
tinIharU ImAna evaM kuphrabIca dvIvidhAmA chan; na yinIharUkA sAtha chan na unIharUkA sAtha nai | ra, allAha jasalAI pathabhraSTa pArchan tinIharUkAlAgi timIle kahilyai mArga pAune chainau |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! mominaharUlAI choDI kAphiraharUlAI Aphno saMrakSaka–mitra nabanAU | ke timIharU allAhalAI AphnaiviruddhamA spaSTa pramANa dina cAhanchau?
nissandeha munAphikaharU narakako sababhandA tallo khaNDamA hominechan ra timI tinIharUkAlAgi kunai sahayogI pAune chainau |

a~, tinIharU jasale prAyazcita gare; AphumA sudhAra gare; allAhalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samAte ra Aphno dharmalAI niSkapaTatAkA sAtha allAhamA samarpita gare tinIharU nai mominaharUkA sAthI hun | ra, allAhale cA~Dai nai mominaharUlAI ThUlo pratidAna pradAna garnechan |
yadi timIharU kRtajJa rahanchau ra ImAna lyAu~chau bhane allAhale timIharUlAI kina yAtanA dinechan ra? allAha ati guNagrAhI evaM sarvajJa chan |
allAha (kasaiko) narAmrolAI khullamakhullA bayAna garnu mana parAu~dainan, a~ kasaimAthi atyAcAra garieko hos (bhane beglai kurA ho) | ra, allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJAtA chan |
timI khullamkhullA satkarma garchau vA gopyarupamA garchau vA (kasaile gareko) kunai atyAcAralAI mApha garchau bhane allAha pani ati kSamAzIla evaM sarvazaktimAna chan |

nissandeha tI mAnisaharU jo allAha evaM unakA rasUlaharUlAI inkAra gardachan ra allAha evaM unakA rasUlaharUbIca vibheda garna cAhanchan ra bhandachan– “hAmI kunai rasUlamAthi ImAna rAkhdachauM ra kehIlAI inkAra gardachauM”, tinIharU duvaiko bIcabATa kunai nikAsa nikAlna cAhanchan |
tinIharU nai pakkA kAphira hun ra kAphiraharUkAlAgi hAmIle apamAnajanaka yAtanA tayAra pArekA chauM |

jasale allAha evaM unakA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAekA chan ra unIharUbIca vibheda garenan, tinIharUlAI tinIharuko pratidAna allAhale chiTTai pradAna garne chan | ra, allAha ati kSamAzIla, parama dayAlu chan |

ahle–kitAbaharU timIsa~ga tinIharUmAthi AkAzabATa euTA pUrNa grantha avatarita garne mAga garchan | tinIharUle ta yobhandA ThUlo mAga mUsAsa~ga garekA thie | ho, tinIharUle “hAmIlAI pratyakSarUpamA allAhako darzana garAU” bhanera mAga garekA thie | ani tinIharUko yasa atyAcArale gardA tinIharUmAthi bajrapAta bhaeko thiyo | tyasapachi tinIharUkAlAgi spaSTa nizAnIharU Aera pani tinIharUle bAcchAlAI upAsya banAe | hAmIle tyasalAI pani mApha garyauM ani mUsAlAI spaSTa pramANa pradAna garyauM |

ra, hAmIle tinIharUsa~ga vacanako pAlanA garAune uddezyale tUralAI tinIharUmAthi uThAyau~ | ani hAmIle tinIharUlAI sajdA gardai dvArabhitra praveza garna Adeza diyau~ | ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI Adeza diyau~ "timIharu sabta (zanivAra) ko ullaGghana nagara" | ra, hAmIle tinIharUsa~ga dRDha vacana liyauM |

tinIharUle Aphno vacana bhaGga garnAle ra allAhakA AyataharUlAI asvIkAra garnAle tathA nabIharUko anAhaka hatyA garnAle ani ‘hAmro hRdayaharu AvaraNabhitra chan’ bhanera bhanekAle —jaba ki vAstavamA allAhale tinIharukA kuphrako kAraNa tinIharukA hRdayaharUmA mohara lagAidiekA chan, jasale gardA kehI kurAharUbAheka tinIharUle ImAna lyAune chainan |
ra tinIharUko inkArako kAraNale tathA marayamamAthi mithyA Aropa lagAunAle (hAmIle tiraskAra garyauM) |

ra, nissandeha tinIharUle ‘hAmIle nai allAhakA rasUla marayama putra IsA masIhako hatyA garekA hau~ bhanekAle (hAmIle tinIharUlAI daNDita garyauM) —jabaki tinIharUle na unalAI mAre ra na zUlI nai caDhAe, baru unI (IsA masiha jastai dekhine arko vyakti) tinIharUkAlAgi bhramita pArie | ra, vAstavamA yasa viSayamA matabheda garneharU avazya nai yasaprati sandehamA chan | yasabAremA aTkalabAjIko anukaraNa garnu bAheka tinIharUsita yasako kunai jJAna chaina | nizcita rupamA tinIharUle IsA masIhako hatyA garekai chainan |
baru allAhale unalAI AphUtarpha uThAe ra allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
ani, ahle–kitAbaharUmadhye kohI yasto chaina jasale unako mRtyupUrva unImAthi ImAna nalyAekohos ra mahApralayako dina unI tinIharu viruddha sAkSI dinechan |

ani yahUdIharUko atyAcAralegardA tinIharUkA lAgi vaidha rahekA pavitra cijaharUlAI hAmIle avaidha garidiyauM | ra yasa kAraNale pani avaidha garidiyauM ki tinIharU (arU mAnisaharUlAI) allAhako mArgabATa prAyaH rokdathe |

ra, yasa kAraNale pani ki tinIharUlAI niSedha garietApani tinIharUle byAja line garthe, ra mAnisaharUko sampatti anAhakamA khAne garthe | ra, tinIharUmadhye kAphiraharUkA lAgi hAmIle duHkhadAyI yAtanA tayAra garekA chauM |

tara, tinIharUmadhye jJAnamA paripakvatA rAkhneharU ra AsthAvAnaharU jo tyasa granthamA AsthA rAkhchan juna timImAthi avataraNa garieko cha ra juna timIbhandA pahile avatarita gariekA thie, ra vizeSa rUpale namAja kAyama garneharu, ra jakAta dineharu tathA allAha evaM Akhiratako dinamAthi AsthA rAkhneharu, yinIharU sabailAI hAmI chiTTai ThUlo pratidAna dinechauM |

(he sandeSTA!) hAmIle timImAthi tyasarI nai ‘vahya’ (prakAzanA) garekA chauM jasarI hAmIle nUha evaM unI pachikA sandeSTAharUmAthi avatarita garekA thiyau~ | ra, hAmIle ibrAhIma, ismAIla, ishAka, yaakUba, yaakUbakA santAnaharU, IsA, ayyUba, yUnusa, hArUna ra sulaimAnamAthi pani (avataraNa) garekA thiyauM | ani, dAUdalAI hAmIle jabUra pradAna garekA thiyau~ |

ra, kati rasUlaharU chan jasako carcA hAmIle timIsa~ga yasabhandA pahile nai garisakekA chau~ ra kati rasUlaharU chan jasako carcA hAmIle timIsa~ga garekai chainau~ | ra, mUsAsa~ga allAhale spaSTarUpamA kurA garekA thie |
IzadUtaharU zubha–sUcaka tathA sacetaka banAiera paThAiekA thie, tAki rasUlaharUpazcAt mAnisaharUlAI allAhaviruddha kehI bhanne ThAu~ narahos | ra, allAha ati prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

tara allAhale timImAthi je avatarita garekA chan tyasabAre svayaM sAkSI chan ki unale nai tyasalAI Aphno jJAnale avatarita garekA hun ra phariztAharU pani sAkSI chan jabaki allAha nai sAkSyako rupamA paryApta chan |
nissandeha juna mAnisaharUle asvIkAra gare ra allAhako mArgabATa roke tinIharU nizcaya nai pathabhraSTatAmA dherai TADhA niskisakekA chan |,
nissandeha juna mAnisaharU kAphira bhae ra anyAya gare allAha tinIharUlAI kadApi kSamA garne chainan ra na tinIharUlAI kunai mArga nai dekhAunechan;
sivAya narakako bATo jasamA tinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan ra yo allAhakAlAgi ekadamai sarala raheko cha |

he manuSyaharU ho! timrA pAlanakartAkotarphabATa satyakA sAtha IzadUta timIharUsamakSa AisakekA chan | ataH timIharU ImAna lyAU | yo timrailAgi uttama hunecha ra timIharU anAsthA pradarzana garchau bhane (jAnirAkha) AkAzaharU evaM dhartImA jejati chan sabai allAhakA hun ra allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

he ahle kitAbaharU ho! Aphno dharmamA simAbhandA agADi nabaDha | allAhako bAremA nitAnta satyabAheka kehI nabhana | maryama–putra IsA masIha kevala allAhakA rasUla evaM unakA vANI hun jasalAI unale maryamatarpha paThAe ra unI unako tarphabATa eka AtmA hun | ataH allAha evaM unakA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAU | ra, (allAha) tIna chan nabhana; yaso bhannabATa rokinu, timIharUkAlAgi yahI nai rAmro hunecha | allAha nai eka mAtra pUjya hun | kohI unako chorA chan bhanne kurAbATa unI pavitra chan | jejati AkAzaharU evaM dhartImA chan sabai unakai hun | ra, kAryasAdhakako rUpamA allAha nai paryApta chan |

AphU allAhakA eka dAsa hunumA masIha kahilyai apamAna ThAndainan, ra na sAmIpya prApta phariztAharU nai | ra, jasale allAhako bhaktilAI AphnolAgi apamAna ThAnchan ra ghamaNDa garchan allAhale tinIharU sabailAI gherera AphUsAmu bhelA pArnechan |

ImAna lyAekA ra satkarma garekAharUlAI allAhale unIharUko pUrA pratidAna dinechan ra Aphno kRpAbATa tyasamA arU thapidinechan | tara jasale apamAna ThAne ra ghamaNDa gare tinIharUlAI unI kaThora yAtanA dinechan | ra, tinIharUle allAhabAheka kasailAI pani Aphno saMrakSaka mitra evaM sahAyaka pAune chainan |
he mAnavajAti! timIharUsamakSa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa pramANa Aisakeko cha ra hAmIle timIharUtarpha spaSTa prakAza avatarita garisakekA chauM |
ani jasale allAhamAthi ImAna lyAe ra unalAI dRDhatAkAsAtha samAtirAkhe tinIharUlAI allAhale Aphno dayA evaM kRpAmA samAveza garnechan ra AphUtarpha jAne sIdhA mArga dekhAunechan |

he sandeSTA! yinIharU timIsita dharmAdeza (phatvA) sodhdaichan | bhanideU– “allAha timIharUlAI ‘kalAlah’ bAre yo dharmAdeza dinchan ki yadi kunai vyakti niHsantAna marcha ra usako ekajanA didI vA bahinI mAtra chin bhane usale choDeko sampattiko AdhA aMza tI didI vA bahinIle pAune chin | tara, yadi niHsantAna didI vA bahinIko mRtyu huncha ra ekajanA dAju vA bhAi mAtra cha bhane tyo tyasako vArisa hunecha | yadi mRtakakA vArisa duIjanA didI vA bahinI chan bhane unIharU usale chADeko sampattimadhye duI tihAI aMzakA hakadAra hunechan | ra, yadi kaiyauM dAju vA bhAi tathA didI vA bahinIharU chan bhane eka puruSako aMza duI mahilAko aMza barAbara hunecha | allAha timIharUkAlAgi spaSTarUpamA bayAna gardachan tAki timIharU pathabhraSTa nahoU | ra, allAha hareka cijako pUrNa jJAtA hun |

he ImAnavAlAharU ho! AphnA vAcAbandhanaharUko pAlana gara | timIharUkA lAgi caupAyA janAvaraharU vaidha gariekA chan tI janAvaraharU bAheka juna timIharUlAI bayAna garinecha | tara timIharU iharAmako avasthAmA zikAralAI jAyaja nabanAunU | nissandeha allAha je cAhanchan Adeza dinchan |

he ImAnavAlAharU ho! allAhakA nizAnIharUko anAdara nagara, ra na pratiSThita mahinAharUko, ra na balIkA janAvaraharUko, ra na IzabheTakA lAgi paTTI bA~dhiekA janAvaraharUko ra na pratiSThita gRha (kaabA) tarpha AphnA pAlanakartAko varadAna evaM prasannatAko khojImA niskaneharUko nai | iharAmako avasthA samApta bhaepachi timIharU zikAra garna sakchau | timIharUlAI pratiSThita ghara (kAabA) bATa rokne samudAyako zatrutAle sImA ullaMghana garna uttejita kadApi nagaros | puNya evaM Izabhayako kAryamA ApasamA sahayoga gara ra pApa evaM atyAcArako kAryamA paraspara sahayoga nagara | ra, allAhako bhaya rAkha | nissandeha allAha kaThora daNDadAtA hun |

mRta janAvaraharU, ragata, suMgurako mAsu, allAhabAheka arU kasaiko nAma liera jabaha gariekA (janAvara), ghA~TI thicera mAriekA, coTapaTakale marekA, mAthibATa laDera marekA, siGa lAgera marekA ra kunai hiMsaka janAvarale khAekA janAvaraharU timIharUkA lAgi avaidha gariekA chan, yo beglai kurA ho ki timIharUle jIvita pAera jabah (vadha) garyau | ra, thAnamA caDhAiekAharU pani avaidha chan | ra, timIharUle tIra hAnera bhAgya nirdhAraNa garnu pani avaidha ho | yo avajJA ho | Aja kAphiraharU timIharUko dharmabATa nirAza bhaisakekA chan; tinIharUsita naDarAU; maisita DarAU | Aja maile timIharUko ‘dIna’ (jIvana paddhati) lAI timIharUkA nimti pUrNa gareko chu ra timIharUprati Aphno anugraha pUrA gareko chu ani timIharUkA lAgi ‘dIna’ svarUpa islAmalAI rojeko chu | kasaile bhokale gardA vivaza bhaera pApa garne manasAya narAkhI tyo khAidincha bhane nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

tinIharUkA nimti ke vaidha garieko cha bhanera tinIharU sodhchan | bhanideU– “timIharUkA lAgi svaccha vastuharU vaidha gariekA chan ra tI janAvaraharU pani jasalAI timIharUkA lAgi allAhale sikAe anusAra timIharUle prazikSaNa diekA zikArI janAvaraharUle samAtun | ataH timIharU tinIharule samAtekA zikAraharU khAU tara tyasamA allAhako nAma leU | ra, allAhako bhaya rAkha | nissandeha allAha cA~Dai hisAba linechan |”

Aja timIharUkA lAgi pavitra cijaharU vaidha gariekA chan ra ahle–kitAbako bhojana timrolAgi vaidha cha tathA timro bhojana tinIharUkA lAgi ra niSkalaGka AsthAvAna strIharU evaM ahle–kitAba strIharU pani, tara yasa zartamA ki timIharUle unIharUlAI mahara deU | uddezya nikAhako paridhimA lyAunu hunuparcha na ki svacchanda kAmavAsanAmA lAgnu; na gupta mitratA gA~snu nai | kinaki jasale ImAnalAI nakArcha usakA satkarmaharU akAratha jAnechan | ra, U Akhiratako dina noksAna behorneharUmadhye hunecha |

he asthAvAnaharU ho! timIharU namAjakAlAgi ubhidA Aphno anuhAra tathA hAta– kuhinAsamma dhoU ra TAukomAthi masaha gara (hAta phera) ra AphnA khuTTA golIgA~Thosamma dhoU| ra yadi timIharU ‘jinAbata’ (apavitratA) ko avasthAmA chau bhane pavitra hoU | ra, yadi timIharU birAmI chau, vA yAtrAmA chau, vA timIharUmadhye kohI zauca garI AekA chau vA strIsa~ga samAgama garekAchau ani pAnI upalabdha chaina bhane timIharU pavitra mATo khojI garI tyasako dvArA Aphno anuhAra tathA hAtamAthi masaha gara (hAta phera) | allAha timIharUlAI kunai kisimako apThyAromA pArna cAha~dainan baru timIharUlAI pavitra banAuna ra Aphno varadAna pUrA garna cAhanchan | AzA cha timIharU kRtajJa banne chau |

ra, allAhale timIharUmAthi gareko anugraha evaM timIharUsita lieko dRDha pratijJAlAI dhyAnamA rAkha– jaba timIharUle bhanekA thiyau– “hAmIle sunyauM ra AjJApAlana garyauM |” ra allAhako bhaya rAkha | nissandeha allAha hRdayakA rahasyaharU pani jAndachan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhakA lAgi nitAnta satyamA kAyama raha~dai nyAyako sAkSI bana | ra, kunai jAtiko zatrutAle timIharUlAI yati uttejita nagaros ki timIharU nyAyabATa vimukha hoU | nisApha gara; yo Izabhayasita nikaTatama kurA ho| allAhako bhaya rAkha | timIharU je gardachau allAha tyasako khabara rAkhnevAlA chan |
jo AsthA rAkhchan tathA satkarma garchan tinIharUsa~ga allAhale pratijJA garekA chan ki unIharUkAlAgi kSamA tathA ThUlo pratidAna raheko cha |
jo kAphira bhae ra hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare tinIharU narakabAsI hun |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhako tyasa kRpAlAI yAda gara jaba euTA samudAyale timIharUmAthi jiyAdatI garna cAheko thiyo taba allAhale timIharUmAthi tinIharukA hAtaharUlAI rokidie | allAhako bhaya gara | AsthAvAnaharUle kevala allAhamAthi bharosA garnuparcha |

ra, allAhale isrAIlakA santatisita dRDha pratijJA lie | ra, hAmIle tinIharU bIca bAhra nAyaka tainAtha garyau~ | allAhale bhane– “ma timIharUkA sAtha chu | yadi timIharUle namAja kAyama garyau, jakAta diyau, merA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna lyAyau, unIharUko sahayoga garyau ra allAhalAI uttama RNa diyau bhane ma avazya nai timIharUkA pApa meTnechu ani timIharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunechu jasako talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan | yadi yasapachi pani timIharUmadhye kasaile inkAra garyo bhane usale sIdhA mArga gumAyo |”

ahle–kitAbale svayam Aphno vAcA toDekAle hAmIle tinIharUlAI zrApita garyauM ra tinIharUkA hRdayalAI kaThora pAridiyauM | tinIharU zabdaharUlAI tinIharuko sthAnabATa parivartana gardachan | juna kurAko tinIharUlAI zikSA diieko thiyo tinIharukA adhikAMza bhAgalAI birsidie ra timIle kehI mAnisabAheka tinIharUle gareko vizvAsaghAtako kunai na kunai khabara sunirahanechau | ataH tinIharUlAI kSamA gara ra vAstA nagara | nizcaya nai allAha sukarmIharUlAI mana parAu~chan |

testai hAmIle tI mAnisaharUlAI pani pratijJA garAyauM jasale bhane– “hAmI IsAI hau~ |” tinIharUle pani tI zikSAharUko adhikAMza bhAga birsidie jasabAre tinIharUlAI smaraNa garAieko thiyo | antamA hAmIle tinIharUbIca mahApralayakA dinasammakA lAgi zatrutA tathA dveSako Ago salkAidiyauM | ra, tinIharU jejati gardachan tyasabAre cA~Dai nai allAhale tinIharUlAI batAunechan |

he ahle–kitAba ho! timIharUsamakSa hAmrA rasUla AipugekA chan jasale timIharUlAI tI kurAharU batAu~chan juna timIharUle granthabATa lukAu~dai AekA chau, ra unale dherai kurAharU kSamA pani gardaichan | nizcaya nai timIharUkA lAgi allAhako tarphabATa prakAza evaM spaSTa grantha Aisakeko cha |

allAhale yasadvArA tI mAnisaharUlAI zAntimArgaharu dekhAu~chan jo unako prasannatAlAI pacchAudai chan | ra, unIharUlAI Aphno Adezale a~dhyArAharUbATa nikAlera prakAzatarpha lyAu~chan tathA unIharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAu~chan |

nissandeha maryama putra masIha nai allAha hun bhannele kuphra gare | he sandeSTA bhanideU– “allAhale maryama putra masIha, unakI AmA ra dhartIkA sampUrNa cijalAI naSTa garna cAhemA kasale allAhalAI yasabATa rokne sAmarthya rAkhcha?! jejati AkAzaharU ra pRthvI tathA yI duvai bIca chan, tI allAhakai hun | unI je cAhanchan, sRSTi garchan | ra, allAha sampUrNa kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

ra, yahUdI tathA IsAIharUle dAvI gare– “hAmI allAhakA putra tathA priya pAtra hau~ |” tinIharUsita sodha– “tyaso bhae unale timIharUlAI timro aparAdhako sajAya~ kina dinchan?” baru timIharU pani ta tI manuSyaharu hau jasto unale arU manuSya sRSTi garekA chan | unI jasalAI cAhanchan kSamA garchan ra jasalAI cAhanchan yAtanA dinchan | ani, AkAzaharU, pRthvI tathA duvaibIca jejati chan allAhakai niyantraNamA chan ra unaitarpha pharkera jAnechan |,

he ahle–kitAba! timIharUsamakSa IzadUtaharUko AgamanamA eka antarAlapachi aba hAmrA rasUla AisakekA chan jasale timIharUkA lAgi spaSTa zikSA diirahekA chan yasa uddezyale ki timIharUle yo bhanna pAune chainau ki timIharUkahA~ kunai zubha sUcaka ra sacetaka Aena | nissandeha timIharUsamakSa zubha sUcaka evaM sacetaka AisakekA chan | ra, allAha sampUrNa kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba mUsAle AphnA jAtikA mAnisaharUlAI bhane– “he merA samudAyakA mAnisaharU ho! timIharumAthi allAhako kRpAlAI smaraNa gara jaba unale timIharUmAjha sandeSTAharU banAe ani timIharUlAI zAsaka banAe tathA timIharUlAI tI cijaharU pradAna gare juna saMsAramA arU kasailAI pradAna garenan |”
“he merA samudAyakA mAnisaharU ho! tyasa pavitra jamInamA praveza gara juna allAhale timIharUkAlAgi lekhidiekA chan ra pachADi nahaTa; natrabhane timIharU asaphala bhaI pharkanechau |”

unIharUle bhane– “he mUsA! tyahA~ dherai zaktizAlI mAnisaharU basdachan | hAmI tyahA~ kadApi jAdainau~, jabasamma tinIharU tyahA~bATa niskadainan | ho, tinIharU tyahA~bATa niske bhane hAmI avazya nai praveza garnechau~ |”

(allAhasita) bhaya rAkhneharUmadhye duIjanA vyaktiharu– jasalAI allAhale Aphno kRpApAtra banAekA thie, unale bhane– “timIharu yinIharUmAthi caDhAi gardai DhokAmA praveza gara | bhitra pasne bittikai timIharU nai vijayI hunechau | yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane allAhamAthi bharosA gara |”
tinIharUle bhane– “he mUsA, hAmI tyahA~ kadApi praveza garne chainau~, jabasamma tinIharU tyahA~ chan | timI ra timrA pAlanakartA duvai jAU ra yuddha gara | hAmI yahI~ basirahanechauM |”
mUsAle bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA! ma svayaM ra Aphno bhAi bAheka kasaimAthi adhikAra rAkhdina | tasartha hAmI ra avajJAkArI samudAyabIca viccheda garideU |”
allAhale bhane– “yo deza cAlIsa varSasamma yinIharUkAlAgi varjita cha | yinIharU dhartImA bhauMtArI rahanechan | ani yI avajJAkArIharUko cintA nalinu |”

(he muhammada sa.!) tinIharUlAI AdamakA duI chorA (hAbIla ra kAbIla) ko kathA nitAnta satyakAsAtha sunAideU | smaraNa gara, jaba duvaile euTA balidAna peza gare taba duImadhye ekako balidAna ta svIkRta bhayo tara arkoko asvIkRta | asvIkRta hunele bhanyo– “ma avazya nai timro hatyA garnechu |” unale bhane– “allAha dharmaparAyaNaharUko mAtra balidAna svIkArdachan |”
yadi timIle mero hatyAkolAgi hAta uThAyau bhane ma timro hatyAkolAgi hAta uThAune chaina | ma sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartA– allAhasa~ga DarAu~chu |
ma yo cAhanchu ki mero pApa ra Aphno pApa duvai timI nai liera jAU ra narakabAsIharUmA sAmela hoU | atyAcArIharUko yahI nai sajAya~ ho |
antataH usako manale usalAI Aphno bhAiko hatyA garna uksAyo, ra usale unako hatyA garidiyo | ataH U noksAna behorneharUmA sAmela bhayo |

ani allAhale euTA kAga paThAe jasale unalAI Aphno bhAiko zava kasarI lukAune bhanne kurA dekhAuna jamInamA khosrana thAlyo | usale bhanyo– "hAya mero barbAdI! ma tyo kAga jasto pani banna sakina ki Aphno bhAiko zavalAI chopna sakU~ |” yasarI u pazcAttApa garneharumA sAmela bhayo |

yasai kAraNale hAmIle isrAIlakA santAnaharUkA lAgi lekhidiyau~ ki josukaile kunai yasto vyaktiko hatyA garcha jasale kasaiko hatyA gareko chaina vA dezamA vidhvaMsa maccAeko chaina bhane, mAnau~, usale sampUrNa mAnavajAtikai hatyA garyo | ani, josukaile tyasa nirdoSa jyAnalAI bacAyo bhane, mAnau~, usale sampUrNa mAnavajAtilAI nai jIvana diyo | ani, hAmrA rasUlaharU tinIharUsamakSa spaSTa AdezaharU liera Ae, tara tyasapachi pani tinIharUmadhye dheraile dhartImA atyAcAra garirahe |

tI vyaktiharuko sajAya~ jo allAha tathA unakA rasUlaviruddha laDAi~ garchan, ra dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAuna bhAgadauDa garchan,yo ho ki tinIharUlAI vadha gariyos yA zUlI caDhAiyos yA tinIharUkA hAta tathA khuTTA viparIta dizAbATa kATiUn yA tinIharUlAI deza nikAlA gariyos | yo apamAna ta tinIharUkAlAgi yasa saMsAramA ho ra paralokamA tinIharUkAlAgi (yobhandA pani) ThUlo yAtanA raheko cha |
tara timIharUle prabhutva pAunu aghi nai jasale prAyazcita gare bhane yAda rAkha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhako bhaya gara, unako sAmipyatA prApta garne sAdhanako joho gara | ra unako mArgamA saMgharSa gara AzA cha ki timIharU saphala hunechau |

kuphra garneharUsita yadi sampUrNa dhartImA bhaeko dhana cha ra tyasakAsAtha tyati nai thapa dhana pani, tAki yI sabai dhana diera tinIharU mahApralayako dinako yAtanAbATa bacna cAhanchan bhane pani tinIharUko tyo harjAnA svIkAra garine chaina | ra, tinIharUkAlAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA rahekocha |
tinIharU narakako AgobATa umkana khojnechan tara tyasabATa umkana bhane kahilyai pani sakne chainan ra tinIharUkAlAgi sadAsarvadAko yAtanA hunecha |
ra, cora puruSa hos vA strI duvaikA hAta kATideU | yo tI duvaiko Arjanako badalA ho, ra allAhako tarphabATa zikSAprada daNDa | ra, allAha sAmarthyavAna evaM tatvadarzI chan |
ani, jasale Aphno yasa atyAcArapachi prAyazcita garyo evaM sudhAra garyo, allAha usamAthi pheri kRpAdRSTi garnechan | nissandeha allAha kSamAzIla evaM paramadayAvAna chan |
ke timI jAndainau ki AkAzaharU evaM dhartIko rAjyako adhikArI allAha nai hun; jasalAI cAhanchan unI yAtanA dinchan ra jasalAI cAhanchan kSamA garchan? ra, allAha sabai thokako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

he IzadUta! tI mAnisaharUle timIlAI dukhI napArUn jo kuphramA sakriya chan, cAhe tinIharUmadhye hun jasale maukhika rUpamA bhanchan ki tinIharUle ImAna lyAe tara tinIharUko hRdayale ImAna lyAeko chaina | ra, cAhe tinIharUmadhye jo yahUdI hun | yinIharU jhuTo kurA sunna abhyasta chan | ra, anya tI mAnisaharUko pani sundachan jo timIsamakSa AekA chainan | zabdaharUko sthAna nizcita hu~dAhu~dai pani unIharUko sthAna badalidinchan | tinIharU bhanchan– “yadi timIharUlAI yo Adeza diiyo bhane svIkAra gara ra yadi yo Adeza diiena bhane TADhai basa |” ra, kasailAI allAhale nai phitnA (utpIDana) mA homna cAhanchan bhane timI allAhako dA~jomA usako lAgi kehI pani garna sakdainau | yI tinIharU hun jasako hRdayalAI allAhale pavitra pArna cAhenan | tinIharUkA lAgi saMsAramA apamAna cha ra paralokamA ThUlo yAtanA raheko cha |

yinIharU mithyA kurA sunne bAnI basAlekAharu hun ra avaidha dhana khAneharU hun | yadi yinIharU timIkahA~ Au~chan bhane timIlAI akhtiyAra cha, ki ta yinIharUbIca phaisalA gara ki ta yinIharusita bevAstA gara | ra, yadi timI bevAstA garchau bhane tinIharUle timro kehI bigArna sakdainan | ra, yadi nirNaya garchau bhane tinIharUbIca nyAyakA sAtha nirNaya gara | nizcaya nai allAha nisApha garneharUlAI mana parAu~dachan |

ra, kasarI tinIharUle timIlAI nirNAyaka banAu~daichan, jabaki tinIharUsa~ga taurAta maujUda cha, jasamA allAhakA AdezaharU lekhieko bhaetApani tinIharU vimukha hunchan! vAstavamA tinIharU ImAna nai rAkhdainan |

hAmIle taurAta avatarita garyau~ jasamA mArgadarzana evaM jyoti thiyo | sampUrNa sandeSTAharU jo AjJAkArI thie, yasai anusAra yahUdIharUbIca phaisalA garne garthe | ani dharmAdhikArI tathA zAstrajJAtAharU pani (yasailAI nirNayako AdhAra banAu~the) kinabhane tinIharU allAhakA granthako saMrakSaka banAiekA thie ra tinIharU yasako pani sAkSI thie | ataH timIharU mAnisaharUsita naDarAU kevala masita nai DarAU | ra, merA AyataharUlAI tuccha mUlyamA nabeca | jasale allAhadvArA avatarita kAnUna anusAra nirNaya gardainan tinIharU nai kAphira hun |

(hAmIle taurAtamA) tinIharUkAlAgi lekhekA thiyau~ ki prANako badalA prANa, A~khAko badalA A~khA, nAkako badalA nAka, kAnako badalA kAna, dA~tako badalA dA~ta ra yasaiprakAra anya AghAtaharUko pani barAbarIko badalA hunecha | tara jasale tyasalAI mApha garidincha tyo usako pApako prAyazcita hunecha | ra, jasale allAhadvArA avatarita kAnUna anusAra nirNaya gardainan tinIharU nai atyAcArI hun |

ra hAmIle yI sandeSTAharUpachi maryama putra IsAlAI paThAyau~, jo unakAsAmu rahekA taurAtako puSTikartA thie | ra, unalAI hAmIle injIla pradAna garyauM jasamA mArgadarzana tathA divyajyoti thiyo, jo unakAsAmu rahekA taurAtako puSTikartA ra Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi mArgadarzana evaM upadeza thiyo |

ra, (hAmro Adeza thiyo ki) injIladhArIharUle tyasa kAnuna anusAra nai phaisalA garUn, juna tyasamA allAhale avataraNa garekAchan | ra, jasale allAhale avatarita gareko kAnUna anusAra nirNaya gardainan tinIharU nai avajJAkArI hun |

he sandeSTA! hAmIle timImAthi satyakAsAtha grantha avatarita garyau~, jasale pahilekA granthaharUko puSTi gardacha, ra jo tinIharuko saMrakSaka pani ho | ataH timI tinIharUbIca allAhadvArA avatarita kAnUna anusAra nai phaisalA gara | ra, juna satya timIsamakSa Aeko cha tyasabATa vimukha bhaera tinIharUko cAhanAharUko pachi nalAga | hAmIle tinIharUmadhye sabaikAlAgi euTA dharma–vidhAna evaM kAryapraNAlI taya garekA chauM | yadi allAhale cAheko bhae timIharU sabailAI euTai samudAya banAune thie, tara allAhale timIharUlAI pradAna garekA cijamA timIharUko parIkSA lina cAhe | ataH satkarmamA ekaarko bhandA agADi baDhne pratispardhA gara | antataH timIharU sabai allAhatarpha nai pharkanechau ani unale juna kurAmA timIharU matabheda garchau timIharUlAI batAunechan |

ra, tyasaile yinIharUbIca tyasa kAnUna anusAra phaisalA gara juna allAhale avatarita garekA chan | ra, yinIharUko cAhanAko pachADi najAU | timIlAI allAhale avataraNa garekA kehI AdezaharUbATa yinIharUle vimukha pArlAn bhanera saceta rahu | ra, yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane jAnirAkha, allAhale nai tinIharUlAI tinakA kehI pApaharUko sajAya~ dina cAhanchan | ra, nissandeha mAnisaharUmadhye adhikAMza avajJAkArI nai hun |
ke yinIharU ajJAnatAko phaisalA cAhanchan? ra, AsthAvAnaharUkA nimti allAhabhandA ucita nyAyAdhIza arU ko huna sakcha ra?

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yahUdI tathA IsAIlAI Aphno saMrakSaka–mitra nabanAU | yinIharU parasparamA eka–arkAkA saMrakSaka–mitra hun | ra, timIharUmadhye jasale tinIharUlAI Aphno mitra banAu~cha U tinIharUmA nai ganinecha | nissandeha allAha atyAcArIharUlAI satmArga dekhAu~dainan |

timI dekhdaichau, jasako hRdayamA (kapaTako) roga cha tinIharU yahUdI tathA IsAIharu kahA~ bhAgadauDa gardaichan | tinIharU bhanchan– katai kunai saGkaTamA phasne chau~ ki bhanne hAmIlAI Dara lAgcha | sambhavataH allAhale Aphno tarphabATa vijaya vA kunai vizeSa kurA dekhAunechan ani tinIharU Aphno manamA lukAeko kurAprati pachutAune chan |

ra, (tyatibelA) AsthAvAnaharUle bhannechan– “ke allAhako dRDha kasama khAera hAmI timIharUsa~ga nai chau~ bhanI vizvAsa dilAuneharU yinai hun?” yinakA sArA karmaharU vyartha bhae ra yinIharU noksAna behorne bhaekA chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUmadhye kohI Aphno dharmabATa vimukha huncha bhane allAhale (timro sthAnamA) tyastA mAnisaharulAI pratisthApita garnechan jasalAI unale manaparAunechan ra unIharUle allAhalAI manaparAune chan; jo AsthAvAnaharU prati namra ra kAphiraharUprati kaThora hunechan; jo allAhako mArgamA saGgharSa garnechan ra kunai nindA garne vyaktiko nindAbATa DarAune chainan | yo allAhako varadAna ho; jasalAI cAhanchan pradAna garchan | ra, allAha aparampAra evaM sarvajJa chan |
timIharUkA saMrakSaka–mitra vAstavamA allAha, unakA rasUla tathA tI AsthAvAnaharU hun jo namAja kAyama garchan, jakAta dinchan yasa avasthAmA ki unI (allAhako sAmu) samarpita hunchan|
ra, jasale allAha, unakA rasUla ra AsthAvAnaharUlAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAu~chan (tinIharU allAhakA jamAta hun) ani allAhako jamAta nai vijayI hunecha |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUbhandA pahilekA ahle–kitAba ra kAphiraharUmadhye jasale timro dharmalAI ThaTTA tathA khela banAe, tinalAI saMrakSaka–mitra nabanAU | yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane allAhako bhaya rAkha |
ra, jaba timIharU namAjakAlAgi bolAu~chau taba tinIharU tyasa ajAna (pukAra) lAI ThaTTA tathA khela banAu~chan | yo yasa kAraNale ki tinIharU vivekahIna mAnisaharU hun |

bhanideU– “he ahle–kitAba ho! ke timIharU hAmImAthi mAtra yasa kurAle Akrozita chau ki hAmIle allAhamAthi ra AphUmAthi avatarita tathA yasabhandA pahile avatarita kurAmAthi ImAna lyAekA chau~, jabaki timIharUmadhyekA adhikAMza vyaktiharU avajJAkArI chan?”

bhanideU– “ke ma timIharUlAI allAhakahA~ pariNAmako dRSTikoNale yastA narAmrA mAnisaharUko bAremA batAU~ jasamAthi allAhako dhikkAra ra prakopa bhayo ani jasamadhyebATa unale bA~dara ra su~gura banAe tathA tyo jasale ThUlo vidhvaMsakArIko dAsatva svIkAra garyo |” yinIharUko ThegAnA ati narAmro cha ra yinIharU ati pathabhraSTa chan |
ra, tinIharU timIharUsamakSa Aera bhanchan– “hAmIle ImAna lyAyau~”, jabaki tinIharU kuphrakAsAtha Ae ra kuphrakaisAtha pharke | ra, tinIharU jejati lukAu~chan tyo allAhalAI rAmrarI thAhA cha |
ra, timIle tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzalAI pApa tathA atyAcAra garne ani avaidha dhana khAne kAmamA ta~chADa machADa gariraheko pAunechau | kati narAmro rahecha unIharUle garne kAma!
tinIharUkA dharmaguru tathA santaharUle tinIharUlAI pApakA kurA garna ra avaidha dhana khAnabATa kina rokdainan? kati narAmrA chan tI kukRtyaharU juna tinIharU gardachan!

yahUdIharU bhandachan– “allAhakA hAta bA~dhiekA chan |” hoina, baru tinIharUkA hAta bA~dhiekA chan | tinIharUko yasa bhanAIle tinIharU dhikkArie | baru allAhakA duvai hAta khullA chan | unI jasarI cAhanchan kharca gardachan | ra, (he muhammada sa.!) timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa timImAthi avataraNa garieko granthale tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzako vidroha tathA asvIkAroktimA nai abivRddhi garnecha | ra, hAmIle tinIharUbIca mahApralayasammako lAgi zatrutA evaM dveSa utpanna garidiekA chauM | jaba jaba tinIharU yuddhako Ago bhaDkAu~chan allAha tyasalAI nibhAuchan | ani, tinIharU dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAuchan jabaki allAha vidhvaMsakArIharUlAI mana parAudainan |
ra, yadi yI ahle–kitAbaharule AsthA rAkheko bhae ani Izabhaya apanAeko bhae hAmI tinIharUkA pApaharUlAI meTAune thiyau~ ra tinIharUlAI Anandamaya bagai~cAmA praveza garAune thiyau~ |

ra, yadi tinIharUle taurAta, injIla tathA unIharUkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avataraNa bhaeko (grantha) lAI kAyama gareko bhae tinIharUle AphUmAthibATa ra AphnA khuTTAharUko munibATa khAdya sAmAgrIharU pAune thie | tinIharUbIca euTA madhyamArgI samUha ta cha, tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzako karma ati narAmro cha |

he IzadUta! timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa jejati timImAthi avataraNa bhaeko cha tyasalAI rAmrarI puryAU | yadi timIle yo kAma garenau bhane timIle unako saMdeza puryAenau | ra, allAhale mAnisaharUbATa timro rakSA garchan | nissandeha allAha kAphiraharUlAI mArga dekhAu~dainan |

bhanideU– “he ahle–kitAba ho! jabasamma timIharUle taurAta, injIla tathA timIharUsamakSa timrA rabako tarphabATa avataraNa garieko kurAlAI kAyama gardainau tabasamma timIharUko kunai AdhAra hune chaina |” ra (he muhammada sa.!) juna kuraAna timro ‘raba’ko tarphabATa timImAthi avataraNa garieko cha tyasale tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzako vidroha evaM inkAralAI ajha baDhAune nai cha | ataH timI tI kAphiraharUkA lAgi duHkhita nabana |

nissandeha musalamAna, yahUdI, sAbiI (nakSatrakA pUjArI) evaM IsAIharUmadhye jo pani allAha tathA AkhiratamAthi ImAna rAkhnechan ra satkarma garnechan tinIharUkAlAgi na kunai bhaya hunecha na tinIharU duHkhI nai hunechan |

hAmIle isrAIlakA santAnabATa dRDha vacana liyau~, ra tinIharUkAlAgi rasUlaharU paThAyau~ | tara, jaba jaba tinIharUkahA~ kunai IzadUta tinIharUko icchA viparIta kunai Adeza liera Ae, tinIharUle kehI rasUlaharulAI asatya ThaharyAune gare bhane anya kehIko hatyA garne gare |

ra, tinIharUle yo ThAnekA thie ki kunai vipat Aune chaina | tyasaile tinIharU andhA evaM bahirA banirahe | ani allAhale tinIharUlAI mApha garidie | punaH tinIharUmadhye dheraijaso andhA tathA bahirA nai bane | ra, tinIharUle je garirahekA chan tyo allAhale dekhirahekA chan |

nissandeha tinIharUle kuphra gare jasale yo bhane ki maryama putra masIha nai allAha hun, jabaki masIhale bhanekA thie– “he isrAIlakA santAnaharU ho! tyasa allAhako bhakti gara jo merA pani pAlanakartA hun ra timIharUkA (pani) pAlanakartA hun |” jasale kasailAI allAhako sAjhedAra ThaharAyo usakolAgi allAhale svarga niSedha gare | usako nivAsa naraka hunecha ra yastA atyAcArIharUkA kohI sahayogI hune chainan |

nissandeha tinIharUle kuphra gare jasale yo bhane ki allAha tInamadhye tesrA hun jabaki eka allAhabAheka arU kohI upAsya nai chaina | yadi yinIharUle AphnA kurAharUlAI tyAgenan bhane yinIharUmadhye jo kuphramA kAyama rahe tinIharulAI dukhaHdAyI yAtanAle samAtne cha |
ke tinIharU allAhatarpha pharkane chainan ra unIsa~ga kSamAyAcanA garne chainan? jabaki allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

maryama putra masIha ta kevala eka rasUla thie | unIbhandA pahile dherai rasUlaharU AisakekA chan | unakI AmA eka saccaritra strI thiin, tI duvai bhojana garne garthe | vicAra gara! hAmI kuna kuna tarikAle yinIharUlAI AphnA AyataharU spaSTa pArera batAu~chauM! ani, hera! unIharU ulTo pharkI katA jA~daichan |
bhanideU– “ke timIharU allAhalAI choDera tyasako upAsanA garchau jasale na timIharUlAI kunai hAni puryAune sAmarthya rAkhcha ra na kunai lAbhako nai?” ra, allAha nai sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

bhanideU– “he ahle–kitAba ho! Aphno dharmamA hakalAI tyAgera sImA ullaGghana nagara | ra, tI mAnisaharUkA manokAkSAharUko anusaraNa nagara jo yasabhandA pahile pathabhraSTa bhae ra dherailAI pathabhraSTa pAre ra svayaM pani sIdhA mArgabATa vicalita bhae |”
IsrAilakA santAnaharUmadhye jasale kuphra gare tinIharU dAUda tathA maryama–putra IsAko mukhabATa zrApita bhae, kinaki tinIharU avajJA ra sImA ullaMghana garne garthe |
tinIharUle garne garekA kukarmabATa eka arkolAI rokdainathe | kati narAmro kArya thiyo juna tinIharUle garirahekA thie!

tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzale kAphiraharUlAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAeko timIle dekhnechau | tinIharUle svayaMko lAgi jejati agADi paThAekA chan tI ati narAmrA chan | yasai kAraNale allAha tinIharUmAthi krodhita chan, ra tinIharU sadAsarvadA yAtanAmA rahanechan |

yadi tinIharUle allAha, sandeSTA tathA AphUtarpha avataraNa gariekA (grantha) harUmAthi AsthA rAkheko bhae tinIharUle avajJAkArIharUlAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAune thienan | tara tinIharumadhye dheraijaso avajJAkArI chan |

nissandeha timIle AsthAvAnaharUko zatrutAmA sababhandA adhika krUra yahUdI evaM muzrikaharUlAI pAunechau ra AsthAvAnaharUpratiko mitratAmA sababhandA najika tI mAnisaharUlAI pAunechau jasale bhane– “hAmI ‘nasArA’ (IsAI) hauM” kinabhane unIharUmA dheraijaso upAsaka dharmaguruharU ra sAMsArika jIvanalAI tyAgekA santaharU chan ra unIharU ghamaNDa gardainan |

ra, jaba unIharU rasUlamAthi avatarita vANI sundachan taba unIharUkA A~khAbATa satyabodhako kAraNale A~su bageko timI dekhnechau | ra, unIharU prAthanA garchan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA hAmIle ImAna lyAyau~ ataH sAkSI dineharUmA hAmIlAI pani sAmela gara |”
(unIharU bhanchan) “hAmIle allAhamAthi ra hAmIsamakSa Aeko satyamAthi kina ImAna nalyAune jabaki hAmro cAhanA nai yahI ho ki hAmrA pAlanakartAle hAmIlAI satkarmI mAnisaharUmA sAmAveza garUn?”

unIharUko yasa prArthanAlAI svIkArdai allAhale unIharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharu pradAna garne nechan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan, jahA~ unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan ra yahI nai sukarmIharUko pratidAna ho |
ra, jasale ‘kuphra’ gare ra hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare tinIharU narakabAsI hun |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! tI pavitra vastulAI avaidha nabanAU jasalAI allAhale timIharUkAlAgi vaidha garekA chan, ra sImA ullaGghana nagara | nissandeha allAha sImA ullaGghanakArIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |
allAhale timIharUlAI juna uttama vaidha cijaharU pradAna garekA chan tyasabATa khAU, ra tyasa allAhako bhayarAkha jasamAthi timIharUle ImAna lyAekA chau |

allAhale timIharUlAI timIharUle khAekA aniyojita kasamako lAgi pakaDa garne chainan | tara, timIharUle khAekA pakkA kasamako lAgi bhane timIharUlAI pakaDa garnechan | ataH yasako prAyazcita dasajanA garIbalAI yasto ausata khAlako khAnA khuvAunu ho juna timIharU Aphno parivArajanalAI khuvAune gardachau vA tinIharUlAI vastra pradAna garnu vA euTA dAsalAI mukta garnu | tara yasako sAmarthya narAkhnele tIna dina brata basos | yo timIharUko kasamako prAyazcita ho, jaba timIharU (yasto) kasama khAnchau | ataH AphnA kasamaharUko rakSA gara (jathAbhAvI kasama nakhAne gara) | yasarI allAha AphnA AyataharU spaSTa pArdachan tAki timIharU kRtajJatA vyakta gara |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! madirA, juvA, thAna, tIra (hAnera bhAgya pattA lagAune kArya) sabai ghRNita zaitAnI kAryaharU hun | yinIharubATa baca, tAki timIharU saphala huna saka |

zaitAnale madyapAna tathA juvAmA lagAera timIharUbIca zatrutA evaM dveSa utpanna garna cAhancha ra timIharUlAI allAhako smaraNa evaM namAjabATa rokna cAhancha | ke timIharU yI kurAharUbATa rokinchau ta?
ra, allAhako AjJApAlana gara ra rasUlako AjJApAlana gara ani satarka rahane gara | yadi timIharU bimukha hunchau bhane jAnirAkha hAmro rasUlako dAyitva spaSTarUpamA sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho |

jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare tyasa kurAmA kunai pApa lAgne chaina juna tinIharule khAisake, jaba kI tinIharu (avaidhabATa) bacchan, AsthAmA aTala rahanchan tathA satkarma garchan ani Izabhaya rAkhchan ra ImAna lyAu~chan | pheri allAhasita DarAu~chan ra baDhibhandA baDhi pUNya kArya garchan | ra, allAha ta sukarmIharUlAI mana parAu~chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhale (hajako avadhimA) timro hAtamA vA bhAlAharUko najikai AekA zikAraharUdvArA timro parIkSA linechan yo jAnnakolAgi ki allAhalAI nadekhikanai unIsita ko ko DarAu~da rahechan | ra, jasale yasapachi pani sImA ullaGghana garcha usako lAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA raheko cha |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! “ihrAma” ko avasthAmA zikAra nagara ra timIharUmadhye kasaile jAnIjAnI mArcha bhane tyasako kSatipUrti usale mAreko jastai janAvara ho jasako nirNaya timIharUmadhyekai duIjanA nyAyIka vyaktiharUle garnechan, jasalAI bhe~TasvarUpa kaabA puryAunu parcha, vA tyasa pApako prAyazcita svarUpa garIbaharUlAI khAnA khuvAunu parcha, vA tyasako saTTAmA brata basnuparcha tAki usale Aphno karmako sajAya bhogos | jejati pahile bhaisakekA chan tinalAI allAhale kSamA gare | tara, jasale yasalAI dohoryAunecha allAha usasita tyasako badalA linechan | ra, allAha prabhutvazAlI chan tathA badalA line sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

ani, timIharUko phAidAkAlAgi ra yAtrudalako phAidAkAlAgi samudramA zikAra garnu ra tyo khAnu vaidha garieko cha | tara jamInamA zikAra garnulAI cAhi~ “ihrAma” lagAeko avasthAmA avaidha garieko cha | ra, tyasa allAhako bhaya gara jasakahA~ timIlAI ekatrita garinecha |

allAhale pratiSThita ghara kaabAlAI mAnisaharUkAlAgi (sAmUhika jIvana) sthApanAko sAdhana banAe ani pratiSThita mahinA, kurabAnI diine janAvara tathA ghA~TImA paTTA lagAiekA janAvaralAI pani tAki timIharUlAI thAhA hos ki allAha AkAzaharU evaM dhartIkA sabai cija jAndachan | ra, allAha hareka cijakA jJAtA hun |
jAnirAkha– allAha kaThora daNDadAtA hun ra ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu pani |
rasUlako dAyitva sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho | je timIharU prakaTa gardachau ra je timIharU lukAu~chau allAha tI sabai jAndachan |

bhanideU– “apavitra ra pavitra samAna huna sakdainan cAhe apavitratAko pracuratAle timIlAI jatisukai pani AkarSita garos | he AsthAAvAnaharU ho! allAhasita DarAu | AzA cha timIharU timIharU saphala huna saknechau |”

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! tI kurAharubAre sodhapucha nagara juna timIharUsamakSa prakaTa gariemA timIharUlAI narAmro lAgnecha | ra, kuraAna avataraNa bhairaheko samayamA yadi timIharUle sodhyau bhane tI kurAharU timIharU samakSa spaSTa pAriinecha | ahilesamma timIharUle jejati garyau tyasalAI allAhale kSamA garekA chan ra allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM sahanazIla chan |
yastai kisimakA praznaharU timIharUbhandA pahileko eka samudAyale pani sodheko thiyo, ra tinIharU tinai kurAharUle gardA kAphira bhae |
allAhale na kasailAI ‘bahIrA’ ThaharAekA chan na ‘sAibA’, na ‘vasIlA’ ra na ‘hAma’ | tara, kAphiraharU allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa gardaichan | ra, tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza vivekahIna chan |

ra, tinIharUlAI allAhadvArA avatarita niyama–kAnUnatarpha tathA IzadUtatarpha bolAIMdA tinIharU bhanchan– “hAmrolAgi tyahI paryApta cha jasamA hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI pAekA chau~ |” cAhe tinIharukA pUrvajaharUle kehI pani najAnekA hoUn ra na mArgadarzana nai pAekA hoUn, tA pani?

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharu mAthi timIharu ko mAtra Aphno jimmevArI ho! yadi timIharU satmArgamA chau bhane pathabhraSTaharUle timIharU lAI hAni puryAuna sakdainan | timIharU sabai allAhakahA~ nai pharkera jAnucha ani (unale) timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbAre batAunechan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyuko samaya Ayo bhane vasIyata gardAkheri timIharUmadhye duIjanA nyAyIka sAkSI hunuparcha, vA yadi timIharU yAtrAko avasthAmA chau ra tyahI~ mRtyuko vipatti Aipugyo bhane (Aphno mAnche nabhaeko khaNDamA) timIharUbhandA bAhirakai duIjanA sAkSI hunuparcha | kunai zaMkA bhaemA duvai sAkSIlAI namAja pazcAt roka jahA~ duvaile allAhako kasama khAera bhanUn– “hAmI yasako badalAmA kunai mUlya line chainau~ cAhe kohI nAtedAra nai kina nahos, ra na hAmI allAhako sAkSIlAI lukAune nai chau~ | yadi hAmIle yasto garyau~ bhane hAmro gantI pApIharUmA hoos |”

pheri yI duvaile (haka mArera) pApako bhAgidAra bhaeko pattA lAgyo bhane yinIharUko ThAu~mA anya duIjanA tyastA vyaktiharUmadhyebATa khaDA houn jasako haka aghillA tI duIjanAle mArna cAhekA thie, ani yinIharUle hAmI duvaiko sAkSya tI duIjanAko sAkSyabhandA baDhI saccA cha ra hAmIle kunai sImA ullaGaghana garekA chainau ra yasto garyauM bhane hAmro gaNanA atyAcArIharUmA hoos bhanera allAhako kasama khAUn |

yasto gariemA mAnisaharUle satya gavAhI dinechan bhanne adhika sambhAvanA rahanecha vA tinIharU yasa kurAbATa DarAunechan ki kahI~ arkAko kasamabATa tinIharUko kasama natoDiyos | allAhako bhaya gara ra suna, ra allAha avajJAkArIharUlAI satmArga dekhAu~dainan |

juna dina allAhale rasUlaharUlAI ekatrita garnechan ra unIharUlAI sodhnechan– “timIharUlAI ke javApha diiyo?” unIharUle bhannechan– “hAmIlAI kehI jJAna chaina | timI nai adRzya kurAharuko mahAna jJAtA hau |”

ra smaraNa gara jaba sallAhale bannechan he IsA! maile timI mAthi ra timrA AmA mAthi gareko kRpAlAI yAda gara jaba maile ruhulkudusa (pavitra AtmA) dvArA timro sahayoga gare~, timI zizu avasthAmA pani mAnisaharusa~ga kurAkAnI gardathyo ThUlo umara mA pani garane chau, ra maile timIlAI graMtha, tatvadarzitA, taurAta evaM injIla sikAe~ ani jaba timI mero anumatile mATole paMkSIko AkRti banAera tyasamA phukthyau ani tyo mero AjJAle sA~ccikai paMkSI banthyo, ani timI mero anumatile janmajAta andho evaM kuSTha rogIharUlAI niko pArthyau ra jaba timI mero anumatile mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArI (cihAnabATa) nikAldathyau | ra, tyatikhera maile nai isarAIlakA santAnaharUbATa timIlAI bacAe~; jaba timI unIharUsamakSa spaSTa nizAnIharU liera AekA thiyau ra, tinIharUmadhye anAsthA pradarzana garneharUle bhanekA thie~– “yo ta prasTa jAdU ho |”

ra, smaraNa gara– jaba maile havArI (masIhakA sAthI) harUlAI Adeza die~ ki mamAthi tathA merA rasUlamAthi ImAna lyAU taba unIharUle bhane– “hAmIle ImAna lyAyau~ ra timI sAkSI basa ki hAmI AjJAkArI hauM |”

ra, smaraNa gara– jaba havArIharUle bhane– “he maryama putra IsA! ke timrA pAlanakartAle hAmImAthi AkAzabATa ‘mAidA’ (khAdyavastule sajAieko dastarakhAna) avatarita garna sakchan?” ani IsAle bhane– “yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane allAhako bhaya gara |”

unIharUle bhane– “hAmI ke cAhanchauM bhane tyasabATa khAauM ra hAmro hRdaya santuSTa hos, jasale gardA hAmIlAI yo jAnakArI hos ki timIle hAmIlAI satya kurA batAekA rahechau ra hAmI tyasako sAkSI huna sakau~ |”

maryama putra IsAle prArthanA gare– “he allAha! hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmImAthi AkAzabATa dasatarkhAna avatarita gara, juna hAmrolAgi, ra hAmIbhandA pahilekA tathA pachikAlAgi khuzIko avasara banos ra timrotarphabATa euTA nizAnI banos | ani, hAmIharUlAI AjIvikA deU ra timI uttama annadAtA hau |”

allAhale uttara die– “ma avazya timIharUkAlAgi tyo (mAidA) avatarita garchu tara tyasapachi timIharUmadhye kasaile asvIkAra garyo bhane tyasalAI yasto daNDa dinechu jasto ma saMsAramA kasailAI dinechaina |”

ra, smaraNa gara jaba allAhale sodhnechan– “he maryamaputra IsA! ke timIle mAnisaharUlAI bhanekA thiyau ki allAhakA atirikta malAI ra merI AmAlAI pani upAsya banAU?” unale uttara dinechan– “allAha timI pavitra chau! juna kurA bhanne adhikAra malAI thiena tyo ma kasarI bhanna saktheM? maile tyaso bhaneko bhae timIlAI thAhA hune thiyo kinabhane mero manamA bhaeko kurA timI jAndachau ra juna kurA timro manamA cha tyo ma jAndina | nissandeha timI adRzyakA mahAna jJAtA hau |

maile ta timIle Adeza gareko kurA mAtrai tinIharUlAI bhane~, yo ki allAhako bhakti gara jo merA pani pAlanakartA hun ra timIharUkA pani | ra, jabasamma ma unIharUbIca rahe~ tabasamma maile unIharUko khabara rAkhe~ pheri jaba timIle malAI uThAyau taba timI nai unIharUkA nirIkSaka thiyau | ra, timI ta sampUrNa cijakA khabara rAkhnevAlA hau |
yadi timI unIharUlAI daNDa dinchau bhane nissandeha unIharU ta timrai dAsa hun ra yadi unIharUlAI kSamA pradAna garchau bhane timI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chau |”

ani allAhale bhannechan– “yo tyo dina ho jasamA satyaniSThaharUko lAgi tinIharuko satyatA lAbhaprada hunecha |” unIharUkA lAgi yastA bagaiMcAharU chan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadA–sarvadA rahanechan | allAha unIharUsita prasanna chan ra unIharU allAhasita prasanna | yahI ThUlo saphalatA ho |
AkAzaharU, pRthvI tathA yinamA rahekA sampUrNa cijaharUmAthi allAhakai zAsanAdhikAra raheko cha | ra unI hareka kurAko sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
sArA prazaMsA allAhakai nimti hun jasale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko racanA gare; andhakAraharU evaM prakAza banAe، taipani kAphiraharU AphnA pAlanakartAko samakakSI ThaharAu~chan |
unai hun jasale timIharUlAI mATodvArA sRSTi gare, ani (jIvanako) euTA avadhi nizcita gare | nizcita avadhiko jJAna unalAI nai cha, taipani timIharU sandeha garchau |
ra, AkAzaharU evaM pRthvImA unai eka allAha chan | unI timrA gopya tathA pratyakSa savai kurA jAndachan ra timIharUle garne gareko karmalAI pani unI jAndachan |
allAhakA nizAnIharUmadhye junasukai nizAnI pani unIharUsamakSa Au~cha tyasabATa unIharU vimukha hunchan |
tinIharUsamakSa satya Au~dA tyasalAI tinIharUle mithyA ThaharyAe | ra, cA~Dai nai tinIharUlAI tyasa sambandhamA sUcanA prApta hunecha jasako bAremA tinIharU ThaTTA garne garthe |

ke tinIharUle dekhenan ki hAmIle tinIharUbhandA pahile kati tyastA jAtiharUlAI naSTa pArisakekA chauM jasalAI hAmIle dhartImA jasarI sthApita garekA thiyauM tyasarI timIharUlAI sthApita garekA chainauM? tinIharUmAthi hAmIle AkAzabATa musaladhAre varSA garAyauM ra tinIharUko talatirabATa nadIharU bagAyauM | antataH hAmIle tinIharUko kukarmale gardA tinIharUlAI naSTa garidiyauM | ra, tinIharUpachi hAmIle anya jAtilAI hurkAyauM |
ra, yadi hAmIle timImAthi kAgajamA lekhieko grantha avatarita gareko bhae ra tinIharUle tyasalAI Aphno hAtale sparza gareko bhae pani kAphiraharUle yo ta khullA jAdU ho bhanera bhanne thie |

tinIharU bhanchan– “unImAthi kunai phariztA kina avatarita gariena?” yadi hAmIle kunai phariztA avatarita gareko bhae yasako phaisalA nai bhaisakthyo ra tinIharUlAI alikati pani avasara diine thiena |
ra, yadi hAmIle usa (rasUla) lAI phariztA banAeko bhae pani mAnchekai rUpamA banAune thiyauM, ra tinIharUlAI tyahI zaMkAmA rAkhthyauM jasamA tinIharU ahile chan |
he sandeSTA! timIbhandA pahile pani rasUlaharUko upahAsa garieko thiyo, tara tI upahAsa garneharUlAI tyahI tathya (prakopa) le gherichADyo jasako yinIharU upahAsa garthe |
yinIharUlAI bhanideU– “dhartImA ghumaphira gara | ani, hera jasale mithyAropaNa gare tinIharUko ke pariNAma bhayo?”

yinIharUsa~ga sodha– “AkAzaharU evaM dhartImA jejati chan kasakA sampatti hun?” bhanideU– “yI sabai allAhakai hun | unale dayAlAI svayaMmAthi anivArya garekA chan | mahApralayako dina unI timIharUlAI avazya ekatrita garnechan jasamA kunai sandeha chaina | tara, jasale AphUlAI svayaM noksAnImA pArekA chan tinIharU yasamA AsthA rAkhdainan |”
rAta ra dinamA basobAsa garne sabai unaikA hun ra unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

bhanideU– “ke ma AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sRSTikartA allAhalAI choDera kohI arUlAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAU~ jabaki unI khAnA khuvAu~chan ra unalAI khvAIne khAco chaina |” bhanideU– “malAI sarvaprathama AphUlAI samarpita gareko banne ra kadApi bahudevavAdIharUmadhye nabanne Adeza bhaeko cha |”
bhanideU– “yadi maile AphnA pAlanakartAko avajJA gareM bhane euTA ThUlo dinako daNDa bhognu parnecha bhanI malAI DaralAgcha |”
tyasadina jasalAI sajAya~bATa bacAiyo tyasamAthi allAhale dayA gare ra yo spaSTa saphalatA ho |

ra, yadi allAhale timIharUlAI kunai hAni puryAu~chan bhane unIbAheka kasaile pani tyasalAI TArna sakdaina ra yadi unI timIharUlAI kunai lAbha pradAna garchan bhane unI sabai kAryako sAmarthya rAkhchan |
ra, unalAI AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi pUrNa prabhutva prApta cha ra unI tatvadarzI evaM sarvajJa chan |

sodha! sababhandA ThUlo sAkSI ko ho? bhanideU– ‘allAha' nai ma ra timIharUkobIca sAkSI rahekA chan | ra, yo kuraAna matarpha avatarita garnuko uddezya timIharUlAI tathA jasakahA~ yo pugcha tinIharUlAI saceta garU~ | ke sAccikai timI sAkSI dinchau ki allAhasa~ga kunai anya pUjyaharU pani chan?” bhanideU– “ma ta yasako sAkSi dina sakdina | pUjya ta unI mAtra hun | ra,ma mukta chu tI sabaibATa jasalAI timIharU (allAhako) sAjhedAra banAu~chau |”
jasalAI hAmIle grantha pradAna garekA chauM tinIharUle rasUla (muhammada sa.) lAI AphnA putraharUlAI cine jastai cinchan | AphUlAI noksAnamA pArekAharU nai AsthA rAkhdainan |
ra, tyo vyakti bhandA ThUlo atyAcArI ko holA jo allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garcha vA allAhakA nizAnIharUlAI asatya Thahara garcha | nissandeha atyAcArIharU kahilyai saphala huna sakdainan |
ra, juna dina tinIharu sabailAI hAmI ekatrita garnechauM tyasadina bahudevavAdIharUlAI sodhnechauM– “kahA~ chan timIharUle ThAnekA timrA sAjhedAraharU!?”
he hAmrA pAlanakartA timro kasama! hAmI kadApi bahudevavAdI thienauM bhanera jhUTha racnu vAheka anya kunai upadrava tinIharUle garna sakne chainan |
hera, tinIharUle kasarI AphaiMviruddha jhuTho bole | ani, tinIharUkA managaDhante IzvaraharU harAe |

ra, tinIharUmadhye kehI yastA pani chan jasale kAna thApera timro kurA sunchan tara hAmIle tinIharUkA hRdaya pardAle DhAkidiekA chauM tAki tinIharUle bujhna nasakUn ra tinIharUkA kAnamA TheDI rAkhidiekA chauM | tinIharUle sabai kisimakA nizAnIharU avalokana gare pani tyasamAthi ImAna lyAune chainan | yahA~samma ki jaba tinIharU timIsa~ga vAdavivAda garna Au~chan tyatibelA yI kAphiraharU bhanchan– “yI ta pUrvajaharUbATa caliAekA dantyakathAharU mAtra hun |”
ra, tinIharUle mAnisalAI yasabATa rokchan ra svayam pani TADhA rahanechan ra tinIharUle AphaiMlAI naSTa gardaichan tara tinIharUle mahasusa garirahekA chainan |

(he muhammada sa.!) kati rAmro hunthyo ki timIle dekhne thiyau jaba tinIharUlAI AgomA khaDA garAinecha taba tinIharUle bhannechan– “Aha! hAmIlAI pharkAI dieko bhae kati rAmro hunthyo holA! hAmIle AphnA pAlanakartAkA AyataharUlAI mithyA ThAnne thienauM ra AsthAvAnaharUmadhye hunethiyauM |”

apitu juna kurAharU pahile tinIharU lukAune garthe tinai kurAharU tinIharUsamakSa prakaTa bhaekA chan | ra, tinIharUlAI pheri paThAiyo bhane pani tinIharUle tyahI garnechan juna tinIharUkA lAgi niSedha garieko thiyo | ra, nissandeha tinIharU jhuThA hun |
ra, tinIharU bhanchan– “hAmro jIvana yo sAMsArika jIvana mAtra ho | ra, hAmI pheri uThAine chainau~ |”

(he muhammada sa.!) timIle tinIharUlAI tinakA pAlanakartA sAmu khaDA garieko avasthAmA dekhna pAe rAmro hunthyo | pAlanakartAle sodhnechan– “ke yo satya hoina?” tinIharUle bhannechan– “kina nahunu hAmrA pAlanakartAko kasama! (yo satya ho)” pAlanakartAle bhannechan– “lau tyaso bhae timIharUle garekA kuphrako badalAmA yAtanA bhoga |”

noksAnamA pare tinIharU jasale allAhasa~ga bheTne kurAlAI jhuTho ThaharAe | jaba akasmAt tyo samaya Aunecha taba tinIharUle bhannechan– “Aha! tyasa galtImAthi aphsoca cha juna yasa viSayamA hAmIle garyauM |” ra, tinIharUle piThyU~mA Aphno (pApako) bhArI bokekA hunechan | jJAta hos yo ati ghRNita bhArI ho juna tinIharUle boknechan |
ra, sAMsArika jIvana khela tamAzA mAtra ho | ra, Izabhaya rAkhneharUkAlAgi ta paraloka nai uttama sthAna ho | ta ke timIharU vivekale kAma lidainau?

(he sandeSTA!) hAmIlAI thAhA cha ki yinIharUle bhaneko kurAle timIlAI duHkhita tulyAu~cha | yinIharUle timIlAI mAtra jhuTho ThaharyAu~dainan yathArthamA yI atyAcArIharUle ta allAhakA AyataharUlAI jhuTho ThaharAu~daichan |

timIbhandA aghikA IzadUtaharU pani jhuTho ThaharAie | tara, unIharUle AphUle bhogekA asvIkArokti tathA kaSTamA dhairya dhAraNa gare | antataH hAmro sahayoga unIharUlAI Aipugyo | allAhako vANI kasaile parivartana garna sakdaina | ra, timIlAI IzadUtaharUbAre samAcAra prApta bhaisakekai cha |

ra, (he muhammada sa.!) yadi unIharUko vimukhatA timrolAgi ekadamai asahanIya cha, ra yadi timI sakchau bhane dhartImA suruGga vA AkAzamA kunai bharyAGga khoja ani tinIharU najika kunai camatkAra lyAU | cha allAhale cAhekA bhae tI sabailAI satmArgamA ekatrita garne thie | ataH timI ajJAnIharUmadhye nabana |
sunnele nai svIkAra garchan | jahA~samma yI mRtaharUko kurA cha allAhale yinIharUlAI punarjIvita garI uThAunechan | pheri tinIharUlAI unaitarpha pharkAera laginecha |

ra, yinIharU bhanchan– “yasa (sandeSTA) mAthi yinakA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kunai nizAnI kina avatarita gariena?” bhanideU– “nizcaya nai allAha nizAnI avatarita garne sAmarthya rAkhchan, tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |”

ra, bhUmimA hi~Dne jati prakArakA janAvaraharU chan ra AphnA duI pakheTAdvArA uDne jati paMkSIharU; tinIharU pani timIharU jastai alaga samUha hun | hAmIle Aphno bahImA kehI pani chuTAekA chainauM | ani yinIharU AphnA pAlanakartAsAmu nai ekatrita garinechan |

ani, jasale hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI asatya Thahara gare, tI bahirA ra lATA hun, tathA tinIharU andhakAramA chan | allAha jasalAI cAhanchan pathabhraSTa pArchan ra jasalAI cAhanchan satmArgamA DoryAu~chan |

bhanideU– “(he kAphiraharU ho!) ali socera batAU, yadi timIharUmAthi allAhako prakopa AiparemA vA mahApralaya nai ghaTita bhaemA ke timIharU allAha–bAheka anya kasailAI bolAu~chau? (batAU) yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane?
baru timIharUle allAhalAI mAtra pukArdachau, ani unale cAheko khaNDamA tyo saGkaTa TAridinchan | ani (taba) timIharUle ThaharyAiekA sAjhedAraharUlAI birsanchau |
ra, hAmIle timIbhandA pahile dherai samudAyaharUtarpha rasUla paThAyauM ra tinIharUlAI daridratA tathA zArIrika kaSTaharUmA grasta pAryauM tAki tinIharU vinamra hoUn |
ra, tinIharUsamakSa hAmro prakopa Au~dA tinIharU kina binamra bhaenan? baru tinIharUko hRdaya jhan kaThora bhayo | ra, tinIharUle garirahekA narAmrA kAryaharUlAI zaitAnale zobhanIya tulyAidiyo |

ani jaba tinIharUle smaraNa garAiekA kurA birse taba hAmIle tinIharUkAlAgi sabai sampannatAkA DhokA kholidiyauM | ani jaba tinIharU pradAna gariekA cijaharUmA magna bhae taba hAmIle akasmAt tinIharUlAI samAtyauM, taba tinIharU nirAza huna puge |
antataH atyAcArI samudAyako jaro nai kATiyo | sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhakailAgi jo sampUrNa saMsArakA pAlanakartA hun |

(he sandeSTA!) tinIharUlAI sodha– “ke timIharUle socekA chau ki allAhale timIharUko sunne ra dekhne zakti khose ra timrA hRdayaharUmA sIla (mohara) lagAidie bhane allAhabAheka kuna upAsyale timIharUlAI tyo phirtA dina sakcha?” hera, hAmI kasarI AyataharU varNana garchauM taipani tinIharU bevAstA garchan |
bhanideU– “ke timIharUle Aphno bAremA beglAbeglai vicAra garyau ki yadi timIharUmAthi allAhako prakopa akasmAt vA praSTa rupamA Aiparyo bhane atyAcArIharUbAheka anya ko naSTa holA ra?”
ra, hAmIle rasUlaharUlAI kevala zubha–sUcaka evam sacetaka banAera paThAekA chauM | ra, jasale ImAna lyAe ra sudhrie unIharUkA lAgi na kunai Dara cha na unIharU cintita nai hunechan |
ra, jasale hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara garchan tinIharuko avajJAle gardA tinIharUmAthi prakopa AilAgnecha |

bhanideU– “masita allAhako khajAnA cha bhanI ma timIharUlAI bhandina; na parokSako jJAna nai rAkhchu, ra na ma phariztA hune dAvI nai garchu | ma ta kevala tyasa prakAzanAko anusaraNa garchu juna mamAthi avatarita garincha |” bhanideU– “ke andho ra dekhne vyakti samAna huna sakcha? ke timIharU vicAra gardainau?”

ra, timI tI mAnisaharUlAI yasa (prakAzanA) dvArA saceta gara jo AphnA pAlanakartAsamakSa ekatrita garinechan bhanI DarAu~chan | yinIharUkAlAgi unIbAheka na kohI saMrakSaka ra na kohI siphArizakartA nai hunecha | AzA cha yinIharU allAhako bhaya rAkhnechan |

ra, tinIharUlAI AphUbATa TADhA napAra jasale bihAna ra sA~jha AphnA pAlanakartAlAI unako prasannatA prAptiko cAhanA gardai pukArchan; tinIharUko kunai pani hisAba timImAthi chaina na timro kunai hisAba tinIharUmAthi cha ki timIle tinIharUlAI TADhA pAra | yasto garyau bhane timI atyAcArIharUmA gaNanA hunechau |

ra, yasai prakAra hAmIle tinIharUmadhye ekalAI arkodvArA jA~cekA chauM tAki tinIharUle yinalAI dekhera bhanUn– “ke yinai hun hAmIharUmadhyekA jasamAthi allAhale kRpA gare?” a~, ke allAha AphnA kRtajJa bhaktaharUlAI sababhandA baDhI jAndainan ra?

ra, yadi timIsamakSa hAmrA AyataharUmAthi AsthA rAkhneharU Au~chan bhane bhana– “timIharUmAthi zAnti hos | timrA pAlanakartAle dayAlAI AphnolAgi anivArya garekA chan | timIharUmadhye kasaile ajJAnatAvaza kukarma garyo ra tyasapachi prAyazcita garyo ani sudhAra garyo bhane allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |”
ra, yasarI nai hAmI AyataharUlAI khulasta rUpamA varNana garchau ra yasa uddezyale pani ki aparAdhIharUko bATo ekadama spaSTa hoos |

bhanideU–“allAhakA atirikta timIharU jasalAI pukArdachau tyasako upAsanA garna malAI niSedha garieko cha |” bhanideU– “ma timIharUkA manokAMkSAharUko anusaraNa gardina; yaso garemA ma pathabhraSTa hunechu ra sIdhA mArga pAekAharUmadhye huna sakdina |"

bhanideU– “ma AphnA pAlanakartAbATa prApta euTA spaSTa nizAnImA kAyama chu ra timIharUle tyasalAI jhuTho ThaharAekA chau | jasako lAgi timIharU masa~ga hatAra garchau tyo masa~ga chaina | phaisalA garne adhikAra allAhasa~ga mAtra rahekocha | unI satyatathya bayAna gardachan ra unI sarvottama nirNayakartA hun |”
bhanideU– “jasakolAgi timIharU hatAra gardaichau yadi tyo cija masa~ga bhaeko bhae ma ra timIharUkAbIca (uhilyai) phaisalA bhaisakne thiyo |” ra, allAha atyAcArIharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |

ra parokSakA sA~cAharU unaisa~ga rahekA chan juna unIbAheka kohI pani jAndaina | jamIna tathA pAnImA jejati chan unalAI thAhA cha | yasto hunai sakdaina ki kunai pAta jharyo tara unalAI thAhA nai nahos | dhartIko andhakAramA kunai yasto dAnA vA kunai kA~co vA pAkeko cija chaina jasako vivaraNa euTA spaSTa kitAbamA aMkita nahos |

unai hun jasale rAtamA timIharUko prANalAI niyantrita gardachan ra dinamA jejati garchau tyasako jAnakArI rAkhchan ani dinamA timIharUlAI uThAu~chan tAki nirdhArita avadhi pUrA huna sakos | ani timIharU unaitarpha pharkera jAnechau | ra unale timIharUlAI timIharUle garne garekA kAryabAre batAunechan |

ani, AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi unako pUrNa prabhutva prApta cha ra unI timIharUko heracAhakAlAgi saMrakSaka (phariztA) paThAu~chan | yahA~sammaki jaba timIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyu Aipugcha taba hAmIle paThAekA (phariztA) le usako AtmAlAI kabjA garcha | ra, unIharU Aphno kAryamA kunai DhilAsustI gardainan |
pheri tI sabai AphnA vAstavika svAmI allAhatarpha nai pharkAinechan | sAvadhAna! phaisalAko pUrNa adhikAra unalAI mAtra cha | ra, unI chiTai hisAba linevAlA chan |

sodha– “jamIna tathA pAnIkA andhakAraharUbATa timIharUlAI kasale bacAu~cha jasalAI timIharUle vinayapUrvaka tathA guptarUpamA pukArdachau? (kasalAI bhanchau ki) unale hAmro uddhAra gare bhane hAmI avazya nai kRtajJaharUmadhye hunechauM |”
bhanideU– “allAhale nai timIharUlAI yasabATa ra sabai kaSTaharubATa mukti pradAna garchan tara timIharU bhane sAjhedAra banAune garchau |”

bhanideU– “unI timIharUkAlAgi mAthitirabATa vA khuTTAmuni tirabATa yAtanA paThAune sAmathrya rAkhdachan vA timIharUlAI vibhinna sampradAyamA vibhAjana garI paraspara bhiDanta garAune tathA eka sampradAyalAI arko sampradAyako zaktiko svAda cakhAune sAmathrya pani rAkhdachan |” hera, hAmI kasarI AyataharU vibhinna DhaGgale prastuta gardaichauM tAki tinIharUle bujhna sakUn |,
timro samudAyakA mAnisaharUle yasalAI inkAra gare jabaki yo satya ho | bhanideU–“ma timIharUkolAgi havaladAra banAieko chaina |”
hareka kurAkAlAgi euTA samaya tokieko cha ra timIharU cA~Dai nai jAnnechau |

ra, tinIharUlAI hAmrA AyataharUbAre vyartha bakavAsa gareko pAyau bhane tinIharU kunai arko viSayamA nalAgesamma tinIharUbATa alaga basa | ra, timIlAI zaitAnale bhulAyo bhane yAda AunAsAtha tI atyAcArI mAnisaharUsa~ga nabasa |
tinIharUko hisAbako sambandhamA Izabhaya rAkhneharUmAthi kunai uttaradAyitva chaina sivAya upadeza dinu tAki tinIharU DarAUn |

ani, tinIharUlAI choDideU jasale Aphno dharmalAI khela tamAzA banAekA chan, ra jasalAI sAMsArika jIvanale dhokAmA pAreko cha | ra, tinIharUlAI yasa (kuraAna) dvArA nasIhata gara tAki kunai vyakti Aphno kukarmako kAraNale barabAda nahos | allAhabAheka na usako kohI saMrakSaka–mitra na siphArizakartA nai hunecha | ra, usale kSatipUrti svarUpa sarvasva die pani svIkAra garine chaina | yI tinai hun jasalAI tinIharukai kukarmako kAraNabATa barabAda pArinecha | tinIharUko Aphnai kuphra (anAsthA pradarzana) ko kAraNa tinIharUkAlAgi umla~do tarala padArtha tathA dukhada yAtanA rahekocha |

he sandeSTA! sodha– “ke hAmI allAhalAI choDI tyasalAI pukArauM jasale hAmIlAI na kunai lAbha puryAuna sakcha na hAni nai? ra, allAhale hAmIlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAisakeko avasthAmA ke aba hAmI ulTo pAu phirauM? ke hAmIle Aphno avasthA tyasa vyaktiko jasto banAauM jasalAI zaitAnaharUle marubhUmimA pathabhraSTa garI chADidiekA hoUn ra usakA sAthIharUle usalAI sIdhA mArgatira DAkirahekA hoUn ki hAmItarpha AU?” bhanideU– “vAstavika mArgadarzana ta allAhako mArgadarzana ho | ra, hAmIlAI sampUrNa jagatkA prabhusAmu AtmasamarpaNa garne Adeza bhaeko cha |”
ani, (yo Adeza pani diieko cha ki) namAja kAyama gara, unaisa~ga DarAU ra unaikahA~ timIharU ekatrita garinechau |

ra, unai hun jasale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI nyAyasaMgata racanA gare ra juna dina unale bhannechan ‘bhaihAla’ taba tyo hunecha | unako vacana satya ho | ra, juna dina ‘sUra’ (narasiGghA) phukinecha tyasadina unakai zAsana hunecha | unI adRzya tathA dRzya sabai jAndachan | ra, unI tatvadarzI tathA susUcita chan |
ra, smaraNa gara jaba ibrAhImale AphnA pitA AjaralAI bhane– “ke tapAIM mUrtiharUlAI upAsya banAunu huncha? ma ta tapAI ra tapAIko samudAyakA mAnisaharulAI spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA dekhdaichu |
ra, ibrAhImalAI yasarI hAmIle pRthvI evaM AkAzaharUko rAjya–vyavasthA dekhAyauM tAki unI AsthAvAnaharUmadhyekA banUn |
jaba rAta paryo unale euTA tArA dekhe ra bhane– “yo merAe svAmI ho |” ani, jaba tyo astAyo taba unale bhane– “ma astAune vastulAI mana parAu~dina |”

tyasapachi unale ujyAlo candramA dekhe ra bhane– “yo nai merAe svAmI ho |” ani, jaba tyo astAyo taba unale bhane– “merA pAlanakartAle malAI satmArga dekhAenan bhane ma nizcaya nai pathabhraSTaharUmadhyeko hunechu |”

tatpazcAt jaba unale sUryalAI prakAzamAna dekhe taba unale bhane– “yo merAe svAmI ho | yo ta sababhandA ThUlA rahecha |” jaba tyo pani astAyo taba unale bhane– “he merA samudAyakA dAjubhAiharU ho! mero tyasamA kunai sarokAra chaina jasalAI timIharU sAjhedAra banAu~chau |”
“maile dattacitta bhaI Aphno anuhAra tyasatarpha gareko chu jasale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko racanA gare | ra, ma kadApi muzrikaharUmadhye hoina |”

unakA samudAyakA mAnisaharUle unIsa~ga vAdavivAda garna thAlepachi unale bhane– “ke timIharU masa~ga allAhako viSayamA vAdavivAda garchau jabaki unale malAI sIdhA mArga dekhAekA chan? ra, ma timIharUle racekA sAjhedAraharUsa~ga DarAudina | a~, merA svAmI kehI cAhanchan bhane (tyo beglai kurA ho) | merA mAlika sabai cijako jJAna rAkhdachan | ke timIharU samjhadainau?”

ra, ma timIharUle racekA sAjhedAraharUsa~ga kasarI DarAU~ jabaki timIharU allAhako sAjhedAra racna DarAu~dainau jasakAlAgi allAhale timIharUmAthi kunai pramANa avatarita garekA nai chainan | ani hAmI duvai samUhamadhye ko baDhI nizcintatAko adhikArI hauM? yadi timIharUlAI jJAna cha (bhane batAU) |
juna mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAe ra Aphno ImAnalAI anyAyasita misAenan nizcintatA (zAnti) tinIharUkAlAgi ho ra tinIharU nai satmArgamA chan |

ra, yo hAmro tyo tarka ho juna hAmIle ibrAhImalAI unakA jAtikA mAnisaharUviruddha pradAna garyauM | hAmI jasalAI cAhanchauM tyasako sthAna ucca pArdachauM | nissandeha timrA svAmI tatvadarzI evaM sarvajJa chan |

ani, hAmIle ibrAhImalAI ishAka tathA yaakUba pradAna garyauM | sabaiko pathapradarzana garyauM ra nUhalAI pani hAmIle yasabhandA aghi mArgadarzana garekA thiyauM tathA unakA santAnaharUmadhye hAmIle dAUda, sulaimAna, aiyyUba, yUsupha, mUsA evaM hArUnalAI pani | yasarI nai hAmI sukarmIharUlAI pratidAna pradAna garchauM |
ra jakariyyA ra yahayA ra IsA tathA ilyAsalAI pani (satmArga dekhAyauM) | yI sabai satkarmIharU thie |
ismAIla, ala–yasaa, yUnusa ra lUtalAI pani (satmArga dekhAyauM) | sabailAI hAmIle saMsArabAsIharUmAthi pradhAnatA pradAna garyauM |
ra, tinIharukA pUrvaja, santAna tathA dAjubhAiharUmadhye dherailAI pani; hAmIle yinIharUlAI cayana garyauM ra sIdhA mArga dekhAyauM |
yo allAhako mArgadarzana ho | unI AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanchan satmArga pradAna garchan | yadi yinIharUle zirka garekA bhae yinIharUle garekA sabai satkarmaharU bekArakA hune thie |

yI tI mAnisaharU hun jasalAI hAmIle grantha, nirNayAdhikAra ra IzadUtatva pradAna garyauM | ahile pani yadi tinIharU yasako inkAra garchan bhane hAmIle tyasa (mArgadarzana) ko lAgi yastA mAnisaharU cayana garekA chauM jasale inkAra garne chainan |

yI tinIharU hun jasalAI allAhale bATo dekhAe | tasartha timI pani tinIharukai tarIkAko anusaraNa gara | bhanideU– “ma timIharUsa~ga yasako kunai pratidAna mAgdina | yo ta sampUrNa saMsArabAsIkA lAgi upadeza mAtra ho |”

ra, unIharUle allAhako sahI kadara garenan jaba tinIharUle bhane– “allAhale kunai manuSyamAthi kehI avatarita garekA chainan |” sodha– “tyo grantha kasale avatarita garyo juna mUsAle manuSyaharukAlAgi divyaprakAza tathA mArgadarzanako haisiyatale lyAekA thie; jasalAI timIharUle alaga alaga pAnAharUmA rAkhekA chau; jasamadhye kehI vyakta garchau ani adhikAMza lukAu~chau, ra timIharUlAI tyo sikAiyo jasako bAremA na timIharUlAI thAhA thiyo na timrA purkhAharUlAI nai?” bhanideU– “allAhale (avatarita gare) |” ani, tinIharUlAI tinakA kukarmako khelamA nai magna rahana deU |

ani, yo ho grantha juna hAmIle avatarita garekA chauM juna barakatayukta (maGgalamaya) cha ra yasabhandA pahile avataraNa garieko (IzagranthaharU) ko puSTi gardacha, ra juna yasa uddezyale (avatarita garieko ho) ki timIle zaharaharUko yasa kendra (makkA) tathA tyasa varapara basobAsa garneharUlAI saceta garna saka | ra, jo Akhirata mAthi ImAna rAkhdachan tinIharU yasa granthamA pani ImAna rAkhdachan | ra, tinIharU AphnA namAjaharUko rakSA gardachan |

ra, tyobhandA ThUlo anyAyI ko holA jasale allAhamAthi mithyA Aropa lagAu~cha vA AphUmAthi vahya Aeko cha bhanne dAvI garcha jabaki tyasamAthi kunai prakAzanA avatarita gariekai hu~daina ra jasale “allAhale avataraNa gareko granthajhaiM ma pani avatarita garI dekhAidinchu” bhancha? kaThai, tyo samaya timIle dekhna pAune bhae jaba atyAcArIharU mRtyuvedanAmA hunechan ra phariztAharU AphnA hAta phailAu~dai bhannechan “tyAga AphnA prANaharU! Aja allAhaviruddha asatya kurA bhanekAle ra unakA AyataharUkA bAremA uddaNDatA dekhAekAle timIharUlAI apamAnajanaka yAtanA diinecha |”

(allAhale bhannechan) timIharU eklA–eklai hAmIsamakSa upasthita bhaekA chau jasarI timIharUlAI zurumA hAmIle sRSTi garekA thiyauM | ra, hAmIle timIharUlAI je pradAna garekA thiyauM tyo AphUpachi choDera Ayau ra hAmIle timrA tI siphArizakartAharUlAI pani dekhirahekA chainauM jasalAI timIharUle Aphno viSayamA hAmro samakakSI ThAnekA thiyau | timIharUko sampUrNa sambandha viccheda bhayo ra juna dAvI timIharU garthyau tI sabai gume |

allAhale nai annakA dAnA tathA khajurako geDAlAI aMkurita pArchan | unaile nirjIvabATa sajIvalAI tathA sajIvabATa nirjIvalAI nikAlchan | yI sampUrNa kAryaharU garne allAha hu~dA hu~dai katA bahakiMdaichau?

unI bihAnI lyAu~chan | unale nai rAtalAI vizrAmako samaya banAe ra unale nai sUrya tathA candramAlAI gantIko mAdhyama banAe | yI sabai unai zaktizAlI tathA sarvajJale nirdhArita garekA vidhIharU hun |
ra, unai hun jasale timIharUkAlAgi tArAharUlAI sthala tathA jalakA andhakAraharUmA mArga pattAlagAune sAdhana banAe | ra, jJAnIharUkAlAgi hAmIle nizAnIharUbAre prasTasa~ga bayAna garidiekA chauM |
ra, unai hun jasale timIharUlAI euTai jyAnabATa sRSTi gare ani sabaikAlAgi euTA basne ThAu~ ra euTA sumpine ThAu~ cha | ra, hAmIle vivekazIlakAlAgi nizAnIharUbAre prasTasa~ga bayAna garekA chauM |

ra, unai hun jasale AkAzabATa pAnI barsAe | tyasapachi hAmIle tyasabATa dherai kisimakA banaspatiharu ubjAyauM | ani, hAmIle tyasabATa hariyA ghA~sapAta tathA rukha–viruvAharU ubjAyauM jasabATa jhuppAkA jhuppA dAnAharU paidA bhae; tyastai khajurakA gAbhAharUbATa jhuNDiekA jhuppAkA jhuppA khajura | ani aMgura, jaitUna tathA anArako bagaiMcA banAyauM jasakA phalaharU kehI eka arkAsa~ga mildAjuldA ra kehI bhinna bhinna pani chan | sabaikA phala hera jaba tI phalchan ra jaba tI pAkchan | nissandeha yasamA AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |

ra, tinIharUle jinnaharUlAI allAhasa~ga sAjhedAra ThaharAe jabaki allAhale nai tinIharUko sRSTi garekA hun | ra, tinIharUle binA jJAna allAhakA chorAchorI ThaharAe | unI pavitra tathA ucca chan tinIharUle bhanirahekA kurAharUbATa |
unI AkAzaharU evaM pRthvIkA AviSkAraka hun | unako kunai choro kasarI huna sakcha jabaki unako kohI patnI chaina? sampUrNa cija unaile utpatti garekA hun ra unI sabai cija jAndachan |
unai allAha timrA pAlanakartA hun | unIbAheka kohI upAsya chaina | unI sabai cijakA racayitA hun | ataH timIharU unakai dAsatva svIkAra gara ra unI sabai cijakA vyavasthApaka hun |
dRSTiharUle unalAI pAuna sakdainan tara unale dRSTiharUlAI pAuchan ra unI sUkSmadarzI evaM saceta chan |

nizcaya nai timIharUsamakSa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa pramANaharU AisakekA chan | ani viveka prayoga garnele AphaiMlAI phAidA puryAunecha ani andho bannele AphaiMlAI hAni puryAunecha | ma timIharUkAlAgi saMrakSaka hoina |

ra, yasaigarI hAmI AphnA pramANaharU vibhinna zailImA peza garchauM ra yasa kAraNale garchau ki tinI (kAphira) harule bhanUn (he muhammada sa.) timIle sikera AekAchau ra yasakAraNale ki jJAnI mAncheharUkAlAgi hAmI yasalAI spaSTa pArauM |
(he sandeSTA!) tyasa vahyako anusaraNa gara juna timro pAlanakartAbATa timImAthi avatarita garieko cha | unIbAheka kohI upAsya chaina | ra, bahudevavAdIharUlAI bevAstA gara |
