yadi allAhale cAheko bhae tinIharUle zirka garne thienan | ani, hAmIle timIlAI tinIharUmAthi saMrakSaka tainAta garekA chainau ra na timI tinIharUmAthi havaldAra nai hau |

yI kAphiraharUle allAhabAheka jasalAi pukArchan tyasalAI gAlI nagara anyathA tinIharUle pani sImA ullaGghana gardai ajJAnatAvaza allAhalAI gAlI garnechan | yasaigarI hAmIle hareka samudAyakolAgi tinIharuko karmalAI zobhanIya banAekA chauM | ani, tinIharU tinakA pAlanakartAkahA~ nai pharkera jAnucha ra taba unale tinIharUlAI tinIharUkA karmabAre batAunechan |

ra, tinIharU allAhako dRDha zapatha khAera bhanchan– yadi tinIharUsamakSa kunai nizAnI Ayo bhane tinIharUle avazya tyasamAthi ImAna lyAunechan | bhanideU– “nizAnIharU allAhakahA~ nai chan |” ra, (he AsthAvAnaharU ho!) timIharUlAI ke thAhA nizAnIharU Au~dA pani tinIharUle ImAna lyAune chainan |
ra, hAmI tinIharUkA hRdaya tathA A~khAharUlAI ulTApAlTI pArnechauM, jasto ki tinIharUle pahilo palTa ImAna lyAenan | ra, hAmI tinIharUlAI tinako uddaNDatAmA nai barAlina choDidinchauM |

ra, yadi hAmIle tinIharUmAthi phariztAharU avatarita garidieko bhae ani mRtaharUle tinIharUsa~ga kurAkAnI pani garekA bhae ani hAmIle tinIharUsAmu sampUrNa cija ekatrita garidieko bhae pani tinIharUle ImAna lyAune thienan yadi allAhale nai cAhekA bhae beglai kurA thiyo | tara, tinIharUmadhye adhikatama ajJAnI chan |

ra, yasarI nai hAmIle pratyeka sandeSTAkolAgi manuSya tathA jinnaharu madhyekA zaitAnaharUlAI zatru banAekA thiyauM jasale eka arkAlAI kapaTapUrNa kurAharUko parAmarza diera dhokA dine garthe | yadi timrA pAlanakartAle cAhekA bhae tinIharUle tyasto garne thienan | ataH tinIharU ra tinIharukA SaDyantraharUlAI bevAstA gara |

ra yasa kAraNale pani ki AkhiratamAthi AsthA narAkhneharUko manamastiSkaharU tinIharUtarpha nai AkarSita houn ra yinIharU tyasaimA khuzI rahUn tathA tinIharUle garne kAmaharUmA yinIharU pani lipta hoUn |

ani ke ma allAhabAheka arU kunai nyAyakartA khojU~ jaba ki unale nai timIharUmAthi vistRta grantha avatarita garekA chan? ra, jasalAI hAmIle grantha (taurAta) pradAna garekA thiyauM tyo timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa nyAyasaMgata DhaMgale avatarita garieko ho bhanera tinIharUlAI thAhA cha | ataH timI kadApi zaMkAluharUmadhye nabana |
ra, timro pAlanakartAko kurA satya tathA nyAyapUrNa cha | unakA AdezaharUlAI kasaile pani parivartana garna sakdaina | ra, unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

(he muhammada (sa.)!) dhartImA basobAsa garirahekA adhikAMza mAnisaharU anusAra hiMDyau bhane tinIharUle timIlAI allAhako mArgabATa haTAunechan | tinIharU mAtra kapolakalpita kurAtarpha lAgchan ra aDakalabAjI garchan |
nissandeha timrA pAlanakartA Aphno mArgabATa pathabhraSTa huneharUsita rAmrarI avagata chan, ra unI mArgadarzana pAekAharUlAI pani rAmrarI jAndachan |
ra, timIharU unakA AyataharUmAthi ImAna rAkhchau bhane mAtra allAhako nAma uccAraNa gariekA janAvara khAU |

ani ke kAraNale timIharU tI janAvaraharU khAdainau jasamA allAhako nAma uccAraNa garieko cha jabaki allAhale tI sabai janAvaraharUko vivaraNa spaSTa rUpamA timIharUlAI batAisakekA chan juna timIharUkAlAgi niSedhita cha | yo beglai kurA ho ki timIharU niSedhitako lAgi bAdhyatAko sthitimA puga | ra, adhikAMza mAnisaharU yastA chan jo ajJAnatAmA AphnA nikRSTa cAhanAle arUlAI bahakAirahekA chan | nissandeha timrA pAlanakartA sImA ullaGghanakArIharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |
ra, timIharU dRzya tathA adRzya pApaharUlAI tyAga | jasale pApa garchan tinIharUle cA~Dai nai AphUle garekA pApaharUko sajAya~ pAunechan |

juna janAvaramAthi (vadha gardA) allAhako nAma uccAraNa garieko chaina tyo nakhAU; yaso garnu avajJA hunecha | nissandeha zaitAnaharUle AphnA sAthIharUko hRdayamA yo kurA hAlchan tAki tinIharU timIharUsa~ga jhagaDA garUn | ra, yadi timIharUle tinIharUko anuzaraNa garyau bhane timIharU avazya nai bahudevavAdI hunechau |

tyo vyakti jo pahile mUrdA thiyo ra hAmIle usalAI jIvita tulyAyauM ani tyasakolAgi ujyAlo pAryauM jasale gardA U mAnisaharU bIca Avata jAvata garcha, ke tyasto vyakti tyasa andhakArabATa niskanai nasakne vyakti jasto huna sakcha? yasarI nai kAphiraharUkAlAgi tinale garne garekA kAryaharUlAI zobhanIya banAiekA chan |

ra, yasarI hAmIle hareka gAu~mA ThUla–ThUlA aparAdhIharu lagAidiekA chauM ki tinIharUle tyahA~ SaDyantra garUn | tara tinIharU AphaiMviruddha SaDyantra garchan tara tinIharUlAI yasako anubhUti hudaina |

ra, tinIharUsamakSa kunai Ayata Au~dA tinIharU bhanchan– “hAmI kadApi ImAna lyAu~dainauM jabasamma hAmIlAI pani tyastai cija pradAna gariMdaina jasto allAhakA rasUlaharUlAI pradAna garieko thiyo |” allAhale kasalAI Aphno sandeSTA banAune bhanne sambandhamA unI svayaM rAmrarI jAndachan | nissandeha aparAdhIharUle tinIharukA SaDyantrale gardA allAhakahA~ apamAna evaM kaThora yAtanA bhognu parnecha |

ani jasalAI allAhale satmArga dekhAuna cAhanchan tyasako chAtilAI islAmakAlAgi kholdachan, ra allAha jasalAI pathabhraSTa pArna cAhanchan tyasako chAtilAI saGkucita evaM saMkIrNa tulyAu~dachan, mAnau tyo AkAzatarpha uklirahekocha | yasarI nai allAha tI mAnisaharUmAthi (anAsthAko) phohora thupAridinchan jo ImAna lyAudainan |
ra yo timro pAlanakartA ko bilkula sIdhA mArga ho, nizcaya nai hAmIle upadeza grahaNa garne vyaktiharuko lAgi vistRta rupamA bayAna garidiekA chau~ |
tinIharUkAlAgi tinakA pAlanakartAkahA~ zAntigRha raheko cha, ra allAha tinIharUle garne gareko ThIka vyavahArale gardA tinIharuko saMrakSaka mitra hunechan |

ra, juna dina unI (allAhale) tinIharU sabai (jinna evaM mAnava) lAI ekatrita pArnechan ra, (bhannechan)– “he jinnaharUko samudAya! timIharUle mAnisaharUbATa dherailAI Aphno (sahayogI) banAyau |” ani, mAnisaharUmadhyekA tinIharukA mitraharUle bhannechan–“he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmI eka arkobATa khubai lAbhAnvita bhayauM ra (antataH) tyasa samayamA AipugekA chauM juna timIle hAmrolAgi nizcita garekA thiyau |” unI bhannechan– “timIharUko bAsasthAna naraka ho; sadA tyasamai rahanechau | ho, allAhale nai cAhe bhane beglai kurA ho | nissandeha timrA pAlanakartA tatvadarzI evaM sarvajJa chan |”
ra, yasarI nai hAmI atyAcArIharUle garne garekA kukarmale gardA tinIharUlAI eka arkAko sahayogI banAidinchauM |

he jinna tathA manuSyakA jamAta ho! ke timIharUsamakSa timIharUmadhyebATa rasUlaharU Aenan jasale timIharUlAI merA AyataharU sunAune garthe ra yasa dinako sAkSAtkArabATa timIharUlAI sAvadhAna garne garthe? tinIharUle bhannechan– “hAmI svayaM AphaiMviruddha sAkSI chauM |” ra, (nizcaya nai) tinIharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanale dhokAmA pAreko thiyo | ani tinIharU kAphira thie bhanera tinIharUle AphaiMviruddha sAkSI dinechan |
(he muhammada sa.!) yo kArya garnuko uddezya ke cha bhane timrA ‘raba’ nagaraharUlAI atyAcArapUrNa tarikAle naSTa pArne chainan, jaba ki tyasakA bAsindAharU anabhijJa hoUn |
ra, sabai mAnisaharUkAlAgi tinIharukA karma anusAra darjAharU chan | ra, tinIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUbATa timrA pAlanakartA anabhijJa chainan |

ra, timrA pAlanakartA nispRha tathA dayAlu chan | unale cAhemA timIharUlAI sakhApa pArnechan ra jasalAI cAhanechan timro sthAnamA pratisthApita garnechan jasarI unale timIharUko utpatti anya samudAyako vaMzabATa gare |
timIharUsita vAcA garieko (dina) nizcaya nai Aunecha | ra, allAhalAI vivaza pArne sAmarthya timIharUmA chaina |

ra, (he muhammada sa.) bhanideU– “he merA jAtibandhuharu ho! timIharU Aphno sthAnamA karma gara ma Aphnai karma garchu | ani paralokamA uttama bAsasthAna kasako hunecha bhanne kurA cA~Dai nai thAhA pAunechau |” nissandeha atyAcArIharU kahilyai saphala hune chainan |

ra, yinIharU allAhakolAgi unaile sRSTi garekA khetI evaM pazumA aMza nirdhArita garchan ani AphnA vicAra anusAra bhanchan– “yo allAhakAlAgi ra yo hAmIle ThaharAekA sAjhedAraharUkAlAgi raheko cha | ani yinIharUle ThaharAekA sAjhedAraharUko aMzabATa allAhasamma kehI pugdaina tara allAhakAlAgi nirdhArita aMza cAhi~ tinIharUle ThaharAekA sAjhedAraharUsamma pugcha | kati nikRSTa phaisalA garchan yinIharU!

ra, yasaigarI dheraijaso bahudevavAdIharUkAlAgi tinIharUle ThaharAekA sAjhedAraharUle tinakA santAnalAI hatyA garne kAryalAI zobhanIya banAidiekA chan tAki tinIharUko vinAza hos ra tinIharukAnimti tinIharUko dharmalAI barbAda pArun | ra, allAhale cAheko bhae tinIharUle tyasto garne thienan | ataH choDideU tinIharUlAI ra tinIharUle garne mithyAropaNalAI |

ra, tinIharU Aphno kalpanAko bharamA yo pani bhanchan– “yI pazuharU tathA khetI sabaikAlAgi niSedhita cha, jasalAI hAmI cAhanchauM usale mAtra yo khAna sakcha | ani, kehI pazuharU yastA chan jasako piThayu~ko prayoga abaidha garieko cha |” ra, kehI tyastA janAvaraharU pani chan jasamAthi allAhako nAma uccAraNa gardainan | yI sabai allAhaviruddha raciekA kurAharU hun | unI cA~Dai nai tinIharUbATa tinakA mithyAropaNako badalA dinechan |

ra, tinIharU yo pani bhanchan– “juna baccA yI pazuharUkA garbhamA chan tI kevala hAmrA puruSaharUkAlAgi chan ra hAmrA strIharUkAlAgi avaidha chan | ra, yadi tyo mRta avasthAmA janmancha bhane tinIharU (puruSa ra mahilA) sabai tyasamA sAmela hunechan |” cA~Dai nai allAhale tinIharUlAI tinakA managaDhante kurAharUko badalA dinechan | nissandeha unI tatvadarzI evaM sarvajJa chan |

nissandeha tinIharU ghATAmA chan jasale ajJAnatA evaM mUrkhatAle gardA AphnA santAnaharUko hatyA gare ra allAhaviruddha mithyAropaNa garI unale pradAna garekA khAdya sAmagrIlAI avaidha ThaharyAe | nissandeha tinIharU pathabhraSTa bhae ra sIdhA mArga pAuna sakenan |

ani, allAha nai hun jasale bagaiMcAharU banAe, kehI laharA bhaekA tathA kehI laharA nabhaekA ra khajura evaM khetI jasabATa vibhinna svAdakA khAdyAnnaharU prApta hunchan ra tyastai jaituna evaM anAra pani, juna eka arkAsa~ga mildAjuldA pani hunchan ra bhinna pani | jaba tI phalchan taba timIharU tyasako phala khAU ra kATne dina unako aMza (jakAta) cuktA gara, ani apabyaya nagara | nissandeha allAha apabyaya garneharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |

ra, allAhale janAvaraharUmA kehI (ThUlA) bhArI bokne paidA gare ra kehI bhUmimA lAgekA (sAnA AkArako) pani | allAhale pradAna garekA khAdya sAmagrIharUmadhyebATa khAU | tara zaitAnakA padacinhaharUko anusaraNa nagara | nizcaya nai tyo timIharUko khullama–khullA zatru ho |

ATha prakArakA bhAle pothIharU chan; duIvaTA bheDAmadhyebATa, duIvaTA bAkhrAmadhye bATa | (he nabI sa.!) sodha, allAhale yinakA bhAle varjita garekA chan ki pothI, vA tyo bhrUNa juna bheDI ra bAkhrIharUkA garbhamA chan? yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane Thosa jJAnakAsAtha batAU |

ani, U~TabATa duIvaTA ra gAIbATa duIvaTA | sodha, duvaikA bhAleharUlAI varjita garekA chan vA duvaikA pothIharUlAI vA duvaikA garbhamA rahekA baccAharulAI? ke timIharU tyasa samayamA upasthita thiyau jaba allAhale timIharUlAI yasako Adeza diekA thie? ani, tyobhandA ThUlo atyAcArI aru ko huna sakcha jasale binAjJAna mAnisalAI pathabhraSTa garna allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garchan? nizcaya nai allAha atyAcArIharUlAI mArgadarzana gardainan |

bhanideU– “jo vahya mamAthi bhaeko cha tyasamA ma kunai pani yasto cija pAu~dina juna khAnevAlAko lAgi avaidha hos, sivAya mRta janAvara vA bageko ragata vA suMgurako mAsu; kAraNa nizcaya nai yI sabai apavitra chan, vA avajJA gariMdai allAhabAheka arU kasaiko nAma uccAraNa garI vadha garieko janAvara hos | parantu, kasaile avajJAkArI vA sImAullaGghanakArI nabhaI (khAna) vivaza bhayo bhane nizcaya nai timrA pAlanakartA ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |”

ani, yahUdIharUkA lAgi hAmIle hareka naGgrAdhArI janAvaraharUlAI avaidha ThaharyAyauM ra gAI tathA bAkhrAko boso pani tinIharUkAlAgi hAmIle avaidha ThaharyAekA thiyauM, sivAya tinakA piThyU~ vA AndrAmA TA~siekA vA haDDImA misieko boso | yo pratiphala hAmIle tinIharukA uddaNDatAko kAraNale diekA thiyauM | ra, hAmI nai satyavAdI hauM |
ra, aba yadi tinIharUle timIlAI jhuTho ThAnchan bhane, bhana timrA pAlanakartA apAra dayAlu chan | tara, aparAdhIharUbATa unako yAtanAlAI TArna sakiMdaina |

bahudevavAdIharUle bhannechan– “yadi allAhale cAheko bhae na hAmIle sAjhedAra ThaharyAune thiyauM na hAmrA purkhAharule nai ra na hAmIle kunai cijalAI avaidha ThaharyAune thiyauM |” yasabhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUle pani yasarI nai jhuTho Thahara garekA thie | antataH tinIharUle hAmro yAtanAko svAda cAkhe | bhanideU– “ke timIharUsa~ga kunai jJAna cha? cha bhane hAmIsamakSa prastuta gara | timIharU ta kevala bhramako anusaraNa garchau ra aDkala mAtra garchau |”
bhanideU– “satyasamma pugne nirNAyaka tarka ta allAhakahA~ cha | unale cAhemA vAstavamA nai timIharU sabailAI satmArgamA DoryAune thie |”

bhanideU– “bolAU AphnA sAkSIharUlAI jasale yasa kurAko sAkSI diUn ki allAhale nai yI cijaharUlAI avaidha ThaharyAekA chan |” ani yadi tinIharUle sAkSI die bhane timI cAhi~ tinIharUlAI sAkSI nadinu | ra, timI tI mAnisaharUkA icchAharUko anusaraNa nagarnU jasale hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara gardachan ra jo paralokamA AsthA rAkhdainan sAthai AphnA pAlanakartAko samakakSI pani banAu~chan |

bhanideU– “AU ma timIharUlAI tyo paDhera sunAu~chu juna timrA pAlanakartAle timro lAgi avaidha garekA chan | tI hun - “kunai pani cijalAI unako sAjhedAra nabanAunU, ra mAtApitAsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra garnU, ra nirdhanatAko Darale AphnA santAnako hatyA nagarnU, kinabhane timIharUlAI ra unIharUlAI pani hAmI nai jIvikA pradAna garchau | ani, azlIla kurAharUko najika pani najAnU, cAhe tyo dRzya hos vA adRzya, ra kunai yasto jIvako hatyA nagarnU jasako hatyA allAhale avaidha garekAchan; nyAyasaMgata hatyAbAheka | yI kurAharU hun jasako nirdezana unale diekAchan | AzA cha ki timIharU viveka prayoga garnechau |”

ra, TuhurAharUko sampattiko najika najAU; sivAya rAmro tarikAle yahA~samma ki U vayaska avasthAmA pugos | ra, nApataula pUrNa nyAyasaMgata DhaGgale gara | hAmI kunai pani vyaktimAthi usako sAmarthya bhandA baDhi jimmevArI diMdainauM | ra, kasaiko bAremA kunai TikA TippaNI gardA nyAyakA sAtha gara cAhe tyo timro nAtedAra nai kina nahos | ra, allAhasa~gako pratijJA pUrA gara | allAha timIharUlAI yI kurAharUko nirdezana dinchan tAki timIharU upadeza grahaNa gara |

ra, yo ki– “yahI nai mero sIdhA mArga ho | timIharU yasaiko anusaraNa gara, ra anya mArgaharUko anusaraNa nagara kinabhane tyasale timIharUlAI unako mArgabATa vicalita garidinecha | (allAha) timIharUlAI yI kurAharUko nirdezana dinchan tAki timIharU pathabhraSTatAbATa bacna saka |”

ani hAmIle mUsAlAI grantha pradAna garyauM juna bhalAiko nIti apanAuneharUkAlAgi pUrNa ra hareka cijako sabistAra vivaraNa thiyo, ani mArgadarzana tathA dayA thiyo, tAki tinIharUle AphnA pAlanakartAsita bheTa hune kurAmA ImAna lyAUn |
ra, yo grantha (kuraAna majIda) pani hAmIlenai avatarita garekA hauM juna barakatayukta (maGgalamaya) raheko cha | ataH yasako anusaraNa gara ra Izabhaya rAkha tAki timIharUmAthi dayA gariyos |

tAki– “hAmIbhandA pahile duIvaTA samUhamAthi mAtra grantha avatarita bhaeko thiyo” bhanne kurA timIharU bhanna nasaka ani unIharU ke paDhchan–paDhAu~chan bhanne bAremA hAmI anabhijJa thiyauM (bhanne kurA nabhana) |

vA yo bhanna pAune chainau ki yadi hAmImAthi pani grantha avatarita bhaeko bhae hAmI tinIharUbhandA baDhI satmArgamA hune thiyauM | la, aba timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa pramANa, mArgadarzana evaM dayA Aipugeko cha | ani tyasabhandA ThUlo atyAcArI aru ko huna sakcha jasale allAhakA AyataharUlAI jhuTho ThaharAu~chan ra tyasabATa vimukha hunchan? jo jo hAmrA AyataharUbATa vimukha hunchan tinIharUlAI yasa vimukha hune kAryako badalA kaThora yAtanA dinechauM |

ke aba mAnisaharU yasako pratIkSAmA chan ki tinIharUsamakSa phariztAharU AUn vA timrA ‘raba’ svayaM AipugUn vA timrA ‘raba’ kA kehI nizAnIharU sAmunne prakaTa hoUn? juna dina timrA pAlanakartAkA kehI nizAnIharUko Agamana huncha tyasa dina yo ImAna lyAune kAryale pahile ImAna nalyAeko vA ImAna lyAI puNyakarma nagareko vyaktilAI kunai phAidA dine chaina | bhanideU– “timIharU pani pratIkSA gara; hAmI pani pratIkSA gardaichauM |”

jasa jasale Aphno dharmalAI vikhaNDita tulyAe ra vibhinna sampradAyamA vibhAjita bhae tinIharUsa~ga timro kunai sarokAra chaina; tinIharUko mAmilA allAha samakSa rahekocha | ani tinIharUlAI tinIharUle garne kAryaharUbAre allAhale nai avagata garAunechan |

jo (allAhakahA~) puNyakarma liera Aunecha usalAI tyasako dasaguNA puNya prApta hunecha ra jasale kukarma liera Aunecha usalAI kevala tyasa barAbarakai sajAya~ hunecha ra tinIharUprati anyAya garine chaina |
bhanideU– “malAI merA pAlanakartAle sIdhA mArga dekhAekA chan; bilakula ThIka juna ibrAhImako mArga thiyo; jasalAI unale dattacitta bhaI apanAekA thie | ra, unI muzrikaharUmadhyekA thienan |
bhanideU– “mero namAja, mero samasta bhaktiharU, mero jIvana tathA mero maraNa sabai kevala allAha; sampUrNa saMsArakA pAlanakartAkai lAgi hun |
unako kohI sAjhedAra chaina | ra, malAI yahI Adeza prApta bhaekocha | ra, sarvaprathama AtmasamarpaNa garne mai hu~ |”

bhanideU– “ke ma allAhabAheka kunai anya pAlanakartA khojU~ jabaki unI hareka cijakA pAlanakartA hun?” ra, pratyeka vyaktile je jati kamAu~cha usako bhAgIdAra Aphai huncha | ra, kunai pani bhArI boknele arU kasaiko bhArI bokne chaina | ani timIharU timrA pAlanakartAtarpha nai pharkanucha | ani juna juna kurAmA timIharU matabheda gardaithyau tyo unale timIharUlAI batAunechan |

ra, unai hun jasale timIharUlAI dhartIkA uttarAdhikArI banAe ra timIharUmadhye kehIlAI anya kehImAthi ucca darjA pradAna gare, tAki jejati unale diekA chan tyasamA timIharUko parIkSA liUn | nissandeha timrA pAlanakartA zIghra nai sajAya~ dinevAlA chan ra unI kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu pani chan |
alipha0 lAma0 mIma0 sAda0

yo grantha juna timItarpha avatarita garieko cha, yasale gardA timro mana saMkucita nahos, yasako avataraNako uddezya yo cha ki timIle yasadvArA (anAsthAvAdIharUlAI) DarAU ra yo AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi upadeza ho |

(he mAnava ho!) juna grantha timrA ‘raba’ dvArA timIharUtarpha avataraNa garieko cha tyasako anusaraNa gara, ra unIbAheka anya kunai saMrakSaka–mitraharUko anusaraNa nagara | tara timIharU kamai upadeza svIkAra gardachau |
ra, katipaya bastIharU chan jasalAI hAmIle vinaSTa pAryauM | tinIharUmAthi hAmro prakopa yA ta rAtako samayamA Ayo yA aparAnhako samayamA jaba tinIharU vizrAma garihekAthie |
ra, jaba hAmro prakopa tinIharUmAthi Aipugyo taba tinIharUko mukhabATa ‘vAstavamA hAmI atyAcArI thiyauM’ bhannubAheka kehI pani niskena |
ani hAmIle jasakahA~ sandeSTAharU paThAiekA thie tinIharUlAI avazya nai sodhnechauM ra hAmIle nizcaya nai sandeSTAharUlAI pani sodhnechauM |
ani hAmI pUrNa jAnakArIkA sAtha tinIharUkA sArA vRttAnta bayAna garnechauM ra hAmI kahIM gAyaba raheko chainau~ |
ra, tyo dina taula ThIkasa~ga hunecha | ani jasako (satkarmako) pallA gahana hunecha tinIharU nai saphala hunechan |
ra, jasako pallA halukA hunecha tinIharU nai svayaMlAI ghATAmA pArneharU hun kinabhane tinIharU hAmrA AyataharUsa~ga anyAyapUrNa vyavahAra garne garthe |
ra, hAmIle nai timIharUlAI dhartImA adhikArakAsAtha basAyauM ra tyasamA timIharUkAlAgi jIvana–sAmagrI banAyauM | tara, timIharU kamai kRtajJatA dekhAu~chau |
hAmIle timro saMracanA garyau~ tyasapachi timro rUpa banAyauM ani phariztAharulAI bhanyauM– “AdamalAI sajdA gara |” taba iblIsa bAheka sabaile sajdA gare | U sajdA garneharUmA sammilita bhaena |

una (allAha)le bhane– “jaba maile timIlAI Adeza die~ ta kuna cijale timIlAI sajdA garnabATa rokyo?” usale javApha diyo– “ma UbhandA zreSTha chu, malAI timIle agnibATa sRjanA garekA chau ra usalAI mATobATa sRjanA garekA chau |”
una (allAha) le bhane– “timI yahA~bATa orla | kinabhane timIlAI yahA~ ghamaNDa garne kunai adhikAra chaina | ataH niskihAla; timI apamAnita huneharu madhyekA hau |”
usa (iblIsa) le bhanyo– “malAI tyasadinasammako avasara pradAna gara jaba mAnisaharU uThAinechan |”
una (allAha) le bhane– “timIlAI avasara diiyo |”
ani usa (iblIsa) le bhanyo– “jasarI timIle malAI pathabhraSTa pArekA chau ma pani yinIharUko ghAtamA timro sIdhA mArgamA basnechu |”
“tyasapachi ma tinIharUlAI agADibATa, pachADibATa, dAyA~bATa ani bAyA~bATa ghernechu ra timIle tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzalAI kRtajJa pAune chainau |”
una (allAha) le bhane– “yahA~bATa apamAnita tathA dhikkArita bhaera niska! tinIharUmadhye ja–jasale timro anusaraNa garchan; avazya nai ma timIharU sabaidvArA narakalAI bharnechu |”
ra, he Adama! timI ra timrI patnI duvai svargamA basa ra jahA~bATa je cAhanchau aghAuJjela khAU tara yo bRkSa najika najAnU, anyathA timIharU atyAcArI Thaharinechau |

ani iblIsa duvailAI bahakAuna thAlyo tAki duvaikA guptAGgaharUlAI jo duvaibATa chopiekA thie, kholI deos | ra, bhanna thAlyo– “timIharUlAI timrA pAlanakartAle yasa vRkSabATa manAhI garekA chainan parantu yasa kAraNale mAtra ki timIharU duvai phariztA banne chau vA amaratva prApta garnechau |”
ra, duvaisamakSa usale kasama khA~dai bhanyo ki ma nizcaya nai timro saccA hitaiSI hu~ |

ani usale duvailAI chalako jAlamA phasAyo ra jaba duvaile bRkSako phala cAkhe taba duvaikA guptAGgaharU eka arkAsamakSa ughrie ani duvaile svargakA pAtaharUdvArA Aphno zarIralAI chopna thAle | tyasapachi duvaikA pAlanakartAle pukAre– “ke maile timIharUlAI tyasa bRkSabATa rokeko thiina~? ra, nizcita rUpamA zaitAna timIharUko khullama khullA zatru ho bhanI timIharUlAI bhaneko thiina~?”
duvaile bhane– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIle AphUmAthi atyAcAra garyauM | aba yadi timIle hAmIlAI kSamA pradAna garenau ra hAmImAthi dayA garenau bhane nizcaya nai hAmI barabAda hunechauM |”
allAhale bhane– “timIharU sabai orla! timIharU eka–arkAkA zatru hau ra timIharUkA lAgi dhartImA nizcita avadhisamma bAsasthAna ra jIvikopArjanako sAdhana raheko cha |”
(allAha le) bhane– “dhartImai timIharUle jIvana vyatIta garnucha, tyahIM marnu cha ra tyasai bATa timIharUlAI nikAlinecha |”

he AdamakA santAnaharU ho! hAmIle timIharUkAlAgi yasto pozAka avatarita garekA chauM jasale zarIrakA guptAGgaharUlAI DhAkcha ra jo sajAvaTako sAdhana pani bancha | ra, sababhandA uttama pahirana ta takvA (Izabhaya) ho | yo allAhakA nizAnIharUmadhyeko ho tAki mAnisale upadeza grahaNa garUn |

he AdamakA santAnaharU ho! zaitAnale timIharUlAI tyasarI nai parIkSAmA napAros jasarI usale timrA bAbuAmAlAI tinIharukA vastra tinIharUbATa khosadai svargabATa niSkAsita garAeko thiyo tAki usale duvailAI eka–arkAko guptAGga dekhAos | U ra usakA sAthIharUle timIharUlAI juna ThAu~bATa herchan tyahA~bATa timIle unIharUlAI dekhna sakdainau | hAmIle zaitAnalAI tinIharukA saMrakSaka–mitra banAekA chauM jo ImAna lyAu~dainan |

yinIharU jaba kunai azlIla kArya garchan taba yinIharU bhandachan– “hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI yastai gardai Aeko pAekA chauM ra allAhale nai hAmIharUlAI yasto garne Adeza diekA chan |” bhanideU– “allAha kadApi azlIlatAko Adeza diMdainan | ke timIharU allAhaviruddha tyasto kurA garchau jasako timIharUlAI jJAna nai chaina?”

he sandeSTA! bhanideU– “merA pAlanakartAle malAI nyAya garne Adeza diekA chan | ra, unako Adeza yo pani ho ki timIharU hareka namAjamA muhAra sIdhA (kiblAko dizAmA) rAkha, ra AjJApAlanalAI unakAlAgi viziSTa garera unailAI pukAra | jasarI unale timIharUko sRjanA gare tyasarI nai timIharU pheri pharkera Aune chau |”

euTA samUhalAI allAhale satmArga dekhAe ra arko samUhamAthi pathabhraSTatA siddha bhayo | tinIharUle allAhalAI choDI zaitAnalAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAekA chan | tara tinIharU svayaMlAI satmArgI bhanne ThAndachan |
he AdamakA santAnaharU ho! hareka upAsanAko belAmA sundara pozAka dhAraNa gara | ra, khAnapIna gara tara apavyaya nagara, kinabhane unI apavyayIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |

sodha– “allAhale AphnA upAsakaharUkAlAgi sRSTi gareko saundarya evaM zuddha khAdyapadArthalAI kasale avaidha garyo?” bhanideU– “yI ImAna lyAuneharUkAlAgi sAMsArika jIvanamA chadaicha ra vizeSa rupamA mahApralayako dina unIharUkAlAgi mAtra rahanecha |” yasarI nai hAmI AphnA AyataharU jJAnavAnaharUkAlAgi spaSTasa~ga bayAna garchau |

bhanideU– “merA pAlanakartAle avaidha garekA chan– azlIlatAkA kAryaharU cAhe tI dRzya hun vA adRzya, pApa, anAhakamA atyAcAra ra yo ki kasailAI allAhako sAjhedAra banAU jasako bAremA unale kunai pramANa nai avatarita garekA chainan ra yo ki allAhako bAremA timIharu yasto kurA bhana jasako timIharUlAI kunai jJAna nai chaina |”
ra, hareka samudAyakonimti euTA samaya avadhI nizcita cha | unIharUko tyo myAda pUrA bhaepachi tinIharu na eka chinako lAgi pachADi haTna sakne chan ra na agADi nai baDhna sakne chan |

he AdamakA santAnaharU ho! timIharUsamakSa timIharUmadhyebATa IzadUtaharU Aera merA zlokaharU sunAemA jasale Izabhaya rAkhchan ra AphUmA sudhAra lyAu~dachan unIharukolAgi na kunai bhaya hunecha ra na unIharU duHkhI nai hunechan |
ra, jasale hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI jhuTho ThaharAunechan ra tinako bevAstA gardai ghamaNDa garnechan tinIharU narakabAsI hun jahA~ tinIharU sadA rahanechan |

ataH tI byaktIharu bhandA ThUlo atyAcArI ko huna sakchan jasale allAhaviruddha mithyAropaNa garchan vA unakA AyataharUlAI jhuTho Thahara garchan? yastA mAnisaharUle Aphno bhAgyamA lekhie anusAra pAirahanechan yahA~samma ki tyo samaya Aipugcha jaba hAmrA phariztAharU tinIharuko prANa lina Aipugnechan ani sodhnechan– “kahA~ chan tinIharU jasalAI timIharU allAhalAI choDera pukArne garthyau?” javApha dinechan– “hAmIbATa tinIharU harAe |” ra, tinIharU kAphira hun bhanera AphaiMviruddha sAkSI dinechan |

ani allAha bhanchan– “timIharU pani AphUbhandA pahile bitekA jinna tathA mAnavakA samUhaharUsa~ga narakamA jAU |” pratyeka samUha narakamA praveza gardA AphUbhandA pahilekA samUhalAI dhikkArnechan yahA~samma ki jaba sabai tyasamA ekatrita hunechan hareka pachillA samUhale AphUbhandA aghikA samUhako viSayamA bhannechan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! yinIharUle nai hAmIlAI pathabhraSTa garekA thie tasartha yinIharUlAI narakako dobbara yAtanA deU |” allAhale bhannechan– “sabaikAlAgi dobbara nai cha tara timIharUlAI thAhA hudaina |”
ani aghillA samUhaharUle pachillA samUhaharUlAI bhannechan– “timIharUlAI hAmImAthi pradhAnatA prApta thiena?”ani timIharU pani Aphno kriyAkalApako badalAmA yAtanAko svAda cAkha |

jasale hAmrA AyataharUlAI asvIkAra gare ra tinIharulAI bevAstA gardai ghamaNDa gare tinIharUkAlAgi siyoko pvAlabATa U~Ta nachirunjelasamma AkAzakA DhokAharU kholine chainan ra na unIharU svargamA dAkhila huna sakne chan | ra hAmI yasarI nai aparAdhIharulAI badalA dine garchau|
tinIharUkAlAgi ochyAna pani narakako agnikai hunecha ra mAthibATa tyasaiko oDhne pani | ra, hAmI atyAcArIharUlAI yastai sajAya~ dine garchauM |
ani, jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare; hAmI kasailAI pani usako sAmarthya bhandA bar3hI bojha didainauM | tyastai mAnisaharU svargamA jAnechan; tyahA~ tinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan |

ra, unIharUko manamA bhaekA dveSabhAvalAI hAmI bAhira nikAlnechauM | unIharUko talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan ra unIharUle bhannechan– “sArA prazaMsAharu allAhakainimti hun jasale hAmIlAI yahA~ko bATo dekhAe ra allAhale hAmIlAI mArga nadekhAeko bhae hAmIle mArga pAune thienauM |” nissandeha hAmrA pAlanakartAle paThAekA IzadUtaharU satya liera AekA thie | ra, ghoSaNA garinecha– “timIharUle garekA karmaharUko pratiphalasvarUpa timIharU yasa svargako uttarAdhikArI banAiekA chau |”

ani svargakA bAsindAharUle narakakA bAsindAharUlAI pukArera bhannechan– “hAmIle ta hAmrA pAlanakartAle hAmIsita gareko vacanalAI satya pAyauM | ke timIharUle pani timIharUkA pAlanakartAle garekA vacanalAI satya pAyau?” tinIharUle bhannechan– “ho |” ani tinIharUbIca eka udghoSakale ghoSaNA garnecha– “atyAcArIharUmAthi allAhako dhikkAra cha |,,
jo allAhako mArgabATa rokthe ra tyasalAI TeDho pArna khojthe ani Akhiratako dinalAI asvIkAra garthe |”

ani, yI duvai samUhabIca euTA pardA hunecha, ra aarApha (ucAI) mA kehI anya mAnisaharU hunechan jasale harekalAI tinakA lakSaNaharUbATa cinnechan ra svargakA bAsindAharUlAI bolAera bhannechan– “timIharUmAthi zAnti hos!” yadyapi unIharU tyasamA praveza garina nasakeko bhaetApani tyasako pUrNa AzAvAdI rahanechan |
ra, jaba tinIharUko dRSTi narakabAsIharUtarpha pharkAinecha taba tinIharUle bhannechan– “he pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI yI atyAcArIharUmA sAmela nagara |”

ra, arAphavAlAharUle tI mAnisaharUlAI AvAja dinechana jasalAI tinIharukA nizAnIbATa cininechan, bhannechan– “na timIharUko jatthAle kAma diyo ra na timIharUle garne gareko timIharUko ahaMkArale nai |”

(svargabAsIharUtarpha isArA gardai bhanne chan) ke yI nai tinIharU hoinan jasako sambandhamA timIharU kasama khAne garthyau ki allAhale tinIharUlAI Aphno dayAbATa kehI dine chainan? (he AsthAvAnaharU ho!) timIharU svargamA praveza gara | timIharUlAI nakunai bhaya hunecha ra na timIharU duHkhi nai hunechau |

ra, narakabAsIharUle svargabAsIharUsita AvAja dinechan– “hAmItarpha thorai mAtra bhae pani pAnI vA allAhale timIharUlAI pradAna garekA khAdyapadArthaharumadhye kehI paThAu |” unIharUle uttara dinechan– “allAhale yI duvailAI kAphiraharUkAlAgi avaidha garekA chan |

yinIharUle nai Aphno dharmalAI manoraJjana evaM khela tamAsA banAekA thie ra sAMsArika jIvanale bhramamA pAreko thiyo |” ataH Aja hAmI tyasarI nai tinIharUlAI birsanechauM jasarI tinIharUle yasa dinako sAkSatkAralAI birsekA thie ra hAmrA AyataharUlAI jhuTho Thahara garne garthe |
ra, nizcaya nai hAmIle tinIharUsamakSa jJAnako AdhAramA khulasta rUpamA varNana garieko grantha lyAekA chauM juna mArgadarzana evam dayA ho tI mAnisaharUko lAgi jo AsthAvAna chan |

ke yinIharU mAtra tyasako vAstavikatA sAmunne Aos bhanne pratIkSAmA chan? juna dina tyo vAstavikatA sAmunne Aipugnecha pahile dekhi nai tyasako upekSA garneharUle bhannechan– “vAstavamA hAmrA pAlanakartAkA rasUlaharU satya liera AekA thie | ani ke hAmrolAgi kohI siphArizakartAharU chan jasale hAmrolAgi siphAriza garun vA hAmIharUlAI pheri sAMsArika jIvanatarpha pharkAiyos tAki hAmIle yasabhandA pahile gardai gareko kukarma harUko saTTAmA satkarma garauM?” vAstavamA tinIharUle AphaiMlAI ghATAmA pAre ra tinIharUle racekA sArA jhuThaharU tinIharUbATa harAe |

nissandeha timIharUkA pAlanakartA allAha hun jasale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIlAI cha dinamA sRSTi gare ani Aphno siMhAsanamA virAjamAna bhae | unI rAtalAI dinale chopdachan juna rAtako pachADi dauDera Au~cha | ra sUrya, candra ra tArAharU sabai unakai Adezako niyaMtraNamA chan | sAvadhAna! sRSTi unakai ho ra Adeza pani unakai | allAha barakatayukta (maMgalamaya) chan jo sampUrNa jagatkA mAlika hun |
timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAlAI bilaunA gardai ra gopya rUpamA pukArne gara | nissandeha unI sImA ullaGghanakArIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |
ra, dhartImA tyasako sudhAra gariepachi vidhvaMsa namaccAU ani bhaya rAkhdai tathA AzA gardai unailAI pukAra | nissandeha allAhako dayA sukarmIharUko najikai raheko cha |

ra, unai hun jasale Aphno dayA (varSA) bhandA pahile hAvAlAI zubha–sUcanAsvarUpa paThAu~chan | yahA~samma ki jaba tyasale gahruGgA bAdalaharUlAI liera Au~cha taba hAmI tyasalAI euTA mRta bhUmitarpha hA~kera laijAnchauM ani bAdalabATa varSA garAera tyasabATa aneka tharikA phala utpanna garchauM | yasarI nai hAmI mRtaharUlAI (jIvita pArera) nikAlnechauM | AsA cha ki timIharU zikSA grahaNa garnechau |

uttama bhUmibATa tyasakA pAlanakartAko anujJAle khubai banaspati utpanna hunchan ra juna bhUmi kharAba huncha tyasabATa kharAba vastu nai ubjane garcha| hAmI yasarI kRtajJaharUkAlAgi bArambAra AphnA nizAnIharU prastuta gardachau~ |

nizcaya nai hAmIle nUhalAI unako samudAyatarpha paThAyauM | ani unale bhane– “he mero samudAya! allAhako upAsanA gara | unIbAheka timIharUko anya kohI upAsya chaina | ma timIharUmAthi Aune bhayAnaka dinako yAtanAbATa DarAu~chu |”
unako jAtikA aguvAharUle bhane– “hAmI ta timIlAI spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA dekhchauM |”
unale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! mamA kunai prakArako pathabhraSTatA chaina baru ma sampUrNa jagatkA svAmIko sandezavAhaka hu~ |
timIharUlAI AphnA pAlanakartAkA sandeza puryAu~chu ra timIharUko hitaiSI hu~ | ra, malAI allAhako tarphabATa tyo jJAna prApta bhaeko cha juna timIharUlAI chaina |

ke timIharU yasa kurAle cakita bhayau ki timIharUsamakSa timImadhyekai eka vyaktimArphat timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa anusmArikA Aeko cha tAki unale timIharUlAI saceta garUn | ani timIharU Izabhaya grahaNa gara tAki timIharUmAthi dayA gariyos?”

ani tinIharUle unalAI jhuThalAe | antataH hAmIle unI tathA unakA sAthIharUlAI euTA DuMgAmA surakSita garidiyauM ra jasale hAmrA AyataharUlAI jhuTho ThaharAekA thie tinIharUlAI DubAidiyauM | nissandeha tinIharU andhA mAnisaharU thie |
ra, hAmIle Adatarpha unakA bhAi ‘hUda’ lAI paThAyauM | unale bhane– “he merA jAtivandhuharU ho! allAhako upAsanA gara | unIbAheka timIharUko kohI upAsya chaina | ke timIharU DarAu~dainau?”
unakA jAtikA kAphira aguvAharUle bhane– “hAmI timIlAI mUrkhatAgrasta dekhdachauM ra timIlAI jhuThAharUmadhye ThAndachauM |”
unale bhane– “he mero jAtibandhuharU ho! mamA mUrkhatAko kunai kurA chaina, baru ma sampUrNa saMsArakA pAlanakartAko rasUla hu~ |”
timIharUlAI AphnA ‘raba’ ko sandeza puryAu~chu ra timIharUko nAsovAhaka hiteSI hu~ |

ke timIharU yasa kurAle cakita bhayau ki timIharUsamakSa timImadhyekai eka vyaktimArphat timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa anusmArikA Aeko cha tAki unale timIharUlAI Dara dekhAun? ani, smaraNa gara jaba unale timIharUlAI nUhakA santAnapachi uttarAdhikArI niyukta gare ra timIharUlAI khubai hRSTapuSTa banAe | ani allAhakA upakAraharUlAI smaraNa gara tAki timIharU saphala huna saka |

tinIharUle uttara die– “ke timI hAmIsamakSa yasa kAraNale AekA chau ki hAmIharU kevala eka allAhako bhakti garauM ra jasalAI hAmrA pUrvajaharUle pujdai AekA chan tyasalAI chADideauM? yadi timI saccA hau bhane juna yAtanAko dhamkI timI hAmIlAI dinchau, hAmImAthi liera Au |

hUdale bhane– “timIharUmAthi timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa yAtanA evaM krodha nizcita bhaisakeko cha | ke timIharU masa~ga yastA nAmaharUko bAremA vAdavivAda garchau juna timIharU ra timrA pUrvajaharUle racekA chan jasakAlAgi allAhale kunai pramANa avataraNa garekai chainan? ani, timIharU pratIkSA gara ra ma pani timIharUsa~ga pratIkSA garchu |”
antataH hAmIle hUda tathA unakA sAthIharUlAI Aphno kRpAle bacAyauM | ra, jasale hAmrA AyataharUlAI jhuTho ThaharAekA thie tinIharulAI jaro dekhinai kATidiyauM ra tinIharU ImAna lyAunevAlA thienan |

ra samUdakA jAtitarpha hAmIle unakA bhAi sAlehalAI paThAyauM | sAlehale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! allAhako upAsanA gara | unIbAheka timro kohI upAsya chaina | timIharUsamakSa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa nizAnI Aisakeko cha | yo allAhako U~TanI timIharUkolAgi nizAnI ho ani tyasalAI allAhako dhartImA carna choDideU ani tyasalAI hAni puryAune manasAyale hAta nalagAU natra timIharUmAthi duHkhada yAtanA Aiparnecha |”

ani, smaraNa gara jaba pAlanakartAle timIharUlAI Adapachi uttarAdhikArI banAe ra dhartImA AbAda gare jahA~ timIharU tyasako samatala maidAnamA mahala nirmANa garchau ra pahADalAI khopera ghara banAu~chau | ani, allAhakA upakAraharUlAI smaraNa gara ra dhartImA vidhvaMsa namaccAU |

unakA jAtikA aguvAharUle jo ahaMkAra garne garthe, durbala ThAniekA AsthAvAnaharUsa~ga sodhe– “ke timIharU vizvAsa gardachau ki sAleha AphnA pAlanakartAdvArA paThAiekA hun?” tinIharUle javApha die– “juna sandezakAsAtha unalAI paThAieko cha tyasamAthi hAmI ImAna rAkhdachauM |”
ahaMkArIharUle bhane– “juna kurAmAthi timIharUla ImAna lyAekA chau tyasako hAmIharU inkAra gardachauM |”

antataH tinIharUle tyasa U~TanIlAI ghu~DA kATera mAridie ra AphnA pAlanakartAko Adezako ullaGghana gare ani bhane– “e sAleha! yadi timI IzadUtaharUmadhyekA hau bhane juna yAtanAbATa timIle hAmIlAI Dara dekhAune garthyau tyo hAmIsamakSa lyAU |”
ani tinIharUmAthi bhayAnaka prakopa Aiparyo | ra, tinIharU A–AphnA gharamA (sutekai avasthAmA) ghopTo pare |

ani sAlehale tinIharUbATa pharkidai bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! maile timIharUlAI AphnA pAlanakartAko sandeza puryAidie~ ra timIharUko bhalAI gareM tara timIharU bhane hitaiSIlAI mana parAu~dainau |”
ra, lUtalAI (paThAyauM) | unale AphnA samudAyakA mAnisaharUlAI bhane– “timIharU yasto azlIla kArya kina garchau juna kArya timIharUbhandA aghi saMsAramA kasaile garena?
timIharU mahilAharUlAI choDI puruSaharUsita kAma vAsanA purA garchau | vAstavamA timIharU sImA ullaGghanakArI hau |
tara, unako samudAyakA mAnisaharUko uttara yasa bAheka kehI thiena– “unIharUlAI Aphno bastIbATa bAhira nikAla | yinIharU baDo sadAcArI banna khojchan |”
ani hAmIle lUta tathA unakA parivAralAI bacAyauM sivAya unakI patnI jo pachADi rahaneharUmadhye ki thiin |
ra, hAmIle tinIharUmAthi (DhuMgAko) varSA garyauM | ani, hera aparAdhIharUko pariNAma kasto bhayo?

ra, madayanatarpha unakA bhAI ‘zuaiba’ lAI paThAyauM | unale bhane–“he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! allAhako upAsanA gara | unIbAheka timro kohI upAsya chaina | timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa timIharUsamakSa spaSTa mArgadarzana Aipugeko cha | ani, timIharU nApa tathA taula pUrA–pUrA garne gara ra mAnisaharUlAI tinIharuko sAmAna kama nadeU sAthai dhartImA sudhArapachi vidhvaMsa namaccAU | yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane yo nai timIharUko lAgi uttama cha |”

ra, timIharU mominaharUlAI DarAune, allAhako mArgabATa rokne ra tyasalAI TeDho pArna khojne uddezyale hareka bATomA nabasne gara | ra, smaraNa gara jaba timIharU alpasaMkhyaka thiyau ani allAhale timIharUko saMkhyAlAI bahusaMkhyaka banAidie | ani hera, ke bhayo vidhvaMsakArIharUko pariNAma!

ra, timIharUmadhyeko eka samUhale maile diera paThAieko saMdezamA ImAna lyAeko cha, ani arko samUhale ImAna lyAeko chaina | ataH allAhale hAmIbIca nirNaya nagaruJjela pratIkSA gara | ra, unI sarvottama nirNAyaka hun |

unakA jAtikA ahaMkArI aguvAharUle bhane– “he zuaiba! timI ra timIsa~ga ImAna lyAune harUlAI hAmIle nizcaya nai Aphno bastI bATa niSkAsita garnechauM, athavA timIharU hAmro samudAyamA phirtA Aunaiparcha” | zuaibale bhane– “ke hAmIle tyasalAI ghRNA garepani yaso garnuparcha?”

hAmI timIharUko dharmamA phirtA AyauM bhane hAmI allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garnevAlA hunechauM, jabaki allAhale yasabATa hAmIlAI chuTakArA diisakekA chan | timIharUko dharmamA phirtA hune kurA hAmrolAgi ekadamai asambhava cha; hAmrA pAlanakartA allAhale nai cAhe bhane beglai kurA ho | hAmrA pAlanakartAle hareka vastuharulAI Aphno jJAnako paridhimA lieko cha | kevala allAhaprati hAmI bharosA rAkhchauM | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmI ra hAmrA samudAyabIca ThIka ThIka nirNaya gara kinabhane timI nai sarvottama nirNAyaka hau |
unakA samudAyakA kAphira netAharUle bhane– “yadi timIharUle zuaibako anusaraNa garyau bhane timIharU avazya nai barabAda hunechau |”
antataH tinIharUlAI bhUkampale a~ThyAyo, ani tinIharU AphnA gharamai ghopTo parirahe |
juna vyaktiharUle zuaibalAI jhuTho Thahara gare tI yasarI barabAda bhae mAnauM (tinIharU) tyahA~ kahilyai basekai thienan | jasale zuaibalAI jhuTho Thahara garekA thie tinIharU nai ghATAmA rahe |

ani zuaibale pharkaMdai bhane– “he merA samudAyakA mAnisaharU ho! maile timIharUsamakSa AphnA ‘raba’ ko sandezaharU puryAisakeM ra timIharUko hita nai cAheM | aba ma asvIkAra garneharUkAlAgi ke AdhAramA aphasoca garU~!”
ani, hAmIle juna bastImA pani nabI paThAyauM tyahA~kA bAsindAlAI daridratA tathA kaThinAimA pAryauM tAki tinIharU vinamratA apanAUn |

ani hAmIle vipannatAlAI sampannatAmA pariNata garyauM yahA~samma ki tinIharU susampanna bhae ra bhanna thAle– “yastai sukha–duHkhakA dinaharU hAmrA pUrvajaharUmAthi pani AekA thie |” ani, hAmIle tinIharUlAI thAhA nabhaekai avasthAmA tinIharUlAI akasmAt samAtyauM |

ra, yadi tI nagarabAsIharUle ImAna lyAekA bhae tathA Izabhaya rAkhekA bhae hAmI tinIharUkAnimti AkAza tathA dhartIbATa barakatakA DhokAharUlAI kholne thiyauM tara tinIharUle asvIkAra gare | ani tinIharUkA kukarmako kAraNale gardA hAmIle tinIharUlAI samAtyauM |
ke nagarabAsIharU rAtI tinIharU sutirahekai avasthAmA hAmro prakopa AipugnabATa nizcinta chan?
vA ke nagarabAsIharU diu~sai tinIharU khelirahekai avasthAmA hAmro prakopa AipugnabATa nizcinta chan?
ke tinIharU allAhako juktibATa nizcinta chan? ani allAhako juktibATa ta noksAna behorneharU mAtra nizcinta rahane garchan |

ke vigatakA dhartIbAsIharUpachi uttarAdhikArI bhaekA vyaktiharUlAI ukta ghaTanAle zikSA diena ki hAmIle cAheko bhae tinIharUko pApale gardA tinIharUlAI naSTa garna sakthyauM? ra, hAmI tinIharukA hRdayamAthi mohara lagAidinchauM, ani tinIharU sunnai sakdainan |

yI bastIharU hun jasakA kehI vRttAntaharU hAmI timIharUlAI sunAu~daichauM | tinIharUsamakSa tinIharukA rasUlaharU nizAnIharU liera AekA thie tara pahile jhuTho ThaharAekA kurAharUmAthi tinIharU ImAna lyAunevAlA bhaenan | yasarI nai allAha kAphiraharUko mana–mastiSkamA sila lagAu~chan |
ra, adhikAMza mAnisaharUmA hAmIle pratijJAko kunai pAlanA pAenauM baru adhikAMzalAI hAmIle avajJAkArI nai pAyauM |

pheri yinIharUpachi hAmIle mUsAlAI AphnA camatkAraharU diera phiraauna evaM unakA jAtikA saradAraharUsamakSa paThAyauM ani tinIharUle tI nizAnIharUprati atyAcAra gare | ani hera! ke pariNAma bhayo vidhvaMsakArIharUko?
ra, mUsAle bhane– “he phiraauna! ma sampUrNa saMsArakA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa rasUla hu~ |”

mero lAgi anivArya cha ki allAhako tarphabATa je kurA pani bhanU~ satya bhanU~ | ma timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa pramANa liera timIharUsamakSa Aeko chu | ata: isarAIlakA santAnaharUlAI masa~ga jAna deU |
phiraaunale bhanyo– “yadi timI kunai camatkAra liera AekAchau bhane tyasalAI prastuta gara yadi timI Aphno dAvImA satyavAdIharUmadhye hau bhane |”
ani mUsAle Aphno lauro phyA~ke ra tyo spaSTa ajiGgara banyo |
ani, unale Aphno hAta bAhira nikAle ra tyo tyatikhera nai darzakaharUkA sAmu camkina thAlyo |
ani phiraaunako jAtikA aguvAharUle bhane– “nizcaya nai yo atyanta kuzala jAdugara rahecha |”
yasako cAhanA timIharUlAI timro dezabATa nikAlnu rahecha | ani timIharUko ke cha sallAha?
tinIharUle sujhAva die– “mUsA ra unakA bhAilAI avasara deU ra samasta zaharaharumA saMkalanakartA harUlAI paThAU |
jasale tapAIMsamakSa sampUrNa dakSa jAdUgaralAI lyAUn |”
ra, jAdugaraharU phiraaunasamakSa Aera bhane– “yadi hAmI vijayI bhayauM bhane hAmIlAI ta avazya pratidAna milcha?”
phiraaunale bhanyo– “a~, nissandeha timIharU (rAjadarabAramA) pAzrvavartIharUmadhye hunechau |”
jAdugaraharUle bhane– “mUsA! yA ta timI phyA~ka yA hAmI phyA~kchauM |”
mUsAle bhane– “timIharU nai phyA~ka |” ani, jaba tinIharUle phyA~ke taba mAnisaharUkA A~khAharUmA jAdU garidie, ra tinIharuko hRdayamA Dara utpanna garidie ra unIharUle ThUlo jAdU prastuta gare |
hAmIle mUsAmAthi saMketa garyauM– “phyA~ka Aphno lauro |” ani akasmAta tyasale (ajiGgara banera) tinIharUkA mithyA svAMgalAI nilana thAlyo |
ani nitAnta satya pramANita bhayo ra je tinIharUle gardathe tyo asatya Thahara bhayo |
ra, tinIharU sabai tyahA~ parAjita bhae ani khubai apamAnita bhaera pharkie |
ra, jAdugaraharU natamastaka bhae |
bhane– “hAmIle saMsArakA pAlanakartAmAthi ImAna lyAyauM |
mUsA tathA hArUnakA pAlanakartAmAthi |”

phiraaunale bhanyo– “maile anumati dinupUrva nai timIharUle tyasamAthi ImAna lyAyau? nizcaya nai yo yahA~kA bAsindAharUlAI yahA~bATa niSkAsana garnakAlAgi gopya SaDyantra ho juna timIharUle milera (yasa) zaharamA garyau | ani cA~Dai nai timIharUle (yasako pariNAma) thAhA pAunechau |
ma nizcaya nai timIharUkA hAtakhuTTAharU viparIta dizAbATa kATidinechu ani timIharU sabailAI zUlImA caDhAunechu |”
tinIharUle bhane– “(timIle je gare pani) hAmIharU AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha nai pharkera jAnechau~ |

timI hAmIsita kevala yasa kurAko badalA liirahekA chau ki hAmIle AphnA pAlanakartAkA nizAnIharU AphUsamakSa Aune bittikai tyasamAthi ImAna lyAyauM | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI dhairyatA pradAna gara ra hAmIlAI AjJAkArI bhaekai avasthAmA mRtyuvaraNa garAU |

ra, phiraaunakA jAtikA saradAraharUle bhane– “ke tapAI mUsA ra unakA jAtilAI tyasai choDidinu huncha tAki tinIharU dhartImA vidhvaMza maccAUn ra tapAIM ani tapAIMkA bhagavAnaharUlAI chADera basUn?” phiraaunale uttara diyo– “hAmI unakA putraharUko vadha garnechauM ra unIharUkA strIharUlAI jIvita chADnechauM | ra hAmI unIharUmAthi pUrNa prabhutvazAlI chau~ |”

mUsAle Aphno samudAyakA mAnisaharUlAI bhane– “allAhasita sahAyatA mAga, ra dhairya dhAraNa gara | nissandeha dhartI allAhakai ho unI AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanchan tyasako uttarAdhikArI banAidinchan ra antima pariNAma ta Izabhaya grahaNa garneharUkAlAgi raheko cha |”

mUsAkA jAtikA mAnisaharUle bhane– “hAmI timro AgamanabhandA aghi pani satAiyau~ ra timro AgamanapazcAt pani hAmI satAi~daichauM |” mUsAle bhane– “tyo samaya nikaTa cha jaba timrA pAlanakartAle timro zatrulAI naSTa garnechan ra tinIharUko sthAnamA timIharUlAI dhartIko adhikArI banAunechan | ani allAhale dekhnechan ki timIharU kastA karma garchau |”
hAmIle phiraaunIharUlAI akAla tathA phalaphUlako abhAvagrasta pAryauM tAki tinIharUmA cetanA Aos |

jaba tinIharUlAI sukha sampannatA prApta hunthyo taba tinIharU bhanthe– “hAmI yasakA hakadAra hau~ |” ra, jaba tinIharUlAI duHkha parthyo taba tinIharUle tyasa duHkhalAI mUsA tathA unakA sAthIharUlAI AphnolAgi apazakuna batAu~the | jAnirAkha! vAstavamA tinIharUko apazakuna allAhakahA~ nizcita raheko cha tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzalAI thAhA chaina |
phiraaunakA anuyAyIharUle bhane– “timIle hAmIharUmAthi jAdU garna junasukai nizAnI liera Ae pani hAmI timImAthi vizvAsa garne chainauM |”
ani hAmIle tinIharUmAthi khullA nizAnIharU svarupa A~dhI–beharI, salaha, uDusa, bhyAgutA ra ragata paThAyauM, tara tinIharUle ahaMkAra nai gare ra tinIharU thie nai jaghanya aparAdhI mAncheharU|

ra, jaba tinIharUmAthi prakopa Au~thyo taba tinIharUle bhanthe– “he mUsA timIlAI AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa juna pratijJA prApta cha tyasako AdhAramA hAmrolAgi prArthanA gara | yadi timIle hAmIharUbATa prakopa nivAraNa garyau bhane hAmI timro kurA mAnnechauM ra isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI mukta garera timIsa~ga paThAidinechauM |”
parantu jaba hAmIle tinIharUbATa tyo prakopa eka avadhikAlAgi jasasamma tinIharU pugne nai thie– nivAraNa garthyau~ taba tinIharU Aphno pratijJA bhaGga garne gardathe |
ani hAmIle tinIharUsita badalA liyau~ ra tinIharUlAI samudramA curlumma DubAyau~, kinabhane tinIharUle hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare ra tinIharubATa anabhijJa pani thie |

ra, kamajora ThAniekA vyaktiharUlAI hAmIle barakata (vRddhi) pradAna garieko bhU–bhAgako pUrva tathA pazcimakA uttarAdhikArI banAyau~ ani isarAIlakA santAnako hakamA tinIharUko dhairyale gardA timrA ‘raba’ ko zubhavacana pUrA huna gayo | ani, hAmIle phiraauna tathA usakA samudAyakA mAnisaharUle banAune garekA sAmAnaharU tathA nirmANa garne garekA ucca bhavanaharUlAI naSTa garidiyauM |

ani, hAmIle isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI samudra pAra garAyauM | ra, tinIharU yasto samudAyakA mAnisaharUkahA~ Ae jo AphnA kehI mUrtIharUsamakSa basekA thie | tinIharUle bhane– “he mUsA yinIharUkA upAsyaharUjhaiM hAmrolAgi pani euTA upAsya banAideU |” mUsAle bhane– “vAstavamA timIharU ati ajJAnI mAnisa rahechau |”
nissandeha tinIharU juna kAryaharUmA lipta chan tyo naSTa hunecha ra tinIharUle garirahekA kAryaharU nitAnta asatya chan |
unale bhane– “ke ma allAhabAheka timIharUkAlAgi kunai arko upAsya khojU~, jabaki unaile timIharUlAI sampUrNa saMsArabAsImAthi pradhAnatA pradAna garekA chan |”

ani smaraNa gara, jaba hAmIle timIharUlAI phiraaunakA mAnisaharUbATa mukta garekA thiyau~ jasale timIharUlAI dherai duHkhada yAtanA dine garthe; timrA putraharUko badha garthe ra timrA chorIharUlAI jIvita chADdathe | ra, yasamA timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kaDA parIkSA thiyo |

ra, hAmIle mUsAsa~ga tIsa rAtako avadhi nirdhArita garyauM ani tyasamA arU dasa thapera pUrNa garyauM | ataH unakA pAlanakartAko nirdhArita avadhi cAlIsa dinako bhayo | ra, mUsAle AphnA bhAi hArUnalAI bhane– “mero anupasthitimA mero jAtiko uttarAdhikArIko kAryabhAra samhAla; tinIharuko sudhAra gara ra vidhvaMsakArIharUko mArgako anusaraNa nagarnu |”

ani, jaba mUsA hAmro nizcita samayamA upasthita bhae ra unakA pAlanakartAle unIsa~ga kurAkAnI gare taba unale bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA! timI svayaMlAI malAI darzana zakti pradAna gara tAki ma timIlAI dekhna sakU~ |” allAhale bhane– “timI malAI kadApi dekhna sakdainau | tara, parvatatarpha hera yadi tyo Aphno sthAnamA sthira rahyo bhane timI malAI dekhna saknechau |” ra, jaba unakA pAlanakartA parvatamAthi prakaTa bhae taba yo prakaTikaraNale tyasalAI TukrA–TukrA pAridiyo ra mUsA behoza bhaera laDe | ra, jaba unI hozamA Ae taba unale bhane “pavitra chau timI; ma timIsamakSa kSamAyAcanA garchu ra ma ImAna lyAuneharUmA sarvaprathama hu~ |”

allAhale bhane– “he mUsA! maile timIlAI Aphno sandeza diera tathA timIsa~ga kurA garera sampUrNa mAnisaharU madhyebATa chAneko chu, ani je jati maile pradAna gareko chu tyasalAI samAta ra kRtajJa bana |”

ra, hAmIle unakAlAgi lekhne–pATIharUmA hareka prakArakA upadeza tathA tapasIla lekhyau~ (ra bhanyau~)– “yI AdezaharUlAI dRDhatApUrvaka samhAla ra Aphno jAtilAI tI uttama Adezaharuko pAlanA garne Adeza deU | ma cA~Dai nai timIlAI avajJAkArIharUko sthAna dekhAunechu |”

juna vyaktiharU dhartImA anAhaka ghamaNDa garchan tinIharUbATa ma AphnA nizAnIharU pheranechu | tinIharUle sabai nizAnIharU dekhe pani ImAna lyAune chainan ra sIdhA mArga pAe pani tyasalAI apanAune chainan, tara bhraSaTamArga bheTTAemA tyasamA hi~Dnechan | yasako kAraNa ke ho bhane tinIharUle hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare ra yasalAI bevAstA gare |
ra, juna mAnisaharU hAmrA nizAnIharU evaM paralokako AgamanalAI jhuThalAe tinIharUkA karmaharU vyartha hunechan | tinIharUlAI tinIharuko karma anusAra nai badalA diinecha |,

ra, mUsAkA jAtikA mAnisaharUle unako anupasthitimA AphnA gara gahanAharUbATa pUjya svarUpa bAcchAko euTA DhA~cA banAe jasabATa bAcchAko AvAja niskanthyo | ke tinIharUle dekhenan ki tyo tinIharUsa~ga na kurAkAnI garna sakthyo ra na tinIharUlAI kunai mArga nai dekhAuna sakthyo? taipani tinIharUle tyasalAI pUjya banAe ra tinIharU atyAcArI thie |

ani, jaba tinIharUko bhrama TuTyo ra tinIharU vAstavamA pathabhraSTa bhaekA chan bhanne kurA bujhe taba tinIharUle bhannathAle– “yadi hAmrA pAlanakartAle hAmImAthi dayA garenan ra hAmIlAI kSamA garenan bhane hAmI nizcaya nai ghATA khAneharUmadhye hunechauM |”

ra, jaba mUsA ati krodhita evaM dukhita bhaera AphnA jAtikahA~ pharke taba unale bhane– “mero anupasthitimA timIle kati narAmro uttarAdhikAra nirvAha garyau | ke timIle AphnA pAlanakartAko Adeza Aunuaghi nai hatAra garyau?” unale (lekhiekA) pATIharUlAI (ekAtarpha) rAkhe ra AphnA bhAi (hArUna) ko kapAla samAtI unalAI AphUtira tAnna thAle | hArUnale bhane– “he merA AmApaTTikA dAi! mAnisaharUle malAI durbala ThAne ra mero hatyA garne prayAsa gare | ataH zatruharUlAI mero hA~so uDAune maukA nadeU ra malAI atyAcArIharUmA sAmela nagara |”
(ani) mUsAle prArthanA gare– “he merA pAlanakartA! malAI ra merA bhAilAI kSamA pradAna gara ra hAmIlAI Aphno dayAmA praviSTa gara | vAstavamA timI parama dayAlu chau |”

(allAhale bhane)– “juna vyaktiharUle bAcchAlAI pUjya banAe tinIharU avazya AphnA pAlanakartAko prakopagrasta hunechan, ra sAMsArika jIvanamA apamAnita hunechan ani mithyA racne vyaktiharUlAI hAmI yastai daNDa dine garchauM |
ani, juna mAnisaharUle kukarma gare ra tyasapachi taubA gare tathA ImAna lyAe nizcaya nai timrA pAlanakartA tyasaprati ati kSamAzIla evaM dayAvAna chan |”
ra, jaba mUsAko krodha zAnta bhayo taba unale pATIharU uThAe | ra, tyasako lekhamA AphnA pAlanakartAko bhaya rAkhneharUkAnimti mArgadarzana tathA kRpA thiyo |

ra, mUsAle hAmIle nirdhArita gareko myAdamA upasthita garAuna AphnA samudAyakA sattarIjanA puruSaharUlAI cayana gare | jaba tinIharUlAI bhUkampale samAtyo taba mUsAle bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA yadi timIle cAheko bhae tinIharU ra malAI pani yasaaghi nai vinaSTa garisakekA hunethiyau | ke timI hAmImadhye kehI mUrkhaharUle garekA aparAdhale gardA hAmI sabailAI vinaSTa garchau? yo ta timro tarphabATa kevala euTA parIkSA thiyo jasadvArA timI jasalAI cAhanchau pathabhraSTa garchau ra jasalAI cAhanchau mArgadarzana garchau | hAmrA saMrakSaka–mitra timI nai hau | ataH hAmIlAI kSamA pradAna gara ra hAmImAthi dayA gara kinabhane timI nai uttama kSamAzIla chau |

ra, hAmrolAgi yasa lokako bhalAI tathA paralokako pani bhalAI lekhideU | hAmI timItarpha nai pharkiyau~ |” allAhale bhane– “yo mero yAtanA ho jasalAI cAhanchu ma yo yAtanA dinchu | tara mero dayA cAhi~ hareka vastumAthi chAeko cha | ma yasalAI tI mAnisaharUkAlAgi avazya nai lekhnechu jo Izabhaya garchan, jakAta dine garchan ra hAmrA AyataharUmAthi ImAna rAkhchan |

jo ummI sandeSTA (muhammada sa.) ko anusaraNa garchan; jasalAI unIharU AphUsa~ga raheko taurAta tathA injIlamA ullekha bhaeko pAU~chan; jasale tinIharUlAI sukarmako Adeza dinchan ra kukarmabATa rokchan ra pavitra vastuharUlAI tinIharUkA lAgi vaidha tathA apavitra vastuharUlAI avaidha garchan ani tinIharUmAthi lAdieko bojhalAI jhArchan; tyasa bandhanalAI kholchan jasamA tinIharU jakaDiekA thie | ataH juna mAnisaharUle unImAthi AsthA rAkhe ra tinIharuko samarthana tathA maddata gare ra unImAthi avataraNa bhaeko prakAzako anusaraNa gare, tinIharU nai saphalatA prApta garneharU hun |”

he muhammada (sa.!) bhanideU– “he manuSya ho! ma timIharU sabaitarpha tyasa allAhadvArA paThAieko rasUla hu~ jasakAlAgi AkAzaharU tathA dhartIko zAsana raheko cha | unIbAheka kohI pUjya chaina | unI nai jIvana pradAna garchan ra mRtyu dinchan | ataH allAha tathA unako tyasa ummI rasUla (sa.) mAthi ImAna lyAU jo allAha tathA unakA vANIharUmAthi ImAna rAkhchan ra unakai anusaraNa gara jasale gardA timIharUle mArga prApta garna saknechau |”
ra, mUsAkA jAtimadhye kohI yastA pani chan jo satyako mArga batAu~dachan ra satyamA AdhArita nisApha garchan |

ra, hAmIle isrAIlakA santAnalAI alaga alaga bAhravaTA khAnadAnamA vibhAjita garyau~ ra unIharUko alaga alaga jamAta nirdhArita garyauM ra jaba unakA jAtile unIsita pAnI mAge taba hAmIle mUsAlAI prakAzanA garyauM– “Aphno lauro DhuGgAmA hAna |” ani tyasabATa bAhravaTA muhAna phuTe ra pratyeka khAnadAnale A–Aphno pAnIko ghATa cine | ra, hAmIle tinIharUmAthi bAdalako chAyA~ pAryauM | ani tinIharUkA lAgi manna tathA salvA (eka prakArako utkRSTa khAnA) avatarita garyauM | (ra, bhanyauM)– khAU tI pavitra khAnAharU juna hAmIle timIharUlAI pradAna garekA chauM | unIharUle hAmro kunai aniSTa garenan baru Aphnai kSati gare |

ra, smaraNa gara– jaba tinIharUlAI Adeza diiyo– “yasa bastImA basobAsa gara ani jahA~bATa cAhanchau khAU tathA ‘hittatun’ bhandai jAu, ra sajdA gardai dvArabhitra praveza gara | hAmI timIharUko pApalAI kSamA garidinechauM ani sukarmIharUlAI ajha baDhI dinechauM |”
ani atyAcArIharUle tinIharUlAI bhanieko kurAlAI badale | ani, hAmIle tinIharUko atyAcArako kAraNa tinIharUmAthi AkAzabATa prakopa paThAyauM |

ra, tinIharUlAI tyasa bastIko vRttAntabAre sodha juna nadIko kinAramA avasthita thiyo | tinIharUle zanibArako dinamA sImA ullaGghana garna thAle, kinabhane zanibArako dinamA nai mAchAharU tinIharUsamakSa samudrako kinAramA Aune garthe ra zanibArabAheka anya dinaharUmA Au~dainathe | yasarI nai hAmI tinIharUlAI tinIharukA avajJAko kAraNale parIkSA linthyauM |

ra, jaba tinIharUmadhye euTA samUhale bhanyo– “timIharU yastA mAnisaharUlAI kina upadeza dinchau jasalAI allAha binAza garnevAlA vA kaThora daNDa dinevAlA chan |” unIharUle bhane– “yasa kAraNale ki timrA pAlanakartA samakSa doSa mukta huna sakauM ra yasa kAraNale pani ki tinIharU (allAhako avajJAbATa) bacna sakUn |”

ra, jaba tinIharUle AphUlAI diieko upadezaharUlAI birse taba hAmIle tI mAnisaharUlAI bacAyauM jo kukarmabATa rokne garthe ra bA~kI sabai mAnisaharUlAI jo atyAcArI thie tinIharuko avajJAko kAraNale kaThora yAtanAdvArA samAtyauM |
ani, jaba pUrNa uddaNDatAkAsAtha tinIharUle tyahI kAma garna thAle jasabATa tinIharUlAI manAhI garieko thiyo taba hAmIle Adeza diyauM– “apamAnita ra tuccha bA~dara hoU |”

ra, tyasa samayalAI smaraNa gara jaba timrA pAlanakartAle ghoSaNA garekA thie– “unale mahApralayako dinasamma yahudIharUmAthi yastA mAnisaharUlAI thoparne chan jasale tinIharUlAI kaThora yAtanA diirahanechan |” nissandeha timrA raba daNDa dinamA chiTo chan tara unI ati kSamAzIla evaM dayAvAna (pani) chan |

ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI samUha samUha banAera dhartImA bA~DidiyauM | tinIharUmadhye kehI sajjana chan bhane kehI tyasako viparIta | ra, hAmIle tinIharUko parIkSA sukha tathA duHkhako mAdhyamabATa gardai garyauM tAki tinIharU (satya tarpha) pharkiUn |

ra, tinIharUpazcAt yastA ayogya vyaktiharU Izagranthako vArisa bane jo yasa saMsArakai sampatti Arjana garna juTekA chan ra bhanchan– “hAmI kSamA prApta AzAvAdI chau~ |” ra, yadi sAMsArika sAmagrI tyattikai mAtrAmA (ajhai) Ae bhane tyo tinIharUle linechan | ke tinIharUbATa Izagranthako vacana liieko chaina ki tinIharUle allAhabAre satyabAheka arU kehI nabhanUn? ra, jejati tyasa granthamA raheko cha tyo tinIharUle paDhekA pani chan | Izabhaya rAkhneharUkAlAgi paralokako nivAsa uttama raheko cha | ke timIharU (yatti pani) bujhdainau?
ani, juna mAnisaharU IzagranthalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samAtchan ra namAja kAyama garchan, nissandeha hAmI satkarmIharUko pratidAnalAI akArtha garne chainau~ |

ra, jaba hAmIle tinIharUmAthi pahADalAI chAtAjhaiM yasarI khaDA garyauM ki tyo tinIharUmAthi khasnai lAgyo bhanne kurA tinIharUle ThAne, taba (hAmIle bhanyauM) juna hAmIle timIharUlAI pradAna garekA chau~, tyasalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samAta ra je tyasamA lekhieko cha tyasalAI yAda rAkha AzA cha ki timIharU kukarmabATa bacna saknechau |

ani, jaba timrA pAlanakartAle AdamakA santAnaharUkA piThyU~harUbATa tinIharukA santati sRSTi gare, ra tinIharUlAI svayaM tinIharUmAthi sAkSI banAu~dai sodhe– “ke ma timIharUko pAlanakartA hoina?” tinIharUle bhane– “kina nahunu? hAmI sAkSI chau~ |” (yo pratijJA linuko uddezya yo ho ki) timIharU mahApralayako dina bhanna sakne chainau ki “hAmIlAI yasako patto nai thiena |”

vA yo bhanna sakne chainau ki, “zirka hAmrA pUrvajaharUle yasabhandA pahile nai garekA thie ra hAmI tinIharUpachikA santati paryauM | ani ke timIle hAmIlAI duSkarmIharUko kRyAkalApakA kAraNale binaSTa garnechau ta?”
ra, yasarI hAmI AphnA AyataharU (zlokaharU) lAI spaSTa rUpamA prastuta garne garchauM tAki tinIharU (allAha tarpha) pharkUn |

ra, he sandeSTA! tinIharUlAI tyasa vyaktiko vRttAnta sunAU jasalAI hAmIle AphnA AyataharUko jJAna pradAna garyauM tara tyo tyasako pAlanAbATa panchera bhAgyo ani zaitAnale tyasalAI pachyAyo ani tyo pathabhraSTaharUmadhye bhayo |

ra, yadi hAmIle cAheko bhae tyasalAI AyataharUdvArA uccatA pradAna garne thiyauM tara tyo dhartItarpha nai jhukyo ra Aphno nikRSTa cAhanAkai pachADi lAgyo | ani tyasto vyaktiko udAharaNa kukurako jasto cha jasalAI timIle AkramaNa gare pani vA nagare pani jibro bAhira nikAlera hA~pne garcha nai | yahI udAharaNa tI vyaktiharUko pani ho jasale hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare | ani timIle yo kathA tinIharUlAI sunAU tAki tinIharUle socavicAra garUn |
tI vyaktiharUko udAharaNa ati nikRSTa raheko cha jasale hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare ra tinIharU AphUmAthi nai atyAcAra gardai thie |
jasalAI allAhale mArga dekhAu~chan usale nai satamArgI huncha, ra jasalAI unI pathabhraSTa garchan tinIharU nai hun ghATA khAneharU |

ra, hAmIle dherai jinna tathA manuSyalAI narakakolAgi sRSTi garekA chauM | tinIharUko hRdaya cha tara tinIharU tyasabATa bujhdainan; tinIharUkA A~khA chan tara tinIharU tyasabATa dekhdainan ra tinIharUkA kAna chan tara tinIharU tyasabATa sundainan | tinIharU pazujastai chan baru tyasabhandA pani baDhI pathabhraSTa | tinIharU nai anabhijJa mAnisaharu hUn |

allAhakA rAmrA nAmaharU chan | ataH unalAI unakai nAmabATa pukArne gara ani tI vyaktiharUlAI choDideU jo unakA nAmaharUlAI nikaTa garne duSTatA dekhAu~chan | tinIharUle garne garekA kAryako sajAya~ tinIharUle cA~Dai nai pAunechan |
hAmIdvArA sRSTi gariekAmadhye yastA samUhaharU pani chan jo satyako mArga dekhAu~chan ra tyasai bamojima niyAya garchan |
ra, juna vyaktiharUle hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare tinIharUlAI hAmI kramazaH samAtne chau~ ki tinIharUlAI thAhA pani hunechaina |
ra, ma tinIharUlAI avasara diiraheko chu | nissandeha mero yojanA ati sudRDha raheko cha |
ke tinIharUle socenan ki unakA sAthI (muhammada sa.) mA kunai unmAda chaina | unI ta kevala prasTa sacetaka hun |

ke tinIharUle AkAzaharU tathA dhartIko prabandhamA ra allAhale sRSTi gareko vastumA vicAra garenan? ra yo pani (socenan) ki zAyada tinIharUko mRtyuko samaya najika pugeko cha ki? ani tyasapachi tinIharU kuna kurAmA ImAna lyAunechan ta?
ra, jasalAI allAhale pathabhraSTa gardachan tyasalAI kohI mArgadarzana dina saknechaina | ra allAhale tinIharUlAI tinIharuko uddaNDatAmA nai vibhrAnta bhaI ghumna chADidinchan |

mahApralaya kahile Aunecha bhanI tinIharUle timIsita sodhchan | bhanideU– “tyasako jJAna ta merA pAlanakartAlAI mAtra cha; tyasalAI tyasako (nirdhArita) samayabhandA pahile unale prakaTa garnechainan | AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA lAgi yo kaThina samaya hunecha, ra tyo timIharUmAthi akasmAt nai Aunecha |” tinIharUle yasabAre yasarI sodhchan mAnauM timI tyasabAre pUrNa rupamA avagata chau | bhanideU– “tyasako jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha | tara, adhikAMza mAnisaharUlAI thAhA nai chaina |"

bhanideU– “ma na svayaMko lAbhako adhikAra rAkhdachu, ra na hAnIko nai, allAhale cAheko bAheka | ra, yadi mamA parokSa ko jJAna bhaeko bhae maile dherai lAbha jammA garna sakne thie~ ra malAI kunai kaSTale pani chune thiena | ra ma ta ImAna lyAune mAnisaharuko lAgi spaSTa sacetaka ra zubha sucaka mAtra hU~ |

unI allAha nai hun jasale timIharUlAI eka jIvabATa sRSTi gare ra tyasaibATa tyasako joDI banAe, tAki tyasale Aphno joDIbATa santuSTi prApta garos | ani jaba patile patnIlAI DhAkcha taba patnIle haluko garbha dhAraNa garin, jasalAI liera unI hi~DaDula garirahanchin ra jaba unI bojhilo hunchin taba duvai AphnA pAlanakartA allAhasita prArthanA garchan– “yadi timIle hAmIlAI yogya zizu pradAna garyau bhane hAmI avazya nai kRtajJa hunechauM |”
jaba allAha unalAI yogya zizu pradAna garchan, taba duvaile tyasako sRSTimA allAhasa~ga zirka garna thAlchan | tara, allAha tinIharUko zirkabhandA ati ucca chan |
ke tinIharU yastAlAI sAjhedAra banAu~chan jo kunai pani vastu sRSTi gardainan, baru tinIharU svayaM sRSTi garinchan?
ra, tinIharu na tinIharUko maddata garne sAmarthya rAkhdachan na svayaMlAI nai sahayoga puryAuna sakchan |
ra, yadi timIle tinIharUlAI sIdhA mArgatarpha bolAyau bhane tinIharUle timro anusaraNa garne chainan | tinIharUlAI (satmArgatarpha) bolAunu vA cupa lAgera basnu (duvai) timIharUko lAgi samAna cha |
timIharU allAhabAheka juna cijaharUlAI pukArchau tinIharU pani timIharU jastai bhaktaharU hun | timIharU tinIharUlAI bolAU, yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane tinIharUle timIharUko pukAra sunnu parcha |

ke tinIharUkA khuTTA chan jasadvArA tinIharU hi~DaDula garna sakchan vA hAtaharU chan jasadvArA tinIharU samAtna sakchan vA A~khAharU chan jasadvArA tinIharU dekhna sakchan vA kAnaharU chan jasadvArA tinIharUle sunna sakchan? bhanideU– (yadi chan bhane) “bolAU AphnA sAjhedAraharUlAI; ani mero viruddha upAya gara; ani malAI alikati pani avasara nadeU |”
merA saMrakSaka–mitra ta allAha hun jasale grantha avatarita gare ra unI nai satkarmIharUlAI saMrakSaNa pradAna gardachan |
ra, allAhabAheka jasalAI timIharU bolAune garchau tinIharUle na ta timIharUlAI maddata garna sakchan, na svayaMlAI sahAyatA garna sakchan |
ra, yadi timI tinIharUlAI satmArgatarpha bolAu~chau bhane tinIharUle sunne chainan | ra, timIle tinIharUlAI AphUtarpha heriraheko dekhchau tara tinIharUko dRSTi nai hu~daina |
(he muhammada sa.) mApha garne nIti apanAU; puNya karma garne Adeza deU, ra ajJAnIharulAI bevAstA gara |
ra, yadi zaitAnabATa timIlAI uksAvaTa huncha bhane allAhako zaraNa mAga | nissandeha unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |
nissandeha Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI yadi zaitAnale parAmarza dincha bhane unIharU tatkAlai sAvadhAna bhaihAlchan ani tinIharUkA A~khA khulchan |
tara (kAphiraharUlAI) unakA sAthIbhAIharUle pathabhraSTatAtarpha nai DoryAu~chan pheri yasamA kunai kamI pani gardainan |

he sandeSTA! yadi timI tinIharUsamakSa kunai nizAnI prastuta gardainau bhane tinIharU bhanchan kunai nizAnI kina lyAenau? bhanideU– “ma tyasai Adezako mAtra pAlanA garchu juna merA rabale malAI prakAzanA garchan | yo (kuraAna) timIharUko pAlanakartAko tarphabATa pramANa ho ra ImAna lyAune mAnisaharUkA lAgi mArgadarzana tathA dayA ho |”
ra, jaba kuraAnako pATha garincha taba tyasalAI dhyAnapUrvaka sunne gara tathA mauna dhAraNa garne gara tAki timIharUmAthi dayA hos |
ra bihAna belukA AphnA pAlanakartAlAI manamanai, bilaunA gardai tathA bhayakA sAtha ra madhuro svaramA smaraNa garne gara ra acetana mAnisaharUmadhye nabana |
nissandeha jo (phariztAharU) timro pAlanakartAkahA~ chan tinIharU unako upAsanAbATa vimukha hu~dainan ra unakai mahimAgAna garchan ani unailAI sajdA garne garchan |

(he muhammada sa.) tinIharU timIsa~ga anphAla (yuddhamA prApta hune dhana) ko bAremA sodhdachan | bhanideU– “anphAla ta allAha ra rasUlako lAgi ho |” ani allAhako bhaya gara tathA ApasI sambandha ThIka rAkha | ra, yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane allAha tathA unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana gara |

vAstavika mominaharU tI hun jasako hRdaya allAhalAI samjhine bittikai kA~pna thAlchan, ra unakA AyataharU paDhera sunAu~dA unIharUko ImAna jhan baDhna thAlcha, ra unIharU AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi bharosA rAkhchan |
jo namAja kAyama garchan ra hAmIle unIharUlAI je–jati pradAna garekA chauM tyasamadhyebATa kharca garchan |
unIharU nai saccA mominaharU hun | unIharUkAlAgi unakA pAlanakartAkahA~ ucca darjAharU rahekA chan ani kSamAdAna tathA uttama khAdyAnna–sAmagrI pani |

(anphAlabAre pani tyastai sthiti utpanna bhayo jasto sthiti tyasa samaya utpanna bhaeko thiyo) jabaki timrA rabale timIlAI satyakAsAtha timro gharabATa nikAlera lyAekA thie ra AsthAvAnaharUmadhye euTA samUhalAI yo apriya thiyo |
tinIharU satyabAre timIsa~ga jhagaDA gardai thie jabaki tyo ekadama spaSTa bhaisakeko thiyo | tinIharUko sthiti yasto thiyo ki mAnauM tinIharU mRtyulAI herdai tyasarpha ghisAriMdaichan |

ra, tyasa samayako smaraNa gara jaba allAhale timIharUsa~ga duI dalamadhye eka timIharUko hunecha bhanI vacana diirahekA thie ra nirbala samUha cAhi~ timIharUlAI prApta hos bhanne timIharUko cAhanA thiyo tara allAhako cAhanA Aphno AdezadvArA satyalAI kAyama rAkhnu ra kAphiraharUko jaro kATera phyA~knu raheko thiyo |
tAki satyalAI satya tathA asatyalAI asatya pramANita garUn yadyapi yo aparAdhIharUlAI jatisukai apriya kina nalAgos |

smaraNa gara jaba timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAsita bilaunA gardai thiyau ani unale timro prArthanA svIkAra gare (ra bhane) ma lagAtAra eka pachi arko Aune eka hajAra phariztAdvArA timIharUko maddata garnechu |

allAhale yo kurA kevala timIharUko lAgi zubha–sUcanA banAe; ra tAki timIharUko manalAI santuSTi prApta hos | ra, sahAyatA kevala allAhakai tarphabATa Au~cha | nissandeha allAha atyanta prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

tyasa samaya allAhale timIharUko nizcintatA tathA nirbhayatAkAlAgi (timIharUlAI) AphnotarphabATa nindrAle DhAke ra AkAzabATa timIharUmAthi pAnI barsAe tAki tyasabATa timIharUlAI pavitra pAruna ra zaitAnako phohoralAI haTAUna ra timIharUko hRdayalAI hausalA pradAna garun ani kadamaharUlAI sudRDha pArun |

tyasa samaya timrA pAlanakartAle phariztAharUlAI saGketa gardai thie– “ma timIharUko sAthamA chu ra mominaharUlAI dRDhatA pradAna gara | ma ahile kAphiraharUko hRdayamA bhaya utpanna garnechu | ani timI tinIharUko gardana ra pratyeka jornIharUmA prahAra gara |”
yo yasa kAraNale ki tinIharUle allAha evaM unakA rasUlasita mukAbilA gare | ra, jasale allAha evaM unakA rasUlasita mukAbilA garcha allAhale usalAI kaThora daNDa dinechan |
yo (daNDako svAda yahA~) cAkha ra (jAni rAkha) anAsthAvAdIharUkA lAgi narakako yAtanA raheko cha |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timIharUko bhiDanta yuddhako maidAnamA kAphiraharUsita bhayo bhane tinIharUlAI piThyu~ nadekhAU |

ani, yuddhako raNanIti svarupa vA kunai sainyadalamA sAmela huna uddezya bAheka jo tyasadina piThyU~ pharkAu~cha tyasto vyakti allAhako prakopamA phasnecha tathA tyasako bAsasthAna naraka hunecha ra tyo ati narAmro sthAna ho |

ra, timIharUle tinIharUlAI mArekA hoinau, baru allAhale svayaM tinIharUlAI mArekA hun | ra, (he muhammada (sa.)!) jatibelA ra jaba timIle phyA~kyau tyo timIle phyA~kekA hoinau baru allAhale phyA~kekA hun jasako uddezya AsthAvAnaharUlAI uttama pratidAna pradAna garnu thiyo | nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |
(euTA uddezya) yo ho ra allAhale kAphiraharUko calakhelalAI durbala pArne chan |

yadi timIharU phaisalA cAhanthyau bhane phaisalA timIharUsamakSa Aipugeko cha | ra, yadi timIharU rokinchau bhane yahI timrolAgi rAmro hunecha | ra, yadi pheri tyahI garchau bhane hAmI pani tyahI garnechauM | ra, timIharUko jatthAle timIharUlAI kadApi kunai lAbha puryAune chaina cAhe tyo jati nai ThUlo saMkhyAmA kina nahos | ra, allAha AsthAvAnaharUkA sAthamA chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAha evaM unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana gara ra, Adeza sunepachi tyasabATa vimukha nahoU |
ra, tI mAnisaharU jasto nabana jo bhanchan– “hAmIle (IzvarIya Adeza) sunyau jabaki tinIharUle sunnu hu~dainan |”
nissandeha allAhako dRSTimA prANIharUmadhye sabaibhandA nikRSTa tI bahirA evaM lATAharU hun jo kehI pani bujhdainan |

ra, yadi allAhale tinIharUbhitra kunai guNa dekheko bhae avazya nai tinIharUlAI sunne yogya banAune thie | ra, yadi aba tinIharUlAI sunne zakti pradAna garchan bhane tinIharU vimukha bhaI bhAgnechan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAha ra rasUlakA AdezaharulAI svIkAra gara jabaki rasUlale timIharUlAI yasto kAryakAlAgi bolAu~chan jasale timIharUlAI (ananta) jIvana pradAna garcha | jAnirAkha allAha mAnisa tathA usako hRdayabIca pardA banna pugchan | ra, yo pani jAnirAkha timIharU unakaisAmu ekatrita garinechau |
ra, tyasa upadravaprati saceta hoU jasako prabhAva viziSTa rUpamA kevala tI mAnisaharUmA sImita rahane chaina, timIharUmadhye jasale pApa garekA chan | jAnirAkha allAha kaThora yAtanA dinevAlA chan |

ra, smaraNa gara tyo samaya jaba timIharU alpasaMkhyaka thiyau; dhartImA durbala ThAninthyau; mAnisaharUle timIharUlAI apaharaNa garchan ki bhanI DarAu~thyau ani allAhale timIharUlAI bAsasthAna pradAna gare ra Aphno sahayogabATa timIharUlAI sazakta banAe ra uttama vastuharU khAnalAI die AzA cha ki timIharU kRtajJa banne chau |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! jAnI–jAnI allAha evaM rasUlasa~ga vizvAsaghAta nagara ra na Aphno amAnata (nAso) harUko khayAnata (hinAminA) nai gara |
ra, jAnirAkha timIharUkA dhana tathA santAnaharU parIkSAkA sAmagrI hun ra allAhakahA~ (puNyakarmako) ThUlo pratidAna raheko cha |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timIharU Izabhaya rAkhchau bhane allAhale timIharUlAI phaisalA garne kasauTI pradAna garnechan ra timIharUkA pApaharUlAI nAza garnechan ra timIharUlAI kSamA dinechan ra allAha mahAn anugrahI rahekA chan |

ra, (he muhammada (sa.!) tyasa samayako smaraNa gara jaba kAphiraharUle timIlAI bandI banAune vA timro hatyA garne vA timIlAI deza–nikAlA garne SaDyantra garekA thie | tinIharU Aphno calakhela gardai thie ra allAha Aphno yojanA banAudai thie | ra, allAha nai sarvottama yojanAvid hun |
ra, jaba tinIharUsamakSa hAmrA AyataharU paDhincha taba tinIharU bhanchan– “a~, hAmIle sunisakyauM | hAmIle cAheko bhae yastA vANIharU pani bhanna sakthyauM | yI ta kevala atItakA kathAharU hun |”
ra, jaba tinIharUle bhane– “he allAha! yadi yo (kuraAna) timrotarphabATa nitAnta satya ho bhane hAmImAthi AkAzabATa DhuGgA barsAU vA kunai duHkhadAyI yAtanA paThAU |”
tara (he muhammada sa.!) timI unIharUbIca rahunjela allAhale unIharUlAI yAtanA dine chainan | ra na allAhako yo niyama ho ki unIharUle kSamAyAcanA gariraheko avasthAmA unale yAtanA diUn |

parantu aba allAhale tinIharUmAthi yAtanA kina avatarita nagarUn jabaki tinIharU pratiSThita masjidabATa rokchan; jabaki tinIharU tyasako saMrakSaka pani hoinan | yasako vAstavika saMrakSaka ta Izabhaya rAkhne mAnisaharU hun tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |
ra, tyasa gRha (kaabA) najika tinIharUko namAja, suselnu tathA tAlI piTnu bAheka anya kehI hoina | aba timIharuko asvIkArako kAraNa yAtanAko svAda cAkha |

nissandeha kAphiraharU allAhako mArgabATa roknakAnimti Aphno dhana–sampatti kharca garchan | ra, tinIharUle ajha kharca garnechan tara antataH tyo prayAsa tinIharUkA lAgi pazcAtApako kAraNa nai bannecha ra pherI tinIharU parAjita hunechan | pheri kAphiraharU narakatarpha ekatrita garinechan |
tAki allAhale apavitratAlAI pavitratAbATa alaga pArUn ra apavitratAlAI eka arkomAthi rAkhera jammA pArUn ra tyasa (thupro) lAI narakamA homidiUn | yastA mAnisaharU nai ghATA khAneharU hun |

he sandeSTA! yI kAphiraharUlAI bhanideU– “yadi tinIharU (Aphno kukarmabATa) rokinchan bhane atItamA bhaekA tinIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garinecha, tara yadi pheri tyastai kArya garna thAle bhane (smaraNa garUn) pahilekA mAnisaharUmAthi niyama lAgU bhaI sakekocha |”

ani, yinIharU viruddha yuddha jArI rAkha yahA~samma ki utpIDana samApta hoos tathA dharma pUrNa rUpamA allAhakai bhaihAlos | ra, yadi tinIharU (utpIDanabATa) rokie bhane allAhale tinIharUko kAryalAI dekhirahekA chan |
ra, yadi tinIharU piThyU~ pharkAu~chan bhane jAnirAkha allAha timrA saMrakSaka mitra hun | kati sarvottama saMrakSaka–mitra evaM sahAyaka rahekA chan unI!

ra, jAnI rAkha timIharU yuddhamA jejati dhana prApta garchau tyasako pA~cauM bhAga allAha ra unakA rasUla, nAtedAra, anAtha, nirdhana tathA yAtruharUkolAgi ho | yadi timIharUle allAha ra tyasamAthi ImAna rAkhchau juna AdezaharU hAmIle Aphno bhaktamAthi (satya evaM asatyabIca) pharaka garne dina avatarita garyauM juna dina duI samUhaharUbIca muThabheDa bhaeko thiyo | ra, allAha sampUrNa kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

smaraNa gara jaba timIharU (madInAko) nikaTatama kinArAmA thiyau ra zatruharU TADhAko kinArAmA thie ra yAtrI samUha timIharUbhandA tala thiyo | ra, yadi timIharUle paraspara vacana dieko bhae nirdhArita samayamA pugnamA vibheda huna sakthyo tara allAhale euTA kAma garnu nai thiyo, juna nirNaya bhaisakeko thiyo tAki jasalAI naSTa hunu cha tyo pratyakSa pramANasAtha naSTa hoos, ra jasalAI jIvita rahanu cha tyo spaSTa pramANasAtha jIvita rahos | nizcaya nai allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

tyasa belA allAhale timIlAI sapanAmA tinIharUko saMkhyA kama garera dekhAe | ra, yadi tinIharUko saMkhyA baDhI dekhAekA bhae avazya nai timIharU sAhasa gumAune thiyau ra yasa viSayamA jhagaDA garne thiyau | tara allAhale timIharUlAI tyasabATa surakSita rAkhe | nissandeha unI hRdayakA kurAharUbAre pani avagata chan |

ra, tyasa samaya jaba timIharUko (zatrusa~ga) muThabheDa bhayo allAhale tinIharUlAI timIharUko dRSTimA kama (saMkhyAmA) dekhAe ra timIharUlAI tinIharUko dRSTimA (ArambhamA) kama (saMkhyAmA) dekhAe kinakI allAhale tyo kAma garnu nai thiyo jasako nirNaya bhaisakeko thiyo | ra, sampUrNa mAmilA allAhako tarpha nai pharkAinecha |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! jaba (kAphiraharUko) kunai samUhasa~ga timIharUko muThabheDa huncha taba aDiga rahane gara ra allAhalAI atyadhika smaraNa garne gara tAki timIharUlAI saphalatA prApta hos |

ani, allAha evaM unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana gara ra paraspara jhagaDA nagara anyathA timIharU kamajora hunechau ra timIharUko zakti vilopa hunecha | ra dhairya dhAraNa gara | nizcaya nai allAha dhairyavAnaharUkA sAthamA chan |

ra, tinIharUjhaiM nabana jo (satyaviruddha) ahaMkAra gardai ra mAnisaharUlAI dekhAu~dai Aphno gharabATa niske ra tinIharU allAhako mArgabATa (mAnisaharUlAI) rokne garthe | juna kArya tinIharU gardaichan tyo allAhako niyantraNabhandA bAhira chaina |

ani, smaraNa gara jaba zaitAnale tinIharUlAI tinaharukA kriyAkalApaharulAI sundara tulyAera dekhAyo ra bhanyo– “Aja kohI pani timIharUmAthi vijayI huna sakdaina ra ma timIharUko sAthI hu~ |” (tara) jaba duvai sainika dalaharUko muThabheDa bhayo taba U piThyU~ pharkAera pachi haTyo ra bhanyo– “timIharUsa~ga mero kunai sarokAra chaina | ma juna kurA dekhdaichu timIharU tyo dekhna sakdainau | malAI ta allAhasita Dara lAgirahekocha kinabhane allAha kaThora yAtanA dinevAlA chan |”

tyasa samaya munAphika tathA hRdaya–rogI mAnisaharUle bhane– “yinIharUlAI yinako dharmale dhokAmA pAreko cha |” ra, jasale allAhamAthi bharosA rAkhcha, nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
yadi timIle tyo sthiti dekhana pAune thiyau jaba phariztAharU avizvAsIharUko mukha tathA DhADamA hirkAu~dai prANa luchdachan ra (bhanchan) “cAkha dankado Agoko yAtanA!”
yo pariNAma timIharuko tI kAryaharUle gardA bhayo juna timIharUkA hAtale aghi paThAe | nissandeha allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi atyAcAra gardainan |

(tinIharUko avasthA) phiraaunakA jAtikA mAnisaharU tathA tinIharUbhandA aghikA vyaktiharUko jastai bhayo | tinIharUle allAhakA AyataharUlAI asvIkAra gare | (ataH) allAhale tinIharUlAI tinIharukA pApaharUko kAraNale samAte | nissandeha allAha zaktizAlI evaM kaThora yAtanA dinevAlA chan |

yo yasakAraNale ki juna varadAna allAhale kunai samudAyalAI pradAna garchan tyasalAI unI tabasamma parivartana gardainan jabasamma tinIharU svaMya Aphno vyavahAralAI AphaiM parivartana gardainan | ra, nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

(tinIharUko avasthA) phiraaunakA jAtikA mAnisaharU tathA tinIharUbhandA aghikA vyaktiharUjhaiM bhayo | tinIharUle AphnA pAlanakartAkA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare ataH hAmIle tinIharukA pApaharUko kAraNale tinIharuko vinAza garidiyauM ra phiraaunakA jAtikA mAnisaharUlAI curlummai DubAidiyauM | tinIharU sabai atyAcArI thie |
nissandeha allAhako dRSTimA prANIharUmadhye sabaibhandA nikRSTa kAphiraharU hun | ata: unIharU ImAna lyAu~dainan |
(yI nai hun) josa~ga timIle sandhi garyau pheri tinIharU nai hareka paTaka sandhi bhaGga garchan ra (allAhasita) alikati pani DarAu~dainan |
ataH yadi timIle tinIharUlAI yuddhamA samAtchau bhane yinIharUlAI diieko sajAya~ dvArA yinIharU pachADi rahaneharulAI dhapAu| tAki tinIharUle zikSA grahaNa garun |

ra, yadi timIlAI kunai samudAyako tarphabATa vizvAsaghAtako AzaGkA cha bhane tinIharusa~gako pratijJA barAbarIko tavarale tinIharUsamakSa bhaGga garideU | nizcaya nai allAha vizvAsaghAtIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |
anAsthA pradarzana garneharUle bhAgera hAmIbATa bacna saknechan bhanne kurA kadApi naThAnUn | nissandeha tinIharUle (hAmIlAI) vivaza pArna sakdainan |

ra, timIharU yathAsambhava tinIharUviruddha (sainya) zakti ra tayAra ghoDAharU juTAI rAkha tAki tyasabATa timIharU allAhakA zatru ra AphnA zatruharUlAI ani tinIharUbAheka anya (zatruharU) lAI bhayabhita tulyAU jasalAI timIharU jAndainau tara allAha tinIharUlAI jAndachan | ra, timIharU allAhako mArgamA je pani kharca garnechau tyasako pUrA pratidAna timIharUlAI diinecha | ra, timIharUkA sAtha kadApi anyAya hune chaina |
ra, yadi tinIharU sandhiko lAgi jhukAvaTa dekhAu~chan bhane timI pani tyasakA lAgi tayAra hoU | ra, allAhamAthi nai bharosA gara | nizcaya nai allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |
ra, yadi tinIharU timIlAI dhokA dina khojchan bhane timrolAgi allAha nai paryApta chan | unai ta hun jasale timIlAI Aphno sahAyatA tathA AsthAvAnaharUdvArA sudRDha tulyAekA chan|

ra AsthAvAnaharUko hRdayalAI joDidiekA chan | yadi timIle dhartIkA sampUrNa sampatti kharceko bhae pani timIle tinIharUko hRdaya joDna sakne thienau | tara allAha nai hun jasale tinIharU bIca prema utpanna gare | nissandeha unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
he sandeSTA! timronimti allAha tathA timrA anuyAyI mominaharU nai paryApta chan |

he sandeSTA! mominaharUlAI yuddhakAlAgi prerita gara | timIharUmadhyekA bIsajanA dhairyavAna tinIharUkA duIsaya janAmAthi vijayI hunechan ra timrA sayajanA AsthAvAnaharu ekahajAra kAphiraharUmAthi vijayI hunechan | kinabhane tinIharU abujha rahekA chan |

aba allAhale timro bojhalAI kama garidiekA chan kinakI unalAI rAmrarI thAhA cha ki timIharUbhitra kehI kamI kamajorI (Aisakeko) cha | ataH timrA aba timrA sayajanA dhairyavAna duIsayajanA kAphira mAthi ra timrA ekahajAra dhairyavAna, duIhajAra kAphiraharU mAthi allAhako Adezale vijayI hunechan | ra, allAha dhairyavAnaharU kAsAtha chan |

dhartImA (zatruharUlAI) rAmrarI nakulciunjelasamma sandeSTAko hAtamA bandIharU rahUn (unako lAgi) ucita chaina | timIharU sAMsArika lAbha cAhanchau jabaki allAha Akhirata (paralokako bhalAI) cAhanchan | ra, allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
yadi allAhako Adeza pahile nai lekhieko bhae je timIharUle liyau tyasale gardA timIharUlAI kaThora yAtanA diine thiyo |
ani juna vaidha tathA pavitra dhana timIharUle yuddhabATa prApta garekA chau tyasalAI khAU ra allAhasita DarAune gara | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla tathA parama dayAlu chan |

he sandeSTA! Aphno kabjAmA rahekA bandIharUlAI bhanideU– “yadi allAhale timIharUko hRdayamA kunai rAmro bhAvanA dekhe bhane juna (dhana) timIharUbATa liieko cha tyasabhandA uttama timIharUlAI pradAna garnechan ra timIharUlAI kSamA pani garnechan |” ra, allAha ati kSamAzIla eva parama dayAlu chan |

ra, yadi tinIharU timIsa~ga vizvAsaghAta garna cAhanchan bhane yasaaghi pani tinIharUle allAhasa~ga vizvAsaghAta garisakekA chan | ani (tyasaile) allAhale tinIharUlAI timro kabjAmA pAridie ra allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvajJa chan |
