juna mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAe, gharabAra tyAge, Aphno dhana–sampatti tathA jyAnale allAhako mArgamA yuddha gare ra juna mAnisaharUle (gharabAra tyAgera AuneharUlAI) Azraya die ra sahayoga gare tI sabai vAstavamA paraspara saMrakSaka mitra hun | ra, tI vyaktiharU jasale ImAna ta lyAe tara gharabAra tyAgenan (kAphira bastImai rahe) unIharU jabasamma gharabAra tyAgera Au~dainan tabasamma unIharUko saMrakSaNako kunai jimmevArI timImAthi chaina | tara yadi unIharU dharmako mAmilAmA timIsa~ga maddata cAhanchan bhane unIharUko sahayoga garnu timrolAgi anivArya cha | tara yastA samudAyaviruddha hoina josa~ga timro sandhi bhaekocha | ra, allAhale timrA sampUrNa kAryaharUlAI dekhirahekA chan |
ra, jo mAnisaharU kAphira bhae tinIharU eka arkAkA sahayogI–mitra hun, ra (he AsthAvAnaharU ho!) yadi timIharUle yaso garenau bhane dhartImA upadrava tathA ThUlo vidhvaMsa maccinecha |

jasale ImAna lyAe, hijarata gare, allAhako mArgamA yuddha gare ra jasale gharabAra tyAgneharUlAI Azraya die tathA unIharUko sahayoga gare tinIharU nai saccA AsthAvAnaharU hun | tinakAnimti kSamAdAna tathA pratiSThita jIvikA raheko cha |

ra, juna mAnisaharUle pachi ImAna lyAe, ra gharabAra tyAge ra timIharUsa~ga milera yuddha gare, tI sabai timIharUmadhyekai hun | ra, nAtedAraharU allAhako AdezAnusAra eka arkAko baDhI hakadAra hunchan | nizcaya nai allAha hareka vastukA jJAtA hun |
allAha tathA unakA rasUlako tarphabATa josa~ga timIle sandhi garekA thiyau, tI muzrikaharUkAlAgi sandhi bhaGgako ghoSaNA cha |
ani (he, bahudevavAdIharU ho!) ajha cAra mahinAsamma timIharU dhartImA ghumaphira gara ra jAnirAkha timIharU allAhalAI vivaza pArna sakdainau ra allAha kAphiraharUlAI apamAnita garnevAlA chan |,

ra, mahAn hajako dina mAnisaharUkAlAgi allAha tathA unakA rasUlako tarphabATa ke sArvajanika ghoSaNA cha bhane allAhalAI bahudevavAdIharUprati kunai vAstA chaina ra unakA rasUlalAI pani | ataH yadi timIharU prAyazcita garchau bhane yo timrailAgi rAmro hunecha ra yadi timIharU vimukha hunchau bhane jAnirAkha timIharU allAhalAI vivaza pArna sakdainau | ra, (he sandeSTA) kAphiraharUlAI kaThora yAtanAko zubha sUcanA deU |,

tI bahudevavAdIharUbAheka josa~ga timIle sandhi garyau ani tinIharUle timIsa~ga na kunai kamI kamajorI dekhAe na timIharUviruddha kasaiko sahayoga nai gare, tyastA vyaktiharUsa~ga timIharU pani sandhiko myAda pUrA gara | nissandeha allAha bhaya rAkhneharUlAI mana parAu~chan |

ani pratiSThita mahinAharU samApta bhaepachi muzrikaharUlAI jahA~kahI~ pAu~chau hatyA gara; giraphtAra gara; ghera ra hareka chApA mArne ThAu~mA tinIharUko tAkamA basa | tara yadi tinIharUle prAyazcita garchan; namAja kAyama garchan; jakAta cuktA garchan bhane tinIharUko bATo choDideU | nizcaya nai allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |,

ra, yadi bahudevavAdIharUmadhye kasaile timro zaraNa mAgcha bhane tyasalAI zaraNa deU yahA~samma ki U allAhako vANI sunos | pheri usalAI usako surakSita gantabyamA puryAideU, kinabhane tinIharU ajJAnI vyaktiharU hun |,

allAha tathA unakA rasUla sita bahudevavAdIharUkAe sandhi kasarI huna sakcha ra? tI bahudevavAdIharUbAheka josa~ga timIle pratiSThita masjida najika sandhi garyau, yadi tinIharU timrolAgi Aphno sandhimA kAyama rahanchan bhane timI pani tinIharukAlAgi kAyama rahane gara | nissandeha allAha Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI mana parAu~dachan |,

(tara arU bahudevavAdIharUsa~ga) sandhi kasarI bA~kI rahana sakcha? timIharUmAthi tinIharU vijayI bhaeko khaNDamA timIharUbAre na sAinoko mAna maryAdA rAkhchan na sandhiko nai | tinIharU Aphno mukhale ta timIharUlAI rAjI garne prayAsa garchan tara tinIharuko hRdaya mAndainan ra tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza avajJAkArI hun |
tinIharUle allAhakA AyataharUlAI tuccha mUlyamA bece| tesaile mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa roke | tinIharUle garne garekA kArya avazya nai nikRSTa hun |,
tinIharU kunai pani AsthAvAnasa~gako mAmilAmA na nAtedArIko paravAha garchan na samjhautAko maryAdA nai rAkhchan ra tinIharU sImA ullaGghanakArIharU nai hun |,
ataH yadi tinIharU prAyazcita garchan; namAja kAyama garchan ra jakAta cuktA garchan bhane tinIharU timrA dhArmika dAjubhAi hun | ra, hAmI jJAnIharUkAlAgi AdezaharU spaSTa garidinchauM |

ra, yadi tinIharU vAcA garera AphnA vacanaharU toDchan ra timro dharmamAthi AkramaNa garchan bhane timI pani yI kuphrakA aguvAharUsa~ga yuddha gara kinabhane tinIharUkA vacanaharu rahena | tAki tinIharU rokiUn |

ke timIharU tyastA mAnisaharUsa~ga yuddha gardainau jasale AphnA kasamaharU toDe; rasUlalAI dezanikAlA garne nizcaya gare ra yinIharUle nai (yuddhako) pahala gare? ke timIharU yastA mAnisaharUsita DarAu~chau? jabaki allAha yasakA adhika hakadAra hun ki timIharU unIsita DarAU, yadi timIharU AsthAvAna hau bhane |

tinIharUviruddha yuddha gara | allAhale tinIharUlAI timro hAtabATa yAtanA dinechan; tinIharUlAI apamAnita garnechan ra timIharUlAI tinIharUviruddha sahayoga puryAunechan ani AsthAvAnaharUkA hRdayalAI zItalatA pradAna garnechan |
ra, allAhale tinIharUkA hRdayako krodhalAI samApta pArnechan, ani jasalAI cAhanchan tyasatarpha dayAdRSTi garchan | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvajJa chan |

ke timIharUlAI tetikai choDinecha bhanne ThAnekA chau jabaki allAhale timIharUlAI ahilesamma jAnekai chainan ki kasale (allAhako mArgamA) athaka saGgharSa gare ra allAha, unakA rasUla tathA AsthAvAnaharUbAheka kasailAI ghaniSTa mitra banAenan? allAha timIharUle garirahekA sampUrNa kAryabAre jAnakAra chan |

allAhakA mashajidarU AvAda garnu bahudevavAdIharUko kAma hoina jabaki tinIharU AphUviruddha kuphrako sAkSI diirahekA chan | tinIharUkA sampUrNa kAryaharU akArtha hunechan ra tinIharU sadA–sarvadA narakamA rahanechan |

allAhakA masjidaharU ta tinIharU AvAda rAkhchan jo allAha tathA paralAekakAe dinamAthi ImAna rAkhdachan; namAja kAyama garchan tathA jakAta cuktA garchan ra allAhabAheka anya kasaisita DarAu~dainan | ani AzA cha, yinIharUle nai satmArga pAunechan |

ke timIharUle hAjIharUlAI pAnI khuvAune ra pratiSThita masjida (kaabA) ko sambhAra garne kAryalAI tI vyaktiharUle gareko kAmasa~ga barAbara ThAnekA chau jo allAha evaM antima dinamAthi ImAna rAkhdacha ra allAhako mArgamA yuddha garchan? vAstavamA tInIharU allAhako dRSTimA barAbara chainan | ra, allAha atyAcArIharUlAI mArga dekhAu~dainan |
juna mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAe; gharabAra tyAge ra dhana ra jyAnale allAhako mArgamA yuddha gare allAhakahA~ tinIharUkAlAgi uccatama darjA raheko cha ani tinIharU nai saphala hunechan |
tinIharUkA pAlanakartAle tinIharUlAI Aphno tarphabATa dayA, prasannatA tathA yastA bagai~cAko zubhasandeza dinchan jahA~ tinIharUkAlAgi sthAyI Ananda–sAmagrI raheko cha |
tinIharU tyasamA sadAsarvadA rahanechan | nissandeha allAhakahA~ mahAn pratidAna raheko cha |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timrA pitA tathA dAjubhAiharU ImAnalAI bhandA kuphralAI (baDhI) mana parAu~chan bhane tinIharUlAI saMrakSaka–mitra nabanAU ra jasale tinIharUlAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAu~chan tinIharU nai atyAcArI hun |

(he sandeSTA )! bhanideU– yadi timrA pitAharU, chorAharu, dAjubhAiharU, patnIharu, nAtedAraharU, timIharUle Arjana gareko sampatti, vyApAra, jasamA mandI hunabATa DarAu~chau ani timIharUle mana parAekA gharaharU (sabai) allAha, unakA rasUla ra unako mArgamA yuddha garnu bhandA baDhI priya chan bhane allAhale Aphno nirNaya paThAuJjela parkha | ra, allAhale avajJAkArI mAnisaharUlAI satmArga dekhAu~dainan |

allAhale dherai avasaraharUmA timro sahayoga garisakekA chan ra ‘hunaina’ (yuddha) ko dina pani, jaba timIharUlAI timro ThUlo saMkhyAle ahaGkArI banAekAe thiyo, tara tyasale timIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAena ra pRthvI vistRta hu~dAhu~dai pani timIharUkAnimti sA~ghuro bhaekAe thiyo ani timIharU piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgyau |

tyasa pazcAta allAhale AphnA rasUla tathA AsthAvAnaharUkA lAgi nizcintatA avatarita gare ra yastA sainikaharU paThAe jo timrAlAgi adRzya thie | ani unale kAphiraharUlAI yAtanA die ra yahI nai kAphiraharUko pratiphala huncha |
ani yasapachi pani allAha jasalAI cAhanchan parayazcita garne avasara dinchan ra allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! muzrikaharU apavitra hun | tasartha tinIharU yasa varSapachi pratiSThita masjida (kaabA) nikaTa jAna napAUn ra yadi timIharUlAI daridratAko bhaya cha bhane allAhale cAhemA Aphno varadAnale timIharUlAI sampanna tulyAunechan | nissandeha allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ahle kitAbaharUmadhye tI mAnisaharUsa~ga tabasamma yuddha gara, jo allAha evaM AkhiratamAthi ImAna lyAu~dainan; allAha tathA unakA rasUlale avaidha garekA cijaharUlAI avaidha ThAndainan ra satya dharmakAe anuzaraNa gardainan, yahA~samma ki tinIharU apamAnita bhaera Aphno hAtale jijayA (rakSA kara) tirUn |

ani, yahudIharU bhanchan– “ujaira allAhakA putra hun |” ra, IsAIharU bhanchan– “masIha (jisasa krAisTa) allAhakA putra hun |” yI kevala tinIharUkA maukhika kurAharU hun | tinIharU AphUbhandA pahilekA kAphiraharUko bhanAiko nakkala gardaichan | allAhako prakopa tinIharUmAthi paros | tinIharU kahA~ bhaDkirahekAchan!

tinIharUle AphnA dharmajJAtA ra sanyAsIharUlAI allAhabAhekakA ‘raba’ banAekA chan ra (tyastai) marayama putra IsAlAI pani, jabaki tinIharUlAI kevala eka Izvarakai bhaktiko Adeza diieko thiyo | unIbAheka kohI upAsya chaina, unI tinIharUle tulyAirahekA zirkabATa pavitra chan |
tinIharU Aphno mukhale allAhako jyotilAI nibhAuna cAhanchan jabaki allAhale Aphno prakAzalAI pUrNa garerai chADne chan, yaddhapi kAphiraharUle (rattibhara) mana naparAUn |
unai hun jasale AphnA rasUlalAI mArgadarzana tathA satya–dharmakAsAtha paThAe tAki yasalAI anya sampUrNa dIna (dharma) harUmAthi vijayI banAUn, cAhe bahudevavAdIharUlAI apriya nai kina nalAgos |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! vAstavamA dheraijaso dharmaguru evaM sanyAsIharU mAnisaharUkA sampatti anucita tarIkAle khAnchan ra allAhako mArgabATa rokchan ani juna vyaktiharU suna tathA cA~dI jammA garchan ra tyasalAI allAhako mArgamA kharca gardainan tinIharUlAI duHkhadAyI yAtanAko zubha sUcanA sunAideU |

tyasa dina yasa (suna–cA~dI) lAI narakako agnimA tatAinecha ani tyasabATa tinIharUko nidhAra, kAkhI evaM piThyU~harU DAminecha (ra bhaninecha) yI tinai vastuharU hun juna timIharUle svayaMkAlAgi jammA garekA thiyau | lau aba svayaMle jammA gareko dhanako svAda cAkha!

allAhakahA~ mahinAharUko gaNanA tyasai dinadekhi unako kitAbamA bAhra raheko cha, junadina unale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko sirjanA gare | tyasamadhye cAra mahinA AdarakA chan | yahI sidhA dIna ho | ani yI mahinAharUmA (yudha garera) svayaMmAthi atyAcAra nagarnU | ra, timIharU sabai milera muzrikaharU viruddha yuddha gara jasarI tinIharU sabai milera timIharUviruddha yuddha garchan | ra, jAnirAkha allAha Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA sAthamA chan |

vAstavamA nasI (mahinAharUlAI aghipachi sArne kArya) kevala kuphramA bRddhI garnu ho | yasadvArA kAphiraharUlAI nai pathabhraSTa garincha | eka varSa ta tinIharU tyasalAI vaidha ThAndachan ra arko varSa tyasailAI avaidha tAki tinIharUle allAhale avaidha garekA mahinAharUko saMkhyA pUrgaNa rUna ani allAhale avaidha garekAlAI vaidha garUn | tinIharUkA kukarrmaharUlAI tinIharuko dRSTimA sundara dekhAieko cha ra allAhale kAphiraharUlAI satyamArga dekhAu~dainan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUlAI ke bhaeko cha ki jaba timIharUlAI allAhako mArgamA (yuddhako lAgi) niska bhanI nirdezana diincha taba timIharU dhartItarpha Dhalchau? ke timIharU AkhiratalAI choDera sAMsArika jIvanalAI nai rAejekA chau? sAMsArika jIvanako lAbha ta Akhiratako tulanAmA dherai tuccha raheko cha |

yadi timIharU niskenau bhane allAhale timIharUlAI duHkhadAyI yAtanA dinechan ra timIharUko sthAnamA anya jAtilAI lyAunechan ra timIharUle unalAI kunai kSati puryAuna sakne chainau | ra, allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

yadi timIharU una (muhammada sa.) lAI sahayoga gardainau bhane (nagara), allAhale unalAI sahayoga pradAna garisakekA chan jaba unalAI kAphiraharUle unako gharabATa niSkAsita garidiekA thie | unI duIjanAmadhye dozrA thie ra duvai (saura nAmaka) guphAmA thie | tyasa samayamA sandeSTAle AphnA sAthIlAI bhanekA thie– “cintita nahoU; nissandeha allAha hAmIharUkA sAthamA chan |” ani allAhale unIharUmAthi Aphno tarphabATa nizcintatA pradAna gare ra unIharUlAI yastA senAharUdvArA sahayoga gare jasalAI timIharU dekhdainathyau | ani, unale kAphiraharUko bhanAilAI hAecAe tulyAe ra allAhako bhanAi nai sarvopari rahane cha | ra, allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
halukA ra bhArI duvai avasthAmA timIharU niskihAla ra Aphno dhana–sampatti tathA dilojyAnale allAhako mArgamA yuddha gara | yadi timIharUbhitra jJAna cha bhane yahI timIharUko nimti uttama ho |

(he sandeSTA!) yadi sighra prApta hune dhana ra choTo yAtrA bhaeko bhae tinIharU avazya nai timIsa~ga jAna tayAra hune thie tara tinIharUmAthi kaThina yAtrAko vipatti Aeko cha | aba tinIharU allAhako kasama khAera bhannechan “yadi hAmIharUmA zakti bhaeko bhae tapAIsa~ga avazya niskane thiyauM |” (yasto bahAnA garera) tinIharU AphulAI nai vinAza pArdaichan | ra, nizcaya nai tinIharU mithyAvAdI hun bhanne allAhalAI thAhA cha |
(he sandeSTA!) allAhale timIlAI kSamA pradAna garUn | sA~co bolne vA mithyAvAdIharUlAI rAmrarI naThamyAIkana timIle tinIharUlAI kina anumati diyau?

allAha evaM AkhiratamAthi AsthA rAkhne vyaktiharU Aphno jyAna ra dhanakAsAtha garine yuddhabATa pachADi haTnakAlAgi kahilyai timIsita anumati mAgne chainan | ra allAha Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |
timIsa~ga anumati mAgne vyaktiharU tinIharU hun jo allAha evaM paralAekakA dinamAthi AsthA rAkhdainan | ra jasako hRdaya sandehamA parekocha, tinIharU Aphno sandehamai parirahekA chan |

ra yadi tinIharUmA (yuddhakolAgi) prasthAna garne manasAya bhaeko bhae tyasakAnimti tinIharUle avazya kehI tayArI garne thie | tara allAhale tinIharUko ubhine kAryalAI mana parAenan ani allAhale tinIharUlAI susta banAI die ra bhaniyo– “timIharU basneharusa~ga basirahu |”

yadi tinIharU timIharUsa~ga niskekA bhae timIharUko barbAdImA nai bRddhi garne thie ra timIharUbIca upadrava maccAunakAlAgi nai bhAgadauDa garne thie | ra timIharUbIca unakA kehI guptacaraharU pani chan | ra, atyAcArIharUlAI allAha rAmrarI jAndachan |

tinIharUle yasabhandAaghi pani upadrava maccAune prayAsa gardai AekA chan ra timIlAI asaphala pArna hareka prakArakA upAyaharU garekA chan yahA~samma ki satyako Agamana bhaI sakyo ra allAhako Adeza sarvopari bhayo, jabaki tinIharU yasto cAha~dainathe |

ra tinIharUmadhye yasto vyakti pani cha jasale bhancha– “malAI anumati dinuhos ra malAI parikSA napArhonuhAes |” jAnI rAkha yinIharu parikSAmA parisakekA chan | ra nissandeha narakale kAphiraharUlAI cAraitirabATa gherAmA lieko cha |

(he muhammada sa.) timIlAI sukha prApta bhaemA tinIharUlAI narAmro lAgcha tara timImAthi saGkaTa AiparemA prasanna hu~dai tinIharU mukha pharkAera bhanchan– “hAmIle pahile nai Aphno mAmilA ThIka pArisakekA thiyauM |”
bhanideU– “hAmImAthi allAhale lekhekobAheka arU kunai saGkaTa Aune chaina |” unI nai hAmrA kAryasAghaka hun | ra, AsthAvAnaharUle unaimAthi bharosA rAkhnupardacha |

bhanideU– “timIharU hAmrolAgi juna kurAko pratIkSA gardaichau tyo kevala duI uttama vastumadhye euTA ho (vijaya vA zahAdata) | tara, hAmI timIharUkAlAgi ke apekSA garchauM bhane, ki ta allAhale svayaM timIharUlAI yAtanA diUn vA unale hAmro hAtabATa daNDa diUn | ani timIharU pratIkSA gara | nissandeha hAmI pani timIharUsa~gai pratIkSA garchauM |”
bhanideU– “timIharU icchApUrvaka (dhana) kharca gara vA anicchApUrvaka, timIharUko tyo (kharca) kadApi kabula garine chaina, vAstavamA timIharU avajJAkArI mAnisaharu hau |”
tinIharUko dAna asvIkAra hune kAraNa yo mAtra ho ki tinIharU allAha tathA unakA rasUlakAsAtha kuphra garthe ra namAjamA pani DhilAsustI garthe ani anicchApUrvaka kharca garthe |

ani tinIharUkA dhana–sampatti tathA santAnaharUle timIlAI dhAekAmA napArUn | allAha unIharUlAI yI cijaharUdvArA sAMsArika jIvanamA daNDa dina cAhanchan ra tinIharUko prANa anAsthAko avasthAmA nai nikliyos bhanne cAhanchan |
ra, tinIharU allAhako kasama khAera bhanchan– “hAmI timIharUmadhyekai hauM |” tara vAstavamA tinIharU timIharUmadhyekA hoinan | tinIharU ta (timIharUsita) DarAunekhAlakA mAnisaharU hun |
yadi tinIharUle Azrayasthala, guphAharU vA chirne euTA pvAla mAtra pAe bhane pani tinIharU nizcaya nai jabarjastI tyasamA luknechan |
ra, tinIharUmadhye yastA vyaktiharU pani chan jo dAnaharU ko silasilAmA timImAthi AkSepa lagAu~chan | yadi yasabATa tinIharUlAI diiyo bhane prasanna hunchan ra yadi diiena bhane turunta risAu~chan |

ra, kati rAmro hune thiyo yadi allAha tathA unakA rasUlale pradAna gareko dhanabATa tinIharU santuSTa bhaekA bhae, ra yo bhanekA bhae ki allAha nai hAmrolAgi paryApta chan | allAha Aphno anugrahale ajha thapnechan ra unakA rasUlale kRpA garne chan | hAmI ta allAhatarpha nai AzAko dRSTi lagAirahekAchauM |

sadkA ta kevala daridraharU, abhAva grastaharU ra sadkAko vyavasthApanamA niyukta vyaktiharUkAlAgi ho, ra tI vyaktiharUkAlAgi jasakA hRdayaharUlAI joDnu abhiSTa hos; (sAthai yo dAnakoSa) dAsaharUko mukti, RNIharU (ko RNa bhuktAnI) kA lAgi, allAhako mArgamA ra yAtrIharUkAnimti ho | yo allAhako tarphabATa anivArya Adeza ho | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ani, tinIharUmadhye yastA vyaktiharU pani chan jo nabIlAI dukhita tulyAu~chan ra bhanchan– “unI ta halukA kAnakA (arthAt harekakA kurA sunnevAlA) rahechan!” bhanideU– “unI timIharUko bhalAikAnimti nai sundachan | unI allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhdachan ra AsthAvAnaharUko kurAmA bharosA gardachan | ra timIharUmadhye AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi sarvathA dayA raheko cha |” ra, allAhakA rasUlalAI dukhita pArneharUkAlAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA raheko cha |

(he AsthAvAnaharU ho!) yinIharU timIharUlAI prasanna pArna allAhako kasam khAnchan | tara yadi tinIharU (vAstavika) AsthAvAna hun bhane allAha tathA unakA rasUla yasa kurAkolAgi adhika hakadAra chan ki unIharUle unalAI prasanna pArUn |
ke tinIharUlAI thAhA chaina ki jasale allAha tathA unakA rasUlako virodha garcha usakolAgi narakako agni tayAra cha jahA~ U sadA rahanuparnecha | tyahI ta ThUlo apamAna ho |

munAphikaharU AphUviruddha musalamAnaharUmAthi kunai yasto sUraha (adhyAya) avatarita holA bhanI DarAu~chan jasale tinIharUko hRdayakA kurA musalamAnaharU samakSa spaSTa garidinecha | bhanideU– “timIharU ajhai ThaTTA gara | avazya nai allAha tyasa (bheda) lAI vyakta garnechan jasako timIharUlAI Dara cha |”

ra, yadi timIle tinIharUlAI (ke kurA gardai thiyau bhanI) sodhyau bhane tinIharUle spaSTa rUpamA bhannechan– “hAmI tyasai gaphasapha ra khyAla ThaTTA gardai thiyauM |” bhanideU– “ke timIharU allAha, unakA AyataharU ra unakA rasUlako ThaTTA gardai thiyau?”

aba bahAnA nagara | timIharUle ImAnapachi kuphramA pharkisakekA chau | yadi hAmIle timIharUmadhye euTA samUhalAI kSamA garidie pani arko samUhalAI avazya daNDa dinechauM kinabhane tinIharU aparAdhI hun |

sabai munAphika (DhoMgI) puruSa tathA munAphika mahilAharU ekaarkAmadhyekA hun | tinIharU kukarmako Adeza dinchan; ra puNya–karmabATa rokchan ra (kharca garnabATa) AphnA hAta rAekirAkhchan | tinIharUle allAhalAI birse tasartha allAhale pani tinIharUlAI birse | nissandeha munAphikaharU sImAellaghanakArI hun |

allAhale munAphika ra kAphira puruSa tathA mahilAharUsa~ga narakako agniko vAcA garekA chan jasamA tinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | tyo tinIharUkAlAgi paryApta hunecha | tinIharUmAthi allAhako dhikkAra raheko cha ra tinIharUkAlAgi sthAyI yAtanA raheko cha |

(timI munAphikaharU) tI vyaktiharUjastai chau jo timIharUbhandA zakti, dhana tathA santAnamA baDhI thie | ra, tinIharUle Aphno bhAgyako lAbha uThAisake | ataH jasarI timIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUle Aphno bhAgyako lAbha uThAekA chan tyasarI timIharUle pani Aphno bhAgyako lAbha uThAi sakyAai ra jasarI tinIharU asatya (vAdavivAda) mA vyasta rahe tyasarI nai timIharU pani asatyamA vyasta rahyau | yI tI vyaktiharU hun jasale garekA karmaharU loka evaM paraloka duvaimA bekAra bhae ra tinIharU nai ghATA behorneharU hun |

ke yinIharUlAI AphUbhandA pahilekA nUha, Ada, samUda tathA ibrAhImakA jAti ra madyanabAsI tathA palTAiekA gAu~harUko bAremA jAnakArI prApta bhaeko chaina? tinIharUsamakSa tinakA rasUlaharU spaSTa pramANaharUkA sAtha Ae (tara tinIharUle mAnenan) ra allAha tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garnevAlA thienan baru tinIharUle svayaM AphUmAthi atyAcAra gare |

AsthAvAna puruSa tathA mahilAharU eka arkAkA saMrakSaka–mitra hun | unIharU puNya karmako Adeza dinchan ra kukarmabATa rokchan; namAja kAyama garchan; jakAta cuktA garchan ra allAha tathA unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana garchan | yinIharU nai hun jasamAthi allAhale cADaiM nai dayA garnechan | nissandeha allAha sarvazaktimAna evaM tatvajJa chan |

allAhale AsthAvAna puruSa tathA mahilAharUsita yastA bagaiMcAharUko vAcA garekA chan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU kalakala bagirahekA hunechan | unIharU tyasamA sadA–sarvadA rahanechan | sadAbahAra bagaiMcAharUmA rahekA AnandadAyI bhavanaharUko pani (unIharUsa~ga vAcA garieko cha) | ra, allAhako prasannatA ta sabaibhandA mahAn ho | yahI nai atyanta ThUlo saphalatA ho |
he nabI! kAphira tathA munAphikaharUviruddha jihAda gara ra tinIharUprati kaDAi gara | tinIharUko bAsasthAna naraka ho | ra, kati nikRSTa bAsasthAna ho tyo |

yinIharU allAhako kasama khAera bhanchan– “tyo kurA tinIharUle bhanekA chainan” jabaki tinIharUle kuphrako bolI bolekA chan ra tinIharU islAma grahaNa garepachi kAphira bhaekA chan | ra, tinIharUle yasto kAryako ceSTA gare jasamA tinIharU saphala huna sakenan | yinIharUle kevala yasa kurAko badalA liekA chan ki yinIharUlAI allAhale Aphno anugraha evaM unakA rasUlale Aphno kRpAbATa sampanna banAidiekA chan | yadi tinIharU prAyazcita garchan bhane tinIharUlAI nai rAmro hunecha ra yadi tinIharU mukha moDchan bhane allAhale tinIharUlAI loka ra paraloka duvaimA duHkhadAyI yAtanA dinechan | ra, dhartImA tinIharUko na kohI saMrakSaka–mitra hunecha na kohI sahayogI nai |

ra, tinIharUmadhye kehI mAnisaharU yastA pani chan jasale allAhasita pratijJA garekA thie ki yadi allAha Aphno anukampAbATa (dhana) pradAna garchan bhane hAmI avazya nai dAna garnechauM ra avazya nai satkarmIharUmadhye bannechauM |
tara jaba allAhale Aphno kRpAbATa sampanna tulyAe taba tinIharU kaJjusa huna puge ra kunai vAstai nagarI (pratijJAbATa) vimukha bhae |

ataH allAhale AphUsa~ga garekA vAcA bhaGga gareko ra jhuTho boleko pariNAmasvarUpa tinIharUko hRdayamA tyasa dinasammakAlAgi niphAka (kapaTa) utpanna garidie juna dina tinIharUko bheTa allAhasa~ga hunecha |
allAha tinIharUkA gopya rahasya evaM kAnekhusIlAI jAndachan bhanne kurA ke tinIharUlAI thAhA chaina ra? allAha parokSako kurAharUko pani rAmrarI jJAna rAkhdachan |

jo svecchApUrvaka dAna garne AsthAvAnaharUko Arthika balidAnamAthi TikATippaNI garchan ra tI vyaktiharUko upahAsa garchan josa~ga yasabAheka kehI hu~daina juna tinIharU mihineta majadurI garera dinchan | allAha tI upahAsa garneharUko upahAsa garchan | ra, tinIharUkAlAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA cha |

(he muhammada sa.!) timI yastA vyaktiharUkAlAgi kSamAko prArthanA gara vA nagara (euTai kurA ho) | timIle tinIharUkAlAgi sattarI paTakasamma kSamAko prArthanA garyau bhane pani allAhale tinIharUlAI kSamA garne chainan kinabhane tinIharule allAha tathA unakA rasUlako inkAra gare | ra allAha avajJAkArIharulAI sIdhAmArga dekhAu~dainan |

(tabUka yuddhamA) pachADi rahaneharU allAhakA rasUla birUddha basna pAekomA prasanna thie ra unIharU Aphno dhana tathA jyAnale jihAda garna rucAenan ani (arUlAI) bhane– “garmImA yuddhakA lAgi bAhira naniska| ” bhanideU– “narakako agni ta yo bhandA pani adhika tAto cha |” tinIharUle bujhna sakekA bhae kati rAmro hune thiyo |
yinIharU alikati hA~sUn ra dherai roUn, tI karmaharUkA kAraNa juna tinIharUle gardai AekA chan |

(he muhammada sa.!) yadi allAhale timIlAI yinIharUkA kunai samUhabIca phirtA lyAu~chan bhane ra yinIharUle timIsa~ga (yuddhako maidAnamA) niskane anumati mAgchan bhane bhanideU– “timIharU masa~ga kahilyai pani niskana sakdainau ra masa~ga milera kunai zatruviruddha kadApi yuddha garna sakdainau | timIharUle pahilo paTaka nai basna rUcAyau ataH pachADi basneharUsa~gai basi rAkha |”,

ra, tinIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyU bhaemA kahilyai usako ‘janAjA’ (antima saMskAra) ko namAja napaDha ra kahilyai usako cihAnanira khaDA nahoU kinabhane tinIharUle allAha tathA unakA rasUlalAI inkAra gare ra avajJAkArI bhaerai mare |

tinIharUko dhana tathA santAna (zakti) bATa timIlAI bhrama nahos | allAhale tinIharUlAI yI vastuharUdvArA sAMsArika jIvanamA daNDa dina cAhanchan ra tinIharUko prANa kAphira bhaekai avasthAmA jAos bhanne cAhanchan |

ani, jaba allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhne tathA unakA rasUlasita milera jihAda garne kurAmA AdhArita sUraha avatarita huncha taba tinIharUmadhyekA dhanI vyaktiharU timIsita anumati mAgdachan ra bhandachan– “hAmIlAI basneharUsa~ga basna deU |”,
tinIharU pachADi basneharUsa~gai basna mana parAu~chan | tinIharUko mana–maStiskamA sila lagAieko cha tyasaile tinIharU bujhdainan |
tara, rasUla tathA unakA AsthAvAna sAthIharU Aphno jyAna ra dhanale jihAda gare | unIharUkAlAgi nai uttama cijaharU chan ra unIharU nai saphala hunechan |
allAhale unIharUkAlAgi yastA bagaiMcAharU tayAra pArekA chan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA chan | unIharU tyasamA sadA rahanechan ra yo mahAn saphalatA ho |

arabakA gAu~leharUmadhyekA vyaktiharU bahAnA banAera Ae tAki tinIharUlAI (gharamai basne) anumati diiyos ra allAha tathA unakA rasUlasita jhuTho bolne vyaktiharU gharamai basirahe | ani yinIharUmadhye kAphira mAnisaharUlAI duHkhadAyI yAtanA avazya pugnecha |

durbala, rogI tathA kharca garna nasakne vyaktiharU (jihAdamA nagae pani unIharU) mAthi kunai doSa chaina, yasa zartamA ki unIharU allAha tathA unakA rasUlaprati pUrNa sadbhAva rAkhUn | (yastA) sukarmIharUviruddha abhiyogako kunai bATo nai chaina | ra, allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

na tI vyaktiharUmAthi (kunai doSa cha) jo timIkahA~ yo bhandai Au~chan ki malAi (jihAdakAlAgi) kunai savArI dinu ra timI yo bhanchau– “masa~ga timrolAgi kunai savArI chaina |” unIharU AphUsita kharca garna kehI nabhaeko pirale A~khAbATa dhardharI A~su bagAu~dai pharkanchan |

doSa ta tI vyaktiharUmAthi cha jo dhanI hu~dAhu~dai pani timIsita anumati mAgna Au~chan | tinIharU pachADi rahaneharu (mahilA) sa~ga basna rucAu~chan ra allAhale tinIharUkA mana–mastiSkamA sila lagAidiekA chan | ataH tinIharU kehI jAndainan |

jaba timI tinIharUtarpha pharkera jAnechau taba tinIharU timIsa~ga vibhinna kisimakA bahAnA banAunechan | bhanideU– “bahAnA nabanAU; hAmI timIharUko kunai kurAmA vizvAsa garne chainauM | allAhale hAmIlAI timIharUkA sampUrNa sthitiharUbAre sUcita garisakekA chan ra AindA pani allAha tathA unakA rasUlale timIharUkA kriyAkalApa hernechan | ani timIharU adRzya tathA dRzya (vAstavikatAharU) kA jJAtA (allAha) tarpha pharkAinechau ra unale timIharUlAI timIharUle garekA kAryaharUbAre avagata garAunechan |”

jaba timI tinIharUtarpha pharkanechau taba tinIharUle timIsamakSa allAhako kasama khAnechan tAki timIle tinIharUlAI tinIharU kai avasthAmA chADideU | ataH tinIharUlAI tinIharUkai avasthAmA chADideU, tinIharU phohora hun ra tinIharUle garne garekA kAryako pratiphalasvarUpa tinIharUko bAsasthAna naraka nai raheko cha |
tinIharUle timIsamakSa kasama khAnechan tAki timI tinIharUsita prasanna hoU | ra, timI tinIharUsa~ga prasanna bhaetA pani allAha cAhi~ yastA avajJAkArI mAnisaharUsita prasanna hune chainan |

(arabakA) gAu~leharU kuphra tathA niphAka (kapaTa) mA atyantai rahekA chan | ra, tinIharUkAlAgi yahI nai ucita cha ki allAhale AphnA rasUlamAthi avataraNa garekA AdezaharUsita tinIharU anabhijJa rahUn ra allAha sarvajJa tathA tatvadarzI chan |

ani, tI gAu~leharUmadhye kehI yastA vyaktiharU chan jasale AphUle kharca garne kurAlAI svayaMmAthi harjAnA ThAndachan ra timImAthi narAmro samaya AilAgos bhanne kurAko pratIkSAmA rahanchan | jabaki tinIharUmAthi nai narAmro samaya AilAgeko cha ra allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

ra, kehI gAu~leharU yastA pani chan jo allAha tathA AkhiratamAthi AsthA rAkhchan ra Aphno kharcalAI allAhako nikaTatA prApti tathA rasUlako AzIrvAda prAptiko sAdhana banAu~chan | hera, tyo nizcaya nai unIharUkAlAgi nikaTatA prAptiko sAdhana ho | allAhale unIharUlAI avazya nai Aphno anukampA antargata linechan | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

muhAjira (ApravAsI) tathA ansAra (sahayogI) harUmadhye pahile agrasaratA dekhAuneharU ra jasale tyasapachi niSThAsAtha unIharUko anusaraNa gare allAha tI sabaisita prasanna bhae ra tinIharU (pani) allAhasita prasanna bhae | ra, allAhale unIharUkAlAgi yastA bagaiMcAharU tayAra pArekA chan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan ra unIharU tyasamA sadAsarvadA rahanechan | yahi ThUlo saphalatA ho |

ra, timro varipari basne gAu~le tathA madInAbAsIharUmadhye kehI yastA munAphikaharU chan jo niphAkamA dRDha chan | timI tinIharUlAI cindainau; hAmI cAhi~ tinIharUlAI jAndachauM | hAmI tinIharUlAI dohoro yAtanA dinechauM ani tinIharU ati ThUlo yAtanAtarpha pharkAinechan |

ra, tinIharUmadhye kehI yastA pani chan jasale AphnA pApaharUlAI svIkArekA chan | tinIharUle mizrita karma garekA thie; kehI puNyakarma ra kehI duSkarmaharU | AzA cha ki allAhale unIharUlAI kSamA pradAna garnechan | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

(he nabI sa.!) unIharUko dhanabATa ‘sadakA’ (dAna) svIkAra gara, yasadvArA unIharUlAI timI pavitratA ra zuddhatA pradAna garnechau | ra unIharUko hitamA prArthanA gara, nissandeha timro prArthanA unIharUkA lAgi zAntiprada cha | ra, allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |
ke tinIharUlAI thAhA chaina ki allAhale nai AphnA bhaktaharUko taubA svIkAra garchan ra sadakA kabula garchan | ra, nizcaya nai allAha ati kSamAzila evaM parama dayAlu chan |

ra, (he nabI sa.!) bhanideU– “timIharU karma gardai jAU; allAha, unakA rasUla ra AsthAvAnaharUle timIharUkA karmaharU hernechan | ra, timIharU dRzya tathA adRzya kurAharUkA jJAtAtarpha pharkAinechau ani unale timIharUlAI timIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUbAre avagata garAunechan |”
ra, anya kehI yastA vyaktiharU chan jasako mAmilA allAhako Adeza naAuJjela sthagita garieko cha cAhe unale tinIharUlAI yAtanA diUn vA mApha garUn | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ani, kehI yastA vyaktiharU pani chan jasale hAni puryAune, inkAra garne, AsthAvAnaharUbIca matabheda utpanna garne ra yasaaghi allAha tathA unakA rasUlaviruddha yuddha garisakekA mAnisaharUkAlAgi ghAta sthala upalabdha garAune uddezyale euTA masjida nirmANa gare | ra, tinIharUle kasama khAnechan ki bhalAI bAheka hAmro aru kunai irAdA thiena | tara tinIharU pakkA mithyAvAdI hun bhanera allAhale sAkSI dinchan |

(he nabI sa.!) timI tyasa masjidabhitra kahilyai khaDA nahoU | barU juna masjidako nirmANa pahilo dinadekhi nai IzaparAyaNatAko AdhAramA bhaeko thiyo tyo yasa kurAkolAgi baDhI upayukta cha ki timI tyasabhitra ubhine gara | tyasabhitra yastA mAnisaharU chan jo ati pavitra rahana mana parAu~chan | ra, allAha pani pavitra rahaneharUlAI mana parAu~chan |

ke jasale Aphno bhavanako jaga allAhako bhaya evaM unako prasannatAmAthi rAkhcha tyo vyakti rAmro ho ki tyo vyakti jasale Aphno bhavanako jaga yasto khokro kinArAmA rAkhcha jasale usalAI liera narakako agnimA khascha? ra, allAha atyAcArI mAnisaharUlAI kahilyai sIdhA mArga dekhAu~dainan |

yo bhavana juna tinIharUle nirmANa garekA chan, sadhaiM tinIharUko hRdayamA sandehako jaro banirahancha sivAya yasako ki tinIharUko hRdaya nai chiyA–chiyA huna pugUn ra allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

nissaMdeha allAhale AsthAvAnaharUbATa unIharUko jyAna tathA dhana–sampatti svargako saTTAmA kharIda garisakekA chan | unIharU allAhako mArgamA yuddha garchan ani mArchan ra mArinchan | yo taurAta, iJjIla evaM kuraAnamA bhaeko satya vacana ho, ra allAhabhandA baDhI Aphno vacanalAI pUrA garne arU ko huna sakcha? ataH khuziyAlI manAU tyasa kharida–bikrIprati juna timIharUle unIsita garekA chau ra yahI mahAn saphalatA ho |

(yI AsthAvAnaharU nai) allAhatarpha pharkaneharU, unako upAsanA garneharU, stuti garneharU, (unakai mArgamA) bhramaNa garneharU, rukua garneharU (jhukneharU), sajdA garneharU, satkarmako Adeza dineharU, duSkarmabATa rokneharU ra allAhakA sImAharUko rakSA garneharU hun | ani, timI AsthAvAnaharUlAI zubha–sUcanA deU |
nabI tathA AsthAvAnaharUle muzrikaharUkAlAgi tinIharU narakabAsI hun bhanI spaSTa bhaepachi kSamAko lAgi prArthanA garUn bhanne kurA ucita chaina, cAhe tinIharU unakA nAtedAra nai kina nahun |

ra, ibrAhImale AphnA pitAkAnimti gareko kSamAko prArthanA kevala euTA vAcAko kAraNa thiyo juna unale AphnA pitAsita garekA thie | tara jaba unalAI pitA allAhakA zatru hun bhanne kurA spaSTa bhayo taba unale pitAsitako nAtA toDe | nissandeha ibrAhIma ati komalahRdayI ra sahanazIla thie |

allAhale kunai jAtilAI mArgadarzanapazcAt, juna kurAharUbATa tinIharU bacnuparcha tI kurAharU praSTa napAresamma, tyo jAtilAI pathabhraSTa garnu unako niyama hoina | nissandeha allAha sampUrNa cijakA jJAtA chan |
nissandeha AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA allAhakai zAsana raheko cha | unI jIvanadAna garchan ra mRtyu pani dinchan | ra, allAhabAheka na timIharUko kohI saMrakSaka–mitra raheko cha na kohI sahayogI nai |

allAhale dayAdRSTi gare sandeSTAmAthi ra tI muhAjira tathA ansAraharUmAthi jasale tyasa saGkaTako ghaDImA nabI (sa.) ko sahayoga garekA thie | jabakI unIharUmadhye euTA samUhako hRdayamA kehI kuTilatA Aune bhaekAe thiyo | ani allAhale unIharUlAI pani mApha gare | nizcaya nai unIharUprati unI karuNAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

ani, tI tIna janAmAthi pani jasako mAmilA sthagita garieko thiyo jabaki tinIharUkAnimti pRthvI Aphno pUrNa vizAlatAkA bAvajUda saGkIrNa bhaeko thiyo ra tinIharUko Aphno jyAna pani tinIharukAlAgi bojha huna pugeko thiyo | ra, allAhabAheka anya kahiM zaraNa prApta hu~daina bhanne kurA tinIharUle bujhekA thie | ani allAhale tinIharUmAthi kRpA gare tAki tinIharUle prAyazcita garUn | nissandeha allAha nai taubA svIkArakartA evaM parama dayAlu chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhako bhaya rAkha ra satyaniSTha mAnisaharUsa~ga basnegara |

madInAbAsI evaM unIharUko varipari basobAsa garne gAu~leharUkAnimti allAhakA rasUlalAI choDera gharamA basirahanu ra unako jyAnabhandA Aphno jyAnalAI priya banAunu ucita thiena, kinabhane tinIharUlAI allAhako mArgamA tirkhA, thakAi tathA bhokabATa juna kaSTa pugyo tinIharU jati pani hi~De, juna hi~DAIle kAphiraharUlAI krodhita tulyAyo, ra zatruharUko junasukai khabara pani lie, tI sabai kAryaharUko badalAmA tinIharUko nAmamA eka puNyakarma lekhiyo | nizcaya nai allAha satkarmIharUko pratidAna vyartha tulyAu~dainan |

ra, unIharUle juna sAno vA ThUlo dhanarAzi kharca garchan vA juna upatyakA pani pAra garchan yI sabai lekhine garincha, tAki allAhale tinIharUlAI tinIharukA kAryaharUko uttama pratidAna pradAna garUn |

sabai AsthAvAnaharU niskanu jarurI thiena | barU yasto kina bhaena ki pratyeka samUdAyabATa kehI vyaktiharU niskiun tAki dharmalAI rAmrarI bujhna sakUn ra pharkepachi Aphno samudAyakA mAnisaharUlAI sAvadhAna garUn tAki tinIharU (avajJAkAe pariNAmabATa) DarAUn |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUko najika rahekA kAphiraharUsita yuddha gara ra tinIharUle timIharUmA zakti bhaeko mahasUsa garUn | ra jAnirAkha, allAha Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA sAthamA chan |

ra, jaba kunai sUraha avataraNa garincha taba kehI munAphikaharU sodhchan– “yasa sUrahale timIharUmadhye kasako AsthAlAI baDhAeko cha?” hAe, juna vyaktiharU AsthAvAna chan, tinIharUko AsthAlAI vAstavamA abhivRddhi gareko cha ra tinIharU prasanna pani chan |
tara, jasakA hRdayaharUmA roga raheko cha yasa sUrahale tinIharUkA apavitratAmAthi ajha apavitratA nai thapeko cha | ra, tinIharU kAphira bhaekai avasthAmA mare |
ke tinIharU dekhdainan ki hareka varSa eka–duIpaTaka tinIharUlAI vipattIdvArA parIkSaNa garincha? taipani tinIharU na prAyazcita garchan na kunai upadeza nai grahaNa garchan |

ra, jaba kunai sUraha avataraNa garincha taba tinIharU A~khai A~khAmA eka arkAsa~ga kurA garchan; kahI~ timIlAI kasaile dekhiraheko ta chaina? tyasapachi cupa lAgera hiMDchan | allAhale tinIharUkA hRdayaharUlAI nai palTAidiekA chan kinabhane tinIharU yastA mAnisaharU hun jo buddhile kAma li~dainan |

(he manuSya ho!) timIharUsamakSa timIharUmadhyebATai eka rasUlako Agamana bhaeko cha jasalAI timIharUmAthi AilAgne saGkaTale dukhita tulyAu~cha; unI timro saphalatAko atyantai abhilASI chan ra AsthAvAnaharUprati atyantai mamatAmaya tathA dayAvAna chan |
ani, yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane, bhana– “allAha merAlAgi paryApta chan | unIbAheka anya kohI upAsya chaina; ma unIprati nai bharosA rAkhdachu ra unI mahAn rAjasiMhAsanakA svAmI hun |”
alipha0 lAma0 rA0; yI tatvadarzitAle paripUrNa granthakA AyataharU hun |

ke mAnisaharUkAnimti yo Azcaryako viSaya baneko cha ki hAmIle tinIharUmadhyekai ekajanA puruSamAthi vahya avatarita garyauM (yAe bhanera) ki mAnisaharUlAI sAvadhAna gara | ra, AsthAvAnaharUlAI unIharUkAnimti tinIharukA pAlanakartAkahA~ sammAna raheko cha bhanI zubhasandeza deU | kAphiraharU bhandachan– “yo vyakti vAstavamA spaSTa jAdugara ho |”

vAstavamA timIharUkA pAlanakartA allAha nai hun jasale chaH dinamA AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko sRjanA gare, ani rAjasiMhAsanamAthi virAjamAna bhaera saMsArako rAjakAja calAu~daichan | unako anumati binA kohI pani siphArizakartA banna sakdaina | unai allAha timIharUkA pAlanakartA hun tasartha unakai upAsanA gara | ke timIharU upadeza grahaNa gardainau?

unaitarpha timIharU sabai pharkera jAnu cha, allAhako vAcA satya ho | unale nai prANIlAI pahilo paTaka sRSTi gare ra pheri unale nai tyasalAI dohoryAera sRSTi garnechan, tAki imAna lyAera satkarma garneharUlAI nyAyakAsAtha pratidAna diUn ra kAphiraharUkAelAgi tinIharUle garekA kuphrale gardA ati umliMdo pAnI ra duHkhadAyI yAtanA cha |

unai hun jasale sUryalAI prakAzamAna tathA candramAlAI jyotimaya banAe ra tyasakAlAgi gantavyaharU nirdhArita gare tAki timIharU tyasabATa varSa evaM tithiko hisAba pattA lagAuna saka | allAhale yasalAI satyakA sAtha nai sRjanA garekA chan | jJAnI mAnisaharUkAlAgi unI AphnA AyataharU spaSTa rUpamA batAu~chan |
nissandeha Izabhaya rAkhne mAnisaharUkAlAgi rAta ra dinako Avata jAvatamA ra AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA, allAhale sRjanA garekA vastuharUmA nizAnIharU chan |
nissandeha juna vyaktiharU hAmIsita bheTa hune AzA rAkhdainan tathA sAMsArika jIvanalAI rojekA chan ra tyasamA santuSTa chan ra juna vyaktiharU hAmrA nizAnIharUsita asAvadhAna chan,
tyastai vyaktiharUko bAsa tinIharUko kamAile gardA naraka raheko cha |

nisassandeha, juna vyaktiharU AsthA rAkhchan ra satkarma garchan unIharUlAI unIharuko ImAnale gardA unakA pAlanakartAle (svargakAe) mArga dekhAunechan, anugrahapUrNa bagai~cAharUmA unIharUko talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan |

tyahA~ unIharUko pukAra hunecha– “subhAnakallAhumma” (he allAha timI pavitra chau) | ra, unIharUle eka arkAkAe svAgata “salAma” (zAnti hAes) dvArA garnechan | ra, unIharUko antima prArthanA hunecha “alhamdulillAhi rabbila AlamIna” (sabai prazaMsAharU sampUrNa saMsArakA pAlanakartA allAhako nimti chan) |

ra, yadi allAhale mAnisaharUkAlAgi tinIharUle bhalAI mAgna hatAra garejhaiM tinIharUko kukarmako phala prakaTa garna hatAra garekA bhae pahile nai tinIharUko jIvanako anta bhaisakne thiyo | ataH juna mAnisaharUlAI hAmIsita bheTne AzA chaina, tinIharUlAI sImA ullaGghana garne kAryamA bhautArina choDidinchauM |

ra, jaba mAnisamAthi saGkaTa Aiparcha taba usale sutera, basera tathA ubhiera pani hAmIlAI pukArcha tara jaba hAmI usabATa saGkaTa nivAraNa garchauM taba yasarI jAncha ki, mAnauM usale AphUmAthi pareko saGkaTamA hAmIlAI kahilyai pukArekai thiena | yasarI nai hAmIle sImA ullaGghanakArIharUkAlAgi tinIharuko kriyAkalApaharUlAI sundara tulyAekA chauM |

ra, hAmIle timIharUbhandA pahilekA kaiyauM jAtiharUlAI taba naSTa garyauM jaba tinIharUle atyAcAra gare jaba ki tinIharUsamakSa spaSTa nizAnIharU liera tinIharukA rasUlaharU AekA thie tara tinIharU imAna lyAune nai thienan | yasarI nai hAmI aparAdhI samudAyaharUlAI sajAya~ dine garchauM |
ani tinIharUpachi hAmIle timIharUlAI pRthvImA uttarAdhikArI banAekA chauM tAki hAmI herauM ki timIharU kastA karma garchau |

ra, jaba tinIharUsamakSa hAmrA spaSTa AyataharUko pATha garincha, taba hAmIsa~gako bheTako AzA narAkhne vyaktiharU bhanchan– “yasakAe saTTAmA arkAe kuraAna lyAU vA yasaimA pherabadala gara |” bhanideU– “yasamA malAI Aphno tarphabATa parivartana garne kunai akhtiyAra chaina | ma ta tyasai Adezako anuyAyI hu~ juna matarpha avataraNa garincha | yadi maile AphnA pAlanakartAko avajJA gareM bhane malAI euTA bhayAnaka dinako yAtanAsa~ga Dara lAgcha |

bhanideU– “yadi allAhale cAheko bhae, na ma nai timIharUsamakSa yasako pATha garne thie~, na allAhale nai timIharUlAI tyasabAre avagata garAune thie | Akhira yasaaghi maile Aphno jIvanako euTA ThUlo aMza ta timIharUsaMga bitAisakeko chu | ke timIharU vivekale kAma lidainau?”
tyo vyaktibhandA baDhI atyAcArI ko holA jasale allAhaviruddha mithyA raccha vA unakA AyataharUlAI asatya Thahara garcha? nissandeha aparAdhIharU saphala hune chainan |

yinIharU allAhabAheka tyasako bhakti garchan jasale na tinIharUlAI hAni puryAuna sakcha na lAbha nai puryAuna sakcha | ra, bhanchan– “yinIharU allAhasamakSa hAmrA siphArizakartAharU hun |” bhanideU– “ke timIharU allAhalAI tyasa kurAbAre avagata garAu~chau jasalAI unale na AkAzaharUmA na pRthvImA nai jAndachan, jasalAI tinIharU allAhako sAjhedAra ThaharyAu~chan tyasabATa unI ati pavitra tathA ucca chan |

surUvAtamA sampUrNa mAnava ta euTai ummata (dhArmika samudAya) thie, ani (pachi) tinIharUle vibheda gare | ra, yadi timrA ‘raba’ ko tarphabATa pahile nai euTA kurAko nirNaya nabhaeko bhae juna kurAmA tinIharU vibheda gardaichan tyasako nirNaya garidine thie |
ra, tinIharU bhanchan– “unakA ‘raba’ ko tarphabATa kina kunai nizAnI avatarita gariena?” bhanideU– “parAekSakA jJAna allAhalAI mAtra cha | ani pratIkSA gara; ma pani timIharUsa~gai pratIkSA garchu |”

ra, jaba hAmIle mAnisaharUlAI tinIharUle duHkha bhogepachi dayAko svAda cakhAuchau~ taba tinIharU hAmrA nizAnIharUviruddha jukti racna thAlchan | bhanideU– “allAha yojanA banAunamA jhan tivra chan |” vAstavamA timIharU je jukti garchau hAmrA phariztAharUle tyasalAI lekhirahekA chan |

unI nai hun jasale timIharUlAI thala evaM jala (samudra) mA hiDAu~chan | yahA~samma ki jaba timIharU DuMgAharUmA hunchau ra DuMgAharU anukUla vAyukA sAtha mAnisaharUlAI liera gairahekA hunchan ra tinIharU prasanna hunchan, tyattikaimA akasmAt pratikUla hurI calna thAlcha; hareka dizAbATa laharaharU uThna thAlchan ra tinIharU svayaM tyasamA gherieko samjhinchan | tyasa samaya tinIharU Aphno bhaktilAI allAhakainimti zuddha pArdai unalAI pukArdachan– “yadi timIle yasabATa hAmIlAI bacAyau bhane hAmIharU nizcaya nai kRtajJaharUmadhye bannechauM |”

tara, jaba unI tinIharUko uddhAra garchan taba tinIharU turunta pRthvImA anAhaka vidroha garna thAlchan | he mAnava! timIharUko yo vidroha timrai thAplomA pariraheko cha | sAMsArika jIvanako thorai dinako Ananda leU, pheri hAmItarpha nai pharkera Aunu cha | ani timIharUle jejasto garne garekA thiyau hAmI timIharUlAI avagata garAunechauM |

sAMsArika jIvanako udAharaNa yasto ho jasto hAmIle AkAzabATa pAnI barsAyauM | tyasale gardA mAnisa tathA pazule khAne pRthvIko upaja dherai baDhyo ani ThIka tyasa samaya jaba pRthvI Aphno basanta RtumA thiyo ra khubai sajieko thiyo ra tyasakA mAlikaharUle tyasabATa pUrNa lAbha uThAune sAmarthya prApta cha bhanne ThAnekA thie | akasmAta rAta vA dinako samayamA hAmro Adeza Ayo ra hAmIle tyasalAI kATieko bAlI jhaiM banAidiyauM mAnauM hijosamma tyasamA kunai cijako astitva nai thiena | yasarI nai hAmI cintana manana garne mAnisaharUkA lAgi (AphnA) nizAnIharU vistRta rUpamA bayAna garchauM |
allAha timIharUlAI zAntigRha (svarga) tarpha bolAu~chan ra jasalAI cAhanchan sIdhA mArga dekhAu~chan |

jasale satkarma gare unIharUkAlAgi ati rAmro pratidAna cha ra ajha thapa prApta hunecha | unIharUkA anuhAramA na kAlo chAyA~ na apamAna nai chAeko hunecha | unIharU nai svargakA bAsindAharu hun jahA~ unIharU sadA–sarvadA rahanechan |

ra, juna mAnisaharUle kukarma gare, tyasako badalA tyasakai samAna hunecha | ra, tinIharUlAI apamAnale DhAkekAe hunecha | tinIharUlAI allAhabATa kohI surakSA dinelA hune chaina | tinIharukA anuhAraharUmAthi pareko andhakAra yasto hunecha jasto mAnauM andhakAramaya rAtakA TukrAharUdvArA tinIharUkA muhAraharU Dhapakka DhAkiekA hoUn | tinIharU narakakA bAsindA hun jahA~ tinIharU sadA–sarvadA rahanechan |

ra, tyasadina hAmI sabailAI ekatrita garnechauM | ani muzrikaharUsita bhannechauM– “timIharU ra timrA sAjhedAraharU A–Aphno sthAnamai rokiera raha |” ani tinIharUbIca aparicittatAko pardA haTAi dinechauM | ani tI sAjhedAraharUle bhannechan– “timIharU hAmro bhakti ta gardainathyau |”
ani hAmI ra timIharUbIca allAha nai sAkSIko rUpamA paryApta chan | hAmI timIharUko bhaktibATa ekadamai anabhijJa thiyauM |”
tyahA~ sabaile AphUle vigatamA garekA kAryaharUko jA~ca garnechan ra tinIharU AphnA vAstavika svAmI allAhatarpha pharkAinechan ra tinIharUle racne garekA mithyAharU harAunechan |

bhanideU– “timIharUlAI AkAza tathA pRthvIbATa kasale khAdyAnna pradAna garcha? kAna tathA A~khAharUmAthi kasako adhikAra raheko cha? kasale nirjIvabATa sajIva tathA sajIvabATa nirjIvalAI sRjanA garcha ra kasale saMsArakA kAryaharU saJcAlana garcha?” tinIharUle turUntai bhannechan– “allAhale!” ani sodha– “tyaso bhae timIharU kina DarAu~dainau?”
unai allAha timIharUkA vAstavika pAlanakartA hun | ani satyapachi pathabhraSTatAbAheka arU ke nai bA~kI rahancha ra? ani! timIharU katA pharkAirdaichAai?
yasarI avajJAkArIharUkA bAremA tinIharUle AsthA lyAu~dainan bhanne timrA pAlanakartAko vANI satya pramANita bhayo |

sodha, ke timrA sAjhedAraharUmadhye kohI yasto cha jasale sRSTiko Arambha gareko hos, pheri tyasako punarAvRtti pani garna sakos? bhanideU– “allAhale nai sRSTiko Arambha garchan ra tyasapachi tyasalAI punaH sRSTi garnechan | ani timIharU kahA~ dhAekAmA pAridaichau?

sodha– “ke timIharUkA sAjhedAraharUmadhye kohI yasto pani cha jasale satmArga dekhAuna sakos?” bhanideU– “kevala allAha satmArga dekhAu~chan |” ani batAU– “jasale satyako bATo dekhAu~cha tyo baDhI anusaraNa yogya raheko cha vA tyo jasalAI mArga nadekhAuJjela svayaM mArga prApta garna sakdaina? Akhira timIharUlAI ke bhaeko cha? timIharU kasto nirNaya garchau?”

ra, tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza kevala anumAnako pachADI hiMDchan jabaki anumAnale satyabATa alikati pani nispRha garna sakdaina | nissandeha tinIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUbATa allAhalAI pUrNarUpamA avagata cha |

ra, yo kuraAna allAhabAheka anya kasaidvArA racieko hoina | barU yo yasabhandA aghikA granthaharuko puSTi ho ra granthaharuko vistAra ho | yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | yo sampUrNa saMsArakA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avataraNa garieko cha |
ke tinIharU yasalAI rasUlale racekA hun bhanera bhanchan? bhanideU– “yadi timIharU saccA hAai bhane yastai kunai euTA sUraha prastuta gara ra yasakA lAgi allAhabAheka sakdo sabailAI bolAU |”

vAstavikatA yo ho ki tinIharUle tI kurAharUlAI asvIkAra gare junabAre tinIharUlAI pUrNa jJAna thiena ra ahilesamma tinIharUsamakSa tyasako vAstavikatA pani khulna sakeko chaina | yasaigarI tinIharUbhandA aghikA mAnisaharUle pani mithyA Thahara garekA thie | ani, hera kasto bhayo atyAcArIharUko pariNAma!
ra, tinIharUmadhye kehI vyaktiharU yasamA AsthA rAkhchan ra kehI vyaktiharU yasaprati AsthA rAkhdainan | ra, timrA pAlanakartA vidhvaMsakArIharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |

ra, yadi tinIharU timIlAI mithyA Thahara garchan bhane bhanideU– “merolAgi mero karma ra timIharUkAlAgi timrA karmaharU chan | maile garekA kAryaharuko javAphadehI timIharUmAthi chaina, ra, (tyasarI nai) timIharUkA kAryaharUko jimmevArIbATa ma mukta chu |”
ra, tinIharUmadhye kehI vyaktiharu timItira kAna lagAera sunchan | ke timI bahirAlAI sunAuna sakchau jabaki tinIharU kehI bujhdainan pani?
ra, tinIharUmadhye kehIle timItarpha herchan | ke timI andhAlAI, jabaki tinIharUle dekhdainan, mArga dekhAuna sakchau?
nissandeha allAha mAnisaharUmAthi paTakkai atyAcAra gardainan, tara mAnisaharU svayam AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra garchan |

ra, tyasadina jaba allAhale tinIharU sabailAI ekatrita garnechan taba lAgnecha ki tinIharU paraspara paricita huMdai (saMsAramA) dinako kehI kSaNamAtra basekai thie | vAstavamA tI vyaktiharU noksAnamA pare jasale allAhasita bheTako AzA nai rAkhenan ra tinIharU (kadApi) satmArgamA thienan |

ra, hAmI tinIharUlAI juna kurAko dhamkI diirahekA chauM, tyasako kehI aMza cAhe hAmI timIlAI dekhAauM vA tyasa aghi nai timIlAI mRtyuzaiyAmA puryAauM, tinIharU (kAphiraharU) hAmIkahA~ nai pharkera Aunu cha ra juna kriyAkalApa tinIharU gardaichan allAha tyasako sAkSI chan |

ra, pratyeka samudAyakAlAgi rasUla rahekA chan | ani jaba unIharUkahA~ rasUlako Agamana huncha taba tinIharUbIca nyAyakAsAtha (aAsthA ra anAsthAkAe) nirNaya garincha ra tinIharUmAthi anyAya gariMdaina |
ra, tinIharU (rasUlaharUlAI) bhanchan– “yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane tyo vacana kahile pUrA hunecha?

bhanideU– “ma Aphno hAni tathA lAbhako pani adhikAra rAkhdina, a~! allAhale nai cAhemA beglai kurA ho |” hareka samudAyakolAgi euTA nirdhArita myAda cha | jaba tyo myAda Aipugcha taba tinIharU na eka kSaNapachi haTna saknechan na aghi nai baDhna saknechan |
bhanideU– “ke timIharUle vicAra garyAai, yadi allAhako prakopa timIharUmAthi rAta vA dinamA AidiyAe bhane; ke yAe yasto cija hAe jasakolAgi aparAdhIharU hatAra maccAun?”
ke jaba tyo Aipugnecha taba timI mAnnechau? ke aba! jabaki yasakAlAgi timIharU hatArirahekA thiyau?
pheri atyAcArIharUlAI bhaninecha– “timIharU sadA rahane yAtanA bhoga | timIharUlAI timro Aphnai karmako badalA prApta bhaeko cha!”
ra, timIsita tinIharU sodhchan– “ke tyo (yAtanA) avazyambhAvI ho?” bhanideU– “ho, merA pAlanakartAko kasama tyo avazyambhAvI ho | ra, timIharU (tyo avazyambhAvI hunabATa) vivaza pArna sakdainau | ”

ra, yadi pratyeka atyAcArI vyaktilAI pRthvIkA sampUrNa vastuharU pani prApta hunchan bhane (yAtanAbATa surakSita huna) tI sabai arthadaNDako rUpamA dina tayAra hunecha | ra, jaba tinIharU yAtanAlAI dekhnechan, Aphno lAja lukAunechan ra tinIharUbIca nyAyakAsAtha nirNaya hunecha ani tinIharUmAthi anyAya garine chaina |
jAnirAkha! AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA jejati chan allAhakai hun | jAnirAkha, allAhako vacana satya cha tara adhikAMza mAnisaharUlAI thAhA nai chaina |
unI nai jIvanadAna garchan ra mRtyu dinchan ra unaitarpha timIharU sabailAI pharkAera laginecha |
he mAnava ho! timIharUsamakSa timrA pAlanakartAkotarphabATa upadeza, hRdayamA bhaekA rogako upacAra ra mAnneharUkAlAgi mArgadarzana tathA dayA Aipugeko cha |

bhanideU– “yo allAhako varadAna tathA dayA (le avataraNa garieko) ho | tasartha mAnisaharU tyasamA prasanna hunu parcha | yo tyasa (dhana) ko tulanAmA ati uttama raheko cha juna tinIharU jammA gardaichan |

(he nabI sa.!) sodha– “ke timIharUle vicAra garyau ki allAhale timIharUlAI pradAna gareko khAdyAnnamadhye timIharU svayaMle kehIlAI avaidhaDha ra kehIlAI vaidha garekA chau?” sodha–“yasto garne anumati ke allAhale timIharUlAI diekA chan? vA timIharU allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garchau?”
allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garneharUko dhAraNA mahApralayakAe dina (aAphUbAre) ke hunecha? allAha mAnisaharUprati kRpA–dRSTi rAkhdachan, tara adhikAMza mAnisa allAhaprati kRtajJa chainan |

ani, (he nabI sa.!) timI juna avasthAmA rahane garchau ra kuraAnabATa je pani paDhchau ra (he mAnava!) timIharU juna kArya pani garchau, hAmI tI sabai dekhchauM jaba timIharU tyasamA magna hunchau | kunai ratti barAbarako cija AkAza tathA jamInamA chaina, na sAno ra na tyobhandA ThUlo juna timrA pAlanakartAko dRSTibATa ojhelamA hos ra eka spaSTa pustakamA aMkita nahos |
jAnirAkha! allAhakA mitraharU na DarAu~chan na duHkhita nai hunchan|
jasale ImAna lyAe ra IzaparAyaNatAko nIti apanAirAkhe |
unIharUkAlAgi sAMsArika jIvanamA ra paralokamA pani zubha–sUcanAharU chan | allAhako mahAvANImA kunai pherabadala hune chaina | ra, nizcaya nai yahI mahAna saphalatA ho |
tinIharUkA durvacanale timIlAI duHkhita natulyAos | vAstavamA sampUrNa sammAna allAhakainimti hun | unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

jAnirAkha! juna prANIharU AkAzaharU evaM pRthvImA chan sabai allAhakA hun ra jasale allAhabAheka (arU) sAjhedAraharUlAI pukArchan tinIharU kuna cijako anusaraNa gardaichan? tinIharU kevala kalpanAko anusaraNa gardaichan ra tinIharU aDakalabAjI mAtra gardaichan |

unai hun jasale timIharUkAlAgi rAta (lAI aMdhyArAe) banAe tAki tyasamA timIharU ArAma gara ra dinalAI ujyAlo banAe (tAki jivikAepArjana garnasaka)| nissandeha sunne vyaktiharUkAlAgi tyasamA nizAnIharU chan |

unIharU bhanchan– “allAhale euTA putra grahaNa garekA chan |” unI ta (yasabATa) pavitra chan | unI Atmanirbhara chan | AkAzaharU evaM pRthvImA jejati chan unaikA hun | yasakAlAgi timIharUsita kunai pramANa chaina | ke timIharu allAhaviruddha tyo kurA garchau jasabAre timIharUlAI kunai jJAna nai chaina |
bhanideU– “juna vyaktiharU allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garchan tinIharU kadApi saphala hune chainan |”
yo saMsArako kSaNika mojamastI ho, yasapachi tinIharU hAmItarpha nai pharkanu parnecha | ani tinIharUko kuphrale gardA hAmI kaThora daNDa dinechauM |

ra, tinIharUlAI nUhako vRttAnta sunAU | jaba unale AphnA jAtikA mAnisaharUlAI bhanekA thie– “he jAti–bandhuharU ho! yadi timIharUlAI mero basA~I ra merA allAhakA AyataharUdvArA upadeza dinu kaSTapUrNa lAgirahekocha bhane, (jAnIrAkha) ma ta allAhamAthi bharosA garekAe chU | ataH timIharU AphnA sAjhedAraharUsa~ga milera sarvamAnya yojanA banAU ra tyasako kunai pani pakSa anyolamA narahos | pheri tyasalAI meroviruddha lAgU garihAla, ra malAI alikati pani avasara nadeU |”

yadi timIharU vimukha hunchau bhane (jAinrAkha) maile timIharUsita kunai pratidAna ta mAgeko chaina | mero pratidAna ta kevala allAhakahA~ raheko cha ra malAI AjJAkArIharUmadhye banne hukuma bhaeko cha |”

tara, tinIharUle unalAI mithyA Thahara gare | ataH hAmIle nUha evaM DuGgAmA rahekA unakA sAthIharUlAI bacAyauM ra unIharUlAI nai pRthvIkA uttarAdhikArI banAyauM ra tI sabai vyaktiharUlAI hAmIle DubAidiyauM jasale hAmrA aAyataharUlAI asatya Thahara garekA thie | ani hera kasto pariNAma bhayo tI (ImAna nalyAune) vyaktiharUko jo saceta gariekA thie |

pheri unI (nUha) pachi hAmIle anya rasUlaharUlAI tinIharukA samudAyaharUtarpha paThAyauM | ani unIharU spaSTa nizAnIharUsAtha tinIharUsamakSa gae tara tinIharU pani tyasa kurAmAthi ImAna lyAunevAlA thienan jasalAI aghikA mAnisaharUle nakArekA thie | hAmI yasarI nai sImA ullaGghanakArIharUkA mana–mastiSkamAthi sila lagAidinchauM |
pheri unIharU pazcAt hAmIle mUsA tathA hArUnalAI AphnA nizAnIharUsAtha phiraauna evaM unakA bhAradAraharUsamakSa paThAyauM ani tinIharUle ghamaNDa gare ra tinIharU ta aparAdhI samUdAya nai thie |
ani jaba tinIharUsamakSa hAmrotarphabATa satya pugyo taba tinIharUle bhane– “nizcaya nai yo euTA spaSTa jAdU ho |”
mUsAle bhane– “ke jaba timIharUsamakSa satyako Agamana bhaisakeko cha taba timIharU (tyasako bAremA) yasto kurA bhanchau? ke yo jAdU ho?” jabaki jAdUgaraharU kahilyai saphala huna sakdainan |”

tinIharUle bhane– “ke timI hAmIkahA~ yasa kAraNale AekA chau ki timI hAmIlAI tyasa mArgabATa vimukha pAra jasamA hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI pAekA chauM ra pRthvImA timIharU duvaiko mapAI~ kAyama hos? ra, hAmI timIharU duvailAI kahilyai mAnne chainauM |”
ra, phiraaunale bhanyo– “hareka jAnakAra jAdUgaralAI masamakSa upasthita garAU |”
jaba jAdUgaraharU Ae taba mUsAle tinIharUlAI bhane–“juna vastu timIharUle phyA~knucha phyA~ka |”

jaba tinIharUle vastu phyA~ke taba mUsAle bhane– “yo juna timIharUle lyAekA chau tyo jAdU ho | nizcaya nai allAhale tyasalAI vyartha tulyAunechan | allAhale vidhvaMsakArIharUko kAryalAI saphala pArdainan |”
ra, allAhale Aphno AdezaharUdvArA satyalAI satya sAbita garidinchan cAhe aparAdhIharUle katti pani mana naparAUn |

ani mUsAmAthi unakA samudAyakA kehI sadasyaharUbAheka anya kasaile phiraaunako Darale ra Aphnai adhikArIharUko Darale ImAna lyAenan ki kadAcita phiraaunale tinIharUlAI kunai saGkaTamA pAros kinabhane phiraaunalAI tyasa dezamA prabhutva prApta thiyo ra U sImA ullaGghanakArIharUmadhyeko thiyo |
ra, mUsAle bhane– “he mero samUdAyakA mAnisaharu ho! yadi timIharU allAhamAthi ImAna rAkhchau bhane unaimAthi bharosA rAkha yadi timIharU AjJAkArI hau bhane |”
ani unIharUle bhane– “hAmIharUle allAhamAthi nai bharosA garyauM | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI atyAcArI vyaktiharUkAlAgi parIkSAko sAdhana nabanAU |
ra, hAmIlAI Aphno kRpAdvArA kAphiraharUbATa mukta gara |

ra, hAmIle mUsA tathA unakA bhAImAthi prakAzanA avatarita garyauM ki timIharU misramA AphnA mAnisaharUkAnimti ghara banAU ra AphnA gharaharUlAI kiblA (masjida) banAU ani namAja kAyama gara ra AsthAvAnaharUlAI zubha–sUcanA deU |”

ra, mUsAle prArthanA gare– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! timIle phiraauna tathA usakA bhAradAraharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanamA sundaratA tathA dhanasampatti pradAna garekA chau | he pAlanakartA! ke yasa kAraNale tinIharUle mAnisaharUlAI timro mArgabATa pathabhraSTa pArUn? he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tinIharUkA dhanasampatti naSTa gara ra tinIharUko hRdayalAI kaThora pAra tAki tinIharU duHkhadAyI yAtanA nadekhuJjela ImAna nalyAUn |”
allAhale bhane– “timI duvaiko prArthanA svIkAra gariyo | ra, timIharu duvaijanA A–Aphno kadama jamAirAkha | ra, ajJAnIharUko mArgako kadApi anusaraNa nagara |”

ani, hAmIle isarAIlakA santAnaharUlAI samudra pAra garAyauM ra phiraauna tathA usakA sainikaharUle atyAcAra tathA jyAjati garne dhyeyale tinIharUko pIchA gare yahA~samma ki jaba phiraauna Dubna lAgyo taba usale bhanyo– “maile ImAna lyAe~ tyasa (allAha) mAthi jasamAthi isarAIlakA santAnaharUle ImAna lyAekA chan; unIbAheka kohI upAsya chaina ra ma AjJAkArIharUmadhyeko hu~ |”
ke aba? jabaki yasaaghi timI avajJAkArI thiyau ra vidhvaMsakArIharUmadhyekA thiyau?”
ani Aja hAmI timro zavalAI bacAunechauM tAki timI AphUpachi AuneharUkAlAgi nizAnI bana ra nizcaya nai dherai mAnisaharU hAmrA nizAnIharUbATa vimukha chan |

hAmIle isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI dherai rAmro bAsasthAna tathA pavitra khAdyAnna pradAna garyauM tara tinIharUle jJAna prApta bhaepani matabheda gare | juna kurAmA tinIharU matabheda gardaichan tyasabAre timrA pAlanakartAle mahApralayako dina avazya nai nirNaya garnechan |

ra, yadi timIlAI hAmIle avataraNa gareko (grantha) prati kunai zaGkA cha bhane juna vyaktiharU timIbhandA aghikA granthaharU paDhchan tinIharUlAI sodha | vAstavamA yo timIsamakSa timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa satya nai Aipugeko cha | ra timI kadApi sandeha garneharUmadhye nabana |
na tI vyaktiharUmadhye bana jasale allAhakA AyataharUlAI asatya Thahara gare | anyathA timI ghATAgrasta mAnisaharUmadhye bannechau |
nissandeha juna mAnisaharUmAthi timrA pAlanakartAko vacana siddha bhaisakeko cha tinIharUle ImAna lyAune chainan |
yaddhapi tinIharUsamakSa sabai prakArakA nizAnIharU AipugUn, yahA~samma ki tinIharUle dukhadAyI yAtanA dekhUn |

ani ke kunai yasto nagara cha jasale (yAtanA dekhera) ImAna lyAeko hos ra usako ImAna usakAlAgi lAbhaprada siddha bhaeko hos? sivAya yUnusakA samudAyako| jaba tinIharUle ImAna lyAe taba hAmIle sAMsArika jIvanamA tinIharUbATa apamAnajanaka yAtanA haTAidiyauM ra eka avadhisamma sAMsArika lAbha uThAune avasara pradAna garyauM |
ra, yadi timrA rabale cAheko bhae pRthvImA basne sabai mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAune thie | ani ke timI mAnisaharUlAI AsthAvAna banna bAdhya pArnechAai ta?
ra kunai pani vyaktikolAgi allAhako anumatibinA ImAna lyAuna sambhava chaina, ra allAhale juna vyaktiharU buddhile kAma li~dainan tinIharUmAthi (kuphra ra zirkako) phohora thupAridinchan |
bhanideU– “dhyAnapUrvaka hera, AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA ke ke chan |” tara juna vyaktiharU ImAna lyAu~dainan tinIharUlAI nizAnIharU tathA cetAvanIharUle pani kunai phAidA puryAu~daina |
tinIharU tyastai dinaharUko pratIkSA garirahekA chan jasto tinIharUbhandA pahile bitekA vyaktiharUle bhoge | bhanideU– “timIharU pratIkSA gara, ma pani timIharUsa~gai pratIkSA garchu |”
ani hAmI AphnA rasUla tathA AsthAvAnaharUlAI (yastA samayamA) surakSA pradAna garchauM | yasarI AsthAvAnaharUlAI surakSA pradAna garnu hAmro jimmevArI ho |

(he sandeSTA!) bhanideU– “he manuSyaharu ho! yadi timIharUlAI mero dharmamA kunai kisimako sandeha cha bhane (sunirAkha) timIharU allAhabAheka jasako upAsanA garchau ma cAhi~ tyasako upAsanA gardina~ | ma tyasa allAhako upAsanA garchu jasale timIharUlAI mRtyu dinchan | ra, malAI AsthAvAnaharUsaMgai rahane Adeza bhaeko cha |”
ani yo ki timI ekAgra bhaI svayaMlAI (yasa) dharmakolAgi samarpita gara ra kadApi bahudevavAdIharUmadhye nabana |
ra, allAhalAI choDI anya kasailAI napukAra jasale na timro bhalAI garna sakcha na hAni nai | yadi timIle tyasto garyau bhane timI nizcaya nai atyAcArI vyaktiharUmadhye hunechau |

ani, yadi allAhale timIlAI kunai kaSTa puryAu~chan bhane unIbAheka kasaile tyasako nivAraNa garna sakne chaina ra yadi unI timro bhalAI cAhanchan bhane unako udAra kRpAlAI kasaile pharkAuna sakne chaina | AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye unale jasalAI cAhanchan anugraha pradAna garchan, ra, unI ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

bhanideU– “he mAnava ho! timIharUsamakSa timrA rabako tarphabATa satya Aipugeko cha | ani jasale mArgadarzanako aunasaraNa garcha usale Aphnai hita garcha ra jasale pathabhraSTatA apanAu~cha usale Aphnai hAni garcha | ra, ma timIharUmAthi havaladAra hoina |”
(he sandeSTA!) timIlAI juna Adeza (vahyasvarUpa) paThAincha tyasako anusaraNa gardai jAU, ra allAhako phaisalA naAunjela dhairyadhAraNa gara | ra, unI sarvotkRSTa nirNAyaka hun |
alipha0 lAma0 rA0 | yo tyo grantha ho jasakA AyataharU sudRDha pAriekA chan ra tatvadarzI evaM paramajJAtAko tarphabATa savistArakA sAtha bayAna gariekA chan,
ki allAhabAheka kasaiko upAsanA nagara ra ma timIharUkAelAgi unako tarphabATa sacetaka evaM zubhasUcaka hu~ |

ra, yo ki AphnA pAlanakartAsita kSamAyAcanA gara ra unItarpha pharka tAki unale timIharUlAI eka nizcita avadhisamma rAmro jIvana sAmagrI pradAna garUn ra pratyeka ucca vyaktilAI usako uccatA pradAna garUn | ra, yadi timIharU vimukha hunchau bhane ma timIharUko viSayamA euTA ThUlo dinako yAtanAbATa DarAu~chu |
timIharU allAhatarpha nai pharkera jAnu cha, ra, unI hareka vastuko sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

hera, tinIharU AphnA chAtiharUlAI dobbara pArdachan tAki AphUlAI allAhabATa lukAuna sakUn | jAnirAkha jaba tinIharU AphUlAI vastrabhitra DhAkchan tyasabelA pani allAha tinIharUle lukAekA vA prakaTa garekA kurAharUlAI jAndachan | nissandeha unI hRdayakA bhedaharUlAI pani rAmrararI jAndachan |

ani, dhartImA hiMDaDula garne kunai yasto prANI chaina jasako jIvikAko bhAra allAhamAthi nahos ra unI tinIharuko bAsasthAnalAI jAndachan ra mRtyupachi sumpine sthAnalAI pani | yI sabai kurAharU spaSTa kitAbamA vidyamAna chan |

ra, unai hun jasale AkAzaharu tathA dhartIlAI cha dinamA sRSTi gare jabaki pahile unako arza (rAja siMhAsana) jalamAthi thiyo | (timIharuko sRjanAko) uddezya timIharuko parIkSA linu ho ki timIharumadhye ko karmako dRSTile uttama raheko cha | ra, timI bhanchau ki timIharulAI mRtyupazcAt avazya jIvita garinecha bhane kAphiraharule avazya bhannechan– “yo ta spaSTa jAdUbAheka kehI hoina |”

ra, yadi hAmIle eka vizeSa avadhikAlAgi tinIharUko yAtanAlAI sthagita garyauM bhane, tinIharUle bhannechan– “yasalAI kasale rokeko cha?” jAnirAkha– “juna dina tyasako samaya Aipugcha tyo tinIharUbATa TArine chaina | juna kurAko tinIharU ThaTTA garne garchan tyasaile tinIharUlAI ghernecha |”
ra, hAmIle mAnisalAI Aphno tarphabATa dayAko svAda cakhAera pheri tyasabATa tyasalAI vaJcita garyauM bhane tyo nirAza evaM kRtaghna huna pugcha |

ra, yadi hAmIle usalAI tyo saGkaTapachi juna usamAthi AilAgeko thiyo, varadAnako svAda cakhAyauM bhane, usale bhancha– “mero sabai duHkha haraNa bhayo |” U ati nai prasanna bhaera ahaMkAra garna thAlcha |
sivAya tI vyaktiharU jasale dhairya dhAraNa gare ra satkarma gare, unIharUkAlAgi kSamA tathA ThUlo pratidAna raheko cha |

ani (he sandeSTA!) sambhavataH yasto nahos ki timI AphUtarpha vahya dvArA paThAiekA kehI kurA choDideU ra timro hRdaya saGkIrNa hos, kAphiraharUle bhanne gareko yasa kurAle gardA ki unIprati kunai khajAnA kina avataraNa gariena vA unIsa~ga kunai phariztA kina Aena? timI kevala sacetaka hau ra allAha sampUrNa cijaharUkA nirIkSaka hun |

ke tinIharU unale kuraAna svayaM racekA hun bhanera bhanchan? bhanideU– “tyaso bhae timIharUle pani yasarI nai raciekA dasavaTA sUraha lyAU ra allAhabAheka jasalAI timIharU sahAyatAkolAgi bolAuna sakchau bolAU; yadi timIharU saccA chau bhane |”

ra, yadi tinIharU timro kurAlAI svIkAra garirahekA chainan bhane timI yakInakAsAtha jAnirAkha ki kuraAna allAhako jJAnakAsAtha avataraNa garieko cha, yAe ki ra allAhabAheka kohI upAsya chaina | ani ke timI aba AjJAkArI hunchau ta?
jo mAnisaharU sAMsArika jIvana tathA tyasako ramajhamako cAhanA garchan, tinIharUlAI tinakA karmaharUlAI yasai saMsAramA pUrNa garidinchAaiM ra tyasamA tinIharUlAI kunai kamI gariMdaina |
yinIharUko hitamA AkhiratamA kevala agni hunecha ra jejati tinIharUle kamAekA hunechan tI barabAda hunechan ra jejati kAryaharU garekA hunechan tI sabai vyartha hunechan |

ke tyo vyakti jo Aphno pAlanakartAbATa prApta spaSTa pramANamA rahekocha ra tyasasa~ga allAhabATa prApta thapa sAkSI pani cha, ani mArgadarzana tathA dayAko rUpamA tyasabhandA pahile Aeko mUsAko grantha pani sAkSI cha | (tinIharUbAre ke bicAra cha?) yinIharU sabai yasa (grantha mAthi) ImAna lyAuMchan | ra, sampradAyaharUmadhye jasale yasalAI asvIkAra garcha tyasako lAgi naraka vAcA gariekosthAna ho | ataH timI yasamA kunai zaMkA nagara | nizcaya nai yo timro pAlanakartAko tarphabATa nitAnta satya ho | tara, adhikAMza mAnisaharU yasamA AsthA rAkhdainan |

ra, tyo vyaktibhandA ThUlo atyAcArI ko holA jasale allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garcha? yastA vyaktiharU AphnA pAlanakartA sAmunne peza garinechan, ra sAkSIharUle bhannechan–“AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi mithyAropaNa garne yinIharU nai hun |” jAnirAkha atyAcArIharUmAthi allAhako dhikkAra cha |
jasale allAhako mArgabATa rokchan, ra tyasalAI baGgyAuna khojchan, ra yastA vyaktiharUle AkhiratalAI asvIkAra garchan,

yinIharU dhartImA (allAhalAI) vivaza garna sakdainan na tinIharUkAlAgi allAhabAheka sahayogI mitra nai chan | tinIharUlAI kaiyAaiM guNA yAtanA diinecha | tinIharU na sunna sakchan na dekhna nai sakchan |
yinIharU nai tI vyaktiharU hun jasale svayaMlAI ghATAmA pArekA chan, ra juna kurAharU tinIharUle racekA thie tI sabai tinIharUle gumAekA chan |
nissandeha tinIharU nai AkhiratamA sarvAdhika ghATA behorneharUmA parnechan |
nissandeha juna vyaktiharUle ImAna lyAe, satkarma gare, ra AphnA pAlanakartAsamakSa samarpita rahe tinIharU nai svargamA jAneharU hun jahA~ tinIharU sadA rahanechan |

duvai samUha (kAphiraharU tathA muslimaharU) ko udAharaNa yasto cha jasto euTA andho tathA bahiro hos ra arko A~khA bhaeko tathA sunna sakne | ke duvaiko avasthA barAbara huna sakcha? ani ke timIharU (yasa udAharaNabATa) kunai zikSA prApta gardainau?
ra, hAmIle nUhalAI unakA jAtitarpha paThAyauM (ani unale bhane)– “ma timIharUkAlAgi spaSTa rUpamA sacetaka hu~ |
ki timIharU allAhabAheka kasaiko upAsanA nagara | nissandeha ma timIharUlAI hune kaSTakara yAtanAkAe dinabATa DarAu~chu |”

ani tyasa jAtikA anAsthAvAdI nAikeharUle bhane– “timI hAmro najaramA hAmIjastai euTA mAnisabAheka kehI hoinau | ani, hAmI AphUmadhye spaSTa rUpamA tuccha vyaktiharUbAheka arU kasailAI timro anusaraNa gareko pAu~dainau ra hAmI kunai pani cija yasto pAu~dainauM jasamA timIharU hAmIbhandA ucca chau | barU hAmI timIlAI mithyAvAdI po ThAndachauM |”

nUhale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhu ho! alikati soca ta, yadi ma AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa pramANamAthi kAyama chu ra pheri unale malAI Aphno vizeSa dayA pani pradAna gare, tara tyo timIle dekhna sakenau, tara, timI mAnna tayAra chainau bhane, ta ke hAmI jabarajastI tyasalAI timImAthi thupArauM?

ra, he merA samudAyakA mAnisaharU ho! ma (yasako pratiphalamA) timIharUbATa kunai dhana mAgdina | mero pArizramika kevala allAhako jimmAmA raheko cha, ra ma AsthAvAnaharUlAI niSkAsana pani gardina | unIharU AphnA pAlanakartAsita bheTnevAlA chan | tara ma timIharUlAI ajJAnI samUha bhaeko dekhdachu |
he merA jAtikA mAnisaharU ho! yadi maile unIharUlAI niSkAsita gareM bhane malAI allAha (ko yAtanA) bATa kasale bacAuna sakcha? ke timIharU (yati pani) kurA bujhdainau?

ma yo bhandina ki masa~ga allAhakA khajAnAharU chan | ra, ma parokSabAre jAndina~; na ma phariztA nai hu~ bhanne dAvI garchu, ra na timIharUko najaramA tuccha rahekA vyaktiharUbAre yo bhanchu ki allAhale unIharUlAI kadApi kunai bhalAI pradAna gardainan | unIharUko hRdayamA bhaekA kurAharUlAI allAha rAmrarI jAndachan | yastA kurA garemA ma avazya nai atyAcArIharUmadhye hunechu |,

tinIharUle bhane– “he nUha! timIle hAmIsa~ga tarkavitarka garyau ra dherai tarkavitarka garyau, tara yadi timI saccA hau bhane juna kurAbATa timIle hAmIlAI dhamkyAu~daichau tyo hAmIsamakSa liera AU |”
nUhale bhane– “tyo allAhale nai lyAunechan, yadi unale cAhe bhane | ra, timIharU unalAI vivaza pArna sakdainau |

yadi allAhale timIharUko pathabhraSTatA cAhe bhane, maile timIharUko jatisukai hita cAhe pani mero sahAnubhUtile timIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAune chaina | unI nai timIharUkA pAlanakartA hun ra unaitarpha timIharU pharkAinechau |”

ke tinIharUle “una(rasUla)le nai tyo racekA hun” bhanera bhanchan? bhanideU– “yadi maile tyo raceko ho bhane mero pApa mamAthi cha, ra jo aparAdha timIharU garirahekA chau tyasako dAyitvabATa ma mukta rahekochu |”
nUhamAthi prakAzanA gariyo ki timro jAtimadhye, jasale ImAna lyAe unIharUbAheka, arU kasaile ImAna lyAune chaina | ani tinIharUle je garirahekA chan tyasako lAgi timI duHkhita nahoU |
ra, hAmro nirikSaNamA hAmro prakAzanA anusAra DuMgA nirmANa gara, ra atyAcArIharUko sambandhamA masita siphAriza nagara, tinIharU avazya nai DubAinechan |

ani nUhale DuMgAko nirmANa kArya Arambha garepachi unakA samudAyakA nAikeharu unako najikabATa ohora dohora gardA unako khillI uDAu~the | ani nUhale bhanne garthe– “yadi timIharu hAmro upahAsa garchau bhane timIharule khillI uDAe jhaiM hAmI pani timIharuko avazya nai khillI uDAunechauM |
ani, timIharUlAI cA~Dai thAhA hunecha ki kasamAthi yasto yAtanA Aunecha jasale tyasalAI apamAnita garnecha, ra kasamAthi sthAyI yAtanA barsanecha |”

yahA~samma ki hAmro Adeza Aipugyo ra ‘tannUra’ phuTyo | hAmIle bhanyauM– “tI vyaktiharUbAheka jasako bAremA pahile nai batAisakieko cha, sabai prakArakA (janAvarakA) eka–eka joDI ra Aphno parivArakA anya sadasyaharU tathA AsthAvAnaharUlAI tyasa (DuMgA) mA savAra garAU |” unIsAtha ta kehI vyaktiharUle mAtra ImAna lyAekA thie |
nUhale bhane– “tyasamA savAra hoU, allAhakai nAmabATa tyo (DuGgA) calnu tathA rokinu cha | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |”
ra, tinIharulAI bokera pahADaharujasto laharabIca DuMgA caldai thiyo | nUhale alaga raheko Aphno putralAI pukArera bhane–“he merA putra! hAmIsa~ga savAra hoU ra kAphiraharumA sAmela nahoU |”

usale javApha diyo–“ma yasto pahADamAthi caDhnechu jasale malAI pAnIbATa surakSita rAkhnecha |” una (nUha) le bhane– “Aja allAhako Adeza (yAtanA) bATa kasaile pani bacAuna sakdaina, sivAya tI byaktiharU bAheka jasamAthi allAhako dayA hunecha |” tyattikaimA duvaikAbIcamA lahara uThyo ani U Dubne vyaktiharumadhyeko bhayo |
ra Adeza bhayo– “he pRthvI Aphno pAnIlAI nila ra he AkAza rokihAla |” ani pAnI sukyo ra phaisalA pUrA gariyo tathA DuMgA jUdI pahADamA rokiyo ra bhaniyo– “atyAcArIharUkAlAgi zrApa cha |”

ra, nUhale AphnA pAlanakartAlAI pukAre ra bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA mero putra nizcaya nai mero parivAraantargata raheko cha, nissandeha timro vacana satya cha ra timI sampUrNa hAkimaharUmadhye sababhandA uttama hAkima hau |”

allAhale bhane– “he nUha! yathArthamA U timro parivAraantargatako hoina | vAstavamA tyo ta pUrNarUpamA kukarma ho | timIlAI jJAna nabhaeko kurAko mAga masita nagara | ajJAnIharUjhaiM nabana, bhanI ma timIlAI upadeza dinchu |”

unale bhane– “he merA raba! juna kurAko malAI jJAna chaina tyasabAre timIsita prazna garnabATa bacna ma timro zaraNa cAhanchu | yadi timIle malAI kSamA ra dayA garenau bhane ma ta ghATA behAerneharUmadhye hunechu |”

Adeza bhayo–“he nUha! orla yasa avasthAmA ki hAmrotarphabATa zAnti ra maMgalamaya cha timI ra timIsa~ga bhaekA samUhaharUmAthi | ra kehI yastA samUhaharU pani chan jasalAI hAmIle nizcaya nai sAMsArika phAidAbATa lAbhAnvita garnechauM tara pheri tinIharUlAI hAmrotarphabATa dukhadAyI yAtanA pugnecha |”

(he sandeSTA!) yI parokSakA khabaraharU hun juna hAmIle timItarpha paThAune garchauM, jasalAI yasabhandA pahile na timI, na timrA jAtikA mAnisaharUle nai jAndathe | ani dhairya dhAraNa gara, nizcaya nai antima pariNAma Izabhaya rAkhneharUko hakamA nai hunecha |

ra, hAmIle Adatarpha unakA bhAi hUdalAI paThAyauM | unale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! allAhako upAsanA gara | unIbAheka timro kohI upAsya chaina | timIharU (allAhakAe sAjhedAra banAera unImAthi) mithyAropaNa mAtra garirahekA chau |

he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! ma yasa upadezako saTTAmA kunai pratidAna timIharUsita mAgdina | mero pratidAna kevala unako jimmAmA raheko cha jasale malAI sRSTi gare | ke timIharU buddhile kAma liMdainau?

he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAsita kSamAyAcanA gara | ra, unaitira pharka | unale timIharUmAthi AkAzabATa abirala varSA garnechan ra timIharUko zaktimA ajha zakti thapnechan | ra, timIharU aparAdhI bhaI bimukha nahoU |”
tinIharUle bhane– “he hUda! timIle hAmIsamakSa kunai spaSTa pramANa prastuta garenau, ra timIle bhandaimA hAmI AphnA upAsyalAI choDne chainauM | ra, na hAmI timImAthi bizvAsa garnechAaiM |

hAmI ta yAe bhanchAaiM ki timImAthi hAmro kunai devatAko mAra pareko cha |” hUdale bhane– “ma allAhalAI sAkSI banAu~chu ra timIharU pani sAkSI basa, jasalAI timIharU sAjhedAra banAune garchau tinIharUsa~ga mero kunai sarokAra chaina...
unI (allAha) bAheka | ataH timIharU sabai milera meroviruddha yojanA banAU ra malAI alikati pani avasara nadeU |

mero pUrNa bharosA unai allAhamAthi cha, jo merA pAlanakartA hun ra timIharUkA pAlanakartA pani | kunai prANI chaina jasako culTho unale pakrekA nahoUn | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA bilkula sIdhA mArgavAlA hun |

ra, timIharU vimukha hunchau bhane hoU | jasakAsAtha malAI timIharUsamakSa paThAieko thiyo tyo sandeza maile timIharUsamma puryAidie~ | merA pAlanakartAle anya samudAyalAI timIharUko sthAnamA lyAunechan ra timIharUle unako kehI bigArna sakne chainau | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA sampUrNa cijakA saMrakSaka hun |
ani, jaba hAmro Adeza Aipugyo, taba hAmIle Aphno kRpAle hUda tathA unakAsAtha ImAna lyAuneharUlAI bacAyauM ra tinIharUlAI euTA kaTAera prakopabATa jogAyauM |
yo ho Ada jasale AphnA pAlanakartAkA AyataharUlAI inkAra garyo tathA unakA rasUlaharUko avajJA garyo ra pratyeka atyAcArI, satyadrohIko Adezako anusaraNa garyo |
ani zrApa cha tinIharUkAlAgi yasa saMsAramA ra mahApralayako dinamA pani | jAnirAkha, Adale AphnA pAlanakartAko avajJA gare | jAnirAkha, barabAdI Ayo hUdako samudAya AdamAthi |

ra, samUdatarpha unakA bhAi sAlehalAI paThAyauM unale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! kevala allAhako upAsanA gara | unIbAheka timIharUko kohI upAsya chaina | unale nai timIharUlAI dhartIbATa sRjanA gare ra tyasamA timIharUlAI basAe | ataH unIsita kSamAyAcanA gara ani unaitarpha pharka | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA ati nikaTa chan ra prArthanAlAI pani svIkArchan |”,

tinIharUle bhane– “he sAleha! yasaaghi timI hAmImAjha AzAko kendra thiyau | ke timI tI cijaharUko pUjAbATa hAmIlAI rokchau jasako pUjA hAmrA pUrvajaharUle gardai AekA chan? ra, juna kurAtarpha timI hAmIlAI bolAu~daichau tyasako bAremA hAmI dvidhAjanaka sandehamA chauM |”

una(sAleha)le bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! alikati vicAra gara! yadi ma AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa tarkamA kAyama chu, ra unale malAI Aphno vizeSa kRpA pani pradAna garekA chan, taipani ajhai maile allAhako avajJA gareM bhane allAhavirUddha kasale mero sahayoga garlA? timIharUle malAI ajha ghATAgrasta pArnechau |

ra, he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! yo allAhako U~TanI timIharUkAnimti euTA nizAnI ho | ataH allAhako dhartImA svatantrapUrvaka carnakAlAgi yasalAI choDideU ra yasalAI kunai kisimako kaSTa nadeU | anyathA timIharUlAI euTA nikaTa yAtanAle gA~jnecha |”
tara, tinIharUle tyasako khuTTA kATidie | ani sAlehale bhane– “timIharU ajha tInadina gharamA mojamastI gara | yo kunai jhuTalAinekhAlakAe dhamkI hoina |”

jaba hAmro Adeza Ayo, hAmIle Aphno vizeSa kRpAdvArA sAleha tathA unakAsAtha rahekA AsthAvAnaharUlAI bacAyauM, ra tyasa (mahApralayakAe) dinako apamAnabATa pani (bacAunechauM) | nissandeha timrA pAlanakartA nai zaktivAna evaM prabhutvazAlI chan |
ra, atyAcArIharUlAI bhayAvaha garjanale samAtyo | ani tinIharU Aphno gharamA (yasarI) ghopTo pare...
mAnauM tinIharU tyahA~ basekai thienan | jAnirAkha, samUdale AphnA pAlanakartAko avajJA garyo | suna, samUdako lAgi barabAdI cha!
ra, ibrAhImakahA~ hAmrA phariztAharU zubhasUcanA liera Ae | unIharUle salAma bhane | ibrAhImale pani salAma bhane, ra kehI kSaNamai bhuTeko bAccho peza gare |

parantu jaba unale unIharUkA hAta tyasatarpha baDheko dekhenan, unIharUlAI aparicita ThAnI unale manamA Dara mahasUsa gare | unIharUle bhane– “naDarAU, hAmIharU lUtakA samudAyatarpha paThAiekA chauM |”
ra, unakI patnI najikai ubhiirahekI thiin | unI musumusu hA~sin | ani hAmIle unalAI isahAka tathA isahAkapachi yaakUbako zubhasUcanA diyauM |
unale bhanin– “aho! ke maile santAna pAuna sakchu ra!? jabaki ma svayaM buDhesakAlamA pugekI chu, ra yinI merA pati pani bUDhA bhaisakekA chan | yo ta ekadamai Azcaryajanaka kurA ho |”

unIharUle bhane– “ke timI allAhako Adezaprati Azcarya garchau? he ibrAhImakA parivAra ho! timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA tathA unakA anugrahaharU rahekA chan | nissandeha unI ati prazaMsanIya evaM gauravazAlI chan |”
ani jaba ibrAhImako Dara harAyo ra unalAI zubhasUcanA pani prApta bhayo, unale hAmIsita lUtako jAtikA bAremA tarkavitarka garna thAle |
vAstavamA ibrAhIma ati sahanazIla, komala–hRdayI tathA allAhasamakSa jhukne vyakti thie |
he ibrAhIma! choDideU yasa kurAlAI (kinabhane) timrA pAlanakartAko Adeza Aipugeko cha, ra tinIharUmAthi TArna nasakine prakopa AunevAlA cha |
ani, jaba hAmrA phariztAharU lUtakahA~ puge taba unI ati cintita bhae ra tinIharUko sambandhamA AphUlAI asamartha pAe | ra, bhane– “Ajako dina ati kaThina raheko cha |”

ra, unakA samudAyakA mAnisaharU anAyAsa unItarpha Ae | unIharU pahiledekhi nai azlIla kAryamA lipta thie | lUtale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! yI hun merA chorIharU jo timIharUkAlAgi baDhI pavitra chan | ra, allAhako bhayarAkha | ani merA pAhunAko sambandhamA malAI apamAnita nagara | ke timIharUmadhye kohI pani sajjana chaina?”
tinIharUle bhane– “timIlAI thAhA cha~daicha ki hAmIlAI timrA chorIharUmA hAmro kunai adhikAra chaina, ra hAmI je cAhanchauM tyo pani timIlAI thAhA nai cha |”
lUtale bhane– “hAya, yadi masaMga timIharUsita mukAbilA garne zakti bhaidieko bhae, vA kunai zaktizAlI sahArAko Azraya lina sakeko bhae!”

unI(phariztAharU)le bhane– “he lUta! hAmI timrA rabakA dUta hauM | tinIharU kadApi timro nikaTa pugna sakne chainan | ani timI AphnI patnIbAheka AphnA parivArakAsAtha rAtako kunai samayamA prasthAna gara ra timIharUmadhye kasaile pani pharkera naheros | nissandeha tyasa (timrI patnI) mAthi pani tyahI prakopa Aunecha juna tinIharUmAthi Aunecha | tinIharUko barabAdIko samaya bihAna raheko cha | ke bihAnI ati nikaTa chaina ra?”
ani jaba hAmro Adeza Ayo, hAmIle tyasa (bastI)ko mAthillo bhAgalAI tallo bhAgamA ghopTAidiyauM ra tinIharUmAthi lagAtAra DhuGgAko varSA garAyauM |
tI sabai Dhu~gAharU timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa aMkita thie | ra, tyo atyAcArIharUbATa TADhA thiena |

ra, madyanatarpha unakA bhAi zuaibalAI paThAyauM | unale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! kevala allAhako upAsanA gara | unIbAheka timro anya kohI upAsya chaina | ra, nApa tathA taulamA kamI nagara | ma timIharUlAI susampanna dekhdaichu tara ma timIharUprati tyasa dinako prakopabATa DarAu~chu jasale (sabailAI) ghernecha |
ani, he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! nyAyakAsAtha ThIkasaMga nApa evaM taula pUrA gara ra mAnisaharUlAI unIharukA vastuharU kama nadeU | ra, dhartImA vidhvaMsa namaccAU |
yadi timIharU vizvAsa garchau bhane allAhale dieko phAidA nai timIharUkAlAgi rAmro ho | ra, ma timIharUko saMrakSaka hoina |”

tinIharUle bhane– “he zuaiba! ke timro namAjale timIlAI yo sikAu~cha ki hAmI hAmrA pUrvajaharule pujdai AekA vastuharUko pUjA tyAgauM, ra Aphno dhanako lenadena pani Aphno icchA anusAra nagarauM? a~, timI nai eka sahanazIla evaM satyaniSTha vyakti hau |”

una(zuaiba)le bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! ke timIharUle vicAra garyau yadi ma AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa spaSTa pramANamA kAyama chu, ra unale malAI Aphno tarphabATa uttam jIvikA pani pradAna garekA chan bhane (ma AphnA pAlanakartAko avajJA garI timro sAtha kasarI dina sakchu?) ra ma junakurAbATa timIharUlAi rAekchU svayaM tyahI kArya garna cAMhadina | yathAsambhava ma kevala timIharUko sudhAra nai cAhanchu | ra, yI sabai kArya (allAhako kRpAmA nirbhara chan |) ma unImAthi nai bharosA garchu ra unaitarpha pharkinchu |
