ra, he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! katai yasto nahos ki meroviruddha timIharUko virodhale gardA timIharUmAthi pani tyahI prakopa Aiparos juna prakopa nUha, hUda ra sAlehakA samudAyaharUmAthi Aeko thiyo, ani lUtako samudAya ta timIharUbATa TADhA pani raheko chaina |
ani, AphnA pAlanakartAsita kSamAyAcanA gara ra unaitarpha pharka | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA parama dayAlu evaM snehI chan |”

tinIharUle bhane– “he zuaiba! hAmI timIle bhanekA prAyaHjaso kurAharU bujhdainauM ra hAmIharU timIlAI hAmImadhyeko euTA durbala vyakti ThAndachauM | ra, yadi timrA dAjubhAiharU nabhaekA bhae nizcaya nai hAmIle timIlAI DhuGgA barsAera mArne thiyauM | ra, hAmImAthi timIlAI prabhutva pani prApta chaina |”

una(zuaiba)le bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! ke merA dAjubhAiharU timIharUkAlAgi allAhabhandA pani zaktizAlI chan, ki timIharUle allAhalAI ekdamai nakAryAai? nissandeha merA pAlanakartAle timIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUlAI gherekA chan |

ra, he merA jAtibandhuharU! timIharU Aphno ThAu~mA kArya gardai jAU, ma pani Aphno kArya gardai jAnchu | apamAnita garne prakopa kasamAthi Au~cha ra ko jhuTho cha, bhanne kurA timIharUle cA~Dai nai jAnnechau | timIharU pratIkSA gara, ma pani timIharUsa~gai pratIkSA gardaichu |”

ani, jaba hAmro Adeza Ayo taba hAmIle zuaiba tathA unakA ImAnavAlA sAthIharUlAI Aphno kRpAmA surakSita rAkhyauM, ra atyAcArIharUlAI bhayaGkara garjana (prakopa)le samAtyo | ani tinIharU AphnA gharaharumA ghopTina puge |
mAnauM tinIharU tyahA~ basekai thienan | jAnirAkha, madyanakA lAgi tyastai barbAdI bhayAe jasto samUdamAthi thiyo |
ra, hAmIle mUsAlAI AphnA nizAnIharU tathA spaSTa pramANakAsAtha paThAyauM..
phiraauna tathA usakA bhAradAraharUsamakSa | ani, bhAradAraharUle phiraaunakai Adezako pAlanA gare jabaki phiraaunako Adeza satya thiena |
mahApralayako dina usale Aphno samudAyako aguvAi garnecha, ra tinIharUlAI narakamA liera jAnecha | ra, tyo katti narAmro sthAna hunecha jahA~ tinIharU orlanechan!
yasa saMsAramA pani tinIharUlAI dhikkArieko cha ra mahApralayako dina pani | ra kati narAmro upahAra rahecha juna tinIharUlAI diieko cha!,
yI kehI nagaraharUkA vRttAnta hun juna hAmI timIsamakSa bayAna gardaichauM | tinIharUmadhye kehI ahilesamma kAyama chan bhane kehI naSTa bhaisakekA chan |,

ra, hAmIle tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garenauM | baru tinIharUle nai svayaMmAthi atyAcAra gare | ataH jaba timrA pAlanakartAko Adeza (prakopa) Aipugyo taba tinIharUle pukArdai garekA allAhabAhekakA upAsyaharU tinIharukAlAgi kunai kAmamA Aenan | baru tinIharUle tinIharuko vinAzamA bRddhi gare |
timrA pAlanakartAko pakaDa yastai hunecha, jaba unI avajJAmA lipta nagaraharUlAI samAtnechan | vAstavamA unako pakaDa kaSTakara ra zasakta hune garcha |
nissandeha tyasamA paralokako yAtanAko bhaya rAkhne vyaktikAlAgi zikSA cha | tyo sampUrNa mAnisaharUlAI bhelA garine dina hunecha ra yahI (allAhasamakSa) hAjira garine dina pani hunecha |
ra, hAmI tyasalAI euTA nizcita dinakolAgi mAtra vilamba gardaichauM |
ra, jaba tyo dina Au~cha, taba kohI pani allAhako anumati binA bolna sakne chaina | ani tinIharUmadhye kehI abhAgI Thaharinechan ra kehI bhAgyamAnI |
ani jo abhAgI hunechan, tinIharU narakamA jAnechan jahA~ tinIharU svA~svA~ ra phvA~phvA~ garnechan |

tinIharU sadAkAlAgi tyasaimA rahanechan jabasamma (paralAekakA) AkAzaharU tathA dhartI kAyama rahanechan | timrA rabako cAhanA arkai bhayo bhane beglai kurA ho | nissandeha timrA raba je cAhanchan tyo garerai chADchan |

ani, bhAgyazAlI vyaktiharU svargamA praveza garnechan, sadAkA lAgi tyasaimA basobAsa garnechan jabasamma (paralAekakA) AkAzaharU tathA dhartI kAyama rahanechan | timrA rabako cAhanA arkai bhayo bhane beglai kurA ho | yo allAhako abicchinna anugraha hunecha |

ataH (he sandeSTA) yinIharUle upAsanA garirahekA yI upAsyaharUbAre timI kunai sandehamA naparnu | tinIharU AphubhandA aghikA pUrvajaharu jhaiM upAsanA gardaichan | ra, hAmI tinIharUko (daNDako) pUrNa hissA naghaTAikana dinechauM |

ra, hAmIle mUsAlAI grantha pradAna garyauM ani tyasamA vibheda gariyo | yadi timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa pahile nai euTA kurA nizcita nabhaeko bhae tinIharUbIca nirNaya garine thiyo | ra, tinIharU yasa sambandhamA dubidhApUrNa sandehamA gheriekA chan |
ra, timrA pAlanakartAle tI sabailAI tinIharukA karmaharUko pUrNa pratiphala dinechan | nissandeha unI tinIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUsita rAmro avagata chan |

ataH (he sandeSTA!) satmArgamA aDiga rahane gara timI pani ra timIsa~ga pharkekA vyaktiharU pani jasarI timIlAI Adeza bhaeko cha | ra, sImA ullaGghana nagara | nissandeha unI timIharUle garne sampUrNa kAryaharUlAI dekhirahekA chan |

ra, timIharU atyAcArI vyaktiharUtarpha alikati pani najhUka anyathA narakako agnile chunecha | ra, allAhabAheka timro kohI pani saMrakSaka–mitra hune chaina | ani na timIharUle kunai sahayoga nai pAunechau |
ra, namAja kAyama gara dinako duvai kinArA tathA rAtakA vibhinna praharaharUmA | nissandeha puNyakarmaharUle pApaharUko nivAraNa garchan | yo upadeza ho upadeza grahaNa garneharUkAlAgi |
ra, dhairyadhAraNa gara, nizcaya nai allAha surmIharUko pratidAnalAI naSTa garnai chainan |

ani timIharUbhandA pahilekA samudAyamA yastA satyaniSTha vyaktiharU kina thienan jasale dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAunabATa manAhI garUn, sivAya kehI vyaktiharUbAheka jasalAI hAmIle surakSita rAkhyauM? ra, atyAcArI mAnisaharU tI kurAharUko pachi nai lAge juna unIharUlAi pracUra mAtrAmA pradAna gariekAe thiyAe ra tinIharU aparAdhI thie |
ra, timrA rabale nagaraharulAI tyahA~kA bAsindAharu sudhAraka hu~dAhu~dai kahilyai kunai atyAcArapUrNa tarikAle naSTa gardainan |
ra, timrA pAlanakartAle cAhekA bhae sampUrNa mAnavalAI euTai samudAya banAune thie | tara, aba tinIharU vibheda nai garirahanechan |,

tI vyaktiharUbAheka jasamAthi allAha kRpA garchan ra yasakainimti unale tinIharUlAI sRjanA garekA hun | ra, timrA rabako yo vacana pUrA bhaeko cha ki ma narakalAI nizcaya nai jinna ra mAnava duvaile bharnechu |”

ra, he sandeSTA! IzadUtaharUkA yI sampUrNa ghaTanAharU timro hRdayalAI sudRDha pArna timIlAI sunAu~chauM | ra, yasamA timrAelAgi satyakAe jJAna pugeko cha | ra, yo AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi upadeza tathA anusmaraNa (pani) ho |
ani, ImAna nalyAuneharUlAI bhanideU– “timIharU Aphno sthAnamA kArya gardai jAU ra hAmI pani kArya gardai jAnchauM |
ani, timIharU pratIkSA gara ra hAmI pani pratikSA garirahekAchauM |”,

ra, AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA adRzya vAstavikatAharUko jJAna kevala allAhalAI cha | ra, sampUrNa mAmilAharU unaitarpha pharkAincha | ataH unakai upAsanA gara ra unaimAthi bharosA gara ra, timIharUle garne garekA kAryabATa timrAe pAlanakartA anabhijJa chainan |
alipha0 lAma0 rA0; yI spaSTa granthakA AyataharU hun |
hAmIle yasa kuraAnalAI arabI bhASAmA avatarita garekA chauM tAki timIharUle bujhna saka |
(he sandeSTA) hAmIle timIlAI timImAthi prakAzanA gareko yasa kuraAnadvArA euTA ati uttama vRttAnta sunAu~dachauM jasabAre timI pahile anabhijJa thiyau |
yo tyasa yugako kurA ho jaba yUsuphale AphnA pitAlAI bhane– “he merA pitA! maile eghAravaTA tArA, evaM sUrya tathA candramAlAI merosAmu sajdA gardaichan bhanera sapanAmA dekheko chu|”
unale bhane–“he mero putra! Aphno yo sapanA AphnA dAjuharUlAI nasunAunU anyathA tinIharUle timIviruddha SaDayantra garnechan, kinabhane zaitAna mAnavako spaSTa zatru ho |”

ra, yasaigarI timrA pAlanakartAle timIlAI (sandezaTA) cayana garnechan; kurAharUko tahasamma pugna sikAunechan, ra jasarI unale Aphno anugraha timrA pUrvajaharU ibrAhIma tathA ishAkamAthi pUrNa garekA thie tyasarI nai timI tathA yAakUbakA santAnaharUmAthi pani Aphno anugraha pUrNa garnechan | nissandeha timrA pAlanakartA sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |”
vAstavamA yUsupha tathA unakA dAjuharUko kathAmA sodhneharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |
unakA dAjuharUle ApasamA bhane– “yUsupha tathA unakA bhAi hAmrA pitAkAlAgi hAmIbhandA adhika priya rahekA chan jabaki hAmI euTA samUha nai chauM | saccAI yo ho ki hAmrA pitA ThUlo bhUlamA chan |”,
“yUsuphalAI mArideU vA usalAI ajJAta ThAu~mA phyA~kideU tAki timrA pitAko dhyAna pUrNarUpale kevala timIharUtarpha nai kendrita hoos, ani yUsuphapachi timIharU yogya samUha bhaihAlnechau |”

tinIharUmadhye ekajanAle bhanyo– “yUsuphako hatyA nagara barU yadi timIharU kehI garna nai cha bhane usalAI kunai gahiro inArako piMdhamA phyA~kideU jahA~bATa usalAI kunai yAtru–dalale nikAlera laijAos |”
tinIharUle bhane– “he hAmrA pitA! Akhira yUsuphako sambandhamA tapAIM hAmImAthi bharosA kina garnuhunna jabaki hAmI usako vAstavika zubhacintaka hauM?
bholi usalAI hAmIsa~ga jAna dinuhos, tAki usale khAnapIna garos ra khelos | usako surakSAkAlAgi hAmI cha~daichauM ni |”
yAakUbale bhane– “timIharule usalAI liera jAnu meronimti cintAko viSaya hunecha, sAthai timIharu usakolAgi asAvadhAna bhaeko avasthAmA usalAI bvA~sole khAlA ki bhanne pani malAI Dara lAgcha |”
tinIharUle bhane– “hAmI euTA samUha hu~dAhu~dai pani yadi bvA~sole usalAI khAyo bhane ta hAmIle sabaithAka gumAunechauM |”

jaba tinIharU usalAI liera gae ra inArako gahirAImA hAlne nizcaya gare, taba hAmIle yUsuphatarpha prakAzanA garyauM–eka samaya avazya aAune jaba jaba timI tinIharUlAI unIharule gareko yasa duvryavahArabAre avagata garAunechau tara tinIharU tyasabAre anabhijJa hunechan |
kehibera rAti tinIharU ru~dai–karAu~dai AphnA pitAsamakSa Ae |

bhanna thAle– “pitA jyU! hAmI ApasamA dauDako pratispardhAmA vyasta thiyauM ra yUsuphalAI AphnA sAmAnaharUko surakSAkolAgi choDekA thiyauM | tyasai avadhimA bvA~sole usalAI khAidiyo | tara, hAmIle hAmI sAMcAe bAeldai pani tapAIM hAmro kurA patyAunuhunna |”

ra, tinIharUle yUsuphako kamijamA jhuTho ragata pani lagAera lyAekA thie | yaakUbale bhane– “(yo satya hoina) barU timIharUkAe manale euTA jaTila mAmilAlAi sarala kanAidiyAe | ataH dhairya garnu nai uttama huncha | ra, timIharUle racekA kurAharUmA allAhakai sahayoga cAhieko cha |”

ani, tyasatarpha euTA yAtrudala Ayo ra tyasale pAnI bharna Aphno euTA mAnche paThAyo | ani jaba usale (inAramA) Aphno bAlTina khasAlyo taba usale pukAryo– “zubha–sUcanA! yahA~ euTA keTo po rahecha |” ra, tinIharUle unalAI euTA vyApArika sampatti ThAnera lukAe | ra, jejati tinIharUle garthe tyasabAre allAha rAmrarI avagata thie |
ani tinIharUle unalAI dherai kama dirahama (mUdrA) mA bikrI gare | ra, tinIharUlAI tyasamA kunai cAso pani thiena |

ra, misrako juna vyaktile unalAI kharIda garyo usale AphnI patnIlAI bhanyo– “yasalAI rAmrarI rAkha; AzA cha yo hAmrolAgi lAbhadAyaka hunecha vA yasalAI hAmI putra nai banAu~MlA |” yasarI hAmIle yUsuphalAI (misrako) bhUmimA sthApita garyauM tAki unalAI mAmilAko tahasamma pugna sikAauM | ra, allAha Aphno kArya garerai chADchan tara adhikAMza vyaktiharUlAI thAhA nai hu~daina |
ra, jaba yUsupha paripakka umeramA puge; hAmIle unalAI nirNaya kSamatA ra jJAna pradAna garyauM | ra, yasarI nai hAmI satkarmIharUlAI pratidAna dine garchauM |

ra, unI juna mahilAko gharamA thie tinale unalAI phakAuna cAhin ra, (eka dina) DhokAharU banda garera bhanin– “AijA (ma tero lAgi tayAra chu) |” yUsuphale bhane– “allAhako zaraNa mAgchu | allAha nai merA pAlanakartA hun | unale malAI sammAnakAsAtha rAkhekA chan (ma yo kukarma kasarI garna sakchu ra?) | atyAcArIharUle kahilyai saphalatA pAuna sakdainan |”

ra, tI (mahilA) yUsuphako cAhanA gardai agADi baDhin ra yUsuphale AphnA pAlanakartAko spaSTa pramANa nadekhekA bhae unI pani mahilAko cAhanA gardai agADi baDhne thie | yastai bhayo tAki hAmI unIdvArA kukarma tathA azlIlatA nivAraNa garauM | vAstavamA unI hAmrA chAniekA bhaktaharUmadhyekA thie |

ani, duvaijanA DhokAtarpha huttie ra tinale unako kamija pachADibATa cyAtin | ra, DhokA najika tI duvaile mahilAkA patilAI pAe | unale bhanin– “tapAIMko parivArasita kuniyata garne yasa vyaktiko sajAya~ kaida vA kaSTakara yAtanAbAheka ke huna sakcha?”

una(yUsupha)le bhane– “unale nai malAI phakAuna khojin | ra, mahilAko Aphnai parivArakA eka sAkSIle tarka peza garyo– “yadi usako kamija aghiltirabATa cyAtieko cha bhane mahilA saccA ra yUsupha jhUThAharUmadhye hun |
ra yadi unako kamija pachiltirabATa cyAtieko cha bhane mahilA jhUTho ra unI(yUsupha) saccA hun |”
ani jaba patile unako kamija pachiltirabATa cyAtieko dekhe, unale bhane– “yo avazya nai timI mahilAharUko jAlamA phasAune caturyAi~ ho, ra timIharUko phandA vAstavamA gajjabako huncha |
yUsupha timI yasa kurAlAI choDideU ra (he strI!) timI Aphno pApakolAgi prAyazcita gara | vAstavamA doSa timrai cha |”

ra, nagarakA mahilAharUbIca yo carcAko viSaya banyo ki samrATakI patnIle Aphno yuvA (dAsa)lAI Aphno kAmecchA pUrA garna phakAuna khojekI chin ra usako premamA pAgala bhaekI chin | hAmro vicAramA ta unI ThUlo bhUlamA chin |”

ani, unale tinIharUko IrSryApUrNa caturyAi~kA kurAharU sunera tinIharUlAI bolAuna paThAin, ra tinIharUkAlAgi baiThakako vyavasthA garin | ani, tinIharUmadhye pratyekalAI ekaekavaTA churI diin ra una (yUsupha)lAI bhanin– “yinIharUkA sAmunne AU |” jaba tI mahilAharUle unalAI dekhe taba tinIharU daMga pare | tinIharUle Aphno hAta nai kATna puge ra bhane– “hAzA lillAh! (allAhako Azraya!) yinI ta mAnava hoinan | yinI ta mahAn phariztA hun!”

(tI strIle) bhanin– “yahI ho tyo vyakti jasako bAremA timIharUle mero nindA gardai thiyau | sA~ccikai maile usalAI phakAune prayAsa garekI thie~, tara U mero phandAmA Aena | ani, yadi usale mero kurA mAnena bhane nizcaya nai U kaida garinecha ra dherai apamAnita hunecha |

una(yUsupha)le prArthanA gare– “he merA raba! juna kAryatarpha tinIharUle malAI bolAu~daichan, merAelAgi tyasabhandA baDhI priya ta kArAgAra nai cha | yadi timIle tinIharuko SaDyantra mabATa nivAraNa garenau bhane ma tinIharUko jAlamA phasnechu ra ajJAnIharUmadhye hunechu |
ani unakA rabale unako prArthanA svIkAra gare ra tinI (mahilAharU)ko chalalAI unIbATa haTAidie | nissandeha unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |
nizAnIharU dekhera pani tinIharUle yUsuphalAI kehI samayakAlAgi kArAgAramA banda garne niSkarSamA puge |

unakA sAtha anya duI yuvakaharU pani kArAgAramA praveza gare | ekadina tI duImadhye euTAle bhanyo– “maile sapanAmA dekheM ki ma madirA nicordai chu |” ra, arkole bhanyo– “maile sapanAmA dekheM ki maile Aphno TAukomAthi roTI bokeko chu jasabATa paMkSIharU khA~daichan | hAmIlAI svapna–phala batAidinuhos, kinabhane tapAIMM hAmro dRSTimA satkarmI hunuhuncha |”

unI (yUsupha)le bhane– “timIharUlAI diine bhojana timIharUsamakSa AunubhandAaghi nai ma timIharUlAI svapna–phala batAidinechu | yI tI kurAharUmadhye hun juna merA pAlanakartAle malAI sikAekA chan | maile tI vyaktiharUko dharma choDisakeko chu jo allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhdainan ra AkhiratalAI pani asvIkAra garchan |

ra, ma AphnA pUrvaja ibrAhIma, ishAka tathA yaakUbako dharmako anusaraNa gardaichu | hAmIlAI allAhasa~ga kunai cijalAI sAjhedAra banAune adhikAra nai chaina | yo hAmImAthi tathA mAnavamAthi allAhako vizeSa anugraha ho | tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU bhane kRtaghna chan |
he merA kArAgArakA duvai sAthI ho! ke aneka pAlanakartAharU rAmrA hun vA kevala eka allAha jasalAI sabaimAthi prabhutva prApta cha?

allAhabAheka timIharU ja–jasako pUjA garchau tinIharU kevala nAma hun juna timIharU tathA timrA purvajaharUle racekA hun | allAhale tyasakolAgi kunai pramANa avataraNa garekA chainan | vAstavamA allAhabAheka kasaiko zAsana–sattA chaina | unako Adeza cha– “unIbAheka kasaiko upAsanA nagara | yahI sIdhA dharma ho |” tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |”

he merA kArAgArakA duvai sAthIharU ho! timIharU duvaimadhye pahilo vyaktile Aphno svAmIlAI madirA pilAunecha, ra jahAMsamma dozrokAe kurA cha ta usalAI zUlI caDhAinecha ani usako TAukolAI paMkSIharUle luchera khAnechan | timIharUle sodhekA kurAharUko sambandhamA nirNaya bhaisakeko cha |

ra, tI duvaimadhye rihA hune vyaktilAI yUsuphale bhane– “AphnA svAmI (misrakA samrAT) samakSa mero pani carcA garnU |” parantu zaitAnale usalAI AphnA svAmIsamakSa carcA garna bhulAidiyo jasale gardA unI kehI varSasamma kArAgAramai rahe |

eka dina rAjAle bhane– “maile sapanAmA ke dekheko chu bhane, sAtavaTA moTA gAIlAI anya sAtavaTA dublA gAIle khA~daichan, ani, sAtavaTA annakA hariyA bAlA chan ra anya sAtavaTA sukekA bAlA | he bhAradAraharU ho! yadi timIharU svapna–phala jAndachau bhane malAI mero svapna–phala batAU |”
tinIharule bhane– “yI chyAsmis sapanAharu hun ra hAmIlAI sapanAharuko artha pani thAhA chaina | ”

ani tI duImadhye kArAgArabATa rihA bhaeko tyasa vyaktile jasalAI dherai samayapachi (yUsuphale bhaneko) kurA yAda Ayo; bhanyo– “ma tapAIMlAI yasa sapanAko bhAvArtha batAunechu | ataH malAI (kArAgAra) paThAidinuhos |”

he yUsupha! he param saccAvAdI! hAmIlAI artha batAU– sAtavaTA moTA gAIlAI anya sAtavaTA dublA gAIle khA~daichan, ani, sAtavaTA annakA hariyA bAlA chan ra anya sAtavaTA sukekA bAlA | tAki ma mAnisaharUsamakSa pharkU jasale gardA tinIharUle (svapnaphala) jAnUn |
unale bhane– timIharU sAtavarSa lagAtAra khetI gardairahanu | ani juna (anna) kATchau tyasamadhye timIharU khAnejati bAheka sabai annalAI tyasako bAlAmai rahana dinU |

tyasapachi bhokamarIkA sAtavaTA kaThina varSaharU Aunechan, tyasa avadhimA tI sabai annaharU upabhoga garinecha juna timIharUle jammA garera rAkhekA hunechau, tyo thorai (anna) vAheka juna timIharUle tyasamadhye jogAera rAkhnechau |
ani tyasapachi eka yasto sAla Aunecha jasamA varSAdvArA mAnisaharUko maddata garinecha ra tinIharU khubai (aMgura) nicornechan |

rAjAko Adeza bhayo– “yUsuphalAI liera AU |” ani jaba bolAune vyakti unIsamakSa Ae taba unale bhane– “timI Aphno svAmIkahA~ pharkera jAU ra juna mahilAharUle AphnA hAta kATekA thie tinIharUko vAstavika mAmilA ke ho bhanI sodha | nissandeha tinIharUko caturyAi~bAre merA pAlanakartA pUrNarUpamA avagata chan |”

ani rAjAle sodhe– “tyasa samaya ke bhaeko thiyo jaba timIharUle yUsuphalAI phakAuna khojekA thiyau?” tinIharUle bhane– “hAza lillAha” (allAhako Azraya!) hAmIle yUsuphamA kunai khoTa pAenauM | ajijakI patnIle bhanin– “aba satya kurA spaSTa bhaisakekai cha | maile nai usalAI phakAune prayAsa garekI thie~ | vAstavamA unI saccA vyakti hun |”
(yUsuphale bhane) yasako uddezya yo thiyo ki rAjAle jAnUn ki maile uhA~ko anupasthitimA uhA~sita vizvAsaghAta gareko chaina, ra, yAe pani ki allAha vizvAsaghAtIharUkAe cAlalAI saphala huna didainan |

ra, (yUsuphale bhane) ma svayaMlAI doSamukta ThAndina | nizcaya nai manale kukarmakolAgi prerita garcha, sivAya tyasa vyaktilAI jasamAthi mero pAlanakartAko dayA huncha | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

ra samrATale Adeza die–“yUsuphalAI mero sAmunne liera AU, unalAI Aphno nIji kAryakAlAgi niyukta garne chU |” ani jaba unIsita kurAkAnI bhayo taba unale bhane– “Ajadekhi timI hAmro najikako vizvAsilo padAdhikArI bhayau |”
una DhayUsupha)le bhane– “mulukako khajAnA (koSa) mA malAI niyukta garnuhos | ma yasako surakSA garna sakchu ra malAI yasako jAnakArI pani cha |”

ra, yasarI hAmIle yUsuphalAI yasa dezamA sattAdhikAra pradAna garyauM, (tAki) unI dezamA jahA~ cAhanchan basobAsa garUn | hAmI jasalAI cAhanchauM Aphno varadAna pradAna garchauM ra sUkarmIharUko pratidAna kahilyai naSTa gardainauM |
ra, juna vyaktiharUle ImAna lyAe ra Izabhaya rAkhe tinIharukAlAgi Akhiratako pratidAna ati uttama raheko cha |
ani, (jaba akAlako samaya Ayo) yUsuphakA dAjuharU Ae ra unIsamakSa puge | ra, unale tinIharUlAI cinihAle tara tinIharU unI (yUsupha) sita apiracita nai rahe |

ra, jaba yUsuphale tinIharUkA mAla–sAmAna tayAra garAidie taba tinIharUlAI bhane (arko paTaka Au~dA) Aphno sautinI bhAilAI pani sAthamA liera AunU | ke timIharUle dekhenauM ki ma timIharUlAI sAmAna pani pUrai nApera dinchu ra uttama atithi satkAra garnevAlA pani hu~?
ani, yadi timIharUle usalAI ma samakSa liera Aenau bhane timIharUlAI mero tarphabATa na kunai anna prApta hunecha ra na timIharU mero nikaTatA nai prApta garnasaknechau |
tinIharUle bhane– “hAmI yasa saMbandhamA usakA pitAlAI saMjhAera rAjI garne prayAsa garnechauM | ra, hAmIle yo kAma garnu nai cha |”
una (yUsupha)le AphnA karmacArIlAI Adeza die– “tinIharUle tireko dhana pani tinIharUkai borAmA phirtA rAkhideU | Aphno ghara pugepachi tinIharUle thAhA pAulAn | AzA cha, tinIharU pharkera Aunechan |”

ani jaba tinIharU Aphno pitAsamakSa puge taba bhanna thAle–“pitAjyU! hAmIlAI anna dina manAhI garieko cha | ani hAmIsa~ga hAmro bhAilAI pani jAne anumati dinuhos tAki hAmI anna liera Auna sakauM | hAmI usako rakSA garnechau |”
yaakUbale bhane– “ke ma usako bAremA timIharUmAthi tyasarI nai bharosA garU~ jasarI yasabhandAaghi usako bhAiko bAremA gareko thie~? ra, allAha nai uttama rakSaka tathA sarvazreSTha dayAlu chan |”

ra, jaba tinIharUle Aphno sAmAna khole taba Aphno mUladhana pani pharkAieko pAe | tinIharUle bhane– “pitAjyU! hAmIlAI ke cAhiyo? hernus, hAmIle dieko mUladhana phirtA garieko cha | aba hAmI Aphno parivArakAlAgi thapa khAdyAnna lyAunechauM; Aphno bhAiko rakSA pani garnechauM ra euTA U~Tale bokna sakne jati khAdyAnna thapa prApta garnechauM | yati khAdyAnna ta sajilai prApta hunecha |”

yaakUbale bhane– “jabasamma timIharU allAhako nAmamA dRDha vacana di~dainau ki usalAI masamakSa lyAunechau tabasamma ma usalAI timIharUsa~ga kadApi paThAudina~ | yo beglai kuro ho ki timIharU (saMkaTamA) gherinechau |” jaba tinIharUle Aphno vacana die, yaakUbale bhane– “hera hAmI je bhandaichauM tyasako nirIkSaka allAha hun |”

yaakUbale nirdezana didai bhane– “he merA putraharU ho! euTai DhokAbATa praveza nagarnU baru vibhinna DhokAharUbATa praveza garnU | ra ma timIharUlAI allAhako cAhanA viparIta bacAuna sakdina | Adeza kevala allAhakai calcha | mero pUrNa bharosA unaimAthi cha ra sabai bharosA garneharUle unaimAthi bharosA rAkhnuparcha |”

ra, jaba tinIharU Aphno pitAko AdezAnusAra praveza gare, taba tinIharUko sAvadhAnIko yo upAya allAhako nirNayako agADi kAma lAgne thiena | kevala yaakUbako hRdayamA utpanna bhaeko icchA thiyo jasalAI unale pUrA gare | ra, unI hAmIle sikAeko jJAnale gardA jJAnavAna thie | tara, adhikAMza vyaktiharU jAndainan |
ra, jaba tinIharU yUsuphasamakSa puge taba unale Aphno bhAi (binyAmIna) lAI basAera bhane– “ma timro dAju yUsupha hu~ | aba timI yinIharUle (hAmIharUsa~ga) garne gareko vyavahArabAre cintA nagara |”

jaba, unale tinIharuko sAmAna tayAra garAe tyasabelA Aphno bhAiko borAmA pAnI piune kacaurA rAkhidie | tyasapachi eka janA ghoSaNA garnele pukArdai bhanyo– “e yAtru–dalakA mAnisaharu! timIharu nizcaya nai cora hau |”
tinIharUle unIharUtarpha mukha pharkAera bhane– “timIharUle kuna cija gumAekA chau ra?”
tinIharUle bhane– “rAjakIya nApne bhA~Do gumAekA chauM | ra, jasale tyo khojera lyAunecha usakAe lAgi eka U~Tale bokna sakne (anna) prApta hunecha, yasako jimmA ma linchu |”
tinIharUle bhane– “allAhako kasama! hAmI yasa dezamA vidhvaMsa maccAuna AekA hoinau ra na hAmI cora nai hauM |”
unIharule bhane “yadi timIharU jhuTho sAbita bhayau bhane usa (cora)lAI ke sajAya~ hunuparcha?”
tinIharUle bhane–“jasako sAmAnamA tyo vastu bheTinecha tyasalAI nai daNDasvarUpa rAkhinecha |” hAmIkahA~ atyAcArIlAI yastai sajAya~ dine garincha |

ani usale unako bhAiko sAmAnabhandA pahile tinIharUkA sAmAnako talAsI zuru garyo | ani usale unako bhAiko sAmAnabATa harAieko vastu nikAlyo | yasarI hAmIle yUsuphakAlAgi upAya garyauM | unale zAhI kAnUnaantargata Aphno bhAilAI rokna sakne thienan sivAya yasako ki allAha nai cAhUn | hAmI jasalAI cAhanchauM padonnati garchauM | ra, hareka jJAnavAnabhandA ucca eka jJAnavAna cha |

unI (yUsuphakA dAjuharU)le bhane– “yadi usale coreko ho bhane yasaaghi usakA dAjule pani corI gareko thiyo!” tara, yUsuphale yasa kurAlAI Aphno manamai lukAirAkhe, ra, tinIharUsamakSa jAhera garenan | (unale manamanai) bhane– “timIharU ati nikRSTa darjAkA mAnisaharU hAai, ra juna Aropa timIharU lagAu~daichau allAha tyasako vAstavikatA rAmrarI jAndachan |”
tinIharUle bhane– “mahAmahima! yinakA pitA ati vRddha chan | ataH tapAIM usako sthAnamA hAmIharUmadhye kasailAI rAkhnus | hAmro dRSTimA tapAIM ati paropakArI hunuhuncha |”
una (yUsupha) le bhane–“maAjallAha (allAhako Azraya!) josa~ga hAmIle Aphno cija pAekAchauM tyasalAI choDI anya kasailAI kasarI giraphtAra garna sakchauM ra? tyaso garemA hAmI po anyAyI hunechauM |”

ataH, jaba tinIharU usa (binayAmina)bATa nirAza bhae taba ekAntamA parAmarza garna thAle | tinIharUko jeThole bhane–“timIharUkA pitAle timIharUsa~ga allAhako nAmamA dRDha vacana linubhaeko thiyo bhanne kurA timIharUlAI thAhA chaina? ra, yasabhandAaghi pani timIharUle yUsuphako mAmilAmA kasUra garisakekA chau | ra, ataH ma mero pitAle anumati nadiesamma yahA~bATa hallinna vA jabasamma allAhale nai merolAgi kunai nirNaya gardainan | ra, unI sarvazreSTha nirNAyaka hun |”
timIharU sabai AphnA pitAkahA~ pharka ra bhana– “pitAjyU! tapAIMko putrale corI garyo | ra, hAmI ta tyahI varNana gardaichauM je hAmIlAI thAhA cha | ra parokSako nirIkSaka ta hAmI hoinau |
ani, tapAIM tI nagarabAsIharUlAI sodhnuhos, ra tyasa yAtrudalalAI pani sodhnuhos josa~ga hAmI AyauM | hAmI bilakula sA~co bolirahekA chauM |”

yaakUbale bhane– “(yasto hoina) barU timIharU AphnaitarphabATa kurA banAu~daichau | ataH (mero lAgi) dhairya nai uttama hunecha | AzA cha ki tI sabailAI allAhale mero sAmunne lyAunechan | unI nai sarvajJa tathA tatvadarzI chan |”
ani unale tinIharUbATa munTo pharkAe ra bhane– “hAya yUsupha!” ra, pIra tathA cintAle (ru~dA ru~dA) unakA A~khAharU setA bhaekA thie | ra, unI zokamagna thie |
chorAharUle bhane– “allAhako kasama! tapAIM sadhaiM yUsuphalAI nai yAda garirahanu huncha | yahA~samma ki yA tapAIM birAmI parnuhuncha yA Aphno jyAna nai gumAunuhuncha |”
unale bhane– “ma Aphno zoka ra vedanA kevala allAhasamakSa prakaTa garchu | ra, allAhako tarphabATa malAI tI kurAharUko jJAna prApta cha, juna timIharU jAndainau |
he merA putraharU ho! timIharU jAU ra yUsupha tathA unako bhAiko bAremA pattA lagAU | ra, allAhako dayAbATa nirAza nahoU | unako dayAbATa kevala avajJAkArIharU nirAza hunchan |”

jaba, tinIharu unI (yUsupha) kahA~ puge ra bhane– “mahAmahima! hAmI ra hAmro parivAralAI saMGkaTale ghereko cha | hAmIle ati thorai mUladhana lyAekA chauM | ataH hAmIlAI pUrA pUrA anna pradAna garnuhos ra dAna pani garnuhos | allAhale dAna garnelAI nizcaya nai pratidAna pradAna garchan |”
unale bhane– “timIharUlAI thAhA cha ki yUsupha ra unakA bhAisa~ga ke garekA thiyau jaba timIharU ajJAnatAmA thiyau?”

tinIharUle bhane– “ke hajura nai yUsupha hunuhuncha ra!” unale bhane– “ho, ma yUsupha hu~ | ra, yo mero bhAi ho | allAhale vAstavamA hAmIprati upakAra gare | satya yo ho ki juna vyaktiharU Izabhaya rAkhchan ra dhairyadhAraNa garchan allAha tyastA sukarmIharUko pratidAnalAI kadApi naSTa gardainan |”
tinIharUle bhane– “allAhako kasama! unale tapAIMlAI hAmImAthi zreSThatA pradAna garekA chan | ra, vAstavamA hAmI nai doSI hAaiM |”
yUsuphale bhane– “Aja timIharUmAthi kunai kAryavAhI hune chaina | allAhale timIharUlAI kSamA garUn! unI sarvAdhika dayAlu chan |
mero yo kamija liera jAU ra yasalAI merA pitAjIko anuhAramA rAkha, unako netrajyoti pharkine cha | ra, timIharU Aphno sampUrNa parivAralAI liera makahA~ AU |”
ra, jaba yAtrudala prasthAna garyo | unakA bAbule bhane– “timIharUle malAI yo bUDho ta khuskecha kyAre nabhanne ho bhane malAI ta yUsuphako sugandha Airaheko cha |”
tinIharUle bhane– “allAhako kasama! tapAIM ahilesamma Aphno purAnai bhrAntimA hunuhuncha |”

ani jaba zubha–sUcanAvAhaka Ayo usale yUsuphako kamija yaakUbako anuhAramAthi rAkhyo ani unako netra–jyoti pharkera Ayo | unale bhane–“ma allAhako tarphabATa tyo kurA jAndachu juna kurA timIharU jAndainau bhanera ke maile timIharUlAI bhaneko thiina ra?”
tinIharUle bhane– “he pitAjyU! hAmrA pApaharUko kSamAkolAgi prArthanA garnuhos | vAstavamA hAmI doSI hAaiM |”
unale bhane– “ma timIharUkAlAgi AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga kSamAyAcanA garnechu | nizcaya nai unI ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |”

ani, tinIharU yUsuphakahA~ puge, una (yusUpha)le AphnA AmA–buvAlAI a~gAlAe die ra (sampUrNa parivAralAi) bhane– “ tapAiharU misramA praveza garnuhos! allAhale cAhemA tapAIMharUko lAgi zAnti nai zAnti cha |”

ani, AphnA AmA–buvAlAI siMhAsanamA basAe ra tinIharU sabai unIsamakSa jhuke |ra, unale bhane–“pitAjyU! yo ho mero atItako sapanAko sAkAra rUpa hAe, jasalAI merA pAlanakartAle satya siddha gare | unako upakAra ho ki unale malAI kArAgArabATa nikAle ra unaile ma ra merA dAjuharUbIca zaitAnadvArA sirjita phUTako sthitipazcAt tapAIharUlAI gAu~bATa yahA~samma puryAidie | vAstavamA merA pAlanakartA sUkSma upAyadvArA Aphno cAhanA pUrA garchan | nissandeha unI sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |”

“he merA pAlanakartA! timIle malAI rAjya pradAna garyau | ra, mAmilAko tahasamma pugna zikSA pradAna garyAai | he AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sRSTikartA! timI nai loka tathA paralokamA mero saMrakSaka hau | timIle malAI yasako sthitimA mRtyu deU ki ma muslima hu~ ra malAI satkarmIharUmA sAmela gara |”

(he muhammada sa.!) yo kathA parokSakA samAcAraharUmadhyeko ho, jasako prakAzanA hAmI timImAthi gardaichauM tara timI ta tyahA~ upasthita thienau jaba unIharUle (yUsuphakA birUddha) SaDyantra gardai AphnA sabai upAya prayoga garisakekA thie |
ra, timIle jati cAhe pani dheraijaso mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAune chainan |
ra, timIle yasakAlAgi tinIharUsita kunai pratidAna mAgirahekA chainau | yo ta sampUrNa mAnavajAtikAnimti euTA anusmaraNa mAtra ho |
ra, AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA katipaya nizAnIharU chan jasako bevAstA gardai yinIharU hiDne gardachan |
ra yinIharUmadhye adhikatara vyaktiharU allAhamAthi mAtra ImAna rAkhdainan barU unIsita arUlAI pani sAjhedAra ThaharyAu~chan |
ke tinIharU yasa kurAbATa nizcinta chan ki tinIharUmAthi allAhakA prakopamadhye kunai prakopa AilAgnecha vA asucita avasthAmai mahApralaya akasmAt tinIharUmAthi AilAgnecha?
bhanideU– “mero mArga yahI ho | ma allAhatarpha bolAu~chu pUrNa sujhabujhakA sAtha, ma svayaM pani ra merA anuyAyIharU pani | allAha pavitra chan ra ma sAjhedAra banAuneharUmadhyeko hoina |”

hAmIle timIbhandA pahile bastIkA mAnisaharUmadhyebATa jasalAI pani paThAyauM tinIharU puruSa nai thie, jasamAthi hAmIle prakAzanA garthyAai~ | ke tinIharUle dhartImA ghumaphira garenan ra dekhenan ki tinIharUbhandA aghikA mAnisaharUko pariNAma ke bhaeko thiyo? ra, Izabhaya rAkhneharUkAlAgi Akhiratako ghara nai uttama raheko cha | ke timIharU bujhdainauM?

yahA~samma ki jaba rasUlaharU nirAza bhae, ra mAnisaharUle pani tinIharUlAI jhUTho ThaharyAeko rahecha bhanne ThAne, taba ekAeka hAmro sahayoga unIharUkahA~ pugyo | ani, jasalAI hAmIle cAhyauM usalAI bacAiyo ra hAmro prakopa aparAdhI mAnisaharUbATa TAriMdaina |

unIharUkA vRttAntaharUmA cetanazIlaharUkAlAgi ThUlo zikSA cha | yo (kuraAna) racieko kurA hoina, apitu yasaaghi avatarita granthako puSTi garne, hareka cijako vistRta varNana ra AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi mArgadarzana tathA dayA ho |

alipha0 lAma0 mIma0 rA0; (he muhammada sa.!) yI IzvarIya granthakA AyataharU hun | ra, juna kurA timImAthi timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avataraNa garieko cha tyo nitAnta satya ho | tara, adhikatara mAnisaharU ImAna lyAu~dainan |

allAha nai hun jasale kunai stambha binA AkAzaharUlAI jasto timI dekhdaichau, mAthi uThAe ra pheri Aphno rAjasiMhAsanamA birAjamAna bhae | ra, unale sUrya tathA candramAlAI euTA niyamita sevAmA khaTAe | pratyeka cija eka nirdhArita samayakolAgi gatizila cha | allAhale sampUrNa kArya saJcAlana garirahekA chan | unI AyataharUlAI spaSTa pArera batAune garchan tAki timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga bheTa hune kurAmA vizvAsa gara |

ra, unai hun jasale dhartIlAI phailAe ra tyasamA pahADa evaM nadIharU sRjanA gare | unI sabai kisimakA phalakA joDA banAe | unale nai dinalAI rAtale chopdachan | nissandeha cintana manana garneharUkAlAgi yI sabaimA nizAnIharU chan |

ra, dhartImA eka arkAsita milekA vibhinna prakArakA bhU–bhAgaharU chan; aMgurakA bagaiMcA, khetIpAti ra khajurakA bRkSaharU chan jasamadhye kasaiko euTA mAtra hAMgA huncha ra kasaikA dherai hA~gAharU hunchan | yI sabailAI ekai pAnIle siMcAi garincha, tara hAmI kehI phalalAI dherai svAdiSTa banAidinchauM ra kehIlAI kama svAdiSTa | nissandeha yasamA vivekale kAma line vyaktiharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |

ra, yadi timI Azcarya mAnchau bhane Azcaryajanaka ta yI mAnisaharuko yo bhanAi ho ki jaba hAmI marera mATo banisakekA hunechauM taba hAmI nava–sRSTi garinechauM? yinIharu nai hun jasale Aphno pAlanakartAlAI inkAra garekA chan, ra yinakai gardhanamA sikrI parnecha | ra yinIharu nai narakabAsI hun jahA~ sadA rahanechan |

ra, yinIharu bhalAibhandA pahile kubhalAekAelAgi hatAra gardaichan, jabaki yasabhandA pahile kaiyauM zikSAprada udAharaNaharu bitisakekA chan | vAstavikatA yo ho ki timrA pAlanakartAle mAnisaharuko atyAcArako bAvajuda tinIharulAI kSamA garchan, ra yo pani satya ho ki timrA pAlanakartA kaThora daNDadAyaka pani chan |

ra, kAphiraharu bhandachan– “yasa vyaktimAthi unakA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kunai nizAnI kina avataraNa gariena?” (bhanideU) timI kevala sacetaka hau ra pratyeka samudAyakolAgi ekajanA mArgadarzaka hune garcha |”
allAha nai pratyeka garbhavatIko garbhako jJAna rAkhdachan, ra, jejati tyasa garbhAzayamA thapaghaTa hune garcha, tyasabAre pani avagata chan | ra, hareka cija unIkahA~ nizcita mApamA cha |
unI adRzya tathA dRzya vAstavikatAkA jJAtA, mahAn evaM sarvocca hun |
timIharUmadhye kasaile cAhe gAepya rUpamA kurA garos vA ThUlo svaramA, vA kohI rAtako andhakAramA lukeko hos, vA dinako ujyAlomA hiMDaDula gariraheko hos, (allAhakAlAgi) samAna cha |

pratyeka vyaktiko agADi ra pachADi unale nirIkSakaharU niyukta garekA chan, jo allAhako Adezale usako rekhadekha garchan| ra, allAhale kunai samudAyalAi prApta anukaMpAlAi tabasamma parivartana gardainan, jabasamma unale svayaM Aphno vyavahAralAI badaldainan | ani, allAhale kunai samudAyamAthi kunai prakopa lyAune nirNaya gardA tyasalAI kasaile TArna sakdaina, ra na tyasa samudAyakAlAgi allAhako dA~jomA kunai sahayogI hunecha |
unai hun jasale timIharUbhitra bhaya ra AzA utpanna garnakAe nimitta bijulIkAe camaka dekhAu~chan| ra, unai hun jasale bhArI bAdalaharU sRjanA garchan |

bijulIko garjana tathA phariztAharU pani unakai bhayale stutikAsAtha unakai pavitratAko guNagAna garchan | unI nai caTyAGga paThAu~chan ra jasalAI cAhanchan usamAthi, allAhako bAremA vivAda garirahekai avasthAmA, prahAra garchan | ani, unI ati sarvazaktimAna chan |

unalAI nai pukArnu satya ho, ra unIbAheka tinIharUle jasalAI pukArchan tinIharUle yI vyaktiharUlAI kunai javApha dina sakdainan, jasto kunai vyaktile pAnItarpha Aphno hAta phailAos tAki usako mukhamA pAnI pugos jaba ki pAnI mukhamA pugnechaina | ra avizvAsIharUko prArthanA ta khera nai jAncha |
ani, AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA chan, tinIharU svecchAle vA vivazatApUrvaka allAhakai sajdA garchan, ra bihAna ra belukA tinakA chAyA~harU pani (unakai sAmunne jhukchan |)

tinIharUlAI sodha, AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA pAlanakartA ko hun? bhanideU– “allAha!” ani tinIharUlAI bhana– “ke timIharUle unalAI choDI yastA cijaharUlAI Aphno saMrakSaka–mitra banAekA chau jasalAI svayaM Aphno lAbha tathA hAniko pani sAmarthya chaina?” sodha– “ke dRSTivihIna ra dekhna sakne (vyakti) samAna huna sakchan? ke andhakAraharU tathA prakAza samAna huna sakchan?” ke tinIharUle ThaharAekA samakakSIharUle pani allAhale sRSTi garejhaiM kunai sRSTi garekA chan, ani tinIharUlAi sabai sRSTiharU samAna bhaeka chan?” bhanideU– “pratyeka cijakA sraSTA allAha nai hun | unI eka mAtra chan ani prabhutvazAlI chan |”

allAhale AkAzabATa pAnI barsAe ra nadInAlAharU Aphno kSamatA anusAra bage | ani bADhIle utpanna bhaekA phI~jalAI uThAe | ra, yastai kisimako phI~ja tI dhAtuharUbATa pani niskancha jasalAI gahanA vA bhA~DAku~DA banAuna mAnisaharUle AgomA pagAlne garchan | yasarI nai allAha satya tathA asatyalAI judhAera prasTa pArchan | phI~ja ta bekAra bhaera uDera jAncha tara mAnisaharUkAlAgi lAbhadAyaka vastuharU dhartImA bA~kI rahane garchan | yasarI allAha udAharaNaharU bayAna garne garchan |

juna vyaktiharUle AphnA pAlanakartAko AmantraNalAI svIkAra gare, tinIharukAlAgi rAmro pariNAma raheko cha, ra juna vyaktiharUle tyasalAI svIkAra garenan, tinIharU pRthvImA bhaekA sampUrNa cijakA mAlika bhae pani ra thapa tyati nai bhaemA pani tinIharU (allAhako pakaDabATa bacna) tI sabailAI arthadaNDako rUpamA dina tayAra hunechan | yastA vyaktiharU narAmraro hisAbamA phasnechan ra tinIharUko bAsasthAna naraka hunecha ra kati nikRSTa bAsasthAna ho naraka!

ani tyo vyakti jasalAI timImAthi timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avatarita grantha satya ho bhanne jJAna cha, ke tyo (izvarIya prakAzanA binAkAe) dRSTibihIna vyakti jasto huna sakcha? upadeza kevala buddhimAn vyaktiharUle nai grahaNa garchan |
jasale allAhasa~ga gareko pratijJA pUrA garchan ra AphnA vacanalAI bhaGga gardainan |
ani jasale tyasa sambandhalAI joDera rAkhchan jasalAI allAhale joDera rAkhne Adeza diekA chan; AphnA pAlanakartAsita DarAu~chan ra kaDA hisAbako pani bhaya rAkhdachana,

ra jasale AphnA pAlanakartAko prasannatA prAptikAlAgi dhairya garchan; namAja kAyama garchan ra hAmIle pradAna garekA sampattimadhye gAepya rUpamA tathA dekhAera kharca garchan, ani pApalAI sukarmadvArA meTne garchan tinaikAlAgi ho Akhiratako ghara |

(arthAt) sadhaiM rahane yastA bagaiMcAharU jasamA unIharU svayaM praveza garnechan, ra tinIharukA pUrvaja, patnI ra santAnaharUmadhye satkarmIharU pani praveza garnechan | ra, phariztAharU pratyeka DhokAbATa tinIharUsamakSa Aunechan |
(ra, bhannechan) timIharUle gareko dhairyako kAraNa timIharUmAthi zAnti hos | ani, kati utkRSTa cha tyo Akhiratako ghara!

ra, tI vyaktiharU jasale allAhasa~ga dRDha pratijJA garepachi tyasalAI toDne garchan | jasalAI allAhale joDne Adeza diekA chan tyasalAI toDne garchan ra dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAune garchan tyastA vyaktiharUlAI dhikkAra cha ra tinIharUkA lAgi duHkhadAyI bAsasthAna raheko cha |

allAha jasalAI cAhanchan pracura mAtrAmA jIvikA pradAna garchan, ra (jasalAI cAhanchan) sImita mAtrAmA jIvikA dinchan | ra, tinIharU sAMsArika jIvanamA nai prasanna chan jabaki sAMsArika jIvana paralokako jIvanako tulanAmA alpa sAmagrI mAtra ho |

ra, kAphiraharU bhanchan– “yasa (sandeSTA) mAthi unakA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kunai nizAnI kina avataraNa gariena?” bhanideU– “allAha jasalAI cAhanchan pathabhraSTa garchan ra jo unItarpha pharkane garcha usailAI Aphno mArga dekhAu~chan |”
tI vyaktiharU jo ImAna lyAu~ne hun ra jasako hRdayale allAhako smaraNabATa santuSTi prApta garchan | ra, jAnirAkha allAhako smaraNabATa nai hRdayaharU santuSTa hune garchan |
tI vyaktiharU jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare tinIharU saubhAgyazAlI hun | ra, tinIharukAlAgi rAmro pariNAma cha |

(he nabI sa.!) yasarI nai hAmIle timIlAI euTA yasto samudAyatarpha paThAekA chauM jasabhandA pahile katipaya samudAyaharU bitisakekA chan, tAki timIle tinIharUlAI hAmIle prakAzanA gareko (grantha) paDhera sunAU| yinIharU karuNAmaya (allAha) lAI mAnirahekA chainan | bhanideU– “unI nai merA pAlanakartA hun | unIbAheka kohI pUjya chaina | ma unImAthi nai bharosA gardachu ra unItarpha nai pharkane garchu |”

ra, yadi kunai yasto kuraAna avatarita garieko bhae jasako balale pahADaharU hiDna thAlthe, vA dhartI TukrA–TukrA huna thAlthyo, vA murdAharU kurA garna thAlne thie, (tA pani yinIharUle ImAna lyAune thienan) | apitu sampUrNa adhikAra allAhakai hAtamA cha | ke yasa kurAbATa AsthAvAnaharUko citta bujhena ki yadi allAhale cAheko bhae sabailAI mArgadarzana garne thie? ani, juna vyaktiharUle asvIkArako nIti apanAe tinIharUmAthi ra tinakA ghara cheuchAumA allAhako vAcA pUrA nahuJjela kunai na kunai prakopa AI nai rahanecha | nissandeha allAha Aphno vAcAviruddha jA~dainan |
ra, timIbhandA pahile pani rasUlaharUko upahAsa gariyo | ra, maile kAphiraharUlAI avasara pradAna gareM ani tinIharUlAI samAteM | ani, kasto thiyo mero prakopa!?

pheri, ke tI jasale pratyeka jIvako Arjanako rekhadekha garchan ra unIharUle unai allAhako sAjhedAra banAekA chan? (he nabI sa.!) bhana, timIharU unako nAma ta bhana| ke timIharU una (allAha) lAI tyasa kurAko jAnakArI dina cAhanchau jasako bAremA unI dhartImA jAndainan vA timIharU mukhamA je Ayo tyahI bakchau? vAstavamA avajJAkArIharUkAlAgi tinIharukA SaDayantralAI zobhanIya banAieko cha ra tinIharU satmArgabATa rokiekA chan, ani jasalAI allAhale pathabhraSTa garchan usalAI kasaile mArgadarzana garAuna sakdaina |
yastA vyaktiharUkAlAgi sAMsArika jIvanamA yAtanA cha ra Akhiratako yAtanA ta tyasabhandA pani kaThora rahekocha | ra, tinIharUlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa kasaile pani bacAunevAlA chaina |

Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI vacana diieko svargako vizeSatA yo ho ki tyasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan; tyasako phala pani cirasthAyI hunecha ra chahArI pani avinAzI | yo pratiphala ho Izabhaya rAkhneharUko, ra kAphiraharUko pratiphala cAhi~ naraka ho |

ra, juna vyaktiharUlAI hAmIle grantha pradAna garekA chauM tinIharU timImAthi avataraNa garieko (grantha) bATa prasanna hunchan tara kehI samUhaharU tyasakA kehI aMzaharUlAI mAndainan | bhanideU– “malAI allAhakai upAsanA garne ra unako samakakSI nabanAune Adeza bhaeko cha | ma unItarpha nai bolAu~daichu ra unItarpha nai malAi pharkera jAnucha |”

ani yasarI nai hAmIle yasa granthalAI euTA Adezako rupamA arabImA avataraNa garekA chauM ra yadi yo satjJAna AipugdA pani timI tinIharukA cAhanAharuko anusaraNa garchau bhane allAhaviruddha timrAlAgi kohI sahayogI–mitra hune chaina tathA pratirakSaka pani hune chaina |

(he muhammada sa.) hAmIle timIbhandA pahile pani rasUlaharu paThAekA thiyauM ra tinIharulAI patnI tathA santAnaharu pani pradAna garekA thiyauM | ra, kunai rasUlalAI allAhako anumati binA kunai pani nizAnI (camatkAra) lyAune adhikAra thiena | pratyeka yugakolAgi euTA grantha raheko cha |
allAhale jasalAI cAhanchan meTAu~chan, jasalAI cAhanchan bA~kI rAkhchan ra mUla grantha unaisita raheko cha |

ra, (he sandeSTA!) juna narAmro pariNAmako dhamkI hAmIle yinIharUlAI diirahekA chauM tyasakA kehI aMza cAhe timIlAI dekhAauM vA timIlAI mRtyu pradAna garauM, timro jimmevArI kevala sandeza puryAunu ho | hisAba linu kAma hAmro jimmAmA cha |

ke tinIharU dekhdainan ki hAmIle tyasa bhU–bhAgako sImAlAI cAraitirabATa saMkucita pArdaichauM | ra, allAha phaisalA garchan | kasaile pani unako phaisalAlAI TArna sakdaina | ra, unalAI hisAba lina katti pani samaya lAgne chaina |

ra, tinIharUbhandA pahile bitekA vyaktiharUle pani vibhinna kisimakA SaDyantra garekA thie | parantu jukti pUrNarUpeNa allAhako hAtamA cha | unI pratyeka prANIle garirahekA kAryasita avagata chan | ra, paralokamA rAmro pariNAma kasakolAgi raheko cha bhanne kurA cA~Dai nai avajJAkArIharUle thAhA pAunechan |
(he muhammada sa.!) avajJAkArIharU bhanchan– “timI rasUla hoinau |” bhanideU– “ma ra timIharUbIca allAhako sAkSI paryApta cha ra tI vyaktiharUko josa~ga IzvarIya granthako jJAna cha |”

alipha0 lAma0 rA0; (he nabI sa.!) yo grantha ho jasalAI hAmIle timImAthi avataraNa garekA chauM tAki timI mAnisaharUlAI tinIharUkA pAlanakartAko Adezale andhakArabATa nikAlera prakAzamA lyAU; ati prabhutvazAlI evaM prazaMsanIya (pAlanakartA) ko mArgamA |
tyasa allAhako (mArgamA) jo AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa cijaharUkA svAmI hun | ra, ati kaThora vinAzakArI daNDa raheko cha avajJAkArIharUkAlAgi |
jasale sAMsArika jIvanalAI paralokamAthi prAthamikatA dinchan ra allAhako mArgabATa rokchan ani tyasalAI baGgyAuna khojchan | tinIharU pathabhraSTatAmA dherai TADhA pugisakekA chan |

ra, hAmIle pratyeka rasUlalAI unIharUko samudAyako bhASAmA nai paThAyauM tAki unIharUle tinIharUlAI (IzvarIya AdezaharU) spaSTa rUpamA batAuna sakUn | ani allAha jasalAI cAhanchan pathabhraSTa garchan ra jasalAI cAhanchan satmArga dekhAu~chan | ra, unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, hAmIle mUsAlAI AphnA nizAnIharU diera paThAekA thiyauM ki Aphno samudAyalAI andhakArabATa nikAlera prakAzamA lyAUn ra tinIharUlAI IzvarIya itihAsakA zikSAprada ghaTanAharU yAda dilAUn | nissandeha yasamA dhairyavAna tathA kRtajJaharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |

ra, jaba mUsAle Aphno samudAyalAI bhane– “timIharUprati allAhale gareko varadAnalAI yAda gara jaba unale timIharUlAI phiraaunIharUbATa mukta gare jasale timIharUlAI kaThora yAtanA dine garthe; timrA chorAharUlAI vadha garthe ra mahilAharUlAI jIvita choDne garthe ra yasamA timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa timIharUkAlAgi ThUlo parIkSA thiyo |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba timrA pAlanakartAle timIharUlAI sAvadhAna gare ki yadi timIharU kRtajJa rahanchau bhane ma timIharUlAI ajha baDhI kRpApAtra banAunechu tara kRtaghna bhaemA vAstavamA mero yAtanA kaThora cha |”
ra, mUsAle bhane– “yadi timIharU ra dhartImA rahekA anya sampUrNa vyaktiharU nai kRtaghna bane pani (allAhako kehI bigra~daina), kinabhane unI apekSArahita evaM svayaM prazaMsanIya chan |”

ke timIharUlAI| timIharUbhandA pahile bitekA samudAyaharU– nUha, Ada tathA samUdakA samudAya ra tinIharupachikA samudAyaharUko vRttAnta prApta bhaena jasalAI allAhabAheka kasaile pani jAndaina | tinIharUsamakSa tinIharukA rasUlaharU spaSTa nizAnIharU liera Aepachi tinIharUle (cupa lagAuna) AphnA hAta tinIharukA mukhamAthi rAkhidie ra bhane– “timIharU je lyAekA chau hAmI mAndainau ra juna kurAtarpha timIharU bolAu~daichau tyasa bAremA hAmI atyanta dvividhAjanaka sandehamA chauM |

tinIharUkA rasUlaharUle bhane– “ke timIharUlAI AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sRSTikartA allAhako bAremA sandeha cha? unI ta timIharUlAI timrA pApaharUlAI kSamA garna ra euTA nirdhArita samayasamma avasara pradAna garna bolAu~daichan |” uttaramA tinIharUle bhane– “timIharU ta hAmI jastai mAnava hau timIharUko cAhanA hAmIlAI hAmrA pUrvajaharUle juna cijaharUko upAsanA garne garthe tyasabATa haTAunu ho | tyaso bhae spaSTa pramANa prastuta gara |”

tinIharUkA rasUlaharUle bhane– “hAmI vAstavamA timIharUjastai mAnava hauM tara allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanchan usamAthi Aphno dayA garchan | ra, allAhako AjJAbinA spaSTa pramANa prastuta garnu hAmro adhikAramA chaina | ra, AsthAvAnaharUle kevala allAhaprati bharosA garnuparcha |

ra, hAmI allAhamAthi bharosA kina narAkhauM jabaki unaile hAmIlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAekA chan | ani, juna kaSTaharU timIharUle hAmIlAI dinegarchau tyasamA hAmI dhairya garnegarchauMM ra bharosA rAkhne vyaktiharUle allAhamAthi nai bharosA rAkhnuparcha |”

ra, kAphiraharUle AphnA rasUlaharUlAI bhane– “ki ta hAmI timIharUlAI Aphno dezabATa niSkAsita garidinchauM, ki ta timIharU hAmrai dharmatarpha pharkanuparcha |” ani pAlanakartAle unIharUtarpha prakAzanA gare– “hAmI avazya nai atyAcArIharUlAI nAza garnechauM |
ra, tinIharUpachi hAmI timIharUlAI tyasa dhartImA punarbAsa pradAna garnechauM | yo tinIharUkAlAgi upahAra ho jo mero agADi upasthita hunabATa DarAu~chan ra mero cetAvanIko bhaya garchan |”
ani, tinIharUle nirNayako mAga gare, ra sabai uddaNDa tathA satyatAkA zatruharU asaphala bhae |
u narakakAe gherAmA hune cha (jahA~) usalAI pIpayukta pAnI pilAinecha |
usale tyo piunecha, tara ghA~TI bhandA tala nilna sakne chaina | ra, usalAI cAraitirabATa mRtyule ghernecha tara u marne chaina | tyasapachi euTA arkA kaThora daNDa usakAelAgi tayAra hunecha |

ra, AphnA pAlanakartAlAI asvIkAra garneharUkA karmaharUko udAharaNa tyo kharAnI jasto cha, jasalAI kunai hurI Aeko dina uDAera laijAncha | tinIharUle jejati Arjana gare tyasamadhye tinIharUle kunai cijamAthi pani akhtiyAra rAkhne chainan | ra, yahI ati nIca starako pathabhraSTatA ho |
ke timIharUle dekhenau, allAhale satyakAsAtha AkAzaharU tathA dhartIko sirjanA garekA chan | unale cAhemA timIharUlAI naSTa garidinechan ra timIharUko sthAnamA nayA~ prANIko sRSTi garidinechan |
ra, yo allAhako lAgi katti pani kaThina chaina |

ra, sabai allAhakahA~ upasthita hunechan | ra durbala vyaktiharUle ThUlo banneharUlAI bhannechan–“(saMsAramA) hAmI ta timIharUkA anuyAyI thiyauM | ani, ke tinIharu (Aja) hAmIlAI allAhako yAtanAbATa thAerai bhae pani bacAuna sakchau?” tinIharUle javApha dinechan–“yadi allAhale hAmIlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAekA bhae hAmI avazya timIharUlAI tyo mArga dekhAune thiyauM | aba hAmI roauM vA dhairya garauM hAmrolAgi dubai barAbara cha | hAmro lAgi bA~cne kunai upAya chaina |”

ra, hisAbakitAbako TuGgo lAgepachi zaitAnale bhannecha– “vAstavikatA ke cha bhane allAhale timIharUlAI satya vacana diekA thie (juna pUrA bhayo) | tara, maile dieko vacana maile pUrA garina~ | timIharUmAthi mero kunai dabAva thiena | maile kevala timIharUlAI bolAe~ ra timIharUle mero kurA mAnyau | tasartha mero nindA nagara, svayaM Aphnai nindA gara | ma timIharUlAI sahayoga garna sakdina, na timIharU nai malAI sahayoga garna sakchau| timIharUle malAI yasaaghi (allAhasa~ga) sAjhedAra banAekA thiyau bhanne kurA ma mAndina |” nissandeha atyAcArIharUkAlAgi dukhadAyI yAtanA cha |

ani, tI mAnisaharU jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare tinIharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAinecha jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan ra tyahA~ tinIharU AphnA pAlanakartAko anujJAbATa sadA rahanechan jahA~ unIharUko svAgata zAntiko zubhakAmanAbATa hunecha |

ke timIharUle dekhenau allAhale “kalimA–e–taiyyibA” (pavitra vANI) ko dRSTAnta kasarI bayAna garekA chan? tyo euTA asala jAtako vRkSa jastai ho jasako jaro bhUmibhitrasamma jameko huncha ra jasakA hA~gAharU AkAzasamma pugekA hunchan |
jasale sadA AphnA pAlanakartAko anujJAbATa phalaharU dine garcha | ra, allAha mAnisaharUkAlAgi dRSTAntaharU bayAna garchan tAki tinIharU upadeza grahaNa garUn |

ra, ‘kalimA–e–khabIsA’ (apavitra vacana) ko udAharaNa yasto kujAtako vRkSa jasto cha jasako jaro bhUmibhitra paseko hu~daina, jasalAI bhUmiko mAthillo bhAgabATa nai ukhelincha | tyasalAI alikati pani sthiratA prApta hu~daina |
allAha AsthAvAnaharUlAI dRDhavANIdvArA loka tathA paraloka duvaimA dRDhatA pradAna gardachan, tara atyAcArIharUlAI pathabhraSTa garidinchan | ra, allAha je cAhanchan tyahI garchan |
ke timIle tinIharUko sthitimAthi vicAra garenau jasale allAhako anugrahako saTTAmA kRtaghnatA dekhAe ra Aphno samudAyakA mAnisaharUlAI vinAzako gharamA utAre |
(arthAt) narakamA jahA~ tinIharU hominechan ra juna ati nikRSTa bAsasthAna ho |

ra, tinIharule (arulAI) allAhakA pratidvandI ThaharyAe tAki mAnisaharulAI unako mArgabATa pathabhraSTa garun | bhanideU– “kehI dinasamma mojamastI garihAla | antataH timIharuko bAsasthAna naraka nai ho |”

he sandeSTA! merA AsthAvAna upAsakaharUlAI bhanideU– “unIharUle namAja kAyama garUn, ra hAmIle pradAna garekA sampattibATa gepya tathA khullArUpale kharca garUn | tyasadinako AgamanabhandA aghi nai junadina na kinabeca hunecha na mitratA tathA prema nai kAma lAgnecha |”

tI allAha nai hun jasale AkAzaharU tathA dhartIlAI sRSTi gare | ani, AkAzabATa pAnI barsAera timIharUko jIvikAkolAgi phalaharU utpanna gare ra DuMgAharUlAI timIharUko adhInamA garidie tAki samudraharUmA unakai AdezabATa calUn | tyastai nadIharUlAI pani timIharUko adhInamA pAre |
ra, unale sUrya tathA candramAlAI timIharUko sevAmA khaTAekA chan, jo nirantara gatizIla chan | ra, rAta tathA dinalAI pani timIharUkai sevAmA khaTAekA chan |

ra, unale timIharUlAI tI sabai vastu pradAna gare juna timIharUle unIsita mAgyau | ra, yadi timIharUle allAhakA anugrahaharUko gaNanA garna cAhyau bhane, ganna sakne chainau | vAstavamA mAnisa anyAyI evaM kRtaghna chan|
ra, smaraNa gara jaba ibrAhImale prArthanA gare– “he merA pAlanakartA! yasa nagaralAI zAnti tathA nizcintatAko nagara banAU ra malAI ra merA santAnalAI mUrti pUjAbATa bacAU |

he merA pAlanakartA! yI mUrtiharUle dherai mAnisaharUlAI pathabhraSTatAmA pArekA chan | ani jasale mero anusaraNa garnecha U pani mero hunecha, ra jasale mero avajJA garcha, nizcaya nai timI ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chau |,

he hAmrA pAlanakartA! maile AphnA kehI santAnaharUlAI nirjana ra bA~jho upatyakAmA timro pratiSThita gRhako cheumA lyAera basAeko chu | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tAki unIharUle namAja kAyama garUn | ani mAnisaharUkA hRdayalAI unItarpha AkarSita garideU ra unIharUlAI phalaphUlaharUdvArA jIvikA pradAna gara tAki unIharU kRtajJa banUn |
he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmI juna kurA gopya rAkhchauM vA juna kurA vyakta garchauM timI tI sabailAI jAndachau | ra, vAstavamA allAhabATa kunai cija gupta rahana sakdaina; na pRthvImA na AkAzamA nai |
sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhakailAgi hun jasale malAI mero buDhesakAlamA ismAIla tathA ishAka pradAna gare | nissandeha merA pAlanakartA prArthanA sunnevAlA chan |
he merA raba! malAI namAja kAyama garnevAlA banAU ra merA santAnaharUlAI pani | he hAmrA raba! mero prArthanA svIkAra gara |
he hAmrA raba! hisAbakitAbako dina malAI, merA mAtApitA ra sampUrNa mominaharulAI kSamA pradAna gara |”
ra, atyAcArIharU juna kArya garchan tyo allAha jAndainan bhanne naThAna | allAha tinIharUlAI tyasa dinasamma mAtra maukA diirahekA chan juna dina A~khAharu ekohoro herirahanechan|
(ra, mAnisaharU) TAuko uThAera bhAgirahekA hunechan; TvAlla parI herirahekA hunechan | ra, tinIharUkA hRdayaharU uDirahekA hunechan |

ra, mAnisaharUlAI tyasadinabATa sAvadhAna garAU juna dina prakopa AilAgnecha, taba atyAcArIharUle bhannechan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI kehI samayakAlAgi ajha avasara pradAna gara | hAmI timro nimantraNAlAI svIkAra garnechauM; rasUlaharUko anusaraNa garnechauM |” (uttara diinecha)– “ke yasaaghi timIharU kasama khA~dainathyau ki timIharUko patana kahilyai pani hune chaina bhanera?”

jabaki timIharU tI samudAyaharUkA nagaraharUmA basobAsa garisakekA thiyau jasale svayaMmAthi atyAcAra garekA thie, ra dekhisakekA thiyau ki hAmIle tinIharUsa~ga ke garekA thiyauM | ani, paTaka paTaka tinIharUko udAharaNa diera timIharUlAI samjhAI sakekA thiyauM |
tinIharUle sakdo calakhela garekA thie, ra tinIharUkA sampUrNa calakhelaharU allAhasa~ga (likhita) chan | vAstavamA tinIharUko upAya yasto thiyo ki pahADa pani Aphno sthAnabATa Dagamaginthyo holA |
ataH timI allAhalAI AphnA rasUlaharUsita vacana bhaGga garnevAlA naThAna | nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM pratizodha linevAlA chan |
tyasadina yasa pRthvIlAI arkai pRthvImA pariNata garinecha tathA AkAzaharUlAI pani, ra tI sabai (atyAcArIharU) eklo ra prabhutvazAlI allAhako sAmUnne upasthita hunechan|
ra, tyasa dina timI aparAdhIharUlAI jaJjiramA jakaDieko dekhnechAai|
tinIharUko pahirana alakatrAko hunecha ra tinIharUkA anuhAralAI agnile DhAknecha |
tAki allAhale pratyeka vyaktilAI usako Arjanako pratiphala diUn | nissandeha allAhale cA~Dai nai hisAbakitAba linechan |
yo (kuraAna) mAnisakAlAgi (allAhako) sandeza ho ra yasa uddezyale ki tinIharUlAI yasabATa saceta gariyos ra tinIharUle jAnUn ki unI nai eka mAtra upAsya hun ra buddhimAnIrUle upadeza grahaNa garUn |
alipha0 lAma0 rA0; yI Izagrantha evaM spaSTa kuraAnakAjJa AyataharU hun |
yasto samaya pani Aunecha jaba kAphiraharU musalamAna hune abhilASA garnechan |
(he muhammada sa.!) tinIharUlAI khA~dai–piu~dai mojamastI garna choDideU | ra, jhUThA AzAle tinIharUlAI bhulyAi rAkhos | tinIharUle cA~Dai nai thAhA pAihAlnechan |
hAmIle jati pani nagaraharUlAI naSTa pAryauM tI sabaikA lAgi nizcita phaisalA thiyo |
kunai pani samUha Aphno mRtyuko samayabhandA na pahile marnecha na pachi nai |
ra, tinIharUle bhane– “he tyo vyakti jasamAthi yo upadeza avataraNa garieko cha! vAstavamA timI bahulAhA rahechau |
(tinIharUle bhane) yadi timI saccA hau bhane hAmIsamakSa kina timI phariztA lyAu~dainau?”
(bhanideU–) “hAmI phariztAharUlAI kevala satyako sAtha paThAune garchauM | ra, tyatikhera tinIharUlAI alikati pani avasara diine chaina |”
nissandeha hAmIle nai kuraAnalAI avatarita garekA hauM ra hAmI nai yasako surakSA garchauM |
hAmIle timIbhandA pahilekA samudAyaharUmA pani rasUla paThAyauM |
josukai rasUla pani tinIharUkahA~ Ae tinIharUle unako khillI nai uDAe |
hAmI yasalAI aparAdhIharUko hRdayamA yasarI nai praveza garAu~chauM |
tinIharU ImAna lyAu~dainan | ra, pahile bitekA samudAyaharUle pani yastai garekA thie |
ani, yadi hAmIle tinIharukAlAgi AkAzako kunai DhokA kholidiyauM ra tinIharu tyasamA caDhna thAle pani...
tinIharUle bhannechan– “hAmrA A~khAharUlAI dhokA bhairaheko cha | barU hAmImAthi jAdU garieko cha |”
ani, hAmIle AkAzamA buruja (majabuta killA) banAekA chauM ra darzakaharUkAlAgi tyasalAI sajAekA chauM |
ra, pratyeka tiraskRta zaitAnabATa tyasalAI surakSita pArekA chauM |
yadi kasaile lukIchipI sunne prayAsa garcha bhane euTA jvalanta agnizikhAle tyasalAI pachyAunecha |
ani, dhartIlAI pani hAmIle phailAyauM ra tyasamA pahADaharU gADyauM tathA tyasamA sabai kisimakA ucita banaspatiharU umAryauM |
ani, hAmIle timIharU ra tI sabaikAlAgi jasako bharaNapoSaNa timIharUle garirahekA chainau, tyasamA jIvikAkA sAdhanaharU sRjanA garyauM |
ani, jati pani cijaharU chan, tI sabaiko bhaNDAra hAmIsita cha tara tyasalAI hAmI nizcita mAtrAmA avataraNa garchauM |
ra, hAmI nai urvara hAvA paThAu~chauM | ani AkAzabATa pAnI barsAu~chau | ra, hAmI nai timIharUlAI tyo pAnI khuvAu~chauM | ra, timIharU tyasalAI bhaNDAraNa garna sakdainathyau |
ani, hAmI nai jindagI tathA mRtyu dinchauM ra hAmI nai sabaikA uttarAdhikArI pani hauM |
ani hAmI timIharu madhye bitekA mAnisaharulAI jAndachauM ra pachi Aune vyaktiharUlAI pani |
nissandeha timrA pAlanakartAle tI mAnisaharUlAI ekatrita garnechan | vAstavamA unI tatvadarzI evaM sarvajJa chan |
ra, hAmIle mAnisalAI kuhiera sukeko Dallo mATobATa sRSTi garekA hauM |
ra, jinnalAI hAmIle tyasabhandA pahile nai agni jvAlAbATa sRSTi garekA thiyauM |
ra, smaraNa gara tyasa avasaralAI jaba allAhale phariztAharUlAI bhane– “ma dhartImA kuhiera sukeko Dallo mATobATa euTA mAnava sRjanA gardaichu |
ani jaba pUrNarUpale tyasalAI banAisakchu ra tyasabhitra Aphno AtmAbATa phuknechu, taba timIharU usakAsAmu sajdA garnU |”
ani sArA phariztAharUle sajdA gare |
sivAya iblIsa, usale sajdA garneharUmA sAmela huna inkAra garyo |
allAhale sodhe– “iblIsa timIlAI ke bhayo, timI sajdA garneharUmA kina sAmela bhaenau?”
usale bhanyo– “ma tyasa manuSyasAmu sajdA garne hoina, jasalAI timIle kuhiera sukeko Dallo mATobATa sRSTi garekA chau |”
allAhale Adeza die– “tyaso bhae yahA~bATa niskera jAU | nizcaya nai timI tiraskRta bhayau |
ra, aba badalA diine dinasamma timImAthi zrApa cha |”
usale bhanyo– “prabhu! malAI mAnisaharUlAI punaH jIvita pArine dinasammako lAgi avasara pradAna gara |”
allAhale bhane– “timIlAI avasara dii~daicha |
euTA nizcita samayakAe dinasamma |”
zaitAnale bhanyo– “prabhu! jasarI timIle malAI pathabhraSTa garekA chau, ma pani mAnisaharUkA lAgi (pApaharUlAI) sundara banAera dekhAunechu, ra, tI sabailAI pathabhraSTa pArnechu|
tinIharUmadhye chAniekA bhaktaharU bAheka |”
allAhale bhane– “masamma pugne yahI sIdhA mArga ho |
merA bhaktaharUmAthi timro kunai vaza calne chaina | timro vaza pathabhraSTa huneharUmAthi mAtra calnecha jo timro anusaraNa garnechan |”
nissandeza tinIharU sabaikA lAgi vAcA garieko ThAu~ naraka ho |
tyasakA sAtavaTA DhokAharu chan; pratyeka DhokAkolAgi tinIharuko euTA hissA nizcita garieko cha |
nissandeha Izabhaya rAkhneharU bagai~cA tathA (peya padArthakA) muhAnaharUbIca hunechan |
(bhaninecha) yasamA timIharU zAnti ra nirbhayapUrvaka praveza gara |
unIharUko hRdayamA rahekA sabai chalakapaTaharulAI yasarI nikAlera phyA~knechauM ki unIharU dAjubhAi banera palaGgamAthi Amunne–sAmunne basnechan |
na unIharulAI tyahA~ kunai thakAi ra kaSTa pugnecha na tyahA~bATa nikAline nai cha |
(he sandeSTA!) merA bhaktaharUlAI sUcita garideU– “ma ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chu |
tara mero yAtanA pani ati dukhadAyI cha |
ra, tinIharUlAI ibrAhImakA atithiharUko vRttAnta sunAU |”
jaba tinI (phariztA)harU ibrAhImasamakSa upasthita bhae taba salAma gare | ibrAhImale bhane– “hAmIlAI timIharUsa~ga Dara lAgirahekocha |”
tinIharUle bhane–“naDarAU! hAmI timIlAI euTA jJAnavAna putrako zubhasandeza dinchauM |”
ibrAhImale bhane– “ke timIharUle malAI yasa buDhesakAlamA zubha–sandeza diirahekA chau? yo zubha–sUcanA timIharU kuna AdhAramA diirahekA chau ta?”
unIharule bhane– “hAmI tapAIlAI satya zubha–sandeza diirahekA chauM | ataH tapAI nirAza huneharumadhye nabannuhos |”
ibrAhImale bhane– “pathabhraSTa mAnisaharU bAheka Aphno pAlanakartAko kRpAbATa arU kAe nirAza hunchan?”
ibrAhImale pheri sodhe– “he paThAiekAharU ho! timIharU kuna kAmako lAgi AekA hau?”
unIharUle javApha die– “hAmIlAI euTA aparAdhI samudAyatarpha paThAieko cha |
(jasalAI prakopa diinecha) tara lUtakA sabai parivAra jasalAI hAmI bacAunechauM |
sivAya lUtakI patnI, U pachi rahane vyaktiharUmA sAmela hunechin bhanne nizcita garisakekA chauM |”
ani jaba paThAiekAharU lUtako ghara Ae,
lUtale bhane– “timIharU aparicita mAncheharU hau |”
tinIharule bhane– “hoina, baru hAmI tapAIsamakSa tyo kurA liera AekA chauM jasamA yinIharu sandeha garne garthe |”
ani, hAmI tapAIMsamakSa vAstavika kurA liera AekA chauM ra hAmI satyavAdI hauM |

ataH tapAIM Aphno parivAralAI liera rAtako kunai praharamA niskinuhos, ra, tapAIM svayaM unIharUko pachi–pachi hiMDnuhos | ra, tapAIMharUmadhye kasaile pani pachADi pharkiera naheros | ra, tapAIMharUlAI jahA~ jAne Adeza bhaeko cha tyahA~ jAnuhos |”
ra, hAmIle lUtalAI yo nirNayabATa sUcita garyauM ki bihAnI hu~dAhu~dai tinIharUko jaro kATera phAlinecha |
ra, nagarabAsIharU lUtakahA~ harSollAsakA sAtha Ae |
lUtale bhane– “yinIharU merA atithi hun tasartha malAI beijjata nagara |”
allAhasa~ga DarAU ra malAI apamAnita nagara |
tinIharUle bhane– “timIlAI saMsArabhariko ThekkA lina hAmIle manAhI garekA thienau ra?”
lUtale bhane– “yadi timIharU garnai cAhanchau bhane yI merA chorIharU hun |”
(he muhammada sa.!) timro umerako kasama! tinIharU moja–mastIko nazAmA DubirahekA thie |
antataH sUryodaya hunAsAtha euTA pracaNDa dhamAkAle tinIharUlAI samAtyo |
ani hAmIle tyasa nagaralAI ghopTAidiyauM, ra tinIharUmAthi polieko mAToko DhuMgAko varSA garidiyauM |
nissandeha yasamA gahiro socavicAra garne vyaktiharUkAlAgi dherai nizAnIharU chan |
ra, yo nagara mUlabATomA raheko cha |
nissandeha yasamA AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi nizAnI rahekA chan |
aikAkA bAsindAharU pani atyAcArI nai thie |
ani hAmIle tinIharUsita pani badalA liyauM | yI duvai nagaraharU khullA mArgamA rahekA thie |
ra, hijrabAsIharUle pani sandeSTAharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare |
ra, hAmIle AphnA nizAnIharU tinIharUlAI pani pradAna garyauM, tara tinIharUle tyasako upekSA nai gare |
ra, tinIharU zAntipUrvaka pahADaharUlAI khopera gharaharU nirmANa garne garthe |
antataH bihAna hu~dAhu~dai tinIharUlAI bhayaGkara dhamAkAle samAtyo |
ra, tinIharUle garne garekA kAryaharU tinIharUkAlAgi kunai kAmamA Aenan |

ra, hAmIle AkAzaharU, dhartI tathA yI duvaikA bIcamA rahekA sampUrNa vastuharUlAI satyakA sAtha sRSTi garekA chauM | ra, mahApralaya avazya nai Aunecha | ataH timI tinIharUlAI ziSTatApUrvaka kSamA deU |
nissandeha timrA pAlanakartA nai mahAna sRSTikartA evaM sarvajJa chan |
ra, nissandeha hAmIle timIlAI dohoryAera paDhine sAtavaTA AyataharU ra mahAn kuraAna pradAna garekA chauM |
ra, hAmIle kAphiraharUkA vibhinna prakArakA mAnisaharUlAI dhana–sampatti diekA chauM tyasamAthi kadApi A~khA nagADa, ra tinIharUmAthi duHkhita nai hAeU, ra mominaharUprati namratAko vyavahAra gara |
ra, bhanideU– “ma spaSTa rUpamA sacetaka hu~ |”
(yo tyastai cetAvanI ho) jasto hAmIle ApasamA phuTa pArneharUmAthi avatarita garekA thiyauM |
jasale kuraAnalAI TukrA–TukrA pAreko chan |
timrA pAlanakartAkAe kasama! hAmI tinIharU sabaisita avazya sodhapucha garnechauM..
tI kAryaharUbAre juna tinIharUle garne garthe |
ataH (he nabI sa.!) timIlAI juna Adeza prApta bhaeko cha, tyo mAnisaharUlAI spaSTarUpamA sunAU ra bahudevavAdIharUmathi dhyAna nadeU|
ThaTTA garne vyaktiharUkA lAgi timro tarphabATa hAmI paryApta chauM |
jasale allAhakA sAtha arko pUjya banAune gardachan | ataH cA~Dai nai tinIharUle (yasako pariNAma) jAnnechan |
ra, tinIharUkA kurAle timro hRdaya saMkucita huncha bhanne kurA hAmIlAI rAmrarI thAhA cha |
ataH timI AphnA rabako prazaMsAkAsAtha unako pavitratA bayAna gara, ra sajdA garne vyaktiharUmA sAmela hoU |,
ra, timI AphnA rabako upAsanA garne gara yahA~samma ki nizcita kurA (mRtyu) timIsamakSa AIpugos |
Aipugyo allAhako Adeza | ataH (avajJAkArIharU ho!) yasakolAgi hatAra nagara | allAha yinIharUle banAirahekA sAjhedAraharUbATa pavitra evaM ucca chan |

unI yasa rUha (izanANI) lAI Aphno juna bhaktamAthi cAhanchan Aphno Adezale phariztAharUko mAdhyamabATa avatarita garchan, ki mAnisaharUlAI Dara dekhAun (yo bhandai ki)– “mabAheka anya kohI pUjya chaina| tyasaile timIharU kevala mero bhaya rAkha |”
unale nai AkAzaharU tathA dhartIlAI satyako AdhAramA sRSTi gare | unI yinIharUle garne zirkabhandA ucca chan |
unale mAnavalAI vIryakAe thAepAbATa sRjanA gare, tara U khullama khullA jhagaDAlu banna pugyo |
ra, janAvaraharUlAI pani unale nai sRSTi gare, jasabATa timIharU nyAno vastra tathA anya phAidA uThAu~chau, ra tImadhye kehIlAI khAne pani garchau |
ra, tinIharumA timIharUkolAgi saundarya raheko cha, jaba bihAna tyasalAI carAuna laijAnchau ra jaba tyasalAI sA~jha parepachi liera Au~chau |

ra, tinIharUle timIharUkA bhArI bokera yasto sthAnaharUsamma puryAu~chan jahA~samma timIharU kaThina parizrama binA puryAuna sakne thienau | nissandeha timIharUkA pAlanakartA ati snehazIla evaM parama dayAlu chan|

ra, unale nai ghoDA, khaccara tathA gadhAharU sRSTi gare tAki timIharU tyasamA savAra hoU ra yI timro jIvanako zobhA pani banUn | ra, allAha yastA vastuharUko sRSTi garchan jasabAre timIharUlAI thAhA pani chaina |
ra, sidhA mArga ta allAhatarpha cha ra, kehI TeDhA mArgaharU pani chan, ra allAhale cAheko bhae timIharU sabailAI satmArga dekhAune thie |
unai hun jasale timrolAgi AkAzabATa pAnI barsAe juna timIharU piune garchau, ra tyasale gardA umrekA banaspatiharUmA AphnA pazuharU carAu~chau |
tyasai pAnIdvArA unI timIharUkAlAgi khetI, jaitUna, khajUra, aMgUra ra dherai prakArakA phalaharU utpanna garchan | nissandeha yasamA cintanazIla vyaktiharUkAlAgi nizAnI raheko cha |
ra, unale nai rAta ra dina, sUrya ra candramAlAI timIharUko sevAmA khaTAekA chan | unakai AdezabATa tArAharU pani sevAmA khaTiekA chan | nissandeha yasamA vivekazIlaharUkA lAgi nizAnIharU chan |
ra, unale timrolAgi jamInamA raMgIbiraMgI juna vastuharu sRSTi garekAchan,...nissandeha tyasamA pani zikSA grahaNa garneharUkA lAgi ThUlo nizAnI cha |,

ani, unaile samudralAI timIharUko adhInamA pAre tAki timIharU tyasabATa tAjA mAsu khAU ra tyasabATa gahanA nikAla jasalAI timIharU lagAune garchau | ra, DuGgAharUlAI pAnI cirdai tyasabATa aghi baDheko timI dekhchau | yI sabaiko uddezya yo ho ki timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAko anugrahakAe khojI gara ra unIprati kRtajJa bana |
ani, unale pRthvImA pahADaharUlAI gADe tAki tyasale timIharUlAI liera nalaDos ra nadI tathA mArgaharU banAe tAki timIharU bATo pAuna saka |
ani, unale (mArga batAune) arU cinhaharU rAkhe | ra, yinIharU tArAharUko mAdhyamabATa pani mArga pattA lagAune garchan |
ani ke jasale sRSTi garchan, unI sRSTi garna nasakne jastA huna sakchan? ke timIharU upadeza grahaNa gardainau?
ani, timIharUle allAhakA varadAnaharUlAI gaNanA garna cAhe pani garna sakdainau | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ani, juna kurA timIharU gopya rAkhchau ra juna kurA timIharU prakaTa garchau tI sabai allAha jAndachan |
ani, allAhalAI choDI tinIharU ja–jasalAI pukArchan tinIharUle kehI pani sRSTi garna sakdainan, baru tinIharU svayaM sRSTi gariekA hun |
(tinIharU) murdA hun; jIvita hoinan ra tinIharUko punarutthAna kahile hunecha bhanne kurA pani tinIharUlAI thAhA chaina |
timIharUkA pUjya kevala eka allAha hun, ra juna vyaktiharU paralokamA ImAna rAkhdainan tinIharUkA hRdaya nai inkArI hun, ra tinIharU ghamaNDI pani hun |
nizcaya nai juna kurA tinIharU lukAune garchan ra juna kurA prakaTa garne garchan allAha tI sabai kurA jAndachan | vAstavamA allAha ahaGkArIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |
ani, jaba tinIharUlAI sodhincha ki timIharUkA pAlanakartAle ke avataraNa garekA chan? taba tinIharU bhanchan– “yI atItakA kathAharU hun |”

mahApralayako dina tinIharUle Aphno bhAra pani pUrNarUpamA uThAunuparcha ra tI vyaktiharUko bhAra pani uThAunuparcha, jasalAI tinIharU ajJAnatAkA kAraNa pathabhraSTa gardaichan | jAnirAkha, tinIharUle uThAune bhAra ati nikRSTa raheko cha |

tinIharUbhandA aghikA mAnisaharUle pani (yastai) calakhela garekA thie, tara allAhale tinIharUko jaga nai ukhelera phyA~kekA thie ra phalasvarUpa tinIharUmAthi chAnA nai bhatkera khaseko thiyo, ra tyasa dizAbATa tinIharUmAthi prakopa Ayo jahA~bATa tinIharUle kalpanAsameta garekA thienan |

ani, mahApralayako dina pani allAhale tinIharUlAI apamAnita garnechan ra sodhnechan– “kahA~ chan merA tI sAjhedAraharU jasako bAremA timIharU jhagaDA garnegathryau |” jJAnI vyaktiharUle bhannechan– “Aja kAphiraharUkAlAgi apamAna tathA duSpariNAma raheko cha |”

jasako prANa, tinIharUle svayaMmAthi atyAcAra gariraheko avasthAmA, phariztAharUle grasta pArdachan, tyasa samaya tinIharU AtmasamarpaNa garchan (ra bhanchan)– hAmI kunai kukarma garirahekA thienauM | (phariztAharU bhanchan) kina nahunu, timIharU jejati garne gathryau tI sabai allAha rAmrarI jAndachan |
ataH narakakA DhokAharUko bhitra pasa, jahA~ timIharUlAI sadA basnu cha | ani kati nikRSTa raheko cha ghamaNDI vyaktiharUko bAsasthAna!

ani, timrA rabale ke avataraNa garekA chan, bhanne bAre jaba Izabhaya rAkhneharUsita sodhinecha taba tinIharUko uttara hunecha– “sarvottama vANIharU!” satkarmIharUkAlAgi yasa saMsAramA pani bhalAI raheko cha ra paralokako ghara ta jhan rAmro cha, ra, kati rAmro rahecha Izabhaya rAkhneharUko ghara!

sadA rahane bagaiMcAharU jahA~ unIharU praveza garnechan, jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharUkAlAgi tyasamA tI sabai cija hunechan juna unIharUle cAhanechan | allAha yasarI nai Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI pratidAna dinegarchan |

jasako prANa pavitra (aAsthAvAna) raheko avasthAmA phariztAharUle linechan | phariztAharUle bhannechan– ‘assalAmualaikum’ (tapAIMmAthi zAnti hos) | Aphno satkarmako badalAmA svargamA praveza garnuhos |”

ke tinIharU kevala yasa pratIkSAmA chan ki tinIharUsamakSa phariztAharU AUn vA timrA rabako Adeza nai Aos? tinIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUle pani yastai garekA thie | allAhale tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garenan barU tinIharUle svayaMmAthi atyAcAra garne garthe |
ataH tinIharUlAI tinakA kukarmaharUko pariNAma prApta bhayo | ra, juna kurAko tinIharU ThaTTA garne garthe tyasaile nai tinIharUlAI gheryo |

ra muzrikaharUle bhanchan–“yadi allAhale cAheko bhae na hAmIharU na hAmrA pUrvajaharUle nai unIbAheka anya kasaiko upAsanA garne thiyauM; na unako Adeza binA kunai cijalAI avaidha Thahara garne thiyauM |” yinIharUbhandA pahilekA vyaktiharUle pani yastai garekA thie | ani rasUlako kAma kevala spaSTa rUpamA sandeza puryAunu ho |

hAmIle pratyeka samudAyamA rasUla paThAyauM | (yAe sandeza diera) ki kevala allAhako upAsanA gara, ra ‘tAgUta’ (hareka kisimako avajJAkArI) bATa TADhA rahane gara | ani tinIharUmadhye kehIlAI allAhale mArgadarzana gare ra kehImAthi pathabhraSTatA lAgU bhayo | ani dhartImA bhramaNa gara ra hera nakArneharUko ke kasto pariNAma bhayo |
(he sandeSTA!) yadyapi timI tinIharUko mArgadarzanakAlAgi lAlAyita chau, tara allAha tinIharulAI mArgadarzana gardainan jasalAI unI pathabhraSTa pArchan, ra na kohI usako sahayogI huncha |

mRta vyaktiharUlAI allAhale punaH jIvita gardainan bhanI tinIharU allAhako joDadAra kasama khAnchan | kina gardainan? yo ta euTA satya vAcA ho jasalAI unale pUrA garerai choDnechan tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |

yasto hunu yasa kAraNale Avazyaka cha ki allAhale tinIharUsamakSa tyasa tathyalAI kholUn jasako sambandhamA tinIharU matabheda garirahekA chan, tAki kAphiraharUle jAnun ki tinIharU nai mithyAvAdI hun |
(allAha bhanchan) jaba hAmI kunai cijalAI astitva pradAna garna cAhnchAai~, tyasalAi hAmIle “bhaihAla” bhanchAai~ ki tyo bhaihAlcha |

ani, tI vyaktiharU jo atyAcArako zikAra bhaepachi allAhakolAgi AphnA gharaharU tyAge, tinIharUlAI avazya yasa saMsAramA uttama bAsasthAna pradAna garnechauM, ra paralokako pratidAna ta jhan ThUlo hunecha | kati uttama hunthyo tinIharUle jAnekA bhae!
tinIharU nai hun jasale dhairyadhAraNa gare ra tinIharU nai AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi bharosA rAkhdachan |
ra, timIbhandA pahile kevala puruSaharUlAI hAmIle rasUlako rUpamA paThAyauM jasamAthi hAmIle prakAzanA garne garthyAai~ | ataH yadi timIharUlAI thAhA chaina bhane granthavAhakaharUlAI sodha |

(tinIharUlAI) pramANa ra granthaharU diera (paThAekA thiyauM) ra hAmIle timImAthi pani yo grantha avataraNa garekA chauM, tAki timI mAnisaharUkAnimti juna kurA avataraNa garieko cha, spaSTa gara, ra tAki tinIharUle (tyasamA) vicAra garUn!
ke SaDyantrapUrNa yojanA banAune vyaktiharU yasa kurAbATa nizcinta bhaekA chan ki allAhale tinIharUlAI dhartImA dhasAUn vA tinIharUmAthi akalpanIya dizAbATa prakopa Aos...
vA yatAuti ghumaphira garirahekai avasthAmA tinIharUlAI allAhale samAtUn | ani tinIharUle allAhalAI vivaza pArna sakdainan |
vA khatarA mahasusa garirahekai avasthAmA samAtUn? (tara yastAe hudaina) kinabhane nissandeha timrA raba snehazIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ke tinIharU allAhale sRSTi garekA kunai cija dekhdainan ki tyasakA chAyA~harU dAyA~bAyA~ pharkaMdai ra vinamratA prakaTa gardai allAhasamakSa sajdA garne garchan?
allAhakai sajdA garchan AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA rahekA prANIharU ra phariztAharU | ra, unIharU alikati pani ghamaNDa gardainan |
tinIharU AphUmAthi rahekA rabasita DarAu~chan ra tinIharUlAI je Adeza diincha tyahI kAma garne garchan |
ra, allAha bhandachan– “duIvaTA upAsya nabanAU | vAstavamA tyo upAsya euTai cha ataH kevala masita nai DarAU |”
ani, AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa cijaharU unakai hun, ra unakai dIna (dharma) sadhaiMkolAgi raheko cha | ani ke timIharU allAhabAheka arUsita DarAu~chau?
ra, timIharUlAI prApta sampUrNa baradAna allAhakai tarphabATa raheko cha | pheri jahile pani jaba timIharUlAI kunai duHkha parcha unIsamakSa nai duHkha pokhchau |
pheri jaba unI timIharUko duHkha nivAraNa garchan, taba timIharUmadhyekA kehI vyaktiharU AphnA rabako sAjhedAra banAuna thAlchan |
tAki tinIharUle allAhako upakAraprati kRtaghnatA dekhAUn | ani (he bahudevavAdIharU ho!) mojamastI garihAla; cA~Dai nai timIharUle yasako pariNAma thAhA pAunechau |

ra, tinIharU hAmIle pradAna gareko dhana–sampattimA yastA (upAsyaharU) kA nimti aMza chuTTyAu~chan jasako bAremA tinIharUlAI kehI thAhA chaina | allAhako kasama! timIharUle racekA kurAharUko kAraNa timIharUlAI avazya sodhapucha garinecha |
ra, tinIharU allAhakAlAgi chorIharU bhaeko ThaharyAu~chan, jaba ki unI pavitra chan| ra tinIharU (sAjhedAra ThaharAuneharU) kAlAgi tyo juna tinIharU cAhanchan |
ra jaba tinIharUmadhye kasailAI chorI janmieko khabara diincha; manai manamA atyanta duHkhI hu~dai unIharUko anuhAra kAlo bhaihAlcha |
yasa zubha sUcanAlAI azubha ThAnera U mAnisaharUsita lukera hi~Dcha, (socdai) ki apamAna sahera yasalAI jIvita rAkhne ki mATomA gADne? apasoca kati narAmro nirNaya cha juna yinIharU garne garchan |
paralokamA ImAna narAkhne vyaktiharUko vizeSatA ati narAmro cha jabaki allAhakA vizeSatAharU ucca chan | ra, unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, yadi allAhale mAnisaharUlAI tinIharUko atyAcArakA kAraNa turuntai samAteko bhae unale dhartIkA kunai prANIlAI choDne thienan | tara euTA nirdhArita myAdasamma unI tinIharUlAI avasara dinchan | ani jaba tyo nirdhArita myAda Aipugcha taba tinIharU na eka ghaDI pachi haTna saknechan na aghi nai baDhna saknechan |

ani, tinIharU allAhakAnimti tyo kurA siddha garchan juna tinIharU svayaM mana parAu~dainan, ra tinIharUko jibrAle jhUTha mAtra bolne garcha ki (mahApralayako dina) tinIharUkAlAgi rAmro pratiphala raheko cha | hoina, vAstavamA tinIharUkAlAgi naraka raheko cha ra tinIharU tyasamA sadA rahanechan |

allAhako kasama, nizcaya nai hAmIle timIbhandA aghikA samUdAyaharUsamakSa Aphno IzadUta paThAyauM tara zaitAnale tinIharUkA kukarmaharUlAI tinIharUko dRSTimA sundara tulyAera dekhAyo ani tyahI zaitAna Aja tinIharUko saMrakSaka–mitra baneko cha ra tinIharUkAlAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA rahekocha |

ra, hAmIle timImAthi yo grantha yasa uddezyale avataraNa garekA chauM ki timI tinIharUsamakSa tyo kurA rAmrarI spaSTa garideU jasamA tinIharU matabheda garirahekA chan | ra, AsthA rAkhne vyaktiharUkAlAgi (yo grantha) mArgadarzana tathA dayA ho |,
ra, allAhale nai AkAzabATa pAnI barsAe ani mRta bhUmilAI jIvita pAre | nissandeha yasamA sunne vyaktiharUkAlAgi ThUlAe nizAnI raheko cha |
ra caupAyAharumA pani timIharukolAgi zikSA cha ki hAmIle tinIharuko peTabhitrako gobara ra ragatako bIcabATa timIharulAI zuddha dUdha khuvAune garchau juna piune vyaktikAnimti ati svAdiSTa huncha...

ani, khajura tathA aMgurakA vRkSakA phalaharubATa pani | timIharu tyasabATa nazAlu padArtha pani banAune garchau ra pavitra khAnekurA pani | nissandeha yasamA vivekazIla vyaktiharukAlAgi ThUlo nizAnI raheko cha |
ani, timrA rabale mAhurIlAI yo kurA saGketa gare ki timIharU pahADa, rukha tathA mAnisaharUle uThAekA chAnAharUmA Aphno ghara banAU |

ani hareka prakArakA phalaharUbATa khAU ra AphnA rabako sahaja mArgamA hiDne gara | tinIharUkA peTabATa vibhinna raGgako peya padArtha niskancha | tyasamA mAnisaharUkAlAgi upacAra raheko cha | nissandeha yasamA vivekazIla vyaktiharUkAlAgi nizAnI rahekocha |

ani, allAhale nai timIharUlAI sRSTi gare | tyasapachi unI nai timIharUlAI mRtyu dinchan, ra timIharUmadhye kehI vyaktiharU nikRSTatama Ayusamma puryAinchan yahA~samma ki tinIharUle jJAna Arjana garisakepachi pani kehI jAndainan | nissandeha allAha sarvajJa evaM sAmarthyavAna chan |

allAhale timIharumadhye kehI vyaktiharulAI anya kehI vyaktiharumAthi jIvikAmA pradhAnatA pradAna garekA chan, ani pradhAnatA prApta vyaktiharule Aphno jIvanavRtti Aphno mAtahatakA vyaktiharulAI dine gardainan ki tinIharu tyasamA barAbara hoUn | ani ke tinIharu allAhako varadAnalAI asvIkAra gardachan?

ra, allAhale timIharUkAlAgi timIharUmadhyebATa joDIharU banAe ra timrA tI joDIharUbATa timIharUkAlAgi chorA ra nAtiharU sRSTi garekA chan | ra, timIharUlAI pavitra jIvikA pradAna garekA chan | ani ke yasakA bAvajuda pani yinIharU asatyamAthi AsthA rAkhdachan ra allAhako varadAnalAI asvIkAra gardachan?
ani, allAhalAI choDI yastA cijaharUko pUjA garchan juna tinIharU AkAzaharU tathA dhartIbATa na kunai jIvikA pradAna garne adhikAra rAkhdachan na kunai sAmarthya nai |
ataH allAhakAlAgi (galata) upamAharU nadeU | nissandeha allAha rAmrarI jAndachan, jabaki timIharU jAndainau |

ra, allAha euTA udAharaNa bayAna garchan; euTA nokara cha jo aruko svAmitvamA cha, svayaM kunai adhikAra rAkhdaina, arko vyakti cAhi~ yasto cha jasalAI hAmIle Aphno tarphabATa uttama jIvikA pradAna garekA chauM jasabATa U gopya evaM khullArUpamA kharca gardacha, ke yI duvai samAna huna sakchan ta? (vAstavamA) sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhakailAgi hun tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |

ani, allAha euTA arko udAharaNa bayAna gardachan; duIjanA vyaktiharU chan, jasamadhye ekajanA lATo cha, jasalAI kunai kurAko sAmathrya chaina, tyo Aphno svAmImAthi bojha baneko cha | usale tyasalAI jatA paThAe pani tyasale kunai ThIka kArya garera Au~daina, ke yo tyo vyakti samAna huna sakcha jasale nyAyako Adeza dincha ra AphU pani sIdhA mArgamA cha?

ani, AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA adRzya tathyaharUko jJAna kevala allAhalAI cha | ani, mahApralaya ta palabharamA vA tyobhandA pani chiTo hunecha | nissandeha allAha pratyeka cijako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
allAhale timIharUlAI timrA AmAharUko kokhabATa yasa avasthAmA nikAle ki timIharUlAI kehI pani thAhA thiena | ra, unale timIharUkA kAna, A~khA ra muTu banAe tAki timIharU kRtajJa bana |

ke tinIharUle paMkSIharUlAI AkAzamA kasarI TikirahekA chan bhanI avalokana garekA chainan? tyasalAI kevala allAhale thAmekA hunchan | nissandeha yasamA ImAna lyAune vyaktiharUkAlAgi ThUlAe nizAnIharU chan |

ani, allAhale nai timrA gharaharUlAI bAsasthAna banAe ra timrolAgi caupAyAharUkA chAlAharUbATa yastA gharaharU banAe jasalAI timIharU yAtrA tathA bAsa duvai samayamA halukA anubhava garchau, ra, tinIharUkA Una, bhuvA tathA rauMbATa unale gharelu vastuharU ra upabhogya vastuharU banAe euTA nizcita avadhikolAgi |

ani, allAhale nai timIharUkAlAgi AphUle sRSTi garekA bastuharUko chAyA~ banAe; pahADaharUmA timrolAgi guphAharU banAe, ra, unale nai timrolAgi vastraharU banAe jasale timIharUlAI garmIbATa bacAu~chan ani yastA vastraharU pani jasale timIharUlAI yuddhamA surakSita rAkhchan | yasarI allAha timIharUprati Aphno varadAna pUrA garchan tAki timIharU AjJAkArI bana |
yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane (yo sandeza) spaSTa rUpamA puryAune jimmevArI timImAthi cha |
tinIharU allAhakA varadAnasaMga rAmrarI paricita chan, taipani tyasalAI asvIkAra garchan | tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza pUrNarUpamA kRtaghna chan |
ra, (ke hunecha!) tyasadina jaba hAmI pratyeka samudAyabATa eka sAkSI khaDA garnechauM, ani tyatikhera kAphiraharUlAI na (kehI bhanne) AjJA diinecha na tinIharUlAI saphAi nai peza garne |
ra, jaba atyAcArIharUle yAtanA dekhnechan, taba na tinIharUko yAtanA halukA garinecha na tinIharUlAI avasara nai diinecha |

ra, jaba bahudevavAdIharU saMsAramA AphUle ThaharAekA sAjhedAraharUlAI dekhnechan taba tinIharUle bhannechan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! yinIharU nai hun hAmIle banAekA sAjhedAraharU jasalAI hAmI timIlAI choDera pukArne garthyAai~ |” tara tinIharUle uttara dinechan ra bhannechan– “timIharU nai jhUThA hau |”
tyasa dina tinIharU sabai allAhasAmu AtmasamarpaNa garnechan ra tinIharUle racekA jhUThaharU tinIharUbATa harAunechan |
juna vyaktiharU kuphra garchan ra allAhako mArgabATa rokne garchan, tinIharUle maccAeko vidhvaMzale gardA tinIharUlAI diine yAtanAmAthi hAmI ajha baDhI yAtanA thapnechauM |
