ani, smaraNa gara tyasadinako jaba hAmI pratyeka samudAyamA unIharUmadhyebATai sAkSI khaDA garnechauM ra (he muhammada sa.!) timIlAI yI vyaktiharUkAlAgi sAkSIko rUpamA lyAunechauM | ra, hAmIle timImAthi yo grantha avatarita garekA chauM juna pratyeka kurAlAI spaSTa pArne ra AjJAkArIharUkAlAgi mArgadarzana, dayA tathA zubha–sUcanA ho |

vAstavamA allAha nyAya, paropakAra ra nAtedAraharUlAI (haka) dina Adeza dinchan, ra ati azlIlatA, duSkarma tathA atyAcArabATa manAhI garchan | unI timIharUlAI upadeza dinchan tAki timIharU zikSA grahaNa gara |

ani, timIharUle allAhasita vAcA garepachi tyasalAI pUrA garne gara, ra Aphno kasama sudRDha garepachi tyasalAI natoDa jabaki timIharUle svayaMmAthi allAhalAI jimmebAra ThaharyAekA chau | nissandeha allAha timIharUle garne garekA karmaharUbATa avagata chan |

ra, tI mahilA jasto nabana jasale svayaMle parizrama garI kAteko dhAgolAI A~phaile TukrA–TukrA pArin | timIharU Aphno kasamalAI ApasI vyavahAramA chalakapaTako sAdhana banAu~chau tAki euTA samudAyale arko samudAyabhandA baDhI lAbha prApta garos jabaki allAha yasa vAcAdvArA timIharUko parIkSA linchan | ra, unI nizcaya nai mahApralayako dina timIharUsamakSa timrA matabhedaharUko vAstavikatA spaSTa garnechan |

ra, allAhale cAheko bhae timIharU sabailAI euTai samudAya banAune thie tara unI jasalAI cAhanchan pathabhraSTa garchan ra jasalAI cAhanchan mArgadarzana garchan | ra, jejati kAma timIharU garirahekA chau tyasabAre nizcaya nai timIharUlAI sodhapucha garinecha |

ani, timIharU Aphno kasamaharUlAI ApasamA dhokA dine sAdhana nabanAU | anyathA timIharUkA pAu sthira bhaepachi punaH ciplana pugnechan ra timIharUle allAhako mArgabATa anya vyaktiharUlAI rokekAle timIharUle nikRSTa pariNAma bhognu parnecha | ra, timIharUkAlAgi ThUlo yAtanA raheko cha |
ani, allAhasita garekA vAcAlAI tuccha lAbhakolAgi nabeca | timIharU jJAna rAkhchau bhane allAhakahA~ raheko (timro pratidAna) nai timrolAgi sarvazreSTha cha |

timIharUsita bhaeko (dhana–sampatti) samApta hunevAlA cha, ra allAhasita bhaeko bA~kI rahanecha | ra, hAmI dhairyadhAraNa garneharUlAI tinIharukA satkarmaharUko sarvotkRSTa pratidAna avazya pradAna garnechauM |
puruSa hos vA mahilA jasale ImAna lyAera satkarma garcha hAmI avazya nai usalAI pavitra jIvanayApana garAunechauM, ra unIharUle garekA kAryaharUko uttama pratidAna pradAna garnechauM |
ra, timI kuraAnako pATha suru gardA tiraskRta zaitAnabATa allAhako zaraNa mAgne gara |
AsthAvAnaharu tathA AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi bharosA rAkhneharumAthi zaitAnako vaza calne chaina |
usako vaza ta yastA vyaktiharUmAthi mAtra calne garcha jasale usalAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAu~chan ra tyasalAI allAhako sAjhedAra ThaharyAu~chan |

ani, jaba hAmI kunai Ayatako saTTAmA anya Ayata avataraNa garchau~, ra ke avataraNa garnucha bhanI allAhalAI rAmrarI thAhA cha, taba tinIharU bhanchan– “(he muhammada sa.!) timI ta yo kuraAna svayaM racne garchau |” vAstavamA tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU anabhijJa chan |

bhanideU– “tyasalAI ta pavitrAtmA (jibraIla) le ThIka merA rabako tarphabATa kramazaH avataraNa garekA chan tAki AsthAvAnaharUlAI sudRDhatA pradAna garUn | ra, yo muslimaharUkAlAgi mArgadarzana evaM zubha–sUcanA ho |”

hAmIlAI rAmrarI jJAta cha ki tinIharU (timro bAremA) bhanchan– “yasa vyaktilAI euTA mAnchele sikAune garcha |” tara tinIharUko saGketa juna vyaktitarpha raheko cha usako bhASA ta gaira–arabI (ajamI) ho jabaki yo bizuddha arabImA cha |
vAstavamA juna vyaktiharU allAhakA AyatamAthi ImAna lyAu~dainan, allAha pani tinIharUlAI mArgadarzana gardainan, ra yastA vyaktiharUkAlAgi duHkhadAyI yAtanA raheko cha |
mithyA racne vyaktiharU ta tinai hun jo allAhakA AyataharUmAthi ImAna rAkhdainan ra yastA vyaktiharU nai jhUThA hun |

jo vyakti Aphno ImAnapachi allAhaprati anAsthA prakaTa garcha, tyo vyaktibAheka jasalAI vAdhya tulyAiyo ra usako hRdaya ImAnaprati dRDha cha, tara jasale spaSTarUpamA AnAsthA prakaTa garcha tinIharUmAthi allAhako krodha raheko cha, ra, tinIharUkA lAgi ThUlo yAtanA pani raheko cha |
yAe yasa kAraNale ki, tinIharUle sAMsArika jIvanalAI paralokamAthi prAthamikatA die | ra, allAha kRtaghna vyaktiharUlAI (mukti) dekhAu~dainan |
tinIharU nai yastA vyaktiharU hun jasako mana, mastiSka, kAna tathA A~khAharUmAthi allAhale sila lagAidiekA chan ra tinIharU nai cetanAhIna vyaktiharU hun |
yasamA kunai sandeha chaina ki ‘Akhirata’ mA ghATA khAne tinIharU nai hunechan |

pheri timrA pAlanakartA tI vyaktiharUkAlAgi hun jo satAiepazcAt palAyana bhae, pheri jihAda gare, ra dhairyale kAma lie | yasapachi pani timrA pAlanakartA nizcaya nai ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
smaraNa gara jaba pratyeka vyakti Aphnai bacAu gardai hAjira hunecha ani pratyeka vyaktilAI usako karmako pUrNa badalA pradAna garinecha ra kasaimAthi alikati pani anyAya garine chaina |

ani, allAha yasto nagarako udAharaNa prastuta garchan jasalAI zAnti tathA santuSTi prApta thiyo ra pratyeka dizAbATa tyasako khAdyAnna sAmagrI prazasta mAtrAmA Airaheko thiyo tara tyasale allAhako varadAnaprati kRtaghnatA dekhAyo | ataH allAhale tyasalAI tyasako kukarmale gardA bhoka ra trAsako svAda cakhAe |
ra, tinIharUsamakSa tinIharUmadhyebATa rasUla puge | tinIharUle unalAI pani mithyA Thahara gare | ani, tinIharUlAI prakopale samAtyo ra tinIharU thie nai atyAcArI |
ani allAhale jejati vaidha evaM pavitra AjIvikA timIharUlAI pradAna garekA chan tyasamadhye khAU | ra, yadi timIharU allAhakai upAsanA garchau bhane unako varadAnakAnimti kRtajJatA dekhAU |

unale timIharUkAlAgi marekA janAvara, ragata, su~gurako mAsu ra (vadha garnalAi) allAha bAheka anya kasaiko nAma uccAraNa gariekA janAvaralAI avaidha (harAma) garekA chan, tara kohI vivaza bhayo ra usale anicchApUrvaka ra sImA ullaGghana nagarI khAyo bhane allAha nissandeha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

ra, timIharU Aphno mukhale raceko AdhAramA yo halAla (vaidha) ra yo harAma (avaidha) ho bhanne nagara ki timIharU allAhavirUddha mithyAropaNa garnevAlA bannechau | vAstavamA jasale allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garchan tinIharU saphala huna sakdainan |
yo (sAMsArika sukha) kSaNika sukha mAtra ho | ra, tinIharUkAlAgi dukhadAyI yAtanA raheko cha |

ra, juna cijaharU hAmIle yasaaghi timIlAI bayAna garyauM, tI sabai yahUdIharUkA lAgi pani avaidha garekA thiyauM | ra, hAmIle tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garenauM, barU tinIharU svayaM Aphai~mAthi atyAcAra garne garthe |

tara, juna vyaktiharU ajJAnatAko kAraNale duSkarma garchan pheri prAyazcita garera Aphno karmako sudhAra garchan tinIharUko prAyazcita tathA sudhArapachi timrA pAlanakartA ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
nissandeha ibrAhIma svayaM Aphai~mA euTA samudAya, allAhakA AjJAkArI tathA ekAgracitta vyakti thie ra unI bahudevavAdIharUmadhyekA thienan |
unI allAhakA sukha–sAmagrIharUprati kRtajJa thie | allAhale unalAI roje ra sIdhA mArga dekhAe |
ani, hAmIle unalAI lokamA bhalAI pradAna garyauM ra unI paralokamA satkarmIharUmadhye hunechan |
pheri hAmIle timItarpha vahya garyauM ki ekAgra bhaera ibrAhImako mArgako anusaraNa gara | ra, unI bahudevavAdIharUmadhyekA thienan |

“sabta” (zanibAra) ko dinako Adara garnu kevala tI vyaktiharUkAlAgi anivArya garieko thiyo jasale tyasamA matabheda garekA thie | timIharUkA pAlanakartAle mahApralayako dina tinIharUbIca tI kurAharUko avazya nirNaya garnechan jasamA tinIharU matabheda garne garchan |

he sandeSTA! mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mArgatarpha tatvadarzitA evaM sadupadezako mAdhyamabATa bolAU ra tinIharUsita sarvottama tarIkAle tarkavitarka gara | timrA raba rAmrarI jAndachan ki ko unako mArgabATa bhraSTa bhaeko cha ra ko sIdhA mArgamA cha |
ra timIharU badalA lina cAhanchau bhane tyahI hadasamma leU jati timIharUmAthi atyAcAra garieko cha | ra, timIharU dhairyale kAma linchau bhane dhairyavAnaharUkAlAgi tyo jhan rAmro hunecha |

(he nabI (sa.)!) dhairyapUrvaka kAma leU ra timro dhairyatA allAhakai kRpAmA nirbhara cha ra tinIharUko avasthAprati duHkhita nahoU ra tinIharUko SaDyantrapUrNa yojanAprati Aphno hRdaya saGkIrNa napAra |
nissandeha allAha tyastA vyaktiharUkAsAtha chan jo Izabhaya rAkhchan ra satkarma garchan |

pavitra chan unI (allAha) jasale AphnA bhakta (muhammada sa.) lAI eka rAta pratiSThita masjida (kaabA) dekhi hAmIle varipari maMgalamaya tulyAieko aksA–masjidasamma bhramaNa garAe tAki unalAI hAmI AphnA kehI nizAnIharU dekhAauM | nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |
ani, hAmIle mUsAlAI grantha pradAna garyauM ra unalAI isrAIlakA santAnaharUkAlAgi mArgadarzaka banAyauM, yasa AdezakA sAtha ki mabAheka arU kasailAI Aphno kAryasAdhaka nabanAunu |”
he tI vyaktiharUkA santAna ho jasalAI hAmIle nUhasa~ga (DuGgAmA) savAra garAekA thiyauM! nissandeha nUha (hAmrA) kRtajJa bhakta thie |
ani, hAmIle isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI granthamA Aphno spaSTa nirNaya bhanidiekA thiyauM ki timIharUle dhartImA avazya nai duIpaTaka upadrava maccAunechau ra ThUlo uddaNDatA dekhAunechau |

ani jaba tI duImadhye pahilo (vidhvaMza) ko samaya Ayo taba (he isrAIlakA santAnaharu ho!) hAmIle timIharuviruddha AphnA yastA bhaktaharu paThAyauM jo ati zaktizAlI thie, ani tinIharu dharabhitrasamma puge | ra tyo bAcA pUrA hunu nai thiyo |
tyasapachi hAmIle timIharUlAI unIharUmAthi prabhutva jamAune avasara pradAna garyauM ra sampatti tathA santAnaharUdvArA timIharUlAI sahayoga garyauM ani timIharUlAI ThUlo samUhavAlA banAyauM |

yadi timIharU satkarma garchau bhane tyo AphnailAgi garnechau ra yadi kukarma garchau bhane tyo pani AphnailAgi garnechau | ani, jaba arko vAcAko samaya Ayo (taba hAmIle zaktizAlI bhaktaharUlAI pheri paThAyauM) tAki tinIharUle timrA anuhAraharUlAI bigArUn ra (baitul–makdis) masjidamA pahilekA zatruharU praveza garejhaiM tinIharU pani praveza garUn tathA niyantraNamA liekA sabai cija naSTa pArUn |

AzA cha ki timrA pAlanakartAle timIharUmAthi dayA garnechan ra yadi timIharU pahilejastai karma garchau bhane hAmI pani timIharUsa~ga tyastai vyavahAra garnechauM | ra, kRtaghnaharUkA– lAgi hAmIle narakalAI kArAgAra banAekai chauM |
vAstavamA yasa kuraAnale bilakula sIdhAmArga dekhAu~cha ra satkarma garne AsthAvAnaharUlAI mahAn pratidAnako zubha sUcanA dincha |
ra, juna vyaktiharU AkhiratamAthi ImAna lyAu~dainan tinIharUkAlAgi hAmIle duHkhadAyI yAtanA tayAra pArekA chauM |
ra, mAnava tyasarI kubhalAI mAga garcha jasarI bhalAI prAptikolAgi prArthanA garnuparne thiyo | ra, vAstavamA mAnava uttAulo huncha |

ra, hAmIle rAta tathA dinalAI duIvaTA nizAnIko rUpamA banAekA chauM | ani hAmIle rAtako nizAnIlAI prakAzahIna tathA dinako nizAnIlAI prakAzamaya banAyauM tAki timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAko anugraha khoja ra tAki timIharU varSaharUko saMkhyA tathA hisAba jAnna saka | ra, hAmIle pratyeka vastulAI vistRta rUpamA spaSTa pArekA chauM |
ani, hAmIle pratyeka manuSyako saubhAgyalAI usako gardhanamA jhunDyAidiekAchau~ | ra, mahApralayako dina usakolAgi hAmIle euTA bahI (khAtA) nikAlnechauM jasalAI usale ekadama khullA pAunecha |
(ani bhaninecha) paDha Aphno karmapatra | Aja timI Aphno hisAba garna svayaM paryApta chau |

jasale mArgadarzana grahaNa garcha usale svayaMkolAgi mArgadarzana prApta garcha ra juna vyakti pathabhraSTa huncha, pathabhraSTatAko hAni pani usaile bhognuparcha | ra, kasaile pani anya kasaiko bhArI bokne chaina | ra, jabasamma hAmI kunai rasUla paThAu~dainau tabasamma hAmI prakopa di~dainauM |

ani, jaba hAmI kunai nagaralAI naSTa garna cAhanchauM taba hAmI tyahA~kA sampanna vyaktiharUlAI Adeza dinchauM ra tinIharU khubai upadrava maccAu~chan | ani (prakopako) Adeza tinIharUmAthi lAgU huncha | antataH hAmI tyasalAI pUrNa rUpamA naSTa garidinchauM |
ani, nUhapachi hAmIle katipaya samudAyalAI naSTa pAridiyauM | ra, timrA raba AphnA bhaktaharUko pApasa~ga pUrNa rUpamA paricita chan ra dekhirAkhekA chan |

jo zIghra prApta hune cIja (sAMsArika lAbha) ko icchA garcha hAmI tyasamadhye jasalAI cAhanchauM ra jati cAhanchauM zIghra pradAna garchauM | tara, usako bhAgyamA naraka lekhidinchauM jasamA U tiraskRta bhaera ra dhikkAriera hominecha |
ani, jasale paralokako icchA garcha ra tyasakolAgi sakdo prayatna pani garcha sAthai AsthA pani rAkhcha tyastA sabai mAnisaharUko prayatnalAI kadara garinecha |
hAmI yinIharU ra tinIharU sabailAI jIvikopArjanakA sAmAnaharU pradAna garchauM | yo timro pAlanakartAko dena ho ra timrA pAlanakartAko denalAI kasaile pani rokna sakdaina |
hera, hAmIle kasailAI kasaimAthi kasarI pradhAnatA pradAna garekA chauM | ra, paraloka ta zreNIharUko hisAbale ucca cha ra pratiSThAko hisAbale jhan uttama hunecha |
ra, allAhasita anya kasailAI pUjya nabanAU natra tiraskRta tathA asahAya bhaera basna pugnechau |

ra, timrA pAlanakartAle nirNaya garidiekA chan ki timIharU unIbAheka kasaiko upAsanA nagara; mAtApitAsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra gara | yadi tI duvaimadhye eka vA duvai timro upasthitimA bRddhAvasthAmA pugchan bhane unIharUlAI ‘uph!’ pani nabhana; ra na unIharUlAI hapkAU baru unIharUsita AdarapUrvaka kurA gara |
ani, dayAkAsAtha vinamratAkA hAta unIharUsamakSa phailAera basa ra prArthanA gara– “he merA svAmI! uhA~harUmAthi dayA gara jasarI uhA~harUle bAlyakAlamA mero pAlanapoSaNa garnubhaeko thiyo |”
timIharUko manamA bhaekA kurAharU timrA svAmI rAmrarI jAndachan | yadi timIharU satkarmI rahanchau bhane vAstavamA unI (satkarmatarpha) pharkane vyaktiharUkAnimti ati kSamAzIla chan |
ani, nAtedAralAI usako haka pradAna gara, ra dIna–dukhI tathA pathikalAI pani | ra, (sampatti) apabyaya nagara |
apabyayIharU zaitAnakA dAjubhAi hun | ra, zaitAna AphnA pAlanakartAprati kRtaghna cha |
ra, yadi timIharUlAI AphUle AzA gareko Aphno svAmIko dayAko khojIko kAraNale yinIharUbATa piThayU~ pharkAunu pare pani yinIharUsita namra kurA gara |
AphnA hAta Aphno gardhanamA nabA~dha; na tyasalAI bilakulai khullA choDa, anyathA timI nindanIya tathA vivaza bhaera basnechau |

nissandeha timrA svAmI jasalAI cAhanchan usako jIvikA vistRta tulyAidinchan ra jasalAI cAhanchan usako jIvikA saMkucita pAridinchan | nissandeha unI AphnA bhaktaharUko bAremA rAmro jAnakAra chan ra (unIharUlAI) dekhchan |,
ra, timIharU daridratAko bhayale AphnA santAnaharuko hatyA nagara | hAmI nai unIharUlAI jIvikA pradAna garnechauM ra timIharUlAI pani | nissandeha unIharUko hatyA mahApApa ho |
ra, vyabhicArako najika pani najAU kinabhane yo ati azlila kArya tathA kumArga ho |

ani, allAhale avaidha ThaharyAeko jyAnalAI nyAyocita kAraNa binA namAra ra atyAcArapUrvaka mAriekA (vyaktiko) abhibhAvakalAI pratihatyAko mAga garne adhikAra hAmIle pradAna garekA chauM | tara, tyo abhibhAvakale (badalAko) hatyAmA sImA ullaGghana nagaros, nizcaya nai usalAI sahayoga garinecha |,
anAthako sampattiko najika pani najAU ucita tarikAle bAheka; yahA~samma ki U Aphno paripakvatAko umeramA pugos | ra, Aphno vAcA pUrA gara kinabhane vAcAbAre avazya sodhapucha hunecha |
ani, nApataula gardA jahile pani pUrA nApa dine gara ra sahI tarAjule jokhne gara | yahI uttama tathA pariNAmako dRSTile rAmro raheko cha |
ani, jJAna nabhaeko kurAko pachi nalAga kinabhane kAna, A~khA ra hRdayakA bAremA sodhinecha |
ani, dhartImA ghamaNDakAsAtha nahi~Da kinabhane na timIle dhartIlAI cirna sakchau ra na lambAImA pahADako barAbara huna sakchau |
yI sabai kukarmaharU timrA pAlanakartAsamakSa ati apriya chan |
yI tI tatvajJAnaharUmadhye hun jasako prakAzanA timrA svAmIle timImAthi garekA chan | ra, allAhasita anya kasailAI pUjya nabanAU anyathA timI nindita tathA zrApita bhaI narakamA hominechau |
ke timIharUkA pAlanakartAle timIharUlAI putra dinakA lAgi chAnekA chan ani AphnolAgi phariztAharUlAI putrIsvarUpa grahaNa gare? timIharUle Aphno mukhale bhanekA kurA ati ThUlo (jhUTha) ho |
ani, hAmIle yasa kuraAnamA mAnisaharUlAI vibhinna prakArale samjhAyauM tAki tinIharUle upadeza grahaNa garUn | tara tinIharU tyasabATa ajha TADhA nai bhAgchan |
bhanideU– “timIharUko bhanAi anusAra yadi unIsita anya IzvaraharU bhaekA bhae tinIharUle avazya siMhAsanako svAmIsamma pugna kunai na kunai mArga khojera nikAlne thie |”
tinIharUle jejati bhanirahekA chan tyasabATa unI pavitra ra atyanta ucca rahekA chan |

sAtavaTai AkAza, pRthvI ra tinIharUbhitra rahekA sampUrNa cijaharU allAhako stuti gardaichan | unako prazaMsAsAtha stuti nagariraheko kunai pani cija chaina | tara, timIharU unIharUle gariraheko stutilAI bujhdainauM | nissandeha unI sahanazIla ra kSamAzIla chan |
ani, jaba timI kuraAnako pATha garchau, hAmI timI ra paralokamA ImAna narAkhne vyaktiharUbIca euTA adRzya AvaraNa khaDA garidinchauM |

ani, tinIharUko hRdayalAI (pani) AvaraNale DhAkidinchauM tAki tinIharU bujhnai nasakUn ra tinIharUkA kAnamA bahiropana hAlidinchauM | ra, jaba timI kuraAnamA eka mAtra pAlanakartAko carcA garchau taba tinIharU piThyU~ pharkAera TADhA bhAgchan |

jaba tinIharU timItarpha kAna thApera sundachan; tinIharU kuna uddezyale sunchan bhanne kurA hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM ra tinIharUle kAnekhusI gariraheko kurA pani jAndachauM | yI atyAcArIharU ApasamA bhanchan– “timIharU kevala eka jAdUpIDita vyaktiko anusaraNa garirahekA chau |”
hera, tinIharUle timro bAremA kastA kisimakA udAharaNaharU bayAna garchan, yasai kAraNa tinIharU ta pathabhraSTa bhae | ataH tinIharUle satmArga pAunai sakdainan |
ra, tinIharU bhanchan– “ke jaba hAmI (marera) hADakhoDa tathA TukrA–TukrA hunechauM taba nava jIvana pAera punarUtthAna garinechauM?”
bhanideU– “timIharU DhuGgA bana yA phalAma |

vA timro vicAramA yo bhandA pani kunai yasto Thosa sRSTi (jasale jindagI pAunu asambhava cha |) ani tinIharUle avazya nai sodhne chan– “kasale hAmIlAI pUnarjanma garAune cha?” bhanideU– “timIharUlAI pahilopaTaka sRSTi garnele nai | tyasapachi tinIharU Aphno TAuko hallAu~chan ra agADi hallAu~dai sodhchan–“yo kahile hunecha?” bhanideU– “yasamA ke Azcarya cha ki yo zIghra nai hunecha!”
tyasadina jaba unale timIharUlAI bolAunechan, timIharU unako prazaMsA gardai AjJApAlana garnechau ra timIharUle saMsAramA thorai dina bitAekA chau bhanne anumAna garnechau |

(he sandeSTA!) merA bhaktaharUlAI bhanideU ki unIharUle rAmro kurA mAtra garne garUn | vAstavamA zaitAnale mAnavaharUbIca vaimanasyatA utpanna garne prayAsa garcha | nizcaya nai zaitAna mAnavako khullamkhullA zatru ho |

timIharUkA pAlanakartA timIharUko avasthAbATa rAmrarI jAndachan | unale cAhemA timIharUmAthi dayA garnechan | ra, unale cAhemA timIharUlAI yAtanA dinechan | ra, (he sandeSTA!) hAmIle timIlAI mAnisaharUkA kAryasAdhaka banAera paThAekA chainau |

ani, AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA rahekA sampUrNa vastusa~ga timrA pAlanakartA rAmrarI avagata chan ra hAmIle kehI sandeSTAharUlAI anya kehI sandeSTAharUmAthi zreSThatA pradAna garekA chauM | ra, hAmIle nai dAUdalAI jabUra (grantha) pradAna garyauM |
bhanideU– “allAhabAheka jasalAI timIharU (kAryasAdhaka) ThAndachau tinIharUlAI bolAera hera | tinIharUle na timIharUko kaSTa nivAraNa garna sakchan na (tyasamA kunai) parivartana nai garna sakchan |”

tinIharU jasalAI pukArchan unIharU svayaM AphnA pAlanakartAko nikaTatA prAptikAlAgi mAdhyama khojdaichan ki unIharUmadhye kasale adhika nikaTatA prApta garna sakcha | ani, unIharU AphnA pAlanakartAko dayAko AzAmA rahanchan ra unako yAtanAbATa DarAu~chan | vAstavamA timrA pAlanakartAko yAtanA bhayAnaka cha |
ra, kunai yasto nagara chaina jasalAI hAmIle mahApralayako dinabhandA aghi dhvasta napArauM vA kaThora yAtanA nadeauM | yo kurA pustikAmA lipibaddha bhaisakeko cha |

ani, hAmIlAI kevala yasa kurAle nizAnIharU paThAunabATa rokyo ki atItakA mAnisaharUle tyasalAI nakArekA thie ra, hAmIle samUda jAtilAI spaSTa nizAnIkA rUpamA U~TanI pradAna garekA thiyauM | tara tinIharUle tyasamAthi atyAcAra gare | ra, mAnisaharUlAI saceta garna nai hAmI nizAnIharU paThAune garchauM |

ani, smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle bhanyauM– “timrA pAlanakartAle mAnisaharUlAI gherAmA liekA chan |” ani, hAmIle timIlAI dekhAeko dRzya ra kuraAnamA tiraskAra garieko bRkSalAI mAnisaharUkAlAgi parIkSA banAidiyauM | ani, hAmI tinIharUlAI sAvadhAna garchau~ tara cetAvanIle tinIharUko uddaNDatAmA ThUlo vRddhi nai gardacha |

ra, smaraNa gara tyasa samayalAI jaba hAmIle phariztAharUlAI bhanyauM ki AdamasAmu sajdA gara taba iblIsabAheka sabaile sajdA gare | usale (iblIsale) bhanyo– “ke ma yasto vyaktilAI sajdA garU~ jasalAI timIle mATobATa sRjanA garekA chau?”
bhanyo– “ke yahI ho jasalAI timIle mamAthi zreSThatA pradAna garyau? yadi timIle malAI mahApralayako dinasamma avasara diyau bhane kehI vyaktibAheka usakA sampUrNa santAnalAI Aphno vazamA pArnechu |"
allAhale bhane– “jAU, unIharUmadhye jasale timro anusaraNa garcha tI sabaikAlAgi naraka nai pUrNa badalA hunecha |”

ani, tinIharUmadhye ja–jasalAI timI bahakAuna sakchau Aphno AvAjale bahakAU | ra, tinIharUmAthi AphnA ghoDasavAra tathA paidala dubaidvArA jAilAga | ani, tinIharUkA sampatti ra santAnaharUmA sAjhedAra bana | ra, tinIharUlAI vacanako jAlamA phasAU | ra, zaitAnale tinIharUlAI dieko vacana dhokA mAtra huncha |
(merA niSkapaTa) bhaktaharUmAthi kadApi timro adhikAra calne chaina ra kAryasAdhakako rUpamA timrA pAlanakartA paryApta chan |
timIharUkA pAlanakartA unai hun jo samudramA timrAlAgi DuMgA calAu~chan tAki timI unako varadAna khoja | nissandeha unI timIharUprati parama dayAlu chan |

ani, jaba samudramA timIharUmAthi saGkaTa AilAgcha taba timIharUle pukArne garekA unI bAheka sabai IzvaraharU harAu~chan ra jaba unale surakSita DhaMgale timIharUlAI bhUmitarpha puryAidinchan taba timIharU unIbATa vimukha hunchau | ra, mAnava ati kRtaghna cha |

ke unale timIharUsa~gai dhartIlAI dha~sAunechan vA timIharUmAthi DhuMgA barsAunechan bhanne kurAmA timIharU nizcinta bhaisakekA chau? (unale yasto garemA) timIharU Aphno lAgi kunai kAryasAdhaka pAune chainauM |

vA timIharU nizcinta chau ki allAhale timIharUlAI pheri samundramA laijAnechan ra timIharUko kRtaghnatAle gardA timIharUlAI bhayAnaka A~dhI–beharI paThAera DubAunechan? yasto bhayo bhane timIharUle tyasa bAremA kasailAI hAmIsita sodhapucha garnevAlA pAunechainau |

ra, hAmIle AdamakA santAnalAI sammAnita tulyAekA chauM | ra, tinIharUlAI hAmIle thala tathA jala duvaimA savArI pradAna garyauM | tinIharUlAI pavitra cijaharUbATa jIvikA pradAna garyauM ra hAmIle sRSTi garekA dherai cijaharUmAthi tinIharUlAI spaSTa zreSThatA pradAna garyauM |

tyasa dinako (kalpanA gara) jaba hAmI pratyeka mAnava samUhalAI unakA aguvAsahita bolAunechauM | ani, jasalAI unako karmapatra unako dAhine hAtamA diinecha tI vyaktiharUle (ullAsakA sAtha) Aphno karmapatra paDhnechan ra unIharUmAthi kaNa barAbara pani anyAya hune chaina|
ra, juna vyakti yasa lokamA andho banera basnecha tyo paralokamA pani andho tathA mArgavihina bhaera rahanecha |

ani, he sandeSTA! hAmIle timImAthi avataraNa gareko prakAzanAbATa timIlAI jhukyAuna khojdathe tAki timI hAmro nAmamA Aphno tarphabATa anya kunai kurA racera peza gara | timIle yasto gareko bhae tinIharUle pakkai timIlAI mitra banAune thie |
ani, yadi hAmIle timIlAI aDiga nabanAeko bhae timI saMbhavaH tinIharUtarpha kehI hadasamma jhukne thiyau |
yasto bhaeko bhae hAmIle timIlAI yasa saMsAramA pani duIguNA yAtanAko svAda cakhAune thiyauM ra paralokamA pani | tyasabelA timIle hAmro dA~jomA kunai sahayogI pAune thienau |

ani, vAstavamA yinIharU (makkAko) bhUmibATa timro khuTTA tAnnakAlAgi prayAsarata thie tAki yinIharUle timIlAI yahA~bATa niSkAsita garna sakUn ra yasto bhaeko bhae pani yinIharU tyahA~ timro niSkAsanapachi kehI dina mAtra Tikna sakne thie |

(he muhammada sa.) yahI hAmro nizcita kArya praNAlI (sunnata) timIbhandA pahile paThAekA AphnA rasUlaharUmAthi raheko cha ho (jasalAI hAmIle lAgU gardai AekA chauM |) ra, timIle hAmro sunnatamA kunai parivartana pAune chainauM |
ra, namAja kAyama gara sUrya Dhalkane samayadekhi rAtI pUrai a~dhyAro huJjelasamma | ra, phajrako kuraAna pATha pani | nissandeha phajrako kuraAna pATha sAkSAt huncha |
ra, rAtako kehI bhAgamA tahajjuda paDhne gara | yo atirikta (namAja) timairalAgi ho | cA~Dai nai timrA rabale timIlAI prazaMsanIya sthAnasamma puryAunechan |
ra, prArthanA gara– “he merA raba! malAI satyako sAtha praveza garAunu ra satyakA sAtha ani nikAla satyakA sAtha nai nikAlnu ra merolAgi AphnA tarphabATa prabhutva tathA sahayoga pradAna gara |”
ra, ghoSaNA garideU– “satya Aipugyo ra asatya nirmula bhayo | ra, asatya nirmula hunakAlAgi nai ho |”
ra, yo kuraAna juna hAmI avataraNa garirahekAchauM AsthAvAna harUkAlAgi Arogya tathA dayAko rUpamA raheko cha tara yasale yI atyAcArIharUko ghATAmA mAtra abhivRddhi garcha |
ra, jaba hAmI mAnavamAthi anugraha garchauM taba U bAGgiera vimukha huncha tara jaba usalAI kaSTa pugcha U nirAza huna pugcha |
bhanideU– “pratyeka vyakti Aphno tarIkA anusAra kAryarata cha | aba kuna vyakti sIdhA mArgamA raheko cha bhanne kurA timrA pAlanakartA nai rAmrarI jAndachan |”
ra, tinIharU timIsita rUha (AtmA) ko bAremA sodhchan | bhanideU– “rUha merA pAlanakartAko Adeza ho, ra timIharUlAI ekadamai kama jJAna diieko cha |”
ra, hAmIle cAhemA hAmI timItarpha paThAeko prakAzanA khosna sakchauM | ani timIle AphnolAgi hAmIviruddha kunai kAryasAdhaka pAune chainau |”
yo ta kevala timro rabako kRpA ho | vAstavamA timImAthi unako ThUlo anugraha cha |
bhanideU– “yadi manuSya tathA jinna sabai milera yasa kuraAnajastai kunai cija lyAune prayAsa gare bhane pani lyAuna sakne chainan, cAhe tinIharU ApasamA ekaarkAko sahayoga nai kina nagarUn |”
hAmIle yasa kuraAnamA mAnavako (prazikSaNa dinakA)lAgi hareka prakArako udAharaNa prastuta garekA chauM tara adhikAMza mAnisa avajJAmA nai aDiga chan |
ra, tinIharUle bhane– “hAmI timImAthi vizvAsa gardai gardainauM jabasamma timI bhUmibATa hAmrolAgi mUla phuTAu~dainau...
vA timrolAgi khajUra tathA aMgurako bagaiMcA hos, ra timI tyasako bIcamA naharaharU bagAera dekhAU...
vA AkAzalAI TukrA TukrA pArera khasAU jasto ki timI bhanne garchau vA allAha tathA phariztAharUlAI lyAera hAmro sAmunne sAkSAt rUpamA khaDA gara....

vA timrolAgi jukhrupha (euTA bahumUlya dhAtu) ko ghara hos vA timI AkAzamAthi caDha | ra, hAmI timro caDhne kAryalAI pani vizvAsa gardaina jabasamma timI (tyahA~bATa) kunai grantha avatarita gardainau, jasalAI hAmI svayaM paDhauM |” bhanideU– “merA raba ati pavitra chan | ma allAhako sandeza lyAune eka mAnava mAtra hu~ |”
ra, mAnisaharUsamakSa mArgadarzanako AgamanapazcAt tinIharUle ImAna lyAunumA kevala tinIharUko yo bhanAi bAdhaka banyo–“ke allAhale euTA mAnavalAI rasUla banAera paThAekA chan ta?”
bhanideU– “yadi dhartImA phariztAharU nizcinta bhaI hiMDDula tathA basobAsa garekA bhae hAmIle tinIharUsamakSa AkAzabATa kunai phariztAlAI nai rasUla banAera paThAune thiyauM |”
bhanideU– “ma ra timIharUbIca allAha nai sAkSIko rUpamA paryApta chan | unI AphnA bhaktaharUkA bAremA pUrNa jJAtA ra draSTA hun |”

ani, kevala tI vyaktiharUlAI satmArga prApta hunecha jasalAI allAhale mArgadarzana garnechan, ra jasalAI allAhale pathabhraSTa garnechan timIle tinIharUkAlAgi allAhabAheka kunai saMrakSakamitra pAune chainau | ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI mahApralayako dina andho, lATo ra bahiro avasthAmA tinIharUko zira TekAera ekatrita garnechauM | tinIharUko bAsasthAna naraka hunecha | jaba jaba (narakako) Ago nibhna thAlcha tyasako jvAlAlAI baDhAunechauM |

yo tinIharUko sajAya~ hunecha kinaki tinIharUle hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI nakAre ra bhane– “ke jaba hAmI (saDera) haDDI tathA TukrA TukrA huna pugnechauM taba hAmro pUnarjanma euTA nayA~ sRSTiko rUpamA hune cha ta?”

ke tinIharUle socenan– “juna allAhale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko sRjanA garekA chan unI tyastAharUlAI sRjanA garne avazya nai sAmarthya rAkhdachan? ra, unale unIharUkA lAgi euTA samaya nirdhArita garekA chan jasamA kunai sandeha chaina |” tara, atyAcArI vyaktiharU inkAramA nai aDiga rahe |
bhanideU– “yadi merA rabako dayAko khajAnA timIharUko hAtamA bhaeko bhae timIharUle tyasalAI kharca hune Darale rokera rAkhnethyau | ra, vAstavamA mAnisa ati saMkIrNa–hRdayI cha |

ra, hAmIle mUsAlAI nauvaTA spaSTa nizAnIharU pradAna garyauM | aba timI svayaM isarAIlakA santAnaharUsita sodha | jaba mUsA tinIharUkahA~ Ae ra phiraaunale bhanyo– “he mUsA! ma timIlAI jAdUpIDita ThAndachu |”

mUsAle bhane– “timIlAI thAhA cha ki yI spaSTa nizAnIharU kevala AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA rabale (timro) camatkArakArUpamA avataraNa garekA chan| ra mero vicAramA, he phiraauna! timI vinAza garine vyakti hau |”
antataH phiraaunale mUsA tathA isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI (misrako) bhUmibATa niskAsita garne vicAra garyo, tara hAmIle tyo sameta tyasasa~ga rahekA sArA mAnisaharUlAI DubAidiyauM |
ra, isrAilakA santAnalAI hAmIle bhanyauM– “yasa dezamA basobAsa gara | ani jaba paralokako vAcA Aipugcha, hAmI timIharU sabailAI jammA garera lyAunechauM |”

ani, hAmIle yasa kuraAnalAI satyakA sAtha avataraNa garyauM ra tyo satyakai sAtha avatarita pani bhaeko cha | ra, (he muhammada sa.!) hAmIle timIlAI kevala (AsthAvAnaharUlAI) zubha–sUcanA dine tathA (avajJAkArIharUkAlAgi) sacetaka banAera paThAekA chauM |
ra, yasa kuraAnalAI hAmIle thorai–thorai garI avataraNa garekA chauM tAki mAnisaharUlAI yo samayako antarAlamA sunAU | ra, hAmIle yasalAI kramika rUpamA avataraNa garekA chauM |

bhanideU– “timIharU yasamAthi ImAna lyAU vA nalyAU | vAstavamA jasalAI yasa (grantha) ko jJAna pradAna garieko cha, jaba unIharUsamakSa yasako pATha garincha taba unIharU anuhArale bhuI choera sajdA garchan |
ra, bhanchan– “pavitra chan merA raba | unako vAcA avazya pUrA hunecha |”
ani, unIharU ru~dai ghopTo parchan ra yasa kAryale unIharUko vinamratAlAI jhan baDhAu~cha |

bhanideU– timI “cAhe allAha bhanera pukAra vA rahamAna (atyanta karuNAmaya) bhanera juna nAmale pani unalAI pukAra, sabai sarvazreSTha nAmaharU unakai hun | ra, Aphno namAja na ati ucca svaramA paDha na ati manda svaramA nai apitu yI duvaiko bIcako mArga apanAU |”

ra, bhanideU– “sampUrNa prazaMsAharu allAhakailAgi hun jasale Aphnonimti na kunai putra grahaNa garekA chan na unako sattAmA kohI sAjhedAra nai cha, ra na durbalatAkA kAraNa unakA kohI sahayogI cha | ra, unako khubai mahimAgAna gara |”
sampUrNa prazaMsA unai allAhakAlAgi hun jasale AphnA bhakta (muhammada sa.) mAthi grantha avataraNa gare, ra tyasamA kunai kamI bA~kI rAkhenan |

ThIka–ThIka kurA bhanne grantha (avataraNa gariyo) tAki Aphno tarphabATa (Aune) kaThora yAtanAbATa sAvadhAna garUn ra satkarma garne AsthAvAnaharUlAI zubha–sUcanA diun | nissandeha tinIharUkAlAgi rAmro pratidAna raheko cha |,
jasamA unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan |
ra, tAki allAhale svayaMkolAgi euTA putra dhAraNa garekA chan bhanne vyaktiharUlAI pani unale sAvadhAna garUn |

(tinIharu yasto kurA bhandaichan jasako svayaM) na tinIharulAI jJAna cha na tinakA pUrvajaharulAI nai | ati gambhIra abhiyoga ho juna tinIharuko mukhabATa niskirahekocha | tinIharu spaSTa rupamA mithyA bolirahekA chan |,
(he sandeSTA!) yadi tinIharUle yasa zikSAprati ImAna lyAenan bhane sambhavataH timI tinIharUko bAremA cintita bhaera Aphno jyAnasameta gumAunechau |
pRthvImA rahekA sampUrNa cijaharUlAI hAmIle tyasakolAgi zobhA banAekA chauM tAki hAmI mAnisaharUko parIkSA liera herauM ki tinIharUmadhye ko ko satkarma garchan |
ra, hAmI (antamA) yI sabailAI ujADa bhUmimA pariNata garidinechauM |
ke timI yo ThAndachau ki guphA ra zilAlekhavAlAharu hAmrA nizAnIharumadhye ati Azcaryajanaka nizAnIharu thie?
jaba tI yuvAharU guphAmA Azraya lina puge taba tinIharUle bhane– “hAmIprati Aphno tarphabATa dayA pradAna gara ra hAmro mAmilAmA hAmIlAI sahI nirdezana deU |”
ani, hAmIle guphAmA tinIharUkA kAnamA kaiyauM varSakolAgi bujo lagAIdiyauM |
pheri hAmIle tinIharUlAI jagAyauM tAki duvai samUhamadhye kasale tyahA~ bitAeko avadhiko sahI gaNanA garna sakcha hAmI herauM |

hAmI timIlAI tI guphAmA pasekAharUko vAstavika kathA sunAu~daichauM | vAstavamA tinIharU kehI yuvA thie jasale AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi ImAna lyAe ra hAmIle tinIharUlAI mArgadarzanamA ajha avibRddhi garidiyauM |

ra, tinIharUko hRdayalAI tyatikhera sudRDha pAryauM jaba tinIharU ubhie ani ghoSaNA gare, “hAmrA pAlanakartA unI mAtra hun jo AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA mAlika hun | hAmIle unIbAheka kunai IzvaralAI pukAremA tyo ati anucita kurA huncha |”

(ani tinIharUle ApasamA bhane)– “yI hAmrA jAtibandhuharUle ta jagatakA pAlanakartAlAI choDera arUlAI pUjya banAekA rahechan | yinIharU tinIharUko pakSamA kunai spaSTa pramANa kina prastuta gardainan? allAhako sambandhamA mithyA racne vyaktibhandA ThUlo atyAcArI aru ko huna sakcha ra?”

ra, jabaki timIharU tI bahudevavAdIharU tathA tinIharUle allAhabAheka upAsanA garirahekA IzvaraharUbATa alaga bhaisakekA chau; guphAmA Azraya leU | timIharUkA ‘raba’ timIharUmAthi Aphno dayA phailAunechan | ra, timIharUko kAmakAlAgi sAdhana juTAunechan |

ra, timI sUryalAI tyasako udAune samayamA tinIharUko guphAbATa dAhinetarpha DhalkadaiM gareko dekhdathyauM bhane astAu~dA pani tinIharUlAI choDI bAyA~tarpha Dhalka~dai gareko dekhdathyau | ra, tinIharU guphAko euTA pharAkilo sthAnamA thie | yo allAhakA nizAnIharUmadhyeko ho | allAha jasalAI mArgadarzana garchan usale mAtra mArga pAuna sakcha | ra, jasalAI unI pathabhraSTa pArchan usakolAgi timI kunai kAryasAdhaka tathA mArgadarzaka pAune chainau |

ra, timIle tinIharUlAI dekhdA jAgeko ThAnthyau jabaki tinIharU sutekA thie | hAmIle tinIharUlAI dAyA~ tathA bAyA~tarpha kolTe pherAune gathryauM | ra, tinIharUko kukura pani guphAko pravezadvAramA Aphno agADiko dubai khuTTA phailAera basiraheko hunthyo | yadi timIle tinIharUlAI ciyAera hereko bhae timI piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgne thiyau ra timIharU nizcaya nai trasita hune thiyau |

ra, yasarI hAmIle tinIharUlAI jagAyauM tAki tinIharU ApasamA prazna garUn | tinIharUmadhye ekajanAle sodhyo– “bhana, timIharU yahA~ kati dinasamma rahyau?” tinIharUle bhane– “eka dina vA eka dinabhandA pani kama |” pheri tinIharUle bhane– “timIharUle bitAeko avadhibAre timrA raba nai rAmrarI jAndachan | ra timIharU AphUmadhye ekajanAlAI Aphno yo (cA~dIko) mudrA diera nagaratarpha paThAU jasale nagarako kuna khAdyAnna rAmro cha bhanera pattA lagAos ra tyahA~bATa timIharUkA lAgi kehI khAdyAnna lyAos | ra, U hoziyArIkAsAtha tyahA~ jAos ra kasaile pani timIharUbAre thAhA napAos...

(kinabhane) yI kAphiraharUle timIharUko bAremA thAhA pAe bhane timIharU mAthi DhuMgA barsAera mAridinchan vA (bAdhya pArera) Aphno samudAyamA samAveza garchan | ra, punaH timIharUle kadApi saphalatA pAune chainau |”

ani, yasarI hAmIle (mAnisaharUlAI) tinIharUko sthitibAre avagata garAidiyauMgha tAki allAhako vacana satyasiddha cha, ra mahApralayako AgamanamA kunai sandeha chaina bhanI jAnUn | (tyasasamayako smaraNa gara) jaba mAnisaharU guphAvAlAharUsita ke garnuparcha bhannebAremA vivAda garirahekA thie | kehI vyaktiharUle bhane– “tinIharU (ko guphA) mAthi (smAraka svarUpa) euTA bhavana nirmANa garideU | tinIharUbAre tinIharukA raba rAmrarI jAndachan |” tara tinIharukA mAmilAmA prabhutva prApta garekA vyaktiharUle bhane– “hAmI tinIharU (ko guphA) mAthi euTA masjida nai banAunechauM |”

kehI vyaktiharUle bhannechan– “guphAvAlAharU tInajanA thie ra cautho unako kukura thiyo |” ra, anya kehI vyaktiharUle bhannechan– “tinIharU pA~cajanA thie ra chaiThauM tinIharuko kukura thiyo |” yI sabai adRzyakA kurA bAremA aDkala gardai bhanieko mAtra ho | ra, ajha anya vyaktiharUle bhannechan “tinIharU sAtajanA thie ra AThauM tinIharUko kukura thiyo |” bhanideU– “merA raba nai tinIharUko saMkhyAko bAremA rAmrarI jAndachan | tinIharUbAre yI vyaktiharUlAI thAerai jJAna cha | ataH tinIharUbAre timI praSTa kurA mAtra gara | ra, tinIharUkA sambandhamA kasaisita kunai sodhapUcha nagara |”
ra, kunai pani kAryabAre kadApi nabhana ki tyo kArya ma bholi garU~lA |”

tara sAthai “inzAallAha” (allAhale cAhemA) pani bhana | ani, birsieko khaNDamA AphnA rabako smaraNa garihAla ra bhana– “AzA cha ki merA rabale yobhandA pani kama samayamA sahI kurAko mArgadarzana garlAn |”
ra, tinIharU Aphno guphAmA tInasaya varSasamma base ra thapa nau varSa pani |

ra, bhanideU– “tinIharUko basAIbAre allAha rAmrarI jAndachan | AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA adRzya vAstavikatAko jJAna unailAI cha | unI ati dekhnevAlA tathA sunnevAlA hun | tinIharUkAlAgi unIbAheka kohI saMrakSaka chaina | ra, unI Aphno zAsanamA kasailAI sAjhedAra banAu~dainan |”

(he nabI sa.!) timrA rabako tarphabATa timImAthi prakAzanA garieko granthako pATha gara | unakA kurAharUlAI kasaile parivartana garna sakdaina | unIbATa bacera bhAgna kunai Azrayasthala pAune chainau |

ra Aphno rabako prasannatA prAptikolAgi unalAI bihAna ra belukA pukArne vyaktiharUsa~ga timI svayaMlAI joDera rAkha | ra, yasa sAMsArika jIvanako zobhAlAI khojdai timro dRSTi unIharUbATa nahaTos | ra, timI kunai pani yasto vyaktiko AjJApAlana nagara jasako hRdayalAI hAmIle hAmaira smaraNabATa vismRta tulyAekA chauM, ra jo Aphno kuabhilASAko anusaraNa garcha ani jasako kAryale sImAharUlAI nAgheko cha |

ra, bhanideU– “yo nitAnta satya (kuraAna) timrA rabako tarphabATa raheko cha | ani, aba jasale cAhancha yasalAI mAnos, ra jasale cAha~daina namAnos |” hAmIle atyAcArIharUkAlAgi yasto agni tayAra garekA chauM jasako jvAlAle tinIharUlAI lapeTnecha | ra, tinIharUle bilApa gardA tinIharUko satkAra pagleko tAMmA jasto (umla~do) pAnIdvArA garinecha jasale anuhAraharUlAI polnecha | katti nikRSTa peya tathA atyanta nikRSTa vizrAmasthala ho naraka!
ra, jasale ImAna lyAe tathA satkarma gare, hAmI tyastA puNyakarma garne vyaktiharUko pratidAnalAI barbAda huna diMdainau |

yI vyaktiharU nai hun jasakolAgi yastA zAzvata bagaiMcAharU hunechan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | unIharUlAI tyahA~ sunakA bAlAharUdvArA AbhUSita garinecha | ra, unIharUle narama, pAtalA ra moTA rezamakA hariyA vastraharU pahirinechan ani aglA gaddIharUmAthi aDesa lAgera basnechan | katti uttama pratidAna tathA katti utkRSTa vizrAmasthala ho svarga!

ra, timI tinIharUlAI duIjanA vyaktiko dRSTAnta bayAna gara | tI duIjanAmadhye ekajanAkolAgi hAmIle duIvaTA yastA aMgurakA bagai~cAharU banAidiekA thiyauM jasalAI hAmIle khajurakA rUkhaharUdvArA gherekA thiyauM ra tI duvai bagaiMcAharUbIca annabAlI pani lagAekA thiyauM |
tI duvai bagaiMcAharUle khubai phala utpAdana garne garthe ra tinamA kunai kamI thiena ra tI duvaikAbIcamA hAmIle euTA nahara bagAidiekA thiyauM |
ra, usalAI khubai phala prApta bhayo | ani usale Aphno sAthIsa~ga kuraikurAmA bhanyo– “ma ta timIbhandA baDhI dhanI chu ra samUhako hisAbale pani baDhI zaktizAlI chu |”
ra, U (ahaMkAra gardai) svayaMmAthi atyAcArI bhaI Aphno bagaiMcAmA praveza garyo | usale bhanyo– “mero vicAramA yo sampatti kahilyai naSTa hune chaina...
ra na ma paraloka sthApanA hune kurAmA vizvAsa rAkhdachu | ra, yadi ma merA rabasAmu pharkAie~ nai bhane avazya yobhandA pani uttama sthAna pAunechu |”
usako sAthIle kurA kATdai bhanyo– “ke timI tyasako inkAra garchau jasale timIlAI mATobATa ra tyasapachi vIryabATa sRSTi gare pheri timIlAI pUrNa mAnava banAera khaDA gare?
tara ma ke vizvAsa garchu bhane unai allAha merA pAlanakartA hun | ma AphnA rabasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAune chaina |

ra, timI bagaiMcAmA praveza gardA “mAzAallAh lA kuvvata illA billAh” (yI sabai allAhako cAhanAle bhaekA hun ra kevala allAhalAI yasako sAmarthya cha) kina bhanenau yadi timIle malAI dhana tathA santAnamA AphUbhandA tuccha ThAnchau bhane?

merA rabale malAI timrAe bagaiMcAbhandA pani uttama pradAna garne ra timro bagaiMcAmAthi AkAzabATa prakopa paThAunechan (jasale gardA) tyo bA~jho bhUmimA pariNata hunecha bhanne sakbhAvanA dherai cha |
vA tyasako pAnI bhUmimA yati bhitra jAnecha ki tyasako khojI garna timrolAgi asambhava hunecha |”

ani, (tyastai bhayo) usakA sampUrNa phala naSTa bhae | usale Aphno bagaiMcAko chAno ghopTyAieko dekhera Aphno lAgatamAthi pazcAtApa garna thAlyo ra bhanyo– “maile AphnA rabako sAjhedAra nabanAeko bhae!”
ani, allAhaviruddha usalAI sahayoga garne kunai pani jamAta bhaena ra na usale badalA nai lina sakyo |
yasarI sampUrNa adhikAra allAhakai hAtamA cha; unakai pratidAna uttama tathA unakai pariNAma rAmro cha (bhanne kurA siddha bhayo) |

ani, he sandeSTA! ra yinIharUkolAgi sAMsArika jIvanako udAharaNa yasto cha jasarI hAmIle AkAzabATa pAnI barsAyauM ra dhartIkA banaspatiharU bAklA bhaI umre, ani (pAkera) antataH bhusa banna puge, jasalAI hAvAle uDAu~cha | ra pratyeka kAryamAthi allAhakai prabhutva rahekocha |
dhanasampatti evaM santAnaharU kevala sAMsArika jIvanakA zobhA hun | ani, sthAyI satkarmaharU pratidAnakAe dRSTi tathA AzAkAe dRSTile pani uttama chan |

tyasa dinako kalpanA gara juna dina hAmI pahADaharUlAI hiMDAunechauM ra timIle dhartIlAI nAGgo caura dekhnechau ani tinIharUlAI gherera yasarI ekatrita garnechauM ki tinIharUmadhye kohI pani chuTne chaina |

ra, tinIharU sabai timrA rabasamakSa paMktibaddha peza garinechan (ra bhaninechan) “timIharU hAmIsamakSa tyasarI nai AekA chau jasarI hAmIle timIharUlAI pahilo paTaka sRSTi garekA thiyauM | barU timIharUle ThAnekA thiyau ki hAmIle timIharUkAlAgi vAcAko samaya nizcita garne nai chainauM |”

ra, karmapatra (tinIharUsamakSa) rAkhinecha | tyasa samaya timI dekhnechau, aparAdhIharU tyasamA aGkita kurAharUprati DarAirahekA hunechan ra bhannechan– “hAya hAmro durbhAgya! kasto acammako karmapatra!” yasale ta hAmrA sAnA–ThUlA kunai pani kAryalAI nalekhI choDekai chaina | ra, jejati tinIharUle garekA hunechan, tI sabai (tyasamA) raheko pAunechan | ra, timro rabale kasaimAthi atyAcAra garne chainan |

ra, smaraNa gara tyasa avasaralAI jaba hAmIle phariztAharUlAI bhanyauM– “AdamasAmu sajdA gara |” taba iblIsabAheka sabaile sajdA gare | U jinnaharUmadhye thiyo | ani usale AphnA rabako Adezako avajJA garyo | ke timIharU mabAheka usalAI ra usakA santAnalAI saMrakSakamitra banAu~chau jabaki tinIharU timIharUkA zatru hun | yastA atyAcArIharUkAlAgi katti nikRSTa badalA rahekocha!
ra, maile tinIharUlAI na AkAzaharU tathA dhartIko sRSTimA sAkSI banAeko thie~, na svayaM tinIharUko sRSTimA nai | ra, ma pathabhraSTa pArneharUlAI sahAyaka banAudina |

ra, smaraNa gara juna dina allAhale bhannechan– “bolAU merA tI sAjhedAraharUlAI jasalAI timIharUle sAjhedAra ThAnekA thiyau |” ani tinIharUle bolAunechan tara sAjhedAraharUle tinIharUlAI kunai javApha dine chainan | ra, tinIharUko bIcamA hAmI euTA vinAzako khADala banAidinechauM |
ra, aparAdhIharU narakalAI dekhne bittikai bujhnechan ki tinIharU tyasaimA homine hun | tara tinIharUle tyasabATa (bacna) kunai zaraNa pAune chainan |
ra, hAmIle yasa kuraAnamA manuSyakolAgi vibhinna prakArakA udAharaNaharU bayAna garekA chauM | tara manuSya ati nai jhagaDAlu raheko cha |

tinIharUsamakSa mArgadarzana pugepachi tinIharUlAI ImAna lyAuna ra AphnA rabasita kSamAyAcanA garnabATa yasa kurAle mAtra rokyo ki vigatakA samUdAyaharUkA sAtha bhaeko kArya praNAlI unIharUsamakSa Aipugos vA tinIharUsamakSa yAtanA Aipugos |

ra, rasUlaharUlAI hAmIle kevala zubha–sandezavAhaka tathA sacetaka banAera paThAune garchauM | ra, kAphiraharU mithyA (tarka) dvArA jhagaDA garchan tAki satyalAI parAjita garUn | ani, tinIharUle merA nizAnIharU ra juna kurAbATa tinIharUlAI Dara dekhAinthyo tyasalAI sameta upahAsako rUpamA liekA chan |

ani tyasa vyaktibhandA ThUlo atyAcArI ko huna sakcha jasalAI usakA rabakA AyataharU (sunAera) upadeza diepachi U vimukha bhayo ra usako Aphnai hAtale agADi paThAekA kriyAkalApalAI birsiyAe? hAmIle yastA vyaktiharUko hRdaya pardAle DhAkidiekA chauM, tAki tinIharUle bujhna nasakUn ra tinIharukA kAnamA bujo (TheDI) hAlekA chauM (tAki sunna nasakUn) | tyasaile tinIharUlAI timIle jatisukai mArgadarzanatarpha bolAe pani tinIharUle kahilyai pani mArgadarzana pAuna sakdainan |

timrA ‘raba’ ati kSamAzIla evaM dayAvAna chan | yadi unale tinIharUkA kukarmaharUkA kAraNale tinIharUlAI samAtna cAheko bhae turunta nai prakopa paThAune thie | tara tinIharUkAlAgi vAcAko euTA samaya nirdhArita cha jasabATa bacera niskana kunai Azrayasthala pAune chainan |
yI hun (prakopagrasta) nagaraharU! jaba tinIharUle atyAcAra gare taba hAmIle yI sabailAI naSTa garidiyauM | ra, tinIharUko vinAzako pani hAmIle euTA nizcita samaya nirdhArita garekA thiyauM |
ra, smaraNa gara jaba mUsAle Aphno sevakalAI bhane– “ma tI duvai nadIharUko saMgamasthalasamma napuguJjela hiMDirahanechu cAhe lAmAe samayasamma hiMDnu paros |”
jaba duvai nadIko saMgamasthalamA puge, tyahA~ Aphno mAchA birse jasale (mRta mAchAle) samudramA suruGga jhaiM Aphno bATo banAyo |
jaba tinIharU duvai agADi baDhe mUsAle Aphno sevakalAI bhane– “aba hAmro khAjA lyAU | yasa yAtrAle gardA hAmIlAI ati thakAi lAgisakeko cha |”

sevakale javApha diyo– “ la, hernus, jaba hAmI caTTAnamA ArAma garirahekA thiyauM, taba malAI mAchAko dhyAna rahena ra zaitAnale nai malAI tyasabAre tapAIMlAI batAuna birsiyAyAe | ra, mAchAle samudramA acamma tarikAle bATo banAyo |”
mUsAle bhane– “yahI ta hAmI cAhanthyauM |” ataH unIharU duvai AphnA padacinha pahilyAudai pharke |
ani, tI duvaile hAmrA bhaktaharUmadhye eka bhakta (khijra)lAI bheTTAe, jasalAI hAmIle Aphno vizeSa dayA pradAna garekA thiyauM ra Aphno tarphabATa vizeSa jJAna sikAekA thiyauM |
mUsAle unIsita anurodha gare– “ke ma tapAIMsa~ga rahana sakchu tAki tapAIM malAI pani tyasa jJAnabATa zikSA dinuhos juna tapAIMlAI sikAieko cha?”
unale bhane, “timI masa~ga kadApi dhairya garna sakdainau...
ra juna kurA timro jJAnako simAbhandA bAhira cha tyasamA timI dhairya kasarI garna sakchau ra?”
mUsAle bhane– “yadi allAhale cAhe bhane tapAIMle malAI saMyamI pAunuhunecha|, ra ma tapAIMko kunai pani Adezako ullaGghana garne chaina |”
una (khijra) le bhane– “yadi timI masa~ga basna nai cAhanchau bhane jabasamma ma svayaM kunaicijabAre timIlAI batAudina tabasamma tyAe kurA malAi nasodhnU |”

ani tI duvai hiMDe | jaba duvaijanA euTA DuGgAmA savAra bhae taba unale tyasamA pvAla pAre | mUsAle sodhe– “ke tapAIMle yasamA savAra vyaktiharUlAI DubAunako lAgi pvAla pArnu bhaeko ho? tapAIMle anucita kArya po garnu bhayo ta!”
una (khijra) le bhane– “ke maile bhaneko thiina~ ki timI masa~ga dhairyadhAraNa garna sakdainau?”
mUsAle bhane– “mero bhUlamA malAI nasamAtnuhos ra merAe mAmilA prati kaThAera nirNaya nagarnuhos |”

pheri duvai hiMDe | jA~dAjA~dai euTA keTosa~ga tinIharUko bheTa bhayo una (khijra) le usako vadha garidie | mUsAle bhane– “ke tapAIMbATa eka nirdoSalAI binA kunai pratihatyA vadha bhayo? nizcaya nai tapAIMle narAmrAe kArya garnubhayo |”
una (khijra) le bhane– “ke maile timIlAI bhaneko thiina~ ki timI masa~ga kadApi dhairyadhAraNa garna sakdainau?”
mUsAle bhane– “yadi yasapachi pani maile tapAIMlAI kehI sodheM bhane avazya nai tapAIMle malAI Aphno sAthamA narAkhnuholA | nizcaya nai merotarphabATa tapAIM doSamukta bhaisaknubhayo |

pheri duvaijanA hiMDe | hiMDdA hiMDdai unIharU yasto nagaramA puge jasakA bAsindAlAI tinIharUle bhojana garAuna anurodha gare | tara tinIharUle unIharUlAI atithi satkAra garna asvIkAra gare | tyattikaimA unIharUle Dhalna lAgeko euTA parkhAla dekhe, ani una (khijra)le tyasalAI sAejhAe pAridie | mUsAle bhane– “yadi tapAIMle cAhemA yasako pArizramika lina saknuhunthyo!”
una (khijra) le bhane– “la, aba ma ra timIebIca bichoDa huncha | aba ma timIlAI tI kurAharUko satyatA batAunechu jasamA timIle dhairya garna sakenau |”

jahA~samma DuGgAko mAmilA cha tyo kehI nirdhana vyaktiharUko thiyo juna (yasai) samudramA kAma garne garthe | ani maile tyasalAI truTipUrNa banAune icchA kina gareM bhane unIharUbATa TADhA rahekA eka rAjAle sabai (rAmrA) DuGgA balapUrvaka haDapne garthe |
ra, jahA~samma tyo keTAko sambandha cha tyasakA mAtApitA AsthAvAna thie | ani hAmIlAI AzaGkA bhayo ki tyasale ThUlo bhaera avajJA evaM kRtaghnatA garera tI duvaimAthi atyAcAra garlA |
tasartha hAmIle ke cAhyauM bhane tI duvailAI unakA pAlanakartAle yasto santAna pradAna garUn jo suzIla svabhAva tathA dayAbhAvasita nikaTatam hos |

ra, jahA~samma tyo parkhAlako kurA cha; tyo nagarakA duITA anAtha keTAharUko thiyo ra tyasamuni tinIharUko euTA khajAnA (gADieko) thiyo ra, tinIharUkA pitA satkarmI thie | ataH timrA rabako ke cAhanA bhayo bhane yI duvai yuvAvasthAmA pugera timrA rabako kRpAle AphnA khajAnA nikAlUn | ra, yI (sabai) kArya maile Aphno icchAdhikArale gareko hoina | yI hun tI kAryaharUkAe byAkhyAharU jasamA timIle dhairyadhAraNa garna sakenau!
(he sandeSTA) yinIharU timIsita julkarnainako sambandhamA prazna garchan | bhanideU– “ma timIharUlAI unako kehI vRttAnta paDhera sunAu~daichu |”
hAmIle unalAI dhartImA sattA tathA zakti pradAna garekA thiyauM ra unalAI hareka prakArakA sAdhanaharU pradAna garekA thiyauM |
unale bhramaNa zuru gare |

yahA~samma ki jaba unI (samudra kinArasamma) sUryAsta hune sthAnamA puge unale tyasalAI kAlo samudramA Dubdai gareko pAe | ra, unale samudranajika euTA samudAya dekhe | hAmIle bhanyauM– “he julkarnaina! timI yinIharUlAI yA ta yAtanA deU yA tinIharUsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra gara |”
unale bhane– “tinIharUmadhye jasale atyAcAra garnecha usalAI hAmI sajAya~ dinechauM | pheri usalAI AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha pharkAine belAmA unale pani jhan kaDA yAtanA dinechan |
ani, ImAna lyAune ra satkarma garne vyaktikAlAgi rAmro pratidAna cha | ra, hAmI pani unalAI sahajakArya nai ahrAunechauM |
tyasapachi unale (agADiko) bhramaNa zuru gare |
yahA~samma ki sUryodaya hune sthAnasamma puge jahA~ unale sUryalAI yastA mAnisaharUmAthi jhulka~dai gareko pAe jasakAlAgi hAmIle ghAmabATa bacna kunai pardA banAekA thienauM |
yo thiyo unako (vAstavika) sthiti | ra, unakA sthitiharUbAre hAmI rAmrarI avagata chAai~ |
tyasapachi unale arko bhramaNa zuru gare|
yahA~samma ki unale duIvaTA pahADaharuko najikai euTA yasto samudAya bheTTAe jo muskilale kunai kurA bujhna sakthe |

tinIharUle bhane– “he julkarnaina! yAjUja ra mAjUjale yasa bhUbhAgamA vidhvaMsa maccAune garchan | ataH hAmI ra tinIharUbIca euTA parkhAla khaDA garna ke hAmI tapAIMko nimti koSako bandovasta garauM ta?”

julkarnainale bhane– “yasa sambandhamA merA pAlanakartAle malAI pradAna gareko sAmarthya uttama cha | tasartha, timIharU (zrama) zaktile mero sahayoga gara | ma timIharU ra tinIharUbIca majabuta parkhAla banAidinechu |

malAI phalAmakA (ThUlA–ThUlA) phalyAkaharu deU | (unale kAma zuru gare) yahA~samma ki jaba unale dubai pahADako bIcamA (phalyAkaharudvArA rikta sthAna) barAbara pAridie taba unale Adeza die–“Ago dankAU; yahA~samma ki jaba unale tyasalAI tatAera Ago banAI die taba unale bhane”–“malAI paglieko tAmA deU tAki tyasamAthi khanyAU~” |
(tyo parkhAla yati baliyo banyo ki) yAjUja ra mAjUja na tyasamAthi caDhera Auna sakthe ra na tyasamA pvAla pArera nai pasna sakthe |
unale bhane– “yo mero rabako kRpA ho | taipani jaba merA rabako vAcA (mahApralaya) Aunecha taba unale yasalAI bhatkAera samatala pArnecha | nizcaya nai merA rabako vAcA satya cha |
ra, tyasa dina hAmI tinIharUlAI ApasamA judhna choDnechauM | ra, ‘sUra’(narasiMgha) phukinecha ani hAmI sabailAI ekatrita garnechauM |
ra, narakalAI kAphiraharUsamakSa lyAunechauM |
(tI kAphiraharUsamakSa) jo merA upadezaharUprati andho banekA thie ra kehI pani sunna tayAra thienan |
ke tI kAphiraharUle malAI choDI merA bhaktaharUlAI kAryasAdhaka banAunechan bhanne ThAnekA chan? nizcaya nai hAmIle tI kAphiraharUkAlAgi AtithyasvarUpa naraka tayAra pArekA chauM |
he sandeSTA! bhanideU– “ke hAmI timIharUlAI batAidiauM ki AphnA karmaharUko hisAbale sababhandA ghATAmA ko cha?”
tI vyaktiharU hun jasakA sampUrNa prayAsaharU yasa sAMsArika jIvanamA sIdhAmArgabATa alaga rahe ra tinIharU AphUle uttama kArya garirahekA chauM bhanne ThAnirahe |

yI tinai vyaktiharU hun jasale AphnA rabakA nizAnIharU tathA unIsamakSa sAkSAt huna inkAra gare | ataH tinIharUkA karmaharU bekAra bhae, ataH mahApralayako dina hAmI tI karmaharUlAI kunai vajana dine chainauM |
yahI naraka ho tinIharUko sajAya~, kinabhane tinIharUle kuphra garekA thie ra merA AyataharU tathA rasUlaharUko upahAsa garekA thie |
nissandeha juna vyaktiharUle ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare unIharUko AtithyakAlAgi phirdausakA bagaiMcAharU hunechan |
tyahA~ sadA rahanechan ra tyahA~bATa niskera jAne cAhanAsameta garnechainan |

he sandeSTA! bhanideU– “yadi merA rabakA vANIharU lekhna samudra nai masI bane pani merA rabakA vANIharU sakinubhandA aghi nai tyo samApta hunecha | yadyapi hAmI tyasako sahayogakAlAgi arU tyatinai samundra kina nalyAu~ |

bhanideU “ma timIharUjastai eka manuSya mAtra hu~ | matarpha prakAzanA Au~cha ki timIharU sabaikA pUjya eka mAtra chan | ataH jokohI AphnA rabasita bheTako AzA rAkhdacha usale satkarma garnuparcha, ra AphnA rabako upAsanAmA kasailAI sAjhedAra banAunu hu~daina |
kApha0 hA0 yA0 aina0 sAda0 |
yo timro rabale AphnA bhakta jakariyAmAthi gareko kRpAko bayAna ho |
jaba unale AphnA rabasita gupta svaramA prArthanA garekA thie;
“he merA raba! bRddhAvasthAle gardA merA hADaharU kamajora bhaisakekA chan ra kapAla setai phulisakeko cha | ra, he prabhu! timIsita prArthanA garera ma kahilyai asaphala bhaeko chaina |”
ani, ma svayaM AphUpachi AphnA bhAibandhuharUsita DarAu~chu tathA merI patnI bA~jhI chin | ataH Aphno vizeSa kRpAle malAI eka uttarAdhikArI pradAna gara...
jo mero pani uttarAdhikArI banos ra yaakUbakA vaMzako pani | ra, he merA pAlanakartA! usalAI (sabaiko) priya banAU |
he jakariyA! hAmI timIlAI euTA putrako zubha sUcanA dinchauM jasako nAma yahyA hunecha | hAmIle yasabhandA pahile yo nAma bhaeko kunai vyakti sRSTi garekA chainauM |
unale bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA malAI kasarI putra huna sakcha ra jabaki merI patnI bA~jhI chin ra ma ati vRddhAvasthAmA pugisakeko chu?
Adeza bhayoe– “tyastai hunecha |” timrA rabale bhanekAchan– “yo ta merolAgi sarala kArya ho, kinabhane maile yasaaghi svayaM timIlAI sRSTi garisakeko chu jabaki timro astitva pani thiena|”

una (jakariyA) le bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA! merolAgi kunai nizAnI nirdhArita gara |” allAhale bhane–“timrolAgi nizAnI yo raheko cha ki timI svastha hu~dA pani lagAtAra tIna rAtadinasamma mAnisaharUsita kurA garna sakne chainau |”
tyasapachi unI bhaktikoThAbATa niskera AphnA jAtibandhuharUsamakSa Ae ra unIharUlAI saGketadvArA bhane– “timI bihAna belukA Aphno rabako stuti garne gara |”
“he yahyA! (mero) granthalAI dRDhatAsAtha samAta” | ra hAmIle unalAI bAlyakAlamai nirNayazakti pradAna garekA thiyauM...
ra, Aphno tarphabATa komala hRdaya tathA pavitratA pani pradAna garekA thiyauM | tasartha unI Izabhaya rAkhne vyakti thie |,
ra, unI AphnA mAtApitAkA AjJAkArI vyakti thie, nirdayI tathA avajJAkArI thienan |
unakAlAgi zAnti rahekocha, juna dina unI janmie, juna dina unI marnechan ra juna dina unalAI jIvita tulyAI uThAinecha |
ra, granthamA ullekhita marayamako vRttAntako pani carcA gara jaba unI AphnA gharakA mAnisaharUbATa alaga bhaera pUrvatarpha gain |
ani, tinIharUsita pardA garin | ra, hAmIle unIsamakSa Aphno rUha (jibraIla phariztA) lAI paThAyauM ani maryamasamakSa pUrNa mAnavako rUpamA prakaTa bhae |
unale bhanin– yadi timI Izabhaya rAkhne vyakti hau bhane ma timIbATa atyanta karuNAmaya (allAha) ko zaraNa mAgdachu |
unale bhane– “ma ta kevala timro pAlanakartAko phariztA hu~ | timIlAI euTA pavitra chorA pradAna garna Aeko hu~|”
marayamale bhanin– “maile choro kasarI pAuna sakchu ra jabaki malAI na kunai puruSale choeko cha na ma vyabhicArI nai hu~ |”

unale uttara die– “yastai hunecha |” timrA pAlanakartAle bhanekA chan– “merolAgi yo kAma sajilo cha | ra, (hAmI yasakAraNale yaso garnechauM ki) usalAI hAmI mAnisaharUkAlAgi nizAnI tathA Aphno tarphabATa dayA banAauM | yo euTA pUrvanirdhArita phaisalA ho |
ani unI garbhavatI bhain ra tyasai avasthAmA unI euTA TADhAko sthAnamA gain |
ani prasavapIDAle unalAI khajUrako rUkhatarpha DoryAyo | bhanna thAlin– “hAya! yasaaghi nai marera ma vismRta bhaekI bhae (hunthyo)!
tyatikhera khajUrako talatirabATa phariztAle unalAI pukArera bhane– “timI duHkhita nahoU kinabhane timrA rabale timro tala euTA mUla phuTAidiekA chan |”
ra, khajUrako rukhalAI AphUtira hallAU timImAthi pAkekA rasilA khajUraharU khasnechan |
ani khAU, piU tathA A~khAlAI zItala pAra yadi kunai puruSa dekhiemA (izArAle) bhana– “maile karuNAmaya allAhakAlAgi brata basekI chu | tasartha Aja ma kunai mAnisasita bolne chaina |”
pheri unI tyasa baccAlAI bokera Aphno samudAyamA Ain | tinIharUle bhane– “he marayama! timIle ta nikRSTa kArya garekI chau!
he hArunakI bahinI! na timrA buvA kharAba vyakti thie ra na timrI AmA nai vyabhicArI thiin |
taba unale Aphno chorAtira saGketa garin | tinIharUle bhane– “kAkhamA raheko baccAsa~ga hAmI kasarI kurA garna sakchauM ta?”
baccAle bhanyo– “ma nizcaya nai allAhako bhakta hu~ | unale malAI grantha pradAna garekA chan ra sandeSTA banAekA chan |”
ra, ma jahA~sukai rahe pani unale malAI maGgalamaya banAekA chan | ra, jIvita rahuJjela malAI namAja ra jakAtakAe aAdeza diekA chan |
ra, malAI AmAko AjJAkArI banAekA chan ani malAI nirdayI tathA avajJAkArI banAekA chainan |
ra, zAnti nai zAnti cha mamAthi juna dina ma janmeM, juna dina ma marnechu ra juna dina malAI pheri jIvita pArera uThAinecha |
yahI maryama–putra IsAko satya kathA ho jasamA mAnisaharU zaMkA garirahekA chan |
allAhale Aphno nimti kadApi putra grahaNa garne chainan | unI ta ucca tathA pavitra chan | jaba unI kunai kAryako nirNaya garchan, unale tyasalAI bhanchan– “bhai hAla!” ani bhaihAlcha |
ani, (IsAle bhanekA thie) nissandeha allAha nai merA pAlanakartA hun ra timIharUko pani, tasartha unaiko bhakti gara | yahI sIdhA mArga ho |
tara (granthavAhakakA) vibhinna sasamUhaharUle paraspara matabheda gare | ataH kAphiraharUkolAgi tyo binAzakArI dina hunecha jaba usale tyo baDA dina (kayAmata) lAI dekhnecha |
juna dina hAmIsamakSa upasthita hunechan tyo dina tinIharU pUrNarUpale sunne ra dekhne hunechan! tara Aja bhane yI atyAcArIharU spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA grasta chan |
tinIharUlAI tyasa santApapUrNa dinabATa saceta garAU jaba mAmilAko nirNaya garinecha, yasa avasthatAmA ki tinIharU aceta hunechan tathA anAsthA garirahekA hunechan |
antataH dhartI tathA dhartIbAsIharUkA uttarAdhikArI hAmI nai hunechauM ra sabai hAmItarpha nai pharkAinechan |
ra, yasa granthamA ibrAhImako vRtAnta bayAna gara | nissandeha unI satyaniSTha sandeSTA thie |
jaba unale AphnA pitAlAI bhane– “he pitAjyU! tapAIM yastA vastuharUko pUjA kina garnuhuncha juna na ta sunne ra na dekhne zakti nai rAkhdachan ra na tapAIMlAI kunai phAidA nai puryAuna sakchan |”
merA priya pitA! malAI tyo jJAna prApta bhaeko cha juna tapAIMlAI prApta bhaeko chaina | ataH tapAIM merai kurA mAnnuhos, ma bilakula sIdhAmArga dekhAudaichu |
pitAjyU! zaitAnako bhakti nagarnuhos | vAstavamA zaitAna karuNAmaya (allAha) ko avajJAkArI ho |
pitA jyU! katai karuNAmaya (allAha) ko prakopale tapAIMlAI gherlA ki ra phalasvarUpa tapAIM zaitAnako mitra banna pugnuhuncha ki bhanera malAI Dara lAgirahancha |

pitAle bhane– “he ibrAhIma! ke ta~ merA IzvaraharUbATa vimukha huna gairahekochas? yadi ta~ yasAe garnabATa rUkdainas bhane ma ta~lAI DhuGgai–DhuGgAle hirkAera sidhyAidinchu | ta~ sadAkA lAgi mabATa alaga bas |”
ibrAhImale bhane– “tapAIMmAthi zAnti hos! ma ta tapAIMkolAgi AphnA pAlanakartAsita kSamAyAcanA garnechu | unI maprati ati kRpAlu chan |

ma ta tapAIMlAI ra tapAIMle allAhalAI choDI pukArne garekA upAsyaharUlAI pani choDdaichu ani kevala AphnA pAlanakartAlAI pukArne garchu | vizvAsa cha ki ma AphnA pAlanakartAlAI pukArera abhAgI hune chaina |”

ataH jaba ibrAhImale AphnA jAtikA mAnisaharU ra tinIharUle allAhabAheka pUjdai garekA (mithyA Izvara) harUlAI choDidie taba hAmIle unalAI ishAka tathA yaakUba pradAna garyauM ra pratyekalAI sandeSTA banAyauM |
ani, hAmIle unIharUlAI Aphno dayA pradAna garyauM ra unIharUko prasiddhilAI mahAna banAyauM |
ani, granthamA (IzadUta) mUsAko bRtAnta bayAna gara | nissandeha unI chAniekA (vyaktitva), ra rasUla tathA nabI thie |
ani, hAmIle unalAI tUra (nAmaka pahADa) ko dAhine tarphabATa bolAyauM ra rahasyakA kurAkAnIkolAgi unalAI najika garyauM |
ra, hAmIle Aphno vizeSa kRpAle unakA bhAi hArUnalAI sandeSTA banAera (sahAyakako rUpamA) pradAna garyauM |
ra, yasa granthamA ismAIlako pani carcA gara | unI Aphno vacanakA pakkA thie sAthai rasUla tathA nabI pani thie |
ra, unI Aphno parivAralAI namAja tathA jakAtako Adeza dine garthe ra AphnA pAlanakartAko dRSTimA ati priyapAtra thie |
ra, yasa granthamA idrIsako pani carcA gara | nizcaya nai unI satyavAdI manuSya ra nabI thie |
ra, hAmIle unalAI ucca sthAna pradAna garekA thiyauM |

yI nabIharU hun, jo allAhakA kRpApAtra bhae; jo AdamakA santAnamadhyekA thie ra tI vyaktiharUkA santAnamadhye thie jasalAI hAmIle nUhakAsAtha DuGgAmA savAra garAekA thiyauM ani ibrAhIma tathA isrAIlakA santAnamadhye pani | ani unIharU yastA vyaktiharUmadhye thie jasalAI hAmIle sIdhA mArga dekhAekA thiyauM, ra AphnA lAgi cayana garekA thiyauM | yinIharUsamakSa jaba karuNAmaya (allAha) kA AyataharU pATha garinthyo taba sajdA garna thAlthe ra runa thAlthe |
ani unIharUpachi yastA nikammA uttarAdhikArIharU Ae jasale namAjasameta choDidie ra kuabhilASAharUkApachi lAge | yastA vyaktiharUle cA~Dai nai Aphno pathabhraSTatAko pariNAma bhognechan|
tI vyaktiharUbAheka jasale prAyazcita gare; AsthA kAyama gare ra satkarma gare | unIharUle nai svargamA praveza pAunechan | ra, unIharUmAthi katti pani atyAcAra garine chaina |
sadA rahane bagaiMcAharUmA praveza pAunechan jasako parokSataH vAcA karuNAmaya allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUsita garekA chan | unako vAcA nizcitarUpamA pUrA hunecha |
yinIharUle tyahA~ zAnti (salAma) hos bhanne bAheka kunai vyartha kurA sunne chainan, ra tyahA~ yinIharUlAI bihAna belukA (sadhaiM) jivikA prApta hunecha |
yo tyo svarga ho jasako uttarAdhikArI hAmI AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye Izabhaya rAkhne vyaktiharUlAI banAunechauM |

(phariztAle bhane) he sandeSTA! hAmI tapAIMkA pAlanakartAko anumati binA avatIrNa hunai sakdainauM | hAmro agADi–pachADi ra tI duvai bIcakA sampUrNa vastuharU unakai adhinamA chan ani timrA rabale birsane chainan |
AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaikA bIcamA rahekA sampUrNa cijaharUkA raba unai hun | ataH unakai upAsanA gara ra unakai upAsanAmA aDiga rahu | ke timro jAnakArImA unako kohI samakakSI cha?
ra, (avajJAkArI) mAnche bhancha– “ke ma marepachi malAI jIvita pArI uThAinecha ra?”
ke mAnchelAI yati pani yAda chaina ki usalAI hAmIle yasaaghi yastai avasthAmA paidA garyauM jaba U kehI thiena |
ataH timrA rabako kasama! hAmI tinIharUlAI ra zaitAnaharUlAI avazya nai ekikRta garnechauM, ra tinIharUlAI ghu~DA TekAera narakako varipari puryAunechauM |
pheri hAmI pratyeka samUhabATa karuNAmaya (allAha) kA kaTTara virodhI vyaktiharUlAI chA~Tera alaga garnechauM |
ani tyasamA homina lAyaka vyakti ko ko hun bhanI hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM |
ra, (tinIharUlAI Adeza dinechauM) timIharUmadhye pratyekale tyasalAI pAra garnuparcha | yo timrA rabako aTala nirNaya ho |
ani hAmI Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI ta bacAunechauM tara atyAcArIharUlAI cAhi~ ghu~DA Tekekai avasthAmA tyasaimA choDidinechauM |

ra, jaba tinIharUlAI hAmrA spaSTa AyataharU paDhera sunAincha taba kAphiraharU AsthAvAnaharUsita prazna garchan– “hAmro ra timro jamAtaharUmadhye kuna jamAta darjAmA ucca cha ra kasako sabhA zobhanIya raheko cha?”
ra, hAmIle tinIharUbhandA pahile kaiyauM samudAyaharUko binAsa garisakekA chauM, jo yinIharUbhandA baDhI sampanna tathA khyAti prApta thie |

bhanideU– “juna vyakti pathabhraSTatAmA lipta cha atyanta karuNAmaya (allAha) usalAI kehI avasara dine garchan | antataH jaba tinIharUle vAcA garieko kurA cAhe tyo prakopa hos vA mahApralaya dekhnechan, taba tinIharUlAI thAhA hunecha ki sthAnakAe hisAbale nikRSTa ra samUhako hisAbale kamajora ko rahecha |
ani, yo mArgadarzana apanAune vyaktiharUlAI allAha jhan mArgadarzana garchan | ra, bA~kI rahane puNyakarmaharU timrA pAlanakartAko dRSTimA pratiphala tathA pariNAmako dRSTile uttama rahekA chan |”
ke timIle tyasa vyaktilAI dekhyau jasale hAmrA nizAnIlAI asvIkAra garyo, ani dAvI garyo ra bhanyo– “malAI mahApralayako dina pani avazya nai sampatti tathA santAna pradAna garinecha |”
ke tyasale parokSako jJAna prApta gareko cha vA karuNAmaya (allAha) sita kunai vacana lieko cha?
kadApi chaina | yasale jejati bhandaicha, hAmI tyasalAI avazya nai lekhnechauM ra usako yAtanAmA jhanai vRddhi garnechauM |
ra juna cIja (dhanasampatI, santAna ra zakti) ko U kurA garcha tyasako svAmitva hAmImAnai rahanecha ra U hAmIsamakSa eklai Aunecha |
ra, tinIharUle allAhabAheka anyalAI pUjya banAekA chan tAki tinIharU tinakA sahayogI banUn |
kadApi yasto hune chaina | cA~Dai nai tinIharUle yI avajJAkArIharUko bhaktilAI inkAra garnechan, ra tinIharUko virAedhI bannechan |
ke timIle dekhenau ki hAmIle zaitAnalAI kAphiraharUmAthi chADidiekA chauM jasale tinIharUlAI khubai uksAune garchan |
ataH timI tinIharUkobAremA hatAra nagara | hAmI tinIharUkA lAgi (dina) ganirahekA chauM |
juna dina hAmI Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI karuNAmaya (allAha) samakSa samUha–samUhamA peza garnechauM |
ra, aparAdhIharUlAI hAmI tirkhAeko avasthAmA narakakAeghATatarpha hA~kera laijAnechauM |
tyo dina kasaile pani siphAriza garna sakdaina, tyasa vyaktibAheka jasalAI karuNAmaya (allAha) ko vacana prApta hunecha |
ra, tinIharUle bhane– karuNAmaya (allAha) le euTA putra grahaNa garekA chan |
nissandeha timIharUle euTA yasto ati nikRSTa ra bhayAnaka kurA lyAekA chau |
jasale gardA najikai cha ki AkAzaharU bisphoTa hAeun ani dhartI phATUn ra pahADaharU TukrA–TukrA bhaI Dhalun|
kinabhane tinIharUle karuNAmaya (allAha) kA eka putra chan bhanne dAbI garekA chan |
kasailAI putrakA rUpamA grahaNa garnu karuNAmaya (allAha) ko pratiSThAko pratikUla cha |
AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa prANIharU karuNAmaya (allAha) samakSa dAsako rUpamA hAjira hunechan |
unale sabailAI gherekA chan, ra sabaiko pUrNa gaNanA pani garisakekA chan |
ra, mahApralayako dina tinIharUmadhye pratyeka eklA eklai garI allAhasamakSa upasthita hunechan |
nissandeha jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare, cA~Dai nai karuNAmaya (allAha) le unIharUkAlAgi prema utpanna garnechan |
he sandeSTA ho! hAmIle yasa kuraAnalAI timro bhASAmA ati sarala tulyAekA chauM, tAki timI yasako mAdhyamabATa Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI zubhasUcanA deU ra jhagaDAlu vyaktiharUlAI saceta garAU |
hAmIle yinIharUbhandA pahilekA katipaya samudAyaharUko binAza garekA chauM | ke timI tinIharUmadhye kasaiko padacApako anubhUti gardachau vA tinIharUko sUkSma AvAja sunchau ta?
tA0 hA0
hAmIle timImAthi yo kuraAna yasa kAraNale avatarita garekA hoinauM ki timI dukhita hoU |
barU yo ta upadeza ho, bhaya rAkhne vyaktikolAgi |
yo unaibATa avatarita garieko ho jasale pRthvI ra AkAzaharUko sirjanA gare |
unai ati karuNAmaya hun jo rAjasiMhAsanamA birAjamAna chan |
unakailAgi hun tI sabai juna AkAzaharU, pRthvI, tI duvaibIca ra juna mATomuni chan |
yadyapi timI Aphno kurA ucca svaramA bhana, (yA sUkSma svaramA), unI ta lukekA kurAharu ra atyanta gopya kurA pani jAndachan |
unai allAha hun jasabAheka kohI pUjya chaina; unakailAgi ati uttama nAmaharU rahekAchan |
ra, ke timI samakSa (sandeSTA) mUsAko kathA pugekAe cha?
jaba unale Ago dekhe taba Aphno parivAralAI bhane– “eka china parkha | maile Ago dekheM, zAyada tyasabATa ma timIharUkAlAgi kehI agulTA lyAU~, vA Agonajika gaI bATo thAhA pAuna saku~ |
jaba unI tyahA~ Aipuge taba AvAja Ayo– “he mUsA!
ma nai timro pAlanakartA hu~ | timI AphnA duvai juttA phukAla (kinabhane) timI tuvA (nAmaka) pavitra upatyakAmA chau|
ra maile timIlAI rojeko chu | ataH juna prakAzanA (vahya) garincha tyo dhyAnapUrvaka suna |
nissandeha ma nai allAha hu~ | mabAheka anya kohI pUjya chaina | ataH merai upAsanA gara, ra malAI smaraNa garna namAja kAyama gara |
nissandeha mahApralaya Aune nai cha | ma tyasalAI gopya rAkhna cAhanchu tAki pratyeka vyaktile Aphno karma anusAra pratidAna pAos |
ani aba timIlAI yasabATa kunai pani AsthA narAkhne tathA Aphno kubhAvanAko pachADi lAgne vyaktile narokos | natra timI nAza hunechau |
ra, he mUsA! yo timro dAhine hAtamA ke cha?
unale bhane– “yo mero lauro ho jasamA ma aDesa lAgchu; AphnA bAkhrIharUkA lAgi rukhabATa pAta jhArchu ra yasabAheka anya kAma pani line garchu |
(allAhale) Adeza die– “he mUsA! tyasalAI bhuIMmA rAkhideU |”
ani unale tyasalAI bhuIMmA rAkhe; anAyAsa tyo sarpa banera sphUrtipUrvaka ghisrina thAlyo |
allAhale bhane– “tyasalAI samAta ra naDarAU | hAmI ahile nai tyasalAI tyasako pahilekai avasthAmA pharkAunechauM |
ra, timI Aphno hAtalAI Aphno kAkhImunI cyApa | tyo kunai truTi binA camkilo bhaera niskanecha | yo dosro camatkAra ho|
yastAe hAmIle timIlAI AphnA ThUlA nizAnIharU dekhAunakAe lAgi garyAaiM |
timI phiraaunakahA~ jAU kinabhane U vidrohI bhaeko cha |
unale prArthanA gare– “he merA raba! mero chAti kholideU|
ra merAlAgi merA kArya sugama pArideU|
ra mero jibrAko gA~Tho kholideU|
tAki tinIharUle mero kurA bujhna sakUn|
ra mero khAnadAnabATa ekajanAlAi mero sahayogI banAU|
mero bhAi hArUnalAI |
unIdvArA mero zaktimA bRddhi gara|
ra unalAI mero kAryamA sahabhAgI banAU|
tAki hAmI timro atyadhika pavitratA varNana garauM|
ra timIlAI atyadhika smaraNa garauM|
nizcaya nai timI hAmIlAI hernevAlA chau |
allAhale bhane– “he mUsA! timIle mAgekAe kurA svIkAra gariyo|
ra hAmIle pahile ekapaTaka timImAthi upakAra garisakekA chauM |
smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle timrI AmAlAI tyo prakAzanA garyauM jasako varNana aba gari~daicha|

ki mUsAlAI euTA bAkasamA rAkhera nadImA rAkhideU | ani nadIle tyasalAI taTamA puryAunecha jasalAI mero ra usako zatrule uThAunecha | ra, (he mUsA!) maile Aphno tarphabATa timIbhitra sneha hAlidie~ tAki timro pAlanapoSaNa mero rekhadekhamA gariyos |

(smaraNa gara) jaba timrI didI (phiraauna kahA~) gain ra bhanin– “ke ma tapAIMharUlAI yasto mahilAbAre jAnakArI diU~ jasale yasa (zizu) ko pAlanapoSaNa rAmrarI garna sakche?” yasarI hAmIle timIlAI timrI AmAkahA~ puryAidiyauM tAki unakA A~khAlAI zItalatA prApta hos, ra unI cintita nahoUn; ra timIle eka janAlAI mAryau tara hAmIle timIlAI cintA mukta pAryauM | ra, hAmIle timro khUba parIkSaNa garyauM | ani timI varSauMsamma madayanabAsIharUsa~ga basyau | tyasapachi he mUsA! aba timI nirdhArita avasthAmA AipugekAechAai |
ani maile timIlAI AphnolAgi cayana gareM |
timI ra timro bhAi merA nizAnIharU liera jAU ra mero stutimA DhilAsustI nagarnU |
timIharU duvai phiraaunakahA~ jAU (kinabhane) U uddaNDa bhaisakeko cha |
ani usalAI namratApUrvaka samjhAU zAyada ki usale nasIhata kabUla garcha vA DarAu~cha |
duvaile bhane– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! usale hAmImAthi atyAcAra garlA vA uddaNDatAkAe pradarzana garlA ki bhanI hAmI DarAu~chauM |
allAhale bhane– “naDarAU! ma timIharUko sAthamA, sunirahane ra herirahane, chu |

ani timI duvai UkahA~ jAU ani bhana– hAmI timrA pAlanakartAkA rasUlaharU hauM | ataH isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI hAmIsa~ga jAna deU ra unIharUlAI nasatAU | hAmI timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa nizAnI pani liera AekA chauM, ra zAnti usaimAthi hunecha jasale mArgadarzanako anusaraNa garnecha |
(bhana!) jasale asvIkAra garcha ra vimukha huncha usamAthi allAhako prakopa Aunecha bhanI hAmIlAI vahya (prakAzanA) dvArA batAieko cha |
phiraaunale sodhyo “he mUsA! timI duvaikA pAlanakartA ko hun?
unale bhane– “jasale pratyeka cijalAI tyasako AkRti pradAna gare ra tyasalAI mArga dekhAe tinI nai hAmrA pAlanakartA hun |
phiraaunale prazna garyo– “ani atItakA pustAharUko ke avasthA hunecha?
mUsAle uttara die– “tinIharUko bAremA merA pAlanakartAkahA~ euTA vahImA surakSita cha | merA pAlanakartA na galtI garchan na birsane nai garchan |
(tI unai hun) jasale pRthvIlAI timIharUkAnimti bichyaunA banAe; tyasamA timIharUlAI hi~Dna bATAharU nikAle ra AkAzabATa pAnI barsAe | ani hAmIle tyasamA vibhinna prakArakA vanaspatiharU umAryauM |
timIharU khAU ra AphnA caupAyAharUlAI pani khuvAU | nissandeha yasamA buddhimAnharUkAlAgi dherai nizAnIharU chan |
yasai (pRthvI) bATa hAmIle timIharUlAI sRSTi garekA chauM ra yasaimA timIharUlAI pharkAunechauM, ani pheri yasaibATa timIharUlAI dosro paTaka nikAlnechauM |
ra, hAmIle phiraaunalAI AphnA sabai nizAnIharU dekhAyauM | taipani usale mithyA Thahara garyo ra inkAra garyo |
bhanna thAlyo– “he mUsA! ke timI Aphno jAdUko balale hAmIlAI hAmrai dezabATa nikAlna hAmIkahA~ AekA chau?

ThIka cha, hAmI pani timIviruddha avazya nai tyastai jAdU lyAunechauM | ataH timIle hAmI ra AphUbIca yasto samaya nirdhAraNa gara jasabATa na hAmI pachADi haTauMlA na timI nai |samatala ra khullA maidAnamA (upasthita hoauM) |”
mUsAle bhane– “utsavako dina (mukAbilAko lAgi) nizcita bhayo ra darzakaharUlAI suryodayapazcAt bhelA garinecha |”
ani pharkepachi phiraaunale AphnA sArA hatakaNDAharU jammA garyo ra pratispardhAkolAgi Ayo |

mUsAle jAdUgaraharUlAI bhane– “timIharUko vinAza hunecha! allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa nagara | yasto garyau bhane unale euTA kaThora prakopadvArA timIharUlAI nAza garnechan | ra, jasale mithyAropaNa garyo U asaphala bhayo |
ani tinIharUbIca ApasamA matabheda bhayo ra tinIharU gopya rUpamA sallAha garna thAle |
bhanna thAle– “vAstavamA yI dUvai jAdugara hun jasale timIharUlAI Aphno jAdUdvArA timIharUko dezabATa nikAlna ra timIharUko Adarza praNAlIlAI naSTa garna cAhanchan |
ani timIharU AphnA sabai upAyaharU juTAU ra paMktivaddha bhaera AU | ra, Aja jasale jitnecha uhI saphala hunecha |”
tinIharUle bhane– “he mUsA! pahile timI phyA~kchau ki hAmI phyA~kauM?
mUsAle bhane– “baru timIharU nai phyA~ka |” mUsAlAI anAyAsa tinIharUko jAdUle tinIharUkA DorI ra laThThIharU dauDiraheko bhAna bhayo |
ra, mUsA bhitrabhitrai DarAe |
hAmIle bhanyauM– “timI naDarAU | nizcaya nai timI vijayI hunechau |

ra, timro dAhine hAtamA raheko (lauro) phyA~ka | tyasale tinIharUkA banAvaTI cijaharUlAI nilnecha | tinIharUle jejati banAekA chan tyo ta kevala jAdUgarako hatakaNDA mAtra ho | ra, jAdugara jahA~bATa Ae pani saphala hune chaina |”
jAdugaraharUle (bhuimA) sajdA gare ra bhane– “hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM hAruna tathA mUsAkA pAlanakartAmAthi |”

phiraaunale bhanyo– “ke timIharUle mero anumati binA nai AsthA kAyama garyau ta? nissandeha U nai timIharUko tyo guru ho jasale timIharUlAI jAdU sikAyo | ThIka cha, aba ma timIharUkA hAtakhuTTAharU viparIta dizAbATa kATnechu ra khajUrako hA~gAmA zUlI caDhAunechu | ani timIharUle thAhA pAunechau ki duImadhye kasako yAtanA adhika kaThora ra sthAyI raheko cha |”

unIharUle bhane– “hAmI AphUsamakSa AekA pratyakSa pramANaharU ra hAmIharUlAI sRSTi garekA allAhamAthi timIlAI prAthamikatA dine chainauM | ataH timI je nirNaya garna cAhanchau, gara | timro Adeza kevala yasa sAMsArika jIvanasamma mAtra calna sakcha |
hAmIle AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi ImAna lyAekA chauM, tAki unale hAmrA pApaharUlAI ra jAdUlAI pani jasakolAgi timIle hAmIlAI bAdhya tulyAekA thiyau kSamA garUn | allAha nai uttama tathA cirasthAyI chan |
vAstavikatA yahI ho ki jo aparAdhI banera AphnA pAlanakartAsamakSa upasthita hunecha usakolAgi naraka raheko cha jahA~ U na marnecha na jiune nai cha |
ani, jo unIsamakSa ImAnako avasthAmA Aunecha jasle satkarmaharU pani gareko hunechan tyastA vyaktiharUkAlAgi ucca sthAna rahekocha |
zAzvata bagaiMcAharU hunechan jasakA talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan jahA~ unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | yo ho pratiphala, yasto vyaktikolAgi jasale pavitratA grahaNa garyo |

ra, hAmIle mUsAmAthi prakAzanA garyauM– “merA bhaktaharUlAI rAtArAta nikAlera laijAU | pheri unIharUkAlAgi samudramA (lauro hirkAera) sukkhA mArga nikAla | timIlAI na samAtine Dara hunecha na (Dubne) AzaGkA nai |”
phiraaunale AphnA senAkAsAtha unIharUlAI pachyAyo ra samudrale tinIharUlAI pUrNa rUpamA DhAkyo |
phiraaunale AphnA jAtibandhuharUlAI pathabhraSTa pAryo, ra sIdhAmArga dekhAena |

he isrAIlakA santAnaharU ho! hAmIle timIharUlAI timro zatrubATa mukta garyauM | ra, hAmIle timIharUsita tUra (parvata) ko dAhine paTTiko vAcA garyauM, ani timIharUkAlAgi manna tathA salvA avatarita garyauM |

hAmIle pradAna garekA zuddha khAdyAnna khAU ra tyasamA sImA ullaGghana nagara | anyathA timIharUmAthi mero prakopa avatarita hunecha | ra, jasamAthi mero prakopa avatarita huncha tyo vyaktiko vinAza huna jAncha |
tara, juna vyaktile prAyazcita garcha, ImAna lyAu~cha, satkarma garcha ra satmArgamA sthira rahancha tyasakolAgi ma ati kSamAzIla chu |
he mUsA! timIlAI Aphno samudAyakA mAnisaharUbATa alaga pArera ke kurAle cA~Dai lyAyo?
unale bhane– “tinIharU merA pAilA pachyAu~dai Au~daichan, ra he pAlanakartA! maile kevala timro prasannatA prAptikolAgi hatAra gareM |”
allAhale bhane– “hAmIle timro anupasthitimA timro samudAyako parIkSA liyauM ra sAmerIle tinIharUlAI pathabhraSTa pAryo |

ani mUsA atyanta krodha evaM khedako avasthAmA AphnA samudAyakA mAnisaharUtarpha pharke ra bhane– “he merA jAtibandhu ho! ke timIharUkA pAlanakartAle timIharUsa~ga rAmro vAcA garekA thienan, ra ke tyo vAcA (ko samaya) lAmo bhaisakyo? vA timIharU pAlanakartAko prakopa timIharUmAthi avatarita hos bhanne cAhanchau jasale gardA timIharUle masa~ga gareko vAcA bhaMga garyAe?”

tinIharUle bhane– “hAmIle timIsa~ga gareko vAcA Aphno icchAle toDekA hoinauM | tara, hAmImAthi AphnA samudAyakA mAnisaharUkA juna gahanAharU lAdiekA thie tyasalAI hAmIle phyA~kidiyauM | tyastai sAmirIle pani (kehI) rAkhyo |

ani usale tinIharUkAlAgi euTA bAcchoko murti banAera prastuta garyo jasabATa bAcchAko jasto AvAja niskanthyo | ani tinIharUle bhanna thAle– yahI timIharUko pUjya ho ra mUsAko pani | tara mUsAle yasalAI birsekA chan |”
ra tyasale na tinakA kurAharUko javApha dincha ra na tinIharUlAI kunai hAni vA lAbha nai puryAuna sakcha bhanne kurA ke tinIharUlAI thAhA chaina ra?

ra, hArUnale pahile nai bhanekA thie– “he jAtibandhu ho! yasadvArA timIharUko parIkSA liieko cha | ra, timIharUko vAstavika pAlanakartA ta karuNAmaya (allAha) hun | ani, timIharU merai anusaraNa gara ra merai Adezako pAlanA gara |”
tinIharUle bhane– “hAmI ta yasakai pUjA garirahanechauM jabasamma hAmIsamakSa mUsA Au~dainan |”
(pharkepachi) mUsAle bhane– “he hArUna | timIle tinIharU pathabhraSTa bhaeko dekhdA pani kuna kurAle timIlAI rokyo?
ki timIle pani mero anusaraNa garenau | timIle ke mero AjJAko ullaGghana garyau?

hArUnale uttara die– “he merA AmAkAe chAerA! mero dAhrI nasamAtnU ra na mero TAuko(ko kapAla) nai tAnnU | malAI, timIle isrAIlakA santAnaharUbIca vibheda utpanna garyau ra mero kurAko vAstA garenau bhanera bhanchau bhanne pIra paryo |”
mUsAle bhane– “he sAmerI! ke cha timro mAmilA?”
usale bhanyo– “malAI tyo cija dekhA paryo juna tinIharUlAI dekhA parena | ataH maile IzadUtako kehI hadasamma anuzaraNa gareM pheri choDidie~ | mero mana mastiSkale malAI yahI nai sujhAyo |

mUsAle bhane– “timI gaihAla; timro sajAya~ yo ho ki aba timIle jIvanabhari malAI nachunU” bhanirahanu parnecha | ra, (yasabAheka paralokako yAtanAko pani) vacana raheko cha juna kadApi Tarnechaina | ra, yo timro Izvara jasaprati yo pAgala thiyau, hAmI tyasalAI jalAunechauM ani samudramA sarvatra phyA~kidinechauM |
vAstavamA timIharU sabaikA Izvara allAha nai hun | unIbAheka anya kohI pUjya chaina | unale hareka cijalAiaAphnAe jJAnakAe paridhimA liekA chan |”
he sandeSTA! yasarI timIlAI pahile bitekA vRttAnta sunAu~daichauM ra hAmIle timIlAI upadeza (grantha) pradAna garisakekA chauM |
jo tyasabATa vimukha huncha usale avazya nai mahApralayako dina bhArI bokeko hunecha |
tyasamA sadAkolAgi grasta hunechan, ra mahApralayako dina tinIharUkolAgi yo bhAra ati dukhada hunecha |
juna dina sUra phuMkinecha ra hAmI aparAdhIharUlAI yasto avasthAmA ekatRta garnechauM ki tinIharUkA A~khAharU nIlA bhaekA hunechan |
tinIharU paraspara kAnekhusI garnechan ki hAmIle saMsAramA kevala dasa dina bitAekA chauM |
yinIharU juna kurA gardaichan tyasako vAstavikatAbATa hAmI avagata chauM | tyatikhera tinIharUmadhye baDhI sAvadhAna rahane vyaktile bhannecha– timIharUle ekadina mAtra bitAekA chau |
he sandeSTA tinIharU timIsa~ga pahADako bAremA prazna garnechan | bhanideU– “tyasalAI merA pAlanakartAle dhulAe jastAe banAera uDAidinechan |
ra, pRthvIlAI unale samatala khullA maidAna banAera choDnechan|
jasamA na timIle kunai moDa dekhnechau na ukAlo orAlo nai |”

tyo dina sabaile euTA pukArnevAlAko anusaraNa garnechan | kasaile pani alikati pani kuTilatA dekhAuna saknechaina | karuNAmaya (allAha) kA sAmu AvAjaharU dabnechan ra timIle khusakhuse AvAjabAheka arU kehI pani sunne chainauM |
tyo dina kasaiko pani siphAriza kAma lAgne chaina, sivAya tyasa vyaktiko jasalAI karuNAmaya (allAha) le anumati dinechan ra jasakA kurAlAI unale mana parAunechan |
unI mAnisaharUkA aghi tathA pachikA sampUrNa kurAharU jAndachan | tara, tinIharUlAI allAhakA bAremA pUrNa jJAna bhane chaina |
(sabaikA) muhAraharU tI jIvanta tathA kAyama rahane allAha) samakSa jhuknechan | (tyatibelA) atyAcAra bokera AuneharU asaphala hunechan |
ImAna lyAera satkarma garekA vyaktilAI na anyAyako bhaya hunecha na kunai hAniko Dara nai |

ani, he sandeSTA! yasa prakAra hAmIle timImAthi arabI kuraAna avataraNa garyau ra tyasamA vibhinna prakArakA cetAvanIharUko varNana garyauM tAki tinIharUle Izabhaya rAkhun vA allAhale tinIharUmA samajhadArI utpanna garUn |

sarvocca chan allAha vAstavika samrATa | ani timImAthi avataraNa bhairaheko kuraAnako prakAzanA samApta garinuaghi kuraAna pAThamA hatAra nagara ra prArthanA gara– “he merA raba! mero jJAnamA bRddhi gara |”
ani, yasaaghi hAmIle AdamalAI euTA Adeza diekA thiyauM tara unale birsie ra hAmIle unamA dRDhasaGkalpa pAenauM |
ra, smaraNa gara tyasa samayalAI jaba hAmIle phariztAharUlAI bhanyauM– “AdamasAmu sajdA gara |” taba iblIsabAheka sabaile sajdA gare tara usale inkAra garyo |
ani hAmIle bhanyau~– “he Adama! yo timro ra timrI patnIko zatru ho | usale timIharUlAI svargabATa nanikAlos anyathA timI abhAgI hunechau |
yahA~ timro lAgi yo suvidhA cha ki na timI bhoko rahanechau na nAGgo nai |
ra, timIlAI tirkhA tathA ghAmale pani satAune chaina |”
ani zaitAnale unalAI bahakAyo ra bhanyo– “he Adama! ke ma timIlAI amaratAko vRkSatarpha nirdezita garauM ani tyasa rAjyako juna kSINa hunechaina |”
