ataH duvaile tyasabATa kehI khAe | ani turuntai tinakA guptAGgaharU tinIharUsAmu khulna gae ra duvaile svayaMlAI svargakA pAtaharUle DhAkna thAle | Adamale AphnA pAlanakartAko avajJA gare ani sIdhAmArgabATa TADhina puge |
pheri unakA pAlanakartAle unalAI cayana gare; unako prAyazcita svIkAra gare ra unalAI sIdhAmArga dekhAe |

allAhale Adeza die– “timIharU duvai yahA~ (svarga) bATa orlihAla | timIharU ekaarkAkA zatru hau | mero tarphabATa timIharUkAnimti mArgadarzana pugdA jasale mero mArgadarzanako anusaraNa garnecha U na pathabhraSTa hunecha na abhAgI nai |
ra, jo mero smaraNabATa vimukha huncha usako jIvana saGkIrNa hunecha ra mahApralayako dina hAmIle usalAI andho banAera uThAunechauM |”
usale bhannecha– “he merA pAlanakartA! malAI timIle andho pArera kina uThAyau jabaki ma pahile dRSTivAna thie~ |”
allAhale javApha dinechan– “yastai hunuparne thiyo | timIle AphUsamakSa AekA merA AyataharUlAI jasarI birsidiekA thiyau tyasarI nai Aja timIlAI pani birsAinecha |
ra, hAmI sImA ullaGghanakArI tathA AphnA rabakA AyataharUmAthi ImAna nalyAune vyaktilAI yasarI nai badalA dine garchauM ani paralokako yAtanA ta tyobhandA jhan kaThora evam cirasthAyI hunecha |

ke tinIharUlAI yasa kurAle pani sahI bATo dekhAena ki hAmIle tinIharUbhandA pahile kati yastA samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pArisakekA chauM jasakA nivAsasthAnaharUmA yinIharU hi~DaDula garirahekA chan | nissandeha yasamA buddhimAnharUkAlAgi dherai nizAnIharU chan |
ra, yadi timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa euTA kurA pahile nai nizcita nabhaeko bhae ani nizcita myAda pahile nai natokieko bhae avazya ahile nai prakopa AilAgne thiyo |

ataH he sandeSTA! tinIharUle bhanekA kurAprati dhairyadhAraNa gara ra sUryodayaaghi tathA sUryAstabhandA pahile AphnA pAlanakartAko prazaMsAsAtha mahimAgAna garne gara ra rAtakA vibhinna paharaharUmA tathA dinakA vibhinna bhAgaharUmA pani mahimAgAna gara tAki timIlAI prasannatA prApta hos |

ra, timI sAMsArika jIvanakA tI vaibhavaharUtarpha kadApi dRSTi na pAra juna hAmIle vibhinna prakArakA mAnisaharUlAI diirAkhekAchauM | tAki hAmI tyasadvArA tinIharUko parIkSA liauM | ra, timrA pAlanakartAle pradAna gareko jIvikA nai sarvottama tathA dIrghakAlIna raheko cha |

ani, Aphno ghara parivAralAI namAjako hukuma deU ra svayaM pani tyasamA kAyama hoU | hAmI timIsita jIvikA mAgdainauM | hAmI nai timIlAI jIvikA pradAna garchauM ra rAmro pariNAma ta dharmaniSThakailAgi raheko cha |
ra, tinIharU bhanchan– “yasale AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa hAmIkahA~ kunai nizAnI (camatkAra) kina lyAu~daina?” ke tinIharUsamakSa pahilekA granthaharUmA spaSTa pramANaharU AekA chainan?

ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI yasa (antima sandeSTA) aghi nai kunai prakopadvArA naSTa pAreko bhae tinIharUle bhanne thie– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA timIle hAmIsamakSa kunai rasUla kina paThAenau tAki hAmI apamAnita tathA tiraskRta hunuaghi nai timrA AdezaharUko anusaraNa garne thiyauM?”

bhanideU– “hareka vyakti (pariNAmako) pratIkSAmA cha | ani timIharU pani pratIkSA gara | sIdhAmArgavAlA ko hun ra kasale cAheko gantavya prApta garisakekA chan bhanne kurA cA~Dai nai thAhA pAunechau |
nikaTa Aisakeko cha mAnisaharUko hisAbako samaya taipani tinIharU asAvadhAnImA rahI vimukha bhairahekAchan |
tinIharUsamakSa tinIharUkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kunai pani nayA~ upadeza Au~dA tinIharU tyasalAI khelai khelamA sundachan |
tinIharUkA mana anyatra chan, ra atyAcArIharU ApasamA yo gopya prAmarza garchan ki yo vyakti kevala timIharU jastai mAnisa ho | ani ke jAndAjAndai pani timIharU usako jAdUmA phasdachau?
sandeSTAle bhane– “merA pAlanakartA AkAza tathA dhartImA garine pratyeka kurA jAndachan ra unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

(yati mAtra hoina) baru atyAcArIharU bhanchan, “yI chayAsmise sapanAharU mAtra hun, baru yo usaiko managaDhante kurA ho | baru yo vyakti euTA kavi ho | anyathA yasale hAmIsAmu yasto kunai nizAnI lyAos jasto pahilekA sandeSTAharU paThAiekA thie |
tinIharUbhandA pahile juna nagaraharUlAI hAmIle vinAza garyauM tinIharUle ImAna lyAekA thienan | ani ke yinIharUle imAna lyAulAn ta?

ra, ((he muhammada sa.!) hAmIle timIbhandA pahile kevala yastA puruSalAI sandeSTA banAera paThAekA thiyauM jasamAthi hAmI vahya (prakAzanA) garne garthyauM | timIharUlAI yasako jJAna chaina bhane ahle–kitAbaharUsa~ga sodha |
ani, hAmIle tinIharUlAI yasto zarIra banAekA thienauM ki unIharU khAnA nakhAUn ra unIharU sadAkAlAgi jIvita rahun |
pheri, hAmIle unIharUsita gareko vAcA pUrA garyauM, ani unIharU ra hAmIle cAhekA vyaktiharUlAI bacAyauM, tathA sImA ullaGghanakArI vyaktiharUlAI naSTa pAryauM |
he mAnava ho! hAmIle timIharUtarpha yastA grantha avataraNa garekA chauM jasamA timIharUlAI upadeza cha | ke timIharU buddhile kAma lidainauM?
ani, katipaya atyAcArI nagaraharUlAI hAmIle pUrNa rUpamA dhvasta pAridiyauM ra tinIharUpachi anya jAtilAI khaDA garyauM |
ra, jaba tinIharUle hAmro prakopalAI mahasusa gare taba tyasabATa bhAgna thAle |
(bhaniyo) nabhAga; baru pharka AphUle bhogekA sukha–sAmagrItarpha, ra Aphnai gharaharUtarpha tAki timIharUsita prazna gariyos |
tinIharUle bhane– “hAya hAmro durbhAgya! vAstavamA hAmI atyAcArI thiyauM |
tinIharUle yahI bhanirahe yahA~samma ki hAmIle tinIharUlAI kATiekA (bAlI) ra nibheko Ago (jhaiM) banAidiyauM |
ra, hAmIle AkAza, pRthvI tathA yI duvaibIca rahekA prANIharUlAI khelaThaTTAmA sRSTi garekA hoinauM |
yadi hAmIle khelakolAgi banAuna cAheko bhae hAmI tyasalAI AphUkahA~ nai banAihAlthyauM, yadi hAmIle sAccikai yasto garnu thiyo bhane |

baru hAmI nitAnta satyale asatyamAthi prahAra garchauM ra tyasale tyasako TAuko phuTAidincha ani tyo tyatikhera nai samApta huncha | vinAza cha timIharUkAlAgi tI kurAharUle gardA juna timIharU managaDhanta rUpamA racne garchau~ |

AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa prANIharU unai allAhakAlAgi chan | ra, unIsamakSa rahane (phariztA) harUle savayaMlAI ThUlo ThAnera na unako upAsanAbATa vimukha hunchan, na unIharU thakita nai hunchan |
unIharU rAtadina (allAhako) mahimAgAna garchan; nirutsAhita hu~dainan |
ke tinIharUle dhartImA yastA pUjyaharU banAekA chan jasale tinIharUlAI) jIvita pArera uThAu~chan?

yadi AkAza evaM dhartImA allAhabAheka anya upAsyaharU bhaekA bhae yI duvai avyavasthita bhaI astavyasta hune thie | ataH rAjasiMhAsanakA svAmI allAha tinIharUko managaDhante (bahudevabAre) kurAbATa pavitra rahekA chan |
unale gareko kAryabAre sodhine chaina baru tinIharU unIsamakSa uttaradAyI chan |

ke tinIharUle allAhalAI choDI anyalAI pUjya banAekA chan? (he nabI sa.!) bhanideU– “prastuta gara Aphno pramANa | yo ho sAthIharUko kurA (pramANa) ra mabhandA pahilekA (IzabhaktaharU) ko kurA pani | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza vyaktiharU satya jAndainan | tyasakAraNa tinIharU vimukha hu~daichan |
ra, hAmIle timIbhandA pahile jati pani rasUla paThAyauM unIharU sabailAI yahI vahya garyauM ki ma bAheka anya kohI pUjya chaina | ataH kevala merai upAsanA gara |
ra, tinIharU bhanchan– “karuNAmaya (allAha) le putra grahaNa garekA chan |” (hoina) unI pavitra chan | barU unIharU ta allAhakA pratiSThita bhakta hun |
tinIharU kurAmA unIbhandA agADi jA~dainan ra unIharU unakai Adezako pAlanA garchan |

allAha tinIharUkA aghi tathA pachikA sampUrNa mAmilAko jJAna rAkhdachan ra tI phariztAharU kasaiko siphAriza garne chainan, tI vyaktiharUbAheka jasabATa allAha prasanna hunchan | ra, unIharU unako bhayabATa trasita rahanchan |
ra, unIharUmadhye kasaile pani ‘‘unIbAheka ma pani pUjya hu~” bhancha bhane hAmI tyasalAI narakako sajAya~ dinechauM | yasarI nai hAmI atyAcArIharUlAI sajAya~ dine garchauM |

ke kAphiraharUle yasa kurAmA vicAra garenan ki AkAza tathA pRthvI paraspara TA~siekA thie pheri hAmIle tI duvailAI alaga alaga pAridiyauM ra sampUrNa jIvita vastulAI pAnIbATa sRSTi garyauM? ke tinIharU ajhai pani AsthA rAkhdainan?
ani, hAmIle dhartImA pahADaharU sirjanA garyauM tAki tinIharUlAI liera tyo na Dhalkiyos | ra hAmIle tyasamA vistRta mArgaharu banAyauM tAki tinIharule AphnA mArgaharu pAuna sakun |
ani, hAmIle AkAzalAI surakSita chAnA banAyauM taipani tinIharU saMsArakA nizAnIharUprati dhyAna diMdainan |
ani, unai hun jasale rAta, dina ra sUrya evam candramAlAI sRSTi gare | pratyeka A–Aphno kakSamA parikramA garirahekA chan |
ra, (he sandeSTA!) hAmIle kasailAI pani timIbhandA pahile amaratva pradAna garenauM | ani timI maryau bhane ke tinIharU cAhi~ sadA jIvita rahanechan ta?
pratyeka jIvale mRtyuko svAda cAkhne nai cha | ra, hAmI rAmrA ra narAmro avasthAharUmA rAkhera timIharUlAI jA~cnechauM | ra, timIharU hAmItarpha nai pharkera Aunucha |

ani, yI kAphiraharUle timIlAI jahile dekhe pani timro khillI nai uDAu~chan ra bhanchan–ke yahI tyo vyakti ho jasale hAmrA IzvaraharUko varNana (narAmro tarIkAle) garne garcha? jabaki yinIharU svayaM karuNAmaya (allAha) ko japalAI asvIkAra garchan |
mAnisa janmajAtai hatArine ho | timIharUlAI cA~Dai nai AphnA nizAnIharU dekhAunechu | tasartha timIharU masita hatAra nagara |
ani, tinIharU bhanchan– “yadi timI saccA hau bhane batAU tyo vAcA kahile pUrA hunecha?”
yadi kAphiraharU jAnne bhae bhane tyasa samayamA tinIharUle na AphnA anuhAra tathA piThyU~harUbATa (narakako) agnilAI haTAuna saknechan ra na tinIharUlAI kunai sahayoga nai prApta hunechan |
baru tyo (vAcAko) samaya tinIharUsamakSa akasmAt Aunecha ra tinIharUlAI Azcaryacakita tulyAunecha ani na tinIharU tyasalAI panchAuna saknechan na tinIharUlAI kunai avasara nai prApta hunecha |
timIbhandA pahilekA rasUlaharUko pani khillI uDAieko thiyo tara ThaTTA garneharUlAI tyasai (prakopa) le gheryo jasako tinIharU ThaTTA garne garthe |
bhanideU– “karuNAmaya (allAha) bATa timIharUlAI rAta tathA dinako samayamA kasale bacAuna sakcha?” tara tinIharU AphnA pAlanakartAkai japabATa vimukha bhairahekAchan |
ke tinIharUkA kunai yastA pUjyaharU chan jasale tinIharUlAI hAmIbATa bacAuna sakUn? tinIharU na svayaMlAI sahayoga garna sakchan ra na tinIharUlAI hAmI birUddha samarthana nai prApta hunecha |

baru hAmIle tinIharUlAI ra tinakA pUrvajaharUlAI jIvikopArjanakAlAgi sAmagrI pradAna garyauM yahA~samma ki tinIharUko lAmo avadhi bitisakyo | ke tai pani tinIharU dekhdainan ki hAmIle dhartIlAI vibhinna dizAbATa ghaTAu~dai lagekAchauM? ani ke tinIharU vijayI huna saklAn ta?
bhanideU– “ma vahyadvArA timIharUlAI sAvadhAna gariraheko chu tara bahirAharU cAhi~ sAvadhAna gari~dA pani kurA sundainan |
ani, yadi tinIharUlAI timrA pAlanakartAko prakopale alikati pani choyo bhane tinIharU cicyAu~chan “hAya hAmro durbhAgya! hAmI vAstavamA nai doSI thiyauM |”

ra, mahApralayako dina hAmI ThIkasaMga jokhne tarAju rAkhidinechauM | ani kasaimAthi alikati pani anyAya hune chaina | ra, euTA rAyoko dAnA barAbara (karma) bhae pani hAmI tyasalAI lyAunechauM | ra, hisAba linakAlAgi hAmI paryApta chauM |
ra, hAmIle mUsA tathA hAruna lAI kasauTI, jyoti ra upadeza pradAna garekA thiyauM tI Izabhaya rAkhne vyaktiharUkAnimti|
jo AphnA pAlanakartAlAI nadekhikanai DarAu~chan ra mahApralayaprati bhayabhita rahanchan |
ra, yo barakatayukta anusmRti (kuraAna) ho, yasalAI hAmIle nai avataraNa garekA chauM | ke ajhai pani timIharU yasalAI asvIkAra garchau?
ra, yasaaghi hAmIle ibrAhImalAI pani cetanA pradAna garekA thiyauM | ra hAmI unalAI rAmrI jAndathyauM |
jaba unale AphnA pitA evaM samudAyakA mAnisaharUlAI bhane– “yI kastA mUrtiharU hun jasaprati timIharU Asakta chau?”
tinIharUle bhane–“hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI yinIharU kai pUjA gardai Aeko pAyauM |”
ibrAhImale bhane–“timIharU ra timrA pUrvajaharU pani spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA DubekA chau |”
tinIharUle bhane–“ke timI hAmIsamakSa vAstavika vicAra liera AekA chau vA tyattikai khyAlaThaTTA gardaichau?”
ibrAhImalebhane–“hoina (baru satya yo ho ki) timIharukA raba AkAzaharu tathA pRthvIkA pAlanakartA hun jasale yI sabailAI sRSTi gare | ma yasako sAkSI hu~ |”
ra, allAhako kasama! timIharU pharkera gaepachi ma avazya nai timIharUkA mUrtiharU virUddha kehI garnechu |
ani ibrAhImale sabai mUrtiharUlAI TukrA–TukrA pAridie sivAya tyo juna tinIharUkAnimti ThUlo thiyo tAki tinIharU tyasaisa~ga saMparka garUn |
tinIharUle bhane– “hAmrA IzvaraharUsita kasale yasto vyavahAra garyo? nissandeha tyo aparAdhI ho |”
(kehI vyaktiharUle) bhane– “hAmIle eka yuvakalAI yinako bAremA carcA gardai gareko sunekA thiyauM jasako nAma ibrAhIma ho |”
tinIharUle bhane– “usalAI janasamudAyasamakSa liera AU tAki tinIharU pani sAkSI banUn |”
tinIharUle sodhe– “e ibrAhIma! ke taiMle hAmrA IzvaraharUsaMga yasto vyavahAra garis?”
ibrAhImale bhane–“baru yo kAma yinImadhye ThUlo mUrtile gareko hunuparcha | yadi yinIharU bolchan bhane yinalAI nai sodha |”
yo sunera tinIharU AphnA antarAtmAtarpha pharke ra bhane–“vAstavamA timIharU nai atyAcArI rahechau |”
tara pheri tinIharUko mati phiryo ra bhane– “timIlAI thAhA cha~dai cha ki yinIharU boldainan |”
ibrAhImale bhane– “ke ta timIharUle allAha bAheka yastA cijaharUko pUjA garchau jasale timIharUlAI na kunai lAbha puryAuna sakcha na hAni nai?
aphasoca cha timIharUmAthi, ra tI sabaimAthi jasako pUjA timIharUle allAhalAI choDera garchau | ke timIharUko buddhi chaina?”
tinIharUle bhane–“yadi timIharUle kehI garnu nai cha bhane tyasa (ibrAhIma) lAI jalAideU ra AphnA IzvaraharUlAI sahayoga gara |”
hAmIle Adeza diyauM– “e agni timI ibrAhIma(a.)kAnimti zItala ra salAmatI bana!”
tinIharUle ibrAhImaviruddha SaDyantra garekA thie tara hAmIle tinIharUlAI ghATAmA pAryauM |
ani, hAmIle unalAI ra lUtalAI bacAera tyasa bhU–bhAgatira lagyauM jasalAI hAmIle saMsArabAsIharUkAlAgi barakatayukta banAekA thiyauM |
ani, hAmIle ibrAhImalAI ishAka pradAna garyauM ra ajha yaakUba pani | ra, unIharU sabailAI hAmIle satyaniSTha banAyauM |

ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI aguvA banAyauM jo hAmro Adeza anusAra mArgadarzana garne garthe | ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI puNya karmaharU garne, namAja kAyama garne tathA jakAta dine Adezako vahya (prakAzanA) garyauM | ra, tinIharU hAmrA vAstavika upAsaka thie |

ani, hAmIle lUtalAI pani tatvadarzitA tathA jJAna pradAna garyauM, ra tyasa nagarabATa mukti pradAna garyauM jasakA bAsindAharU ghRNita kAryamA lipta thie | tinIharU nizcaya nai kukarmI ra avajJAkArI thie |
ra, unalAI hAmIle Aphno dayAantargata dAkhila garyauM | nizcaya nai unI satkarmIharUmadhyekA thie |
ani, nUhalAI smaraNa gara | jaba unale hAmIlAI unIharUbhandA aghi pukAre hAmIle unako prArthanA svIkAra garyauM | ra, unalAI tathA unakA parivAralAI mahApIDAbATa mukti pradAna garyauM |
ani, unalAI hAmIle tI vyaktiharUviruddha sahayoga garyauM jasale hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI asatya ThaharyAekA thie | nizcaya nai tinIharU duSkarmI thie | ani hAmIle tinIharU sabailAI DubAidiyauM |

ra, smaraNa gara dAUda tathA sulaimAnalAI jaba duvai tyasa khetIko muddAko phaisalA garirahekA thie juna khetImA kehI vyaktiharUkA bAkhrAharU rAti carekA thie | ra, hAmI unIharUko nirNayalAI herirahekA thiyauM |

ani, hAmIle sahI phaisalA sulaimAnalAI phurAidiyauM | ra, hAmIle tatvadarzitA tathA jJAna ta duvailAI pradAna garekA thiyauM | ra, pahADaharUlAI hAmIle dAUdako niyantraNamA garidiekA thiyauM juna stuti garirahanthe ra paMkSIharUlAI pani | ra, yo kArya garnevAlA hAmI nai thiyauM |
ra, hAmIle unalAI timIharUkAlAgi ekaprakArako vastra (DhAla) banAune tarIkA sikAyauM tAki tyasale timIharUlAI yuddhamA surakSita rAkhos | ani ke timIharU kRtajJa hunchau?

ra, hAmIle tibra gatimA calne hAvAlAI sulaimAnako adhInamA garidiekA thiyauM juna unako AdezAnusAra tyasa bhU–bhAgatarpha calne garthyAe jasalAI hAmIle barakatayukta banAekA thiyauM | ra, hAmI pratyeka kurAko jJAna rAkhdachauM |

ra, zaitAnaharUmadhye dherailAI pani (unako adhInamA garidiekA thiyauM) jo unakolAgi gotA lagAune garthe ra tyasabAheka anya kAryaharU pani garne garthe | tinIharU sabaikA saMrakSaka hAmI nai thiyauM |
smaraNa gara aiyUbalAI jaba unale AphnA pAlanakartAlAI pukAre, “ma piDita chu ra timI nai sarvAdhika karuNAmaya chau |”

ani hAmIle unako prArthanAlAI svIkAra garyauM ra tyo pIDA nirmUla pAryauM jasabATa unI pIDita thie | unalAI santAna pradAna garyauM | ra, tI cijaharUkAsAthai hAmIle Aphno vizeSa kRpAko rUpamA arU pani kehI pradAna garyauM tAki vAstavika upAsakaharUkAlAgi pATha banos |
ra, ismAIla, idrIsa tathA jUlkiphlalAI pani smaraNa gara | yinIharU sabai saMyamI vyaktiharU thie |
ra, hAmIle unIharUlAI Aphno kRpAmA praveza garAyauM | vAstavamA unIharU satkarmI thie |

ani, mAchAvAlAlAI smaraNa gara jaba unI risAera hi~De | ra, hAmIle unalAI samAtdainauM bhanThAne | antataH bhayAvaha andhakArabATa unale prArthanA gare– “(he pAlanakartA!) timIbAheka arU kohI pUjya chaina | timI pavitra chau | nissandeha ma atyAcArIharUmadhye hu~ |
ani hAmIle unako prArthanA svIkAra garyauM | unalAI cintAmukta garyauM ra yasarI nai hAmI AsthAvAnaharUlAI mukti pradAna garchauM |
ra, jakariyAlAI smaraNa gara jaba unale AphnA pAlanakartAlAI pukAre– “he merA pAlanakartA! malAI eklai nachoDa, ra timI nai sarvotkRSTa uttarAdhikArI hau |”

ani hAmIle unako prArthanA svIkAra garyauM ra unalAI yahyA pradAna garyauM | ani, unakI patnIlAI unakAlAgi yogya banAyauM | unIharU rAmrA kAryaharUmA prayAsarata thie | hAmIlAI AzA tathA bhayakAsAtha pukArne garthe | ra, unIharU hAmrosAmu namratApUrvaka jhukne garthe |
ra, tI mahilA (maryama) lAI smaraNa gara, jasale Aphno satItvako rakSA garin | ani hAmIle unIbhitra Aphno AtmAbATa phukyauM ra unalAI tathA unakA chorAlAI sampUrNa saMsArakAlAgi nizAnI banAyauM |
yo timIharUko yastAe samUha ho juna vAstavamA euTai samUha ho | ra, ma timIharUkA pAlanakartA hu~ | ataH merai upAsanA gara |
tara, tinIharUle paraspara Aphno dharmalAI chinnabhinna pAre | sabai hAmItarpha nai pharkera Aunucha |
ani jo AsthAvAna bhaera satkarma garcha usako kAmako upekSA hune chaina | ra hAmI tyo lekhirahekA chauM |
ra, juna nagaralAI hAmIle naSTa garekA chauM tyahA~kA bAsindAharU (yasa saMsAramA) pharkera kahilyai Aune chainan|
yahA~samma ki jaba yAjUja tathA mAjUja (ko bATo) kholinecha ra tinIharU hareka ucca sthAnabATa dagurdai Aunechan|

ra, satya vacanako samaya nikaTa Aipugnecha taba kAphiraharU Azcaryacakita bhaI hereko heryai hunechan | (bhannechan–) “hAya hAmro durbhAgya! hAmIle yasalAI birsekA thiyauM | baru hAmI po doSI thiyauM |”
nissandeha timIharU ra allAhabAheka jasako upAsanA garchau sabai (tI) narakakA indhana bannechan | timIharU tyasamA avazya hominechau |
yinIharU vAstavika pUjya bhaekA bhae yinIharU tyasamA homine thienan | barU aba sabai tyasamA sadA rahanechan |
tinIharU tyahA~ cicyAirahekA hunechan ra kehI pani sunna sakne chrainan |
tara, yastA vyaktiharUlAI narakabATa TADhA nai rAkhinecha jasakAnimti hAmrotarphabATa pahile nai bhalAi nizcita bhaisakeko cha |
unIharUle narakako cApa pani sunne chainan ra sadAsarvadA manaparne kurAharUmA ramAunechan |
(tyasa dina) ThUlo trAsale pani unIharUlAI cintita pArne chaina, ra phariztAharUle ‘timIharUsita vAcA garieko dina yahI ho’ bhandai hArdika svAgata garnechan |

tyasa dina hAmIle AkAzalAI bahIkA pannAharUlAI (belnAmA) beraijhaiM beridinechauM | jasarI hAmIle prathama paTaka sRSTi garekA thiyauM (tyasarI nai) tyasalAI dohoryAunechauM | yo hAmro jimmAmA raheko vAcA ho | hAmI yasalAI avazya nai pUrA garnechauM |
ra, hAmIle jabUramA upadezapachi lekhisakekA chauM ki dhartIkA uttarAdhikArI merA satkarmI bhaktaharU hunechan |”
nissandeha yasamA AjJAkArI vyaktiharUkAlAgi ThUlo sandeza raheko cha |
ra, (he muhammada sa.!) hAmIle timIlAI sampUrNa saMsArabAsIharUkAlAgi dayA mAtra banAera paThAekA chauM |
bhanideU– “merotarpha ke prakAzanA garieko cha bhane timIharUkA pUjya kevala eka pUjya chan | ataH ke timIharU AjJAkArI banchau ta?
ani yadi tinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane bhanideU– “maile timIharUlAI pUrNa rUpamA sAvadhAna gareko chu | aba malAI thAhA chaina ki timIharUlAI dieko vacana najikai cha vA TADhA |
tara, allAha timIharUko pAradarzI kurA jAndachan ra gopya kurA pani |
malAI ke thAhA ki yo (vilamba) timIharUko lAgi euTA parIkSA ho vA euTA nizcita samayasammako lAgi Ananda upabhogako avasara |
sandeSTAle bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA! nyAyapUrvaka nirNaya garideU | ra, hAmrA pAlanakartA atyanta dayAlu chan, jasabATa timIharUle bhanne garekA kurAharUvirUddha madata mAginecha |
he manuSya ho! AphnA pAlanakartAsita DarAU | nizcaya nai mahApralayako bhU–cAla ati ThUlo hunecha |

juna dina timIharUle dekhnechau ki pratyeka dUdha cusAune AmAle Aphno dUdha khAne zizulAI birsanechin; hareka garbhavatIle Aphno garbha patana garnechin ra timIle mAnisaharUlAI mAtekAe dekhnechau jabaki vAstavamA tinIharU mAtekAe hu~dainan baru allAhako prakopa nai ati kaThora hunecha |
ani, katipaya vyaktiharU allAhako viSayamA jJAna binA nai vivAda garchan, ra pratyeka uddaNDa zaitAnako anusaraNa garne garchan|
usako bhAgyamA ta yo lekhieko cha ki jasale usalAI mitra banAu~cha tyasalAI usale pathabhraSTa garnecha ra usalAI dankado agniko yAtanAsamma puryAunecha |

he mAnava! yadi timIharUlAI mRtyupazcAtko pUnarjanmamA sandeha cha bhane (timIharUlAI thAhA hunuparcha ki) hAmIle timIharUlAI sRSTi garyau~– (zurumA) mATobATa, tyasapachi vIryabATa, tyasalAI Dhikko ragata banAyauM; ani tyasapachi mAsuko Dallo banAyauM juna rUpayukta pani huncha ra rUpahIna pani, (yAe hAmI yasa kAraNale bayAna garchAai~) tAki timIharUkAlAgi (sRSTi prakRyA) praSTa pArauM | ra, hAmI jasalAI cAhanchauM euTA nirdhArita samayakolAgi garbhamA rAkhchauM | ani timIharUlAI zizu banAera bAhira nikAlchauM tAki timIharU Aphno paripakvatAko umeramA puga | ra, timIharUmadhye kohI (pahile nai) marcha ra kasailAI jIrNa–vRddhAvasthAsamma puryAincha tAki U sabai kurA jAnepachi pani kehI najAnne avasthAmA pugos | ra, timI dekhdaichau ki bhUmi sukkhA huncha tara jaba hAmI pAnI barSAu~chauM taba tyo lahalahAu~cha ra phUlcha ani vibhinna kisimakA sobhAyamAna vanaspatiharU ubjAu~cha |
yo yasakAraNale ki allAha nai nitAnta satya chan | unaile mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArchan ra unI pratyeka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhchan |
ani mahApralaya Aune nai cha | yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | ra, avazya nai allAhale cihAnamA rahekA sampUrNa mAnisaharUlAI (jIvita pArera) uThAunechan |
ani, mAnisaharUmadhye kohI yasto pani cha jo jJAna, mArgadarzana ra jyotimaya granthabinA allAhako viSayamA vivAda garcha|
gardhana markAu~dai, tAki usale mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa rokos | usakolAgi yasa saMsAramA apamAna rahekocha ra hAmI usalAI mahApralayako dina Agoko yAtanAko svAda pani cakhAunechauM |
yo tI karmaharUko pariNAma ho juna timro hAtale agADi nai paThAeko thiyo, ra allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi alikati pani anyAya gardainan |

ra, mAnisaharUmadhye kohI yasto pani cha jo taTamA (ubhiera) allAhako bhakti garcha ani usalAI (sAMsArika) lAbha prApta bhaemA U santuSTa huncha ra kunai saGkaTa AiparemA bimukha huncha | yasarI usale loka ra paraloka duvai gumAu~cha ra vAstavika ghATA yahI ho |
U allAhabAheka yasto cijalAI pukArcha jasale na hAni puryAuna sakcha na lAbha nai | yahI nai carama sImAsamma pugeko pathabhraSTatA ho |
U yasto cijalAI pukArcha jasako hAni usako lAbhabhandA adhika nikaTa huncha | kati nikRSTa cha (usako) saMrakSaka ra kati nikRSTa cha (usako) sAthI!

nissandeha allAhale ImAna rAkhne tathA satkarma garne vyaktiharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunechan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | vAstavamA allAha je cAhanchan tyahI garchan |

jo (nirAza bhaera) yaso ThAndacha ki allAhale loka tathA paralokamA usako sahayoga garne chainan (usako lAgi jIvanako kunai bATo bA~kI rahena) usalAI ke cAhiyo bhane euTA DorI chAnAmA bA~dhos ra (tyasamA gardhana laTakAera Aphno jIvanalAI) samApta pAros | usale socos ke yasa upAyale usalAi krodhita tulyAune cijalAI samApta pArna sakcha?
ra, yastai spaSTa kurAharUkAsAtha hAmIle yo kuraAna avataraNa garekA chauM | ra, allAhale jasalAI cAhanchan satmArga dekhAu~chan |
nissandeha allAha momina (muslima), yahUdI, sAbiI, IsAI, majUsI ra bahudevavAdIharU bIca mahApralayako dina phaisalA garnechan | nissandeha allAha hareka cijakA sAkSI hun |

ke timI dekhdainau ki jejati AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA chan, sUrya, candramA, tArA, parvata, vanaspati, janAvaraharU (AdI) allAhasAmu sajdA garrne garchan, mAnisaharUmadhye dheraile pani | ra, dherai yastA pani chan jasamAthi yAtanA nizcita bhaisakeko cha | ra, allAha jasalAI apamAnita garchan usalAI kasaile pani sammAnita garna sakdaina | nissandeha allAha je cAhanchan, garchan |
yI duI prativAdI hun jasale AphnA pAlanakartAko viSayamA vivAda gare | jasale kuphra garekA chan tinIharUkAlAgi Agoko vastra tayAra pArieko cha | tinIharUkA TAukomAthi umla~do pAnI khanyAinecha|
jasale tinIharUkA peTabhitrakA sabai cija ra chAlAharU pani paglanechan |
ani, tinIharUko daNDakolAgi phalAmakA ghanaharU rahekA chan |
jaba–jaba tinIharU tyahA~bATa asahya bhaera niskana khojnechan taba–taba tinIharU tyasaitarpha pharkAinechan | ra, (bhaninecha) cAkha jvalanta daNDako svAda |

nissandeha jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare unIharUlAI allAha yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunechan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | tyahA~ unIharUlAI sunako kaDA tathA motIharU pahiryAinecha ra tyahA~ unIharUko pahirana zuddha rezamakA hunechan |
unIharUlAI pavitra vacanako mArga dekhAiyo ra prazaMsita pAlanakartAko mArgadarzana garAiyo |

nissandeha jasale kuphra gare ra (mAnisaharUlAI) allAhako mArga tathA tyasa pratiSThita masjidabATa rokne garchan jasalAI hAmIle sampUrNa mAnavajAtikolAgi samAna banAekA chauM cAhe unIharU tyahA~kA bAsindA hun vA aApravAsIharU, tyasamA jasale satyabATa haTera atyAcArako nIti apanAu~cha usalAI hAmI dukhada yAtanAko svAda cakhAunechauM |

ra, (smaraNa gara) hAmIle ibrAhImakAlAgi yo ghara (kaabA) ko sthAna nirdhArita garyauM (yo bhandai) ki masa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra naThaharyAU ra mero gharalAI tavApha (parikramA), kiyAma (khaDA hune), rukua (jhukne) tathA sajdA (sASTAGga daNDavata) garneharUkAlAgi pavitra rAkha |
ra, mAnisaharUmA hajako ghoSaNA garideU ki unIharU hi~Dera vA hareka prakArako dUravartI bATobATa Aune U~TaharUmA savAra bhaera timIkahA~ AUn|

tAki unIharUle AphnAlAgi (rAkhiekA) phAidAharUsamma pugna sakUn ra (balidAnakA) nizcita dinaharUmA tI janAvaraharU– lAI kurabAnI gardA allAhako nAma liUn | ani tyasabATa timIharU pani khAU ra parAzrita, bhokA garIbalAI pani khuvAU |
pheri mAnisaharUle Aphno phohoramailA saphA garUn, AphnA bhAkalaharU pUrA garUn ra prAcIna ghara (kaabA) ko tavApha (parikramA) garUn |

yo thiyo kaabA nirmANa garnuko uddezya | ra, jasale allAhakA pratiSThita sthalaharUko Adara garcha tyo usakA pAlanakartAko dRSTimA usaikolAgi rAmro ho | ra, timIharUkAlAgi caupAyAharU vaidha gariekA chan sivAya tI caupAyAharU jasako bAremA timIharUsamakSa bayAna gariekocha | ani mUrtiharUko phohorabATa baca ra mithyA kurAbATa pani baca|

allAhakailAgi ekAgra hu~dai tathA kasailAI unako sAjhedAra nabanAikana | ra, jasale allAhako sAjhedAra banAu~cha, mAnauM U AkAzabATa khasyo | aba usalAI ki ta paMkSIle uThAera laijAnecha ki ta hAvAle uDAera kunai durgama sthAnamA phyA~kidinecha |
yo hAmro Adeza ho | ra, jasale allAhale nizcita garekA nizAnIharUko Adara garcha tyo vAstavamA hRdayako IzaparAyaNatAko kurA ho |
timIharUkAlAgi euTA nirdhArita samayasamma tyasamA (kurbAnIkA janAvaraharU) lAbha cha | ani tinIharuko vadhazAlA prAcIna ghara (kaabA) najika ho |

ra, pratyeka samudAyakolAgi hAmIle kurabAnI (balI) ko euTA tarikA nirdhArita garekA chauM tAki unIharUle tI caupAyAharUmAthi allAhako nAma uccAraNa garUn juna allAhale unIharUlAI pradAna garekA chan | timIharUkA pUjya eka mAtra pUjya hun tasartha unakai AjJAkArI bana | ra, he nabI! zubhasUcanA deU binamratAkA nIti apanAuneharUlAI |

jasasamakSa jaba allAhako carcA garincha taba unIharUko hRdaya kA~pcha ra jo jastosukai saGkaTa AilAgdA pani dhairyale kAma linchan, jasale namAja kAyama garchan ra hAmIle unIharUlAI jejati pradAna garekA chauM tyasamadhyebATa kharca gardachan |

ra, kurabAnIkA U~TalAI hAmIle timIharUkAlAgi allAhakA nizAnIharUmadhye ThaharyAekA chauM | tyasamA timIharUkA lAgi bhalAI cha | ataH tinIharulAI ubhieko avasthAmA tinIharUmAthi allAhako nAma uccAraNa gara; ani bhUi~mA laDepachi tyasabATa timIharU pani khAU ra santoSa garI basekA tathA mAgne duvai khAlakA dInaduHkhIharUlAI pani khuvAU | yasaprakAra tI janAvaraharUlAI hAmIle timIharUko adhInamA garekA chauM tAki timIharU kRtajJa bana |

allAhakahA~ na kurabAnIko mAsu pugdacha na ragata nai, baru timIharUko ‘takvA’ (dharmaniSThA) mAtra unIsamakSa pugdacha | yasarI hAmIle tI janAvaraharUlAI timIharUko kAbumA garidiekA chauM tAki unale timIharUlAI mArgadarzana garekA hunAle timIharU prazaMsA bayAna gara | ra, he nabI! zubhasUcanA deU ati uttama karma garneharUlAI!
allAha nizcaya nai satya mominaharUko pratirakSA garchan | allAhale kunai pani vizvAsaghAtI tathA kRtadhna vyaktilAI mana parAu~dainan |
tI mAnisaharUlAI anumati diiyo jasasita yuddha garincha, yasakAraNale ki unIharUmAthi atyAcAra gariyo | nissandeha allAha tinIharUko madata garna pUrNa sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

tI yastA vyaktiharU hun jo AphnA gharaharUbATa anAhakamA dhapAie, kevala yo bhanekAle– “allAha nai hAmrA pAlanakartA hun |” yadi allAhale kehI vyaktiharUdvArA anya kehI vyaktiharUko padacyUta garAenan bhane khAnakAhaharU girjAghara, (yahUdIharUko) upAsanA gRha ra (muslimaharUkA) masjidaharU, jahA~ ullekhyamAtrAmA allAhako nAmako japa huncha, yI sabailAI pUrNarUpale bhatkAine thiyo | allAha tI vyaktiharUko sahayoga garnechan jo unako madata garnechan | nissandeha allAha zaktizAlI evaM prabhutvazAlI chan |

yinIharU nai tI vyaktiharU hun jasalAI hAmIle dhartImA sattA pradAna garemA namAja kAyama garnechan, jakAta dinechan, satkarmako Adeza dinechan ra duSkarmabATa roknechan | ra, sampUrNa kAryaharUko pariNAma allAhakai hAtamA cha |
he nabI! yadi yI kAphiraharU timIlAI jhUTho ThaharyAu~chan bhane (Azcarya namAnnU) | yasaaghi pani nUha jAtikA, Ada tathA samUdale jhUTho ThaharyAisakekA chan|
ra, (tyastai) ibrAhIma tathA lUtakA jAtiharUle pani |
ra, madayanabAsIharUle pani | ra, mUsA pani jhUTho ThaharyAie | tara maile kAphiraharUlAI avasara pradAna gareM, pheri samAteM, ani hera kasto thiyo mero prakopa!

ra, katipaya yastA nagaraharU chan jasalAI hAmIle tinIharUle atyAcAra garirahekai avasthAmA naSTa pAridiyauM | ani tinIharU Aphnai chAnAharUmAthi ghopTo pArie | ra katipaya inAraharU bekAra chan tathA katipaya majabuta mahalaharU pani sunasAna chan |
ke tinIharUle dhartImA yAtrA garenan tAki tinIharUkA hRdaya bujhnevAlA vA kAna sunnevAlA hoUn? vAstavikatA ke cha bhane A~khAharU andhA hu~dainan apitu chAtIbhitra rahekA hRdaya andhA hunchan |
ra, yinIharU timIsita yAtanAkolAgi hatAra garirahekA chan | allAha Aphno vAcA kadApi toDdainan | timrA pAlanakartAko ekadina timIharUko gaNanAko ekahajAra varSasa~ga barAbara huncha |
katipaya nagaraharU jasalAI hAmIle atyAcArI bhaeko avasthAmA pani avasara pradAna garyauM, antata hAmIle samAtyauM | ra, (sabai) hAmItarpha nai pharkera Aunucha |
bhanideU– he mAnava ho! ma timIharUkAlAgi spaSTa rUpamA kevala sacetaka hu~ |
ataH juna vyaktiharUle ImAna lyAekA chan ra satkarma garekA chan unIharUkailAgi kSamAdAna cha ra sammAnita jIvikA pani |
ra, juna mAnisaharU hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI viphala tulyAune kuceSTA garchan tinIharU nai narakamA jAneharU hun |

timIbhandA pahile hAmIle juna rasUla vA nabIlAI paThAyauM, unIsita yo bhayo ki jaba unale (mArgadarzana garne) cAhanA gare zaitAnale unako kAmanAmA bAdhA utpanna garyo | tara zaitAnale jastosukai khaDA gareko bAdhAlAI allAhale haTAi dinchan | pheri allAhale AphnA AyataharUlAI sudRDha tulyAe | ra, allAha sarvajJa tathA tatvajJa chan |

(yasto kina huncha bhane) tAki zaitAnale utpanna gareko bAdhAlAI unI tI vyaktiharUkAlAgi parIkSA banAUn jasakA hRdayamA (kapaTako) roga lAgeko cha, ra jasakA hRdayaharU kaThora chan | ra nissandeha atyAcArIharU zatrutAmA nikai TADhAsamma pugekA chan |

ra, yasa uddezyale pani ki jJAna prApta vyaktiharUle vizvAsa garUn ki yo timrA pAlanakartAkai tarphabATa nitAnta satya ho | pheri unIharUle tyasamAthi ImAna lyAUn ra unIharUko hRdaya tyasatarpha jhukos | ra, jasale ImAna lyAu~chan unIharUlAI allAhale avazya sIdhA mArga dekhAu~chan |
ra, kAphiraharU yasa (kuraAna) ko bAremA sandehamA nai rahanechan yahA~samma ki yA ta tinIharUsamakSa akasmAt mahApralaya Aipugos vA tinIharUmAthi azubha dinako prakopa AilAgos |
tyo dina zAsana allAhakai hAtamA hunecha | unale tinIharUbIca nisApha garnechan | ani ImAna lyAune tathA satkarma garneharU ta vaibhavapUrNa svargamA jAnechan |
ra, jasale kuphra gare, ra hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare, tinIharUkAlAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA hunecha |
ra, juna vyaktiharUle allAhako mArgamA gharabAra tyAge pheri mArie vA mare tyastA vyaktiharUlAI allAhale avazya uttama jIvikA pradAna garnechan | ra, nissandeha allAha sarvazreSTha dAnazIla chan |
unale unIharUlAI avazya nai yasto sthAnamA praveza garAunechan jasalAI unIharUle mana parAunechan | ra, allAha sarvajJa tathA atyanta sahiSNu chan |

yo ta ho unIharUko pariNAma | ra, jo vyakti AphU jati satAieko thiyo tyatinai mAtrAmA badalA lincha ra tyasapachi usamAthi punaH atyAcAra garincha bhane allAhale nizcaya nai usalAI sahayoga garnechan | nissandeha allAha mApha garnevAlA tathA kSamAzIla chan |
yo yasakAraNale ki rAtabATa dina tathA dinabATa rAta nikAlne allAha nai hun | ra, nizcaya nai allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvadraSTA chan |
yo yasa kAraNale ki allAha nai nitAnta satya hun, ra unalAI choDI tinIharU juna cijalAI pukArchan tyo asatya ho | ra, nizcaya nai allAha sarvocca tathA mahAn chan |
ke timIle dekhenau ki allAhale AkAzabATa pAnI barsAu~chan ani bhUmi hariyo huna jAncha? nissandeha allAha sUkSmadarzI tathA susUcita chan |
unaikA hun AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa cijaharU ra vAstavamA allAha nispRha tathA svayaM prazaMsanIya chan |

ke timIle dekhenau ki allAhale nai dhartIkA sampUrNa cijaharUlAI timro adhInastha garekA chan, ra DuGgA pani juna unakai AdezabATa samudramA calne garcha | ra, unaile AkAzalAI yasarI thAmekA chan ki unako AdezabinA tyo pRthvImAthi khasna sakdaina | nissandeha allAha mAnavajAtiprati ati snehazIla ra ati karuNAmaya chan |
ra, unai hun jasale timIharUlAI jIvana pradAna gare | pheri mRtyu dinechan ra punaH jIvita pArnechan | vAstavamA mAnava kRtaghna cha|

hareka samudAyakAlAgi hAmIle upAsanAko tarIkA nirdhAraNa garekA chauM jasako tinIharU pAlanA garne garchan | ataH (he nabI!) tinIharUle yasa mAmilAmA timIsita vivAda nagarUn | ra, timI AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha mAnisaharUlAI bolAU | nissandeha timI sIdhA mArgamA chau |
ra, yadi tinIharUle timIsita vivAda garchan bhane bhanideU–“allAha timIharukA kriyAkalApaharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |”
allAha mahApralayako dina timIharUle matabheda garne garekA kurAharUbAre timIharUbIca nirNaya garnechan |
ke timIlAI thAhA bhaena ki allAha AkAza tathA pRthvIkA sampUrNa cijaharUbAre jJAna rAkhdachan | yI sabai lipibaddha chan | ra, yo kArya allAhakAlAgi ati sahaja rahekocha |

ani, yI vyaktiharUle allAhalAI choDI jasako pUjA garirahekAchan tyasabAre allAhale kunai pramANa avatIrNa garekA chainan ra na tyasabAre tinIharUlAI kunai jJAna pani chaina | ra, atyAcArIharUko kohI sahayogI hune chaina |

ra, jaba yinIharUlAI hAmrA AyataharU spaSTa rUpamA paDhera sunAincha taba yI kAphiraharUko anuhAramA aruciko cinha spaSTarUpamA dekhchau | ra, yinIharU hAmrA AyataharU sunAune vyaktiharUmAthi mAnAAaiM aAkramaNa garnechan | bhanideU– “ke ma timIharUlAI tyasabhandA nikRSTa kurAko khabara diU~? tyo Ago ho jasako vAcA allAhale kAphiraharUsita garekA chan, ra tyo ati nikRSTa bAsasthAna ho |”

he mAnava ho! euTA udAharaNa bayAna garincha; yasalAI dhyAnapUrvaka suna | allAhalAI choDI timIharU jasalAI pukArchau, tinIharUle euTA jhiGgAsamma sRSTi garna sakdainan, cAhe tyasakonimti tinIharU sabai ekajuTa nai kina nahoUn | ra, kunai jhiGgAle tinIharUko kunai vastu khosera lagemA tinIharUle tyasabATa tyo vastu pani chuTAuna sakdainan | sahAyatA mAgnevAlA pani durbala ra josita sahAyatA mAgincha tyo pani durbala!
tinIharUle allAhako tyo kadara garna jAndai jAnenan juna tinIharUle garnuparne thiyo | nizcaya nai allAha sarvazaktimAna tathA prabhutvazAlI chan |
allAha nai phariztAharU tathA mAnisaharU madhyebATa sandezavAhaka chAnne garchan | nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA ra sarvadraSTA chan |
allAha rAmrarI jAndachan juna tinIharUko agADi cha ra juna tinIharUko pachADi cha | ra, sabai mAmilAharU allAhatarpha nai pharkAinechan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! rukUa ra sajdA garne gara tathA AphnA pAlanakartAko upAsanA gara, ra pUNyakarma gara tAki timIharU saphala huna saka |

ra, allAhako mArgamA tyasarI nai jihAda gara jasarI jihAda garnu parne ho | unale timIharUlAI chAnekA chan | ra, dharmamA unale timIharUmAthi kunai kaThinAi rAkhekA chainan | timrA pUrvaja ibrAhImako panthalAI mana parAekA chan | unale yasabhandA aghi timIharUko nAma muslima (AjJAkArI) rAkhekA thie | ra, yasa (kuraAna) mA pani timIharUko yahI nAma cha, tAki rasUla timIharUkA sAkSI banUn ra timIharU sampUrNa mAnava jAtikA sAkSI bana | ataH namAja kAyama gara, jakAta deU, ra allAhalAI dRDhatApUrvaka samAta | unI timIharUkA svAmI hun | kati uttama svAmI hun unI ra kati uttama sahayogI!
nizcaya nai mominaharUle saphalatA prApta gare|
jo AphnA namAjamA atyantai vinamratA avalambana garchan|
ra vyartha kurAharUbATa vimukha chan|
ra jakAta cuktA garchana|
ra AphnA guptAGgaharUko surakSA garchan|
sivAya AphnA patnIharU tathA adhInamA rahekA dAsIharU jasasa~ga sambandha rAkhdA unIharU nindanIya hu~dainan |
tara juna vyaktiharU tyasabAhekako AkAMkSA rAkhchan tinIharU sImA ullaGghanakArIharU hun |
ra,jo Aphno nAso tathA vAcAko pAlanA garchan|
ra jo AphnA namAjaharUko rakSA garchan|
tyastA vyaktiharU nai vAstavika uttarAdhikArI hun |
jo phirdosakA uttarAdhikArI hunechan jahA~ unIharU sadA rahanechan |
nissandeha hAmIle manuSyalAI mAToko sAra (nicoDa) bATa sRSTi garyauM |
pheri tyasalAI vIryako thopAsvarUpa euTA surakSita sthAnamA rAkhyauM |

ani vIryalAI Dhikko ragata banAyauM ra tyasa Dhikko ragatalAI mAsuko Dallo banAyauM ani mAsuko DallolAI haDDI banAyauM | ra, hAmIle tyasa haDDImA mAsu caDhAyauM | ani hAmIle tyasalAi arkai sarjana rUpa khiera khaDA garyauM | ataH barakatayukta chan allAha jo sarvottama sRSTikartA hun |
tyasapachi timIharU avazya marnuparnecha |
ani punaH mahApralayako dina timIharU uThAinechau |
hAmIle timIharUmAthi sAtavaTA AkAzaharU sRjanA garekA chauM ra hAmI sRSTibATa anabhijJa chainauM |
ra, AkAzabATa hAmIle ThIka parimANamA pAnI barsAyauM ra tyasalAI dhartImA aDyAyauM | ra, hAmI tyasalAI samApta pArna pani sakSama chauM |
pheri tyasabATa hAmIle khajUra tathA aMgurakA bagaiMcAharU umAryauM | tyasamA timIharUkAnimti dherai svAdiSTa phala sRjanA garyauM ani tyasaibATa timIharU khAnchau |
ra, tUre sainA (nAmaka pahADa) mA umrane tyo (jaitunakAe) vRkSalAI pani (hAmIle nai umAryauM) jasale khAneharUkAlAgi tela ra tarakArI dinchan |

ra, janAvaraharUmA pani timIharUkAlAgi ThUlo zikSA raheko cha | tinIharukA peTamA rahekA padArthabATa piune dUdha pradAna garchauM ra tinIharumA timIharUkAlAgi anya dherai phAidAharU chan | ra, tinIharUmadhye kehIlAI (timI) khAnchau pani |
ra, ti (janAvara)harumAthi tathA Du~gAharUmAthi savAra garAinchau |

ra, hAmIle nUhalAI unako samudAyatarpha paThAyauM | ani unale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhu ho! kevala allAhako upAsanA gara | unIbAheka timIharUkA arU kohI upAsya chaina | ke timIharU Izabhaya rAkhdainau?”

ani unakA samudAyakA kAphira aguvAharUle bhane– “yo kevala timIharUjastai euTA mAnche ho | yasale timIharUmAthi zreSThatA prApta garna cAhancha | yadi allAhale cAhekA bhae phariztAharUlAI paThAune thie | yo kurA hAmIle hAmrA pahilekA purkhA harUbATa sunekai thienauM |”
yo vyakti (nUha) unmatta bhaeko cha | ataH yasako sambandhamA kehI samaya parkha |
nUhale bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA! mero maddata gara” kinaki tinIharUle malAI jhuTho Thahara garekA chan |

ani hAmIle unItarpha prakAzanA paThAyauM ki hAmrai A~khA agADi ra hAmro prakAzanA anusAra DuGgA banAU | jaba hAmro Adeza Au~cha ra tannUra (bATa pAnIkA muhAna) phuTnechan taba timI hareka prakArakA prANIharUbATa eka joDI (bhAle ra pothI) lAI ra timro parivArakA sadasyaharUlAI DuGgAmA savAra garAU, sivAya tI vyaktiharUlAI jasabAre (vinAzako) Adeza bhaisakeko cha | ra, atyAcArI vyaktiharUbAre masita kunai bintI nagara | tinIharU sabai DubAinechan |
ra, jaba timI ra timrA sAthIharU pUrNarUpale DuGgAmA santuSTa bhaera baschau taba prArthanA gara– “sampUrNa prazaMsA unai allAhakAlAgi hun jasale hAmIlAI atyAcArI vyaktiharUbATa bacAe |”
ani, (prArthanAmA yo pani) bhannU ki– “he merA pAlanakartA! malAI barakatayukta sthAnamA orAla ra timI rAmro orAlnevAlA hau |”
nizcaya nai yasamA dherai nizAnIharU chan ra parIkSA ta hAmI line nai garchauM |
pheri unIharUpachi hAmIle anya samudAyaharU sRSTi garyauM |
ra, tinIharUkahA~ tinIharUmadhyekai ekajanA rasUlalAI paThAyauM (jasale bhane)– kevala allAhako upAsanA gara | unIbAheka timIharUko kohI upAsya chaina | ke timIharU DarAu~dainau?

unIharUko samudAyakA kAphira evaM paralokako sAkSatkAralAI mithyA ThAnne aguvAharU, jasalAI hAmIle laukika jIvanamA dhana–sampattile sampanna garekA thiyauM, le (IzadUtabAre) bhane– “yo ta timIharUjastai kevala eka mAnisa ho | usale tyahI cija khAncha juna timIharU khAnchau ra tyahI piu~cha juna timIharU piu~chau |”
ra, yadi timIharUle AphUjastai euTA mAnisako anusaraNa garyau bhane timIharU avazyai ghATAgrasta hunechau |
“ke usale timIharUlAI yasa kurAbATa DarAu~cha ki jaba timIharU marchau ra mATo tathA haDDI bhaisakchau taba timIharU (cihAnabATa) nikAlinechau?”
timIharUlAI diine yo dhamkI ati nai TADhA (asambhava) cha |
je cha hAmro saMsArako jIvana cha jahA~ hAmI marne ra jIune garchauM | ra, hAmro pUnarjanma kadApi hunechaina |
yo ta euTA yasto vyakti ho jasale allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa gareko cha ra hAmI usalAI kadApi mAnne chainauM |
IzadUtale prArthanA gare– “he merA pAlanakartA! mero maddata gara kinaki tinIharUle malAI jhuTho Thahara gare |”
allAhale bhane– “cA~Dai nai tinIharU pachutAunechan |”
antataH eka sAMcAe vAcA anusAra tinIharUlAI caTyAGgale samAtyo | hAmIle tinIharUlAI phyAkeko phohora banAidiyauM | ataH barabAdI cha atyAcArI vyaktiharUko |
tinIharUpachi hAmIle pheri arU samudAyaharU sRSTi garyauM |
kunai samudAya Aphno nirdhArita samayabhandA na pahilA samApta huncha na pachisamma bA~kI rahancha |

ani hAmIle nirantara AphnA rasUlaharU paThAyauM | jaba–jaba kunai samudAyamA rasUla Ae; tinIharUle unalAI mithyA Thahara gare | ani hAmIle ekapachi arkolAI naSTa garidiyauM, ra tinIharU sabailAI kathA nai banAichoDyauM | ataH barabAdI hos ImAna nalyAune vyaktiharUko |
ani hAmIle (sandeSTA) mUsA tathA unakA bhAi hArunalAI AphnA nizAnIharU tathA spaSTa pramANasahita paThAyauM|
phiraauna tathA usakA darabArIyAharUtarpha | tara tinIharUle ghamaNDa gare kinaki tinIharU ati ghamaNDI thie |
tinIharUle bhane– “ke hAmI AphUjastai duI vyaktimAthi ImAna lyAauM jabaki tinIharukA samudAya hAmro mAtahatamA chan?”
ani tinIharUle tI duvailAI mithyA Thahara gare | phalasvarUpa naSTa huneharUmadhye huna puge |
ra, hAmIle mUsAlAI grantha pradAna garyauM, tAki mAnisaharUle satmArga prApta garUn |
ani, hAmIle maryamakA putra tathA unakI AmAlAI nizAnI banAyauM, ra duvailAI euTA zAnta evaM pAnIko mUla tathA dhArA bhaeko uccasthAnamA Azraya diyauM |
he rasUlaharU ho! pavitra cijaharU khAU, ra satkarma gara | timIharU je garchau ma tyo rAmrarI jAndachu |
ani, yo timIharUko samudAya euTai samudAya ho, ra ma timIharUkA pAlanakartA hu~, ani kevala masita DarAU |
tara tinIharUle Aphno dhArmika mAmilAlAI ApasamA chinnabhinna pAre | pratyeka saMpradAyasa~ga jejati cha tinamai magna raheko cha|
ataH choDideU tinIharUlAI, DubirahUn Aphno madamatta avasthAmA eka vizeSa avadhisamma |
ke tinIharU ThAndachan ki hAmIle tinIharUko sampatti ra santAnamA juna vRddhi garirahekA chauM,
hAmIle zIghratApUrvaka tinIharUko bhalAi garirahekA chauM? hoina, tinIharU bujhdainan |
vAstavamA juna vyaktiharU AphnA pAlanakartAko ravAphale trasita rahanchan,
ra juna vyaktiharU AphnA rabakA AyataharUmAthi AsthA rAkhdachan,
ra juna vyaktiharU AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga arU kasailAI sAjhedAra ThaharyAu~dainan,
ra juna vyaktiharU juna sampatti dinchan jaba ki unakA hRdaya AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha pharkanuparne kurAle bhayabhita rahancha,
tyastA vyaktiharU nai bhalAItarpha lamkane hun, ra yinai hun bhalAImA sabaibhandA agADi niskane |
ra, kasaimAthi hAmI usako sAmarthyabhandA adhika bojha thupArdainau | ra, hAmIsita euTA yasto pustaka cha jasale ThIka–ThIka kurA batAunecha | ra, tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra hune chaina |
baru yinIharUkA hRdayaharu yasa mAmilAprati madamatta avasthAmA chan | ra, tyasabAheka tinIharUkA anya kAryaharU pani chan jasamA tinIharU lipta chan |
yahA~samma ki jaba hAmIle tinIharUmadhye sampanna vyaktiharUlAI prakopadvArA samAtnechauM taba tinIharU cicyAunechan |
Aja nacicyAU! timIharUlAI hAmIbATa kunai sahayoga prApta hune chaina |
jaba merA AyataharU pATha garI timIharUlAI sunAinthyo taba timIharU piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgne garthyAai,
ghamaNDa gardai ra yasalAI dantya kathA bhandai choDne garthyAai |
ke tinIharUle yasa vANImA vicAra garenan? vA ke tinIharUsamakSa kunai yasto vastu Ayo juna tinIharUkA pUrvajasamakSa Aeko thiena?
vA ke tinIharUle AphnA rasUlalAI cinenan ki unalAI asvIkAra gare?
vA, ke yo bhanchan ki usamAthi unmAda savAra cha? baru unale tinIharUsamakSa satya liera AekA chan tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza vyaktiharU satyalAI ghRNA garchan |

ra, yadi nitAnta satya tinIharUkA kuabhilASAharUko anusAra bhaeko bhae, AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI evaM tinIharUbIca rahekA sampUrNa cija asta–vyasta hune thie | baru hAmIle tinIharUsamakSa tinIharUkai upadeza (grantha) puryAidiekA chauM tara tinIharU bhane Aphnai upadezabATa vimukha bhairahekA chan |
ke timI tinIharUsita kunai pArizramika mAgdaichau? timrolAgi ta timrA pAlanakartAkai pratidAna uttama cha, ra unI nai sarvottama jIvikA pradAnakartA hun |
nizcaya nai timIle unIharUlAI sIdhA mArgatarpha AhvAna garirahekA chau |
nissandeha juna vyaktiharU paralokamA AsthA rAkhdainan tinIharU sIdhA mArgabATa haTekA vyaktiharU hun |
ra, yadi hAmIle tinIharUmAthi dayA gareko bhae, ra tinIharUkA saGkaTaharU samApta pAreko bhae pani tinIharU uddaNDatAmA jiddI garI rumallirahekA hunethie |
tara, hAmIle tinIharUlAI prakopadvArA samAtyauM taipani tinIharU AphnA pAlanakartAsAmu na jhuke ra na bilaunA nai gare |
yahA~samma ki jaba hAmIle tinIharUmAthi kaThora prakopako DhokA kholidiyauM tyasabelA tinIharU nirAza bhae |
ra, unai hun jasale timIharUkA lAgi kAna, A~khA ra hRdayako sRjanA gare | tara, timIharU kamai kRtajJatA prakaTa garchau |
ani, unai hun jasale timIharUlAI dhartImA phailAe, ra unIsamakSa nai timIharU ekatrita pArinechau |
unI nai timIharUlAI jIvanadAna garchan ra mRtyu dinchan | ani, rAta tathA dinako parivartana unakai hAtamA cha | ke timIharU vivekale kAma lidainau?
baru tinIharUle tyastai kurA gare jasto kurA pahilekA mAnisaharUle garne garthe |
tinIharUle bhane– “ke jaba hAmI marchauM ani mATo ra haDDI bhaisakchauM taba hAmIlAI jIvita pArI uThAinecha ta?”
yasaaghi yasai kurAko dhamkI hAmIlAI ra hAmrA pUrvajaharUlAI pani diieko thiyo | yo ta prAcIna mAnisaharUkA kathAbAheka kehI pani hoina |
bhana– “yadi timIharU jAnakArI rAkhchau bhane, pRthvI tathA tyasamA rahekA cijaharU kasakA hun?”
tinIharUle bhannechan– “allAhakA |” bhana– “ani timIharU upadeza kina grahaNa gardainau ta?”
bhana– “sAta AkAza tathA mahAn siMhAsanakA svAmI ko hun ta?”
turuntai bhannechan– “allAha!” bhana– “ani timIharU kina DarAu~dainau ta?”
bhana– “yadi timIharU jAnakArI rAkhchau bhane, sampUrNa cijaharUko akhtiyAra kasako hAtamA cha, ra unI ko hun jasale zaraNa dinchan tara unako dA~jomA kasaile zaraNa dina sakdaina?”
tinIharUle bhannechan– “allAha!” bhanideU– “pheri timIharU kahA~bATa jAdUpIDita hunchau ta?”
vAstavikatA yo ho ki hAmIle tinIharUsamakSa nitAnta satya lyAekA chauM ra nissandeha tinIharU jhUThA hun |

allAhale na kasailAI putra banAekA chan, na unakAsAtha anya kohI pUjya nai raheko cha | yasto bhaeko bhae, pratyeka pUjya Aphno sRSTilAI liera alaggine thiyo ra tinIharU ekaarkomAthi jAilAgne thie | allAha tI kurAharUbATa pavitra chan juna tinIharU varNana garne garchan|
unI adRzya tathA dRzyakA jJAtA hun | ra, tinIharUle garne garekA zirkabATa nikai ucca chan |
(he muhammada sa.!) prArthanA gara– “he merA pAlanakartA! yadi adharmIharUlAI diieko dhamkI mero upasthitimA Au~cha bhane,
he merA pAlanakartA! malAI atyAcArI mAnisaharUmA sAmela nagarnu |
ra, (he muhammada sa.!) juna dhamkI hAmIle tinIharUlAI diirahekA chauM tyo timro sAmunne nai lyAune pUrNa sAmarthya rAkhdachauM |
nikRSTa kurAko nivAraNa uttama tarIkAle gara | tinIharUle garne garekA kurAsa~ga hAmI rAmrarI avagata chauM |
ra, bhana– “he merA pAlanakartA! zaitAnaharUkA gopya kupreraNAbATa ma timro zaraNa cAhanchu |”
ra he pAlanakartA! tinIharU merA nikaTa AulAn ki bhanI ma timro zaraNa cAhanchu |”
yahA~samma ki jaba tinIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyu nikaTa Au~cha taba usale bhancha, he pAlanakartA! malAI pheri pharkAideU,

tAki AphUle choDI Aeko saMsAramA gaera kehI satkarma garU~ | kadApi hAeina | yo ta usale Aphno mukhabATa bhaneko kurA mAtra ho | aba yinIharUkApachADi euTA barjakha (pardA) hunecha tyasa dinasammakAlAgi juna dina yinIharUlAI pheri uThAinecha |
ani jaba sUra phukinecha taba na tinIharUbIca kunai nAtA kAyama rahanecha, na eka arkAlAI sodhakhoja garnechan |
tyasasamaya jasako puNyakarmako pallA bhArI hunecha vAstavamA unIharU nai saphala hunechan |
ra, jasako puNyakarmako pallA haluko hunecha tinIharU nai svayaMlAI hAni puryAuneharU hun, ani tinIharU sadA narakamA rahanechan |
Agole tinIharUkA muhAra polnecha ra tyahA~ tinIharU kurUpa hunechan |
ke timIharUsamakSa merA AyataharU pATha garera sunAidainathyo ra? taipani timIharU tyasalAI mithyA Thahara garthyAe |
tinIharUle javApha dinechan– he pAlanakartA! hAmro durbhAgya hAmImAthi chAeko thiyo ra vAstavamA hAmI pathabhraSTa thiyauM |
he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI yasabATa nikAla | hAmIle pheri yastai garyauM bhane hAmI avazya nai atyAcArI hunechauM |
allAhale bhannechan– “timIharU apamAnakA sAtha yasaimA basa ra masita kurA nagara |”
merA bhaktaharUko euTA samUhale lagAtAra yahI bhaneko thiyo– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIle ImAna lyAekA chauM | ataH hAmIlAI kSamA gara ra hAmImAthi dayA gara | timI sarvazreSTha dayAvAna hau |”
timIharUle unIharUsita ThaTTA garyau yahA~samma ki yasa kAryale timIharUbATa mero smaraNalAI pani bhulAyo ra timIharU unIharUlAI sadhaiM hA~soko pAtra banAune garthyAe |
Aja maile unIharUlAI unako dhairyako pratidAna diisakeko chu | nissandeha, unIharU nai saphala chan |
allAhale sodhnechan– “batAU, dhartImA timIharU kati varSa basyau?”
tinIharUle bhannechan– “hAmI eka dina vA dinako kehI aMza mAtra tyahA~ rahekA thiyauM | gaNanA rAkhneharUsita sodhnu |”
allAhale bhannechan– “timIharU vAstavamA dherai kama avadhisamma rahekA thiyau | timIharUle yo kurA jAneko bhae!
ataH ke hAmIle timIharUlAI vyartha sRSTi garekA chauM? ra, timIharU hAmItarpha pharkera Aune chainau bhanI ThAnekA chau?
ataH vAstavika samrATa allAha sarvocca chan | unIbAheka kohI pUjya chainan | unI nai mahimAzAlI siMhAsanakA svAmI hun |

ra, jasale allAhakA sAtha anya upAsyalAI pukArcha jasako Usita kunai pramANa chaina, tyasa vyaktiko hisAba usakA pAlanakartAkahA~ huncha | nissandeha adharmIharU kadApi saphalatA prApta garna sakdainan |
ra, allAhasita prArthanA gara– “he raba! kSamA pradAna gara ra dayA gara | timI sarvazreSTha dayAvAna chau |
yo euTA sUraha ho juna hAmIle avataraNa garekA chauM | yasalAI hAmIle anivArya garekA chauM ra yasamA hAmIle spaSTa AdezaharU avataraNa garekA chauM tAki timIharU zikSA grahaNa gara |

vyabhicAriNI mahilA tathA vyabhicArI puruSa duvaimadhye pratyekalAI saya korrA lagAU | ra, yadi timIharU allAha tathA antima dinamAthi ImAna rAkhchau bhane allAhako vidhAna lAgU gardA duvaiko mAyAmohale bAdhA napuryAos ra tinIharUko daNDako samayamA mominaharUko euTA jamAta tyahA~ upasthita rahos |,

vyabhicArI vyaktile kevala kunai vyabhicArI vA bahudevavAdI mahilAsita vivAha garcha | ra, vyabhicArI strIle kevala kunai vyabhicArI vA bahudevavAdI puruSasita vivAha garche | ra, yo mominaharUkAnimti avaidha garieko cha |

ra, jasale pavitra AcAraNa bhaekI mahilAharUmAthi Aropa lagAu~chan ani cArajanA sAkSI peza garna sakdainan, tinIharUlAI assI korrA lagAU | ra, tinIharUko gavAhI kahilyai svIkAra nagara | ra, tinIharU nai hun avajJAkArIharU|
sivAya tI vyaktiharUko jo tyasapachi prAyazcita garchan ra Aphno sudhAra garchan | allAha sA~ccikai parama kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

ra, kunai vyaktiharUle AphnA patnIharUmAthi Aropa lagAu~chan tara tinIharUsita AphUbAheka kohI sAkSI chaina bhane, tinIharUmadhye eka (pati) ko gavAhI hunecha ki usale cArapaTaka allAhako kasama khAera bhanos ki nizcayapUrvaka U satyavAdIharUmadhye ho |
ra, pA~cauM paTaka yo bhanos ki yadi U mithyAvAdIharUmadhye ho bhane usamAthi allAhako abhizApa paros |
ra, tyasa mahilAko daNDa yasarI nivAraNa huna sakcha ki usale cAra paTaka allAhako kasama khAera bhanos– “nizcaya nai unI (usako pati) jhUThAharUmadhyekA hun |”
ra, pA~cauM paTaka yo bhanos ki yadi unI (pati) satya hun bhane mamAthi allAhako prakopa paros |”
ra, yadi timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA ra unako dayA nabhaeko bhae (ke hunthyo?) | nizcaya nai allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM tatvajJa rahekA chan |

Aropa lagAune vyaktiharU timIharUmadhyekai euTA samUha ho | yasalAI AphnolAgi narAmro naThAna baru yo timIharUkAlAgi rAmro ho | tinIharUmadhye jasale jati pApa Arjana garlA tyasamAthi tyati nai prakopa rahekocha | ra, jasale yasamA ThUlo bhUmikA nibhAyo usako lAgi kaThora yAtanA rahekocha |

(he aAsthAvAnaharU hAe) jaba timIharUle yo kurA sunyau taba timIharUmadhye momina puruSa tathA mahilAharUle Aphno manamA sakArAtmaka dhAraNA kina rAkhenan, ra kina bhanenan ki yo ta khullA abhiyoga ho?

mithyAropaNa garne vyaktiharUle Aphno kurA (pramANita garna) ko lAgi kina cArajanA sAkSI prastuta garenan ta? tinIharUle sAkSI prastuta garna nasakeko hunAle allAhako dRSTimA tinIharU nai mithyAvAdI hun |
loka tathA paralokamA timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA tathA unako dayA nabhaeko bhae juna kurAmA timIharU parekA thiyau tyasale gardA timIharUlAI kaThora yAtanAle chune thiyo |

smaraNa gara jaba tyasalAI timIharU Aphno jibrole phailAirahekA thiyau ra timIharU AphnA mukhale tyo kurA garirahekA thiyau jasako timIharUlAI kehI jJAna nai thiena | timIharU tyasalAI sAdhAraNa kurA ThAnthyau, jabaki tyo allAhako dRSTimA ThUlo (aparAdha) thiyo |
ra timIharUle yo sunne bittikai kina yasto bhanenau– “yasako carcA garnu hAmronimti ucita chaina | (he allAha!) timI pavitra chau | yo ta euTA mahAabhiyoga ho |”
allAhale timIharUlAI upadeza dinchan– “yadi timIharU momina hau bhane yasa kisimako kurA kahilyai nadohoryAunU |”
ra, allAhale timIharUkAlAgi AphnA AyataharUlAI spaSTa rUpamA bayAna gardachan ra allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvajJa chan |
ImAna lyAuneharUbIca azlIlatA phailiyos bhanI cAhanA rAkhne vyaktiharUkAlAgi loka tathA paraloka duvaimA dukhadAyI yAtanA raheko cha | allAha jAndachan tara timIharU cAhi~ jAndainau |
ra, timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA tathA unako dayA nabhaeko bhae (timIharUle duSpariNAma bhogne nai thiyau) tara allAha ati mamatAmaya evaM dayAlu chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! zaitAnakA padacinhaharUko anusaraNa nagara | jasale usako anusaraNa garnecha zaitAnale usalAI azlIla tathA anaitika kAryakai parAmarza dinecha | ra, yadi timIharUmAthi allAhako kRpA tathA dayA nabhaeko bhae timIharUmadhye kohI pani kahilyai zuddha huna sakne thienauM | tara, allAha jasalAI cAhanchan, zuddhatA pradAna garchan | ra, allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

timIharUmadhye jo sampanna tathA sAmarthyavAn chau tinIharUle nAtedAra, abhAvagrasta tathA allAhako mArgamA hijrata garne (arthAt gharabAra tyAgne) vyaktiharUlAI sahayoga nagarne kasama nakhAUn, baru unIharUle mAphI diUn ra bevAstA gara| ke allAha timIharUlAI kSamA garUn bhanne kurA cA~hadainau? ra, allAha ta ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
vAstavamA svacchara khulA manakI momina mahilAharUmAthi jasale (vyabhicArako) Aropa lagAu~chan tinIharUmAthi loka tathA paralokamA dhikkAra cha | ra, tinIharUkAlAgi ThUlo yAtanA raheko cha |
smaraNa gara tyo dina jaba tinIharUkA jibrA, hAta tathA khuTTAharUle tinIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbAre tinIharUkai viruddha sAkSI dinechan |
tyasadina allAhale tinIharUlAI pUrA–pUrA pratiphala dinechan, ra tinIharU jAnnechan ki allAha nai spaSTa tathA nitAnta satya hun |

caritrahIna strIharU caritrahIna puruSaharUkAlAgi hun, tathA caritrahIna puruSaharU caritrahIna strIharUkAlAgi hun | ra, saccaritra strIharU saccaritra puruSa tathA saccaritra puruSa saccaritra strIharUkA lAgi hun | yI (saccaritra) mAnisaharU tinIharUle lagAirahekA AropaharUbATa mukta rahekA chan | yastA vyaktiharUkAlAgi nai kSamAdAna tathA ijjatako rojI pani raheko cha |,

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! AphnA gharaharUbAheka anya gharaharUmA anumati binA ra tyahA~ basne vyaktiharUlAI salAma nagarIkana praveza nagara | yo timIharUkAlAgi rAmro ho | AzA cha ki timIharUle yasalAI dhyAnamA rAkhnechau |

yadi tyahA~ timIharUle kasailAI upasthita pAenau bhane timIharUlAI anumati nadiuJjela tyahA~ praveza nagara | ra, yadi timIharUlAI pharkera jAU bhanera bhanincha bhane pharkera jAU | timIharUkAnimti yo vizuddha vidhI ho | ra, timIharUle garne garekA kAryasa~ga allAha avagata chan |

yastA khAlI gharaharU jasamA timIharUkA sAmAnaharU rAkhiekA chan, tyasamA praveza garyau bhane timIharUlAI kunai pApa lAgne chaina | ra, timIharUle dekhAune tathA lukAune sabai cija allAha jAndachan |

(he sandeSTA!) momina puruSaharUlAI AphnA dRSTiharUlAI niyantrita rAkhna tathA AphnA guptAGgaharUko rakSA garna Adeza deU | yo unIharUkAlAgi vizuddha tarikA ho | unIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUsita allAha avagata chan |

ra, momina strIharUlAI bhana ki unIharU AphnA dRSTiharUlAI niyantrita rAkhUn, AphnA guptAGgaharUko rakSA garUn ra Aphno zrRMgAra pradarzana nagarUn, tyasabAheka juna svayaM jAhera bhaeko huncha | ra, AphnA bakSasthalalAI AphnA pachyaurAle DhAkera rAkhUn ani Aphno zrRMgAra jAhera nagarUn, sivAya AphnA pati, pitA, sasurA, putraharU, patikA putraharU, dAjubhAiharU, bhatijAharU, bhAJjAharU, AphnA mahilAharU, dAsa–dAsIharU, mAtahatamA rahekA kAmecchArahita puruSaharU ra tI bAlakaharUkAsAmu jo mahilAharUkA guptAGgaharUbAre anabhijJa chan | ra, AphnA khuTTA bajArdai nahiDUn ki unIharUle lukAekA zrRMgArabAre jAniyos | he mominaharU ho! timIharU sabai allAhatarpha pharka tAki saphala huna saka |

ra, timIharUmadhye jo avivAhita chan ra timIharUkA dAsa–dAsImadhye jo yAegya chan, (tinIharU) ko vivAha garAideU | yadi unIharU gariba chan bhane allAhale Aphno kRpAdvArA unIharUlAI dhanavAna banAidinechan | ra, allAha parama vizAla evaM sarvajJa chan |

vivAhako sAmarthya narAkhne vyaktiharU Aphno caritralAI jogAUna yahA~samma ki unIharUlAI allAhale Aphno varadAnabATa sampanna banAidiUn, ra timIharUkA juna dAsaharU (muktikolAgi) likhita samjhautA garna cAhanchan unIharUlAI samjhautApatra lekhideU, yadi timIharUle unIharUmA bhalAI dekhchau bhane | ra, allAhale timIharUlAI pradAna garekA sampattibATa unIharUlAI pani deU | ra, AphnA dAsIharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanako lAbha prApta garna vyabhicArakolAgi vivaza napAra, jabaki unIharU svayaM pavitra rahana cAhanchan | ra, kasaile tinIharUlAI vivaz tulyAu~cha bhane unIharUlAI vivaza gariepachi allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ani, hAmIle timIharUsamakSa spaSTa AyataharU ra timIharUbhandA pahile bitekA samudAyaharUko vRttAnta tathA Izabhaya rAkhneharUkAlAgi upadeza avatIrNa garekA chauM |

allAha nai AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA jyoti hun | unako jyotiko udAharaNa yasto cha jasto euTA khopo cha jasamA euTA dIyo cha, tyo dIyo pAnasabhitra cha, tyo pAnasa euTA camkilo tArAjhaiM prajvalita cha, juna (dIyo) jaitunako yasto pavitra vRkSako telale bAlincha juna na pUrvIya ho na pazcimI; jasako tela svayaM prajvalita cha yadyapi tyasalAI agnile nachoeko hos | jyotimAthi jyoti cha | allAha jasalAI cAhanchan Aphno jyotiko mArgadarzana dinchan, ra allAha mAnisaharUlAI bujhAunako lAgi udAharaNaharU dinchan | ra, allAha pratyeka vastuko jJAna rAkhdachan |
yastA gharaharUmA jasalAI allAhale ucca pArne ra jasamA Aphno nAmako smaraNa garne Adeza diekA chan | jasamA bihAna, belukI allAhako nAmako guNagAna garchan,

tyastA vyaktiharU jasalAI allAhako smaraNa garna, namAja kAyama garna, jakAta dinabATa na vyApArale, ra na ta kinabecale nai bhulAu~cha | unIharU tyasa dinasa~ga DarAu~chan juna dina hRdaya tathA netraharU vikSubdha hunechan,

tAki allAhale unIharUlAI unIharUle garekA kAryaharUko sarvottama pratidAna pradAna garUn, ra Aphno kRpAle thapa (pratidAna) pradAna garUn | ra, allAha jasalAI cAhanchan behisAba jIvikA pradAna garchan |

ra, kAphiraharUkA kAryaharU sukhkhA marUbhUmiko mRgatRSNAjhaiM chan, jasalAI euTA tirkhAeko vyaktile pAnI ThAncha, tara jaba U tyahA~ pugcha tyahA~ kehI pani pAu~daina, baru usale tyahA~ allAhalAI upasthita pAu~cha | ra, u usako hisAba cuktA garidinchan, kinabhane allAha hisAba line kAmamA ati chiTo chan |

vA (tinIharUkA kAmaharUko udAharaNa) gahiro samudrako andhakAraharUjhaiM raheko cha, jasalAI euTAmAthi arko laharale Dhapakka DhAkekocha, ra tyasamAthi bAdala lAgekocha; andhakAramAthi andhakAra cha ki yadi Aphnai hAta nikAlyo bhane pani tyasalAI dekhna sakidaiMna | ra, jasalAI allAhale prakAza pradAna gardainan, uskAelAgi kunai prakAza hudaina|

ke timIlAI thAhA chaina ki AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa prANIharUle tathA pakheTA phailAekA paMkSIharUle pani allAhako mahimAgAna garchan? pratyekale A–Aphno prArthanA tathA mahimAgAnako tarIkA jAndachan | ra, tinIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUsa~ga allAha jAnakAra chan |
AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko rAjya allAhakai ho, ra (sabai) allAhatarpha nai pharkera jAnu cha |

ke timIle dekhenAai ki allAhale nai bAdalalAI calAu~chan, ani tinIharUlAI ApasamA joDchan tathA tinIharUlAI tahamAthi taha banAera rAkhchan, ra tyasakai bIcabATa timIle pAnI pareko dekhchau? ra, unI AkAzamA raheko (asinAko) pahADabATa asinA barsAu~chan | allAhale jasalAI cAhanchan tyasadvArA hAni puryAu~chan ra jasabATa cAhanchan tyasalAI panchAi dinchan | tyasako bijulIko camakale dekhne zakti nai laijAlA jasto huncha |
rAta tathA dinalAI allAha nai parivartana garirahanchan | dRSTivAna vyaktiharUkAlAgi yasamA nizcaya nai ThUlo zikSA raheko cha |

ra, hareka jantulAI allAhale pAnIbATa sRSTi garekA hun | tinIharUmadhye kehI Aphno peTale ghisrinchan, kehI duI khuTTAle hi~Dchan ra kehI cAhi~ cAra khuTTAle | allAha je cAhanchan tyahI sRSTi garchan | nissandeha allAha pratyeka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
nissandeha hAmIle spaSTa pArne AyataharU avataraNa garekA chauM | ra, allAha jasalAI cAhanchan sIdhAmArga dekhAu~chan |

ani, tinIharU (kapaTIharU) bhanchan– “hAmIle allAha tathA rasUlamAthi ImAna lyAyauM ra AjJApAlana garyauM |” tara, tyasapachi tinIharUmadhye eka samUha vimukha huncha | ra tinIharU AsthAvAna nai hoinan |
ra, jaba tinIharUlAI allAha tathA unakA rasUlatarpha bolAincha tAki unale tinIharUbIca nirNaya garUn akasmAta tinIharUmadhye euTA samUha vimukha bhaihAlcha |
tara tinIharUle haka pAune bhaemA baDo AjJAkArI banera unItarpha Au~chan |
ke tinIharUkA hRdayamA kunai roga cha, vA tinIharU sandehamA chan,, vA allAha tathA unakA rasUlale tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garlAn bhanI DarAu~chan? baru tinIharU nai atyAcArI hun |

AsthAvAnaharUlAI jaba tinIharUbIca nirNayakolAgi allAha tathA unakA rasUlatarpha bolAincha taba unIharU spaSTa rUpamA yati mAtra bhanchan– “hAmIle sunyauM ra AjJApAlana garyauM |”ra, yinIharU nai hun saphala huneharU |
ani, jasale allAha tathA unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana garchan, allAhasita DarAu~chan, ra unako avajJAbATa bacdachan tyastA vyaktiharUle nai saphalatA pAunechan |

tinIharU dRDha kasama khAnchan– “(he sandeSTA!) yadi timI tinIharUlAI Adeza dinchau bhane tinIharU avazya nai prasthAna garnechan |” bhanideU– “kasama nakhAU, timIharUko AjJApAlanako sthiti spaSTa cha, ra timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUsita allAha pUrNa rUpamA avagata chan |

bhanideU– “allAhako AjJApAlana gara tathA rasUlako AjJApAlana gara | yadi timIharU vimukha hunchau bhane, rasUlamAthi kevala unalAI sumpieko jimmevArI cha, ra timIharUmAthi timIharUlAI sumpieko jimmevArI cha | ra, yadi timIharUle unako AjJApAlana garyau bhane timIharUle avazya nai satmArga pAunechau | ra, rasUlako jimmevArI ta spaSTa rUpamA sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho |”

timIharUmadhye ImAna lyAune tathA satkarma garneharUsita allAhale ke vAcA garekA chana bhane, unale unIharUlAI tyasaigarI dhartImA khalIphA (uttarAdhikArI) banAunechana jasarI unale unIharUbhandA pahilekA vyaktiharUlAI khalIphA banAekA thie | ra, allAhale unIharUkAlAgi dRDhatApUrvaka tyo dharma sthApanA garnechan jasalAI unale unIharUkAnimti rojekA chan | ra, unIharUko bhayako avasthAlAI zAntiko avasthAmA pariNata garidinechan | unIharUle merai upAsanA garnechan ra masa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAune chainan | ra, tyasapachi jo kRtaghna hunchan tinIharU nai avajJAkArI hun |
ani, namAja kAyama gara, jakAta deU, ra rasUlako AjJApAlana gara tAki timIharUmAthi dayA gariyos |
timI kadApi yo naThAna ki kAphiraharUle pRthvImA hAmIlAI vivaza tulyAunechan | tinIharUko vAstavika bAsasthAna ta naraka nai ho | katti nikRSTa bAsasthAna raheko cha tyo!

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUkahA~ Auna timIharUkA dAsadAsI ra timrA nAbAlaka santAnaharUle timIharUsita tIna samayamA anumati mAgUn– phajrako namAjaaghi, madhyAnhako samayamA jaba timIharU AphnA vastra pherchau, ra izAko namAjapachi | yI tIna samaya timIharUkAlAgi pardAkA samayaharU hun | yI samayaharUbAheka anya samayamA timIharUkAlAgi ra unIharUkAlAgi pani kunai Apatti chaina, kinabhane timIharU sabai ApasamA ekaarkAko najika Ai nai rahanchau | yasarI allAha spaSTarUpamA AphnA AdezaharU bayAna gardachan | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvajJa chan |

ra, jaba timIharUkA santAnaharU paripakvatAko umeramA pugchan taba unIharU pani tyasarI nai anumati mAgUn jasarI unIharUkA ThUlAbaDA mAnisaharUle mAgne garekA chan | yasarI allAhale AphnA nirdezanaharU spaSTa pArdachan | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvajJa chan |

ra, vivAhako AzA marisakekA vRddha mahilAharUle AphnA (thapa) vastraharU phukAlera rAkhemA kunai Apatti chaina yasa zartamA ki zrRMgAra pradarzana nagarUn | tara unIharUle sAvadhAnI apanAemA unIharUko bhalAI hunecha | ra, allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

na andhomAthi kunai Apatti cha na laGgaDomAthi; na birAmImAthi kunai Apatti cha na timIharUmAthi nai ki timIharU khAU AphnA gharamA vA AphnA bAbu–bAjeharUko gharamA vA AphnA AmA–bajyaiharUko gharamA vA AphnA kAkAharUko gharamA vA AphnA phuphUharUko gharamA vA AphnA mAmAharUko gharamA vA AphnA sAnImAharUko gharamA vA tyo gharamA jasako cAvIharU timro jimmAmA chan vA AphnA mitraharUko gharamA | cAhe timIharU sabai milI saMyukta rUpamA khAU vA beglA beglai khAU yasamA pani kunai Apatti chaina | ra, timIharU gharabhitra praveza gardA AphnA mAncheharUlAI salAma garne gara | yo allAhako tarphabATa barakatayukta pavitra bandanA ho | yasarI nai allAha AphnA AdezaharU spaSTa rUpamA varNana gardachan tAki timIharU bujhna saka |

vAstavika AsthAvAnaharU kevala tI vyaktiharU nai hun jasale allAha tathA unakA rasUlamAthi ImAna lyAekA chan | ra, jaba unIharU kunai sAmUhika kAmale rasUlasa~ga hunchan taba unako anumati namAgI bAhira jA~dainan | (he muhammada sa.!) timIsita anumati line vyaktiharU nai vAstavamA allAha evaM unakA rasUlaprati ImAna rAkhdachan | ataH unIharUle AphnA kunai kAmakA lAgi timIsita anumati mAgdA timI jasalAI cAhanchau anumati deU ra unIharUkAlAgi allAhasita kSamAyAcanA garne gara | nissandeha allAha atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

rasUlako pukAralAI timIharUle ekaApasako pukArajhaiM naThAna | allAhale timIharUmadhye A~khA tarera suTukka bhAgne vyaktiharUlAI rAmrarI cindachan | ataH unako Adeza ullaMghana garneharUle sAvadhAna rahanuparcha ki tinIharUlAI kunai saGkaTale nagheros vA kunai dukhadAyI prakopale nasamAtos |

sAvadhAna! AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sampUrNa cijaharU allAhakai hun | timIharUko avasthAlAI allAha rAmrarI jAndachan | ra, tyasa dina jaba tinIharUlAI unItarpha pharkAinecha taba allAhale tinIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbAre tinIharUlAI avagata garAunechan | ra, allAha hareka cija rAmrarI jAndachan |
atyantai barakatayukta chan unI jasale AphnA bhaktamAthi phurkAna (kasauTI) avataraNa gare tAki unI sampUrNa mAnavakAlAgi sacetaka hoUn |

unai hun jasako zAsana AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImAthi raheko cha | unale na kasailAI putra banAekA chan na kohI unako zAsanamA zarIka nai cha | ra, unale pratyeka cijalAI sRSTi gare ra tyasalAI rAmrosa~ga nirdhArita gare |

tara, tinIharUle allAhabAheka anya yastA upAsyaharU banAekA chan jo kehI pani sRSTi garna sakdainan baru sRSTi garinchan ra jasale svayaMkailAgi na ghATAko na lAbhakai sAmarthya rAkhdachan ani jasalAI na mRtyuko na jIvanako ra na pUnarjanmako sAmarthya cha |

ra, kAphiraharU bhanchan– “yo managaDhante kurA ho juna yinale svayaM racekA hun | ra, anya vyaktiharUle pani yasamA unalAI sahayoga garekA chan |” nissandeha tinIharU atyAcAra tathA jhUThamA utrekA chan |
ra, tinIharU bhanchan– “yI atItakA kathAharU hun juna unale lipibaddha garAekA chan juna unalAI bihAna–belukI sunAincha |”
(he muhammada sa.!) bhanideU–“yasalAI AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA bheda jAnne (allAha) le avataraNa garekA hun | unI atyanta kSamAzIla ra parama dayAlu chan |”
ra, tinIharU bhanchan– “yinI kastA rasUla hun jo khAnA pani khAnchan ra bajAramA pani hiMDchan? unIkahA~ kunai phariztA kina paThAiena tAki unI unakA sahayogI sacetaka banUn |

vA unakAlAgi ki ta kunai khajAnA avatIrNa garieko hunuparthyo ki ta unakAnimti kunai euTA yasto bagaiMcA hunuparthyo jasabATa unale khAne garthe |” ra, atyAcArIharU bhanchan– “timIharU kevala euTA jAdUgrasta vyaktiko anusaraNa garirahekAchau |”
(he sandeSTA!) hera, tinIharU timrolAgi kastA kastA kAlapanika udAharaNa pezagarchan | tinIharU pathabhraSTa bhaisakekA chan aba mArga pAuna sakdainan |

atyantai barakatayukta chan unI jasale cAhe bhane timrolAgi yasabhandA uttama sirjanA garnechan; yastA bagaiMcAharU jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan ra timrolAgi mahalaharU banAidinechan |
baru tinIharUle mahApralayalAI nai mithyA Thahara garekA chan | ani hAmIle mahApralayalAI mithyA Thahara garneharUkAlAgi naraka tayAra pArekA chauM |
ra jaba narakale tinIharUlAI TADhAbATa dekhcha taba tinIharU tyasako AvegapUrNa krodha ra garjana sunnechan |
ra, jaba tinIharUlAI tyasako kunai saGkIrNa sthAnamA bA~dhera phyA~kinecha taba tinIharU tyahA~ mRtyulAI pukArnechan |
Aja timIharU euTA mRtyulAI mAtra hoina anekauM mRtyulAI pukAra |,
sodha! “yo rAmro cha vA tyo sadAsarvadA rahirahane bagaiMcA jasako vacana Izabhaya rAkhne vyaktiharUlAI diieko cha? yo unIharUko pratidAna ho ra pharkane ThAu~ pani |
tyahA~ tI sabai cija hunechan juna unIharU cAhanechan | unIharU tyasamA sadA sarvadA rahanechan | yo timro pAlanakartAsa~ga mAgine yogya vAcA ho |

ra, tyasadina avajJAkArIharUlAI tathA tinIharUle allAhabAheka banAekA pUjyaharUlAI allAhale ekatrita garnechan ani bhannechan– “ke timIharUle merA yI upAsakaharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArekA thiyau vA tinIharU svayaM satmArga birAekA thie?”

tinIharUle bhannechan– “pavitra chau timI, timIlAI choDI arUlAI saMrakSakako rUpamA grahaNa garnu hAmrolAgi ucita thiena |” tara timIle tinIharUlAI ra tinIharukA pUrvajaharUlAI pracura dhana–sampatti pradAna garyau yahA~samma ki tinIharUle upadezalAI nai birsie | ra, tinIharU vinAzayogya vyaktiharU thie!

timrA upAsyaharUle timIharUlAI timIharUko bhanAIlAI jhUTho Thahara garekA chan aba timIharUmA na yAtanAlAI nivAraNa garne sAmarthya cha na tinIharUlAI sahayoga nai garinecha | timIharUmadhye jasale atyAcAra garcha usalAI hAmI ThUlo yAtanAko svAda cakhAunechauM |

ani, timIbhandA pahile hAmIle jati rasUlaharU paThAekA thiyauM unIharU sabai bhojana garne garthe ra hATabajAraharUmA hi~Dne garthe | ra, hAmIle timIharUlAI eka arkAkAlAgi parIkSAko sAdhana banAekA chauM | ke timIharU dhairyadhAraNa garchau ta? ra, timrA pAlanakartA sarvadraSTA chan |

hAmIsa~ga sAkSatkArako AzA narAkhneharU bhanchan– “hAmIkahA~ phariztAharU kina avatarita garienan? vA hAmI AphnA rabalAI nai dekhna sakauM |” yinIharUle svayaMlAI mahAn ThAnekA chan ra ati nai uddaNDa bhaekA chan |
juna dina tinIharUle phariztAharUlAI dekhnechan tyo dina aparAdhIharUlAI kunai khuziyAlI hune chaina, ra bhannechan– “(svargabATa) pakkai vaJcita bhayauM |”
ra, hAmI tinIharUle garekA pratyeka kAryatarpha baDhnechauM ani tI sabai kAryaharUlAI dhulAkA kaNaharU jhaiM charapasTa banAidinechauM |
tyo dina jannatabAsIharUko sthAyIvAsa ra vizrAmAlaya pani asAdhyai rAmro hunecha |
ani, juna dina AkAza bAdalasameta phuTera cirA–cirA hunecha ra phariztAharU pani lagAtAra avatarita garinechan...
tyo dina vAstavika rAjyasattA karuNAmaya (allAha) kai hunecha, ra tyo kAphiraharUkAlAgi baDo kaThinako dina hunecha |
tyo dina atyAcArIle Aphnai hAta Tokdai bhannecha– “hAya! maile rasUlakA sAtha mArga apanAeko bhae besa hunthyo!”
hAya apasoca! maile phalAno vyaktilAI Aphno mitra nabanAeko bhae hunthyAe|
jasale upadeza Aepachi tyasabATa malAI bicalita banAyo, ra vAstavamA zaitAnale kaThina avasthAmA mAnisalAI choDidincha |
ra, rasUlale bhannechan– “he merA pAlanakartA! vastutaH merA samudAyakA mAnisaharUle yasa kuraAnalAI tyAgekA thie |
yasarI nai hAmIle pratyeka nabIkAlAgi aparAdhIharUmadhyebATa zatru banAyauM | ra, mArgadarzaka tathA sahAyakakorUpamA timrA pAlanakartA nai paryApta chan |”

ra, kAphiraharU bhanchan– “yasa vyaktimAthi sampUrNa kuraAna ekai paTakamA kina avatarita gariena?” (he muhammada sa.!) yasarI avatarita garnuko uddezya hAmIle timro hRdayalAI dRDhatA pradAna garnu ho | yasai kAraNale hAmIle tyasalAI vistArai avatarita garekA hauM |
jaba tinIharU timIsamakSa kunai prazna lyAu~chan, hAmI tyasako tyasaibelA rAmro uttara dinchauM ra rAmro vyAkhyA pani garchauM |
jasalAI ghopTo pArera (ghisArdai) narakamA ekatrita garinecha tinIharUko bAsasthAna ati nikRSTa hunecha | ra, tinako bATo pani dherai galata cha |
nizcaya nai hAmIle mUsAlAI grantha pradAna garyauM ra unakA bhAi hArUnalAI unako sahayogI banAyauM |
ra, hAmIle bhanyauM– “timI duvai hAmrA AyataharUlAI jhuTho ThaharAune samudAyatarpha jAU |” antataH hAmIle tinIharUlAI pUrNarUpamA naSTa pAryauM |

ra, nUhakA samudAyalAI pani, jaba tinIharUle rasUlaharUlAI asatya Thahara gare taba hAmIle tinIharUlAI curlummai DubAidiyauM, ra mAnisaharUkAlAgi tinIharUlAI ( zikSAprada ) nizAnI banAidiyauM | ra, atyAcArIharUkA– lAgi hAmIle pIDAdAyaka yAtanA tayAra pArekA chauM |
ra, Ada, samUda, inAravAlA tathA tinIharUbIca rahekA katipaya samudAyaharUlAI pani (hAmIle naSTa pAryauM) |
ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI udAharaNaharU diikana samjhAyau ani sabailAI ( namAneko khaNDamA ) sakhApa pAryauM |
yI kAphiraharU tyasa nagarako najikaibATa AekA chan jasamAthi bhISaNa varSA garAieko thiyo | ke yinIharUle tyasalAI dekhekA thienan? baru tinIharU punarjIvanako AzA nai rAkhdainan |
ra tinIharU jahile pani timIlAI dekhdA timro upahAsa nai garchan (bhandachan) “ke yahI ho jasalAI allAhale rasUla banAera paThAekA chan?”

hAmI AphnA yI upAsya (devatA) harUprati aDiga narahekA bhae usale ta hAmIlAI hAmrA upAsyaharUbATa TADhA pArisakeko hune thiyo | ra, jaba tinIharU yAtanA dekhnechan taba tinIharUle thAhA pAunechan ki vAstavamA ko pathabhraSTa rahecha |
ke timIle tyasa vyaktilAI dekhyau jasale Aphnai manokAmanAlAI Aphno upAsya banAeko cha? ke timI yasto vyaktiko vakIla banna sakchau?
ke tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU sunchan vA bujhchan bhanI ThAnchau ta? tinIharU ta janAvarajastai chan baru jhan pathabhraSTa |
ke timIle dekhenauM timrA pAlanakartAle kasarI chAyA~ phailAekA chan? yadi unale cAhekA bhae tyasa chAyA~lAI sthira nai rAkhne thie | pheri hAmIle sUryalAI tyasa chAyA~ko lAgi sUcaka banAyauM |
pheri hAmIle tyasa chAyA~lAI vistArai AphUtira sameTchauM |
ra, unai hun jasale timIharUkAlAgi rAtalAI pardA, nidrAlAI vizrAma ra dinalAI jAgne samaya banAe |
ra, unai hun jasale Aphno kRpA (varSA) bhandA aghi hAvAlAI zubha–sucanAsvarUpa paThAu~chan | ra, hAmI nai AkAzabATa pavitra pAnI barsAu~chauM...
tAki tyasadvArA mRta bhUmilAI jIvita pArauM ra hAmIle sRSTi garekA dheraijaso caupAyA tathA mAnisaharUlAI tyahI pAnI pilAu~chauM |
ra, hAmIle yasalAI vibhinna tarikAle bayAna garyauM tAki tinIharUle upadeza grahaNa garUn, tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU kRtaghnatAmA nai aDiga rahe |
yadi hAmIle cAheko bhae pratyeka nagaramA ekajanA sacetaka paThAune thiyauM |
ataH kAphiraharUko kurA namAna ra yasa kuraAnadvArA tinIharUviruddha ThUlo saMgharSa gara |
ra, tinai hun jasale duIvaTA samudralAI milAe; euTA miTho–svAdilo cha ra arko cAhi~ nunilo tathA Tarro | ani, unale duvaikA bIcamA euTA adRzya pardA ra euTA pRthaka pArne avarodha khaDA garidie |
ra, unai hun jasale pAnIbATa mAnisalAI sRSTi gare, tathA tyasa mAnavalAI vaMzAvalI evaM sasurAlI nAtedAravAlA banAe | ra, timrA pAlanakartA sAmarthyavAna chan |
ra, tinIharUle allAhalAI choDI yastAko upAsanA garchan jasale tinIharUlAI na lAbha puryAuna sakchan na hAni nai | ra, kAphira sadaiva AphnA pAlanakartAviruddhamA nai sahayoga garne garcha |
ra, hAmIle (he muhammada sa.!) timIlAI kevala zubha–sucaka tathA sacetaka banAera paThAekA chauM |
bhanideU– “ma timIharUsita yasa kAryakAnimti kunai pratidAna mAgdina | a~, jasale cAhancha AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha jAne mArga avalambana garos |”

ra,( he nabI sa.! ) timI unai sajIva (allAha) mAthi bharosA rAkha juna maraNazIla chainan | ra, unako prazaMsAkA sAthai pavitratAko guNagAna gara | ra, unI AphnA upAsakaharU– kA pApaharUbAre jAnakArakA rUpamA paryApta chan |

unai hun jasale AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra tI duvaibIca rahekA sampUrNa cijaharUlAI cha dinamA sRSTi gare | ani siMhAsanamA virAjamAna bhae | unI atyanta karuNAmaya chan | tasartha ( he nabI sa.!) tyo (pratidAna) sarvajJa (allAha) sa~ga nai mA~ga |

ra, jaba tinIharUlAI bhanincha ki rahmAna (karuNAmaya allAha) lAI sajdA gara taba tinIharU bhanchan ‘rahmAna bhaneko ke ho?’ ke timI jasalAI sajdA garna bhanchau tyasailAI sajdA garauM ta?” yasa AmantraNale tinIharUko ghRNAmA ajha abhivRddhi nai garcha |
ati barakatayukta (maGgalamaya)chan tI jasale AkAzamA nakSatraharU banAe ra tyasamA sUrya tathA ujyAlo candra banAe |
ra, unai hun jasale rAta tathA dinalAI eka–arkAko sthAnApana banAe yasto vyaktikolAgi jo upadeza grahaNa garne vA kRtajJa banne icchA rAkhdacha |
ra, karuNAmaya (allAha) kA bhakta unIharU hun jo dhartImA ziSTatApUrvaka hiMDne garchan ra jaba ajJAnIharU unIharUsita ajJAnatA pUrvaka kurA gardachan taba unIharU ‘salAma’ (zAnti) hos’ bhanchan |
ani, jo AphnA pAlanakartAsAmu sajdAmA ra ubhiera (namAja paDhdai) rAta bitAu~chan |
ra jasale bhanchan– “he hAmrA raba! narakako yAtanAlAI hAmIbATa TADhA rAkha | nissandeha tyasako yAtanA jyAdai duHkhadAyI raheko cha |
nizcaya nai tyo ati nikRSTa vizrAmAlaya evaM bAsasthAna ho |
ra, jasale kharca gardA na apavyaya garchan na kanjusyAi~ garchan baru duvaibIca santulana kAyama rAkhchan|

ra, jasale allAhakA sAtha anya kasailAI upAsya bhandainan; allAhale varjita garekA kunai jIvako anAhaka hatyA gardainan, na vyabhicAra garchan | ra, jasale yastA kAryaharU garcha usale Aphno pApako daNDa bhognecha |
mahApralayako dina tyasako yAtanA dobbara pArinecha ra tyo vyakti apamAnita bhaI sadA tyahI~ rahanecha|
sivAya tI mAnisaharU jasale prAyazcita garchan, ImAna lyAu~chan ra satkarma garchan | yastA mAnisaharUkA nikRSTatAlAI allAhale puNyakarmamA pariNata garidinechan |
ra, juna vyakti prAyazcita garcha tathA satkarma garcha vastutaH U allAhatarpha pharkancha |
ra, jo (kahilyai) jhUThako sAkSI bandainan ra anartha kAryako nikaTabATa gujra~dA sajjana vyaktiharU jhaiM aghi baDhchan |
ra, jasalAI unIharUkA rabakA AyataharUdvArA upadeza di~dA tyasaprati bahiro tathA andho bhaera jhukdainan |
ra, jasale prArthanA garchan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmrA patnIharU tathA santAnaharUbATa hAmrA A~khAlAI zItalatA pradAna gara | ra, hAmIlAI IzaparAyaNa mAnisaharUkA nAyaka banAU |”
yastA vyaktiharUlAI nai unIharUko dhairyadhAraNako kAraNale pratidAnasvarUpa ucca bhavana diinecha ra tyahA~ unIharUko svAgata abhivAdana ra salAma garinecha |
tyahA~ tinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | tyo vizrAma tathA basobAsakolAgi ati rAmro sthAna ho |

(he muhammada sa.!) bhanideU! merA ‘raba’ lAI pani ke paravAha! yadi timIharU pukArdainau bhane, aba timIharUle ta asatya Thahara garisakekA chau, ataH tyasako daNDa cA~Dai (timIharumAthi) Aipugnecha |
tA0 sIna0 mIma0 |
yI spaSTa granthakA AyataharU hun |
(he muhammada sa.!) tinIharUle ImAna lyAenan bhane zAyada timIle Aphno jyAna nai gumAunechau |
yadi hAmIle cAhyauM bhane AkAzabATa tinIharUsamakSa yasto nizAnI avataraNa garna sakchauM jasakosAmu tinIharUko gardhana jhukna pugcha |
ra, tinIharUkahA~ karuNAmaya ( allAha ) bATa junasukai naulo upadeza Ae pani tinIharU tyasabATa vimukha nai hunchan |
ra, tinIharUle (tyasalAI) mithyA Thahara garisakekA chan | aba cA~Dai nai tinIharUsamakSa tyasako vAstavikatA prakaTa hunecha jasako yinIharU upahAsa gardathe |
ke tinIharUle dhartIlAI dekhekA chainan ki hAmIle kati ThUlo saMkhyAmA hareka prakArakA utkRSTa vanaspati umArekA chauM?
nizcaya nai tyasamA ThUlo nizAnI raheko cha, tara tinIharUmadhye dheraijasole ImAna lyAunevAlA chainan |
nissandeha timrA pAlanakartA ati prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu chan |
smaraNa gara jaba timrA pAlanakartAle mUsAlAI pukAre ( ra bhane) – “atyAcArI samudAyatarpha jAU|
phiraaunakA jAtitarpha | ke tinIharU DarAu~dainan?”
