mUsAle bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA! tinIharUle malAI mithyA Thahara garlAn bhanne malAI Dara lAgcha |
ra, mero chAtI saMkucita bhairaheko cha ra mero jibro pani prasTasa~ga caldaina | tasartha hArUnalAI pani IzadUtatva pradAna gara |
ra, mamA tinIharUko euTA aparAdha cha | ataH tinIharUle mero hatyA garlAn bhanne Dara lAgcha |”,
allAhale bhane– “tyasto kadApi hune chaina | ataH timI duvai hAmrA nizAnIharU liera jAU | hAmI timIharUkA sabai kurA sunirahekA hunechauM |”
timIharU duvai phiraaunakahA~ jAU ra bhana– “hAmI sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa rasUla hauM |
ki timI isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI hAmIsaMga jAna deU |”
phiraaunale bhanyo– “ke hAmIle bAlyakAlamA timro pAlanapoSaNa garenauM? ra, ke timIle Aphno jIvanakA kaiyauM varSa hAmIkahA~ bitAenau ra?
ra, timIle je garyau tyo ta garyau nai, timI ta kRtaghna pani rahechau |”
mUsAle bhane– “maile tyo kAma tyatibelA gareM jaba ma anabhijJa thie~ |”
ani jaba malAI timIharUko Dara lAgyo taba ma timIharUbATa bhAgeM | tyasapachi merA pAlanakartAle malAI tatvadarzitA tathA jJAna pradAna gare ra malAI rasUlaharUmadhye banAe |
isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI dAsa banAunu maprati kuna kisimako upakAra ho jasako varNana timI garirahekA chau?
phiraaunale bhanyo– “sampUrNa jagatakA raba ko hun ta?”
mUsAle bhane– “juna AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra duvaibIca rahekA sampUrNa cijaharUkA raba hun, yadi timIharU vizvAsa garchau bhane |”
phiraaunale AphnA bhAradAraharUlAI bhanyo– “ke timIharU sunirahekA chainau?”
mUsAle bhane– “timIharUkA pAlanakartA ra timrA pUrvajaharUkA pAlanakartA!”
phiraaunale bhanyo– “timIharUkA rasUla jo timIharUtarpha paThAieko cha tyo ta vAstavamA unmAdI rahecha |”
mUsAle bhane– “jo pUrva, pazcima ra tI duvaibIca rahekA sampUrNa cijakA mAlika hun, yadi timIharUsita buddhi cha bhane |”
phiraaunale bhanyo– “yadi timIle mabAheka anya kasailAI upAsya banAyau bhane ma timIlAI nizcaya nai bandI banAunechu |”
mUsAle bhane– “maile timI sAmu euTA spaSTa nizAnI lyAe tApani?”
phiraaunale bhanyo– “yadi timI satya hau bhane tyo nizAnI prastuta gara |”
ataH mUsAle Aphno lauro dhartImA rAkhe | tyo svasphUrta rUpamA ajiGgara huna pugyo |
ra, unale Aphno hAta ( kAkhIbATa ) nikAle ani tyo acAnaka darzakaharUkA sAmu seto camkilo dekhiyo |
phiraaunale Aphno variparikA darabAriyAharUlAI bhanyo– “yo ta nizcaya nai euTA pravINa jAdugara rahecha |
yasale timIharUlAI Aphno jAdUko balamA timrai dezabATa niSkAsita garna cAhancha | ani, timIharU ke sallAha dinchau ta?”
darabAriyAharUle bhane– “yasalAI ra yasako bhAilAI avasara dinuhos ra nagaraharUtarpha ekatrita garneharUlAi paThAunuhos|
tAki tinIharUle sabai vijJa jAdUgaraharUlAI ekatRta garera tapAIMsamakSa lyAUn |”
ani, sabai jAdUgaraharUlAI nizcita dinako nirdhArita samayamA bhelA pAriyo |
ra, mAnisaharUlAI bhaniyo– “timIharU pani avazya bhelA hoU|
tAki jAdUgaraharU vijayI bhaemA hAmI (khuzyAlI manAunamA) tinIharUkA sAtha rahAai~ |”
ra, jaba jAdUgaraharU Ae taba tinIharUle phiraaunalAI bhane– “yadi hAmI vijayI bhayauM bhane ke hAmIlAI kunai puraskAra prApta hunecha ta?”
phiraaunale bhanyo– “ho, taba ta timIharU vizeSa darabAriyAharUmadhye hunechau |”
mUsAle jAdUgaraharUlAI bhane– “timIharU je phyA~kna cAhanchau phyA~ka |”
ataH tinIharule AphnA DorI tathA laTThIharu phyA~ke ra bhane – “phiraaunako pratiSThAko kasama! hAmI avazya vijayI hunechauM |”
ani mUsAle Ano laTThI phyA~ke jasale anAyasa tinIharukA jAdUkA sAmagrIlAI nilna thAlyo |
ani jAdUgaraharU sajdAmA Dhale |
ra ghoSaNA gare– “hAmIle sampUrNa jagatakA svAmImAthi ImAna lyAyauM|
mUsA ra hArUnakA svAmImAthi |”

phiraaunale bhanyo–“mero anumatibinA nai timIharule usamAthi ImAna lyAyau ta? nissandeha U nai timIharuko mahAn guru rahecha jasale timIharu sabailAI jAdu sikAyo | timIharule cA~Dai nai thAhA pAunechau | nizcaya nai ma timIharukA hAtakhuTTA viparita dizAbATa kATnechu | ra, timIharu sabailAI avazya nai zUlImA caDhAunechu |”
unIharUle bhane– “yasamA kunai Dara chaina | hAmIlAI ta AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha pharkanu nai cha |
hAmIle sarvaprathama ImAna lyAekAle hAmrA pAlanakartAle hAmrA pApaharu kSamA garlAn bhanne hAmrAe bhitrI manakAe cAhanA hAe |”
ra, hAmIleTa mUsAlAI vahya (prakAzanA) garyauM– “rAti nai merA bhaktaharulAI liera niska | nissandeha timIharulAI pachyAinecha |
ani phiraaunale nagaraharUtarpha sUcakaharUlAI paThAyo |,
ra bhanyo nizcaya nai yinIharUko samUha alpasaMkhyAmA raheko cha |
ra, yinIharUle hAmIlAI krodhita tulyAekA chan |
avazya nai hAmI euTA saceta samUha hauM |
antataH hAmIle tinIharUlAI bagaiMcA ra pAnIkA mUlaharUbATa niSkAsita garidiyauM |
ra, khajAnAharU tathA uttama sthAnaharUbATa pani |
tinIharUsa~ga hAmIle yastai garyauM ra tI cijaharUkA uttarAdhikArI isrAIlakA santAnalAI banAidiyauM |
phiraauna tathA unakA sainikaharUle sUryodaya hune bittikai mUsA tathA unakA sAthIharUlAI pachyAe |
jaba duvai samUhale ekaarkAlAI dekhe taba mUsAkA sAthIharUle bhane– “hAmI nizcaya nai pakrAu parne bhayauM |”
mUsAle bhane– “kadApi hoina | avazya nai masa~ga merA mAlika chan | unale malAI mArga dekhAune chan |”
ani hAmIle mUsAlAI vahya garyauM– “Aphno laTThI samudramA hirkAU |” ani nadI phATyo ra tyasako pratyeka aMza ThUlo pahADa jasto huna pugyo |
ra, hAmIle dosro samUhalAI tyahA~ puryAi diyauM |
ani hAmIle mUsA ra unIsa~ga rahekA sabailAI bacAyauM |
ani, arU sabailAI samudramA curlumma DubAyauM |
nissandeha yasamA ThUlo nizAnI raheko cha | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza ImAna lyAune vAlA chainan |
ra, nizcaya nai timrA pAlanakartA atyanta prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ra, tinIharUlAI ibrAhImako vRttAnta pani sunAU|
jaba unale AphnA pitA tathA svajAtikA mAnisaharUlAI bhane– “timIharU kasako upAsanA garchau?”
tinIharUle bhane– “hAmI mUrtiharUko pUjA garchauM ra tinIharUkai sevAmA samarpita rahanchauM |”
ibrAhImale bhane– “jaba timIharU yI mUrtiharUlAI pukArchau taba ke tinIharUle timIharUko pukAra sunchan ta?
vA ke timIharUlAI kunai lAbha vA hAni puryAu~chan?”
tinIharUle bhane– “(hoina) baru hAmIle AphnA purkhAharUle tyastai gardai Aeko pAekA chauM |”
ibrAhImale bhane– “ke timIharUle tyasa (mUrti) ko bAremA vicAra garyau jasako pUjA gardai AekA chau?
timIharU ra timrA purkhAharUle pani?
yinIharU sabai merA zatru hun; sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartA vAheka|
jasale malAI sRSTi gare | ra, unale nai mArga dekhAu~chan |
ani, unale nai malAI khuvAu~chan ra pilAu~chan |
ra, jaba ma birAmI hunchu unale nai malAI niko pArchan |
ani, unale nai malAI mRtyu dinechan ra punaH jIvita pArnechan |
ra, unaiprati ma AzAvAdI chu ki badalA diine dinamA unale merA galtiharUlAI kSamA garnechan |”
he merA pAlanakartA! malAI nirNayazakti pradAna gara ra satkarmIharUmA sAmela gara |
ra, pachi AuneharUmA merolAgi rAmro prasiddhi pradAna gara |
ra, malAI vaibhavapUrNa svargakA uttarAdhikArIharUmA sAmela gara |
ra, merA pitAlAI kSamA gara kinabhane uhA~ pathabhraSTa vyaktiharUmadhyekA hunuhunthyo |
ra, tyasa dina malAI apamAnita nagara juna dina mAnisaharU uThAinechan |
juna dina na dhanasampatti kAma lAgnecha na santAna nai |
tara tyo vyakti jo allAhasamakSa svaccha hRdayakAsAtha Aunecha (usako kurA veglai ho )|”
ra, jannata (svarga) lAI Izabhaya rAkhne mAnisaharUko nikaTa lyAinecha |
ra, narakalAI pathabhraSTa mAnisaharUkAlAgi prakaTa garinecha |
ra, tinIharUsita sodhinecha– “kahA~ chan tinIharU jasako timIharU upAsanA garthyAe?
allAhakA atirikta?” ke tinIharUle timIharUko maddata garna sakchan vA svayaM Aphno bacAu garna sakchan ta?
tinI ra pathabhraSTaharUlAI u~dhomunTo pArI tyasamA hominecha |
ra, iblIsakA sabai senAharUlAI pani |
tinIharUle narakamA praspara vivAda gardai bhannechan—
“allAhako kasama! hAmI vAstavamA nai khullamakhullA pathabhraSTa thiyauM|
jaba hAmIle timIharUlAI sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartAko samakakSa banAirahekA thiyauM |
ra, hAmIlAI aparAdhIharUbAheka kasaile pathabhraSTa garenan |
hAmrolAgi na kohI siphArisakartA cha |
na kunai ghaniSTa mitra nai |
ataH hAmronimti pharkera jAna sambhava bhaeko bhae hAmI avazya nai AsthAvAnaharUmadhye hune thiyauM |”
nissandeha yasa (vRttAnta) mA ThUlo nizAnI raheko cha | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU ImAna lyAune vAlA chainan |
nizcaya nai timrA pAlanakartA atyanta prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu chan |
nUhako samudAyale pani rasUlaharUlAI jhuTho ThaharAe |
jaba tinIharUkA bhAi nUhale bhanekA thie– “ke timIharUlAI (allAhasita) Dara lAgdaina?
ma ta timIharUkAlAgi nAsovAhaka rasUla hu~ |
tasartha allAhasa~ga DarAU ra mero AjJApAlana gara |
ra ma yasa kAryakAnimti timIharUsita kunai pratidAna mAgdina | mero pratidAna ta sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartAkai jimmAmA cha |
ataH allAhasa~ga DarAU ra mero AjJApAlana gara |”
nUhakA jAtibandhuharUle bhane– “ke hAmIle timImAthi ImAna lyAauM jabaki timrA anuyAyI tuccha vyaktiharU rahekA chan?”
nUhale bhane– “tinIharU pahile ke garne garthe bhanne kurA malAI ke thAhA?
tinIharUko hisAba–kitAba ta merA pAlanakartAko jimmAmA raheko cha | timIharUle cetanAle kAma lieko bhae!
ra, ma AsthAvAnaharUlAI nikAlne chaina |
ma ta euTA spaSTa sacetaka mAtra hu~ |
tinIharUle bhane– “e nUha! yadi timIle yo kArya choDenau bhane nizcaya nai hAmI timIlAI DhuGgAle hAnera mArnechauM |”
nuhale bhane– “he pAlanakartA! merA jAtibandhuharUle malAI jhUTho Thahara gare |
ataH ma ra tinIharUbIca spaSTa nirNaya gara ani malAI ra masa~ga bhaekA AsthAvAnaharUlAI bacAU |
tasartha hAmIle nUha ra unIsa~ga rahekA sabailAI bharieko DuGgAmA bacAyauM |
ani bA~kI sabailAI DubAidiyauM |
nissandeha yasa (vRttAnta) mA ThUlo nizAnI raheko cha tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU ImAna lyAune vAlA chainan |
ra, nizcaya nai timrA pAlanakartA atyanta prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu chan |
Adale pani rasUlaharUlAI asatya Thahara garyo |
jaba tinIharUsita tinakA bhAi hUdale bhane–“ke timIharUlAI Dara lAgdaina?
ma timIharUkAlAgi eka nAsovAhaka rasUla hu~ |
ataH allAhako bhaya gara ra mero AjJApAlana gara |
ra, ma yasa kAmakAlAgi timIharUsita kunai pratidAna mAgdina | mero pratidAna ta sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartAko samakSa raheko cha |
ke timIharU hareka ucca sthAnamA vyartha smArakaharU banAirahanchau?
ra, ThUla–ThUlA bhavanaharU nirmANa gardachau? sAyada timIharU sadA yahI~ rahanechau |
ra, timIharU kasaimAthi hAta lagAu~dA atyAcArI bhaera nai lagAu~chau |
ataH allAhasa~ga DarAU ra mero AjJApAlana gara |
ra, unai ( allAha ) sita DarAU jasale timIharUko sahayoga tyasadvArA garyo jasalAI timIharU jAndachau |
unale timIharUko sahAyatA caupAyA tathA santAnaharUdvArA gare |
ra, bagaiMcAharU tathA pAnIkA mUlaharUdvArA |
ma timIharUkAnimti euTA bhayAnaka dinako prakopabATa DarAu~chu |”
tinIharUle bhane– “cAhe timI upadeza deU athavA nadeU, hAmrolAgi samAna cha |
yo ta paramparAdekhi nai caldai Aeko cha |
ra, hAmIlAI yAtanA diine chaina |”

antataH tinIharUle unalAi asatya Thahara gare, tasartha hAmIle tinIharU sabailAI naSTa garyauM | nissandeha yasa (vRttAnta) mA ThUlo nizAnI raheko cha | ra, tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza imAna lyAunevAlA hoinan |
ra, nizcaya nai timrA pAlanakartA atyanta prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu chan |
samUdale pani rasUlaharUlAI asatya Thahara gare |
jaba unakA bhAi sAlehale tinIharUlAI bhane– “ke timIharU DarAu~dainau?
ma timIharUkAlAgi nAsovAhaka rasUla hu~ |
ataH timIharU allAhasa~ga DarAU ra mero AjJApAlana gara |
ra, ma yasa kAryakonimti timIharUsita kunai pratidAna mAgdina | mero pratidAna ta sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartAkai jimmAmA raheko cha |
ke yahA~ bhaekA cijaharUmAjha timIharUlAI nizcinta choDinecha?
(arthAt) bagaiMcAharU tathA pAnIkA mUlaharUmA?
ra, yI khetaharU tathA khajUraharUmA jasakA jhuppAharU ati kalilA chan?
ra, timIharU pahADa kordai garvakAsAtha tyasamA bhavanaharU nirmANa gardachau |
ataH timIharU allAhasa~ga DarAU ra mero AjJApAlana gara |
ra, tI sImA ullaGghanakArIharUko AjJApAlana nagara|
jasale dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAu~chan ra kunai sudhAra gardainan |”
tinIharUle bhane– “timI ta eka jAdUpIDita vyakti hau |
timI hAmIjastai euTA mAnche bAheka arU ke hau ra? yadi timI saccA chau bhane kunai camatkAra prastuta gara |”
unale bhane– “yo euTA U~TanI ho | yasako pAnI piune pAlo euTA nirdhArita dinamA raheko cha bhane timIharUko pAlo arkai nirdhArita dinamA |
yasalAI kunai hAni napuryAunU natra timIharUlAI euTA bhayAnaka dinako prakopale samAtnecha |”
tara tinIharUle tyasako ghu~DA kATidie ani pachutAuna thAle |
antataH tinIharUlAI prakopale samAtyo | nissandeha yasamA ThUlo upadeza raheko cha, tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU ImAna lyAune vAlA chainan |
ra, nizcaya nai timrA pAlanakartA ati prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu chan |”
ra, lUtakA samudAyale pani rasUlaharUlAI asatya Thahara garyo |
jaba unakA bandhu lUtale tinIharUlAI bhane– “ke timIharUlAI Dara lAgdaina?
ma timIharUkAlAgi nAsovAhaka rasUla hu~ |
ataH allAhasa~ga DarAU ra mero AjJApAlana gara |
ra, ma yasa kAryakolAgi timIharUsita kunai pratidAna mAgdina | mero pratidAna ta sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartAko jimmAmA raheko cha |
ke timIharU (kAmabAsanAko lAgi) saMsArakA puruSaharUtarpha Au~chau?
ra, timIharUkA pAlanakartAle timIharUkAlAgi juna strIharU sRSTi garekA chan tinIharulAI choDchau? baru timIharU simA ullaGghanakArI hau |”
tinIharUle bhane– “he lUta! yadi timIle yasalAI tyAgenau bhane timI nirvAsita garinechau |”
lUtale bhane– “ma timIharUko duSkarmabATa dikdAra bhaisakeko chu |
he pAlanakartA! malAI tathA mero parivAralAI tinIharUkA duSkAryabATa bacAU |”
ataH hAmIle unalAI tathA unakA sampUrNa parivAralAI bacAyauM |
sivAya euTI vRddhA mahilAlAI jo pachi rahaneharUmadhye bhain |
pheri hAmIle anya sabailAI naSTa garyauM |
ra hAmIle tinIharUmAthi khUbai varSA garAyauM | katti narAmro thiyo saceta gariekA mAnisaharUmAthi barsAieko varSA |
nissandeha yasa (vRttAnta) mA ThUlo nizAnI raheko cha | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU AsthAvAna hoinan |
ra, nizcaya nai timrA pAlanakartA ati prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ra, aikAbAsIharUle pani rasUlaharUlAI asatya Thahara gare |
jaba zuaibale tinIharUlAI bhane–“ke timIharU DarAu~dainau?
nissandeha ma timIharUkAlAgi nAsovAhaka rasUla hu~ |
ataH allAhasa~ga DarAU ra mero AjJApAlana gara |
ra, ma yasakAryakolAgi timIharUsita kunai pratidAna mAgdina | mero pratidAna ta sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartAkai jimmAmA raheko cha |
pUrA–pUrA nApne gara ra ghaTAera dine vyaktiharUmadhye nabana |
ra, sahI tarAjule jokhne gara |
ra, mAnisaharUlAI tinIharukA vastuharU ghaTI nadeU | ra na dhartImA vidhvaMsa nai maccAU |
ra, unaisa~ga DarAU jasale timIharU tathA vigatakA baMzaharU sRSTi gare |”
tinIharUle bhane– “timI ta jAdUpIDita vyakti hau |
timI hAmIjastai euTA mAnisa bAheka kehI hoinau | ra, hAmro vicAramA timI mithyAvAdIharUmadhye hau |
yadi timI saccA hau bhane hAmImAthi AkAzako euTA TukrA khasAla |”
unale bhane– “timIharUle garirahekA kAryaharUlAI merA raba rAmrarI jAndachan |”
ataH tinIharUle unalAI asatya Thahara gare, tasartha tinIharUlAI chAyA~vAlA dinako prakopale samAtyo | tyo nizcaya nai euTA bhayAnaka dinako prakopa thiyo |
nissandeha yasa (vRttAnta) mA ThUlo nizAnI raheko cha tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU AsthAvAna hoinan |
ra, vAstavamA timIharUkA pAlanakartA ati prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ra, nissandeha yo (kuraAna) sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avataraNa garieko ho |
yasalAI rUharala amIna (jibraIla) le liera avatarita bhaekA hun |
timro hRdayamAthi tAki timI mAnisaharUlAI saceta garneharUmadhye bana |
yo spaSTa arabI bhASAmA cha |
ra, vAstavamA nai yasako varNana pahilekA mAnisaharUkA granthaharUmA pani cha |
ke yinIharUkAlAgi yo euTA ThUlo pramANa hoina ki yasalAI banI–isrAIlakA guruharU pani jAndachan?
ra, hAmIle yasalAI gaira–arabI vyaktimAthi avatarita gareko bhae,
ani tyasale yinIharUlAI paDhera sunAeko bhae pani yinIharUle ImAna lyAune thienan |
yasaprakAra hAmIle aparAdhIharUkA hRdayaharUmA yasalAI dAkhila garekA chauM |
jabasamma tinIharUle pIDAdAyI prakopa dekhdainan tabasamma tinIharUle yasamA ImAna lyAune chainan |
ra, aceta avasthAmA tyo prakopa tinIharUmAthi anAyAsa AilAgnecha |
ani tinIharUle bhannechan– “ke hAmIlAI kehI avasara prApta huna sakcha?”
ke yinIharU hAmro prakopa cA~Dai Aos bhanne cAhanchan?”
ke timIle manan garyau– tinIharUlAI hAmI varSAaiMsamma sukhabhoga garna diauM,
ani tinIharUmAthi tyo (prakopa) Ayo jasabATa tinIharUlAI tarsAi~dai thiyo,
tinIharUle phAidA liirahekA tI sukhasAmagrIharU tinIharUkA lAgi kehI kAma lAgne bhaenan |
ra, hAmIle kunai pani nagaralAI tyasatarpha sacetaka paThAepachi mAtra naSTa garyauM |
(tAki sacetakale) nasIhata garUn kinaki hAmI atyAcArI hoinauM |
ra, yasa (kuraAna) lAI zaitAnaharUle liera avatIrNa bhaekA hoinan |
tinIharUlAI yo suhAu~daina pani ra tiniharU sAmarthya pani rAkhdainan|
tinIharUlAI ta yo sunnabATa pani vaJcita garieko chan |
ataH allAhasa~gai anya pUjyalAI napukAra | anyathA timI pani daNDIta mAnisaharUmA sAmela hunechau |
ra, AphnA nikaTatama nAtedAraharUlAI sAvadhAna gara |
ra, AsthAvAnaharUmadhye AphnA anuyAyIharUsa~ga vinamratAko vyavahAra gara |
tara tinIharU timro avajJA garchan bhane tinIharUlAI bhana– “timIharUle garne garekA kriyAkalApaharUsita mero kunai sambandha chaina |”
ra, bharosA rAkha ati prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu (allAha) mAthi;
jo herne garchan timIlAI jaba timI (namAjamA) khaDA hunchau..
ra, timrA gatividhiharUlAI jaba timI sajdA garneharUmAjha hunchau |
nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |
ke ma timIharUlAI batAU~ zaitAnaharU kasamAthi avatarita hune garchan?
tinIharU pratyeka ghora mithyAvAdI pApIharUmAthi avatarita hune garchan.
jo (zaitAnaharUtarpha) kAna thApchan ra tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mithyAvAdI hun |
ra rahe kaviharU; tinIharUko anusaraNa ta pathabhraSTaharUle garchan |
ke timI dekhdainau kasarI tinIharU pratyeka upatyakAmA bhauMtArirahekA hunchan |
ra, tinIharU je bhanchan tyo gardainan |

tI mAnisaharU bAheka jasale ImAna lyAe, satkarma gare, allAhalAI atyadhika smaraNa gare ra pIDita bhaepachi pratizodha mAtra lie | ra, atyAcArIharUle ke kasto pariNAmako sAmanA garnuparnecha bhanI cADaiM nai jAnnechan |
tA0 sIna0; yI AyataharU kuraAna tathA spaSTa granthakA hun |
mArgadarzana tathA zubhasandeza ho yastA AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi..jha..
jo namAja kAyama garchan, jakAta dinchan ra AkhiratamAthi AsthA rAkhdachan |
nissandeha jasale AkhiratamAthi AsthA rAkhdainan tinIharukA kAryaharUlAI tinIharukAlAgi zobhanIya banAidiekA chauM | tyasaile tinIharU tyasaimA bhauMtArirahekA chan |
yastA mAnisaharUkAlAgi nai pIDAdAyI yAtanA raheko cha ra AkhiratamA tinIharU nai sarvAdhika ghATAmA hunechan |
ra, (he muhammada sa.!) yo kuraAna timIlAI parama tatvadarzI tathA sarvajJa (allAha) ko tarphabATa pradAna gariMdaicha |
smaraNa gara jaba mUsAle AphnA parivAralAI bhane– “maile Ago dekheko chu | ma tyahA~bATa kunai khabara vA Agoko euTA agulTo liera Au~daichu tAki timIharU tApna saka |
jaba mUsA tyahA~ puge taba AvAja Ayo– “barakatayukta chan unI jo yasa agnibhitra chan ra unIharU pani jo yasako varipari chan | ati pavitra chan allAha jo sArA jagatkA mAlika hun |”
e mUsA! nissandeha, ma nai hu~– allAha; atyanta prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI |

ra, timI Aphno lauro dhartImA rAkha | mUsAle tyo lauro sarpa jhaiM ghisriMdai gareko dekhe taba piThyU~ pharkAera bhAge ra pachADi pharkera pani herenan | (bhaniyo)– “he mUsA! naDarAU! rasUlaharU ma najika DarAunu pardaina..
tara tyo vyakti jasale atyAcAra garyo | ani duSkarma garepachi punaH puNya kArya garyo | nissandeha ma ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chu |

ra, Aphno hAta kAkhImA rAkha, tyo kunai rogabinA nai camkilo seto bhaera niskanecha | yI nauvaTA camatkAramadhyekA hun | (yI sabai liera) phiraauna tathA unakA samudAyasamakSa jAU | vAstavamA tinIharU durAcArI hun |
jaba tinIharUsamakSa hAmrA spaSTa nizAnIharU puge taba tinIharUle bhane– “yo ta spaSTa rUpamA jAdU ho |”
ra, tinIharUle atyAcAra tathA ahaGkArale gardA tI camatkAraharUlAI inkAra gare jabaki tinIharUkA AtmA tinIharUprati vizvasta thie | ataH hera, kasto bhayo vidhvaMsakArI– harUko pariNAma!

ra, hAmIle dAUda tathA sulaimAnalAI jJAna pradAna garyauM | ani tI duvaile bhane– “sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhakailAgi hun jasale hAmIlAI AphnA adhikAMza AsthAvAna bhaktaharUmAthi pradhAnatA pradAna gare |”

ani sulaimAna dAUdakA uttarAdhikArI bane | ra, bhane– “he mAnisaharU ho! hAmIlAI paMkSIharUko bhASA sikAieko cha, ani sabai prakArakA vastuharU pradAna garieko cha | nissandeha yo (allAhako) spaSTa kRpA ho |”
ra, sulaimAnasamakSa unakA phauja jinna, manuSya tathA paMkSIharUlAI bhelA garieko thiyo jasalAI vibhinna samUhamA vibhAjana garera laginthyo |

yahA~samma ki jaba tinIharU kamilAharUko upatyakAmA puge taba euTA kamilAle bhanyo– “he kamilAharU ho! A–AphnA dulAharUbhitra pasihAla anyathA sulaimAna ra unakA laskarale ajJAnatAvaza timIharUlAI kulcanechan |”

ani unako kurA sunera sulaimAna musumusu hA~se ra bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA! timIle ma ra merA mAtApitAprati gareko kRpAle gardA timro kRtajJa banne ra timro prasannatA prApta garna sakne satkarma garne kAryako kSamatA pradAna gara ra Aphno dayAdvArA malAI timrA AphnA satkarmI bhaktaharUmA sAmela gara |
ani, unale sabai paMkSIharUlAI khojatalAsa gare ra bhane– “ke ho, ma hudhud (nAmaka caro) lAI dekhdina | ke tyo anupasthita cha?
ma tyasalAI kaThora daNDa dinechu, yA tyasalAI vadha nai garidinechu |” athavA tyasale masamakSa ucita spaSTikaraNa prastuta garos |
ani, kehI samaya nabitdai hudhud Aera bhanyo– “maile yasto kurAko jJAna prApta gareko chu jasabAre tapAIM avagata hunuhunna, ra maile sabAbATa tapAIMkolAgi euTA satya khabara lyAeko chu |
maile ekajanA yastI mahilAlAI dekheM jo Aphno samudAyako zAsaka hun ra tinalAI sampUrNa cijaharU prApta cha tathA tinako euTA mahAn siMhAsana pani cha |,

maile unalAI tathA unako samudAyalAI allAhabAheka sUryako upAsanA gardai gareko pAe~ | ra, zaitAnale tinIharUkA kAryaharUlAI tinIharUko dRSTimA AkarSaka tulyAeko cha ani tinIharUlAI satmArgabATa rokeko cha | tyasaile tinIharU sIdhAmArga pAirahekA chainan |

(usale rokyo) ki tinIharU eka mAtra allAhasAmu sajdA nagarUn jasale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA adRzya cijaharUlAI bAhira lyAu~chan, ra timIharUle gopya rAkhekA tathA prakaTa garekA sabai kurAharUlAI jAndachan |
allAha unai hun, jasabAheka anya kohI upAsya chaina | unI nai mahAn siMhAsanakA svAmI hun |”
sulaimAnale (hudhudlAI) bhane– “timIle sA~co kurA garekA hau vA jhUTho hAmI cA~Dai nai hernechauM |
timI mero yo patra liera jAU ra yasalAI tinIharUsamakSa phyA~kideU | tyasapachi tinIharUbATa TADhA rahera hera ki tinIharU ke pratikriyA dekhAu~chan | ”
rAnIle bhanin– “he darabAriyAharU ho! malAI euTA mahatvapUrNa patra prApta bhaeko cha |
yo sulaimAnako tarphabATa Aeko ho ra juna yo ho ki, “zuru atyanta karuNAmaya parama dayAlu allAhako nAmabATa |
mero avajJA nagara ra mero AjJA mAnera masamakSa hAjira hoU |”
rAnIle bhanin– “he darabAriyAharU ho! malAI yasa mAmilAmA parAmarza deU | ma timIharUko sallAha binA kunai Thosa nirNaya gardina |”
tinIharUle bhane– “hAmI zaktizAlI tathA vIra chauM ra nirNaya tapAIMko hAtamA cha | tapAIM svayaM vicAra garnuhos ki hAmIlAI ke Adeza dinuhuncha |”
rAnIle bhanin– “kurA ke cha bhane, jaba rAjAharU kunai dezamA praveza garchana tyasalAI naSTa ra tyahA~kA sammAnita vyaktiharUlAI apamAnita garchan | ra, yinIharU pani tyastai garchan |
ra ma tinIharUlAI euTA upahAra paThAu~chu ra herchu ki (merA) dUtaharU ke kasto uttara liera Au~chan |”

ra, jaba dUtaharU sulaimAnakahA~ Ae taba unale bhane–“ke timIharU dhana sampattidvArA mero maddata garna cAhanchau? allAhale malAI jejati pradAna garekA chan tyo timIharUlAI dieko dhana sampattibhandA uttama raheko cha, baru timIharU nai Aphno upahArasa~ga ramAU |

( he dUtaharu! ) pharkera tinIharUsamakSa jAU, tinIharUviruddha hAmI yastA senA liera AunechauM jasako mukAbilA tinIharUle garnasakne chainan, ra tyahA~bATa tinIharUlAI beijjatIpUrvaka nikAlnechauM ani tinIharU apamAnita hunechan |”
(sulaimAnale) bhane– “he merA bhAradAraharU ho! tinIharU makahA~ AjJAkArI bhaI Aunuaghi nai timIharUmadhye kasale usako siMhAsana mero sAmunne prastuta garna sakcha?
eka zaktizAlI jinnale bhanyo– “tapAIM Aphno sthAnabATa uThnuaghi nai ma tyasalAI tapAIMsamakSa prastuta garnechu | malAI yo zakti prApta cha ra ma vizvasanIya pani chu |”

granthako jJAnaprApta ekajanAle bhane– “tapAIMle A~khA jhimkyAunubhandA pani cA~Dai ma tyo tapAIMsamakSa prastuta garna sakchu |” ani jaba unale tyo (siMhAsana) Aphno agADi rAkheko dekhe taba unale bhane– “yo ta merA pAlanakartAko varadAna ho tAki unale mero parIkSA leUn ki ma kRtajJa chu vA kRtaghna! ra, jo kRtajJa bancha U AphnailAgi kRtajJa bancha ra jo kRtaghna bancha (usale Aphnai hAni garcha) ta merA pAlanakartA nispRha evaM pratiSThita chan |
sulaimAnale bhane– “rAnIko siMhAsanamA ali pherabadala garideU, herauM unI tyasalAI cinna sakchin vA cinna nasakneharUmadhyeki hunchin |

jaba rAnI Ain taba unalAI bhaniyo– “ke timro siMhAsana yastai cha?” unale bhanin– “mAnau yo tyahI ho | ani yasaaghi nai hAmIlAI jJAna prApta bhaisakeko thiyo ra hAmI AjJAkArI (muslima) banisakekA thiyauM |”
rAnIlAI tI upAsyaharUle rokekA thie jasako tinI pUjA garne garthin | tinI kRtaghna mAnisaharUmadhyekI thiin |

unalAI bhaniyo– “yasa mahalamA praveza gara |” ra, jaba unale tyo dekhin taba tyasalAI pAnIko kuNDa ThAnin ra tyasamA pasnakolAgi piDauMlAsamma lugA uThAin | sulaimAnale bhane– “yo ta pUrNa rUpamA sIsA jaDita mahala ho |” tinale bhanin– “he merA pAlanakartA! maile svayaMmAthi atyAcAra gareki thie~ ra ma sulaimAnasamakSa sampUrNa jagatkA svAmI allAhako AjJAkArI bane~ |”
ra, hAmIle samUdakA samudAyatarpha unakA bhAi sAlehalAI paThAyauM ki kevala allAhako upAsanA gara | tara tinIharU duI samUhamA vibhAjita bhaI paraspara jhagaDA garna thAle |
sAlehale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! timIharU bhalAibhandA pahile hAnIkolAgi kina hatAra garchau? timIharU allAhasita kSamAyAcanA kina gardainau tAki timIharUmAthi dayA gariyos?”
tinIharUle bhane– “hAmI ta timI ra timIsita rahekA mAnisaharUlAi alacchina ThAnchauM |” sAlehale bhane– “timIharUko apasaguna ta allAhasita nai cha, baru timIharUko po parIkSA liIMdai cha ta |”
ra, zaharamA nauvaTA samUhaharU thie jasale dezamA vidhvaMsa maccAune garthe ra sudhArako kAma gardainathe |

tinIharUle bhane– “ApasamA allAhako kasama khAU ki hAmI avazya nai sAleha ra usakA parivAramAthi rAtI AkramaNa garnechauM, ani usakA uttarAdhikArIlAI bhannechauM ki hAmI usako parivArako hatyAsthala gaekA pani thienau | hAmI sA~co bolirahekAchauM |”
ani, tinIharUle SaDyantra gare ra hAmIle pani yojanA banAyauM jasako jAnakArI tinIharUlAI thiena |
ataH hera kasto pariNAma bhayo tinIharUko SaDyantrako | hAmIle tinIharUlAI ra tinIharukA samudAyakA mAnisaharUlAI pUrNa rUpamA vinAza garidiyauM |
ani yinai hun tinIharUkA gharaharU juna, tinIharUle garne garekA atyAcArako kAraNale, dhvasta bhae | nissandeha yasamA jJAnI mAnisaharUkAlAgi nizAnI raheko cha |
ra, ImAna lyAune tathA Izabhaya rAkhne mAnisaharUlAI hAmIle bacAyauM |
ra, smaraNa gara lUtalAI jaba unale AphnA jAti–bandhuharUlAI bhane– “ke timIharU khullamakhullA ghRNita kArya garchau?
ke timIharU yaunatRSNA meTAuna mahilAko sATo puruSatarpha jAne garchau? vAstavamA timIharU nikRSTa ajJAnI samUdAya hau |”
unako samUdAyako uttara yo mAtra thiyo ki, unale bhane lUta ra unakA anuyAyIharUlAI Aphno bastIbATa nikAlI deU | yinIharU ati nai pavitra rahane mAnisaharU hun |
ani hAmIle lUta tathA unakA parivAralAI bacAyauM unakI patnI bAheka jasalAI hAmIle pachi rahaneharUmadhyemA nizcita garekA thiyauM |
ra, hAmIle tinIharUmAthi varSA barsAyauM | katti nikRSTa thiyo sAvadhAna gariekA mAnisaharUmAthi garieko varSA!

(he sandeSTA!) bhanideU– “sampUrNa prazaMsAharU allAhakailAgi hun, ra unakA tI bhaktaharUmAthi salAma tathA zAnti hos jasalAI unale cayana garekA chan |” (tinIharUlAI sodha!) ke allAha uttama chan vA tI upAsyaharU jasalAI tinIharU unako sAjhedAra banAu~chan?

(ke tI sAjhedAraharU uttama chan) vA unI jasale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko sRSTi gare ra timrAlAgi AkAzabATa pAnI barsAe? ani hAmIle nai tyasadvArA zobhAyamAna bagaiMcA umAryauM | timIharUle tyasako bRkSa umArna sakdainathyau | (vicAra gara) ke allAhakAsAtha kohI anya pUjya pani chan ra? baru yI mAnisaharU nai satmArgabATa haTirahekA chan |

(ke tI sAjhedAraharU uttama chan) vA unI jasale dhartIlAI bAsasthAna banAe tathA tyasamA nadIharU bagAe ani tyasamA cukula (ko rUpamA pahADa) banAe ra duI samudra bIca (adRzya) abarodhaka banAe? (bhana) ke allAhakAsAtha kohI anya pUjya pani chan ta? baru yinIharUmadhye adhikAMza vyaktiharU ajJAnI chan |

(ke tI sAjhedAraharU uttama chan) vA unI jasale vyAkulako sundachan jaba usale unalAI pukArdacha? ra, jasale usako saGkaTa nivAraNa garchan ani jasale timIharUlAI dhartImA uttarAdhikArI banAu~chan? (soca) ke allAhakA– sAtha kohI anya pUjya pani chan ta? timIharU kamai vicAra garchau |

(ke tI sAjhedAraharU uttama chan) vA unI jasale timIharUlAI bhUmi tathA samudrakA andhakAraharUmA timIharUlAI mArga dekhAu~chan? ra, vAyulAI Aphno dayA (varSA) bhandA pahile zubha–sUcanA svarUpa paThAu~chan? (soca) ke allAhakAsAtha kohI anya pUjya pani chan ta? yinIharUle garne garekA zirka (bahudevavAda) bATa allAha ati ucca rahekA chan |

( ke tI sAjhedAraharU uttama chan ) vA unI jasale prathama paTaka sRSTi gardachan ra pheri tyasako punarAvRtti pani garchan? ra, jasale timIharUlAI AkAza tathA dhartIbATa jIvikA pradAna garchan? (batAU) ke allAhakAsAtha kohI anya pUjya pani chan ta? bhanideU– “yadi timIharU satya hau bhane AphnA pramANaharU prastuta gara |”
bhanideU– “allAhabAheka AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA rahekA kohI pani parokSako jJAtA chaina, ra tinIharUlAI kahile uThAincha bhanne kurA tinIharU jAndainan |”
baru Akhiratako bAremA tinIharUko jJAna apuga bhaisakekocha; baru yasasambandhamA tinIharU sandehamA chan; baru tinIharU yasa viSayamA andho bhaisakekA chan |
ra, kAphiraharU bhanchan– “jaba hAmI ra hAmrA pUrvajaharU mATo bhaisakekA hunechauM taba ke hAmI (cihAnabATa) nizcita rUpamA nikAlinechauM ta?
yasa kisimakA vAcA ta hAmIsa~ga ra yasabhandA pahile hAmrA pUrvajaharUsa~ga pani gariMdai Aeko cha | yI ta pUrkhAharUkA dantyakathAharU mAtra hun |”
bhanideU– “dhartImA bhramaNa garera hera; kasto pariNAma bhayo aparAdhIharUko?”
ra, (he nabI!) yinIharUko avasthAbAre duHkhI nahoU | ra, yinIharUko SaDyantrale gardA mana sAno napAra |
ra, yinIharU bhanchan– “yadi timI satya hau bhane yo vAcA kahile pUrA huncha?”
bhanideU– “ke thAhA, juna kurAkonimti timIharU hatArirahekA chau tyasako kehI aMza timIharUko najika nai Aisakeko cha ki |”
ra, nissandeha timrA pAlanakartA mAnisaharUprati ati udAra chan | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU kRtajJatA dekhAu~dainan |
nissandeha timrA raba rAmrarI jAndachan juna tinIharUkA hRdayale lukAu~chan ra juna tinIharUle prakaTa gardachan |
AkAza evaM dhartImA kunai yasto gopya vastu chaina jo spaSTa kitAbamA ( lukhiekAe ) nahos |
nissandeha yasa kuraAnale isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI tinIharUle matabheda garirahekA adhikAMza kurAharU batAu~cha |
ra, yo (kuraAna) AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi mArgadarzana tathA dayA ho |
nizcaya nai timrA rabale tinIharUbIca AphnA AdezadvArA nirNaya garnechan | ra, unI prabhutvazAlI evaM sarvajJa chan |
ataH (he nabI!) allAhaprati bharosA rAkha; nizcaya nai timI spaSTa rUpamA nitAnta satyamA kAyama chau |
timI Aphno pukAra na murdAharUlAI sunAuna sakchau na bahirAharUlAI nai jabaki tinIharU piThyU~ pharkAera jAne chan |
ra, na andholAI pathabhraSTatAbATa nikAlera (sIdhA) mArga nai dekhAuna sakchau | timI ta kevala hAmrA AyataharUmAthi ImAna lyAunelAI sunAuna sakchau | ani tinIharU AjJAkArI pani hunchan |

ra, jaba tinIharUsa~gako (kayAmatako) vAcA pUrA hune samaya Aunecha taba hAmI tinIharUkAlAgi dhartIbATa euTA yasto janAvara nikAlnechauM juna tinIharUsa~ga kurA garnecha ( yasa kAraNale ki) ki mAnisaharU hAmrA AyataharUmAthi vizvAsa gardainathe |
ra, tyasa dina hAmI hAmrA AyataharUlAI jhuTho Thahara garne pratyeka samudAyakA vyaktiharUko euTA ThUlo samUhalAI bhelA pArnechauM | ani, tinIharUlAI vibhinna samUhaharUmA vibhAjana garinecha |
yahA~samma ki, sabai Aipugepachi allAhale bhannechan– “ke timIharUle merA AyataharUlAI tinIharuko sambandhamA pUrNa jJAna prApta nagarikanai jhuTho Thahara garyau? vA timIharU ke garirahekA thiyau?”
ra, tinIharUko atyAcArale gardA tinIharUsa~ga garieko (yAtanAko) vAcA pUrA hunecha | tyatikhera tinIharU kehI bolna sakne chainan |
ke tinIharUle dekhekA chainan ki hAmIle rAtalAI vizrAmakolAgi (a~dhyAro) ra dinalAI (kAmako lAgi) ujyAlo banAekA chauM? nissandeha yasamA AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |

ra, juna dina sUra (narasiGghA) phukinecha tyasa dina AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA jejati chan tI sabai bhayabhita hunechan, tinIharU bAheka jasalAI allAhale (surakSita rAkhna) cAhanchan | ra, sabai unIkahA~ vinamra bhaI hAjira hunechan |

ra, timIharU pahADaharUlAI dekhdA tinIharU sthira chan bhanne ThAnchau tara tinIharU pani bAdala jhaiM uDnechan | yo allAhako sRSTi ho jasale pratyeka cijalAI sudRDha tulyAekA chan | nissandeha unI timIharUko pratyeka kAryabATa avagata chan |
juna mAnisaharU puNyakA sAtha (allAhasamakSa) hAjira hunechan, tinIharukAlAgi tyobhandA uttama pratidAna pani hunecha ra yastA vyaktiharU tyasa dina hune DarabATa surakSita rahanechan |
ra, juna mAnisaharU pApakAsAtha (allAhasamakSa) hAjira hunechan tyastA mAnisaharUlAI u~dhomunTo pArI agnimA hominecha | (sodhinecha) “ke timIharU Aphno karmako arU kunai pratiphala pAuna sakchau ta?”

(bhanideU) malAI kevala yasa nagarakA rabako upAsanAko Adeza diieko cha jasale yasalAI pratiSThita banAekA chan | ra, sampUrNa cijaharU unakailAgi hun | ra, malAI Adeza diieko cha ki ma muslimaharUmadhye hoU~ |
ra, yAe ki ma kuraAna paDhera sunAU~ | ataH jasale satmArga grahaNa garcha, usale AphnailAgi grahaNa garcha ra kohI pathabhraSTa huncha bhane bhanideU– “ma ta kevala sacetakaharUmadhye hu~ |”

ra, bhanideU– “sabai prazaMsAharU allAhakailAgi hun | unale timIharUlAI cA~Dai nai AphnA nizAnIharU dekhAunechan | ani timIharUle unalAI cinnechau | ra, timrA pAlanakartA timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbAre anabhijJa chainan |
tA0 sIna0 mIma0
yI spaSTa granthakA AyataharU hun |
(he muhammada sa.!) hAmI timIlAI mUsA tathA phiraaunako vRttAnta ThIkasa~ga sunAu~chau~ tI mAnisaharUkA lAgi jo vizvAsa garchan |

vAstavamA phiraauna dhartImA atyAcArI tathA ahaGkArI bhaisakeko thiyo ra usale tyahA~kA bAsindAharUlAI vibhAjana garera rAkheko thiyo ani tinIharUmadhye eka samUhalAI durbala tulyAeko thiyo | unIharUkA chorAharUlAI hatyA garthyau ra chorIharUlAI jIvita choDthyo | nizcaya nai tyo vidhvaMsakArIharUmadhye thiyo |
ta hAmI dhartImA durbala tulyAieko samUhako upakAra garna cAhanthyauM ra unIharUlAI aguvA tathA uttarAdhikArI banAuna cAhanthyauM |
ani, dezamA tinIharUlAI prabhutva pradAna garna cAhanthyauM, ani phiraauna, hAmAna ra tinIharukA sainikaharUlAI juna kurAko AzaGkA thiyo tyahI dekhAuna cAhanthyauM |

ra, hAmIle mUsAkI AmAlAI vahya garyauM “unalAI dUdha khuvAU | ani, jaba timIlAI unako bAremA khatarA mahasusa huncha taba unalAI nadImA rAkhidinU ra naDarAunU ani cintita pani nahunu | hAmI unalAI timIsamma avazya nai pharkAera lyAunechauM ra unalAI rasUlaharUmadhye banAunechauM |”
ani phiraaunakA mAnisaharUle unalAI (nadIbATa) jhike tAki unI tinIharUkA zatru tathA cintAko kAraNa banUn | nissandeha phiraauna, hAmAna tathA tinIharukA sainyaharUle galti garekA thie |
ra, phiraaunakI patnIle bhanin– “yo mero ra timro A~khAko zitalatA ho; yasalAI namAra; yo hAmrolAgi lAbhadAyaka hunasakcha vA hAmI yasalAI chorA banAuna sakchauM |” tara tinIharU anabhijJa thie |

ra, (utAtira) mUsAkI AmA bhAvavihvala thiin | hAmIle tinako hRdayalAI darilo napAridieko bhae tinale cA~Dai nai yo bheda kholne thiin | (yasako uddezya yo thiyo ki) tinI hAmro vacanamA vizvAsa garnevAlAharUmadhye hoUn |
ra, tinale mUsAkI didIlAI bhanin– “unalAI pachyAu~dai jAU |” ataH tinI ali TADhA rahera cheuchAubATa yasarI herdai gain ki zatruharUle cAla pani pAenan |

ra, hAmIle pahile nai mUsAkAlAgi dhAIAmAharuko dUdha varjita tulyAekA thiyauM | tasartha mUsAkI didIle (tyahA~ gaera) bhanin– “ke ma timIharUlAI yasto parivArasamma puryAU~ jasale timIharUkAlAgi yasako pAlanapoSaNa garidinechan ra unIharU yasako zubhacintaka rahanechan?”

ani yasarI hAmIle unalAI unakI AmAsamma pharkAidiyauM tAki tinako A~khAlAI zItalatA prApta hos ra tinI cintita nahoUn, ani allAhako vacana satya huncha bhanera jAnUn | tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |
ani, jaba unI yuvAvasthAmA puge ra unako (zArIrika) vikAsa pUrA bhayo taba hAmIle unalAI nirNayazakti tathA jJAna pradAna garyauM ra satkarmIharUlAI hAmI yasarI nai pratidAna dine garchauM |

ekadina mUsA zaharamA tyasabelA praveza gare jabaki nagarabAsIharU anabhijJa thie| tyahA~ unale duIjanA vyaktilAI jhagaDA gariraheko pAe | ekako sambandha unako Aphnai samudAyasita thiyo bhane arko vyakti cAhi~ zatru pakSako thiyo | ani unako samudAyako vyaktile zatru pakSako vyaktibiruddha maddatakolAgi pukAryo | ataH mUsAle usalAI mukkAle hirkAe ra usako jIvanalIlA nai samApta garidie | mUsAle (pazcAttApa gardai) bhane– “yo ta zaitAnako kArya bhayo | nizcaya nai tyo khullA zatru evaM pathabhraSTa garnevAlA ho |”
unale bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA! maile svayaMmAthi atyAcAra gareM | tasartha malAI mApha gara |” ataH allAhale unalAI mAphI die | nissandeha unI kSamAzIla (evaM) parama dayAlu chan |
mUsAle pratijJA gare– “he merA pAlanakartA! timIle maprati gareko yo upakArale gardA aba ma kahilyai aparAdhIharUko sahayogI bandina |”

(arko dina) bihAnai unI DarAu~dai ra khatarA mahasusa gardai zaharamA jA~dai thie | akasmAt aghillA dina maddatakolAgi pukArne vyaktile pheri maddatako lAgi karAu~dai bolAyo! mUsAle usalAI bhane– “timI mahAbhraSTa rahechau |”

ani jaba mUsAle tyasalAI samAtna cAhe jo duvaiko zatru thiyo, taba U (isrAIlI) cicyAyo– “he mUsA! ke timI malAI pani tyasarI nai mArna cAhanchau jasarI hijo ekajanAlAI mAryau? timI ta yasa dezamA ghora atyAcArI banera basna cAhanchau ra melamilApa garAuna cA~hadainau |”

tyasapachi zaharako cheubATa ekajanA dagurdai Ae ra bhane– “he mUsA! adhikArIharU ta timro hatyAbAre parAmarza garirahekAchan | tasartha timI yahA~bATa niskera gaihAla | ma timro hitaiSI madhyeko hu~ |”
ataH mUsA tyahA~bATa DarAu~dai satarkatAkAsAtha niske ra prArthanA gare– “he merA pAlanakartA! malAI atyAcArIharUbATa bacAU |”
(misrabATa niskepachi) mUsA madayanatira lAgdai bhane– “AzA cha, merA pAlanakartAle malAI sIdhA mArga dekhAUlAn |”

ra, jaba unI madayanako pAnIsamma puge taba tyahA~ unale mAnisaharUko euTA samUhalAI (A–AphnA janAvaraharUlAI) pAnI khuvAu~dai gareko pAe | ra, arkotarpha duIjanA mahilAharUlAI (AphnA janAvaraharUlAI) rokiraheko pAe | unale sodhe– “timIharUlAI ke apThyAro paryo?” duvaile bhane– “jabasamma tI goThAlAharU janAvaraharU liera jA~dainan tabasamma hAmI pAnI khuvAuna sakdainauM | ra, hAmrA pitA sAhrai bUDho hunuhuncha |”
tyasaile unale tinIharUkA janAvaraharUlAI pAnI khuvAidie | tyasapachi chahArItira gae ra bhane– “he merA raba! timIle malAI junasukai bhalAI pradAna gara, malAI tyasako AvazyakatA cha |”

tI duvai bahinIharumadhye ekajanA lajAI–lajAI hi~Ddai mUsAsamakSa Aera bhanin– “hAmrAnimti timIle pAnI khuvAeko pratiphala dina timIlAI merA pitAle bolAunu bhaeko cha |” jaba mUsA unIsamakSa pugera Aphno sampUrNa ghaTanA sunAe taba unale bhane– “naDarAU! aba timI atyAcArI samudAyabATa mukta bhaekAchau |”
tI duI mahilAmadhye euTIle bhanin–“he pitAjyU! yinalAI jyAlAdArImA rAkhnus kinabhane tapAIMle jyAlAdArImA rAkhna sarvottama vyakti uhI huna sakcha jo balavAna tathA ImAndAra cha |”,

unale ( mUsAlAI ) bhane– “timIle ATha varSasamma makahA~ jyAlAdArImA kAma garne zartamA ma AphnA yI duIjanA chorImadhye euTIko vivAha timIsita garidina cAhanchu | ra, timIle dasa varSa pUrA garyau bhane tyo timrotarphabATa (upakAra) hunecha ra ma timIlAI kaSTa dina cAhanna | inzAallAha ( allAhale cAhemA ) timIle malAI sajjana pAunechau |”
mUsAle bhane– “yo kurA ma ra tapAIMbIca taya bhayo | yI duI avadhimadhye juna avadhi pUrA gare pani mamAthi kunai atyAcAra nahos | ra, hAmro samjhautAmA allAha vakIla hun |”

ra, jaba mUsAle nirdhArita avadhi pUrA gare ra Aphno parivAralAI liera prasthAna gare taba unale tUra (nAmaka pahADa) tira Ago dekhe | unale Aphno parivAralAI bhane– “timIharU yahA~ parkha | maile euTA Ago dekheko chu | sambhavataH tyahA~bATa ma timIharUkAnimti kehI jAnakArI vA agulTo lyAU~ tAki timIharU tApna saka |”
jaba unI tyahA~ puge taba upatyakAko dAhine kinArAko barakatayukta kSetramA raheko rUkha najikabATa AvAja Ayo– “ai mUsA! ma nai allAha hu~; sampUrNa jagatkA svAmI |

ra, Aphno lauro tala rAkha |” ani jaba unale sarpajastai tyasalAI ghisriMdai gareko dekhe taba unI piThyU~ pharkAera bhAge ra pachADi pharkera pani herenan | (allAhale bhane) he mUsA! agADi AU ra naDarAU | timI pUrNa rUpamA surakSita chau |

Aphno hAta kAkhImA rAkha | yo kunai rogabinA nai camkilo seto bhaI niskanecha | ra, bhayabATa bacnakolAgi Aphno pAkhurA Aphno jiumA TAsaU | yI duIvaTA spaSTa nizAnI timro pAlanakartAko tarphabATa phiraauna tathA usakA darabArIharUkAlAgi rahekA chan | nizcaya nai tinIharU ati avajJAkArI mAnisa hun |
mUsAle bhane– “he merA svAmI! maile tinIharUmadhyekA eka vyaktiko hatyA gareko chu | tinIharUle malAI mArlAn bhanne Dara lAgcha |

ra, merA bhAi hArUna bolImA mabhandA baDhI ghArApravAha cha | tasartha usalAI mero sahAyaka banAera masa~ga paThAU, tAki usale mero samarthana garos | tinIharUle malAI jhuTho Thahara garlAn bhanne Dara lAgcha |”

allAhale bhane– “timro bhAidvArA timro pAkhurAlAI sazakta pArnechauM ra timI duvailAI yasto prabhutva pradAna garnechauM ki tinIharU timIsamma pugna pani sakdainan | ra, hAmrA nizAnIharUle gardA timIharU ra timrA anuyAyIharU nai vijayI hunechau |
ra, jaba mUsA hAmrA spaSTa nizAnIharU liera tinIharUsamakSa Ae taba tinIharUle bhane– “yo kevala banAvaTI jAdU ho ra hAmIle hAmrA pUrkhAharUbATa yastA kurAharU sunekA nai chainauM |
mUsAle bhane– “merA pAlanakartA rAmrarI jAndachan ki ko unIkahA~bATa mArgadarzana liera Aeko cha ra kasako antima pariNAma rAmro hunecha | vAstavamA atyAcArIharU kahilyai saphala hune chainan |

phiraaunale bhanyo “he darabAriyAharU ho! mabAheka timIharUkA anya kohI upAsyalAI ma jAndina | e hAmAna! mero nimti IMTa tayAra gara ra merolAgi euTA ucca bhavana nirmANa gara tAki ma tyasamA caDhera mUsAkA upAsyalAI herU~ | ma usalAI jhuThA vyaktiharUmadhye ThAndachu |
ra, phiraauna evaM usako phaujale dhartImA binA haka ghamaNDa gare | ra, tinIharUlAI kadApi hAmIsamakSa pharkAera lyAine chaina bhanne tinIharUle ThAne |
ani hAmIle usalAI ra usakA phaujalAI samAtyauM ra samudramA phyA~kidiyauM | ataH hera! kasto pariNAma bhayo atyAcArIharUko!
ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI aguvA banAyauM jo narakatarpha bolAu~chan | ra, mahApralayako dina tinIharUlAI kunai sahayoga prApta hune chaina |
ra, yasa saMsAramA hAmIle dhikkAralAI tinIharUkA pachADi lagAI diyauM | ra, tinIharU mahApralayakA dina bhalAibATa baJcita garinechan |
ra, pahilekA baMzaharUlAI vinAza garI hAmIle mUsAlAI mAnisaharUkAnimti zikSA, mArgadarzana tathA dayAsvarUpa grantha pradAna garyauM tAki tinIharUle upadeza grahaNa garUn |
(he muhammada sa.!) jaba hAmIle mUsAlAI (zarIatako) Adeza diyauM tyasa belA timI pazcimI bhAgamA upasthita thienauM, na timI sAkSIharUmA sAmela thiyau |

tara, hAmIle kaiyauM pustAharUlAI uThAyauM ra tinIharUko lAmo samaya bitisakeko cha | timI madayana bAsIharUmAjha pani thienauM ki tinIharUlAI hAmrA AyataharU pATha garera sunAune thiyau | ani hAmI nai (rasUla) paThAunevAlA hauM |

ra, jaba hAmIle (mUsAlAI) pukArekA thiyauM tyasa samaya pani timI tUrako kAkhamA thienau tara yo timro pAlanakartAko dayA ho tAki timIle tI mAnisaharUlAI sAvadhAna gara jasatarpha timIbhandA pahile kunai sacetaka AekA thienan tAki tinIharUle zikSA grahaNa garUn |

tinIharUko Aphnai karmale gardA tinIharUmAthi saGkaTa naAeko bhae tinIharUle yo bhanne thie–“he pAlanakartA! timIle hAmItarpha kina kunai rasUla paThAenau tAki hAmI timrA AyataharUko anusaraNa garauM ra AsthAvAnaharUmadhye hoauM?”

tara jaba tinIharUsamakSa hAmro tarphabATa satyako Agamana bhayo taba tinIharUle bhane– “juna kurA mUsAlAI pradAna garieko thiyo tyastai kurA unalAI (muhammada sa.lAI) pani kina pradAna gariena?” ke tinIharUle mUsAlAI pradAna garieko zikSAlAI asvIkAra garekA thienan ra? tinIharUle bhane– “yI duvai jAdUgara hun jo ekaarkAko sahAyatA garchan |” ra, bhane– “hAmI kasailAI mAndainauM |”
bhanideU– “timIharU saccA hau bhane yI duvaibhandA rAmro mArga dekhAune grantha allAhakotarphabATa lyAU, ma tyasako anusaraNa garU~ |”

yadi tinIharUle timro kurA mAnenan bhane, jAnI rAkha ki tinIharU kevala Aphno manokAMkSAko pachi lAgirahekA chan | ra, tyo vyaktibhandA baDhI pathabhraSTa arU ko huna sakcha jo allAhako mArgadarzana choDI Aphnai manokAMkSAko pachi lAgcha? vAstavamA allAha atyAcArI vyaktiharUlAI mArga dekhAu~dainan |
ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI nirantara upadeza puryAyauM tAki tinIharUle zikSA grahaNa garUn |
jasalAI yasaaghi hAmIle grantha pradAna garekA thiyauM tinIharU yasamAthi AsthA rAkhchan |

ra, jaba unIharUlAI yasako pATha garera sunAincha taba unIharU bhanchan “hAmIle yasamAthi ImAna lyAyauM |” nissandeha yo hAmrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa Aeko akATya satya ho | ra, hAmI ta pahiledekhi nai AjJAkArI hauM |
unIharUle dhairyadhAraNa gareko hunAle unIharUlAI dobbara pratidAna diinecha | unIharU puNyakarmadvArA pApa meTAune garchan ra hAmIle pradAna garekA cijaharUbATa kharca garne garchan |

ra, jaba tinIharU vyartha kurA sunchan taba tyasalAI bevAstA garchan ra bhanchan–“ hAmrA kAryaharU hAmrainimti hun ra timIharUkA kAryaharU timIharUkai nimti | timIharUlAI salAma cha! murkhaharUsa~ga hAmro kunai vastA chaina |”
(he muhammada sa.!) timI jasalAI cAhanchau tyasalAI satmArgamA DoryAuna sakdainau | tara allAha jasalAI cAhanchan satmArgamA DoryAu~chan | ra, unI satmArga grahaNa garneharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |

ra, tinIharU (anAsthAvAdIharU) bhanchan– “(he muhammada sa.!) yadi hAmI timIsa~ga yasa mArgamA hiDyauM bhane hAmIlAI hAmrai bhUmibATa samAtera laginecha | ke hAmIle zAntipUrNa harama lAI tinIharUkAlAgi bAsasthAna banAenau jahA~ hAmrotarphabATa hareka prakArakA phalaharU jIvikAsvarUpa tAniMdai Airahanchan? tara, tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza vyaktiharU jAndainan |

ra, hAmIle katipaya yastA nagaraharUlAI vinAza garyauM jasakA bAsindAharU Aphno dhana–sampattiprati ati ahaGkArI thie | yI tinIharukA gharaharU hun juna tinIharUpachi thorai bAheka AbAda bhaenan, vAstavamA hAmI nai vArisa hauM |

ra, timrA pAlanakartAle tabasamma kunai nagaralAI dhvasta pArdainan jabasamma unI tyasako kendramA kunai yastA rasUla paThAu~dainan jasale tinIharUlAI hAmrA AyataharU paDhera sunAUn ra na hAmI kunai nagaralAI tyahA~kA bAsindAharU atyAcArI hunubhandA aghi nai naSTa garne garchauM |

ra, timIharUlAI jejati pradAna garieko cha tyo ta sAMsArika jIvanako sukha–sAmagrI evaM yasako zobhA mAtra ho | ra, jejati allAhakahA~ cha, tyo uttama evaM cirasthAyI cha | ke timIharU buddhile kAma liMdainau |

ke tyo vyakti jasalAI hAmIle satya vacana diekA chauM juna usale avazya nai pAunecha, tyo vyakti saraha huna sakcha jasalAI hAmIle kevala yasai saMsArako sukha–sAmagrI diekA chauM ra jasalAI (kayAmatako dina sajAya~ko lAgi) peza garinecha?
tyo dina jaba allAhale tinIharUlAI bolAunechan ra sodhnechan– “kahA~ chan timIharUle ThAnekA sAjhedAraharU?

yo kurA jasamAthi lAgU huncha tinIharUle bhannechan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! nissandeza yinIharU nai hun jasalAI hAmIle pathabhraSTa pArekA thiyau | yinIharUlAI hAmIle tyasarI nai pathabhraSTa pArekA thiyauM jasarI hAmI svayaM pathabhraSTa bhaekA thiyauM | hAmI timIsAmu unIharUbATa alaga bhaeko ghoSaNA gardachauM | tinIharUle hAmro upAsanA gardainathe |”

ra, tinIharUlAI bhaninecha– “timIharU AphnA sAjhedAraharUlAI bolAU |” ani tinIharUle unIharUlAI pukArnechan | tara unIharUle tinIharUlAI uttara dine chainan | ra, tinIharUle yAtanA dekhnechan | kaThai! tinIharUle satmArga grahaNa gareko bhae!
ra, smaraNa gara tyo dina jaba allAhale tinIharUlAI bolAera sodhnechan– “timIharUle Aphno dUtaharUlAI ke javApha diekA thiyau?”
ani, tinIharUlAI tyo dina kunai javApha phurne chaina ra na eka arkAsa~ga sodhna nai saknechan |
parantu jasale taubA (prAyazcita) garyo, ImAna lyAyo ra satkarma garyo AzA cha U saphala huneharUmadhye hunecha |

ra, timrA pAlanakartA je cAhanchan sRSTi garchan ra jasalAI cAhanchan cayana garchan | tinIharUlAI tyasako kunai akhtiyAra chaina | tinIharUle ThaharAune gareko sAjhedArabhandA allAha atyanta pavitra evaM ati ucca chan |
yinIharUkA chAtIharUle je lukAu~chan ra yinIharU je prakaTa garchan timrA pAlanakartA tyasalAI jAndachan |
ra, unai allAha hun jobAheka kohI upAsya chaina | loka evaM paraloka duvaimA prazaMsA unaikAlAgi raheko cha ra unaiko Adeza pani | ra, timIharU unaitarpha pharkera jAnucha |

he nabI! (yinIharUlAI) sodha– “ke timIharUle vicAra garekAchau yadi allAhale timIharUmAthi mahApralayako dinasamma sadhaiMkolAgi nirantara rAta pAridieko bhae allAhabAheka kuna yasto Izvara cha jasale timrolAgi ujyAlo pArna sakcha? ke timIharU sundainau?

(he nabI sa.!) yinIharUlAI sodha– “ke timIharUle kahilyai vicAra garyau yadi allAhale timIharUmAthi kayAmatako dinasamma sadhaiMkolAgi nirantara dina banAidiekA bhae allAhabAheka kuna yasto Izvara cha jasale timIharUkAlAgi rAta pArna sakcha jasamA timIharU vizrAma garna sakchau? ke timIharU dekhdainauM?
yo allAhakai dayA ho ki unale timIharUkAlAgi rAta tathA dina banAe tAki timIharU rAtamA ArAma prApta gara ra dinamA AphnA pAlanakartAko varadAna khojna saka | AzA cha timIharU kRtajJa hunchau |
smaraNa gara jaba unale tinIharUlAI bolAera sodhnechan– “timIharUle merolAgi ThAnekA sAjhedAraharU kahA~ chan?”

ra, hAmIle pratyeka samudAyabATa ekajanA sAkSI lyAunechauM ra bhannechauM– “lyAU aba AphnA pramANaharU |” tyatikhera tinIharUle nitAnta satya allAhakailAgi raheko kurA jAnnechan ra tinIharUle juna jhuTho Aropa lagAune garthe tI sabai harAunechan |

kArUna mUsAko samudAyako eka sadasya thiyo tara U Aphnai samudAyaviruddha uddaNDa bhayo | ra, hAmIle usalAI yati dhana–sampatti diekA thiyauM ki tyasakA sA~cAharU balavAna vyaktiharUko euTA dalale muskilale uThAuna sakdathyo | jaba usakA samudAyale usalAI bhane– “ghamaNDa nagara, allAha ghamaNDIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |

ra, allAhale timIlAI pradAna gareko dhanabATa Akhirata (mRtyupachiko jIvana) ko gharako cAhanA gara ra Aphno sAMsArIka aMza pani nabhula | ra, allAhale timImAthi garekA upakAra jhaiM timI pani (mAnisaharumAthi) upakAra gara | ra, dhartImA vidhvaMsa namaccAU nissandeha allAha vidhvaMsakArIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |”

usale bhanyo– “yo ta mero jJAnako AdhAramA prApta bhaeko ho |” ke usalAI yo jJAna thiena ki allAhale tyasabhandA pahile kaiyauM pustAlAI naSTa garisakekAchan jo tyasabhandA pani zaktizAlI evaM jatthAvAlA thie | ra, aparAdhIharUsita tinIharUko doSabAre sodhine chaina |

(eka dina) jaba kArUna Aphno samudAyabIca ekadama ThAThabAThakAsAtha niskyo taba sAMsArika jIvanalAI mana parAuneharUle bhane–“kArUna jhaiM hAmIlAI pani dhana–sampatti prApta bhaeko bhae! tyo ta ati bhAgyamAnI rahecha |”
jJAnI vyaktiharUle bhane– “apasoca timImAthi! ImAna lyAune ra satkarma garne vyaktiharUkAlAgi ta allAhakai pratidAna uttama cha | ra, yo pratidAna dhairyavAnaharUlAI mAtra prApta huncha |”
antataH hAmIle kArUnalAI usako ghara sahita dhartImA dhasAidiyauM | tasartha, allAhabATa usalAI bacAune na kunai samUha thiyo, na U AphaiM bacna sakyo |

aba tyahI vyaktiharUle nai jo biteko dina usako sthAnaprAptiko kAmanA garne, bhanna thAle–“apasoca! hAmIle birsekA thiyauM ki allAha AphnA upAsakaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanchan, khubai jIvikA pradAna gardachan ra jasalAI cAhanchan simita mAtrAmA dinchan | yadi allAhale hAmImAthi upakAra nagareko bhae hAmIlAI pani dhartImA dhasAidine thie | apasoca! hAmIle kAphiraharU saphala huna sakdainan bhanne kurA birsekA thiyauM |
tyo Akhiratako gharalAI ta hAmIle dhartImA Aphno baDappana na cAhane ra vidhvaMsa namaccAuneharUlAI dinechauM | ra, rAmro pariNAma ta Izabhaya rAkhneharUkAlAgi nai raheko cha |
puNyakarma liera Aune vyaktikolAgi tyasabhandA uttama pratidAna raheko cha, ra pApa liera Aune vyaktiko lAgi usale gareko karma anusAra nai badalA milnecha |

he nabI sa.! vizvAsa gara ki jasale timImAthi kuraAna anivArya garekA chan unale timIlAI euTA uttama pariNAmasamma avazya puryAunechan | bhanideU– “merA pAlanakartA mArgadarzana liera AunelAI pani rAmrarI jAndachan ra spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA grasta vyaktilAI pani |
timImAthi yo grantha avataraNa garinecha bhanI timIlAI kadApi AzA thiena, tara yo kevala timrA pAlanakartAko dayA ho | ataH kadApi kAphiraharUko sahayogI nahunU |
ra, allAhakA AyataharU timImAthi avataraNa bhaepachi (yasako prasArabATa) timIlAI tinIharUle kadApi narokUn | ra, AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha bolAU ani bahudevavAdIharUmA kahilyai sAmela nahoU |

ra, allAhakAsAtha anya kunai pani pUjyalAI napukAra | unIbAheka kohI pUjya chaina | unako astitva bAheka sampUrNa cija naSTa hunechan | zAsana unaiko ho ra timIharU sabailAI unaitarpha pharkera jAnu cha |
aliph0 lAm0 mIm0
ke mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAe bhandaimA unIharUlAI tyattikai choDinecha bhanne ThAnekA chan, ra tinIharUko parIkSA liine chaina?
jabaki hAmIle yinIharUbhandA pahile bitekA sabai mAnisaharUko kaThina parIkSA liisakekA chauM, ani allAhale avazya jAnnechan ki ko satyavAdIharU hun ra ko jhuThAharU |
ke duSkArya garneharU hAmro niyantraNabATa umkana saphala hunechan bhanne ThAnekA chan? galata phaisalA ho juna tinIharU garirahekA chan |
jo allAhasita bheTne AzA rAkhcha (U nizcinta hoos ki) allAhale nirdhAraNa gareko samaya Aune nai cha | ra, allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |
jo saGgharSa garnecha usale Aphnai bhalAIko lAgi garnecha | nissandeha allAha saMsArabAsIharUsita nispRha chan |
ra, jo ImAna lyAunechan ra satkarma garnechan, hAmIle tinIharUkA duSkarmaharU tinIharUbATa haTAunechauM ani tinIharUlAI tinIharUle garne garekA uttama karmaharUko badalA avazya nai dinechauM |

ra, hAmIle manuSyalAI unakA mAtApitAsa~ga rAmro vyavahArako Adeza diekA chauM | yadi tinIharU timImAthi dabAva dinchan ki tyasalAI mero sAjhedAra ThaharyAU jasako upAsya bhaeko timIlAI jJAna chaina bhane tinIharUko AjJApAlana nagara | timIharU matarpha nai pharkera Aunucha | ani ma timIharUlAI timIharUle garne garekA karmaharUbAre avagata garAunechu |
ra, ImAna lyAune tathA pUNyakarma garneharUlAI hAmI satyavAdIharUmA sAmela garnechauM |

mAnisaharUmadhye kohI yastA pani chan jo allAhamAthi ImAna lyAune dAvI garchan, tara jaba allAhako mAmilAmA tinIharUlAI satAincha taba tinIharU mAnisadvArA diine pIDAlAI allAhako yAtanA jhaiM ThAnchan | ra, yadi timrA rabako tarphabATa maddata Ayo bhane bhanchan– “hAmI timIharUkai sAthamA chauM |” ke mAnisaharUko hRdayamA rahekA kurAharUsa~ga allAha rAmrarI avagata chainan ra?
ra, allAha vAstavika ImAnavAlA ra munAphikaharulAI jAnerai choDnechan |

ra, kAphiraharUle AsthAvAnaharUlAI bhanchan– “timIharU hAmro mArgamA hi~Da ra hAmI timrA pApaharUlAI svayaMmAthi linechauM, jabaki tinIharUle unIharUko kunai pApa AphUmAthi lina sakne chainan | tinIharU sarAsara jhUTho boldaichan |

a~, tinIharUle avazya nai Aphno bhArI uThAunechan ra Aphno bhArIkAsAtha arU thuprai bhArIharU pani | ra, mahApralayako dina avazya nai tinIharUsita tinIharUle garne garekA managaDhante kurAharUbAre sodhinecha |
hAmIle nUhalAI unakA samudAyatarpha paThAyauM jahA~ unI pacAsa kama eka hajAra varSasamma base | antataH tinIharUlAI atyAcArI bhaekai avasthAmA bADhIle samAtyo |
nUha ra DuGgAmA savAra anya mAnisaharUlAI hAmIle bacAyauM ra DuGgAlAI saMsAra bAsIharUkAlAgi euTA nizAnI banAidiyauM |

ra, hAmIle ibrAhImalAI paThAyauM | ra, smaraNa gara jaba unale Aphno samudAyalAI bhane– “allAhako dAsatva svIkAra gara ra unaisita DarAU | yadi timIharUlAI jJAna cha bhane yahI timIharUkAlAgi uttama hunecha |

timIharU allAhalAI choDI jasako bhakti garchau tI ta kevala mUrtiharU hun ra timIharU jhUThako khetI garirahekAchau | allAhalAI choDI timIharU ja- jasako bhakti garirahekA chau nissandeha tinIharUle timIharUko jIvikAko sAmarthya rAkhdainan | baru allAhakahA~ nai jIvikA khoja | unakai bhakti gara ra unaiprati kRtajJatA dekhAU | unaitarpha pharkera jAnucha |
timIharU mithyA Thahara gardachau bhane timIharUbhandA pahile dherai samudAyaharUle pani mithyA Thahara garisakekA chan | ra, rasUlamAthi kevala spaSTa rUpamA sandeza puryAune jimmevArI raheko cha |
ke yinIharUle dekhenan ki allAha sRSTiko Arambha kasarI gardachan? pheri tyasako punarAvRtti garnechan | nissandeha yo allAhakolAgi bilakulai sahaja cha |”
bhana–“dhartImA ghumaphira gara ra hera allAhale kasarI sRSTiko Arambha gare | ani allAhale punarjanma pradAna garnechan | nissandeha allAhasa~ga hareka kAryako sAmarthya cha |
unale jasalAI cAhanchan yAtanA dinchan ra jasamAthi cAhanchan dayA garchan | unaitarpha timIharUlAI pharkAinecha |
timIharU na dhartImA (allAhalAI) vivaza pArna sakchau ra na AkAzamA nai | ra, timIharUkAlAgi allAha bAheka kunai saMrakSaka tathA sahayogI chaina |
juna vyaktiharUle allAhakA AyataharU ra unIsita hune sAkSAtkAralAI inkAra gare tyastA vyaktiharU nai mero dayAbATa nirAza bhae | ra, tyastA vyaktiharUkAlAgi pIDAdAyI yAtanA rahekocha |
ibrAhImako samudAyale yo pratikriyAbAheka kehI bhanena– “usako hatyA garideU vA AgomA DaDhAideU |” tara allAhale unalAI AgobATa bacAe | nizcaya nai yasamA AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU rahekA chan |

ra, ibrAhImale bhane– “timIharUle sAMsArika jIvanamA allAhalAI choDI mUrtiharUlAI paraspara premako sAdhana banAekA chau | tara mahApralayako dina timIharUle ekaarkAko inkAra garnechau ra ekaarkAlAI dhikkArnechau, ani timIharUko bAsasthAna naraka hunecha | ra, timIharUko kohI pani sahAyaka hunechaina |
ani lUtale unImAthi ImAna lyAe | ra, ibrAhimale bhane– “ma AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha hijrata ( palAyana ) gariraheko chu | nissandeha unI prabhutatvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, hAmIle ibrAhImalAI ishAka tathA yaakUba pradAna garyauM | ra, unakA vaMzamA IzadUtatva evaM grantha rAkhidiyauM ra unalAI saMsAramA pratidAna pradAna garyauM | ani AkhiratamA nizcaya nai unI satkaramIharUmadhye hunechan |
ra, hAmIle lUtalAI paThAyauM | jaba unale AphnA samudAyalAI bhane– “timIharU tyo azlIla karma garchau juna timIharUbhandA pahile saMsAra bAsIharUmadhye kasaile pani gareko chaina |
ke timIharU puruSakahA~ jAnchau ra DakaitI gachau ra khullamakhullA duSkarma garchau?” unakA samudAyakA mAnisaharUko uttara yati mAtra hunthyo – “liera AU allAhako yAtanA yadi timI saccA hau bhane |”
lUtale bhane– “he merA pAlanakartA! vidhvaMsakArIharUko mukAbilAmA mero maddata gara |”
ra, jaba hAmrA phariztAharU khuzIko khabara liera ibrAhImakahA~ puge taba tinIharUle bhane “hAmI yasa nagara bAsIharUlAI naSTa garnechauM vAstavamA yinIharU ati atyAcArI hun |”

ibrAhImale bhane– “tyahA~ ta lUta pani chan |” unIharUle bhane– “tyahA~ jo chan tinIharUlAI hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM | hAmI lUta ra unakA parivArakA sadasyaharUlAI avazya bacAunechauM | unakI patnI bAheka jo pachADi rahanevAlAharUmadhye chin |”

ra, jaba hAmrA phariztAharU lUtakahA~ puge unI tinIharUkA kAraNa ati byAkula evaM saMkucita bhae | unIharUle bhane– “naDarAU ra cintita pani nahoU | hAmI timIlAI ra timrA parivArakA sadasyaharUlAI bacAunechauM sivAya timrI patnI bAheka jo pachADi rahaneharUmadhye hun |
hAmIle yasa nagarabAsIharUmAthi yinIharUle garne garekA avajJAko kAraNale AkAzabATa prakopa avatIrNa garnechauM |
ra, hAmIle buddhile kAma line vyaktiharUkAlAgi yasa nagaralAI euTA spaSTa nizAnI banAI choDidiekA chauM |

ra, madayanatarpha hAmIle unakA bhAi zuaibalAI paThAyauM | unale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! allAhako dAsatva praveza gara ra antima dinasita DarAu, ani dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAu~dai na hi~Da |”
tara tinIharUle zuaibalAI jhUTho Thahara gare | antataH euTA pracaNDa bhUkampale tinIharUlAI samAtyo ra tinIharU A–AphnA gharamai ghopTo parirahe |

ani, Ada evaM samUdalAI pani hAmIle naSTa pAryauM | ra, tinIharUkA bAsasthAna pani timIharU samakSa prasTai cha | tinIharUkA karmaharUlAI zaitAnale zobhanIya banAyo ra tinIharUlAI satmArgabATa rokyo, jabaki tinIharU sujhabujha pani rAkhdathe |

ra, kArUna, phiraauna tathA hAmAnalAI pani hAmIle naSTa garyauM | tinIharUsamakSa mUsA pratyakSa pramANaharU liera AekA thie tara tinIharUle ghamaNDa gare jabaki tinIharU (hAmro niyantraNabATa) phutkanevAlA thienan |

ataH hAmIle pratyekalAI usako pApako kAraNale samAtyauM | tinIharUmadhye kehImAthi hAmIle DhuGgA barsAune hurI–batAsa paThAyauM bhane anya kasailAI bhayaMkara dhamAkAle samAtyo | kehIlAI hAmIle dhartIsameta dhasAidiyauM bhane kehIlAI curlummai DubAidiyauM | tinIharUmAthi allAha atyAcAra garnevAlA thienan baru tinIharU svayaM AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra gardai thie |

allAhalAI choDI arUlAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAuneharUko udAharaNa euTA mAkurojasto cha jasale Aphno euTA ghara banAu~cha ra sababhandA kamajora ghara mAkurAko nai huncha | yinIharUle yo tathya bujheko bhae!
yinIharU allAhalAI choDI juna vastulAI pukArdachan allAha tyasalAI rAmrarI jAndachan | unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
yI udAharaNaharU hAmI mAnisaharUlAI samjhAunakolAgi bayAna gardachauM tara yasalAI jJAnavAna vyaktiharUle mAtra bujhdachan |
allAhale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIlAI nitAnta satyakAsAtha sRSTi garekA chan | nissandeha yasamA AsthAvanaharUkAlAgi ThUlo nizAnI raheko cha |

(he muhammada sa.!) tyasa granthako pATha garne gara juna timItarpha vahya dvArA paThAieko cha ra namAja kAyama gara | nissandeha namAjale azlIla kArya evaM narAmro kurAbATa rokdacha | ra allAhako yAda ta ati ThUlo ho | ra, allAha timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |

ra, granthavAhakaharUsa~ga vAdavivAda nagara tara uttama DhaMgale, tI vyaktiharU bAheka jo atyAcArI hun | ra, bhanideU– “hAmI tI sabaimAthi AsthA rAkhdachauM juna hAmImAthi avataraNa gariekA chan ra juna timIharUmAthi avataraNa gariekA chan | ani, hAmrA tathA timIharUkA Izvara euTai hun ra hAmI unaiprati samarpita chauM |

(he muhammada sa.!) yasarI nai hAmIle timImAthi grantha avataraNa garyau | tasartha granthabAhakaharU ta yasamAthi AsthA rAkhdachan, ra tinIharU madhye pani kehI yastA chan jo yasamAthi ImAna rAkhdachan | ra, hAmrA AyataharUko inkAra kevala kAphiraharU nai gardachan |
(he muhammada sa.!) timI yasaaghi na kunai kitAba paDhthyau na Aphno hAtale lekhthyau | yasto bhaeko bhae asatyavAdIharU sandehamA parne thie |
hoina, baru yI spaSTa AyataharU hun juna jJAnavAnaharUko hRdayamA chan | ra, hAmrA AyataharUlAI atyAcArIharUvAheka arU kasaile nakArdaina |
ra, kAphiraharU bhandachan– “yinakA rabako tarphabATa yinI mAthi nizAnIharU kina avatarita gariena?” bhanideU– “nizAnIharU allAhakahA~ chan ra ma kevala spaSTa sacetaka hu~ |

ra, ke yinIharUkAlAgi yo paryApta chaina ki hAmIle timImAthi yasto grantha avatarita garekA chauM juna tinIharUsamakSa paDhera sunAincha? nizcaya nai tyasamA AsthA rAkhneharUkAlAgi dayA ra upadeza cha |

(he muhammada sa.!) bhanideU– “ma ra timIharUbIca sAkSIkolAgi allAha nai paryApta chan | unI AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa cijaharUlAI jAndachan | jo nitAnta asatyalAI mAndachan ra allAhako inkAra gardachan tinIharU nai ghATA behorneharU hun |

yinIharU timIsita prakopakolAgi hatAra garirahekA chan | yadi yasakolAgi euTA samaya nirdhArita nabhaeko bhae yinIharUmAthi prakopa Aisakeko hune thiyo | ra, yo ta tinIharUsamakSa avazya nai akasmAt Aunecha jasako tinIharUlAI AbhAsa pani hune chaina |
yinIharU timIsita turuntai prakopakolAgi hatAra garirahekAchan jabaki narakale ta yI kAphiraharUlAI gherirAkheko cha |
tyasa dina prakopale yinIharUlAI mAthibATa chopnecha ra paitAlA munibATa pani | ra, bhannecha– “aba AphnA duSkarmaharUko svAda cAkha |”
he merA AsthAvAna bhaktaharU ho! mero dhartI vizAla cha | tasartha kevala merai upAsanA gara |
pratyeka jIvale mRtyuko svAda cAkhnuparcha | ani timIharUlAI hAmItirai pharkAinecha |

ani, jasale ImAna lyAekAchan ra satkarma garekAchan unIharUlAI hAmIle svargako ucca bhavanaharUmA basAunechauM jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan jasamA tinIharU sadA–sarvadA rahanechan | satkarmIharUkAlAgi kati rAmro pratidAna rahekocha |
yI unai hun jasale dhairyadhAraNa gare ra AphnA pAlanakartAmAthinai bharosA rAkhdachan |
katipaya janAvaraharU Aphno jIvikA bokera hiMDdainan | allAhale tinIharUlAI jIvikA pradAna garchan ra timIharUlAI pani | ra, unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

yadi timIle yinIharUlAI, AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI kasale sRSTi garekAchan ra kasale sUrya evaM candramAlAI niyantraNamA rAkhekAchan, bhanera sodhyau bhane, yinIharUle avazya bhannechan– “allAhale!” tai pani yinIharU kahA~ bahakAi~daichan?
allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanchan vyApaka jIvikA pradAna garchan, ra jasako lAgi cAhanchan sImita pArchan | nissandeha allAha pratyeka cijako jJAna rAkhdachan |

ani, yadi timIle unIharUlAI, kasale AkAzabATa pAnI barsAyo ra tyasadvArA bhUmilAI tyasako mRtyupazcAt jIvita pAryo, bhanI sodhyau bhane tinIharUle avazya bhannechan– “allAhale!” bhanideU– “sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhakai lAgi hun | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzale bujhdainan |
ani, yo sAMsArika jIvana khela tamAsAbAheka kehI hoina, ra nissandeha paralokako ghara nai vAstavika jIvana ho | yinIharUle jAneko bhae besa hunthyo!

ani jaba yinIharU DuGgAmA savAra hunchan taba AsthAlAI allAhakailAgi viziSTa garI unalAI nai pukArdachan | jaba unale tinIharUlAI bacAera jamInasamma puryAuchan taba tatkAlai tinIharU zirka garna thAlchan |
tAki tinIharUle tyasaprati kRtaghnatA darzAUn juna hAmIle tinIharUlAI pradAna garyauM ra moja–majjA garI basUn | cA~Dai nai yinIharUle thAhA pAunechan |

ke yinIharUle dekhenan ki hAmIle euTA zAntipUrNa pratiSThita gRha banAekA chauM jabaki yasako varipari mAnisaharU luTinchan | taipani ke tinIharU nitAnta asatyalAI nai mAnchan ra allAhako anukampAprati kRtaghnatA prakaTa garchan?

tyo vyakti bhandA ThUlo atyAcArI arU ko huna sakcha ra jo allAhaprati jhuTho raccha, ra nitAnta satyalAI tyasako AgamanapazcAt asatya Thahara garcha? ke yastA kRtaghnaharUko bAsasthAna naraka hoina ta?
ra jo vyaktiharU hAmro (mArUgamA) saGgharSa garchan hAmI unIharUlAI avazya nai Aphno mArga dekhAunechauM | vAstavamA allAha sukarmIharUkA sAthamA chan |
alipha0 lAma0 mIma0 |
romabAsI parAjita bhae |
najikako bhUbhAgamA | tara Aphno yasa parAjayapachi tinIharU cA~Dai nai vijayI hunechan |
kehI varSamai | yasabhandA pahile pani allAhakai hukuma thiyo ra yasapachi pani unaiko hukuma calnecha | tyasadina mominaharU khuzI manAunechan |
allAhako sahayogale (yo jIta hunecha) | allAha jasalAI cAhanchan sahayoga garchan ra unI prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu chan |
yo allAhako vacana ho | allAha Aphno vacanako avahelanA gardainan | tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |
mAnisaharU sAMsArika jIvanakA kevala bAhirI pakSa jAndachan ra tinIharU Akhirata (paraloka)bAre anabhijJa chan |

ke tinIharUle kahilyai AphUbhitra soca–vicAra garenan? allAhale AkAzaharU, dhartI ra duvaikA bIcamA rahekA sampUrNa cijaharU satyAnukUla ra euTA nirdhArita samayasammakolAgi sRSTi garekA chan | tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU AphnA pAlanakartAsa~gako sAkSAtkAralAI inkAra gardachan |

ke tinIharUle dhartImA yAtrA garenan ki tinIharU AphUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUko pariNAma dekhna sakUn? tinIharU yinIharUbhandA zaktizAlI thie ra tinIharUle dhartIlAI khubai jote tathA AbAda pani gare, yinIharUle AbAda garekobhandA pani baDhi! ra, tinIharUsamakSa rasUlaharU nizAnIharU liera Ae | allAha tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garnevAlA thienan baru tinIharU svayaM AphUmAthi atyAcAra gardai thie |
antataH jasale duSkarma garekA thie tinIharUko pariNAma ati nai narAmro bhayo, kinabhane tinIharUle allAhakA AyataharUlAI jhuTho Thahara garekA thie | ra, tinIharU tyasako upahAsa garnegarthe |
allAha nai sRSTiko Arambha garchan ra pheri unI nai tyasako punarAvRtti garnechan | ani unaitarpha timIharU pharkAinechau |
ra, juna dina mahApralaya Aunecha tyasa dina aparAdhIharU ati nai nirAza hune chan |
unIharule banAekA sAjhedAraharUmadhye kohI pani unIharuko siphArizakartA hune chaina | baru, tinIharUle AphnA sAjhedAraharUlAI nakArnechan |
ra, junadina mahApralaya hunecha tyasadina tinIharU sabai ekaarkAsita chuTTinechan |
ani jasale ImAna lyAekA ra satkarma garekA hunechan unIharUlAI svargako bagai~cAmA Ananda evaM ullAsakAsAtha rAkhinecha |
tara jasale kuphra garekA hunechan ra hAmrA AyataharU tathA Akhiratako sAkSAtkAralAI jhuTho Thahara garekA hunechan, tinIharU yAtanAmA hAjira garAinechan |
ataH sA~jha ra bihAna allAhako mahimAgAna gara |
ra, AkAzaharU ra dhartImA sArA prazaMsA unaiko lAgi cha | ra rAtri tesro pahara ra juhara (aparAnha) mA pani |
unI mRtabATa jIvitalAI nikAldachan ra jIvitabATa mRtalAI | ani, unI bhUmilAI tyasako mRtyupazcAt punaH jIvita pArdachan | ra, yasarI nai timIharU pani nikAlinechau |
ra, allAhakA nizAnIharUmadhye yo pani raheko cha ki unale timIharUlAI mATobATa sRSTi gare ani timIharu mAnava bhaera phailiMdaichau |

ra, unakA nizAnIharUmadhye yo pani raheko cha ki unale timIharUkAlAgi timIharUkai sahajAtibATa timIharUkA joDI banAe tAki timIharU tinIharUbATa santuSTi prApta gara | ra timIharUbIca unale prema tathA dayA utpanna gare | nissandeha yasamA socavicAra garne mAnisaharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |,
ra, allAhakai nizAnIharUmadhyekA hun AkAzaharU tathA dhartIko sRSTi ra timIharUkA bhASAharU evaM varNaharUko bhinnatA | nizcaya nai yasamA jJAnavAnaharUkAlAgi dherai nizAnIharU chan |
unakA nizAnIharUmadhyekA hun timIharUko rAta ra dinako sutAI ra jIvikA khojne kArya pani | nizcaya nai yasamA dhyAnapUrvaka sunneharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |

ani, unale timIharUlAI bijulI dekhAu~chan jasale bhaya evaM AzA duvai utpanna garcha ra AkAzabATa pAnI barsAu~chan ani tyasadvArA mUrdA bhUmilAI jIvita pArdachan | nissandeha yasamA buddhivAnaharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |
ra, unakA nizAnIharUmadhye AkAza tathA dhartI unakai AdezamA kAyama rahanu pani ho | pheri jaba unale timIharUlAI dhartIbATa niskana euTA AvAja dinechan taba timIharU akasmAt niskanechau |
ra, AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa cijaharU allAhakailAgi hun | ra, yI sabai unaikA AjJAkArI hun |

unai hun jasale sRSTiko Arambha garchan ani unaile tyasako punarAvRtti garnechan | ra, yo unakolAgi jhan sarala cha | AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA unaiko guNa sarvocca raheko cha ra unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

unale timIharUkAlAgi timIharUkai udAharaNa peza garekA chan– ke timIharUkA dAsa–dAsIharUmadhye kohI yastA pani chan jo hAmIle timIharUlAI pradAna gareko dhana–sampattimA sAjhedAra hoUn ani timIharU unIharUlAI tyasamA Aphno barAbarI ThAndachau? ra, ke timIharU unIharUsita yasarI DarAu~chau jasarI timIharU AphnA mAncheharUsita DarAu~chau? yasaprakAra hAmI buddhivAnaharUkAlAgi AyataharU spaSTa rUpamA bayAna gardachauM |

tara, yI atyAcArIharU jJAna binA AphnA abhilASAharUko pachADi lAgirahekA chan | unIharUlAI kasale sIdhAmArga dekhAuna sakcha jasalAI allAhale pathabhraSTa tulyAekA chan? yinIharUkAlAgi kohI sahayogI chaina |

ataH (he nabI sa.!) ekAgra bhaI yasa dharmatarpha unmukha hoU; tyasa prakRtimAthi kAyama hoU jasamA allAhale mAnisaharUko sRSTi garekA chan | allAhale banAeko saMracanAmA kunai pherabadala huna sakdaina | yo bilakula sIdhA ra ThIka dharma ho | tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |
(he mominaharU ho!) unai allAhatarpha pharka ra unaisita DarAU ani namAja kAyama gara ra muzrikaharUmadhye nabana...
jasale Aphno dharmalAI chinnabhinna pAre ra svayaM vibhinna sampradAyamA vibhAjita bhae | pratyeka sampradAya AphUsita raheko cijamA nai magna cha |

ra, jaba mAnisaharUlAI kunai kaSTa pugcha taba AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha pharkaMdai unalAI pukArdachan | ra,jaba unale Aphno dayAko svAda cakhAu~chan taba tinIharUmadhye euTA samuha Aphno pAlanakartAsa~ga zirka garna thAlcha...
tAki hAmIle gareko upakAraprati kRtaghnatA pradarzana garUn | ThIka cha! majjA gara, timIharUle cA~Dai nai thAhA pAunechau |
ke hAmIle tinIharUmAthi kunai pramANa avataraNa garekA chauM jasale yinIharUlAI hAmIsa~ga sAjhedAra ThaharyAuna bhancha?

jaba hAmI mAnisaharUlAI dayAko rasasvAdana garAu~chauM taba tinIharU tyasamA praphulla hunchan ra jaba tinIharUmAthi tinIharU svayaMle gareko kukarmako kAraNa kunai saGkaTa Au~cha taba akasmAt tinIharU nirAza hunchan |,
ke tinIharUle dekhenan ki allAha jasakolAgi cAhanchan jIvikA pharAkilo pAridinchan ra (jasako lAgi cAhanchan) sImita pAridinchan | nissandeha yasamA ImAna lyAuneharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |

ataH (he AsthAvAnaharU ho!) nAtedAra, dIna–duHkhI tathA yAtrIharUlAI tinIharUko haka dinegara | allAhako prasannatA prApta garna cAhaneharUkAlAgi yo rAmro ho | ra, yastA vyaktiharU nai saphala hunechan |

juna dhana timIharU vyAja lina uddezyale (RNasvarUpa) dine garchau tAki tyo mAnisaharUko dhanamA baDhos, tyo kadApi allAhakahA~ baDhdaina | juna jakAta (dAna) timIharU allAhako prasannatA prAptikolAgi dine garchau yastAharule (Aphno dhana) kaiyana guNA baDheko pAinechan |

allAha nai hun jasale timIharUko sRSTi gare | ani timIharUlAI jIvikA pradAna gare | pheri unaile timIharUlAI mRtyu dinechan | ra, unaile timIharUlAI jIvita pArnechan | ke timIharUle unakA lAgi racekA sAjhedAraharUmadhye kohI cha jasale yImadhye kunai euTA kArya pani garna sakcha? allAha pavitra chan ra tinIharUle ThaharyAekA sAjhedAraharUbhandA ati ucca chan |

mAnisako Aphnai hAtako duSkarmale gardA thala tathA jalamA vidhvaMsa utpanna bhaeko cha tAki allAhale tinIharUlAI tinIharUle garne garekA kehI karmaharUko svAda cakhAUn | zAyada tinIharU (tyasabATa) pharkanechan |
(he nabI sa.!) bhanideU– “dhartImA yAtrA gara ani hera, kasto pariNAma bhayo pahile bitekA vyaktiharUko! tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza muzrika (bahudevavAdI) thie |
ataH (he nabI sa.!) Aphno anuhAra yasai sIdhA dharmamA kAyama rAkha tyasa dinako AgamanabhandA pahile nai jasalAI allAhale TArne chainan | tyasadina mAnisaharU ekaarkobATa alaga hunechan |,
jasale kuphra (inkAra) garcha usako kuphrako (duSpariNAma) usaile bhognu parcha ra jo satkarma garchan unIharUle AphnailAgi ( ArAmako sAdhana) juTAudai chan|
tAki allAhale AsthAvAnaharU tathA satkarmIharUlAI Aphno anukampAbATa rAmro badalA diUn | nissandeha unI kAphiraharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |

ra, allAhakai nizAnIharUmadhye yo pani ho ki unI hAvAlAI khuzIko khabara dinakolAgi ra Aphno dayAko svAda cakhAunakAlAgi paThAu~chan jasale gardA DuGgAharU unako AdezAnusAra calUn tAki timIharU unako anugraha (AjIvikA) khoja tathA unako AbhArI bana |

ani, (he muhammada sa.!) hAmIle timIbhandA pahile rasUlaharUlAI tinIharukA samudAyatarpha paThAyauM | ani, tinIharU Aphno samudAyasamakSa spaSTa nizAnIharU liera Ae ani hAmIle aparAdhIharUbATa badalA liyauM ra AsthAvAnaharUko sahayoga garnu hAmrolAgi anivArya cha |

allAha nai hun jasale hAvA paThAu~chan ra hAvAle bAdala uThAu~cha pheri unI nai tyasalAI jasarI cAhanchan AkAzamA phailAu~chan ra TukrA–TukrA pArchan | ani timI tyasabhitrabATa pAnIko thopA niskiraheko dekhchau | ani jaba allAha tyo varSA AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasamAthi cAhanchan barsAu~chan taba tI bhaktaharU praphulla hunchan..
yadyapI ahilesamma tinIharU yo varSA hunuaghi nirAza thie |
allAhako dayAkA nizAnIharU hera ki kasarI unI mRta bhUmilAI jIvita pArdachan | nissandeha unI nai mUrdAlAI jIvita pArnevAlA chan | ra, unI pratyeka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
yadi hAmIle yasato vAyu paThAyauM ( jasa kAraNa) tinIharUle Aphno khetI paheMlo bhaeko dekhe bhane tinIharU kRtaghnatA prakaTa garna thAlchan |
(he nabI sa.!) timI mUrdAlAI sunAuna sakdainau, ra na bahirAlAI nai Aphno pukAra sunAuna sakchau jaba unI piThyU~ pharkAera jAnchan |
ra, na andholAI usako pathabhraSTatAbATa nikAlera sIdhAmArgamA lyAuna sakchau | timI kevala tI vyaktiharUlAI sunAuna sakchau jo hAmrA AyataharUmA ImAna lyAu~chan ani AjJAkArI pani chan‌ |

allAha nai hun jasale nirbalatAko sthitimA timIharUko sRjanA gare | pheri tyasa nirbalatApachi timIharUlAI zakti pradAna gare | pheri tyasa zaktipachi timIharUlAI nirbala tathA vRddha banAidie | unI je cAhanchan sRSTi garchan ra unI sarvajJa evaM sAmarthyavAna chan |
ra, jaba mahApralaya Aunecha taba aparAdhIharU kasama khAera bhannechan– “hAmI eka ghaNTAbhandA baDhI (saMsAramA) basenauM | yasarI nai tinIharU sAMsArika jIvanamA dhokA khAne gardathe |
ra, ImAna tathA jJAnale sampanna gariekA vyaktiharUle bhannechan– “allAhako lekhya anusAra timIharU mahApralayako dinasamma basyau ra yo ho mahApralayako dina, tara timIharU (yasalAI) jAndainathyau |
ani tyasa dina atyAcArIharUlAI tinIharuko kSamAyAcanAle kunai lAbha puryAune chaina ra na tinIharUlAI kSamAyAcanA garna bhanine nai cha |

hAmIle yasa kuraAnamA mAnisaharUkAlAgi hareka prakArakA udAharaNaharU bayAna garekA chauM | timIle tinIharUsamakSa kunai pani nizAnI peza gare pani kAphiraharUle yahI bhannechan ki timI nitAnta asatyamA chau |
yasarI allAha ajJAnIharUko hRdayaharUmAthi mohara lagAidinchan |
ataH (he nabI sa.!) dhairyadhAraNa gara | nizcaya nai allAhako vacana satya ho | ra, vizvAsa nagarneharUle timIlAI halukA napAUn |
aliph0 lAm0 mIm0 |
yI tatvajJAnale paripUrNa granthakA AyataharU hun |
satkarmIharUkAlAgi mArgadarzana tathA dayA |
jasale namAja kAyama garchan, jakAta cuktA garchan ra AkhiratamAthi pUrNa vizvAsa rAkhchan..
yinIharU nai AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa satmArgamA chan ra yinIharU nai saphala hunechan |

ani, mAnisaharUmadhye yastA pani chan jo bahalAune kurAlAI kinne garchan tAki jJAna binA nai allAhako mArgabATa rokUn ra yI AyataharUko khillI uDAUn | yastA mAnisaharUkAlAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA raheko cha |

usalAI jaba hAmrA AyataharU paDhera sunAincha taba U ghamaNDasAtha yasarI vimukha huncha mAnauM usale sunekai chaina, mAnauM usakA duvai kAnamA bujo lAgekA chan | ataH usalAI duHkhadAyI yAtanAko zubhasandeza deU |
nissandeha jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare tyastA vyaktiharUkAlAgi anugrahapUrNa svarga raheko cha |
tinIharU tyahA~ sadA–sarvadA rahanechan | yo allAhako dRDha vacana ho ra unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

unaile AkAzaharUlAI kunai khambA binA sRSTi gare, juna timIharU dekhirahekA chau | ra, unaile dhartImAthi pahADa banAidie tAki tyo timIharUsahita naDagamagAos ani tyahA~ tharitharikA jIva–jantu phailAidie | ra, hAmIle nai AkAzabATa pAnI barsAyauM | ani tyasamA vibhinna prakArakA utkRSTa cijaharU umAryauM |
yo allAhako sRSTi ho | aba malAI dekhAU allAhabAheka arUle ke sRSTi gare? tara yI atyAcArIharU spaSTa rUpamA pathabhraSTa bhaekA chan |

ra nizcaya nai hAmIle lukamAnalAI tatvadarzitA pradAna garyauM ki timI allAha prati kRtajJa hoU | ra, jasale kRtajJatA prakaTa garcha usako kRtajJatA svayaM usaikolAgi lAbhadAyaka huncha ra jo kRtaghna bancha usale jAnirAkhos allAha nispRha evaM svayaMmA prazaMsita chan |
ra, smaraNa gara jaba lukamAnale Aphno chorAlAI upadeza di~dai bhane– “he mero chorA! allAhasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra nabanAU kinabhane sAjhedAra ThaharAunu ThUlo atyAcAra ho |”

hAmIle mAnisalAI usakA mAtApitAko haka cinna Adeza diekA chauM | usakI AmAle dherai kamajora avasthAmA usalAI garbhamA rAkhin ra duI varSamA usako dudha chuTyo | ataH mero kRtajJa bana ra AphnA mAtApitAko pani (AbhArI) hoU | timI matarpha nai pharkera Aunucha |

yadi tinIharU timImAthi dabAba dinchan ki tyasalAI mero sAjhedAra ThaharyAU juna upAsya bhaeko timIlAI jJAna chaina bhane tinIharUko AjJApAlana nagara | saMsAramA duvaisa~ga rAmro vyavahAra gara ani unako pathamA hi~Da jo matarpha pharke | ani timIharUle matarpha nai pharkanucha ra ma timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbAre timIharUlAI batAunechu |

(ra, lukamAnale bhane) “he merA putra! kunai pani vastu rAyoko dAnA barAbara nai kina nahos ra tyo kunai DhuGgAmuni hos vA AkAzamA vA dhartIbhitra lukeko kina nahos, allAha tyasalAI bAhira lyAunechan | nissandeha allAha sUkSmadarzI evaM sajaga chan |
he merA putra! namAja kAyama garnU, puNyakarmako Adeza dinU, duSkarmabATa roknU ra timImAthi je saGkaTa Ae pani dhairyadhAraNa garnU | nizcaya nai yI sAhasakA kAryaharU hun |
ani, mAnisaharUsa~ga (ghamaNDakA sAtha) mukha napharkAu ra dhartImA ghamaNDa garI nahiMDnU | nissandeha allAha kunai pani ahaGkArI evaM mapAi~ svabhAvako vyaktilAI mana parAu~dainan |
ani, madhyama gatimA hiMDnU ra Aphno bolIlAI madhuro rAkhnU | avazya nai sabaibhandA apriya svara gadhAko svara huncha |

ke timIharU dekhdainau ki allAhale AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sabai cijaharUlAI timIharUko adhInastha garidiekA chan? ra, unale AphnA dRzya tathA adRzya duvai kisimakA varadAna timIharUlAI pUrNa rUpamA diekA chan | taipani kehI mAnisaharU binA jJAna, binA mArgadarzana ra binA prakAzamaya grantha allAhako viSayamA vAda–vivAda garchan |

ani, jaba tinIharUlAI allAhale avataraNa garekA kurAharUko anusaraNa garna bhanincha taba tinIharU bhanchan– “hoina, hAmI tinai kurAko anusaraNa garchauM juna kurAmA hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI pAekA chauM |” ke zaitAnale tinIharUlAI danka~do Agotarpha AhvAna gare pani?
jasale pUrNa AjJAkArI bhaera Aphno anuhAra pUrNa rUpale allAhatarpha pharkAu~cha, vAstavamA usale bharosAyogya sahArAlAI samAtyo ra sampUrNa mAmilAharUko antima nirNaya allAhakai hAtamA cha |

(he nabI sa.!) jasale kuphra garcha usako kuphrale timIlAI dukhI napAros | tinIharU hAmItarpha pharkanucha | ani hAmI tinIharUle garne garekA karmaharUbAre tinIharUlAI sUcita garnechauM | nissandeha allAha manamA lukekA rahasyaharU pani jAndachan |
kehI samayasamma tinIharUlAI (saMsAramA) moja–majjA garne avasara diirahekAchauM pheri tinIharUlAI euTA kaThora yAtanAtarpha DoryAunechauM |
