tinIharUlAI AkAzaharU tathA dhartI kasale sRSTi garyo bhanI timIle sodhemA tinIharUle avazya uttara dinechan– “allAhale |” bhanideU– “sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhakailAgi hun | tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |”
AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sampUrNa cijaharU allAhakai hun | nissandeha allAha nispRha evaM svayaMmA prazaMsita chan |

dhartIkA sampUrNa vRkSaharU kalama bhaemA ra sabai mahAsAgara masI bhaemA tyasapachi anya thapa sAta mahAsAgara pani tyasako sahayogI bhae pani allAhakA kurAharU sakine chainan | nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
timIharU sabailAI sRSTi garnu ra pheri jIvita pArI uThAunu kevala eka prANIlAI jastai ho | nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvadraSTA chan |

ke timI dekhdainau ki allAha nai rAtalAI dinamA praviSTa garchan ra dinalAI rAtamA? ra, unaile sUrya ra candramAlAI adhInastha garekA chan; hareka cija euTA nizcita samayasamma gatizIla huncha | ra, allAha timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUsa~ga avagata chan |,
yI sabai yasa kAraNale hun ki allAha nai nitAnta satya hun ra unalAI choDI juna anya cijaharUlAI yinIharU pukArdachan tinIharU sabai nitAnta asatya hun | ra, nissandeha allAha ucca evaM mahAn chan |

ke timI dekhdainau ki allAhakai varadAnadvArA DuGgAharU samudramA calchan tAki unale timIharUlAI AphnA nizAnIharU dekhAUn | nissandeha yasamA dhairyadhAraNa garne tathA kRtajJa hune vyaktiharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |

ra, jaba (samudramA) laharale tinIharUlAI chAtAharU jhaiM Dhapakka DhAkchan taba tinIharU Aphno dharmalAI allAhakailAgi vizuddha pArera unalAI pukArdachan tara jaba hAmI tinIharUlAI bacAera jamInatira puryAu~chauM taba tinIharUmadhye kehI madhyamArgI hunchan | ra, hAmrA AyataharUlAI kevala vizvAsaghAtI ra kRtaghna vyaktiharule nai asvIkAra garcha |

he mAnava jAti! AphnA pAlanakartAko bhaya rAkha ra tyasa dinako bhaya gara juna dina kunai pitAle Aphno putralAI kunai prakArako lAbha puryAuna sakne chaina; na putra nai Aphno pitAko tarphabATa kunai badalA dinecha | nissandeha allAhako vacana nitAnta satya ho | ataH na yo sAMsArika jIvanale timIharUlAI dhokhAmA pAros ra na kunai dhokhebAjale nai timIharUlAI allAhako sambandhamA dhokhA deos |

nissandeha mahApralayako jJAna allAhamA nai nihita cha, ra unI nai pAnI barsAu~chan, ra garbhamA raheko cijalAI jAndachan, ra kasailAI thAhA chaina ki bholi usale ke kamAu~cha, ra kohI yo pani jAndaina ki usako mRtyu kuna bhUbhAgamA hunecha | nissandeha allAha sarvajJa evaM sarvavidita chan |
aliph0 lAm0 mIm0 |
granthako avataraNa garnu jasamA kunai sandeha chaina; sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa bhaeko ho |

ke kAphiraharU bhandachan– “muhammada sa.le yasalAI svayaM raceko ho ” hoina, yo ta timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa (Aeko) nitAnta satya ho tAki timI yasto samudAyalAI sAvadhAna gara josamakSa timIbhandA pahile kohI sacetaka Aena | zAyada ki tinIharUle satya mArga apanAunechan |

allAha nai hun jasale AkAzaharU, dhartI ra tI duvaibIcakA sampUrNa cijaharUlAI cha dinamA sRSTi gare | ani, unI siMhAsanamA virAjamAna bhae | unIbAheka na timIharUkAnimti kohI samarthaka ra sahAyaka cha, ra na unIsamakSa kohI siphArizakartA nai | ke timIharU upadeza grahaNa gardainau?
unI AdezalAI AkAzabATa dhartImA paThAuna~chan juna pheri unItarpha pharkancha euTA yastA dinamA jasako avadhI timIharUko gaNanA anusAra eka hajAra varSako huncha |
unI nai adRzya ra dRzya kurAharUkA jJAtA, prabhutvazAlI ra parama dayAlu hun |
jasale jejati sRSTi gare uttama DhaGgale banAe ra mAnavako sirjanA mATobATa Arambha gare |
tyasapachi unale usako vaMzalAI tuccha pAnIko satbATa calAe |
ani ThIka pAre ra tyasamA Aphno AtmAbATa phuke | ra, unale timIharUlAI kAna, A~khA, muTu pradAna gare | tara timIharU kamai kRtajJa hunchau |,
ra, tinIharU bhanchan– “ke hAmI dhartImA vilIna bhaepachi punaH navIna rUpamA sRSTi garinechauM?” hoina, baru tinIharU AphnA pAlanakartAsita sAkSAtkArako inkAra gardachan |
bhanideU– “timIharUmAthi niyukta garieko mRtyuko phariztA (dUta) le nai timIharUko prANa lincha ani timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha pharkAinechau |

yadi timIle tyo dRzya dekheko bhae jaba aparAdhIharU AphnA pAlanakartAsamakSa zira nihurAera khaDA hunechan! (tyasa samaya tinIharUle bhannechan) “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIle rAmrarI dekhyauM ra sunyauM | aba hAmIlAI punaH phirtA paThAU tAki hAmI puNyakarma garauM; hAmIlAI vizvAsa bhaisakeko cha |”,
ra, yadi hAmIle cAheko bhae pratyeka vyaktilAI usako satmArga pradAna garne thiyauM | tara, hAmItarphabATa hAmIle narakalAI jinna ra mAnavadvArA bharnechauM bhanne vacana siddha bhaisakeko cha |
ataH cAkha (yAtanAko svAda) timIle tyasa dinako bheTalAI birsanAle hAmI pani timIharUlAI birsAidiekA chauM | cAkha aba AphnA kukarmako kAraNale sadA rahane yAtanAko svAda!

hAmrA AyataharUmAthi ta tI vyaktiharU ImAna lyAu~chan jasalAI jaba yI AyataharU sunAera upadeza diincha taba unIharU sajdAmA gaihAlchan ra AphnA pAlanakartAko prazaMsAsAtha unako mahimAgAna garchan ra unIharU ghamaNDa gardainan |
tinIharU Aphno ochyAnabATa alaggai rahanchan | tinIharU AphnA rabalAI bhaya evaM AzAkA sAtha pukArne garchan ra hAmIle pradAna garekA cijaharUbATa kharca garne garchan |
ra, kasailAI unIharUle garne gareko karmako pratidAnasvarUpa unIharUkAlAgi kasto netra–zItalatA gopya rAkhieko cha bhanne kurA thAhA chaina |
ataH ke kunai AsthAvAna vyakti avajJAkArIjhaiM huna sakcha? unIharU kadApi samAna huna sakdainan |
jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare unIharUlAI unIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUko badalAmA AtithyasvarUpa sadAsarvadA rahane bagaiMcAharU prApta hunechan |

ra, avajJAkArIharUko bAsasthAna naraka hunecha | jaba–jaba tinIharU tyahA~bATa niskana cAhanechan tinIharUlAI punaH tyasaibhitra pharkAinecha ra tinIharUlAI bhaninecha– “tyasa narakako yAtanA bhoga jasalAI timIharU jhuTho ThAndathyau |”
tyo ThUlo yAtanAbhandA pahile hAmI tinIharUlAI yasai saMsAramA (kunai na kunai) sAno yAtanAko svAda avazya nai cakhAunechauM tAki tinIharU (Aphno vidrohako nIti choDI hAmItarpha) pharkiun |
ra, tyo vyaktibhandA ThUlo atyAcArI arU ko holA jasalAI usakA pAlanakartAkA AyataharUdvArA upadeza dii~dA tyasabATa vimukha huncha? yastA aparAdhIharUsita hAmI badalA liI choDnechauM |
ra, hAmIle mUsAlAI grantha pradAna garyauM | ataH tyastai cija (grantha) ko prAptimA timI kunai sandeha nagara | ra hAmIle tyasa granthalAI isrAIlakA santAnakolAgi mArgadarzana banAyauM |
ra, jabasamma tinIharU aDiga rahe hAmIle tinIharUbhitra yastA aguvA banAyauM jo hAmro AjJAbATa mAnisaharUlAI mArgadarzana garthe ra tinIharU hAmrA AyataharUmAthi AsthA rAkhdathe |
vAstavamA timrA pAlanakartA nai mahApralayako dina isrAIlakA santAnaharUbIca tinIharUle paraspara matabheda garne garekA kurAharUbAre nirNaya garnechan |,

tinIharUbhandA pahile kaiyauM vaMzaharUlAI hAmIle vinAza garyauM jasakA bAsasthAnamA (Aja) yinIharU (makkAvAsIharU) hiMDaDula garchan bhanne kurAle ke yinIharUlAI mArgadarzana prApta bhaena? nizcaya nai yasamA ThUlA nizAnIharU chan | ke tinIharU sundainan?
ke tinIharUle dekhenan ki hAmI sukhkhA bhUmitarpha pAnI bagAera laijAnchauM ani tyasadvArA bAlInAlI umArchauM juna tinIharukA caupAyA ra svayaM tinIharUle khAne garchan? ke tinIharU dekhdainan?,
ra, tinIharU bhanchan– “timIharU saccA hau bhane tyo nirNaya kahile hunecha ta?”
bhanideU– “nirNayako dina ImAna lyAunu kAphiraharUkAlAgi bephAidA huncha ra tinIharUlAI avasara pani diine chaina |”
ataH tinIharUlAI tinIharukai avasthAmA choDideU ra pratIkSA gara tinIharU pani pratIkSAmA chan |
he nabI sa.! allAhako bhayarAkha ra kAphira tathA munAphikaharUko AjJApAlana nagara | nissandeha allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvajJa chan |
ra, AphnA rabako tarphabATa prakAzanA garieko kurAko anusaraNa gara | nizcaya nai timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUsa~ga allAha avagata chan |
ra, allAhamAthi bharosA rAkha | ra, bharosAkAlAgi allAha nai paryApta chan |

allAhale kunai pani mAnisako chAtIbhitra duIvaTA hRdaya banAekA chainan na unale timIharUkA tI patnIharUlAI timrA AmA nai banAekA chan josa~ga timIharU jihAra garne garchau ra na unale timIharUkA dattakaputra (dharmaputra) lAI timIharUkA vAstavika putra nai banAekA chan | yo ta timIharUko Aphno mukhako bolI mAtra ho | ra, allAha nitAnta satya kurA garchan | ra, unI nai sIdhAmArga dekhAu~chan |,

dattakaputralAI tinIharUkA (vAstavika) pitAkai nAmako sambandhabATa pukAra | yo allAhako dRSTimA adhika nyAyocita hunecha | ra, yadi timIharU tinIharukA pitAbAre anabhijJa chau bhane unIharU timIharUkA dhArmika bhAi evaM sAthI hun | juna kArya timIharUle bhUlacukamA garyau tyasako kunai pApa hune chaina tara juna kArya timIharU AtmAle jAnI jAnI garchau tyasamA bhane pApa lAgnecha | ra, allAha kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |,

nissandeha nabI AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi svayaM Aphno prANabhandA mahattvapUrNa chan | ra, una (nabI) kA patnIharU mominaharUkA AmA hun | ra, allAhako kitAba anusAra nAtedAraharU sAmAnya momina ra muhAjira (palAyana garne) harUko apekSA baDhI hakadAra chan | tara, timIharU AphnA mitraharUsa~ga rAmro vyavahAra garna cAhanchau bhane yo beglai kurA ho | yo Adeza IzagranthamA lekhieko cha |
ra, (he nabI sa.!) smaraNa gara tyo pratijJAlAI juna hAmIle sabai nabIharUsita, timIsita, nUha, ibrAhIma, mUsA ra maryama–putra IsAsita liekA thiyauM | sabaisaMga hAmIle dRDha vacana liekA thiyauM |
tAki allAhale saccA vyaktiharUsita tinIharUko satyako sambandhamA sodhUn ra kAphiraharUkA lAgi unale duHkhadAyI yAtanA tayAra pArekA nai chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhale timIharUmAthi gareko upakAralAI smaraNa gara jaba timIharUvirUddha euTA sainyadalale AkramaNa gareko thiyo taba hAmIle tinIharUvirUddha bhayAvaha A~dhI ra timIharUle dekhna nasakne senAharU paThAyauM | ra, allAha timIharUle garirahekA kAryaharU dekhirahekA chan |

smaraNa gara jaba zatruharU timIharUko mAthi ra talatirabATa AilAge ra Darale ( timIharUkA ) A~khAharU palTe | ra, ( timIharUko ) kalejo ghA~TIsamma Aipugyo ani timIharU allAhako viSayamA vibhinna socaharU kAyama garna thAlyau |
tyasa samaya AsthAvAnaharU pUrNa tarikAle jA~cie ra khubai hallAie |
ani, tyatikhera munAphikaharU ra hRdayamA (zaMkAko) roga bhaekA vyaktiharUle spaSTa rUpamA bhanna thAle– “allAha ra unakA rasUlale hAmIharUlAI dieko vacana kevala dhokhA ho |”

jaba tinIharUko euTA jamAtale bhanyo– “he yasaribavAsIharU ho! timIharUkAlAgi aba yahA~ (basne) kunai ThAu~ chaina; ataH pharkera jAU |” ra, tinIharUko euTA arko samUha nabI (muhammada sa.) sita yo bhanera anumati mAgiraheko thiyo ki hAmrA gharaharU asurakSita chan | jaba ki tinIharU asurakSita thienan | vAstavamA tinIharU bhAgna khojirahekA thie |

yadi variparibATa senAharU praveza garekA bhae ra tyatikhera tinIharUlAI upadravakolAgi nimantraNA diieko bhae tinIharU tyasamA avazya nai sAmela hune thie | ra, yasa sambandhamA tinIharUlAI muzkilale kunai saGkoca hune thiyo |
jabaki tinIharUle yasaaghi allAhasita (yuddhamA) piThyU~ dekhAu~dainan bhanI pratijJA garekA thie | ra, allAhasita garieko vacanabAre sodhapucha avazya nai hunecha |
(he nabI sa.!) bhanideU– “timIharU mRtyu vA hatyAbATa bhAgemA yasarI bhAgnu timIharUkAlAgi alikati pani lAbhadAyaka hune chaina | yadi bhAgyau bhane timIharUle thorai sukhabhoga garna pAunechau |”

bhanideU– “allAhale timIharUko hAni cAhemA kasale timIharUlAI allAhabATa bacAuna sakcha ra unale timIharUmAthi dayA garna cAhemA kasale unako dayAlAI rokna sakcha? allAhako dA~jomA yinIharUle AphnolAgi na kunai samarthaka ra na kunai sahAyaka pAuna sakchan |
allAha timIharUmadhye bAdhA utpanna garne ra AphnA bhAibandhuharUlAI hAmItarpha AU bhanneharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan | yinIharU yuddhamA kamai bhAga linchan |

yinIharU timIharUko sahayoga garna ati kaJjusa chan | khatarAko samaya Au~dA timI tinIharUlAI dekhnechau ki timItira tyasarI nai AphnA A~khAharU ghumAI ghumAI hernechan jasarI tyo vyakti jasalAI mRtyule ghereko hos | tara khatarAko ghaDI Tarepachi yinIharU nai dhanako lobhamA kaDA zabdamA timIharUmAthi prahAra garchan | yinIharUle ImAna lyAekai chainan | tyasakAraNa allAhale yinIharUkA karmaharUlAI naSTa pAridie | ra, yasto garnu allAhakolAgi ati nai sarala cha |

yinIharU ke ThAnchan bhane AkramaNakArI dalaharU pharkera gaekA chainan | AkramaNakArIharUle punaH AkramaNa garemA yinIharUko cAhanA hunecha ki timIharUko sUcanA prApta gardai badavI ( gAuMleharu ) sita ujADa marUbhUmimai AphUharU rahana pAU~ | ra, timIharUbIca nai rahe pani tinIharU muzkilale yuddhamA sahabhAgI hunechan |
nizcaya nai allAhakA rasUla (muhammada sa.) mA timIharUkAlAgi uttama Adarza raheko cha | jo allAhasitako sAkSAtkAra ra Akhiratako AzA rAkhdachan ani allAhalAI khubai smaraNa gardachan |

ra, jaba AsthAvAnaharUle AkramaNakArI dalaharUlAI dekhe taba unIharUle bhane– “yasaiko vacana allAha evaM unakA rasUlale hAmIlAI diekA thie | allAha evaM unakA rasUlakai kurA sA~co thiyo |” yasa ghaTanAle AsthAvAnaharUko ImAna evaM samarpaNamA vRddhi nai garyo |

ImAnavAlAharUmadhye yastA vyaktiharU pani chan jasale allAhasita gareko pratijJAlAI satya pramANita gare | unIharUmadhye kehIle Aphno jyAna sameta lagAebhane kehI ajha pratIkSArata chan | unIharUle (Aphno vAcAmA) kunai parivartana garenan |

(yI sabai yasa kAraNale bhae ki) allAhale saccA vyaktiharUlAI tinIharuko saccAiko badalA diUn ra unale cAhemA munAphikaharUlAI sajAya~ diUn vA tinIharUlAI kSamA pradAna garUn | nissandeha allAha kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

ra, allAhale kAphiraharUlAI (ahajAbako yuddhabATa) tinIharUko krodhasahita (viphala banAI) pharkAidie | tinIharUle kunai lAbha prApta garna sakenan ra AsthAvAnaharUko tarphabATa yuddha garna allAha nai paryApta chan | ra, allAha zaktizAlI evaM prabhutvazAlI chan |

ra, ahle kitAba madhye jasale AkramaNakArI (kAphira) harUko sahayoga garekA thie allAhale tinIharUlAI tinIharukA killAharUbATa nikAlera lyAe ra tinIharUko hRdayamA unale yasto kisimako trAsa utpanna garidie ki timIharU tinIharuko euTA samUhako hatyA gardaithyau bhane arko samUhalAI bandI banAu~daithyau |

allAhale timIharUlAI tinIharUko jamIna, gharaharU ra dhana–sampattiko uttarAdhikArI banAidie, ani timIharUlAI yasto bhUmi pradAna gare jahA~ timIharUle kadama pani rAkhekA thienau | ra, allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
he nabI sa.! AphnA patnIharUlAI bhana– “timIharU yadi kevala yasa saMsArako jIvana tathA yasakai zobhA cAhanchau bhane AU ma timIharUlAI kehI diihAlchu ra rAmro tarIkAle vidA garidinchu |
ra, yadi timIharU allAha, unakA rasUla (muhammada sa.) ra Akhiratako gharakA icchuka chau bhane allAhale timIharUmadhye uttama satkarmIkAlAgi ThUlo pratidAna tayAra pArera rAkhekA chan |”
he nabIkA patnIharU ho! yadi timIharUmadhye kasaile azlIla karma garyo bhane allAhale usalAI dobbara daNDa dinechan | ra, yo kArya allAhakolAgi ati sarala raheko cha |

ra, timIharUmadhye jasale allAha tathA unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana garnecha ra satkarma garnecha usalAI hAmI dobbara pratidAna dinechauM ra hAmIle usakAlAgi paryApta evaM pratiSThita AjIvikA tayAra pArekA chauM |

he nabIkA patnIharU ho! timIharU sAdhAraNa mahilAharu jastA hoinau | yadi timIharUmA allAhako bhaya cha bhane mITho svaramA kurA nagara jasale gardA pApI mana bhaeko vyakti kunai lobhamA phasos baru spaSTa kurA gara |

ra, AphnA gharaharUmA nai basa | ani, ajJAnatAkAlamA jhaiM zrRGgAra pradarzana nagara | namAja kAyama gara, jakAta deU ra allAha tathA unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana gara | he nabIkA gharakA sadasyaharU ho! allAha timIharUkA sampUrNa apavitratA samApta pArI pUrNa pavitra tulyAuna cAhanchan |
ra, timIharUkA gharamA sunAine allAhakA AyataharU tathA tatvadarzitAlAI yAda rAkha | nissandeha allAha sUkSmadarzI evaM khabara rAkhnevAlA hun |

muslima (samarpita), momina (AsthAvAna), AjJAkArI, satyavAdI, dhairyavAna, vinayazIla, dAnI, vratAluu, A–AphnA guptAGgako rakSA garne ra allAhalAI atyadhika yAda garne puruSa tathA mahilAharUkAlAgi allAhale nizcaya nai kSamA ra mahAn pratidAna tayAra pArera rAkhekA chan |

jaba allAha ra unakA rasUlale kunai mAmalAko nirNaya garidinchan taba kunai pani momina puruSa vA mahilAkolAgi Aphno mAmalAmA nirNayako adhikAra bA~kI raha~daina | ra, jasale allAha evaM unakA rasUlako avajJA garyo U spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA paryo |

(he nabI sa.!) smaraNa gara jaba timIle tyasa vyaktilAI bhanekA thiyau jasamAthi allAha ra timIle upakAra garekA thiyau– “AphnI patnIlAI nachoDa ra allAhasita DarAU |” ra, tyatikhera timIle Aphno manamA tyo kurA lukAekA thiyau jasalAI allAhale jAhera garna cAhanthe | ra, timI cAhi~ mAnisaharUsita DarAu~thyau jabaki allAha yasa kurAkolAgi baDhI hakadAra chan ki timI unIsita DarAU | ataH jaba jaidako unI (jainaba) sa~ga kunai sarokAra rahena taba hAmIle unIsa~ga timro bihe garidiyauM tAki mominaharUkAlAgi AphnA dattakaputraharUkA patnIharUsa~ga vihe garna kunai bAdhA narahos jaba tinIharUko unIharUsa~ga sambandha biccheda garchan | ra, allAhako Adeza kAryAnvayana huncha nai |

nabImAthi allAhale unakAlAgi nizcita gareko kArya garnumA kunai Apatti hune chaina | unIbhandA pahile bitekA nabIharUko hakamA pani allAhako yahI sunnata (tarIkA) thiyo | ra, allAhako Adeza nizcita phaisalA huncha |
jo‌ allAhako sandeza puryAune garthe ra kevala unaisita DarAu~the | ra, allAhabAheka anya kasaisita DarAu~dainathe | ra, allAha hisAba linakAlAgi paryApta chan |
muhammada sa. timIharUmadhye kunai puruSakA pitA hoinan tara unI allAhakA rasUla evaM nabIharUkA samApaka (antima nabI) hun | ra, allAha pratyeka vastukA jJAtA hun |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhalAI atyadhika smaraNa gara |
ra, bihAna–belukA unakai mahimAgAna gara |
unai hun jasale timIharUmAthi dayA paThAu~chan ra unakA phariztAharUle pani tAki unI timIharUlAI andhakAraharUbATa nikAlI prakAzamA lyAUn | ra, unI AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi parama dayAlu chan |
juna dina tinIharUko unI (allAha) sita bheTa hunecha tyo dina tinIharUko abhivAdana “salAma” hunecha | ra, unale tinIharUkAlAgi ati pratiSThita pratidAna tayAra pArekA chan |
he nabI sa.! hAmIle timIlAI sAkSI, zubhasUcaka tathA sacetaka banAera paThAekA chauM |
ra, allAhatarpha unakai anumatile AhvAnakartA evaM prakAzamAna dIpa banAera paThAekA chauM |
ra, AsthAvAnaharUlAI zubhasUcanA deU ki unIharUkAlAgi unakA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa ThUlo varadAna raheko cha |
ani, kAphira tathA munAphikaharUko kurA namAna, tinIharUbATa hune kaSTalAI bevAstA gara ra allAhaprati bharosA rAkha | kAryasAdhakako rUpamA allAha nai paryApta chan |

he AsthAvanaharU ho! yadi timIharU momina mahilAharUsa~ga bihe garchau ani unIharUlAI hAta lagAunu aghi nai talAka dinchau bhane unIharUkolAgI kunai yasto nizcita avadhi (iddat) anivArya chaina jasako gantI rAkha | ataH tinIharUlAI kehI dhana diera yathocita tarIkAle vidA gara |

he sandeSTA! hAmIle timrolAgi timIle ‘mahara’ diekA timrA patnIharUlAI ‘halAla’ (vaidha) garekA chauM ra tI strIharU pani juna allAhale timIlAI pradAna garekA dAsIharUko rUpamA timro adhInamA Au~chan | sAthai, timIsa~ga hijrata garekA timrA kAkAkI chorIharU, phupukI chorIharU, mAmAkI chorIharU, sAnImAkI chorIharU ra tyo momina mahilA jasale svayaMlAI nabImA samarpita garchin yadi nabI unIsa~ga bihe garna cAhanchan bhane yo Adeza mominaharUkolAgi hoina baru timrolAgi mAtra cha | mominaharUkAlAgi unIharUkA patnI tathA dAsIharUbAre jejati sImAharU nirdhArita garekA chauM tyo hAmIlAI rAmrarI thAhA cha | tAki timIlAI kunai kaThinAi nahos | ra, allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

tinIharu madhye jasalAI cAhanchau alaga rAkha ra jasalAI cAhanchau sAthamA | ra, alaga rAkhiekA patnIharUmadhye pheri cAhemA timrolAgi kunai Apatti chaina | yasaprakAra unIharUkA A~khAharUlAI zItalatA prApta hune adhika sambhAvanA raheko cha | ra, unIharU duHkhita pani hu~dainan | ani jejati timIle tinIharUlAI diekAchau tyasamA tinIharU sabai rAjI hunechan | allAha timIharUko manakA kurA rAmrarI jAndachan | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM sahanazIla chan |

tIbAheka anya mahilAharU timrolAgi pani vaidha chainan | ra, na tinIharUko saTTAmA arU patnIharU lyAU cAhe tinIharU timIlAI jatisukai sundara kina nalAgun | tara dAsIharUbAheka | ra, allAha pratyeka cijakA nirIkSaka hun |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! sandeSTAko gharaharUmA bhojanakolAgi anumati binA jAne nagara | na khAne samayakolAgi nai parkhI basa | tara jaba timIharUlAI nimantraNA diincha jAU | ra, timIharU bhojana garisakepachi bidA hoU | ra, kurAkAnImA lAgera nabasa | timIharUkA yastA kriyAkalApaharule nabIlAI dukhita tulyAu~cha tara unI timIharUbATa lAja mAnchan | tara, allAha satya kurA bhanna lajAu~dainan | nabIkA patnIharUsita kunai cija mAgnu paremA pardA pachADibATa mAgne gara | timIharU ra unIharUko hRdayakAlAgi yo baDhI pavitra bATo ho | allAhakA rasUlalAI duHkhI tulyAunu timIharUkAlAgi ucita chaina | unIpachi unakA patnIharUsita vivAha garnu timIharUkolAgi kahilyai pani vaidha chaina | yo allAhako dRSTimA ati nai kharAba kurA ho |
kunai kurA cAhe timIharU prakaTa gara vA tyasalAI gopya rAkha, allAhalAI pratyeka kurAko jJAna huncha |

tinIharUkAlAgi unIharUkA bAbuharU, chorAharU, dAjubhAiharU, dAjubhAikA chorAharU, didIbahinIharUkA chorAharU, dauMtarI mahilAharU ra Aphno adhInamA rahekA dAsa–dAsIharUkA sAmunne AunamA kunai Apatti chaina | ra, timIharU allAhasita bhaya rAkhane gara | nissandeha allAha pratyeka kurAmA dRSTi rAkhdachan |
allAha evaM unakA phariztAharU nabImAthi ‘dayA preSaNa’ (darUda paThAune) garchan | ataH he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharU pani unImAthi ‘darUda’ tathA salAma paThAune gara |

mAnisaharUle allAha evaM unakA rasUlalAI duHkhI tulyAu~chan, allAha tinIharUkAlAgi loka tathA paraloka duvaimA abhizApa rAkhekA chan ra yastA mAnisaharUkAlAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA tayAra pArekA chan |
ra, tI mAnisaharU jo AsthAvAna puruSa ra mahilAharUlAI unIharUko kunai kasUra vinA kaSTa dinchan, tinIharU euTA ThUlo lAJchanA ra khullamakhullA pApako bipatti AphnA TAukomAthi bokchan |

he nabI sa.! AphnA patnIharU, AphnA chorIharU ra mominaharUkA mahilAharUlAI bhanideU– “unIharUle AphUlAI oDhanIharUle DhAkUn | yaso gardA unIharU cinine saMbhAvanA baDhI cha ra satAine chainan | ra, allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

yadi yI munAphika tathA mana–pApIharU ra madInAmA galata pracAra garne vyaktiharUle AphnA kArya tyAgenan bhane hAmI timIlAI tinIharUvirUddha khaDA garnechauM | ani tinIharU yasa zaharamA timIsa~ga thoraisamaya mAtra basobAsa garna saknechan |
tinIharUmAthi cAraitarphabATa abhizApa hunecha | tinIharU jahA~ bheTie pani samAtinechan ra pUrNa rUpamA badha nai garinechan |
yo allAhako sunnata ho juna tyastA vyaktiharUko bAremA pahilaidekhi nai caliAeko cha | ra, timIle allAhako sunnatamA kunai parivartana pAune chainau |
mAnisaharU timIsita mahApralayako bAremA sodhchan; | bhanideU– “tyasako jJAna allAhalAI cha |” timIlAI ke thAhA zAyada ki tyo nikaTa Aipugeko cha?
nizcaya nai allAhale kAphiraharUlAI dhikkArekA chan ra tinIharUkAlAgi narakako Ago tayAra pArekA chana |
jasamA tinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | tyahA~ kunai pani samarthaka ra sahAyaka pAuna sakne chainan |
tyasadina tinIharUkA anuhAraharUlAI AgomA olTAi palTAI garinecha | tinIharUle bhannechan– “hAya! hAmIle allAha evaM rasUlako AjJApAlana gareko bhae!”
ra, bhannechan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIle AphnA aguvA ra ThUlA–baDAharuko AjJApAlana garyauM, tara tinIharUle hAmIlAI satmArgabATa vicalita pAre |
he hAmrA pAlanakartA! tinIharUlAI dobbara yAtanA deU ra ThUlo dhikkAra paThAu |”
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharU tI vyaktiharU jhaiM nabana jasale mUsAlAI kaSTa die | tara allAhale unalAI tinIharUko AkSepabATa mukta pAre ra unI allAhako dRSTimA pratiSThita thie |
he mominaharU ho! allAhako bhaya gara ra ThIka kurA garne gara |
allAhale timIharUkA karmaharU sudhArnechan ra timIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnechan | ra, jasale allAha evaM unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana garyo usale ThUlo saphalatA prApta garyo |

hAmIle yasa amAnata (nAso) lAI AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra parvataharUsamakSa prastuta garyauM tara tinIharU yasa amAnatalAI bokna tayAra bhaenan ra tyasabATa trasita bhae | tara, manuSyale tyasa (nAso) lAI uThAyo | vAstavamA U anyAyI ra ajJAnI cha |

(amAnata paThAunuko uddhezya yo thiyo ki) allAha munAphika evaM muzrika puruSa evaM mahilAharUlAI sajAya~ diUn ra momina puruSa evaM mahilAharUmAthi dayA garUn ra allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
sampUrNa prazaMsAharU unai allAhakAlAgi hun jo AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sabai cijaharUkA mAlika hun | AkhiratamA prazaMsA pani unaikAlAgi hunecha | unI tatvadarzI evaM sarvajJa hun |

jejati pRthvImA praveza garcha, jejati tyasabATa bAhira niskancha, jejati AkAzabATa avatIrNa huncha ra jejati tyasatarpha caDhcha– allAha tI sabailAI jAndachan | ra, unI parama dayAlu evaM kSamAzIla chan |

kAphiraharU bhanchan– “hAmImAthi mahApralaya Audaina | kina Au~daina?” bhanideU– “parokSakA jJAtA merA pAlakartAko kasama! tyo timIharUmAthi avazya nai Aunecha | AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA rahekA rattibhara vastu pani unIbATa lukna sakdaina, na ta tyobhandA sAno na ThUlo nai | baru yI sabai euTA spaSTa khAtAmA chan |
tAki allAhale ImAna lyAune ra satkarmIharUlAI pratidAna diUn | yastA vyaktiharUkAlAgi mAphI cha ra utkRSTa AjIvikA pani |
ra, juna mAnisaharUle hAmrA AyataharUlAI asaphala pArne prayAsa garekA chan tyastA vyaktiharUkAlAgi atyanta pIDAdAyaka yAtanA raheko cha |”

(he nabI sa.!) jJAnavAnaharU jAndachan ki jejati timImAthi timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avataraNa bhaeko cha tyo nitAnta satya ho ra tyasale prabhutvazAlI evaM prazaMsanIya allAhako mArga dekhAu~cha |
kAphiraharU bhanchan– “ke timIharUlAI euTA yasto mAnche dekhAauM jasale timIharUlAI sUcita gardacha jaba timIharU kaNakaNamA pariNata bhaisaknechau taba punajIrvita garinechau |”

ki ta yo vyakti allAhavirUddha jhuTha raccha ki ta U unmAdI bhaeko cha | baru juna mAnisaharU AkhiratamAthi ImAna rAkhdainan, unIharU prakopa grasta hunechan ra unIharU ati nai pathabhraSTatAmA chan |,

ke yinIharUle svayaMlAI agADi tathA pachADibATa gherekA AkAza tathA pRthvIlAI dekhenan? yadi hAmIle cAhyauM bhane yinIharUlAI pRthvImA dhasAuchauM vA AkAzakA kehI TukrAharU yinIharUmAthi khasAlchauM | nizcaya nai yasamA hareka prayazcita garne bhaktakolAgi ThUlo nizAnI raheko cha |

ra, nizcaya nai hAmIle dAUdalAI varadAna diekA thiyauM | hAmIle Adeza diyauM– “he pahADaharU ho! timIharu unakAsAtha (pAlana kartAko) pavitratA varNana garne gara |” ra paMkSIharUlAI pani (hAmIle yahI Adeza diyauM) | ra, unakAlAgi hAmIle phalAmalAI narama pAryauM |
tAki timI kavacaharU banAU ra tyasakA gherAharU ucita anupAtamA joDa ra puNya kAma gara | juna kArya timI garchau tyo ma dekhirahekochu |”

ra, sulaimAnako lAgi hAmIle hAvAlAI vazIbhUta garekA thiyau~ jasako pravAha bihAnIko samaya eka mahinAko yAtrA barAbarako thiyo ra tyasako belukIko yAtrA pani eka mahinA barAbarako nai thiyo | hAmIle unakAlAgi paglieko tAMmAko mUla phuTAekA thiyauM ra yastA jinnaharU unako adhInamA garidiekA thiyauM jo unakA rabako Adezale unIsAmU kAma garthe | tinIharUmadhye jasale hAmro Adezako avahelanA garcha usalAI hAmI prajvalita Agoko daNDa dinechauM |,

unI je cAhanthe tinIharU tyahI banAune garthe– ucca bhavanaharU, citraharU, ThUla– ThUlA kuNDa jastA khaDku~lAharU ra gADiekA ThUlA bhA~DAharU | he dAUdakA mAnisaharU ho! kRtajJa bhaI karma gara | ra, merA bhaktaharUmadhye thorai mAtra kRtajJa chan |

pheri jaba hAmIle sulaimAnamAthi mRtyuko nirNaya lAgU garidiyauM taba jinnaharUlAI unako mRtyuko sUcanA kevala euTA dhartIko dhamirAle diyo jasale unako laurolAI khAiraheko thiyo | ataH jaba sulaimAna laDe taba jinnaharUlAI yo kurA spaSTa rUpamA thAhA bhayo ki tinIharUlAI parokSako jJAna bhaeko bhae tinIharU yasa apamAnajanaka yAtanAgrasta hune thienan |

sabAkA bAsindAharUkAlAgi unIharUko bAsasthAnamA nai euTA nizAnI thiyo– duIvaTA bagaiMcA, euTA dAhinetarpha ra arko cAhi~ debretarpha | khAU AphnA pAlanakartAdvArA pradatta jIvikAbATa ra kRtajJa bana | yo euTA rAmro kSetra ho ra, unI pAlanakartA evaM kSamAzIla chan |

tara tinIharU vimukha bhae | tyasakAraNa hAmIle tinIharU tira bA~dha bhatkAune bADhI paThAyauM ra tinIharUkA duvai bagai~cAlAI duIvaTA tItA ra pIrA phala tathA kehI bayarakA vRkSaharU bhaekA bagai~cAmA pariNata garidiyauM |
hAmIle tinIharUko kRtaghnatAko yahI badalA diyauM ra hAmI kaThora yAtanA kRtaghna mAncheharUbAheka arU kasailAI diMdainauM |

ani, hAmIle tinIharU ra barakatayukta nagaraharUbIca kehI anya dekhine nagaraharU pani AbAda garekA thiyauM ra tinIharUbIca yAtrAkA gantavyaharU nirdhArita garidiyauM | yI nagaraharUmA dinarAta bilakula nizcinta bhaI hiMDaDula gara |”

tara tinIharUle bhane–“he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmro yAtrAko durI baDhAideU |” ra, tinIharUle svayaMmAthi atyAcAra gare | ataH hAmIle tinIharUlAI kathAharU banAidiyauM ra tinIharUlAI titarabitara pAridiyauM | nissandeha yasamA pratyeka dhairyavAna tathA kRtajJa mAnisakolAgi dherai nizAnIharU chan |
iblIsale Aphno dhAraNAlAI tinIharUmAthi satya siddha garyo | ra AsthAvAnaharUko euTA TolIbAheka tinIharUle iblIsakai anusaraNa gare |

tinIharUmAthi saitAnako kunai sAmarthya thiena | tara hAmI yo jAnna cAhanthyauM ki AkhiratamAthi AsthA rAkhne vyaktiharU ko hun ra yasabAre sandehamA rahane ko hun? ra timrA pAlanakartA hareka cIjakA saMrakSaka hun |

bhanideU– “allAhabAheka timIle ThAnekA upAsyaharUlAI bolAU | unIharU AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA euTA kaNa barAbarako cijamAthi pani kunai adhikAra rAkhdainan; ra na yI duvaimA unako kunai sAjhedArI raheko cha ra na tinIharU– madhye kohI allAhako sahayogI nai ho |”

allAhakahA~ siphAriza usaiko lAgi lAbhadAyaka hunecha jasako lAgi unale anumati dinechan | yahA~samma ki jaba tinIharUkA hRdayabATa Dara nikAlinecha taba tinIharUle sodhnechan– “timIharUkA pAlanakartAle ke bhane?” unIharUle bhannechan– “nitAnta satya” | ra unI sarvocca evaM mahAna chan |
sodha–“timIharUlAI AkAzaharU tathA dhartIbATa kasale jIvikA pradAna garcha?” bhana–“allAha!” ra, nizcaya nai “ki ta hAmI vA ki ta timI nitAnta satyamA chauM vA spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA |”
bhanideU– “hAmIle garekA pApaharUko sambandhamA timIharUlAI sodhine chaina; na timIharUkA karmaharUbAre hAmIlAI sodhinecha |”
bhanideU– “hAmrA pAlanakartAle hAmI sabailAI ekatrita garnechan | pheri unale hAmIbIca nyAyasaMgata nirNaya garnechan | unI sarvazreSTha nirNAyaka evaM sarvajJa chan |”
bhanideU–“malAI tI sAjhedAraharU dekhAU jasalAI timIharUle unIsa~ga joDekA chau |” kadApi hoina, vAstavamA unai allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
ra, (he muhammada sa.!) hAmIle timIlAI sampUrNa mAnavajAtikAlAgi zubha–sandezabAhaka tathA sacetakako rUpamA paThAekA chauM | tara, adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |
ra, tinIharU bhanchan–‘yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane yo mahApralayako vAcA kahile Aune cha?
bhanideU– “timIharUkA lAgi yasto dinako vAcA cha jasabATa timIharU na ekakSaNa pachi rahana saknechau na aghi nai baDhna saknechau |”

ra, kAphiraharUle bhane–“hAmI na yasa kuraAnamAthi ImAna lyAunechauM na yasabhandA pahilekA granthamAthi nai | timIle tyo (dRzya) dekheko bhae, jaba atyAcArIharU AphnA pAlanakartAsamakSa rokinechan, ekaarkAmAthi Aropa pratyAropa garnechan | durbala ThAniekAharUle AphUlAI ThUlA ThAnneharUlAI bhannechan– “yadi timIharU nabhaeko bhae hAmI avazya ImAnavAlA hune thiyauM |”
ThUlA banneharUle durbala ThAniekA mAnisaharUlAI javApha dinechan– “ke hAmIle sIdhAmArgako AgamanapazcAt tyasabATa timIharUlAI rokekA thiyauM ra? baru timIharU svayaM aparAdhI thiyau |”

ra, durbala mAnisaharUle ThUlo banneharUlAI bhannechan– “baru rAtadinako calakhela thiyo jaba timIharU hAmIharUlAI allAhako inkAra garna ra unako sAjhedAra ThaharAuna Adeza dinthyo |” ra, jaba tinIharUle prakopa dekhnechan taba lajjAle pachutAunechan ra hAmI kAphiraharUkA gardhana nelale bA~dhnechauM | tinIharUlAI kevala tinIharUle garne garekA kAryako badalA diinecha |
hAmIle juna juna nagaramA sacetaka paThAyauM tyahA~kA sampanna mAnisaharUle yati mAtra bhane– “juna kurAkAsAtha timIlAI paThAieko cha tyo hAmI paTakkai mAndainauM |”
ra, tinIharUle bhane– “hAmI dhana–sampatti tathA santAnamA baDhi chauM ra hAmIlAI kadApi daNDa diine chaina |”
bhanideU– “nizcaya nai merA pAlanakartA jasakA lAgi cAhanchan jIvikA pharAkilo pArdachan ra jasakA lAgi cAhanchan sImita tulyAu~chan | tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |

ra, timIharUkA dhana–sampatti tathA santAna yastA cija hoinan jasale timIharUlAI hAmro nikaTatA pradAna garUn | a~ jasale ImAna lyAunechan, satkarma garnechan unIharUkA lAgi unakA karmaharUko dohoro pratidAna cha ra yastA mAnisaharU nizcinta bhaera svargakA bhavanaharUmA basnechan |
ra, juna mAnisaharU hAmrA nizAnIharUlAI hocyAuna prayAsarat chan tinIharU nai yAtanAmA hominechan |

bhanideU– “merA rabale AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasako nimti cAhanchan khubai jIvikA pradAna garchan ra jasako nimti cAhanchan tyasako jIbikAlAI saGkIrNa tulyAu~chan | timIharUle jejati kharca garnechau, unale tyasako pUrA pratidAna dinechan | ra, unI sarvazreSTha annadAtA hun |
smaraNa gara tyasa (mahApralayako) dinalAI jaba kAphiraharUlAI ekatrita garera allAhale phariztAharUlAI sodhnechan– “ke yinIharUle timIharUko bhakti garne garthe?”

phariztAharUle bhannechan– “timI pavitra chau! hAmro saMrakSaka–mitra kevala timI hau na ki yinIharU; baru yinIharUle jinnako bhakti garne garthe ra yinIharUmadhye adhikAMza unIharUmAthi nai AsthA rAkhdathe |

ataH Aja ( paralokamA) timIharUmadhye kohI pani kasaikolAgi kunai prakArako lAbha vA hAniko mAlika hune chaina | ra, hAmI atyAcArIharUlAI bhannechauM– “tyasa Agoko yAtanA cAkha jasalAI timIharU jhuTho Thahara garthyau |”

ra, jaba tinIharUsamakSa hAmrA spaSTa AyataharU paDhera sunAincha taba tinIharU bhanchan–“yo ta kevala euTA mAnche mAtra ho jo timIharUlAI timIharUkA pUrvajakA pUjyaharUbATa rokna cAhancha |” ra, bhanchan– “yo euTA managaDhanta kurA bAheka kehI hoina |” ra, jaba nitAnta satya Aipugyo taba kAphiraharule bhane yo ta euTA spaSTa jAdUbAheka arU kehI hoina |”
ra, hAmIle yinI (makkAbAsI) harUlAI na ta granthaharUmadhye kehI pradAna garekA thiyauM jasalAI yinIharU paDhne garthe ra na timIbhandA pahile kunai sacetaka nai tinIharUtarpha paThAyauM |

ra, tinIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUle pani mithyA Thahara garekA thie ani tinIharUlAI hAmIle jejati pradAna garekA thiyauM, yinIharU ta tyasako dazAMsa bhAgasamma pani pugna sakenan | tinIharUle merA rasUlaharUlAI asatya Thahara garekA thie | hera kasto kaThora thiyo mero prakopa!

bhanideU– “ma timIharUlAI kevala euTA kurAko upadeza dinchu ki timIharU allAhakolAgi duI–duI janA ra eklA–eklai ubhiera cintana–manana gara | ( ke niSkarSa pAuMchaubhane ) vAstavamA timro yo sAthImA kunai kisimako unmAda chaina | unI ta kaThora prakopa AunubhandA aghi timIharUkA sacetaka mAtra hun |”
bhanideU– “maile juna pratidAna mAge pani tyo timrailAgi hunecha | mero pratidAna ta allAhako jimmAmA cha | unI pratyeka kurAbATa avagata chan |”
bhanideU– “nissandeha merA pAlanakartA nitAnta satyadvArA prahAra gardachan, unI parokSakA jJAtA hun |
bhanideU– “nitAnta satya Aipugyo | ra, asatyako na Arambha huncha ra na punarAvRtti nai huncha |”

bhanideU– “yadi ma pathabhraSTa hune thie~ bhane Aphno mana (ko anusaraNa) le gardA hune thie~ ra yadi ma satmArgamA chu bhane yasako AdhAra tyo prakAzanA ho juna merA pAlanakartA matarpha avatIrNa garchan | nizcaya nai unI zrotA evaM nikaTa rahanevAlA hun |
timIle dekheko bhae jaba yinIharU trasita hunechan ra kunai umkane ThAu~ hune chaina ani najikako sthAnabATa nai samAtinechan |
ra, tinIharUle ( tyatikhera ) bhannechan–“hAmIle yasa kuraAnamAthi ImAna lyAyauM, tara tyati TADhA ( paralokamA ) pugera ImAna prApta garnu tinIharUkAnimti kasarI sambhava huna sakcha ra?”
yasa aghi tinIharUle kuphra garekA thie ra TADhaibATa parokSabAre aDakalako bharamA kurA gare |

ra ( Aja ) tinIharU tathA tinIharUkA abhilASAharubIca tyasarI nai avarodha khaDA gariyo jasarI yasabhandA aghi tinIharU jastai mAncheharUsita garieko thiyo | vAstavamA tinIharU byAkula pArne sandehamA thie |

sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhakAlAgi jo AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sRSTikartA ra duI–duI, tIna–tIna evaM cAra–cAra pakheTA bhaekA phariztAharUlAI sandezavAhaka banAnevAlA hun | allAha Aphno sRSTimA je cAhanchan vRddhi garchan | nissandeha allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

mAnisaharUkAnimti allAha je–jasto dayAko DhokA kholchan tyasalAI kasaile banda garna sakne chaina, ra unale jasalAI banda garchan tyasalAI unIbAheka kasaile kholna sakne chaina | unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

he mAnava! timIharUmAthi allAhale je–jati anukampA garekA chan tyasalAI yAda gara | ke allAhabAheka pani kohI sRSTikartA cha jasale timIharUlAI AkAza tathA dhartIbATa jIvikA pradAna garos? allAhabAheka arU kohI upAsya chaina | timIharUlAI ghopTo pArera katA lagiMdaicha ta?

ra, (he muhammada sa.!) yadi yinIharUle timIlAI mithyA Thahara garirahekAchan bhane timIbhandA pahile pani rasUlaharUlAI mithyA Thahara garisakiekA chan | ra, sabai kAryaharU allAhatarpha nai pharkAinechan |
he mAnava! nissandeha allAhako vacana satya ho | ataH timIharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanale dhokAmA napAros; na kunai dhokebAjale nai timIharUlAI dhokA deos |
nizcita rUpamA zaitAna timIharUko zatru ho | ataH tyasalAI zatru nai jAna | zaitAna Aphno samUhalAI bolAuMcha tAki tI sabai narakabAsI hoUn |
kuphra garneharUkAlAgi kaThora yAtanA rahekocha | ra ImAna lyAune tathA satkarma garneharUkAlAgi kSamAdAna tathA ThUlo pratidAna rahekocha |

ke jasalAI usakA duSkarmaharU zobhanIya tulyAera dekhAieko cha, ra tyasale tI kAryaharUlAI uttama ThAncha ( ke usale tyasalAI chADana sakcha )? nizcaya nai allAha jasalAI cAhanchan pathabhraSTa garchan ra jasalAI cAhanchan sIdhAmArga dekhAu~chan | ataH (he muhammada sa.!) tinIharUko cintAle AphUlAI samApta napAra! tinIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUsita allAha rAmrarI avagata chan |

unI allAha nai hun jasale hAvA calAu~chan ani tyo hAvAle bAdala uThAu~cha | tyasapachi hAmI tyasa bAdalalAI mRta bhUmitarpha laijAnchauM ra tyasadvArA tyasa bhUmilAI tyasako mRtyu pachi jIvita pArchauM | yasarI nai (mAnisaharUlAI) puunarjIvita garinecha |

jasale sammAna cAhancha usalAI thAhA hunuparcha ki sampUrNa sammAna allAhakailAgi hun | pavitra zabdaharU unaitarpha caDhchan ra satkarmale tyasalAI mAthi caDhAu~cha | ra, jasale narAmroko SaDyantra garcha tinIharUkAlAgi kaThora yAtanA raheko cha | ra, tinIharUko SaDyantrako nai nAza hunecha |

(he mAnava!) allAhale timIharUko sRSTi mATobATa gare pheri vIryako thopAbATa | pheri unale timIharUlAI joDI–joDI banAe | ra, josukai mahilA garbhavatI hunche ra zizulAI janma dinche tyo sabai allAhalAI thAhA cha | ra, na kasailAI lAmo Ayu diinecha na tyasamA kamI nai garinecha | tara yo sabai euTA khAtAmA (lipibaddha) cha | yo kArya allAhakAnimti ati sarala raheko cha |

ra, duvai samudra samAna hu~dainan | euTA mITho, tirkhA meTAune ra piuna svAdiSTa huncha ra arko cAhi~ nunilo ra Tarro | ra, timIharU harekabATa tAjA mAsu (mAchA) khAne garchau | ra, yastA AbhUSaNaharU nikAlchau juna timIharU pahirinchau | ani, nadImA DuGgAharUle pAnIlAI cirdai hi~Deko dekhdachau tAki timIharU unako varadAna khoja ra sAyada timIharU kRtajJa hunechau |

unI rAtalAI dinamA tathA dinalAI rAtamA praveza garAu~chan ra unale sUrya tathA candramAlAI (mAnisako) sevAmA khaTAekA chan | tinIharUmadhye sabai euTA nizcita avadhisammakolAgi gatizIla chan | allAha nai timIharUkA pAlanakartA hun ra sAmrAjya unakai ho | ra, allAhabAheka timIharUle jasalAI pukArdachau tinIharU euTA khajUrako bIUko bokrAsametako mAlika hoinan |

timIharUle tinIharUlAI pukAryau bhane pani tinIharUle timIharUko pukAra sunne chainan | tinIharUle pukAra sunihAle pani tyasako uttara dine chainan | ra, mahApralayako dina timIharUko yasa zirkalAI spaSTa rUpamA inkAra garnechan | ra, sarvajJa allAha jasto kasaile timIlAI avagata garAuna sakdaina |
he mAnava! timIharU sabai allAhaprati nirbhara chau | tara allAha cAhi~ nispRha ra parama prazaMsanIya chan |
unale cAhe bhane timro vinAza garna sakchan ra nayA~ sRSTi lyAu~nechan |,
ra, yo kArya allAhakolAgi kattipani kaThina chaina |

ra, kunai bhArI boknele arkAko bhArI bokne chaina | ra, bhArIle dabeko vyaktile Aphno bhArI uThAuna kasailAI bolAemA usako bhArI kasaidvArA pani uThAine chaina, cAhe tyo vyakti ( usako ) nAtedAra nai kina nahos | (he muhammada sa.!) timI kevala tI mAnisaharUlAI sAvadhAna garna sakchau jo parokSamA rahI AphnA pAlanakartAsita DarAu~chan ra namAja kAyama garchan | ra, jasale svayaMlAI pavitra tulyAu~cha tyasale kevala AphnailAgi pavitra tulyAu~cha | ra, sabai allAhatarpha nai pharkera jAnucha |
ra, andho ra dRSTivAna eka samAna hu~dainan |
na andhakAraharU ra na prakAza nai samAna huna sakchan |
ra na chAyA~ ra na carko ghAma nai samAna huna sakchan |
ra na jIvitaharU ra mRtaharU samAna huna sakchan | allAha jasalAI cAhanchan sunna lagAu~chan | ra, cihAnamA rahekA vyaktiharUlAI timIle kadApi sunAuna sakdainau |
timI ta kevala eka sacetaka hau |
hAmIle timIlAI satyakAsAtha eka zubha–sandezavAhaka tathA sacetakako rUpamA paThAekA chauM | ra, kunai samudAya yasto chaina jasatarpha sacetaka paThAieko nahos |

yadi yinIharUle timIlAI mithyA Thahara garirahekA chan bhane yinIharUbhandA pahilekA kAphiraharUle pani asatya Thahara garekA thie | tinIharUsamakSa pani tinIharukA rasUlaharU camatkAraharU, sahIphA (dharmapustikA) harU ra jyotirmaya granthaharU liera AekA thie |
ani maile kAphiraharUlAI samAteM | ataH hera kasto bhayo malAI nakArnu (ko pariNAma)!

ke timI dekhenau ki allAha AkAzabATa pAnI barsAu~chan? tyasapachi hAmIle tyasabATa vibhinna raGgakA phala umArchau? ra, pahADaharUmA pani setA, rAtA, anya vibhinna raGgakA ra gADhA kAlA dhArIharU hunchan |

ra, yasarI nai mAnisa, janAvaraharU, caupAyAharUkA pani vibhinna raGga hunchan | allAhasita kevala unakA jJAnavAna bhaktaharU DarAune garchan | nissandeha allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM atyanta kSamAzIla chan |

juna vyaktiharU allAhako granthako pATha garchan, namAja kAyama garchan ra hAmIle pradAna gareko (dhana–sampatti) bATa khullA vA gopya rUpamA kharca garchan, vAstavamA tyastA mAnisaharU kahilyai ghATA nakhAne vyApArako AzA rAkhchan...,
tAki allAhale unalAI unako pUrNa pratidAna pradAna garun ra Aphno varadAnabATa thapa pradAna garUn | nissandeha unI atyanta kSamAzIla evaM guNagrAhI chan |

ra, hAmIle timItarpha prakAzanAdvArA paThAeko yo grantha bilakula satya ho | ra, yasale pahiledekhi timIsamakSa raheko IzagranthaharUko pani puSTi gardacha | nissandeha allAha AphnA bhaktaharUbAre pUrNa parijJAtA ra sarvadraSTA chan |

ani hAmIle AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye mana parAera chAnekA vyaktiharUlAI yasa granthako uttarAdhikArI banAyauM | unIharUmadhye kehI svayaMmAthi atyAcAra garneharU chan, kehI madhyamArgI chan ra anya kehI allAhako anujJAbATa puNya karmamA aghi baDhneharU chan | yo allAhako ThUlo kRpA ho |,
(yastA mAnisaharUkA lAgi) sadA rahane bagaiMcAharU chan jasamA unIharU praveza garnechan | tyahA~ unIharUlAI sunakA bAlAharU ra motI pahirAinecha ra tyahA unIharUkA vastraharU rezamakA hunechan |
ra, unIharUle bhannechan– “sampUrNa prazaMsA unai allAhakAlAgi hun jasale hAmro cintA nivAraNa gare | nissandeha hAmrA pAlanakartA ati kSamAzIla evaM guNagrAhI chan |
unaile Aphno anukampAbATa sadA rahane sthAnamA praveza garAe jahA~ hAmIlAI na kunai duHkha hunecha na thakAi nai lAgnecha |”

ra, jasale kuphra garekA chan tinIharUkAlAgi narakako Ago cha jahA~ na mRtyu Aunecha ki tinIharU marUn, na tinIharUko yAtanAlAI halukA nai pArinecha | hareka kRtaghna vyaktilAI hAmI yastai badalA dine garchauM |

tinIharU narakamA cicyAunechan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI bAhira nikAla | aba pahile garekA (duSkarmaharU) viparIta hAmI puNya karma garnechauM |” (allAhale bhannechan) “ke hAmIle timIharUlAI yati Ayu diekA thienauM jasamA upadeza lina cAhanele upadeza lina sakthyo? ra, timIharUkahA~ ta sacetaka pani pugekA thie | ataH (yAtanAko) svAda cAkha! atyAcArIharUko ( Aja ) kohI sahayogI chaina |”
nissandeha allAha AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA gopya kurAharU jAndachan | vAstavamA unI manabhitra lukekA bhedaharU pani jAndachan |

allAha nai hun jasale timIharUlAI dhartIkA uttarAdhikArI banAe | ataH jasale kuphra garyo tyasa kuphrako hAni usailAI hunecha ra kAphiraharUkAlAgi tinIharUko kuphrale tinIharukA pAlanakartAkahA~ kevala dveSa nai baDhAu~cha | ra, kAphiraharUko kuphrale tinIharUlAI kevala hAni puryAunecha |

bhana– ”ke timIharUle allAhabAhekakA AphnA tI sAjhedAraharUko bAremA vicAra garyau jasalAI timIharUle pukArne garchau | dekhAU malAI, tinIharUle dhartImA ke sRSTi garekA chan? vA AkAzaharUko sRSTimA tinIharUko kunai sAjhedArI cha? vA hAmIle tinIharUlAI kunai kitAba diekA chau~ jasako kunai pramANamAthi tinIharU kAyama chan? barU yI atyAcArIharU eka arkAsa~ga dhokApUrNa vAcA garirahekA chan |

nizcaya nai allAhale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIlAI tinIharU (A–AphnA sthAnabATa) nahaTUn bhanI samAtera rAkhekA chan | ra, yadi tinIharU haTe bhane tyasapachi arU kasaile tinIharUlAI roknasameta sakne chaina | nissandeha unI atyanta sahanazIla evaM ati kSamAzIla chan |

ra, tinIharUle dRDha kasama khAekA thie ki yadi kunai sacetaka tinIharU– tarpha Ae bhane anya samudAyaharUbhandA baDhI mArgamA hunechan | tara jaba euTA sacetaka tinIharUkahA~ Ae taba unako Agamanale tinIharUko ( sandeza bAhakabATa ) TADhinumA mAtra vRddhi garyo|

dhartImA ghamaNDa garnukA kAraNa ra narAmro upAya racnukA karaNa ( tinIharule yasto vyavahAra gare ), jabaki narAmro upAyale Aphno racayatAlAI nai gherdacha | tinIharU ta atItakA mAnisaharUmAthi lAgU bhaeko niyamako pratIkSAmA hune chan | ra, timIle allAhako niyamalAI kahilyai parivartita pAune chainau, ra na timIle allAhako niyamalAI kahilyai Tareko nai pAunechau |

ke tinIharU dhartImA ghumaphira garenan tAki herUn kasto thiyo unIharUko pariNAma jo tinIharUbhandA pahile bitekA chan, jabaki unIharU tinIharUbhandA baDhI zaktizAlI thie? allAhalAI kunai cijale vivaza pArna sakdaina na AkAzaharUmA ra na dhartImA nai | nizcaya nai unI sarvajJa evaM sAmarthyavAna chan |

ra, allAhale mAnisaharUlAI tinIharUko kriyAkalApale gardA (tatkAlai) samAtne gareko bhae pRthvImA euTA jIvalAI pani choDne thienan | tara allAhale tinIharUlAI nizcita samayasammakA lAgi avasara dinchan | ataH jaba tinIharUko nirdhArita samaya Aunecha allAha Aphno sabai bhaktaharUlAI rAmrarI dekhnechan |
yA0 sIna0
tatvajJAnale paripUrNa kuraAnako kasama!
(he muhammada sa.!) nizcaya nai timI IzadUtaharUmadhyekA hau |
bilkula sIdhAmArgamA chau |
yo (kuraAna) prabhutvazAlI tathA parama dayAlu (allAha) dvArA avatarita ho |
tAki timI yasto samudAyalAI satarka gara jasakA pUrkhAharU satarka gariekA thienan | tyasaile tinIharU anabhijJa chan |
nizcaya nai tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharUko bAremA (allAhako) vacana satyasiddha bhaisakeko cha | tasartha tinIharU ImAna lyAune chainan |
hAmIle tinIharUkA gardhanamA ciu~Dosamma pugne nelaharU berekA chauM | phalasvarUpa tinIharU AphnA siralAI ThADo rAkhna bAdhya chan |
hAmIle tinIharUkA aghiltira ra pachiltira pani parkhAla khaDA garidiekA chauM ani tinIharUlAI DhAkidiekA chauM | tyasaile tinIharU dekhna sakdainan |
(he muhammada sa.!) timIle tinIharUlAI saceta gara vA nagara; samAna cha | tinIharUle ImAna lyAunevAlA chainan |
timI kevala upadezako anusaraNa garne vyakti tathA nadekhikanai karUNAmaya (allAha) sita DarAune vyaktilAI sAvadhAna garna sakchau | ataH tyasalAI kSamAdAna tathA ThUlo pratidAnako zubhasUcanA deU |

nizcaya nai hAmIle eka dina mRtaharUlAI jIvita pArnechauM | ra, tinIharUle agADi paThAekA karmaharU ra pachi choDekA cinhaharU lekhdaichauM | ra, pratyeka kurAlAI hAmIle euTA spaSTa kitAbamA surakSita garekA chauM |
tinIharUlAI nagarabAsIharUko udAharaNa pezagara jaba tinIharUkahA~ rasUlaharU AekA thie |

arthAt jaba hAmIle tinIharUtarpha duIjanA (rasUla) lAI paThAyauM taba tinIharUle tI duvailAI asatya Thahara gare | ani hAmIle tesro (rasUla) dvArA tinIharUlAI sudRDha tulyAyauM | tinIharUle bhane– “hAmI timIharUsamakSa ( allAhako tarphabATa ) paThAiekA hauM |”
tinIharUle bhane– “timIharU ta hAmIjastai mAnche bAheka kehi hoinauM | ra, rahamAna (allAha) le nizcaya nai kunai kurA avatarita garekA chainan | timIharU kevala mithyA kurA garirahekAchau |”
rasUlaharUle bhane– “hAmI timIharUkahA~ (allAhakotarphabATa nai ) paThAiekA hauM bhanne kurA hAmrA raba rAmrarI jAndachan |
ra, hAmro jimmevArI ta kevala spaSTarUpamA sandeza puryAunu raheko cha |”

nagaravAsIharUle bhane– “hAmI timIharUlAI alacchina ThAndachauM | yadi timIharUle yasa kAryalAI tyAgenau bhane hAmI avazya timIharUmAthi DhuGgA barsAunechauM ra hAmro hAtabATa nizcaya nai timIharUlAI kaSTaprada yAtanA pugnecha |”
rasUlaharUle bhane– “timIharUko apasaguna ta timIharUsa~gai rahekocha | ke timIharUlAI upadeza dieko kAraNa timIharU tyaso bhandaichau | baru timIharU sImA ullaGghanakArIharU hau |
nagarako TADhAko kSetrabATa ekajanA manuSya dagurdai Ae ra bhane– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! rasUlaharUko anusaraNa gara |”
yastA vyaktiharUko anusaraNa gara jo timIharUsita kunai pratidAna mAgdainan ra svayaM ThIka mArgamA chan |
ma tyasa upAsanA kina na garU~ jasale malAI sRSTi gare ra jasatarpha timIharUlAI ( mahApralayako dina ) pharkAera laginecha |

ke ma allAhalAI choDI unIbAheka anya kasailAI upAsya banAU~ jabaki rahamAna (allAha) le mero kunai hAni garna cAhemA tinIharuko siphArizale na malAI kunai phAidA puryAuna sakcha ra na tinIharUle malAI bacAuna nai sakchan?
tyaso garemA ma spaSTa rUpamA pathabhraSTatAmA lipta hunechu |
maile timIharUkA pAlanakartAmAthi ImAna lyAe~ | ataH mero kurA suna |”
tI vyaktilAI bhaniyo– “timI svargamA praveza gara |” unale bhane– “hAya! merA jAtibandhuharUle jAneko bhae |
ki kina merA pAlanakartAle malAI kSamA gare ra malAI sammAnita vyaktiharUmA sAmela gare |”
tyasapachi unako samudAyakolAgi hAmIle AkAzabATa kunai sainya dalako avataraNa garenauM, ra hAmI senAko avataraNa garne pani thiena |
(tinIharUko vinAzako lAgi) euTA karkaza dhvanI mAtra bhayo ra svasphUrta rUpamA tinIharU nibhe |
aphasoca mAnisaharUmAthi! junasukai rasUla Au~dA tinIharUle unako khillI uDAne gare |
ke tinIharUle vicAra garenan ki hAmIle tinIharUbhandA pahile kaiyauM samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pArisakekA chauM jo tinIharUkahA~ pharkera Aune chainan |
ra, tinIharU sabai hAmIsamakSa nai upasthita garinechan |
ra, tinIharUkAnimti euTA nizAnI mRtabhUmi pani ho jasalAI hAmIle jIvita pAryauM | ra tyasabATa anna–bAlI umAryauM ani tyasabATa tinIharU khAne garchan |
ani, tyasamA hAmIle khajUra tathA aGgurakA bagaiMcAharU lagAyauM ra tyasamA mUlaharU phuTAyauM |
tAki tyasabATa unIharUle phala khAUn | yI saba tinIharukA hAtale sirjekA hoinan taipani tinIharU kina kRtajJa hu~dainan?
pavitra cha tyo sattA jasale sArA cijaharUlAI joDIko rUpamA banAe cAhe tyo dhartIkA banaspatiharUmadhyekA hoUn, vA svayaM mAnava jAtimadhyekA hoUn, vA tinIharUle najAnekA cijaharUmadhyekA |
ani mAnisaharUkAlAgi rAta pani euTA nizAnI ho jasabATa hAmI dinalAI jhikidinchauM taba unIharU ekAeka a~dhyAromA hunchan |
ra, sUrya Aphno nirdhArita sthAnatarpha gatizIla cha | yo prabhutvazAlI tathA sarvajJa (allAha) dvArA nirdhArita ho |
ani candramA yasakolAgi hAmIle gantavyaharU nirdhAraNa garekA chauM yahA~samma ki tyo khajUrako purAno hAMgojasto huna jAncha |
na sUryale candramAlAI samAtna sakcha na rAtale dinalAI uchinna sakcha | tinIharU sabai antarikSamA nirantara gatizIla chan |
ani, mAnisaharUkA santAnalAI tyasa bharipUrNa DuGgAmA savAra garnu pani tinakAlAgi euTA nizAnI ho |
ra, hAmIle tinIharUkAnimti yo jastai anya cijaharU pani sirjanA garyauM jasamA tinIharU savAra hunchan |
ra, yadi hAmIle cAhyauM bhane tinIharUlAI DubAidinchauM | tyatikhera tinIharukolAgi na kohI sahayogI hunecha ra na tinIharU bacAine nai chan |
tara mero dayA (huncha) ra eka avadhisammakA lAgi AnandajIvana |
ra, jahile pani unIharUlAI aghi ra pachi Aune kurAko bhaya rAkhna bhanincha, tAki tinIharUmAthi dayA gariyos (tara tinIharU dhyAna nai diMdainan) |
ra, tinIharUsamakSa tinIharukA pAlanakartAkA nizAnIharUmadhye juna nizAnI Ae pani tinIharU tyasabATa vimukha huna pugchan |

ra, jaba tinIharUlAI allAhale pradAna gareko khAdyAnnabATa kharca garna Adeza diincha taba kAphiraharUle AsthAvAnaharUlAI bhanchan–“ke hAmI tyasalAI khuvAauM jasalAI allAhale cAheko bhae svayaM khuvAuna sakthe? timIharU pakkai pani khullama khullA pathabhraSTatAmA chau |”
ra, kAphiraharU sodhchan– “timIharU satyavAdI hau bhane yo (mahApralayako) vAcA kahile purA huncha?”
vAstavamA yI kAphiraharU ta yasto karkaza dhvanIko pratIkSAmA chan jasale yinIharUlAI tyasa avasthAmA samAtnecha jaba yinIharU ApasI bAdavivAdamA vyasta hunechan |
tyatikhera tinIharU na kunai upadeza dina saknechan, ra na Aphno parivAratarpha pharkana nai saknechan |
ra, sUra phukne bittikai tinIharU cihAnabATa niskera anAyAsa AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha dagurna thAlnechan |

tinIharUle bhannechan– “hAya, hAmro durbhAgya! hAmIlAI hAmrA zayanakakSabATa kasale byu~jhAyo? yo ta tyahI ho jasako vAcA rahamAna ( karuNAmaya ) le garekA thie ra rasUlaharUle pani satya nai bhanekA thie |
tyo euTA ThUlo karkaza dhvanI sivAya arU kehI hune chaina, ani svasphUrta rUpamA tinIharU hAmIsamakSa upasthita garinechan |
Aja kasaimAthi alikati pani atyAcAra garine chaina, ra timIharUle garne garekA karma anusAra nai badalA diinecha |
svargakA bAsindAharU ta sA~ccIkai Aja–ramAilo garnamA vyasta chan |
unIharU ra unakA patnIharU chahArImuni ucca palaGgamAthi sirAnImA aDes lAgera basirahekA chan |
unIharUkAlAgi tyahA~ hareka kisimakA phalaharU ra tinIharUle cAhekA cijaharU chan |
unako dayAlu pAlanakartAko tarphabATa salAma bhaninecha |
he aparAdhIharU ho! Aja timIharU alaga hoU |
he AdamakA santAnaharU ho! ke maile timIharUsa~ga vAcA lieko thiina ki zaitAnako upAsanA nagarnU kinabhane tyo timIharUko spaSTa zatru ho |
ra kevala merai upAsanA garnU; yahI sIdhAmArga ho |
tara zaitAnale timIharUmadhye dherai mAnisaharUlAI pathabhraSTa pAridiyo | ke timIharU bujhdainauM?
yahI ho tyo naraka jasako Dara timIharUlAI dikhAinthyo |
(ataH) timIharUle gardai gareko anAsthAle gardA Aja yasa (naraka) mA praveza gara |
Aja hAmI tinIharUko mukhamA mahara lagAidinechauM | ra, tinIharukA khuTTAharUle sAkSI dinechan |
ra, hAmIle cAhyauM bhane tinIharUkA A~khAlAI dRSTivihIna banAidinechauM | ani tinIharU bATotira lamkinchan tara unIharU (bATo) kasarI dekhlAn ta?
ra, yadi hAmIle cAhyauM bhane tinIharUko rUpa tinIharukA sthAnamai badalidine chauM | tyatikhera tinIharU na aghi baDhna sakchan ra na pachi haTna sakchan |
ra, jasalAI hAmI lAmo umera pradAna garchauM usako saMracanA ulTo pAridinchauM (arthAt U baccAjhaiM huna pugcha) | ke yo dekhera pani tinIharUlAI buddhi Au~daina?
ra, hAmIle una (nabI) lAI zAyarI (kavitA) sikAekA chainauM ra na unalAI yo zobhA nai dincha | yo ta kevala upadeza tathA spaSTa kuraAna ho |
tAki unI pratyeka jIvita vyaktilAI sAvadhAna garUn ra kAphiraharUmAthi yAtanA sthApita hoos |
ke tinIharUle dekhenan, hAmIle Aphno hAtabATa banAekA cijaharUmadhye caupAyAharU pani tinIharUkAlAgi sRSTi garekA chauM, ani tinIharU jasakA mAlika banekA chan |
ra, hAmIle tinIharulAI tinIharUko adhInamA garidiyauM | tasartha tyasamadhye kehI unIharUkA savArI hunchan ra kehIlAI khAnchan |
ra, tI janAvaraharUmA tinIharUkAlAgi lAbha chan ra peya padArtha pani chan | ke taipani tinIharU kRtajJa bandainan?
ra, tinIharUle allAhabAheka anya upAsya banAe tAki tinIharUlAI sahayoga puryAiyos |
yinIharU tinalAI sahayoga garna asamartha chan jabaki ( tinIharuko soca anusAra ) yinIharu tinIharukA tainAta sainyadala hun |
ataH (he muhammada sa.!) tinIharUkA kurAle timIlAI duHkhI natulyAos | vAstavamA tinIharUle lukAune tathA prakaTa garne kurAharUsita hAmI avagata chauM |
ke mAnisale dekhena ki hAmIle usalAI vIryabATa sRSTi garyauM tara pani U anAyAsa pakkA jhagaDAlu banna pugyo?
ra, usale hAmrolAgi udAharaNa dina thAlyo ani Aphno sRSTi birsiyo | bhanyo– “yI saDegalekA hADaharUlAI kasale jIvita pArna sakcha?”
bhanideU– “tinIharulAI unaile jIvita pArnechan jasale tinIharulAI pahilopaTaka sRSTi gare | unI pratyeka sRSTikA pUrNa jJAtA hun |
jasale timIharUkAlAgi hariyo bRkSabATa Ago nikAle ani tyasaibATa ta timIharU Ago bAlchau |
ke jasale AkAzaharU tathA dhartI sRSTi gare, unI tinIharU jastailAI sRSTi garna samartha chainan? kina chainan? unI ta mahAn sRSTikartA tathA sarvajJa hun |
jaba unI kunai kAryako saGkalpa garchan tyasako lAgi unako Adeza huncha “bhai hAla", ani tyo bhaihAlcha |
ati pavitra chan unI jasako hAtamA pratyeka vastuko Adhipatya raheko cha, ra timIharU sabai unaitarpha pharkAinechau |
paMktibaddha khaDA hune (phariztA) harUko kasama!
ra, pUrNa rUpamA hapkAuneharUko kasama!
ra, “jikra” (kuraAna) ko pATha garneharUko kasama!
nizcaya nai timIharUkA pUjya eka mAtra chan |
jo AkAzaharU, pRthvI, yI duvaikAbIcamA bhaekA cijaharU tathA udaya sthalaharUkA pAlanakartA hun |
nizcaya nai hAmIle tallo AkAzalAI tArAharUko alaGkAradvArA sajAyauM |
ra, hareka vidrohI zaitAnabATa tyasalAI surakSita tulyAunako lAgi |
yinIharU ‘malae aalA’ (mahAsabhA) kA kurAharU sunna sakdainan ra cAraitirabATa yinIharUmAthi prahAra garincha |
tAki yinIharUlAI dhapAiyos | ra, yinIharUkAlAgi cirasthAyI yAtanA cha~daicha |
tara kasaile kunai kurA Tipera bhAgyo bhane tyasalAI Agoko euTA jvAlAle pachyAu~cha |
ataH yI kAphiraharUlAI sodha, ke yinIharUko (punaH) sRSTi garnu kaThina cha vA jasalAI hAmI sRSTi garisakekA chauM? nissandeha hAmIle manuSyalAI lesilo mATobATa sRSTi garyauM |
ho! (he muhammada sa.!) timI Azcaryacakita chau ra tinIharU upahAsa garchan |
ra, jaba tinIharUlAI upadeza diincha taba tinIharU mAndainan |
baru kunai camatkAra dekhepachi tyasako upahAsa nai garchan |
ra, bhanchan– “yo pratyakSa jAdUbAheka arU kehI hoina |”
“jaba hAmI marchauM ra mATo evaM haDDImA pariNata hunchauM taba ke hAmI punarjIvita garinechauM?”
“ke hAmrA atItakA purkhAharUlAI pani?”
bhanideU– “ho, ani timIharU apamAnita sameta hunechau |”
tyo ta euTA hapkAi hunecha | ani lagattai tinIharU dekhna thAlnechan |
ra, bhannechan– “hAya hAmro durbhAgya! yo ta hisAba–kitAbako dina po rahecha |”
“yo tyahI nirNayako dina ho jasalAI timIharU jhuTho Thahara garthyau |
“bhelA gara atyAcArIharUlAI ra tinIharukA joDIharUlAI ani tinIharulAI pani jasako tinIharU upAsanA garnegarthe |
allAhabAheka | ra, tinIharUlAI dankado Agoko bATomA DoryAU |
ra, tinIharUlAI roka | kinabhane tinIharUlAI sodhinechan |
“timIharUlAI ke bhayo ki timIharU eka–arkAlAI sahayoga gardainau?
baru Aja tinIharU Aja baDo AjJAkArI banekA chan |
ra, tinIharU ekaarkAtira anuhAra pharkAera paraspara prazna garne chan |
bhannechan– “timIharU nai hAmIsamakSa dAhine tarphabATa Aune garthyau |”
arko TolIle javApha dinecha– “hoina, baru timIharU nai AsthAvAna thienau |”
“hAmIlAI ta timIharUmAthi kunai adhikAra prApta thiena baru timIharU svayaM uddaNDa thiyau |”
ataH hAmIharUbAre hAmrA pAlanakartAko vacana siddha bhayo | hAmIle avazya (daNDako svAda) cAkhnai parnecha |
“a~, hAmIle nai timIharUlAI pathabhraSTa garyauM | avazya nai hAmI pani pathabhraSTa thiyauM |”
ataH tyo dina tinIharU sabai yAtanAmA sahabhAgI hunechan |
vAstavamA aparAdhIharUsita hAmI yastai vyavahAra garnegarchauM |
jaba tinIharUlAI bhaninthyo ki allAhabAheka anya kohI upAsya chaina taba tinIharU ghamaNDa garne garthe |
ra, bhanne garthe– “euTA unmAdI kavile bhandaimA hAmI AphnA upAsyaharUlAI tyAgauM ta?”
“baru unI (muhammada sa.) ta nitAnta satyakAsAtha AekA chan ra sabai rasUlaharUko puSTi gardachan |”
timIharUle avazya nai duHkhadAyI yAtanAko svAda cAkhnechau |
ra, timIharUlAI kevala timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUkai badalA diinecha |
tara allAhale chAnekA bhaktaharUko kurA beglai cha |
tinIharUkA lAgi nirdhArita jIvikA rahekocha |
phalAhAra chan ra unIharUlAI sammAnita pani garinecha |
vaibhavapUrNa bagaiMcAharUmA |
unIharU Amunne–sAmunne gaddImAthi virAjamAna hunechan |
mUlabATa nai bharieko madyapAtra unIharUsamakSa ghumAinecha |
pUrNa seto! piuneharUko lAgi asAdhyai svAdilo!
tyasabATa na riGgaTA lAgnecha na tyasabATa unIharU mAtne nai chan |
ra, unakA sAthamA ati lajAlu ra ThUlThUlA sundara A~khA bhaekA apsarAharU hunechan |
mAnauM tI surakSita rAkhiekA phulaharU hun |
svargabAsIharU eka–arkotarpha pharkera paraspara sodhnechan |
tinIharUmadhye eka vaktAle bhannecha– mero euTA sAthI thiyo |
usale bhanne garthyo– “ke timI pani (mahApralayako AgamanalAI) satya mAnchau?”
“ke jaba hAmI marera mATo ra haDDImA pariNata hunechauM taba sA~ccai nai hAmIlAI badalA diinecha ta?”
usale sodhyo, “ke timIharU ( tyasalAI ) herna cAhanchau?”
dRSTi lagAunAsAtha tyasa vyaktilAI narakako bIcamA dekhcha |,
ra, bhancha allAhako kasama! timIle ta malAI pani naSTa garna lAgekA thiyau |
ra, yadi merA pAlanakartAko kRpA nabhaeko bhae ma pani ( narakamA ) hAjira garineharUmadhye hune thie~ |
aba hAmI marnevAlA chainauM, haina ta?
hAmro prathama mRtyu bAheka? ra, hAmIlAI yAtanA pani diIMdaina, haina ta?
vAstavamA yahI nai mahAn saphalatA ho |
yasaikolAgi karma garneharUle karma garnuparcha |
AtithyasvarUpa yo ( svarga ) uttama raheko cha, vA jakakUma (siu~DI) ko vRkSa?”
tyasalAI hAmIle atyAcArIharUkAlAgi prakopa banAidiekA chauM |
vAstavamA tyo vRkSa narakako dharAtalamA umrancha |
tyasakA TusA zaitAnaharUkA TAukAharUjastai chan |
narakabAsIharU tyasaibATa khAnechan ra tyasaile peTa bharnechan |
pheri tyasasa~gai tinIharUlAI umla~do pAnI mizraNa hune cha |
pheri tinIharUlAI narakatarpha pharkAinecha |
nissandeha tinIharUle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI pathabhraSTa nai pAe |
ani tinIharukai padacinhamA dauDirahe |
tinIharUbhandA pahile bitekAharUmadhye adhikAMza pathabhraSTa nai thie |
ra, hAmIle tinIharUkahA~ sacetakaharU pani paThAekA thiyauM |
ataH hera kasto (narAmro) pariNAma bhayo saceta gariekA mAnisaharUko!
tara allAhale cayana garekA bhaktaharUko kurA beglai cha |
ra, nizcaya nai nUhale hAmIlAI pukAre | hera hAmI kati rAmrA prArthanA svIkArakartA hauM!
hAmIle unalAI tathA unakA anuyAyIharUlAI ThUlo saGkaTabATa bacAyauM |
ra, unakA santAnalAI nai hAmIle bA~kI rahanevAlA banAyauM |
ra, pachi Aune pustAharUkAlAgi hAmIle unako prasiddhi bA~kI rAkhyauM |
nUhamAthi salAma hos sArA jagatharUmA |
nissandeha hAmI uttama karma garneharUlAI yastai kisimako pratidAna dine garchauM |
nissandeha unI hAmrA AsthAvAna bhaktaharUmadhyekA thie |
tara anya mAnisaharUlAI hAmIle DubAidiyauM |
ra, unakai samUhabATa ibrAhIma pani thie |
smaraNa gara jaba unI AphnA pAlanakartAsamakSa saccA hRdayakAsAtha upasthita bhae |
jaba unale AphnA pitA tathA jAtikA mAnisaharUlAI bhane– “timIharU kuna cijako pUjA garchau?”
“ke timIharU mithyAmai allAhabAhekakA upAsyaharU cAhanchau?”
“bhana sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartAbAre timIharUko ke dhAraNA cha?”
ra, ibrAhImale caTTa tArAharUlAI here |
ani bhane– “ma asvasthya chu |”
ataH tinIharU unalAI pachADi choDera hiMDe |
tyasapachi unI tinIharUkA upAsyaharUsamakSa puge ra bhane– “timIharU kina khA~dainauM?”
“timIharUlAI ke bhaeko cha ki timIharU boldainau?”
pheri dAhine hAtale hAndai tinIharUmAthi jAilAge |
pheri mAnisaharU unItarpha dagurdai Ae |
ibrAhImale sodhe–“ke timIharU tyasako pUjA garchau jasalAI timIharU svayaM ku~dera banAu~chau |
jabaki timIharUlAI tathA timIharUle banAune vastuharUlAI allAhale nai sRSTi garekA hun?”
tinIharUle bhane– “usakolAgi euTA agni gRha banAU ra tyasalAI tyahI danka~do AgomA homideU |”
tinIharUle ibrAhImaviruddha upAya garne euTA khela khelna cAhe tara hAmIle tinIharUlAI nai parAjita garidiyauM |
ibrAhImale bhane–“ma AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha jA~daichu | unale malAI avazya nai mArgadarzana garnechan |
he merA pAlanakartA! malAI euTA yogya santAna pradAna gara |
ataH hAmIle unalAI euTA saMyamI putrako zubhasandeza diyauM |

ani jaba tyo unIsa~ga rAmrarI dauDadhupa garne umeramA pugyo taba unale bhane– “mero priya chorA sapanAmA maile svayaM Aphnai hAtale timIlAI vadha gardai dekheko chu | bhana timro ke vicAra cha? chorAle bhane–“he merA pitA! tapAIMlAI juna Adeza diincha tyasako pAlanA garnuhos | allAhale cAhemA tapAIM malAI dhairyavAnaharUmadhye pAunuhunecha |”
ataH jaba duvaile AphUlAI arpaNa gare ra usalAI jamInamA ghopTo pArI laDAe...
taba hAmIle pukAryauM– “he ibrAhIma!
timIle sapanA sAkAra pAryau | hAmI sukarmIharUlAI avazya yastai pratidAna dinchauM |”
vAstavamA tyo khullA parIkSA thiyo |
ra, hAmIle badalA svarUpa euTA ThUlo balidvArA usalAI bacAyauM |
ra, pachi Aune pustAharUlAI pani hAmIle unako mArgamA rAkhyau |
salAma hos ibrAhImalAI!
sukarmIharUlAI hAmI yastai pratidAna dine garchauM |
vAstavamA unI hAmrA AsthAvAna bhaktaharUmadhye thie |
ra, hAmIle unalAI ishAkako pani zubhasUcanA diyauM jo satkarmIharUmadhye nabI hunechan |
ra, hAmIle unImAthi tathA ishAkamAthi anugraha avataraNa garyauM | unIharU duvaikA santAnaharUmadhye kehI puNyakarmI chan bhane anya kehI svayaMmAthi spaSTa rUpamA atyAcAra garneharU |
ra, mUsA tathA hArUnamAthi pani hAmIle upakAra garyauM |
ra, unIharU duvailAI tathA unakA samudAyalAI ThUlo utpIDanabATa bacAyauM |
ra, unIharUlAI sahayoga garyauM ataH unIharU nai vijayI bhae |
ra, unIharU duvailAI atyanta spaSTa grantha pradAna garyauM |
duvailAI sIdhA bATo dekhAyauM |
ra, pachi Aune pustAharUmA pani hAmIle unIharU duvaiko mArgamA rAkhyauM |
‘salAma’ (zAnti) cha mUsA ra hArUnamAthi |
sukarmI vyaktiharUlAI hAmI yastai pratidAna dinchauM |
vAstavamA unI duvai hAmrA AsthAvana bhaktaharUmadhyekA thie |
nissandeha ilyAsa pani sandeSTAharUmadhyekA thie |
smaraNa gara jaba unale AphnA jAtibandhuharUlAI bhane– “ke timIharU allAhasita DarAu~dainau?
ke timIharU baala (nAmaka mUrti) lAI pukArchau ra sarvotkRSTa sRSTikartAlAI choDidinchau |
allAhalAI jo timIharukA pAlanakartA tathA timrA pUrvajaharUkA pani pAlanakartA hun?”
tara unIharUle unalAI mithyA Thahara gare | ataH tinIharU avazya nai hAjira garinechan |
tara allAhakA viziSTa bhaktaharUko kurA beglai cha |
ra, pachi Aune pustAharUmA pani hAmIle unako mArgamA rAkhyauM |
salAma (zAnti) cha ilyAsInamAthi |
sukarmIharUlAI hAmI yastai pratidAna dinchauM |
vAstavamA unI merA AsthAvAna bhaktaharUmadhyekA thie |
ra nissandeha lUta pani sandeSTAharUmadhyekA thie |
smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle unalAI ra unakA sampUrNa mAnisaharUlAI bacAyauM |
euTI vRddha mahilA bAheka jo pachi rahaneharUmA parin |
pheri hAmIle anya sabailAI pUrNa rUpamA sakhApa pAryauM |
ra timIharU ta tinIharU naSTa bhaekai sthAnabATa bihAnI pakha hiMDchau |
ra rAtamA pani | ke timIharU vicAra gardainau?
ra, vAstavamA yUnusa pani sandeSTAharUmadhyekA thie |
smaraNa gara jaba unI pUrNa rUpamA bharieko DuGgAtarpha bhAge |
pheri ciTThA hAle | ra, unI parAjita bhae |
antataH unalAI vhela mAchAle nilyo ra unI doSI thie |
ani unale (allAhako) pavitratA varNana nagareko bhae...
mAnavajAtiko punarjIvanako dinasamma mAchAkai peTamA rahirahane thie |
ataH hAmIle unalAI sukhkhA maidAnamA phyA~kidiyauM yasa avasthAmA ki unI asvasthya thie |
ra, unImAthi euTA chAyA~ pArne jhyAGako rupamA rukha umAryauM |
ra, unalAI eka lAkha vA tyasabhandA adhika mAnisaharUtarpha paThAyauM |
ani unIharUle ImAna lyAe ra hAmIle euTA nizcita avadhisamma unIharUlAI sukhamaya avasthAmA rAkhyauM |
ataH (he muhammada sa.! bahudevavAdIharUlAI) sodha, “ke timrA pAlanakartAkAnimti chorIharU ra timIharUkAnimti chorAharU chan?”
ke hAmIle phariztAharUlAI strI banAyauM ra tinIharU tyahA~ upasthita thie |
jAnirAkha! tinIharU nizcaya nai mithyA racera bhandaichan...
ki allAhakA santAna chan bhanera | jabaki tinIharU mithyAvAdI hun |
ke allAhale AphnolAgi chorAharUko sATo chorIharU chAnekA chan?
timIharUlAI ke bhayo, timIharU kasto nirNaya garchau?
ke timIharU buddhile kAma liMdainau?
ke timIharUsa~ga yasako kunai Thosa pramANa cha ra?
yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane Aphno likhita pramANa prastuta gara |
yinIharUle allAha ra jinnaharUbIca sAino bhaeko ThaharAe, jabaki jinnaharulAI rAmrarI thAhA cha ki unIharU avazya nai (allAhasAmu) hAjira garinechan |
allAhako bAremA jejati bayAna tinIharu garchan tyasabATa allAha pUrNa pavitra chan |
a~, allAhakA viziSTa bhaktaharUko kurA veglai cha |
(he bahudevavAdIharU ho!) timIharu ra jasalAI timIharU pUjdachau |
timIharU sabai milera pani kasailAI allAhabAre gumarAha sakdainau |
tyo byaktibAheka jasalAI narakamA nai hominecha |
ra, (phariztAharU bhanchan)– hAmImadhye pratyekakonimti nirdhArita sthAna raheko cha |
ra, hAmI paGaktibaddha ubhirahanechauM |
ra, (allAhako) mahimAgAna garirahanchauM |
ssandeha kAphiraharUle bhanne garthe–
“yadi hAmIsita pahilekA mAnisaharUko grantha bhaeko bhae...
hAmI pani allAhakA viziSTa bhaktaharUmadhye hune thiyauM |”
tara yinIharUle yasa kuraAnalAI asvIkAra gare | ataH cA~Dai nai yinIharUlAI (yasako pariNAma) thAhA hunecha |
hAmrA bhakta sandeSTAharUkAlAgi pahile nai hAmro vacana jArI bhaisakeko cha |
ki unIharU nai hun jasalAI sahayoga garinecha |
ra, hAmrai sainyaharU vijayI hunechan |
ani kehI samayakAlAgi yinIharUbATa alaga bhaera basa |
ani, tinIharUlAI herdai gara, ra tinIharUle pani cA~Dai nai (kuphrako pariNAma) dekhnechan |
ke tinIharU hAmro yAtanAkolAgi hatArinchan?
tara jaba tyo yAtanA timIharUko A~ganamA avatIrNa hunecha taba saceta gariekA mAnisaharUko prabhAtakAla ati nai narAmro hunecha |
ani kehI samayakAlAgi tinIharUlAI choDideU |
ra, herdai gara | tinIharUle cA~Dai nai dekhnechan |
timrA sammAnita pAlanakartA tI cijaharUbATa pavitra chan jasako varNana tinIharU gardachan |
salAma (zAnti) hos sampUrNa saMdeSTAharUmAthi |
ra, sArA prazaMsA allAhakainimti chan jo sampUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartA hun |
sAda0; kasama upadezayukta kuraAnako |
hoina, baru kAphiraharU ahaGkAra evaM virodhamA chan |
tinIharUbhandA pahile hAmIle kaiyauM samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pAryauM | ani tinIharU tyatikhera cicyAe jaba ki muktiko lAgi kunai samaya rahena |
tinIharUsamakSa tinIharUmadhyebATa nai ekajanA sacetaka Aekole tinIharU Azcaryacakita bhae | ra, kAphiraharUle bhane– “yo euTA jAdUgara evaM ati jhUTho vyakti ho |
ke yasale yati dherai upAsyaharUlAI euTai upAsya banAidiyo? vAstavamA yo atyantai Azcaryajanaka kurA ho |”
tyasapachi tinIharUkA aguvA yo bhandai hiMDe ki jAU ra AphnA IzvaraharUko pUjAmA aDiga hoU, nizcaya nai cAhieko kurA nizcaya yahI ho |
bigatako dharmamA ta hAmIle yasa prakArako kurA sunekai chainauM | yo kapolakalpita kurA mAtra ho |

( bhanchan ) ke hAmImadhye yahI euTA vyakti ho jasamAthi upadeza avataraNa garieko cha? hoina, baru vAstavikatA ke cha bhane yI kAphiraharU mero granthako viSayamA sandehamA chan | hoina, baru yinIharUle mero yAtanA (ko svAda) ahilesamma cAkhekai chainan |
( sodha ) ke yinIharUsa~ga timrA prabhutvazAlI, mahAnadAtA, pAlanakartAko kRpAko bhaNDAra cha?
vA AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaibIca bhaekA cijaharUko sattAdhikAra tinIharUko hAtamA cha? cha bhane yinIharU DorIko mAdhyamale AkAzamA caDhUn!
yI samUhaharUmadhye kastA kastA sainya dalale ta parAjaya bhogisakekA chan |
tinIharUbhandA pahile nUhako samudAya, Ada ra killA rAkhekA phiraaunale mithyA Thahara garekA thie |
ra samUda, lUtako samudAya ra aikA bAsIharUle pani | yinIharU nai ( parAjaya bhogne ) tI samUhaharU hun |
tinIharumadhye pratyekale A–AphnA rasUlalAI mithyA Thahara garyo | antataH mero prakopa (unIharU– mAthi) satyasiddha bhayo |
yinIharU kevala euTA bhayAvaha citkArako pratIkSAmA chan jasamA kunai pani Dhilo hune chaina |
tinIharU bhanchan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI hisAba kitAbako dinabhandA pahile nai hAmro (daNDako) aMza deU |
(he muhammada sa.!) yinIharUkA kurAmA dhairyadhAraNa gara, ra smaraNa gara hAmro zaktizAlI bhakta dAUdalAI | nissandeha unI atyanta AjJAkArI thie |
hAmIle pahADaharUlAI unako adhInastha garekA thiyauM juna unIsa~gai sA~jha ra bihAna mahimAgAna garnegarthe |
ra, paMkSIharU juna unIsamakSa bhelA hunthe | tI sabai unakA AjJAkArI thie |
ani, hAmIle unako zAsanalAI sudRDha tulyAekA thiyauM ra unalAI tatvadarzitA evaM mAmalAko nirNayazakti pradAna garekA thiyauM |
ke timIlAI jhagaDA garne mAnisaharUko samAcAra prApta bhayo jaba tinIharU parkhAla nAghera miharAba (bhaktikoThA) pugekA thie?

unIharU dAUdasamakSa pugepachi dAUda DarAe | unIharUle bhane– “naDarAunuhos; hAmI duvai prativAdI pakSa hauM | hAmImadhye ekale arkomAthi anyAya garekA cha | ataH tapAIM hAmIharUbIca nyAyakA sAtha nirNaya garidinuhos ra pakSapAta nagarnuhos | ra, hAmIlAI sIdhAmArgako nirdezana dinuhos |
yo mero bhAi ho jasasa~ga unAnsayavaTA bheDI chan, ra masita euTA mAtra bheDI cha | tara usale bhancha– “yo euTA bheDI pani malAI nai deU |” ra, kurA gardA malAI dherai hepeko cha |

dAUdale bhane– “AphnA bheDIharUmA misAuna timro bheDI mAgera usale timImAthi anyAya gareko cha | ra, sAjhedAraharUmadhye adhikAMza eka arkAmAthi anyAya nai garchan | sivAya tI mAnisaharu jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare | tara yastA vyakti dherai kama chan | ra, hAmIle unako parIkSA liyauM bhanne kurA dAudale bujhe | ataH unale AphnA pAlanakartAsita kSamAyAcanA gare tathA jhuke ra sajdA gare ani pUrNa rUpamA allAhatira pharke |
tasartha hAmIle yasako lAgi unalAI kSamA garyauM | nissandeha unakAlAgi hAmIkahA~ pratiSThita tathA uttama bAsasthAna cha |

he dAUda! hAmIle timIlAI dhartImA ‘khalIphA’ (nAyaba) banAyauM | ataH mAnisaharUbIca satyakAsAtha nirNaya garne gara ra manokAGkSAko anusaraNa nagara, natra yasale timIlAI allAhako mArgabATa bhaDakAunecha | nizcaya nai juna mAnisaharU allAhako mArgabATa vicalita hunchan tinIharUle hisAba–kitAbako dinalAI birsidieko kAraNale tinIharUkAlAgi kaThora yAtanA cha |
ra, hAmIle AkAza, pRthvI tathA yI duvaibIca bhaekA cijaharUlAI bekAramA sRSTi garekA chainauM | yo ta kAphiraharUko socAi ho | ani kAphiraharUkAlAgi narakako yAtanA rahekocha |
ke hAmI AsthAvAna tathA satkarmIharUlAI dhartImA vidhvaMsa maccAune mAnisaharUjastai banAu~chauM ta, vA IzaparAyaNaharUlAI duSkarmIharUjastai banAu~chauM ra?
juna graMthana hAmIle timItarpha avatarita garekA chauM atyanta barakatayukta grantha ho, tAki unIharUle tyasakA AyataharUmAthi manana garUn ra buddhimAnaharUle upadeza grahaNa garUn |
ra, hAmIle dAUdalAI sulaimAna pradAna garyauM | unI ati asala bhakta thie | vAstavamA unI atyantai AjJAkArI thie |
jaba unIsamakSa sA~jhapakha drutagatikA sarvottama nazlakA ghoDAharU peza garie...
taba unale bhane, “maile Aphno rabako smaraNakolAgi yo sampatiko moha gareM | yahA~samma ki sUrya dRSTibATa ojhela bhayo |”
(taba unale Adeza die)– “tI ghoDAharU phirtA lyAU |” ani tinI (ghoDA) harukA piMDaulA tathA gardhanaharUmA sumasumAuna thAle |
ra, hAmIle sulaimAnalAI jA~cyauM | ra, unako kursImAthi euTA zarIra rAkhyauM | taba unale pazcAtApa gare |
sulaimAnale prArthanA gare– “he merA pAlanakartA! malAI kSamA gara ra yasto zAsana pradAna gara juna ma pachi kasaikolAgi upayukta nahos | nissandeha timI nai mahAn dAtA hau |
ani hAmIle hAvAlAI unako adhInamA pAryauM jo unako Adeza anusAra jatAtira unale icchA garthe utai calne gathryo |,
zaitAnaharUlAI pani unako adhInamA pAryauM jo sipAlu DakarmI tathA pauDIbAja thie...
ra anya jaJjIrale bA~dhiekAharulAI pani |
(hAmIle bhanyauM)– “yo hAmro apAra ( behisAba ) varadAna ho; timIlAI adhikAra cha ki jasalAI cAha deU vA rokI rAkha |”
nissandeha unakA lAgi hAmIkahA~ pratiSThita tathA uttama bAsasthAna cha |
ra, hAmrA bhakta aiyyUbalAI smaraNa gara, jaba unale AphnA pAlanakartAlAI pukArdai bhane– “malAI zaitAnale pIDA ra duHkha dieko cha |”
(Adeza bhayo)– AphnA khuTTA (bhUmimA) bajAra | yo nuhAuna ra piuna duvaikolAgi ciso (pAnI) ho |
ani, hAmIle unalAI unakA sampUrNa parivAra pradAna garyauM ra tyati nai arU pani thapa (pradAna garyauM) | tyo hAmrotarphabATa kRpA tathA jJAnavAnharUkA– lAgi upadeza thiyo |
ani, Aphno hAtale kUco samAta ra tyasale hirkAU ani kasama natoDa | vAstavamA hAmIle aiyyubalAI saMyamI pAyauM | kati asala bhakta thie unI! nissandeha unI ati prAyazcitakartA thie |
ra, hAmrA bhaktaharu ibrAhIma, ishAka, tathA yaakUbalAI smaraNa gara jo sakSama tathA dUradarzI thie |
unIharUlAI hAmIle euTA vizeSa kArya arthAt AkhiratalAI smaraNa garAunako lAgi cayana garekA thiyauM |
ra, yinIharU sabai hAmIkahA~ cayana gariekA satkarmIharu madhyekA bhakta hun |
ra ismAIla, yasaa ra julkiphlalAI pani smaraNa gara | yinIharU sabai satkarmI vyaktiharUmadhye thie |
yo upadeza ho ra vAstavamA Izabhaya rAkhneharUkAlAgi rAmro sthAna ho...
arthAt sadA rahirahane bagaiMcAharU ( svarga ) jasakA DhokAharU unIharUkAlAgi khullA rahanechan...
tyahA~ sirAnImA aDesa lAgera basI anekatharikA phalaphUla tathA peyapadArtha magAirahekA hunechan |
ra, unIharUsa~ga lajAlu samaAyu apsarAharU hunechan |
( tyasa dina bhanine cha ) yo tyahI ho jasako vAcA timIharUsita hisAbako dinako lAgi garieko thiyo |
yo hAmIle pradAna gareko AjIvikA ho juna kahilyai samApta hune chaina |
ekAtira yo ho | arkotira uddaNDaharUkAlAgi ati narAmro sthAna ho...
naraka, jasamA tinIharU hominechan | hAya! tyo sAhrai nikRSTa nivAsa ho |
yo umla~do pAnI ra pIpa ho | aba yinIharUle yasailAI cAkhUn!
ra, yastai prakArakA vibhinna cijaharu pani |
( aguvAharule ekaarkAlAI bhannechan ) yo samUha pani timIharUsa~gai narakamA jAnecha | tinIharUkAlAgi kunai svAgata chaina | tinIharU avazya nai narakamA hominechan |
(anuyAyIharUle bhannechan) baru timIharUkolAgi kunai svAgata chaina | timIharUle nai yo (prakopa) hAmIsamakSa lyAekA chau | hAya! yo kati nikRSTa sthAna rahecha!
tinIharUle bhannechan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! jasale yasalAI hAmIsamakSa lyAeko cha usalAI narakako duI guNA yAtanA deU |”
ra, narakavAsIharUle bhannechan– khai, hAmI ta dekhdainauM unIharUlAI, jasalAI hAmI duSTaharUmA ganne garthyau?
ke hAmIle nai unIharUko ThaTTA garekA thiyauM vA hAmro dRSTi nai unIharUbATa pheriekA chan?
ssandeha, narakabAsIharUbIca yo jhagaDA avazya nai hunecha |
bhanideU! ma kevala sacetaka hu~ ra ekamAtra prabhutvazAlI allAhabAheka anya kohI upAsya chaina |
AkAzaharu tathA dhartI ra yI duvaibIcarahekA sampUrNa cIcaharukA pAlanakartA, atyanta prabhutvazAlI ati kSamAzIla |
bhanideU– “yo euTA ThUlo sUcanA ho |
jasabATa timIharU bimukha bhairahekA chau |
malAI mAthillo saMsArako kehI jJAna thiena, jaba tinIharU vAda-vivAda gardai thie |
mamAthi vahaya yasa kAraNale garincha ki ma spaSTa sacetaka hu~ |”
tyo samayalAI smaraNa gara jaba timrA pAlanakartAle phariztAharUlAI bhane– “ma gilo mATodvArA mAnavako sRSTi garnechu |”
tasartha maile tyasalAI ThIka pArepachi ra tyasamA Aphno AtmA phukepachi timIharU unIsamakSa sajdA gara |
ataH sArA phariztAharUle sajdA gare |
tara iblIsale garena | usale ghamaNDa garyo ra U kAphiraharUmadhye bhayo |
(allAhale sodhe)– “he iblIsa! jasalAI maile Aphno hAtale sRSTi gareM tyasasAmu sajdA garnabATa timIlAI kele rokyo? ke timI ThUlo banna cAhanchau vA ThUlA baDAharUmadhyekA hau?”
usale bhanyo– “ma UbhandA zreSTha chu | timIle malAI agnibATa sRSTi garyau ra usalAI cAhi~ mATobATa |
allAhale Adeza die– “niska yahA~bATa! kinabhane timI tiraskRta chau |
mahApralayako dinasamma timImAthi mero abhizApa cha |”
usale bhanyo– “he merA pAlanakartA! mAnisaharUlAI punarjIvita garine dinasammakAlAgi malAI avasara deU |”
allAhale bhane– “timIlAI avasara diiyo...
euTA nirdhArita avadhi dinasamma |”
iblIsale bhanyo– “timro pratiSThAko kasama! ma yinIharU sabailAI pathabhraSTa garerai choDnechu |
timrA tI bhaktaharUbAheka jasalAI timIle cayana garekA chau |”
allAhale bhane– “yo nitAnta satya ho ra ma nitAnta satya nai bhanchu |
timI ra mAnisaharUmadhye jasale timro anusaraNa garcha ma avazya sabailAI narakamA homera tyasalAI bharnechu |”
bhanideU–“ma timIharUsita yasako pratiphala mAgdina, ra ma ADambarIharUmadhyeko pani hoina |
yo kuraAna jagatbAsIharUkAlAgi euTA upadeza mAtra ho |
ra, nizcaya nai timIharUlAI yasale dieko samAcAra ko ( vAstavikatA ) cA~Dai nai thAhA bhaihAlnecha |”
yasa granthako avataraNa prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI allAhako tarphabATa bhaeko ho |
nissandeha hAmIle yasa granthalAI nitAnta satyakAsAtha timImAthi avataraNa garekA chauM | ataH AjJApAlanalAI allAhakailAgi viziSTa garI unako upAsanA gara |

jAnirAkha! viziSTa upAsanA ta allAhakailAgi cha, ra jasale unIbAheka anya kasailAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAekA chan tinIharUle hAmIlAI allAhako najika puryAi diUn bhanne uddezyale mAtra hAmI yinIharUko pUjA garchauM | nissandeha allAhale yinIharUbIca tyasa kurAko nirNaya garnechan jasamA yinIharU matabheda gardaichan | ra, jhUThA tathA kRtaghna mAnisaharUlAI allAhale kahilyai sIdhA mArga dekhAu~dainan |
allAhale putra grahaNa garna cAhekA bhae AphnA sRSTiharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanthe chanauTa garne thie | unI ta ( yasto kArya garnabATa ) pavitra chan | tI allAha hun jo eklo tathA prabhAvazAlI chan |

unaile AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI nitAnta satyakAsAtha sRSTi gare | unI rAtalAI dinale ra dinalAI rAtale berchan | unale sUrya evaM candramAlAI sevAmA khaTAekA chan | tI sabai euTA nizcita samayasamma kAryaerat rahanechan | jAnirAkha! unI nai prabhutvazAlI evaM atyanta kSamAzIla chan |

unaile timIharUlAI euTai jIvabATa sRSTi gare | pheri tyasaibATa usako joDI banAe ra caupAyAharUmadhye AThavaTA joDI avatIrNa gare | unI timIharUlAI timrA AmAharUkA garbhamA tIna andhakAraharUbhitra ekapachi arko rUpamA parivartana gardai sRSTi garchan | unai allAha timIharUkA pAlanakartA hun; zAsanasattA unakai ho | unIbAheka kohI pUjya chaina, taipani timIharU katA bahakAinchau ta?

yadi timIharU kRtaghnatA dekhAu~chau bhane allAha timIharUbATa nispRha chan, ra unI AphnA bhaktaharUkAlAgi kRtaghnatA mana parAu~dainan, ra yadi timIharU kRtajJa hunchau bhane allAhale yasalAI manaparAuMchan| ra kunai bhArI uThAunele kasaiko bhAra uThAune chaina | pheri timIharU sabai timrA pAlanakartAtarpha nai pharkera jAnucha | ani unale timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbAre avagata garAunechan | unI manakA kurAharU pani jAndachan |
