ra, jaba mAnavamAthi kunai saGkaTa Au~cha taba U bilaunA gardai AphnA pAlanakartAlAI pukArdacha | ani jaba allAha usamAthi Aphno anugraha barSAu~chan taba usale pahile unIsita juna prArthanA gareko thiyo tyo birsancha ra allAhako sAjhedAra banAuna thAlcha tAki unako bATobATa (mAnisaharUlAI) bahakAos | bhanideU Aphno kuphrako phAidA kehI dina uThAihAla | kinabhane timI narakabAsIharU hau |

ke tyo vyakti jo rAtabhari sajdA garcha ra (prArthanAmA) khaDA rahancha; Akhiratasita DarAu~cha ra Aphno pAlanakartAko dayAko AzA rAkhdacha, tyo vyaktisaraha huna sakcha jasale tyasto gardaina? (he nabI sa.!) sodha ke jJAnI ra ajJAnIharU samAna huna sakchan? vAstavamA buddhimAnharUle mAtra upadeza grahaNa garne garchan |

bhanideU– “he AsthAvAnaharU ho! AphnA rabasita DarAU | yasa saMsAramA rAmro kAma garneharUkAlAgi bhalAi cha | ra, allAhako dhartI ati vistRta cha | nissandeha saMyamIharUlAI unIharUkA pratidAna anagintI pradAna garinecha |”
bhanideU– “AjJApAlanalAI allAhakai lAgi vizuddha garera unako bhakti garne malAI Adeza bhaeko cha |
ra, unako prathama muslima ( AjJAkArI ) banne malAI Adeza pani diieko cha |”
bhanideU– “AphnA rabako avajJA gardA euTA ThUlo dinako yAtanAko malAI Dara lAgcha |”
bhanideU– “ma Aphno AjJApAlanalAI unaikolAgi vizuddha garI kevala allAhakai bhakti garchu |

ani timIharU allAhabAheka jasako icchA lAgcha usaiko bhakti gara |” bhanideU– “vAstavika ghATA behorneharU ta mahApralayako dina svayaMlAI ra Aphno parivAralAI ghATAmA pArneharU hun | suna! yahI spaSTa ghATA ho |
tinIharUkolAgi mAthibATa pani Agoko chA~yA hunecha ra talabATa pani | yahI ho tyo yAtanA jasabATa allAha AphnA bhaktaharUlAI Dara dekhAu~chan | tasartha, he merA bhaktaharU ho! masita nai DarAU |
ra, juna mAnisaharU ‘tAgUta’ ko bhaktibATa TADhA rahanchan, ra allAhatarpha nai pharkanchan tinIharUkA lAgi zubhasUcanA raheko cha | ani merA bhaktaharUlAI zubhasUcanA deU |
jo rAmrarI kurA sundachan ra tyasako rAmro pakSako anusaraNa garchan tyastA mAnisaharUlAI nai allAhale mArgadarzana garekA chan ra tinIharU nai buddhimAn hun |
jasamAthi yAtanAko Adeza siddha bhaisakeko cha, ke timI tyastA narakabAsIharulAI bacAuna sakchau?

tara jo AphnA pAlanakartAko bhaya rAkhchan tinIharUkAlAgi tallai tallA bhaekA ucca mahalaharU chan jasako talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan | yo allAhako vAcA ho | nissandeha allAha AphnA vAcA bhaGga gardainan |

ke timIle dekhenau ki allAhale AkAzabATa pAnI barsAu~chan ra tyasalAI pRthvIkA mUlaharUsamma puryAu~chan, ani tyasako mAdhyamabATa aneka tharikA bAlInAlI umArchan | pheri tyo sukcha ra timI tyasalAI paheMlo dekhchau, ani unale tyasalAI TukrA–TukrA pAridinchan | nissandeha yasamA jJAvAnharUkAlAgi upadeza rahekocha |

tyo vyakti jasako chAtIlAI allAhale islAmakolAgi kholidiekA chan ra U AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa prakAzamA cha, (ke tyo avajJAkArI jasto huna sakcha?) ataH dhikkAra cha tI vyaktiharUmAthi jasako hRdaya allAhako upadezako bAremA kaThora bhaisakeko cha | yinIharU spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA chan |

allAhale uttama vANI avataraNa garekA chan– grantha jasakA AyataharU paraspara mildAjuldA ra bArambAra punarAvRtti gariekA chan; jasalAI sundA tI vyaktiharUko AGa jiriGga huncha jo AphnA pAlanakartAko bhaya rAkhchan | pheri unIharUkA zarIra ra hRdaya narama bhaera allAhako smaraNatira AkarSita hunchan | yo allAhako mArgadarzana ho jasako mAdhyamabATa unI jasalAI cAhanchan sIdhA mArgamA DoryAu~chan ra jasalAI allAhale nai pathabhraSTa pArchan usako kohI mArgadarzaka huna sakdaina |

ke tyo vyakti jasale mahApralayako dina kaThora yAtanAbATa bacna Aphnai mukhalAI DhAla banAunecha (tyo svargamA santuSTisAtha basne vyaktijasto huna sakcha)? atyAcArIharUlAI bhaninecha– “timIharU Aphno kamAiko svAda cAkha |”
tinIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUle pani mithyA Thahara garekA thie | ataH jahA~bATa tinIharUle socekA pani thienan tyahA~bATa tinIharUmAthi prakopa Ayo |
ani allAhale sAMsArika jIvanamai tinIharUlAI apamAnako svAda cakhAe, ra Akhiratako yAtanA ta nizcita rUpamA ajha ThUlo hunecha | Aha, tinIharUlAI yasako jJAna bhaeko bhae!
ra, nissandeha hAmIle yasa kuraAnamA mAnisaharUkAlAgi hareka prakArakA udAharaNaharU varNana garekAchauM tAki tinIharUle upadeza grahaNa garUn |
arabI kuraAna, jasamA kunai kuTilatA chaina, AzA cha tinIharU IzaparAyaNatA apanAUne chan |

allAha euTA yasto vyaktiko udAharaNa dinchan– jasakA kaiyana paraspara virodhI svAmIharU chan, ra arko yasto vyaktiko jo pUrNa rUpamA euTai svAmIko adhInamA huncha | ke duvaiko avasthA samAna huna sakcha? sampUrNa prazaMsA allAhakailAgi chan, tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |
(he muhammada sa.!) nissandeha timI pani marnechau ra tinIharU pani marnechan |
pheri mahApralayako dina timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAkahA~ jhagaDA garnechau |

tyo mAnchebhandA ThUlo atyAcArI arU ko huna sakcha jo allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garcha ra jaba tyasasamakSa nitAnta satyako Agamana huncha taba tyasalAI asatya Thahara garcha? ke kAphiraharUko bAsasthAna naraka hoina ra?
ra, jo satya liera Ae ra jasale tyasalAI satya Thahara gare tinIharU nai allAhako vAstavika bhaya rAkhneharU hun |
tinIharUko pAlanakartAkahA~ ti sabai thoka cha jo cAhanchan | satkarmIharUko yahI nai pratidAna ho |
tAki allAha tinIharUle garekA duSkarmaharUlAI tinIharUbATa haTAun, ra tinIharUlAI tinakA uttama kAryaharUko pratidAna diUn |

ke allAha AphnA bhaktakolAgi paryApta chainan ra? ra yinIharU timIlAI allAhabAheka ( asatya pujyaharu ) kA bhaya dekhAu~chan | ra, allAha jasalAI pathabhraSTa gardachan usakolAgi kohI mArgadarzaka hu~daina |
ra, jasalAI allAha mArgadarzana garchan usalAI kohI pathabhraSTa garna sakdaina | ke allAha prabhutvazAlI evam badalA linevAlA hoinan ra?

AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI kasale sRSTi gare bhanera yadi timIle tinIharUlAI sodhyau bhane tinIharUle avazya bhannechan– “allAhale!” sodha– “yadi allAhale malAI kunai hAni puryAuna cAhemA ke timIharUle pukArne garekA (jhuThA) upAsyaharUle tyasa hAnilAI TArna sakchan, vA allAhale maprati kRpA garna cAhemA ke tinIharU tyasalAI rokna sakchan?” bhanideU– “merolAgi allAha nai paryApta chan | bharosA garneharU unaimAthi bharosA garchan |”
bhanideU– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! timIharU Aphno sthAnamA kAma gara, ma Aphno sthAnamA kAryarata chu | ani timIharUlAI cA~Dai thAhA bhaihAlnecha...
ki kasamAthi ( saMsAramA ) apamAnita garne prakopa AilAgnecha? ra, kasamAthi cirasthAyI yAtanA Aunecha?”

hAmIle yo grantha timImAthi nitAnta satyakAsAtha mAnisaharUkAlAgi avataraNa garekA chauM | ataH jasale mArgadarzana apanAu~cha, Aphnai phAidAkolAgi apanAu~cha, ra jo pathabhraSTa huncha usale AphaiMlAI hAni puryAu~cha | ra (he nabI sa.!) timI tinIharUko jimmevAra hoinau |

tI allAha nai hun jasale mRtyuko belA prANaharUlAI pUrNataH grasta garchan, ra na marekAharUko prANa nindrAmA (grasta garchan) | ani jasamAthi unale mRtyuko phaisalA lAgU garchan usako prANa AphUkahA~ rokera rAkhchan | ra, bA~kI prANaharUlAI euTA nizcita samayakAlAgi choDidinchan | vAstavamA manan garneharUkAlAgi yasamA nizAnIharU chan |
ke tinIharUle allAhabAheka arUlAI siphArizakartA banAekA chan? sodha– “ ke tinIharUsa~ga kunai adhikAra ra jJAna na bhaetApani ( tinIharulAI siphArizakartA banAeko chau )?”
bhanideU– “siphAriza pUrNataH allAhamA nihita cha | unakailAgi AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko rAjya rahekocha | pheri timIharUlAI unaitarpha pharkAera laginecha |”

ra, jaba eka mAtra allAhako varNana garincha taba AkhiratamAthi ImAna narAkhne mAnisaharUko hRdaya ghRNAle saGkucita huna pugcha | tara jaba unIbAheka anya (mithyA pUjya) ko varNana garincha taba tinIharU praphullita hunchan |
bhanideU– “he allAha! AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sRSTikartA, adRzya tathA dRzyakA jJAtA! timI nai AphnA bhaktaharUle garne garekA matabhedaharUkA sambandhamA nirNaya garnechau |

ra, atyAcArIharUsa~ga pRthvIkA sArA sampatti ra ajha thapa tyati nai chan bhane mahApralayako nikRSTa yAtanAbATa bacna unIharU tI sabai kharca garnechan | ra, allAhako tarphabATa tyo kurA prakaTa hunecha jasabAre tinIharUle kahilyai socekA pani thienan |
ra, tinIharUle gareko (narAmro) kAryako duSpariNAma tinIharUsamakSa prakaTa hunecha, ani juna kurAko tinIharU khillI uDAune garthe tyasaile tinIharUlAI ghernecha |

ra, mAnisamAthi jaba saGkaTa Aiparcha taba hAmIlAI pukArna thAlcha, tara jaba hAmI Aphno tarphabATa kunai kRpA garchauM taba usale bhancha– “yo ta malAI Aphnai jJAnako AdhAramA prApta bhaeko ho |” tara yo euTA parIkSA ho tApani tinIharUmadhye adhikAMzale jAndainan |
yinIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUle pani yahI kurA bhanekA thie tara tinIharUkA kriyAkalApale tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAena |

baru tinIharUko kamAiko duSpariNAmale tinIharUlAI samAtyo | ra, aba yI kAphiraharUmadhye jasale pApa garekA chan tinIharUlAI pani tinIharukA duSkarmako pariNAmale samAtnecha | ra, yinIharUle ( yaso garnabATa ) vivaza pArna sakdainan |
ke yinIharUlAI thAhA chaina ki allAha jasakAnimti cAhanchan AjIvikA vistRta tulyAu~chan ra jasakAlAgi cAhanchan simita pArchan? nissandeha yasamA ImAna lyAuneharUkAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |

bhanideU– “svayaMmAthi anyAya garekA merA bhaktaharU ho! timIharU allAhako kRpAbATa nirAza nahoU | nizcaya nai allAhale sampUrNa pApaharU kSamA garnechan | nissandeha unI atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
timIharUmAthi prakopako Agamana pazcAta timIharule kunai sahayoga na pAunu aghi nai AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha pharka ra unako AjJAkArI bana |

ra, AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avataraNa bhaeko sarvAettama zikSAko anusaraNa gara, tyasa samaya bhandA aghi nai ki timIharU asAvadhAna raheko avasthAmA akasmAt timIharUmAthi prakopako Agamana hos |
(yo sacetanA yasa kAraNale cha ki kasaile yo nabhanos) “hAya apasoca! maile allAhako hakamA gareko galtIprati! ra ma upahAsa garneharUmadhye nai thie~ |
vA yo nabhanos– “yadi allAhale malAI mArgadarzana garekA bhae, nizcaya nai ma duSkarmabATa bacneharUmadhye hune thie~ |”
vA yAtanA dekhera yo nabhanos– “yadi maile ekapaTaka pharkane maukA pAe~ bhane ma avazya nai sukarmIharUmadhye hune thie~ |”
kina khabaradAra gariena, hAmrA nizAnIharu timIharu samakSa Ae, tara timIharule tyasalAI jhuTho Thahara garyau ra ahaMkAra garyau ra inakAra garneharumadhye sAmela bhayau |
ra, mahApralayako dina allAhavirUddha mithyAropaNa garneharUko muhAra timIle kAlo bhairaheko dekhnechau | ke ghamaNDIharUko bAsasthAna narakamA hu~daina ra?
allAha AphUsita DarAune vyaktiharUlAI svargamA surakSita rAkhnechan | kunai kisimako duHkhale unIharUlAI chune sameta chaina, ra unIharU kahilyai cintAgrasta pani hune chainan |
allAha sampUrNa cijaharUkA sRSTikartA hun ra unI hareka vastukA saMrakSaka pani hun |
AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sA~cAharU unakai hAtamA chan, ra jasale allAhakA AyataharUlAI nakAre unIharU nai ghATA behorneharU hun |
bhanideU– “he mUrkhaharU ho! ke timIharU malAI allAhabAheka arUko upAsanA garna bhanchau?”

(he nabI sa.!) timItarpha ra timIbhandA pahilekA (nabIharU) tarpha yahI vahya garieko thiyo ki yadi timIle sAjhedAra Thahara garyau bhane timro karma khera jAnecha ra timI avazya nai ghATA behorneharUmadhye hunechau |,
baru, timI kevala allAhako upAsanA gara ra kRtajJa vyaktiharUmadhye hoU |

ra, tinIharUle allAhako yathocita mAna–sammAna garenan | mahApralayako dina pRthvI pUrNa rUpamA unako muThThImA hunecha ra sArA AkAza unako dAhine hAtamA berieko hunecha | mAnisaharU jejati cijaharUlAI unako sAjhedAra banAu~chan tI sabaibATa unI pavitra evaM ucca chan |,

ani, sUra phukinecha taba AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sabai prANIharU aceta bhaI Dhalnechan, tI bAheka jasalAI allAha cAhanchan | pheri arko sUra phukinecha ani svasphUrta rUpamA herdai sabai khaDA hunechan |

ani, pRthvI AphnA pAlanakartAko prakAzale jagamagAunecha; karmapatra rAkhinecha; nabI tathA sAkSIharU hAjira garinechan ra unIharUbIca ThIkasaMga nirNaya garinecha | ra, unIharUmAthi katti pani anyAya garine chaina |
ra, pratyeka vyaktilAI usale garekA karmako pUrNarupamA badalA diinecha | mAnisaharU jejati garchan tI sabai allAha rAmrarI jAndachan |

ra, kAphiraharU– lAI hUlakA hUla narakatarpha lAginecha | ani jaba tinIharU tyahA~ pugnechan tyasakA DhokAharU kholinechan ra tyahA~kA surakSAkarmIharUle tinIharUlAI sodhnechan– “ke timIharUsamakSa timIharUmadhyekai rasUlaharU AekA thienan, jasale timIharUlAI timIharUkA pAlanakartAkA AyataharU paDhera sunAune garthe ra yasa dinako sAkSAtkArabAre sAvadhAna garne garthe?” tinIharUle bhannechan– “ho Aeka thie |” tara, yAtanAko Adeza kAphiraharUmAthi satya siddhabhayo |”
bhaninecha– “narakakA DhokAharUmA praveza gara | timIharU yahA~ sadhaiMkAlAgi rahanuparnecha |” ghamaNDIharUkAlAgi yo kati nikRSTa bAsasthAna ho!

ra, AphnA pAlanakartAko bhaya rAkhne mAnisaharUlAI hUlakA hUla svargatira laginecha | ani jaba unIharU tyahA~ pugnechan tyasakA DhokAharU kholisakiekA hunechan ra tyahA~kA suurakSAkarmIharUle bhannechan–“salAma (zAnti) hos timIharUmAthi! timIharU dherai asala hau | ataH sadAkAlAgi yasamA praveza gara...,

ra unIharUle bhannechan– “sArA prazaMsA allAhakailAgi hun, jasale Aphno vAcA pUrA gare ra hAmIlAI yasa bhumiko uttarAdhikArI banAe | aba hAmI svargamA jahA~ cAhanchauM baschauM |” ani kati uttama pratidAna rahecha satkarmIharUko!

ra, timIle phariztAharUlAI siMhAsanako cAraitira AphnA pAlanakartAko prazaMsAkAsAtha pavitratA varNana garirahekA dekhnechau | ra, mAnisaharUko nyAyocita phaisalA garinecha ani ghoSaNA garinecha– “sArA prazaMsA allAhakainimti hun jo saMpUrNa jagatakA pAlanakartA hun |”
hA0 mIm0
yasa granthako avataraNa prabhutvazAlI evaM sarvajJa allAhako tarphabATa bhaeko ho |
unI pApamocaka, prAyazcita svIkArakartA, kaThora daNDadAtA ra anugrahI chan | unIbAheka arU kohI upAsya chaina | unaitarpha pharkera jAnucha |
allAhakA AyataharUko bAremA kAphiraharU nai jhagaDA garchan | ataH nagaramA tinIharUko gati vidhile timIlAI dhokAmA napAros |

yinIharUbhandA pUrva nUhako samudAya tathA tyasapachikA samUhaharUle pani (nabIharUlAI) mithyA Thahara garekA thie | ra, pratyeka samUhale AphnA rasUlaharUmAthi prahAra garne kuceSTA gare, ra asatyako AdhAramA tarkavitarka gare, tAki nitAnta satyalAI hocyAUn | ani maile tinIharUlAI kabjAmA lie~ | ani ( hera ) kasto thiyo mero daNDa!
ra, yasarI kAphiraharUko sambandhamA tinIharU nizcaya nai narakavAsI hun bhanne timrA pAlanakartAko Adeza satya siddha bhayo |

arza (siMhAsana) uThAekA ra tyasa variparikA phariztAharU AphnA pAlanakartAko prazaMsAkA sAtha mahimAgAna garchan ra unImAthi ImAna rAkhchan ani AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi kSamA prArthanA garchan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! timIle Aphno dayA ra jJAnadvArA pratyeka cijalAI gherekA chau | ataH prAyazcita garne tathA timro mArgako anusaraNa garneharUlAI kSamA gara, ra unIharUlAI narakako yAtanAbATa bacAU |
he hAmrA pAlanakartA! unIharUlAI cirasthAyI svargamA praveza garAU ra unIharUkA pUrvajaharU, strIharU ra santAnaharUmadhye satkarmIharUlAI pani | nissandeha timI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chau |
ra, unIharUlAI prakopabATa surakSita rAkha | ra, vAstavamA tyasadina duSTatAbATa timIle jasalAI surakSita rAkhyau, usamAthi (ThUlo) dayA garyau | ra, yahI nai ThUlo saphalatA ho |”

kAphiraharUlAI ThUlo svaramA bhaninecha– “timIharUlAI Aja jati risa svayaMmAthi uThiraheko cha, allAhalAI timIharUmAthi tyasabelA yobhandA baDhI risa uThthyo jaba timIharUlAI ImAnatarpha bolAinthyo tara timIharU asvIkAra garthyau |”
tinIharUle bhannechan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! timIle hAmIlAI duIpaTaka mRtyu diyau ra duIpaTaka jIvana pradAna garyau | aba hAmIle Aphno pApalAI svIkAra garyauM | ani ke aba kunai nikAsako bATo cha?”

timIharUko yo pariNAma yasa kAraNale bhaeko cha ki jaba eka allAhatarpha bolAinthyo taba timIharU asvIkAra garthyau ra jaba unakA sAtha sAjhedAra ThaharAinthyo taba timIharU svIkAra garthyau | ani aba nirNaya kevala sarvocca evaM mahAn allAhako hAtamA cha |
unai hun jasale timIharUlAI AphnA nizAnIharU dekhAu~chan ra timIharUkAlAgi AkAzabATa jIvikA avatIrNa garchan | ra, upadeza kevala prAyazcita garneharUle grahaNa garchan |
ataH AjJApAlanalAI allAhakailAgi viziSTa garera unailAI pukArne gara, cAhe kAphiraharUle ghRNA nai kina nagarUn |
unI ucca padastha siMhAsanakA mAlika, allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasamAthi cAhanchan vahaya garchan tAki unale sAkSAtkArako dinabATa DarAUn |
juna dina sabai mAnisaharU sAmunne upasthita hunechan, tinIharUko kunai kurA allAhabATa ojhela rahane chaina | (sodhinecha)– “Aja kasako sattA cha? (bhannechan) kevala eka mAtra prabala allAhako |
Aja pratyeka vyaktilAI usako Arjanako pratiphala diinecha | Aja kunai kisimako anyAya hune chaina | nissandeha allAhale hisAba linechan |

ra, he nabI sa.! bhaya dekhAU cA~Dai tinIharUlAI ati nikaTa Airaheko (mahApralayako) dinabATa jaba muTu ghA~TImA aDkinecha ra sabai ThUlo pIDA khapirahekA hunechan | tyo dina atyAcArIharUko na kohI priya–mitra hunecha na kohI yasto siphArisakartA jasako kurA svIkAra gariyos |
allAha A~khAko chala ra muTule lukAekA kurAharU rAmrarI jAndachan |
ani, allAhale nyAyocita nirNaya garnechan ra unIbAheka yinIharUle pukArne garekA (mithyA upAsyaharU) le kunai nirNaya garna sakne chainan | nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvadraSTA chan |

ke yinIharUle dhartImA ghumaphira garenan tAki vigatakA mAnisaharUko duSpariNAma dekhUn | tinIharU zakti ra dhartImA choDekA smRti cinhakA dRSTikoNale yinIharUbhandA agADi thie | tara tinIharUlAI allAhale tinIharUkA pApako kAraNale samAte ra tinIharUlAI allAhabATa bacAuna sakne kohI pani bhaena |

yo yasakAraNale ki tinIharUsamakSa tinakA IzadUtaharU khullA pramANaharU liera AekA thie tara tinIharUle asvIkAra gare | ataH allAhale tinIharUlAI samAte | nissandeha unI zaktizAlI evaM kaThora daNDadAtA hun |
nissandeha hAmIle mUsAlAI AphnA nizAnIharU tathA khullA pramANakA sAtha paThAekA thiyauM...
phiraauna, hAmAna tathA kArUnatarpha | tara tinIharUle bhane– “yo ta jAdUgara ho ati nai jhUTho |”

ani jaba unI hAmrotarphabATa tinIharUkahA~ nitAnta satya liera Ae taba tinIharUle bhane– “tyasamAthi ImAna lyAuneharUkA chorAharUko hatyA garideU ra chorIharUlAI jIvita choDideU |” tara kAphiraharUko calekhala asaphala hune nai thiyo |

ra, phiraaunale bhanyo– “malAI choDa, ma mUsAlAI mAridinchu ra bolAos usale AphnA pAlanakartAlAI | usale timIharUko dharma parivartana garidelA vA dezamA azAnti ra vidhvaMsa maccAulA bhanne malAI AzaMkA cha |
mUsAle bhane– “ma hisAba–kitAbako dinamAthi AsthA narAkhne pratyeka ghamaNDI vyaktibATa AphnA ra timIharUkA pAlanakartAko zaraNako yAcanA garchu |”

ra, phiraaunakai khAnadAnamadhyeko ekajanA AsthAvAna vyakti jasale Aphno ImAna gopya rAkheko thiyo, le bhanyo– “ke timIharU yasto vyaktiko hatyA garna cAhanchau jasale merA pAlanakartA allAha hun bhanera bhanchan ra jasale timIharUkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa nizAnIharU pani lyAekA chan? ra, yadi unI jhuThA hun bhane unako jhUThale unailAI hAni hunecha | tara, yadi unI saccA hun bhane unale timIharUlAI kunai Dara dekhAIekA kunai pani prakopako kunai na kunai aMza timIharUmAthi AilAgnecha | nissandeha allAha sImA ullaGghanakArI tathA mithyAvAdIlAI mArga dekhAu~dainan |

he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! Aja timIharUko zAsana cha, ra po timIharU dhartImA ravApha dekhAirahekA chau | tara yadi allAhako prakopa hAmImAthi avatIrNa bhayo bhane kasale hAmIlAI tyasabATa jogAuna sakcha?” phiraaunale bhanyo– “ma timIharUlAI tyahI kurA batAu~chu juna kurA ma ucita ThAnchu | ra, timIharUlAI tyahI mArga dekhAu~chu juna sojho cha |”
imAnavAlAle bhane– “he merA jAtibandhu ho! timIharUmAthi pani tyahI (prakopa) dina AulA ki bhanne malAI Dara lAgcha juna anya samudAyaharUmAthi Aeko thiyo |
nUhako samudAya, Ada, samUda tathA tinIharUpachikA anya samudAyaharUko jasto | ra, allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi kunai prakArako anyAya garna cAha~dainan |
ra, he merA jAtibandhu ho! ma timIharUkAlAgi eka arkolAI pukArne dinasa~ga tarsanchu |
juna dina timIharU piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgnechau | tara timIharUlAI allAhabATa bacAune kohI hune chaina | ra, allAha jasalAI pathabhraSTa pArchan usako kohI mArgadarzaka huna sakdaina |

ra, yasaaghi timIharUsamakSa yUsupha nizAnIharU liera AekA thie | tara timIharUle tyasa zaGkA garirahyau, juna unale liera AekA thie yahA~samma ki jaba unako mRtyu bhayo taba timIharUle bhanyau– “unIpazcAt aba allAhale kunai rasUla paThAune nai chainan | yasarI allAha tyasalAI pathabhraSTa garchan jo sImA ullaGghanakArI, zaGkAlu chan |

jo allAhakA AyataharUko sambandhamA tinIharUlAI prApta kunai pramANabinA nai tarkavitarka garchan | allAha ra AsthAvAnaharUko dRSTimA yo ati ghRNita kArya ho | yasarI allAha hareka ghamaNDI ra uddaNDa vyaktiko hRdayamA mohara lagAi dinchan |
ra, phiraaunale bhanyo– “he hAmAna! merolAgi euTA aglo bhavana nirmANa gara tAki ma mArgako cheuchAusamma pugna sakU~ |

AkAzako mArgasamma tAki mUsAkA IzvaralAI dekhU~ | ra, vAstavamA ma mUsAlAI ta jhuTho nai ThAndachu | ra, yasaprakAra phiraaunako dRSTimA uyasakA kukarmaharU sundara dekhAie | ra, U (satya) mArgabATa rokiyo ra phiraaunakA upAyaharU ta khera nai jAne thie |
ra, AsthAvAnale bhane– he merA jAti bandhuharU ho! timIharU mero anusaraNa gara | ma timIharUlAI sIdhAmArga dekhAunechu |
he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! yo sAMsArika jIvana kSaNika mojamasti mAtra ho | ra, Akhirata nai cirasthAyI ghara ho |

jasale duSkarma garcha tyasalAI tyati nai badalA diinecha jati usale duSkarma gareko huncha | ra, AsthAvAna raheko avasthAmA puruSa vA strI jo satkarma garchan tinIharU nai svargamA praveza garnechan jahA~ anagintI jIvikA pAunechan |
he merA jAtibandhu! yo kasto kurA ho ki ma timIharUlAI muktitarpha AhvAna garchu, tara timIharU malAI narakatarpha AhvAna garchau?

timIharU malAI allAhako inkAra garna ra unIsa~ga yasto cijalAI sAjhedAra banAuna AhvAna garchau jasako bAremA malAI jJAna nai chaina | ra, ma cAhi~ timIharUlAI prabhutvazAlI evaM parama kSamAzIla (allAha) tarpha bolAiraheko chu |

vAstavamA timI malAI jasatarpha bolAu~daichau usako ta kunai pukAra nai chaina, na saMsAramA ra na AkhiratamA nai | ra, nizcaya nai hAmI sabai allAhakahA~ nai pharkera jAnucha | ra, nissandeha sImA ullaGghanakArIharU nai narakabAsI hun |
maile bhaneko kurA timIharUle cADai nai samjhanechau ra ma Aphno mAmilA allAhalAI sumpanchu | nissandeha allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi dRSTi rAkhchan |
ani allAhale tinIharUle garekA upAyaharUko nikRSTatAbATa usalAI surakSita rAkhe ra phiraaunakA mAnisaharUlAI nikRSTa prakopale gheryo |
Ago– jahA~ tinIharUlAI bihAna ra belukA upasthita garAincha | ra, juna dina mahApralaya huncha (tyasa dina bhaninecha)– phiraaunakA mAnisaharUlAI kaThora yAtanAmA hAla!”

ra, jaba tinIharU narakamA ApasamA jhagaDA garnechan taba durbala (anuyAyI) harUle AphnA aguvAharUlAI bhannechan– “vastutaH hAmI timIharUkA anuyAyI thiyauM | ra, ke timIharU narakako yAtanAko kehI aMza hAmIbATa haTAuna sakchau?
ThulAbaDA banneharUle bhannechan– “hAmI sabai yasai (yAtanA) mA rahanechauM | allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUbIca nirNaya garisakekA chan |”
ra, sabai narakabAsIharU milera narakakA saMrakSakaharUlAI bhannechan–“timI nai AphnA pAlanakartAsita prArthanA gara ki unale hAmrolAgi yAtanAlAI eka dina kama garidiUn |”

unIharUle sodhnechan– “ke timIharUsamakSa timrA rasUlaharU camatkAra liera AekA thienan ra?” tinIharUle bhannechan– “ho, AekA thie |” unIharUle bhannechan– “tyaso bhae timIharU svayaM prArthanA gara |” ra, kAphiraharUko prArthanA ta vyartha nai huncha |
nissandeha hAmI AphnA rasUlaharU ra AsthAvAnaharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanamA pani sahayoga garchauM, ra tyasadina pani jaba sAkSIharU ubhinechan |
tyasadina atyAcArIharUlAI tinIharUkA kunai pani kSamAyAcanAle lAbha puryAune chaina | ra, tinIharUkA lAgi dhikkAra cha ra nikRSTa bAsasthAna |
ra, hAmIle mUsAlAI mArgadarzana pradAna garyauM ani isarAIlakA santAnaharUlAI tyasa granthako uttarAdhikArI banAyauM |
juna buddhimAnharUkAlAgi mArgadarzana evaM upadeza thiyo |
ataH (he nabI sa.!) dhairya dhAraNa gara; allAhako vAcA nizcaya nai satya ho | ra, Aphno pApakolAgi kSamAyAcanA gara | ra, bihAna belukA AphnA pAlanakartAko prazaMsAkAsAtha mahimAgAna gara |

juna vyaktiharU allAhakA AyataharUkA bAremA unIharUsamakSa Aeko pramANa binA nai tarka–vitarka garchan, tinIharUko hRdayamA mAtra ahaMkAra cha jahA~ samma tinIharU kahilyai pugna sakdainan | ataH timI allAhako zaraNa yAcanA gara | nissandeha unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvadraSTA chan |
AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko sRjanA nizcaya nai mAnava jAtiko sRjanAbhandA ThUlo kArya ho tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU bujhdainan |
ra, andhA tathA dRSTivAna samAna huna sakdainan, ra na ImAna lyAera satkarma garhaneharU duSkarmIharU saraha huna saknechan | timIharU ati kama upadeza grahaNa garne garchau |
mahApralaya avazya nai AunevAlA cha | yasamA kunai sandeha chaina | tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU vizvAsa gardainan |

ra, timrA pAlanakartAle bhanekA chan– “timIharU malAI pukAra, ma timIharUko pukAra sunchu | tara juna mAnisaharU ghamaNDale gardA mero upAsanA gardainan, tinIharU avazya apamAnita bhaI narakamA jAnechan |

allAha nai hun jasale timIharUkAlAgi rAta banAe tAki timIharU vizrAma gara ra dinalAI ujyAlo banAe (tAki kAma gara) | nissandeha allAha mAnisaharUmAthi kRpAvAna chan tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU cAhi~ kRtajJa chainan |
unai allAha timIharUkA pAlanakartA pratyeka vastukA sRSTikartA hun | unIbAheka kohI upAsya chaina | ani timIharU katA bahakAi~dai chau?
allAhakA AyataharUlAI asvIkAra garneharU yasarI nai bhaDkirahanchan |

allAha nai hun jasale pRthvIlAI timIharUkAlAgi bAssthAna banAe, ra AkAzalAI chAnA ra timIharUlAI rUpa die | ani unale timIharUko rUpalAI ati sundara banAe ani timIharUlAI pavitra AjIvikA pradAna gare | unai allAha timIharUkA pAlanakartA hun | ani sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartA allAha ati nai barakatayukta chan |
unI ajara chan | unI bAheka aru kohI pUjya chaina | ataH timI AjJApAlanalAI unaikAlAgi viziSTa garI unailAI pukAra | sArA prazaMsA sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartA allAhakainimti hun |

bhanideU– “allAhalAI choDI jasalAI timIharU pukArne garchau, malAI unIharUko upAsanA garna manAhI garieko cha, jabakI rabako tarphabATa masamakSa prasTa pramANaharU AisakekA chan | malAI ta sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartAprati pUrNa samarpita hune Adeza prApta bhaeko cha |

unai hun timIharUlAI mATobATa sRjanA gare, pheri vIryabATa, pheri ragatako DhikkAbATa | pheri unai timIharUlAI zizuko rUpamA bAhira nikAlchan | (ani timIharUlAI hurkAu~chan) tAki timIharU yuvAvasthAsamma puga, pheri vRddhAvasthAsamma puga ra timIharUmadhye kasailAI tyasaaghi nai mRtyu diincha ra kasailAI (avasara diincha) tAki timIharU nirdhArita avadhisamma puga, zAyada timIharU buddhile kAma linechau |
unai hun jasale timIharUlAI jIvana ra mRtyu dinchan | unale kunai kAryako nirNaya gardA yati mAtra bhanchan– “bhaihAla!” ra, tyo bhaihAlcha |
ke timIle allAhakA AyataharUbAre jhagaDA garneharUlAI dekhenauM? tinIharUlAI katAtira bahakAincha?
jasale Izagrantha tathA hAmIle AphnA rasUlaharUlAI diera paThAekA kurAharUlAI asatya Thahara gare, yinIharUle zIghra nai (vAstavikatA) jAnnechan |
jaba yinIharUkA gardhanamA nela tathA ( hAta khuTTAharumA) jaJjIraharU hunechan | yinIharU ghisArinechan |
umla~do pAnImA ra pheri narakako AgomA jalAinechan |
pheri yinIharUlAI sodhinecha– “kahA~ chan tinIharU, jasalAI timIharU sAjhedAra ThaharAune garthyo |
allAhabAheka?” tinIharUle bhannechan– “tinIharU hAmIbATa harAe | baru hAmIle yasabhandA pahile kasailAI pukArekai thienauM | allAha kAphiraharUlAI yasarI nai pathabhraSTa pArchan |
yo badalA ho tyasako ki timIharU dhartImA vinA haka praphullita hunthyau ra ghamaNDa garthyo |
aba narakakA DhokAharUbATa pasa tyasamA sadaiva rahanakAlAgi | kati nikRSTa rahecha ghamaNDIharUko bAsasthAna!

ataH (he muhammada sa.!) timI dhairya dhAraNa gara | nissandeha allAhako vAcA satya ho | cAhe tinIharUlAI hAmIle dieko vacanako kehI aMza timIlAI dekhAau~ vA timIlAI mRtyu pradAna garau~ | Akhira tinIharU hAmItarpha nai pharkera Aunucha |

ra, timIbhandA pahile hAmIle rasUlaharU paThAyauM | unIharUmadhye kehIkA vRttAnta timIlAI batAekA chauM ra kehIko vRttAnta timIlAI batAekA chainauM | ra, allAhako AjJAbinA kunai pani rasUladvArA kunai nizAnI prastuta garnu sambhava thiena | ani jaba allAhako Adeza Au~ne cha taba nyAyocita nirNaya garinecha ra tyatikhera mithyAvAdIharU ghATAmA hunechan |
allAha nai hun jasale timIharUkAlAgi janAvaraharU sRSTi gare, jasamadhye kehImAthi timIharU savArI garchau ra kehIlAI khAnchau |

ra, tyasamA timIharUkAlAgi anekauM phAidAharU pani chan | ra yasa uddezyale pradAna gare ki tyasamAthi savAra bhaera AphUle cAheko gantabsayamma pugna saka ra timIharU tinIharUmAthi ra DuGgAharUmAthi pani savAra hunchau |
allAha timIharUlAI AphnA nizAnIharU dekhAu~chan | ani timIharU allAhakA kuna kuna nizAnIlAI nakArirahanchau ta?

ke tinIharU dhartImA ghumaphira garenan, tAki herUn kasto pariNAma bhayo tinIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUko, jabaki tI samudAyaharU saMkhyAmA yinIbhandA baDhI thie ra zaktiko hisAbale pani ra dhartImA choDne smRtikA cinhaharUko dRSTile pani? tara, tinIharUko kamAile tinIharUlAI kunai phAidA puryAena |

ani jaba tinIharUsamakSa tinakA rasUlaharU khullA pramANaharUkAsAtha Ae, taba tinIharUle AphUlAI prApta jJAnaprati ahaGkAra gare | antataH juna cijako tinIharU khillI uDAu~dathe tyasaile tinIharUlAI gheryo |
pheri jaba tinIharUle hAmro prakopa dekhe taba bhane– “hAmIle eka allAhamAthi ImAna lyAyauM ra juna juna cijalAI hAmI sAjhedAra ThaharyAu~thyauM, tinIharUlAI asvIkAra garyauM |”

tara hAmro prakopa dekhepachi lyAeko ImAnale tinIharUlAI kehI phAidA puryAune thie | yo allAhako sunnata (vidhAna) ho juna nirantara unakA bhaktaharUmA jArI raha~dai Aeko cha | ra, tyatikhera kAphiraharUle ghATA behore |
hA0 mIm0 |
yo atyanta karUNAmaya parama dayAlu (allAha) ko tarphabATa avatarita ho |
yasto grantha jasakA AyataharUko vistRta varNana arabI kuraAnako rUpamA tinIharUkAnimti garieko cha jo jJAna Arjana garna cAhanchan |
zubhasUcaka evaM sacetaka ( graMthana ) ko rUpamA, tara tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU vimukha bhaekA chan ataH tinIharU sundainan |

tinIharU bhanchan– “hAmrA hRdayaharU pardAmA (surakSita) chan tyasa kurAkolAgi junatarpha timIharU hAmIlAI bolAirahekA chau, ra hAmro kAnamA bujo cha | ani hAmI ra timIharUbIca pardA rahekocha | tasartha timI Aphno kArya gardai jAU; hAmI Aphno kArya gardai jAnchauM |

bhanideU– “ma pani timIharUjastai mAnche hu~ | matarpha vahya garincha ki timIharUkA pUjya eka mAtra allAha hun | ataH timIharU unaitarpha ekAgra hoU, ra unaisita kSamAyAcanA gara | ra baravAdI cha tI bahudevavAdIharUko |
jo jakAta diMdainan ra AkhiratalAI inkAra garchan |
nissandeha jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare unIharUkAlAgi kahilyai narokine pratidAna rahekocha |
bhanideU– “ke timIharU unalAI nakArchau jasale duI dinamai pRthvI sRSTi gare, tara pani timIharU anya vastuharUlAI unako samakakSI Thahara gardachau, jabaki sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartA unI nai hun |

ra, unaile pRthvImA tyasako mAthibATa pahADaharU gADidie, ani tyasalAI khubai barakatayukta banAidie | ani pratyekako mAga anusAra ThIka anumAnale khAdyAnna juTAidie | yI sabai kAma cAra dinamai pUrA bhayo |

pheri unI AkAzatira pharke, jaba tyo dhuvA~ thiyo | ani allAhale AkAza tathA pRthvIlAI bhane– “timIharU duvai rAjIkhuzI vA vivazatApUrNa ( astitvamA ) Au |” duvaile bhane– “hAmI rAjIkhuzI hAjira chauM |”

tyasapachi duI dinamA unIharUlAI sAtavaTA AkAzaharU banAidie ra pratyeka AkAzamA tyasako Adeza jArI gare | ra, hAmIle nikaTavartI AkAzalAI tArAharUdvArA sajAyauM ra pUrNa rUpamA ( AkAzaharUlAI ) surakSita pAryauM | yo prabhutvazAlI evaM sarvajJa (allAha) ko pariyojanA ho |
yadi ahile pani yinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane bhanideU– “ma timIharUlAI Ada evaM samUda samudAyamAthi pareko vajrapAtajastai parnasakne vajrapAtabATa saceta garchu |”

jaba rasUlaharU tinIharUkahA~ tinakA agADibATa ra tinakA pachADibATa (yo bhandai) Ae ki timIharU kevala eka allAhako upAsanA gara, taba tinIharUle bhane– “yadi hAmrA pAlanakartAle cAheko bhae unale phariztAharUlAI avataraNa garne thie | ataH juna sandezakAsAtha timIharUlAI paThAieko cha, hAmI tyasalAI mAndainauM |

ani Ada samudAyakA mAnisaharUle dhartImA anAhaka ghamaNDa gare ra bhane– “hAmIbhandA baDhI zaktizAlI ko cha?” ke tinIharUle dekhenan ki allAha jasale tinIharUlAI sRSTi gare tinIharUbhandA unI baDhI zaktizAlI chan? tara tinIharUle hAmrA AyataharUlAI inkAra garirahe |

antataH hAmIle tinIharUmAthi azubha dinaharUmA bhayaGkara A~dhI calAyauM tAki tinIharUlAI sAMsArika jIvanamai apamAnajanaka daNDako svAda cakhAauM ra Akhiratako yAtanA jhanai apamAnajanaka hunecha ra tinIharUlAI kunai sahayoga garine chaina |

jahA~samma samUdako kurA cha–hAmIle tinIharUlAI mArgadarzana garyauM, tara tinIharUle mArgadarzanakosATo andhopanalAI nai manaparAe, jasako pariNAmasvarUpa tinIharUko kukarmale gardA tinIharUlAI apamAnajanaka prakopako garjanale samAtyo |
tara AsthAvAna evaM IzaparAyaNaharUlAI hAmIle surakSita rAkhyauM |
ra, juna dina allAhakA zatruharUlAI narakatarpha DoryAinecha, tyo dina tiniharu sabailAI samUhamA paMktibaddha gari laginecha |
yahA~samma ki jaba tinIharU narakamA pugnechan taba tinIharUviruddha tinakA kAna, A~khA ra chAlAle tinIharUkA karmaharUko gavAhI dinechan |

tinIharUle Aphno chAlAlAI sodhnechan– “timIharUle hAmIviruddha kina sAkSI diyau?” tinIharUle uttara dinechan– “hAmIlAI unai allAhale bolne zakti pradAna gare jasale hareka cijalAI bolne zakti pradAna gare | unaile timIharUlAI pahilo paTaka sRSTi garekA chan ra timIharU sabai unaitarpha pharkera jAnucha |

ra, timIharUkA kAna, A~khA, chAlAle timIharUvirUddha sAkSI dinechan bhanI socera timIharU luknasakne thienauM | baru timIharUle yo ThAnekA thiyau ki timIharUle garne garekA dherai kAryaharUsa~ga allAha avagata nai chainan |
timIharUle AphnA pAlanakartAko sambandhamA gareko yahI kudhAraNAle timIharUlAI naSTa pAryo ra antataH timIharU ghATA behorneharUmA sAmela huna pugyau |
aba yinIharUle dhairya dhAraNa gare pani Ago nai yinIharUko ThegAnA hunecha ra, tinIharUle kSamAyAcanA gare bhane pani kSamA garinechaina |

ra, hAmIle tinIharUkA lAgi yastA sAthIharUlAI tainAtha garyauM jasale tinIharUlAI unIharukA aghillA ra pachillA karmaharUlAI tinIharuko dRSTimA sundara tulyAera dekhAe | antataH tinIharUkA viSayamA pani tyahI kurA pUrA bhayo juna tinIharUbhandA pahile bitekA jinna tathA manuSyako samUhaharUko sambandhamA pUrA bhaeko thiyo | nissandeha tinIharU ghATA behorneharU thie |
ra, kAphiraharUle bhane– “yo kuraAna nasuna; baru kolAhala maccAU, tAki timIharUko bolavAlA rahos |
jasale asvIkAra gare hAmI tinIharUlAI avazya nai kaThora yAtanA cakhAunechauM ra tinIharUlAI tyasa kukarmako badalA avazya nai dinechauM juna tinIharUle garne garthe |
yo, allAhakA zatruharUko badalA naraka ho; hAmrA AyataharUlAI nakArnuko sajAya~ svarUpa, tyahI tinIharUkAlAgi sadAko bAsasthAna hunecha |

ra, kAphiraharUle bhannechan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! jinna tathA mAnavamadhye tinIharUlAI dekhAU jasale hAmIlAI pathabhraSTa garekA thie | hAmI tinIharUlAI paiMtAlAmuni kulcanechauM, tAki tI duvai atyanta apamAnita hoUn |

vAstavamA juna vyaktiharUle bhane– “hAmrA pAlanakartA allAha hun” ani tyasaimA kAyama rahe | unIharUkAlAgi phariztAharU yo bhandai avatarita hunechan– “timIharU naDarAU; duHkhI pani nahoU, baru tyasa svargamA ramAU jasako vAcA timIharUsita garinthyo |”
hAmI sAMsArika jIvanakA pani timIharUkA sahayogI mitra hauM ra AkhiratamA pani | tyahA~ timIharUkAlAgi sabai thoka cha, jeje timIharU mana parAu~chau ra jeje timIharU mAgnechau |
atyanta kSamAzIla, parama dayAlu (allAha) ko tarphabATa, AtithyasvarUpa |
ra, tyasa vyaktibhandA uttama kurA kasako huna sakcha jasale (mAnisaharulAI) allAhatarpha bolAu~cha; satkarma garcha ra bhancha– “ma nizcaya nai AjJAkArI (muslima) harUmadhyeko hu~ |

ra, rAmro tathA narAmro samAna huna sakdainan | ataH (he nabI sa.!) narAmrolAI rAmro dvArA panchAU | ani timIle AphUsita zatrutA raheko vyaktilAI svasphUrta rUpamA Aphno ghaniSTa mitra baneko dekhnechau |
yo saubhAgya kevala dhairyavAnaharUlAI prApta hunecha ra yo saubhAgyazAlI vyaktibAheka arU kasailAI prApta huna sakdaina |
ra, zaitAnako tarphabATa kunai uksAhaTa AemA allAhako zaraNa mAga | nissandeha unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |

ani rAta, ra dina tathA sUrya, candra unakai nizAnIharUmadhye hun | timIharU na sUryalAI Dhoga na candramAlAI nai | baru unai allAhalAI Dhoga jasale tI sabaiko sRSTi gare | yadi timIharUle unakai bhakti garnucha bhane |
pheri pani yinIharU ghamaNDa garchan bhane ( yinIharUle thAhA hunuparcha ki ) jo timrA pAlanakartAkahA~ chan, tinIharU rAta dina unako mahimAgAna garirahekA chan ra kahilyai nIrasa hu~dainan |

ra, yo pani allAhakA nizAnIharUmadhye ho ki timI bhUmilAI nirjIva jasto dekhchau, ani jaba hAmI tyasamAthi pAnI barsAu~chauM taba tyo jIvita tathA urbara huncha | nizcaya nai jasale tyasalAI jIvita pAre, unaile mRtaharulAI pani jIvita pArnechan | nissandeha unI hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

nizcaya nai juna mAnisaharU hAmrA AyataharUko galata artha lagAu~chan tinIharU hAmIbATa lukne chainan | ke juna mAnisaharU AgomA hominechan, tinIharU uttama chan vA tI vyaktiharU jo mahApralayako dina nizcinta avasthAmA Aunechan? timIharU Aphno cAhanA anusAra gara | nizcaya nai timIharUkA sampUrNa kAryaharUlAI unale dekhirahekA chan |
juna vyaktiharUle kuraAnako AgamanapazcAt tyasalAI inkAra gare jabaki yo sammAnajanaka grantha ho |
asatya yasako najika Aunai sakdaina, na sAmunnebATa na yasako pachiltirabATa nai | yo ta tatvadarzI evaM prazaMsanIya allAhako tarphabATa avatarita ho |

(he muhammada sa.!) juna kurA timIbhandA pahilekA rasUlaharUlAI bhanieko thiyo tyahI kurA timIlAI pani bhaniMdaicha | nizcaya nai timrA pAlanakartA kSamAzIla hunukA sAthai kaThora daNDadAtA pani hun |

ra, hAmIle yasa kuraAnalAI gaira arabI bhASAmA avatarita gareko bhae yinIharUle nizcaya nai bhanne thie ki “yasakA AyataharUlAI kina spaSTa rUpamA bayAna gariena? ke grantha gaira arabI (ajmI) ra rasUla cAhi~ arabI?” bhanideU– “yo AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi mArgadarzana evaM upacAra ho | tara jo ImAna lyAu~dainan tinIharUkA kAnamA bujo lAgeko cha, ra yo (kuraAna) tinIharukAlAgi andhopana ( ko kAraNa ) ho | ( mAnauM ) yinIharulAI DhAko sthAnabATa bolAIMdaicha |

nizcaya nai hAmIle mUsAlAI grantha pradAna garyauM, tara tyasamA matabheda utpanna gariyo | ra, timro pAlanakartAko tarphabATa euTA kurA pahile nai nirdhArita nagarieko bhae tinIharUbIca nirNaya bhaisakeko hunthyo | ra, yinIharU tyasako sambandhamA becaina tulyAune sandehamA chan |
jasale satkarma garcha Aphnai phAidAkolAgi garcha ra jasale kukarma garcha, tyasako duSpariNAma usaimAthi Aunecha | ra, timrA pAlanakartA bhaktaharUmAthi katti pani atyAcAra gardainan |

mahApralayako jJAna unai tarpha pharkAincha | ra, gAbhAharUbATa juna phalaharU niskanchan vA kunai AmA juna (zizu) garbhadhAraNa garche, vA jasalAI janma dinche, allAhalAI tI sabaiko jJAna cha | ra, juna dina unale pukArera tinIharUlAI sodhnechan– “kahA~ chan merA sAjhedAraharU?” tinIharUle javApha dinechan– “hAmIle ta prasTa rUpamA bhanisakekA chauM– “hAmImadhye kohI tyasa kurAko sAkSI chainauM |”
ani, yinIharUle pahile pukArne garekA sampUrNa cijaharU yinIharUbATa gumne chan, ratyasabelA yinIharUkAnimti kunai bacAvako maukA rahane chaina bhanne kurAbAre yinIharu vizvasta hunechan |
mAnisa rAmro kurAko prAptikAlAgi garne prArthanAbATa nIrasa hu~daina, tara usamAthi kunai saGkaTa AilAgemA nirAza huncha ra hatAza huncha |

tara usale pAeko duHkhapachi jaba hAmI usalAI karUNAko svAda cakhAu~chauM taba tyasale bhancha– “yo mero adhikAra ho, ra mero vicAramA mahApralaya Aune chaina | ra, malAI Aphno pAlanakartAtarpha pharkAiemA pani unIkahA~ mero lAgi rAmrai hunecha | nissandeha hAmIle yastA kAphiraharUlAI tinIharukA kukarmaharUbAre avagata garAunechauM | ra, tinIharUlAI kaThora yAtanAko svAda cakhAunechauM |
ra, jaba hAmI mAnavamAthi kRpA garchauM taba U bimukha huncha ra Aphutira panchana thAlcha, ra jaba usamAthi saGkaTa AilAgcha taba U lAmo–lAmo prArthanA garna thAlcha |

bhanideU– “vicAra gara yadi yo (kuraAna) allAhako tarphabATa ho, ra timIharUle yasalAI asvIkAra garyau bhane, tyasabhandA baDhI pathabhraSTa arU ko huna sakcha jo virodhako parAkASThasamma pugeko cha?”

hAmI cA~Dai nai tinIharUlAI (jagatkA) kSitijaharumA ra tinIharU svayaMbhitra pani AphnA nizAnIharU dekhAunechauM yahA~samma ki yo (kuraAna) nitAnta satya ho bhanne kurA tinIharUsamakSa spaSTa hunecha | ra ke timrA pAlanakartA pratyeka cijasita avagata cha bhanne kurA paryApta chaina?
jAnirAkha! yinIharU nizcaya nai AphnA pAlanakartAsa~ga sAkSAtkAra hune kurAmA sandehamA chan | suna! niHsandeha allAhale pratyeka cijalAI Aphno paridhimA liekA chan |
hA0 mIm0 |
ain0 sIn0 kAph0 |
prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI allAhale yasarI nai timItarpha ra timIbhandA pahilekA (nabIharU) tarpha vahya paThAu~dai AekA chan |
AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sabai cijaharU unaikA hun ra unI ucca evaM mahAn chan |

mAthibATa AkAzaharU cirA parI jharna A~TekA chan, ra phariztAharU AphnA pAlanakartAko prazaMsAkAsAtha mahimAgAna garirahekA chan, ra dhartIbAsIkAlAgi kSamAyAcanA garirahekA chan | suna, allAha nai atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ra, juna mAnisaharUle allAhabAheka anya saMrakSaka–mitra banAekA chan, allAha po tinIharUkA nirIkSaka hun, ra timI tinIharUkA jimmevAra hoinau |

ra, yasarI hAmIle timItarpha arabI kuraAnako prakAzanA garekA chauM tAki timI makkAbAsIharUlAI ra tyasakA cheuchAukA bAsindAharUlAI saceta gara | ra, tinIharUlAI bhelA hune (mahApralayako) dinabAre saceta gara jasamA kunai sandeha chaina | euTA samUha svargamA hunecha bhane arko samUha dankado AgomA |

ra allAhale cAhekA bhae tinIharU sabailAI euTai ummata ( samUha ) banAune thie, tara unI jasalAI cAhanchan Aphno kRpAmA samAveza garchan | ra, atyAcArIharUko na kohI saMrakSaka–mitra cha, na kohI sahayogI nai |
ke tinIharUle allAhabAhekalAI saMrakSaka–mitra banAekA chan? saMrakSaka–mitra allAha mAtra hun, ra unI nai murdAharUlAI jIvita pArchan | ra, unI hareka kurAko sAmarthya rAkhchan |

ra, timIharU juna kurAmA pani matabheda garirahekA chau tyasako nirNaya allAhako hAtamA cha | yinai allAha merA pAlanakartA hun | unaimAthi maile bharosA gareko chu, ra unaitarpha ma pharkane gardachu |

AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sRSTikartA unai hun | unaile timrolAgi timIharUbATai joDIharU banAe, ra pazuharUkAlAgi pani joDIharU banAe, ra yasarI timIharUko saMkhyA vRddhi garirahekA chan | allAhajasto arU kohI chaina ra unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvadraSTA chan |

AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sA~cAharU unakai hAtamA chan | unI jasakolAgi cAhanchana jIvikA vistRta garidinchan, ra jasakolAgi cAhanchan simita garidinchan | nissandeha unalAI pratyeka kurAko jJAna cha |

allAhale timIharUkAlAgi tyahI dharma nirdhArita garekA chan jasako Adeza unale nUhalAI diekA thie | ani, jasako prakAzanA (he muhammada sa.!) hAmIle timItarpha garekA chauM, ra jasako Adeza hAmIle ibrAhIma, mUsA tathA IsAlAI diekA thiyauM ki dharmalAI sthApita gara ra yasamA matabheda nagara | (he muhammada sa.! ) bahudevavAdIharUlAI tyo kurA ati kaThina cha junatarpha tinIharUlAI AhvAna garchau | allAha jasalAI cAhanchan svayaMkAnimti cayana garchan, ra jo unItarpha pharkancha usalAI unI mArgadarzana garchan |

ra, tinIharUle AphUsamakSa jJAnako AgamanapazcAt ApasI dveSabhAvako kAraNale nai matabheda gare | ra, yadi euTA nirdhArita samayasammakA nimti timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa euTA kurA nizcita nabhaeko bhae tinIharUkA bIcamA nizcaya nai nirNaya bhaisakne thiyo | ra, tinIharUpachi jasalAI granthako uttarAdhikArI banAiyo tinIharU pani tyasaprati vyAkula tulyAune sandehamA nai thie |

tasartha (he nabI sa.!) yasai dharmatarpha nimantraNA deU, ) ra timIlAI diieko AdezAnusAra dRDhatAsAtha sthira rahu, ra yinIharUkA icchAharUko anupAlana nagara, ra bhanideU– “allAhale avataraNa gareko granthamAthi ImAna lyAe~ | ra malAI timIharUbIca nisApha garne Adeza bhaeko cha | allAha nai hAmrA pAlanakartA hun ra timIharUkA pani | hAmrolAgi hAmrA karmaharU chan ra timIharUkAlAgi timrA karmaharU; hAmI tathA timIharUbIca aba kunai tarka vitarka chaina | allAhale ekadina hAmI sabailAI bhelA garnechan ra unaitarpha sabaile jAnuparnecha |

ra juna mAnisaharU allAhako (dharmako) mAmalAmA tarka vitarka garchan, jaba ki unako kurA mAnieko cha | tI mAnisaharUko tarka vitarka allAhako dRSTimA anartha cha ra tinIharUmAthi allAhako prakopa raheko cha | ra tinIharUkAlAgi kaThora yAtanA cha |
allAha nai hun jasale grantha tathA (nisAphako) ‘mIjAna’ (tarAju) lAI avatarita gare | ra, timIlAI ke thAhA katai nirNayako ghaDI najika Aipugeko cha ki?

mahApralayamAthi AsthA narAkhneharU nai yasakolAgi hatAra garchan, tara tyasamAthi AsthA rAkhneharU tyasabATa DarAu~chan, ra tyo satya ho bhanera jAndachan pani| suna, juna mAnisaharU mahApralayabAre tarka–vitarka garchan tinIharU pathabhraSTatAmA dherai TADhAsamma pugekA chan |
allAha AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi atyanta kRpAvAna chan, jasalAI cAhanchana jivikA pradAna garchan ra unI parama zaktizAlI tathA prabhutvazAlI chan |

jo Akhirata (mahApralaya) ko khetI cAhancha usako khetImA hAmI vRddhi garchauM ani jo sAMsArika khetI cAhancha tyasalAI hAmI kevala saMsAramadhyebATa dinchauM, ra AkhiratamA usakolAgi kunai aMza hunechaina |

ke yinIharUsa~ga (allAhakA) kehI yastA sAjhedAraharU chan jasale yinIharUkAlAgi yasto dharma nirdhArita garekA chan jasako anumati allAhale diekA chainan? yadi nirNayako kurA pahile nai nizcita nabhaeko bhae yinIharUko mAmilAko nirNaya ahile nai garine thiyo | ra, atyAcArIharUkAlAgi nizcaya nai pIDAdAyaka yAtanA raheko cha |

atyAcArI mAnisaharUlAI tinIharUkA Aphnai kriyAkalApale gardA bhayabhIta bhaeko dekhnechau, jabaki tyo tinIharUmAthi Aune nai cha | ani, jo vyaktiharUle ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare unIharU svargakA bagaiMcAharUmA hunechan | unIharUkAlAgi unakA pAlanakartAkahA~ tI sabai cijaharU hunechan, jo unIharU mana parAu~chan | tyahI mahAna varadAna ho |

yahI tyo cija ho jasako zubha–sUcanA allAha AphnA yastA bhaktaharUlAI dinchan jasale ImAna lyAekA chan ra satkarma garekA chan | (he nabI sa.!) yinIharUlAI bhana– “ma yasakolAgi ma timIharUsita kunai pratidAna mAgdina, tara sAmIpyatAko prema–bhAva avazya cAhanchu |” jasale bhalAi garcha, hAmI tyasakolAgi tyasamA bhalAi nai vRddhi garchauM | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla ra guNagrAhI chan |

ke rasUlale allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa gareko ho bhanera yinIharU bhanchan? yadi allAhale cAhemA timro hRdayamA mohara lagAuna sakchan ra allAhale asatyalAI meTAu~na sakchan, ra Aphno AdezaharUdvArA nitAnta satyako sthApanA garna sakchan | nissandeha unI ta hRdayamA lukekA rahasyaharUkA pani jJAtA hun |
ra, unai hun jo AphnA bhaktaharUko taubA (prAyazcita) svIkAra garchan; duSkarmalAI mApha garchan ra timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUbAre jAndachan |
unI ImAna lyAune tathA satkarma garneharUko prArthanA svIkAra gardachan, ra AphnA anugrahabATa thapa pradAna gardachan, tara kAphiraharUkAlAgi kaThora yAtanA raheko cha |

ra, yadi allAhale AphnA bhaktaharUkAlAgi asIma jIvikA pradAna gareko bhae tinIharUle dhartImA vidroha nai garne thie | tara unI Aphule cAheko saMtulita mAtrAmA avatarita garchan | nissandeha unI AphnA bhaktaharUko avasthAsa~ga pUrNa avagata ra sarvadraSTA chan |
unai hun jo mAnisaharU nirAza bhaepachi pAnI barsAu~chan ra Aphno dayAlAI phailAu~chan, ani unI saMrakSaka tathA svayaM prazaMsanIya hun |
ra, AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaikA bIcamA phailAiekA sajIvaharU unaikA nizAnIharU hun, ra unI jahile cAhanchan tI sabailAI ekatRta garna sakSama chan |
ra, timIharUmAthi juna saGkaTa Au~cha tyo timIharUko Aphnai hAtako kamAiko kAraNale Au~cha | ra, katipaya kurAharUlAI unI mApha pani garidinchan |
ani, timIharUle dhartImA (allAhalAI) vivaza pArna sakdainau ra allAhako dA~jomA timIharUko kunai saMrakSaka–mitra tathA sahayogI pani chaina |
ra, yI jahAjaharU juna samudramA pahADajastA dekhinchan unaikA nizAnIharUmadhye hun |

allAhale cAhemA jahile pani hAvAlAI sthira pArna sakchan, phalasvarUpa tI (jahAjaharU) samudramA sthira huna pugnechan | nissandeha yasamA pratyeka saMyamI tathA kRtajJa vyaktikAlAgi nizAnIharU chan |
vA tinIharUko kamAiko kAraNale tinIharUlAI vinAza garna sakchan, ra dherai (pApIharU) lAI kSamA pani garna sakchan |
ra phalasvarUpa hAmrA AyataharUbAre vivAda garneharUle tinIharUkAlAgi kunai Azrayasthala chaina bhanne kurA jAnUn |

ani, timIharUlAI jejati pradAna garieko cha tI sabai yasa sAMsArika jIvanakA asthAyI sAdhanaharU mAtra hun | ra, jejati allAhakahA~ chan tI cijaharU uttama chan, ani cirasthAyI pani, tinIharUkAlAgi jasale ImAna lyAekA chan ra AphnA pAlanakartAmAthi bharosA garchan |
jo ThUlA pApaharU ra azlIlatAbATa joginchan ra krodhita bhaeko khaNDamA mApha garchan |
ra, jo AphnA pAlanakartAko AjJAkArI chan, ra namAja kAyama garchan ra AphnA mAmalAharU ApasI sallAhadvArA calAune garchan ra hAmIle jejati jIvikA pradAna garekA chauM tyasabATa kharca garchan |
ra, jo AphUmAthi anyAya bhaeko khaNDamA tyasako pratizodha linchan |
AghAtako badalA tyo barAbarakai AghAta hunuparcha tara jasale kSamA garcha ra melamilApa garcha usako pratidAna allAhako jimmAmA cha | allAha atyAcArIharUlAI mana parAu~dainan |
ra, jasale AphUmAthi atyAcAra bhaepachi tyasako badalA linchan, unIharUmAthi kunai doSa lAgne chaina |
doSa tI mAnisaharUkA hun jasale mAnisaharUmAthi atyAcAra garchan, ra dhartImA anAhakamA jyAdatI garchan | yastA mAnisaharUkAlAgi kaThora yAtanA rahekocha |
tara jasale dhairyadhAraNa garcha ra kSamA garcha nissandeha (usakolAgi) yo sAhasIpUrNa kAma ho|

ra, jasalAI allAha pathabhraSTa pArchan allAhavAheka usako kohI saMrakSaka mitra hunechaina | ra, jaba atyAcArIharUle prakopa dekhnechan taba timIle tinIharUlAI yasto bhandai gareko pAunechau–“ke kunai pharkine mArga raheko cha?”

ra, timI dekhnechau– tinIharU narakasAmunne yasarI upasthita garinechan ki apamAnakA kAraNa ghopTirahekA, gupta A~khAle herirahekA hunechan | ra, ImAna lyAekA vyaktiharUle bhannechan– “vAstavika ghATAgrasta tinIharU hun jasale Aja mahApralayako dina svayaMlAI ra AphnA mAnisaharulAI ghATAmA pAre | smaraNa rahos, atyAcArI mAnisaharU avazya nai sthAyI yAtanAmA rahanechan |
ra, tinIharUkA saMrakSaka–mitraharUmadhye kasaile pani allAhako mukAbilAmA tinIharUlAI sahAyatA garna sakdaina | ra, jasalAI allAha pathabhraSTa pArchan usakolAgi kunai mArga chaina |

AphnA pAlanakartAko AhvAnalAI tyasa dinako Agamanaaghi nai svIkAra gara, jasalAI allAhakotarphabATa TArine chaina| timIharUlAI tyasa dina na kunai Azrayasthala prApta hunecha na timIharU kunai kurAlAI nakArna nai saknechau |

aba yadi yinIharU vimukha hunchan bhane (he nabI sa.!) hAmIle timIlAI yinIharUmAthi saMrakSaka banAera paThAekA chainauM | timro jimmevArI sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho | ra, mAnisalAI jaba hAmI Aphno dayAko svAda cakhAu~chauM taba U ati praphullita huncha, ani jaba usalAI usako Aphno kukarmako kAraNale kunai AghAta pugcha taba tyahI mAnche kRtaghna hunapugcha |
AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko rAjyasattA allAhakai hAtamA cha | unI je cAhanchan sRSTi garchan | unI jasalAI cAhanchan chorIharU pradAna garchan, ra jasalAI cAhanchan chorAharU pradAna gardachan |
ra, unI jasalAI cAhanchan chorA tathA chorI duvai pradAna garchan, ani jasalAI cAhanchan bA~jho banAidinchan| nizcaya nai unI sarvajJa, sAmarvAthyavAna chan |

kunai mAnisalAI saMbhava chaina ki allAhale usita pratyakSa kurA garun| unI yA ta vahaya ( prakAzanA ) dvArA yA pardA pachADibATa yA kunai phariztA paThAera kurA garchan | ani phariztA allAhako AjJAle, je unI cAhanchan, prakAzanA garchan | nissandeha unI ati ucca evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, yasarI nai hAmIle timItarpha Aphno AdezabATa ‘rUha’ (kuraAna) lAI avatIrNa garyauM | timIlAI grantha ke ho ra ImAna kelAI bhanincha bhanne kurA thAhA thiena | tara hAmIle tyasalAI euTA jyoti banAyauM | tyasadvArA hAmI AphnA bhaktaharUmadhye jasalAI cAhanchau mArgadarzana garchauM | nizcaya nai timI sIdhA mArgatira pathapradarzana garirahekAchau |
tyasa allAhako mArgatira jasako niyantraNamA AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sabai cijaharU chan | suna, pratyeka mAmalA allAhatarpha nai pharkancha |
hA0 mIm0
kasama spaSTa granthako |
nissandeha hAmIle yasalAI arabI bhASAko kuraAna banAekA chauM, tAki timIharU bujha |
ra, vAstavamA yo hAmIkahA~ ummul kitAba ( mUla kitAba ) mA aGkita, ucca koTiko ra tatvadarzitAle bharipUrNa cha |
ke hAmI timIharUlAI yasa kAraNale upadeza dina banda garauM ki timIharU sImA ullaGghanakArI samudAya hau?
ra, pahilekA mAnisaharUbIca hAmIle kati nabIharU paThAyauM!
tara tinIharUsamakSa juna nabI Ae pani tinIharUle unako upahAsa nai garne gare |
ani hAmIle tinIharUbhandA zaktizAlI mAnisaharUlAI naSTa garyauM | ra, pahilekA mAnisaharUko vRttAntako varNana bhaisakeko cha |
ra, timIle tinIharUlAI AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI kasale sRSTi garyo bhanera sodhyau bhane tinIharUle avazya nai bhannechan– “yinIharUlAI prabhutvazAlI evaM sarvajJa (allAha) le sRSTi gare |
jasale timIharUkAlAgi pRthvIlAI samatala banAe ra tyasamA timIharUkailAgi bATAharU banAe tAki timIharU gantavyasamma pugna saka |
ra, jasale AkAzabATa ucita parimANamA pAnI barsAe ani hAmIle tyasabATa murdA bhUmilAI jIvita pAyauM |” yasarI nai timIharUlAI (jaminabATa) nikAlinecha |
ra, unai hun jasale hareka cija joDI joDI sRSTi gare | ra, jasale timIharUkAlAgi DuMgAharUlAI ra janAvaraharUlAI savArIko sAdhana banAe jasamA timIharU savAra hune garchau |

tAki tinIharUko piThyU~mA majjAle basa, ra tyasamAthi basdA AphnA pAlanakartAko varadAnalAI yAda gara ra bhana– “pavitra chan tI sattA jasale yinIharUlAI hAmro niyantraNamA garidie jabaki hAmI svayaM yinIharUlAI Aphno niyantraNamA garna sakne thienauM |”
ra, hAmI antataH AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha nai pharkera jAnucha |
ra, tinIharUle allAhakA kehI bhaktaharUlAI unako aMza Thahara garidiekA chan | nissandeha mAnava ekadamai spaSTa kRtaghna rahecha |
ke allAhale AphnA sRSTimadhye svayaMkAnimti chorIharU grahaNa garekA chan ra timIharUlAI chorAharU pradAna garekA chan?
jaba tinIharUmadhye kasailAI tyahI kurAko zubhasUcanA diincha juna usale karuNAmaya (allAha) kolAgi bhancha, taba U bhakkAnu bhaeko avasthAmA mRtyu usako anuhAra kAlo huncha |
ke tyasako ( sUcanA ) jo garagahanAmA pAlincha ra jhaiM–jhagaDAmA pani Aphno mukha pani kholna nasakine?

ra, yinIharUle phariztAharUlAI strI ThAnekA chan, jo karuNAmaya allAhakA bhakta hun? ke tinIharUko sRSTiko samayamA yinIharU upasthita thie? cA~Dai nai yinIharUko gavAhI lekhinecha ra ( mahApralayako dina ) sodhapucha pani hunecha |

ra, yinIharU bhanchan– “karuNAmaya (allAha) le cAhekAbhae hAmI tinIharUko upAsanA garne thienauM |” yinIharU yasa mAmilAko vAstavikatAlAI bilakulai jAndainan | yinIharU kevala aDkalako bharamA kurA garchan |
ke hAmIle yinIharUlAI yasaaghi kunai grantha diekA thiyauM jasalAI yinIharUle dRDhatAkAsAtha samAtekA chan?
baru yinIharU bhanchan– hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI euTA mArgamA pAyau~ ra hAmI pani tinIharUkai padacinha anusAra calirahekA chau~ |

yasarI nai timIbhandA pahile hAmIle kunai sacetaka juna nagaramA paThAyauM tyahA~kA sampanna vyaktiharUle yahI bhane ki hAmIle AphnA pUrvajaharUlAI euTA mArgamA pAekA chauM ra hAmI tinIharukai padacinhako anusaraNa garirahanchauM |

sandeSTAle bhane– “maile timIharUsamakSa timIharUle pUrvajabATa pAeko mArgabhandA uttama mArga prastuta gardA pani?” tinIharUle bhane– “juna kurAkAsAtha timIlAI paThAieko cha tyasalAI hAmI asvIkAra garchauM |”
antataH hAmIle tinIharUsita yathocita badalA liyauM | ani, hera jhUTho ThaharAuneharUko kasto pariNAma bhayo?
ra, smaraNa gara jaba ibrAhImale AphnA bAbulAI ra jAtibandhuharUlAI bhane– “timIharU jasako upAsanA garchau tinIharUsita mero kunai sarokAra chaina |
tyasa pAlanahArabAheka jasale mero sRSTi gare | ani unI nai malAI sIdhAmArga dekhAunechan |
ra, ibrAhIma yahI kurA AphnA santAnaharUmA choDera gae, tAki yinIharUTa (allAhatarpha) pharkiun |
baru maile yinIharU ra yinakA pUrvajaharUlAI sukhasuvidhA pradAna gareM, yahA~samma ki yinIharUsamakSa nitAnta satya ra spaSTa rasUla Aipuge |
tara jaba yinIharUkahA~ nitAnta satya Aipugyo taba yinIharUle bhane– “yo ta jAdU ho ra hAmI yasalAI asvIkAra garchauM |”
ra, yinIharU bhanchan– “yo kuraAna yI duI ThUlA nagaraharU madhyekA kunai mahAn vyaktimAthi kina avatarita gariena?”

ke yinIharU timrA pAlanakartAko dayAlAI bA~DaphA~Da garchan? hAmIle sAMsArika jIvanamA yinIharUbIca yinako jIvikAlAI bA~DidiekA chauM ra kehilAI arkA kehimAthi zreSThatA pradAna garyauM, tAki tinIharUle eka arkobATa sevA prApta garUn | ra, timrA pAlanakartAko dayA yinIharUle jammA garirahekA (dhana–sampatti) bhandA uttama raheko cha |

ra, yadi sabai mAnisaharU euTai samudAya hunechan bhanne kurA nabhaeko bhae hAmI karuNAmaya (allAha) ko inkAra garne mAnisaharUkA chAnAharUlAI ra tinIharUle caDhne bharyAGgaharUlAI cA~dIkA banAidine thiyauM |
ra, tinIharUkA gharakA DhokAharU tathA tinIharUle aDesa lAgne palaGgaharUlAI pani |

ra sajAvaTakA bahumUlya ratnaharU pani (pradAna garne thiyauM) | tara yI sabai sAMsArika jIvanakA mAtra lAbha hun, ra timrA pAlanakartAkahA~ Akhirata ( ko suukha zAnti ) Izabhaya rAkhneharUkAlAgi mAtra raheko cha |
ra, juna mAnisa karuNAmaya (allAha) ko smaraNako bevAstA garchan hAmI tyasakAlAgi euTA zaitAna khaTAidinchauM ani tyo nai usako mitra huncha |
ra yI zaitAnaharU yinIharUlAI sIdhAmArgabATa rokchan jaba ki yinIharU AphUlAI satmArgI ThAnchan |
yahA~ samma ki jaba U hAmIkahA~ pugnecha taba bhannecha – “hAmI ra timIbIca purva tathA pazcimako durI bhaeko bhae hunthayo! timI ta ati nikRSTa sAthI hau |”
ra Aja timIharU yAtanAmA sAjhedAra hunule timIharUlAI kunai lAbha puryAune chaina kinakI timIharU atyAcArI hau |
ani ke timI bahirAlAI sunAuna sakchau vA andhAlAI mArga dekhAuna sakchau ra tyasalAI pani jo spaSTa pathabhraSTatAmA cha?
yadi hAmIle timIlAI lagyauM bhane pani tinIharUsita ta nizcita rUpamA badalA linechauM |
vA timIlAI tyo ( prakopa ) dekhAunechauM jasako vAcA hAmIle yinIharUsita garekA chauM | kinabhane hAmI yinIharUmAthi pUrNa sAmarthya rAkhdachauM |
ataH juna vahaya timItarpha paThAieko cha tyasalAI dRDhatAsAtha samAta | nissandeha timI sIdhAmArgamA chau |
ani, yo timrolAgi ra timro jAtibandhukolAgi upadeza ho | ra, timIharUsa~ga cA~Dai ( yasabAre ) sodhapucha hunecha |
ra, timIbhandA pahile hAmIle paThAekA hAmrA tI rasUlaharUsita sodha– “ke hAmIle karuNAmaya (allAha) bAheka anya kunai yastA IzvaraharU nirdhArita garekA thiyauM jasako upAsanA gariyos?
ra, hAmIle mUsAlAI nizAnIharU diera phiraauna tathA usakA bhAradAraharUtarpha paThAyauM | ani mUsAle bhane– “ma sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartA (allAha) ko rasUla hu~ |”
pheri jaba mUsA tinIharUsamakSa hAmrA nizAnIharU liera Ae taba tinIharUle tI nizAnIharUko khillI uDAuna thAle |
ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI dekhAune pratyeka nizAnI pahileko nizAnIbhandA ThUlo hunthyo | ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI prakopadvArA samAtyauM tAki tinIharU pharkiun |
ra, tinIharUle bhane– “he jAdUgara! unale timIsita gareko vAcA anusAra hAmrAlAgi prArthanA gara | hAmI avazya nai sIdhAmArga apanAunechauM |
ani jaba hAmI yAtanAlAI haTAi dinchau~, akasmAta unIharule vAcA bhaMga garchan |
ra, phiraaunale Aphno samudAyamA ghoSaNA gardai bhanyo– “he merA samudAyakA mAnisaharU ho! ke misrako sattA ra mero mahalako talatirabATa bagiraheko nadI merA hoinan? ke timIharU dekhdainau?
ke ma yo vyaktibhandA uttama hoina jasako kunai pratiSThA chaina ra jo Aphno kurA praSTyAuna pani sakdaina?
usalAI sunakA curAharU kina pradAna garienan vA Usa~ga kramabaddha rUpamA phariztAharU kina avataraNa bhaenan?”
yasarI phiraaunale Aphno samudAyalAI murkha tulyAyo, ani tinIharUle usakai AjJApAlana gare | vAstavamA tinIharU avajJAkArI thie |
pheri jaba tinIharUle hAmIlAI krodhita tulyAe taba hAmIle tinIharUsita badalA liyau~ ani tinIharU sabailAI curlumma DubAidiyauM |
pheri hAmIle tinIharUlAI pachi Aune mAnisaharUkAlAgi euTA atItako dAsatAna ra zikSAprada udAharaNa banAidiyauM |
ra, jaba maryama–putra IsAko udAharaNa diincha taba timro samudAyakA mAnisaharUle hohallA garna thAlchan |
ra bhanchan– “hAmrA upAsyaharU uttama chan vA tyo? yo (IsAko) udAharaNa tinIharU kevala vivAda carkAunakAlAgi dinchan baru tinIharU ta jhagaDAlu hun |
tyo mero euTA bhakta mAtra thiyo jasamAthi hAmIle upakAra garyauM ra usalAI isrAIlakA santAnaharUkolAgi euTA namUnA banAidiyauM |
ra, hAmIle cAhemA timIharUko sthAnamA phariztAharUlAI banAune thiyauM jo dhartImA ( timIharUko ) uttarAdhikArI hune thie |
ra, vAstavamA unI mahApralayakA nizAnI hun tyasaile timIharU tyasamA sandeha nagara | ra, mero kurA mAna, yahI sIdhA mArga ho |
ra, zaitAnale timIharUlAI kadApI narokos | nissandeha tyo timIharUko spaSTa zatru ho |

ra, jaba IsA spaSTa nizAnIharU liera Ae taba unale bhane– “ma timIharUsamakSa tatvadarzitA liera Aeko chu, ani timIharUle paraspara matabheda garne garekA kehI kurAharUko vAstavikatA timIharUlAI prasTa rUpamA batAuna Aeko chu | ataH timIharU allAhako bhaya gara ra mero AjJApAlana gara |
nissandeha allAha nai merA ra timIharUkA pAlanakartA hun | ataH unakai upAsanA gara | yahI sIdhAmArga ho |
tara isarAIlakA santAnakA samUhaharUle paraspara matabheda gare | ataH euTA dukhadAyI dinako yAtanAbATa atyAcArIharUko vinAza hune cha |
yinIharU kevala mahApralayako pratIkSA gardaichan ki tyo akasmAt tinIharUmAthi Aiparos ra tinIharUlAI tyasako khabara pani nahos |
tyo dina Izabhaya rAkhne mAnisaharUbAheka sabai ghaniSTa mitraharU paraspara zatru bannechan |
he merA bhaktaharU ho! Aja timIharU DarAunu pardaina ra timIharU zokagrasta pani hune chainau |
jasale hAmrA AyataharUmAthi ImAna lyAe ra muslima bhae...
(unIharUlAI bhaninecha)– “ praphullita hu~dai praveza gara svargamA timIharU ra timIharUkA patnIharU pani|”
unIharUsamakSa sunakA thAlI tathA pyAlAharU peza garinechan | ani, tyahA~ manamohaka tathA A~khAle rucAune cijaharU hunechan yasa avasthAmA ki timIharU tyasamA sadA rahanechau |
timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharUko pratidAnasvarUpa timIharUlAI uttarAdhikArI banAieko svarga yahI ho |
yahA~ timIharUkAlAgi dherai phalaphUlaharU chan jasabATa timIharU khAnechau |
nissandeha pApIharU sadA narakako yAtanAmA rahanechan |
tinIharUko yo yAtanA kahilyai pani halukA pArine chaina ra tinIharU tyasaimA nirAza bhairahanechan |
ra, hAmIle tinIharUmAthi atyAcAra garenauM, baru tinIharU svayaM atyAcArI thie |
ra, tinIharUle cicyAera bhannechan– “he mAlika! timrA pAlanakartAle hAmIlAI samApta nai garidiUn |” unale javApha dinechan– “timIharU ta sadA yasaimA rahanuparcha |
hAmI timIharUsamakSa nitAnta satya liera AekA thiyauM tara timIharUmadhye adhikAMza tyasalAI ghRNA garne garthyo |
ke tinIharUle kunai kArya garne nizcaya garekA chan? tyaso bhae hAmI pani euTA nirNaya linchauM |
ke tinIharUle yo ThAne ki hAmI tinIharUkA gopya kurAharU ra tinIharUkA kAnekhusI sundainauM? kina nasunnu? hAmrA phariztAharU sabai lekhirahekA pani chan |
bhanideU– “yadi karuNAmaya (allAha) ko kunai santAna bhaeko bhae unako pahilo upAsaka ma nai hune thie~ |
pavitra chan AkAzaharU ra pRthvIkA pAlanakartA tathA siMhAsanakA mAlika tI sabai kurAharUbATa jo yinIharU garne garchan |
ata: choDideU yinIharUlAI tAki yinIharU tathyahIna vicAraharUmA magna rahUn ra khela tamAsAmA vyasta rahUn yahA~samma ki yinIharU tyasa dinalAI dekhUna jasako vAcA yinIharUsita garincha |
unai AkAzamA upAsya chan ra dhartImA pani ra unI tatvajJa evaM sarvajJa chan |

barakatayukta chan unI (allAha) jasakA lAgi AkAzaharU, pRthvI tathA yI duvaibIcakA cijaharUko rAjyasattA cha ra mahApralayako jJAna pani unaisa~ga cha | ra, unaitarpha timIharU sabai pharkera jAnucha |
unalAI choDI yinIharU jasalAI pukArdachan tinIharUlAI kunai kisimako siphArizako adhikAra chaina yasa bAheka ki unIharUle jJAnako AdhAramA nitAnta satyako sAkSI deun |
ra, yinIharUlAI kasale sRSTi garyo bhanI yinIharUlAI sodhyau bhane yinIharUle nizcaya nai yasako uttara dinechan– “allAhale |” pheri yinIharU kahA~ bahakAidaichan?
ra (unI jAndachan) rasUlako yo bhanAI pani “he pAlanakartA! yI tI mAnisaharU hun jo ImAna lyAu~dainan |”
ataH (he nabI sa.!) yinIharUlAI bevAstA gara ra salAma bhana | yinIharUle cA~Dai nai (avajJAko pariNAma) thAhA pAunechan |
hA0 mIm0
kasama cha spaSTa granthako |
hAmIle yasalAI eka barakatayukta rAtamA avataraNa garyauM ki hAmI (mAnisaharUlAI) sAvadhAna garauM |
yasa ( rAta ) mA pratyeka tatvadarzitAyukta mAmalAko nirNaya garincha |
(arthAt) hAmro tarphabATa phaisalA huncha | hAmI avazya nai sandeSTAharU paThAunechauM |
timrA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa dayA svarUpa | nissandeha unI sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJa chan |
AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI ra yI duvaibIcakA sampUrNa cijaharUkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa, yadi timIharU vizvAsa garchau bhane |
unIbAheka arU kohI pUjya chaina | unI nai jIvana pradAna garchan ra mRtyu dinchan | unI nai timIharUkA pAlanakartA hun ra bitekA timrA pUrvajaharUkA pani |
tara yinIharU sandehamA khelirahekA chan |
ata: tyasa dinako pratIkSA gara juna dina AkAza spaSTa rUpamA dhuvA~ liera Aunecha |
ra, tyasale sampUrNa mAnisaharUlAI Dhapakkai DhAknecha | yo ho duHkhadAyI yAtanA |
(taba tinIharUle prArthanA garne chan )– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIbATa yo prakopako nivAraNa gara | hAmI ImAna lyAu~chauM |”
aba tinIharUlAI upadeza grahaNa garne avasara kahA~ cha? jabaki rasUla pratyakSa yinIharUsamakSa AekA thie |
taipani tinIharU bimukha bhae ra bhane– “yo euTA sikAieko unmAdI po rahecha |”
hAmIle yo prakopalAI alikati haTAidiyauM bhane pani timIharU punaH pahilekai kAryatarpha pharkanecha |
juna dina tinIharUlAI narAmrarI samAtnechau, tyasadina hAmI timIharUsita pratizodha nai linechauM |
ra, hAmIle yinIharUbhandA pahile phiraaunako samudAyako parIkSaNa garisakekA chauM | ra, tinIharUsamakSa euTA pratiSThita rasUla Ae |
yasa sandezakA sAtha ki allAhakA bhaktaharUlAI mero jimmA lagAU | nizcaya nai ma euTA nAsobAhaka rasUla hu~ |
ra, allAhaviruddha uddaNDatA nadekhAU | ma timIharUsamakSa spaSTa pramANa liera Aeko chu |
ra timIharU mamAthi DhuMgA barsAunabATa maile Aphno tathA timIharUkA pAlanakartAko zaraNa liisakeko chu |
ra, yadi timIharU mero kurAmA vizvAsa gardainau bhane mabATa para haTa |
taba unale AphnA pAlanakartAlAI pukAre– “yinIharU ta aparAdhI hun |”
( Adeza diiyo)– “rAtArAta merA bhaktaharUlAI liera niska, kinabhane timIharUko pichA garinecha |”
ra, samudralAI rokieko avasthAmA choDa | nizcaya nai yinIharU yastA senA hun jasalAI DubAinecha |
katipaya bagai~cAharU, pAnIkA mUlaharU tinIharUle choDera gae |
ra khetIharU tathA bhavya mahalaharU |
kaiyauM bhogavilAsakA sAmAnaharU jasamA tinIharU magna thie |
yasto bhayo tinIharUko pariNAma ra hAmIle anya mAnisaharUlAI yI vastuharUkA uttarAdhikArI banAidiyauM |
tara tinIharUkAlAgi na AkAza royo na pRthvI nai; na tinIharUlAI kunai avasara nai pradAna gariyo |
ra pakkai pani isrAIlakA santAnaharUlAI hAmIle apamAnajanaka yAtanAbATa mukti pradAna garyauM |
phiraaunabATa | nizcaya nai U ThUlo sImA ullaGghanakArIharU madhyeko thiyo |
ra, hAmIle jJAnako AdhAramA isarAIlakA santAnaharUlAI saMsArakA anya samudAyaharUmAthi pradhAnatA pradAna garekA thiyauM |
ra, unIharUlAI yastA nizAnIharU dekhAekA thiyauM jasamA spaSTa parIkSA thiyo |
yinIharU baDo dRr3hatApUrvaka bhanchan...
"hAmro lAgi ta yahI nai pahilo mRtyu ho ra ( tyasapachi ) hAmI uThAine chainauM |"
yadi timI saccA hau bhane hAmrA pUrkhAharUlAI (jIvita pArI) lyAU |
ke yinIharU rAmrA chan vA tubbaa samudAya ra tinIharUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharU? hAmIle tinIharU sabailAI naSTa pAryauM kinabhane tinIharU aparAdhI thie |
ra, hAmIle AkAzaharU, pRthvI tathA yI duvaibIca rahekA cijaharUlAI khelai–khelamA banAekA chainauM |
yI duvailAI hAmIle nitAnta satyakAsAtha sRSTi garekA chauM tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |
nissandeha yinIharU sabaiko pUnarjIvanakolAgi phaisalAko dina nirdhArita gariekocha |
tyasadina kunai nikaTatama mitra kAma lAgne chaina na tinIharUlAI sahayoga nai garinecha |
tyasa vyakti bAheka jasamAthi allAhale dayA garUn | unI prabhutvazAlI evaM parama dayAlu chan |
nissandeha jakkUma (siu~DIko jasto) vRkSa...
pApIharUko khAnA hunecha |
paglieko dhAtu jastai tyo peTamA umlanecha...
jasarI tAto pAnI umlancha |
(Adeza huncha)– “tyasalAI samAta ra danka~do Agoko bIcasamma ghisArdai laijAU |
ra, tyasako TAukomAthi daNDa svarUpa umla~do pAnI khanyAu |”
(aba) svAda cAkha | timI bilakula prabhutva rAkhne evaM sammAnita vyakti thiyau |
nissandeha yo tyahI (yAtanA) ho jasako AgamanabAre timIlAI sandeha thiyo |”
nissandeha allAhako bhaya rAkhne mAnisaharU zAnta sthAnamA hunechan |
bagaiMcAharU tathA pAnIkA mUlaharUmA |
eka arkAko Amunne sAmunne basI pAtalA tathA moTA rezamakA pozAka dhAraNa garnechan |
yastai hunecha, ra ( izabhaya rAkhne ) yinIharUko pariNAma ra (ajha baDhI) hAmI unIharUko vivAha gorI–gorI mRga nayana bhaekI apsarAharUsa~ga garidinchauM |
tyahA~ unIharUle nizcintatApUrvaka hareka prakArakA svAdiSTa cijaharU mAga garirahekA hunechan |
unIharUle tyahA~ mRtyuko svAda kahilyai cAkhne chainan | a~ saMsAramA juna mRtyu Ayo tyo Ayo | ra, allAhale unIharUlAI narakako yAtanAbATa bacAunechan |
yo kevala timrA pAlanakartAko kRpA ho | yahI mahAn saphalatA ho |
hAmIle yasa kuraAnalAI timro bhASAmA sarala pArekA chauM, AzA cha mAnisaharUle upadeza grahaNa garUn |
timI pratIkSA gara | yinIharU pani pratIkSAmA chan |
hA0 mIm0
yasa granthako avataraNa prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI allAhako tarphabATa bhaeko ho |
nissandeha AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA AsthAvAnaharUkAlAgi anagintI nizAnIharU chan |
ra, timro sRSTimA tathA allAhale dhartImA phailAirahekA janAvaraharUmA vizvAsa rAkhne mAnisaharUkAlAgi asaMkhya nizAnIharU chan |

ani, rAta tathA dinako AgamanamA ra AjIvikAko tyasa mAdhyamamA jasalAI allAhale AkAzabATa avataraNa garchan ani tyasadvArA bhUmilAI tyasako mRtyupachi jIvita pArchan ra hAvAharUko bahAvamA pani vivekazIla mAnisaharUkAlAgi dherai nizAnIharU chan |
yI allAhakA nizAnIharU hun jasalAI hAmI nitAnta satyakAsAtha timIlAI sunAudaichauM | aba yinIharU allAha tathA unakA nizAnIharUpachi kuna kurAmAthi ImAna lyAulAn ta?
pratyeka jhUThA ra pApIkolAgi vinAza rahekocha |

jasale sundacha allAhakA AyataharUlAI juna paDhera sunAi~ncha, pheri (inkAramAthi) garvakAsAtha yasarI aDiga rahancha, mAnauM usale tyasalAI kahile sunekai chaina | tasartha tyasalAI kaThora yAtanAko zubhasUcanA sunAideU |
ra, jaba tyasalAI hAmrA AyataharUmadhye kunai kurAko jAnakArI huncha taba tyasako upahAsa garcha | yastai mAnisaharUkAnimti apamAnajanaka yAtanA raheko cha |

tinIharUkA pachADi naraka cha | tinIharUlAI tinIharUko kamAile kunai phAidA puryAune chaina, na tinIharUle nai jasalAI tinIharUle allAha bAheka Aphno saMrakSaka-mitra banAekA chan | ra, tinIharUlAI ThUlo daNDa raheko cha |
yo (kuraAna) sarvathA mArgadarzana ho | ra, juna mAnisaharUle AphnA pAlanakartAkA AyataharUlAI asvIkAra gare tinIharUkAlAgi pIDAdAyaka yAtanA rahekocha |
allAha nai hun jasale timIharUkAlAgi samudralAI adhInastha garidie tAki tyasamA unako AdezabATa DuGgAharU tairiun ra timIharU unako anugraha prApta gara, ra kRtajJa hoU |
unale Aphno tarphabATa AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sabai cijaharUlAI timIharUko adhInamA garidiekA chan | nissandeha cintana manana garneharUkAlAgi yasamA thuprai nizAnIharU chan |,

(he nabI sa.!) AsthAvAnaharUlAI bhanideU– “jo allAhako tarphabATa narAmro dina Aune kurAsita DarAu~dainan, tinIharUkA kriyAkalApalAI mApha garun tAki allAhale tyastA samudAyalAI usako Arjanako badalA diUn |
jasale puNyakarma garnecha, Aphnai phAidAkolAgi garnecha ra jasale duSkarma garnecha tyasako duSpariNAma usaimAthi AilAgcha | pheri timIharU AphnA pAlanakartAtarpha pharkAinechau |

ra, hAmIle isarAIlakA santAnalAI Izagrantha, nirNayazakti ra IzadUtatva pradAna garekA thiyauM, ani tinIharUlAI rAmro jIvana–sAmagrI pradAna garekA thiyauM | ra, saMsArabharikA mAnisaharUmAthi pradhAnatA pradAna garekA thiyauM |

ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI dharmako spaSTa pramANaharU diyauM | ani tinIharUle spaSTa jJAnako AgamanapazcAt kevala ekaarkAmAthi atyAcAra garne manasAyale tinIharUle ApasamA vibheda gare | nizcaya nai timro pAlana kartAle mahApralayako dina tinIharUle vibheda garirahekA kurAharubAre tinIharUbIca nirNaya garidinechan |

tyasapachi (he nabI sa.!) hAmIle timIlAI dharmako khullA mArga ( zarIata ) mA kAyama garidiyauM | ataH timI yasaiko anusaraNa gara, ra tI mAnisaharUkA icchAharUko anusaraNa nagara jo jJAna rAkhdainan |
nissandeha tinIharUle timIlAI allAhavirUddha kunai lAbha puryAuna sakdainan | ra, atyAcArIharU eka arkAkA mitra hun, jabaki allAha ta IzaparAyaNa mAnisaharUkA mitra hun |
yo (kuraAna) sabai mAnisaharUkAlAgi tatvadarzitAko kurA ho, ra vizvAsa rAkhne vyaktiharUkAlAgi mArgadarzana ra dayA ho |

ke duSkarma garneharUle yo ThAnekA chan ki hAmIle tinIharUlAI unIharUjastai banAidine chauM jasale ImAna lyAe ani satkarma gare? ke unIharUko jIvana ra mRtyU samAna hunecha? tinIharUko nirNaya kati nikRSTa raheko cha!
ra allAhale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIlAI nitAnta satyakAsAtha sRSTi garekA chan, ra yasa uddezyale ki pratyeka prANIlAI usako kamAiko badalA diiyos | ra, unIharUmAthi anyAya garine chaina |

ke timIle tyasa vyaktiko sthitibAre vicAra garyau jasale Aphno icchAlAI Aphno upAsya banAeko cha, ani allAhale jJAnako AdhAramA tyasalAI pathabhraSTatAmA phyA~ki diekA chan, ra tyasakA kAna tathA hRdayalAI sila garidiekA chan, tathA tyasakA A~khAmA paTTi lagAidiekA chan? allAhapachi aba yasto vyaktilAI kasale mArgadarzana garna sakcha ta? ke timIharU zikSA grahaNa gardainau?

ra, yinIharU bhanchan– “jIvana kevala yahI sAMsArika jIvana ho, jahA~ hAmI jIune ra marne garchauM | ra, samayacakrale mAtra hAmIlAI mArdacha | jabaki yinIharUlAI yasako jJAna pani chaina | yinIharU kevala aDkalabAjIko bharamA kurA garchan |
ra, jaba yinIharUlAI hAmrA spaSTa AyataharU paDhera sunAincha taba yinIharUsa~ga, yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane, hAmrA pUrvajaharUlAI uThAera lyAU bhannubAheka arU kunai tarka hu~daina |

(he nabI sa.!) bhanideU– “allAha nai timIharUlAI jIvana pradAna garchan ani mRtyu dinchan, pheri timIharU sabailAI tyasa mahApralayako dina bhelA pArnechan, jasako AgamanamA kunai sandeha chaina | tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU jAndainan |
allAhakailAgi ho AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko zAsana | ra, juna dina mahApralayako ghaDI Aunecha tyo dina asatyavAdIharU ghATAgrasta hunechan |
ra timIle hareka samudAyalAI ghuMDA Tekera baseko avasthAmA dekhnechau | hareka samudAyalAI usako karmapatratira bolAinecha ( ra bhaninecha ki ) Aja timIharUlAI timIharUko karmako badalA diinecha |
yo hAmIle tayAra pAreko karmapatra ho jasale timIharUkA bAremA ThIka ThIka bhandaicha | hAmI tyasalAI lekhAune garthyau~ juna karma timIharU gardaithyau |
ataH jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare, unIharUkA pAlanakartAle unIharUlAI Aphno dayA antargata linechan | yahI nai spaSTa saphalatA ho |
tara jasale kuphra gare (tinIharUlAI bhaninecha) ke timIharUlAI merA Ayataharu paDhera sunAidainathyo? tara timIharUle ghamaNDa garyau ra timIharU aparAdhI samudAya nai thiyau |

ani jaba, allAhako vAcA nitAnta satya ho ra mahApralayako AgamanamA kunai sandeha chaina, bhaninthyo taba timIharU bhanthyau– “mahApralaya bhaneko ke ho hAmIlAI thAhA chaina | hAmI tyasalAI anumAnabAheka arU kehI ThAndainauM ra hAmI paTakkai vizvAsa gardainauM |
ra ( aba ) tinIharUsamakSa tinIharUkA karmaharUko nikRSTatA jAhera bhayo ra tinIharU juna kurAharUko ThaTTA garthe tI kurAharUle nai tinIharUlAI gheryo |

ra, ( tinIharUlAI ) bhaninecha– “Aja hAmI timIharUlAI tyasarI nai bhulAu~chauM jasarI timIharUle yasa dinako sAkSAtkAralAI bhulekA thiyau ra timIharUko bAsasthAna naraka ho ani timIharUko kohI sahayogI chaina |

yo yasa kAraNale ki timIharUle allAhakA AyataharUko khillI uDAyau ra sAMsArika jIvanale timIharUlAI dhokAmA pAryo | ataH Aja na yinIharU narakabATa nikAlinechan ra na yinIharUlAI kSamAyAcanA garne avasara nai diinecha |
ataH sArA prazaMsAharU allAhakainimti chan jo AkAzaharU ra dhartIkA mAlika tathA sampUrNa saMsArabAsIharUkA pAlanakartA hun |
ra, AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA unakai garimA raheko cha | ra, unI prabhutvazAlI tathA tatvadarzI chan |
hA0 mIm0
yasa granthako avataraNa prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI allAhabATa bhaeko cha |,

AkAzaharU, pRthvI ra yI duvaibIcakA cijaharUlAI hAmIle kevala nitAnta satyakAsAtha ra euTA nizcita samayakolAgi sRSTi garekA chauM | ra, kAphiraharUlAI juna kurAko Dara dekhAieko cha, tyasalAI tinIharUle bevAstA garekA chan |

bhanideU– “ke timIharUle vicAra garyau tyasa bAremA jasalAI allAhabAheka timIharU pukArne garchau | malAI dekhAU ki tinIharUle pRthvImA kuna cijalAI sRSTi gare vA AkAzaharUmA tinIharUko kunai sAjhedArI raheko cha? yasaaghiko kunai grantha vA tyasa jJAnabATa bA~kI raheko kunai aMza ma samakSa prastuta gara yadi timIharU saccA hau bhane |

ani, tinIharUbhandA baDhI pathabhraSTa ko huna sakcha jo allAhalAI choDI yastA cijaharUlAI pukArchan jasale mahApralayasamma pani tinIharUko pukArako javApha dina sakdainan, ra tinIharU tinIharukA pukArabAre anabhijJa pani chan?
ani jaba mAnisaharUlAI ekatrita garinecha taba tI pUjyaharU tinIharUkA zatru hunechan, ra tinIharUko upAsanAlAI ThADai asvIkAra garnechan |
ra, jaba yinIharUlAI hAmrA spaSTa AyataharU paDhera sunAincha, taba yI kAphiraharU satyabAre tyasako AgamanapazcAt, yo ta spaSTa jAdU ho bhanera bhanchan |

ke yinIharU “yasalAI yinI (muhammada) le svayaM banAekA hun” bhanera bhanchan? bhanideU– “yadi maile yasalAI AphaiMle banAeko bhae timIharU malAI allAhabATa alikati vacAuna sakne thienauM | timIharU je kurA garchau tyo allAha rAmrarI jAndachan | hAmI ra timIbIca sAkSIko rUpamA unI paryApta chan, ra unI atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu pani chan |

bhanideU– “ma kunai pahilo rasUla hoina, vA ma ra timIharUsita kasto vyavahAra garinecha bhanne kurAlAI nai ma jAndachu | ma ta kevala tyasaiko anusaraNa garchu juna mamAthi prakAzanA garincha | ra, ma kevala spaSTa sacetaka hu~ |”

bhanideU–"ke timIharUle vicAra garyau, yadi yo (quraAna) allAhako tarphabATa bhaeko bhae ra timIharU asvIkAra garyau, jabakI isrAilakA santAnaharUmadhye ekajanA yo jastai (yasa aghi avataraNa bhaisakeko kitAbako) sAkSI diyo ra ImAna lyAyo, jabaki timIharU Aphno ahaGkAramA chau? vAstavamA atyAcArIharUlAI allAha mArga dekhAu~dainan |

ra, kAphiraharU AsthAvAnaharulAI bhanchan – “yadi yo (grantha) uttama hunthyo bhane unIharU tyasatarpha hAmIbhandAaghi baDhna sakne thienan |” ra, tinIharUle yasa ( kuraAna ) bATa mArgadarzana grahaNa garna nasakekAle, tinIharU yahI bhanchan ki yo ta prAcIna mithyA ho |

ra, yasabhandA pahile mUsAko kitAba pathapradarzaka evaM dayA raheko cha | ra, arabI bhASAmA raheko yo granthale tyasa granthako puSTi garcha, tAki yasale atyAcArIharUlAI saceta garos ra satkarmIharUlAI zubhasUcanA deos |
nissandeha jasale hAmrA pAlanakartA allAha hun bhane ra pheri tyasamA aDiga rahe tyastA vyaktiharUlAI na kunai Dara hunecha na cintA nai |
yinIharU svargakA bAsindAharU hun jo sadA tyasaimA basnechan, tI karmaharUko pratidAna svarUpa juna yinIharUle garne garthe |

ani hAmIle mAnisalAI AphnA mAtApitAprati uttama vyavahAra garne Adeza diekA chauM | usakI AmAle usalAI kaSTa sahera garbhamA vahana garin ra kaSTa sahera janmAin | ra usalAI garbhamA vahana garnu ra dUdha chuTAunu avadhi jammA tIsa mahinAko huncha | jaba tyo vyakti pUrNa rupamA balavAna ra cAlIsa varSako huncha, taba bhancha– “he merA pAlanakartA! malAI niyantraNamA rAkha tAki juna varadAna timIle mamAthi ra merA mAtApitAmAthi garekA chau tyasaprati ma kRtajJa banna saku~, ra, yasto puNya kArya garna saku~ jasabATa timI khuzI hunchau | ra, merA santAnalAI pani merolAgi yogya banAU | ma timItira nai pharkeM, ra ma AjJAkArIharUmadhyeko hu~ |”
yinIharU, jasakA puNyakAryaharU hAmI svIkAra garnechauM, ra pApaharU mApha garidinechauM, yinIharU nai svargabAsIharUmadhyekA hun, tyasa saccA vacana anusAra juna yinIharUsita garinthyo |

ra, jasale AphnA mAtApitAlAI bhanyo– “uph! timI duvai prati, ke timIharUle malAI punarjIvita garinecha bhanI Dara dekhAu~chauM, jabaki mabhandA pahile dherai samudAya bitisakekA chan? jabaki ( mAtApitA ) duvai allAhalAI sahayogakAnimti pukArdai bhannechan– “tero nAza hunecha! ImAna lyAU | nissandeha allAhako vacana satya ho |” tara tyasale bhannecha– “yo kevala prAcIna mAnisaharUko kathA ho |”
yinIharU nai tI vyaktiharU hun jasamAthi vacana satyasiddha bhayo, tI jinna tathA mAnavaharUkA sAtha jo tinIharUbhandA pahile nai bitisakekA chan | nissandeha tinIharU ghATA khAneharU thie |
ra, pratyeka vyaktilAI usale garekA kAryaharU anusAra darjA prApta hunecha ra yasakAraNale pani ki allAha tinIharUkA kAryako pUrNa badalA diUn ra tinIharUsa~ga kunai kisimako atyAcAra hune chaina |

ra, juna dina kAphiraharUlAI narakamA hAjira garinecha (tyasa dina bhaninecha)– “timIharUle Aphno sAMsArika jIvanamai Aphno bhAgakA anugrahaharU liisakyau ra tinIharUbATa sukhabhoga hAsila garisakyau | tasartha Aja timIharUlAI dhartImA anAhaka ghamaNDa gareko ra uddaNDatA dekhAeko kAraNale apamAnajanaka yAtanA diinecha |”

ra, AdakA bhAI (hUda) lAI smaraNa gara jaba unale AphnA jAtibandhuharUlAI ahkAphmA Dara dekhAe | jabaki unIbhandA aghi ra pachi pani sacetakaharU bitisakekA chan | (yo bhandai) “timIharU allAhabAheka anya kasaiko upAsanA nagara | vAstavamA ma timIharUbAre ThUlo dinako yAtanAbATa DarAu~chu |”
samudAyakA mAnisaharUle bhane– “ke timI hAmIlAI hAmrA upAsyaharUbATa jhuTho bolera bimukha pArna AekA chau? yadi timI saccA hau bhane tyo ( yAtanA ) jasako dhamkI hAmIlAI didaichau liera Au |”
unI ( hUda )le bhane– “yasako jJAna kevala allAhalAI cha | ma timIharUsamakSa tyo sandeza puryAudaichu juna diera ma paThAieko chu | tara ma timIharUlAI ajJAnI samudAya dekhda chu |
