ani jaba tinIharUle bAdalako rUpamA Aphno upatyakAtarpha tyasalAI Au~dai gareko dekhe taba bhane– “yo Aune bAdala hAmImAthi barsinecha |” ( bAdala hoina ) baru yo tyahI ( yAtanA ) ho jasako lAgi timIharU hatAra gardai thiyau, arthAt euTA yasto A~dhI jasamA pIDAdAyI yAtanA rahekocha |

jasale AphnA pAlanakartAko Adezale hareka vastulAI dhvasta pArnecha |” tyasale gardA tinIharuko hAlata yasto bhayo ki tinIharUkA gharaharUbAheka anya kehI dekhA pardainathyo | yasarI nai hAmI aparAdhI mAnisaharUlAI pratidAna dine garchauM |

ra, vAstavamA hAmIle una ( Ada samudAya ) lAI yasarI sAmarthyavAna tulyAekA thiyauM jasarI timIharUlAI tulyAekA chainauM | ra, hAmIle tinIharUlAI kAna, A~khA evam hRdaya pani pradAna garekA thiyauM tara tinIharUlAI tinakA kAna, A~khA ra hRdayale kehI phAidA puryAenan, kinaki tinIharU allAhakA AyataharUko inkAra garne garthe ani juna kurAko tinIharU ThaTTA garne garthe tyasaile tinIharUlAI gheryo |
ra, nissandeha hAmIle timIharUkA variparikA nagaraharU dhvasta pAryauM | ani paTaka paTaka AphnA nizAnIharU prasTa pAryauM tAki tinIharU pharkiun |

Iza–nikaTatA prAptikolAgi tinIharUle allAhabAheka ja–jasalAI AphnA upAsya banAekA thie tI upAsyaharUle tinIharUko sahayoga kina garenan? barU tinIharU tI vyaktiharUbATa bepattA bhae | yo tinIharUko jhUTha ra abhiyoga mAtra thiyo |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba hAmIle jinnaharUko euTA jamAtalAI timItarpha liera AekA thiyauM tAki unIharUle kuraAna sunUn | ani jaba unIharU tyahA~ sandeSTAsamakSa puge taba unIharule bhane, kAna thApera suna | pheri jaba tyo (kuraAnako pATha) samApta bhayo taba unIharU Aphno samudAyalAI sAvadhAna garna pharkie |

bhanna thAle– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! hAmIle yasto grantha sunekA chauM juna mUsApazcAt avatarita bhaeko cha, jasale AphUbhandA pahilekA granthaharUko puSTi gardacha | yasale satya (dharma) tathA sIdhAmArga batAu~cha |”
he hAmrA jAtibandhuharU ho! allAhako AhvAnakartAko kurA mAna ra unImAthi imAna lyAu | unI (allAhale) timIharUkA pApaharU mApha garnechan ra duHkhada yAtanAbATa bacAunechan |

ra, jasale allAhatarpha AhvAnakartAko kurA svIkAra gardaina tyasa vyaktile dhartImA (allAhalAI) vivaza pArna sakne chaina na tyasa vyaktikolAgi allAha bAheka kohI saMrakSaka–mitra nai hunecha | yastA mAnisaharU nai khullA pathabhraSTatAmA chan |

ke yinIharU dekhenan ki allAha jasale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIlAI sRSTi gare ra tinIharUko sRSTi garnamA thAkenan, unai allAha murdAharUlAI pani jIvita pArne sAmarthya rAkhdachan? kina narAkhnu; unI pratyeka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

juna dina kAphiraharUlAI narakasamakSa peza garinecha (ra sodhinecha)– “ke yo nitAnta satya hoina?” tinIharUle javApha dinechan– " ho, hAmrA pAlanakartAko kasama |” allAhale bhannechan– “aba cAkha Aphno kuphrako badalAmA yAtanAko svAda |”

ataH (he nabI sa.!) dhairyadhAraNa gara jasarI dRDha saGkalpa garne rasUlaharUle dhairya gare | ra, yinIharUko mAmalAmA hatAra nagara, junadina yinIharUle tyo prakopa dekhnechan jasako dhamkI yinIharUlAI dii~daicha tyasadina thAhA hune cha ki yinIharU saMsAramA kehI kSaNa mAtra basekA thie | sandeza puryAiyo | aba aparAdhIharU bAheka arU ko naSTa hune cha ta?
jasale kuphra gare ra ( mAnisaharUlAI ) allAhako mArgabATa roke allAhale tinIharUkA karmaharUlAI vyartha tulyAe |

ani, jasale ImAna lyAe, satkarma gare ra muhammada (sa.) mAthi avataraNa garieko (kuraAna) mAthi AsthA rAkhe –jabaki tyo unIharUkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa nitAnta satya ho– allAha unIharUkA pApaharU samApta pArchangha | ra, unIharUko avasthAlAI sudRDha tulyAu~chan |

yasto yasakAraNale bhayo ki kAphiraharUle asatyako anusaraNa gare ra AsthAvAnaharUle AphnA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa Aeko satyako anusaraNa gare | yasarI nai allAha mAnisaharUkAlAgi tinIharukA udAharaNaharU bayAna gardachan |

ani kAphiraharUsita timIharUko muThabheDa hu~dA tinIharUko gardhana kATa, jaba timIharU unIharUlAI rAmrarI kulcinchau taba tinIharUlAI majabutIkA sAtha bandI banAU | tyasapachi ki ta kRpA gardai choDideU ki ta arthadaNDa leU, yahA~samma ki yuddha samApta bhaihAlos | yo allAhako Adeza ho | ra, allAhale cAhekA bhae svayaM tinIharUsita pratizodha line thie | tara allAhako uddezya eka arkAdvArA timIharUko parIkSA linu ho | ra, juna mAnisaharU allAhako mArgamA zahIda bhae allAha kadApi tinIharUkA karmaharUlAI vyartha pArne chainan |
allAhale unIharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAunechan ra unIharUko avasthA sudhArnechan |
ra (allAha) unIharUlAI tyasa svargamA praveza garAunechan jasako pahicAna unIharUlAI unale pahile nai garAekA chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timIharUle allAhalAI maddata garyau bhane unale timIharUlAI maddata garnechan ra timIharUkA kadama sudRDha pArnechan |
ra, jasale kuphra gare tinIharUkAlAgi vinAza cha ra allAhale tinIharUkA karmaharUlAI vyartha tulyAekA chan |
kinabhane allAhale je avataraNa gare tyasalAI tinIharUle ghRNA gare, ani allAhale pani tinIharUkA karmaharUlAI barabAda tulyAe |

ke yinIharU pRthvImA ghumaphira garenan ra dekhenan ki AphUbhandA pahilekA mAnisaharUko ke kasto pariNAma bhaeko thiyo? allAhale tinIharUlAI pUrNa rUpamA vinAza gare ra yI kAphiraharUkAlAgi pani yastai sajAya~ hunecha |
kinaki AsthAvAnaharUkA saMrakSaka–mitra allAha hun, jabaki kAphiraharUko saMrakSaka–mitra kohI pani chaina |

nissandeha jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare allAhale unIharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAunechan, jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | jasale kuphra gare tinIharU kSaNika phAidAmA ramAirahekAchan ra tyasarI nai khAirahekA chan jasarI pazuharU khAnchan | ra, tinIharUko bAsasthAna naraka ho |

(he muhammada sa.!) kaiyauM yastA nagaraharU thie jo timro yasa nagarabhandA, juna nagarale timIlAI tyahA~bATa niSkAsita garyo, dherai zaktizAlI thie | tI sabai nagaraharUlAI hAmIle naSTa pAryauM, ani tinIharUko kohI sahayogI bhaena |

ataH ke juna vyakti AphnA pAlanakartAbATa prApta spaSTa pramANamA kAyama cha tyo vyakti tI vyaktiharUjasto huna sakcha jasalAI tinIharUkA duSkAryaharU sundara tulyAera dekhAiekA chan ra jo AphnA abhilASAharUko anusaraNa garchan?

Izabhaya rAkhneharUsita juna svargako vAcA garieko cha tyasako guNa ke cha bhane tyahA~ pAnIkA naharaharU hunechan juna kahilyai ganhAune chainan | ra, dUdhakA yastA naharaharU hunechan jasako svAda kahilyai parivartana hune chaina | ra, zarvata (peya padArtha) kA naharaharU hunechan juna piuneharUkAlAgi svAdiSTa hunechan | ra, zuddha mahakA naharaharU pani hunechan | ra, unIharUlAI tyahA~ hareka prakArakA phalaharU prApta hunecha | ra, unIharUkAlAgi unakA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa kSamAdAna pani hunecha | ke yastA vyaktiharU tI vyaktijasto huna sakchan jo sadA AgomA rahanechan jasalAI tAto umla~do pAnI khuvAinecha jasale tinIharUkA AndrAharU nai kATidinecha?

ra, yinIharUmadhye kehI yastA vyaktiharU chan jasale timrA kurAharU kAna thApera sunirAkhchan, yahA~samma ki jaba tinIharU timIbATa haTchan taba jJAnavAna vyaktiharUsita bhanchan– “usale ahile ke bhandai thiyo?” yinIharU nai hun jasakA hRdayaharUmAthi allAhale mohara lagAidiekA chan ra tinIharU Aphno abhilASAko anusaraNa gardaichan |
ani, allAhale mArga prApta vyaktiharUko mArgadarzanamA vRddhi garchan ra unIharUlAI unakA aMzako Izabhaya pradAna garchan |

aba ke yinIharU kevala mahApralayako pratIkSA gardaichan ki tyo yinIharUmAthi akasmAt AilAgos? yasakA nizAnIharU ta prakaTa bhaisakekA chan | tara jaba tinIharUmAthi tyasako Agamana hunecha taba tinIharUkAlAgi upadeza grahaNa garna kunai maukA kahA~ bA~kI rahanecha ra?

ataH (he nabI sa.!) yAda rAkha, allAhabAheka anya kohI pUjya chaina ra kSamA yAcanA gara AphnA pApaharUkAlAgi ra AsthAvAna puruSa tathA mahilAharUkAlAgi pani | allAha timIharUle hi~DaDula garne ra ( sthAyI ) bAsasthAnalAI pani jAndachan |

ra, ImAna lyAekA mAnisaharU bhanchan– “kunai sUraha kina avataraNa gariena?” pheri jaba spaSTa sUraha avataraNa garincha ra tyasamA yuddhako varNana garincha taba hRdayamA ( kapaTako ) roga pAlekA vyaktiharU timItarpha maraNAsanna vyaktile herejhaiM garI herchan | tara tinIharUkolAgi ucita ho....
AjJApAlana ra sadavacana | ani jaba mAmilA (yuddha ) nirdhArita garincha, taba yinIharUle allAha ( ko Adeza ) lAI satya siddha garnu nai yinIharUkailAgi uttama cha |
(allAhako AdezabATa) timIharU bimukha bhaemA dhartImA vidhvaMza maccAunu ra nAtAgotA chinnabhinna pArnu bAheka timIharUbATa ke AzA garna sakincha |
yI nai tinIharU hun jasamAthi allAhako abhizApa pareko cha | ani tinIharUkA zravaNazakti tathA dRSTizakti khosekA chan |
ke tinIharU kuraAnamA cintana–manana gardainan vA tinIharukA hRdayaharUmAthi tAlcAharu lAgeko chan?
mArgadarzana praSTa bhaepachi jasale Aphno piThyU~ phere zaitAnale tinIharUkA lAgi (tinakA duSkarmaharUlAI) sundara pAridiyo ra jhuThA AzAharUko kramalAI phailAidiyo|

yo yasa kAraNale bhayo ki tinI (munAphika) harUle allAhadvArA avatarita dharmaprati ghRNA garneharUlAI bhane– “kehI mAmalAmA hAmI timIharUko AjJApAlana garnechauM” jabaki allAha tinIharUkA gopya kurAharU rAmrarI jAndachan |
ra, tyatikhera tinIharUko ke kasto hAlata hunecha jaba phariztAharUle tinIharUkA anuhAra tathA piThyU~mA hirkAu~dai prANa luchnechan |

yasto yasakAraNale hunecha ki tinIharUle allAhalAI aprasanna tulyAune kurAko anusaraNa gare ra allAhako prasannatAko bATo grahaNa garna mana parAenan | tasartha allAhale tinIharUkA sabai karmaharUlAI naSTa pAridie |,
jasako hRdayamA roga raheko cha, ke allAhale tinIharUko kapaTa prakAzamA lyAune chainan bhanI tinIharu ThAnchan?

ra, yadi hAmIle cAheko bhae tinIharU sabailAI timIsamakSa prakaTa garne thiyauM, ani timIle tinIharUko muhArabATai cinne thiyau | ra, vAstavamA timIle tinIharUko bolne DhaMgale nai cinihAlnechau | ra, allAha timIharUkA sabai karmaharU jAndachan |
nissandeha hAmI timIharUko parIkSA linechau, yahA~samma ki timIharUmadhye jihAda garne tathA dhairyadhAraNa garneharUlAI jAnIhAlauM | ra, timIharUkA avasthAharUko pani jA~ca garihAlauM |

nissandeha jasale kuphra gare ra allAhako mArgabATa mAnisaharUlAI roke, ani rasUlako virodha gare, tyasapazcAt jabaki tinIharUsamakSa mArgadarzana prasTa bhaisakeko thiyo, tinIharUle allAhalAI kunai hAni noksAnI garna sakne chainan, ra cA~Dai nai allAhale tinIharUkA karmaharUlAI naSTa pArnechan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhako AjJApAlana gara ra rasUlako AjJApAlana gara ani AphnA karmaharUlAI vyartha natulyAU |
jasale kuphra gare, allAhako mArgabATa roke, ra kuphrakai avasthAmA mare, allAhale kadApi tinIharUlAI mApha garne chainan |
ataH timIharU sAhasa nagumAU, ra sandhiko AhvAna nagara; vAstavamA timIharU nai vijayI hunechau | ra, allAha timIharUkAsAthamA chan, ani unale kadApi timIharUkA karmaharUlAI barbAda pArne chainan |

sAMsArika jIvana ta khela tamAsA mAtra ho, ra yadi timIharU ImAna lyAu~chau ra Izabhaya rAkhchau bhane allAhale timIharUlAI (yasako) pratidAna dinechan, ra unI timIharUbATa dhanasampattiko mAga gardainan |
yadi unale timIharUsita mAge ra pUrai mAge bhane timIharU kaJjusyAI~ garna thAlnechau | ra, unale timIharUko kapaTa prakAzamA lyAidinechan |

timIharU nai hau jasalAI allAhako mArgamA kharca garna bolAi~dA timIharUmadhye kohI kaJjusyAI~ garna thAlcha | ra, jasale kaJjusyAi~ garcha tyo AphnaivirUddha garcha | ra, allAha sampanna chan, ani timIharU nirdhana chau | ra, yadi timIharU vimukha hunchau bhane unale timIharUko sthAnamA anya samudAyalAI lyAunechan, ani unIharU timIharUjasto hune chainan |
(he muhammada sa.!) nissandeha hAmIle timIlAI spaSTa vijaya pradAna garekA chauM |
tAki allAhale timrA pahile ra pachikA pApaharU mApha garidiUn, timImAthi Aphno anugraha pUrA garidiUn ra timIlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAUn |
ra, allAhale timIlAI prabhAvazAlI sahayoga garUn |

unai hun jasale AsthAvAnaharUko hRdayamA zAnti avatIrNa gare, tAki unIharUle Aphno ImAnamA ajha ImAna thapUn | ra, AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sainyaharU allAhakailAgi hun | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

tAki allAhale AsthAvAna puruSa tathA mahilAharUlAI yastA bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAUn jasako tala tirabATa nadIraharU bagirahekA hunechan, jahA~ unIharU sadA rahanechan | ra, unIharUbATa unakA pApaharUlAI samApta pArUn ra allAhako dRSTimA yo mahAn saphalatA ho |

ra, allAhale tI munAphika puruSa tathA mahilAharUlAI ani muzrika puruSa tathA mahilAharUlAI sajAya~ diUn jo allAhako viSayamA kubhAvanA rAkhdachan | tinIharU saGkaTako cakravyUhamA svayaM pha~se | allAha tinIharUmAthi Akrozita bhae, ani tinIharUlAI dhikkAre ra tinIharUkAlAgi naraka tayAra garidie | ra, yo kati nikRSTa bAsasthAna ho!
ra, allAhakai lAgi chan AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sainyaharU | ra, allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
(he muhammada sa.) nissandeha hAmIle timIlAI sAkSI, zubha–sandezavAhaka ra sacetakakA rUpamA paThAekA chauM |
tAki (he mAnava!) timIharU ImAna lyAU allAhamAthi, unakA rasUlamAthi, unako sAtha deU ra unalAI sammAna gara, ani bihAna tathA belukI unakai mahimAgAna gara |

(he muhammada sa.!) juna mAnisaharU timIsita baiata (zapathagrahaNa) garchan unIharU vAstavamA allAhasita baiata garchan | unIharUkA hAtamAthi allAhako hAta cha | jasale yasa vacanalAI bhaGga garcha tyo AphaiMvirUddha vacana bhaGga garcha | ra, jasale allAhasita gareko vacanalAI pUrA garcha unale tyasalAI avazya mahAn pratidAna pradAna garnechan |

(he muhammada sa.) pachADi chuTekA gAu~leharUle aba timIlAI bhannechan– “hAmIlAI hAmrA dhana–sampatti tathA parivArale vyasta rAkhekA thie | ataH hAmro kSamA yAcanAkolAgi prArthanA garidinuhos |” tinIharU mukhale tyo bhanchan juna tinIharUkA hRdayaharUmA chaina | bhanideU– “yadi allAhale timIharUlAI kunai hAni vA lAbha puryAuna cAhemA kasale allAhaviruddha timIharUkAlAgi kehI garna sakcha ra?” baru allAha timIharUkA kAryaharUbAre pUrNa avagata chan |

barU timIharUle yo ThAnekA thiyau ki rasUla ra mominaharU Aphno parivAratarpha kadApi pharkera Auna sakne chainan | ra, yo kurA timIharUko hRdayalAI khubai rAmro lAgthyo ra timIharUle ati nikRSTa socalAI Azraya diyau | ra, timIharU vinAza huneharU hau |
ra, jasale allAha evaM unakA rasUlamAthi ImAna lyAu~daina hAmIle pani tyastA kAphiraharUkAlAgi dankaMdo Ago tayAra pArekA chauM |
ra, allAhakailAgi hun AkAzaharU tathA dhartIko zAsana | unI jasalAI cAhanchan kSamA dinchan ra jasalAI cAhanchan yAtanA dinchan | ra, allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

jaba timIharU yuddhamA prApta sampatti lina jAnechau taba pachi rahekA mAnisaharUle turuntai bhannechan– “hAmIlAI pani sa~gai jAne anumati dihonus |” yinIharU allAhako AdezalAI parivartana garna cAhanchan | bhanideU– “timIharU hAmIsaMga kahilyai jAna mildaina | allAhale pahile nai yo bhanisakekA chan |” ani yinIharUle bhannechan– “hoina, barU timIharU hAmro DAha garchau |” barU yinIharU sahI kurA kamai bujhchan |

pachADi rahane gAu~leharUlAI bhanideU– “timIharU cA~Dai nai euTA sAhasI yoddhA samudAyavirUddha yuddha garna bolAinechau | ki timIharU tinIharUvirUddha yuddha garnechau ki tinIharUle AtmasamarpaNa garnechan | tyatikhera yadi timIharUle (jihAdako Adezako) pAlanA garyau bhane allAhale timIharUlAI uttama pratidAna dinechan | ra, yadi vigatajastai timIharU vimukha bhayau bhane allAhale timIharUlAI piDAdAyaka yAtanA dinechan |”

andho, laGgaDo ra birAmI jihAdakolAgi prasthAna gardainan bhane kunai Apatti chaina | ra, jasale allAha tathA unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana garcha usalAI unale yastA bagai~cAharUmA praveza garAunechan jasako talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan | ra, jo vimukha huncha tyasalAI unale pIDAdAyI yAtanA dinechan |

nizcaya nai allAha AsthAvAnaharUsita tyasa samaya ati prasanna bhae jaba unIharU vRkSamuni timro hAtamA ‘baiat’ gardai thie | ra, allAha tyasabAre avagata thie jun unIharUko manamA thiyo | ra, unale unIharUmAthi zAnti avataraNa gare, ani unIharUlAI nikaTa bhaviSyamA prApta hune vijaya thapa pradAna gare |
ra, yuddhamA prApta hune dherai dhana–sampatti yinIharUle hAsila garnechan | ra, allAha prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

allAhale timIharUsita yuddhamA prApta hune thuprai dhana–sampattiko vAcA garekA chan, juna timIharUle prApta garnechau | ani yo vijaya unale timIharUlAI cA~Dai pradAna gare | ra, timIharUvirUddha mAnisaharUkA hAtalAI rokidie tAki mominaharUkAlAgi euTA nizAnI hos, ra unale timIharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAUn |
ra arko (vijaya) pani jasako timIharU sAmarthya rAkhdainau | tara allAhale tyasalAI Aphno paridhimA liekA chan | ra, allAha hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
ra, yadi kAphiraharUle timIharUvirUddha yuddha garekA bhae tinIharU piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgne thie | pheri tinIharUle na kunai saMrakSaka–mitra pAune thie ra na sahayogI nai |
yo allAhako kAryavidhi ho juna pahiledekhi nai caldaiAeko cha, ra timIle allAhako kAryavidhimA kunai parivartana pAune chainau |

ra, unI nai hun jasale makkA upatyakAmA tinIharUkA hAta timIharUbATa ra timIharUkA hAta tinIharUbATa roke, jabaki unale timIharUlAI tinIharUmAthi vijaya pradAna garisakekA thie | ra, timIharU juna kArya garchau allAha tyasalAI dekhirahekA chan |

tI tinIharU nai thie jasale kuphra gare, ra timIharUlAI pratiSThita masjidabATa roke, ani balIkA janAvaraharUlAI tyasako balI dine sthAnasamma pugna dienan | yadi (makkAmA) yastA AsthAvAna puruSa ra mahilAharU chan jasalAI timIharU anjAnamA kulcanechau ani yasale timIharU anjAnamai doSI Thaharnechau bhanne AzaMkA nabhaeko bhae hAmI yuddhako Adeza dine thiyauM | (yuddha yasa kAraNale rokiyo ki) allAha jasalAI cAhanchan Aphno dayAmA samAveza garchan | (makkAkA) tI AsthAvAnaharU pRthaka bhaekA bhae makkAbAsIharUmadhye kAphiraharUlAI hAmI pIDAdAyI yAtanA dine thiyauM |

jaba yI kAphiraharUle AphnA hRdayaharUmA pakSapAtalAI bAsa garAe tyo pani ajJAnatAko pakSapAta taba allAhale AphnA rasUla tathA mominaharUmAthi zAnti avatIrNa gare ra mominaharulAI IzabhayamA pratibaddha garAe, kinabhane unIharU nai tyasako baDhI hakadAra ra lAyaka thie | ra, allAha hareka kurAkA jJAtA hun |

vAstavamA allAhale AphnA rasUlalAI nitAnta satyamA AdhArita sapanA dekhAe, ki allAhale cAhemA timIharU AphnA kapAla kaTAera vA kapAla choTyAera nai avazya pratiSThita masjidamA zAntipUrNa DhaGgale praveza garnechau, ra timIharUlAI kunai Dara lAgne chaina | unI tyo kurA jAndathe jun timIharUle jAnekA thienau | tasartha unale timIharUlAI sapanA pUrA hunuaghi euTA najikako vijaya pradAna garidie |
unai hun jasale AphnA rasUlalAI mArgadarzana tathA satya dharmakAsAtha paThAe tAki yasalAI sabai dharmamAthi prabhutva pradAna garUn | ra, sAkSIko rUpamA allAha nai paryApta chan |

muhammada (sa.) allAhakA rasUla hun, ra unIsa~ga bhaekA (sahAbI) harU kAphiraharUviruddha kaThora chan, tara ApasamA bhane ati snehI chan | timIle unIharUlAI sadhaiM rUkUa, sajdA ra allAhako varadAna tathA prasannatAko khojImA vyasta pAunechau | sajdAko prabhAva unIharUko muhAramA dhappa baleko cha, jasabATa unIharU alaggai cininchan | yo ho unIharUko udAharaNa taurAtamA | ra, iJjIlamA unIharUko udAharaNa yasarI diieko cha mAnau euTA khetI cha jasale pahile Aphno aMkura nikAlyo, pheri tyasalAI dRDha tulyAyo | pheri tyo moTo bhayo | pheri Aphno DA~ThamAthi sIdhA khaDA bhayo | jasale kRSakaharUlAI prasanna tulyAyo; (AsthAvAna– harUlAI yo udAharaNa yasa kAraNale diiyo ki) yasale kAphiraharUlAI krodhita tulyAos | allAhale unIharUmadhye AsthAvAna tathA satkarmIharUsita kSamAdAna tathA mahAna pratidAnako vAcA garekA chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAha evaM unakA rasUlabhandA agADi nabaDha | ra, allAhasa~ga DarAU | nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA evaM jJAtA chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! nabIko svarabhandA Aphno svaraharu ucca napAra, ra unIsita carko zailImA kurA nagara jasarI timIharU ApasamA ekaarkAsita carko zailImA garchau anyathA timIharUkA kAryaharU vyartha hunechan ani timIharUlAI tyasako jAnakArI pani hune chaina |

juna mAnisaharU allAhakA rasUlasa~ga kurA gardA Aphno svara sAno pArne garchan unIharU nai tI mAncheharU hun jasakA hRdayaharUlAI allAhale IzabhayakolAgi jA~cekA chan | unIharUkAlAgi kSamAdAna cha ra mahAn pratidAna!
(he muhammada sa.!) juna vyaktiharU timIlAI timro ghara bAhirabATa pukArchan unIharUmadhye dheraijaso vivekahIna chan |
ra tinIharUko najika timI naAuJjela tinIharUle dhairyakA sAtha pratIkSA garekA bhae tyo tinIharUkailAgi uttama hune thiyo | ra, allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAvAna chan |

he AsthAvanaharU ho! yadi kunai avajJAkArIle timIharUsamakSa kunai khabara lyAemA tyasako rAmrarI chAnabina gara | anyathA ajJAnatAvaza timIharU kunai samudAyako hAni garna pugnechau | ani AphUle gareko kAryaprati pazcAtApa garnu parnecha |

ra, jAnirAkha timIharU samakSa allAhakA rasUla upasthita chan | yadi unale adhikatama viSayamA timIharUko kurA mAnemA timIharU svayaM apThyAromA parnechau | tara allAhale timIharUkAlAgi ImAnalAI priya tulyAekA chan ra timIharuko hRdayamA yasalAI zobhanIya banAekA chan | ra, kuphra, pApa tathA avajJAlAI timIharUkAlAgi apriya tulyAekA chan | yI mAnisaharU nai vAstavamA satmArgamA chan |
yo allAhako kRpA tathA upakArale gardA ho | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, yadi AsthAvAnaharUkA duI samUha ApasamA laDAi garchan bhane timIharU unIharUbIca samjhautA garAU | ani yadi euTA samUhale arko samUhamAthi atyAcAra garcha bhane timIharU sabai atyAcArI samUhavirUddha laDAI gara yahA~samma ki unIharU allAhako Adezatarpha pharkiun | ra unIharU pharkanchan bhane tinIharuko bIcamA nyAyapUrNa samjhautA garAU ra nyAya gara | nissandeha allAha nyAyIharUlAI mana parAu~chan |
AsthAvAnaharU eka arkAkA dAjubhAiharU hun | tasartha AphnA duI dAjubhAibIca melamilApa garAu | ra, allAhako bhayarAkha tAki timIharUmAthi dayA gariyos |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! puruSako kunai samUhale arko samUhako upahAsa nagarUn | sambhava cha ki unIharU tinIharUbhandA uttama hoUn | ra, na mahilAharUle mahilAharUko upahAsa garUn | sambhava cha ki unIharU tinIharUbhandA uttama hoUn | na eka ApasamA vyaGga gara, na paraspara eka arkAlAI narAmro nAmale pukAra, ImAna lyAisakepachi "avajJAkArI" ko saMjJA ati nikRSTa ho | ra, jo ( yasto kAryabATa ) prAyazcita gardainan tinIharU atyAcArI hun |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! adhikAMza anumAnaharu bATa bacne gara | kinabhane kehI anumAna pApa hunchan, ra jAsUsI nagara | ra, timIharUmadhye kasaile kasaiko cuklI nalagAos | ke timIharUmadhye kohI Aphno mRta bhAiko mAsu khAna rUcAu~cha? timIharU tyasalAI avazya ghRNA garchau| ra, allAhako bhaya rAkha | nissandeha allAha prAyazcita svIkArakartA tathA parama dayAlu chan |

he mAnava! hAmIle timIharUlAI eka puruSa tathA eka strIbATa sRSTi garyauM ra timIharUkA vibhinna jAti tathA baMza banAyauM, tAki timIharU eka arkAlAI cinna saka | vAstavamA allAhako dRSTimA timIharUmadhye sarvAdhika pratiSThita tyo vyakti ho jo timIharUmadhye sabaibhandA adhika Izabhaya rAkhcha | nissandeha allAha sarvajJa tathA susUcita chan |

yI gAu~leharU bhanchan “hAmIle ImAna lyAyauM |” (he muhammada sa.!) bhanideU– “timIharUle ImAna lyAekA chainau, baru yo bhana ki hAmI AjJAkArI bhayauM | ahile samma timIharUko hRdayamA ImAna pasekai chaina | ra, yadi timIharU allAha tathA unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana garchau bhane allAha timIharUko karmalAI kama A~kne chainan | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM param dayAlu chan |”

vAstavamA AsthAvAna ta tI vyaktiharU hun jasale allAha tathA unakA rasUlamAthi ImAna lyAe, ani unIharUle kunai zaGkAmA parenan, ra Aphno dhana–sampatti ra jyAnasameta lagAera allAhako mArgamA jihAda gare, unIharU nai saccA hun |

(he nabI sa.!) bhanideU– “ke timIharU Aphno dharmako bAremA allAhalAI jAnakArI diirahekA chau, jabaki allAha AkAzaharU tathA pRthvImA rahekA hareka cijalAI jAndachan | ra, allAha hareka vastukA jJAtA hun |

yinIharU timImAthi upakAra dekhAu~chan ki yinIharU musalamAna bhae | bhanideU– “Aphno islAma lyAeko upakAra mamAthi nadekhAU, baru yo ta allAhale timIharUmAthi upakAra garekA chan ki unale timIharUlAI ImAnako mArga dekhAe yadi timIharU satyavAdI hau bhane |
nissandeha allAha AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA adRzyalAI jAndachan, ra timIharU jejati garchau allAha sabai dekhirahekA chan |
kApha0; pratiSThita kuraAnako kasama |
hoina, baru yinIharUlAI Azcarya yasa kurAprati bhayo ki yinIharUmadhyebATa nai yinIharUmAjha ekajanA sacetaka Ae | ani kAphiraharUle bhane– “yo ta Azcaryajanaka kurA ho |”
“ke jaba hAmI marchauM ra mATo banna pugchauM (taba hAmI punaH uThAinchauM)? yo pUnarjIvana ta ati parako kuro ho |”
bhUmile yinIharUmadhye jejati kama garcha tyo hAmIlAI thAhA cha, ra hAmIkahA~ (sabai thoka) surakSita rAkhne khAtA cha |
baru yinIharUle nitAnta satyalAI tyatikhera nai mithyA Thahara garidie jaba tyo yinIharUsamakSa Ayo | ataH yinIharU dvividhAmA chan |
ke tinIharUle AphUmAthi raheko AkAzalAI dekhenan ki hAmIle tyasalAI kasto banAekA chauM; tyasalAI kasarI su–sajjita pArekA chauM ani tyasamA kunai chidra chaina |
ra, pRthvIlAI hAmIle phaisalAyau~, ani tyasamA parvataharU jamAyau~ | ra, tyasamA hAmIle nAnA tharikA manamohaka cijaharU umAryau~ |
allAha tarpha pharkana cAhane hareka bhaktakolAgi A~khA kholne tathA pATha sikAune sAdhanako rupamA |
ra, hAmIle AkAzabATa barakatayukta pAnI barsAyauM, ani tyasadvArA bagaiMcAharU tathA kATine annaharU umAryauM |
ra khajUrakA aglA aglA vRkSaharU jasamA ekamAthi arko jhuNDiekA phalakA jhuppAharU chan |
bhaktaharUko AjIvikAkolAgi | ra, hAmIle pAnIdvArA murdA nagaralAI jIvita pAryauM | yasarI nai (cihAnabATa) bAhirinu cha |
yinIharUbhandA pahile pani mithyA Thahara garisakekA chan nUhako samudAya, rasakA bAsindAharU, samUdale |
ra Ada, phiraauna ra lutakA bhAibandhuharUle |
ra aikAbAsIharU ra tubbaakA samudAyale pani | tinIharU sabaile rasUlaharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare | tasartha mero (tinIharumAthi yAtanAko) mero dhamkI sthApita bhayo |
ke pahilo paTaka sRSTi garnabATa hAmI asamartha rahyau~? hoina, baru yinIharU punarAvRtibAre sandehamA chan |
ra hAmIle mAnisako sRSTi garekA chauM, ra tyasako manamA utpanna hune vicAraharUlAI pani hAmI jAndachauM | ra, hAmI tyasako gardhanako nasAbhandA pani nikaTa rahekA chauM |
ra, yAda rAkha duIjanA lekhanadAsa tyasakA dAyA~ ra bAyA~ basI hareka kurA lekhirahekA chan |
(mAnisale) mukhabATa kunai zabda nikAlna pani pAekA hu~daina tara tyasanajika euTA nirIkSaka tainAta huncha |
ra, mRtyuko behozIle nitAnta satya liera Aipugeko cha | yahI tyo cija ho jasabATa timI umkana khojthyau |
ra sUra phukiMyo| yahI tyo dina ho jasako timIlAI Dara dekhAinthyo |
ra, pratyeka vyakti Ayo, yasa avasthAmA ki usa~ga ekajanA lyAunevAlA ani eka janA sAkSI chan |
nissandeha timI yasa viSayamA anabhijJa thiyau tara hAmIle timrosAmu raheko pardA haTAidiekA chauM ra Aja timro dRSTizakti ati teja huna pugeko cha |
ra usako sAthIle bhannecha masa~ga bhaeko jejati cha tyo upasthita cha |
(Adeza huncha)– timI duvai milera phyA~kideU narakamA hare kasatyako zatru kAphiralAI |
bhalAikA kAryabATa rokne, sImA ullaGghanakArI ra sandehamA parekAlAI |
jasale allAhasa~ga arUlAI pUjya banAeko thiyo | ataH timI duvai tyasalAI kaThora yAtanAmA homideU |
usako sAthI (zaitAna) le bhannecha– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! maile yasalAI pathabhraSTa gareko thiina~ | baru yo svayaM gherai TADhA ko pathabhraSTatAmA thiyo |”
allAhale bhannechan– “ timIharU merosAmu vAdavivAda nagara | maile pahile nai timIlAI (yAtanAko) Dara dekhAisakeko thie~ | "
makahA~ kurA parivartana gariMdaina, ra ma AphnA bhaktaharUmAthi kadApi kunai prakArako anyAya gardina |
tyasa dina hAmIle narakasita sodhnechauM– “ke ta~ bharipUrNa bhais?” tyasale uttara dinecha– “ke ajhai kohI bA~kI cha ra?”
ra, svargalAI dharmaniSTha mAnisaharUko nikaTa lyAinecha, tyo TADhA rahane chaina |
“yo tyahI nai ho jasako vAcA timIharUsita garieko thiyo pratyeka tyasa vyaktikolAgi jo unItarpha lamkanthyo ra AdezalAI yAda rAkhdathyo |
jo karUNAmaya (allAha) sita unalAI nadekhikana DarAu~thyo ra (unaitarpha) pharkiraheko hRdayakAsAtha Ayo |
nizcintakAsAtha svargamA praveza gara | yo zAzvata divasa ho |
unIharUkAlAgi tyahA~ tI sabai sukhasAmagrI hunechan juna unIharU cAhanchan, ra hAmIkahA~ thapa pani cha |

ra, yinIharUbhandA pahile hAmIle katipaya samudAyaharUlAI naSTa pAryau~ jo yinIharUbhandA adhika zaktizAlI thie, ra saMsArakA dezaharUmA khubai ghumaphira gare | ke tinIhalAI zaraNakolAgi kunai ThAu~ rahyo?
nizcaya nai yasamA zikSA raheko cha pratyeka vyaktikolAgi josa~ga hRdaya cha, ra jo pUrNa upasthitikAsAtha dhyAnapUrvaka kurA sundacha |
vAstabamA hAmIle AkAzaharU tathA pRthvI ra yI duvaibIcakA cijaharUlAI cha dinamA sRSTi garekA chau~ | ra, hAmIlAI kunai thakAnale choena |
ataH (he muhammada sa.!) juna kurA yinIharU garchana tyasamA dhairya dhAraNa gara | AphnA pAlanakartAko prazaMsAkA sAtha unako mahimAgAna sUrya udAunu ra astAunubhandA aghi garne gara |
ra, rAtako samayamA unako mahimAgAna gara, ani sajdA (namAja) pachi pani |
ra, dhyAnapUrvaka suna, juna dina pukArnevAlAle najikaiko sthAnabATa pukArnechan |
tyasa dina sabai mAnisaharUle sUrako bhayaMkara AvAja sunnechan tyahI hunecha (dhartIbATa murdAharU) niskane dina |
nissandeha hAmI nai jIvana dinchau~ ra hAmI nai mRtyu dinchau~ | ra, hAmIkahA~ nai pharkera Aunucha |
tyasa dina dhartI tinIharUmAthi ati tivratAkAsAtha phATne cha,| yo bhelA garnu hAmrolAgi ati sahaja cha |

(he muhammada sa.!) juna kurAharU yinIharUle garirahekA chan tyo hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM, ra timI unIharUlAI bAdhya tulyAunevAlA hoinau | ataH jo mero cetAvanIsa~ga DarAu~chan tinIharulAI kuraAnadvArA upadeza deU |
dhUlo uDAune tibra hAvAko kasama |
ani jasale pAnI bokeko bAdala vahana garcha |
ani namratA pUrvaka vahancha |
ani ThUlo kArya (varSA) ko vitaraNa garcha |
nisandeha timIharUlAI juna kurAbATa Dara dekhAIMdaicha tyo pUrNatayA satya ho |
ra, karmaphala avazya sAmunne Aune nai cha |
mArgaharUvAlA AkAzako kasama!
vAstavamA timIharU matabhedamA chau |
(janmajAta) bimukha garieko byakti nai yasabATa bimukha huncha |
galata anumAna garne vyaktiharU vinAza bhae |
jo pathabhraSTatAmA (paralokalAI) birsirahekA chan |
tinIharU sodhchan– “badalA diine dina kahile AulA?”
yo tyo dina hunecha jaba tinIharUlAI AgomA jA~ca garine cha |
timIharu Aphno yAtanAlAI cAkha, yasaikolAgi timIharU hatAra gardaithiyau |
nissandeha Izabhaya rAkhneharU bagai~cA tathA mUlaharUbIca hunechan |
unakA pAlanakartAle diirahekA vardAnaharu svIkAra garne chan | vAstavamA yinIharU yasaaghi sukarmana garneharu thie |
unIharU rAti thorai sutne garthe |
ra, bihAnako samayamA kSamA yAcanA garne garthe |
ra, unIharUko dhana–sampattimA bhikhArI tathA abhAvagrasta vyaktiko hissA hunthyo |
ra, vizvAsIharUkAlAgi dhartImA dherai nizAnIharU chan |
ra, svayaM timIharUko astitvamA pani | ke timIharU dekhdainau?
ra, AkAzamA cha timIharUkAlAgi jIvikA tathA tyo cija pani cha timIharUsita jasako vAcA garincha |
AkAza tathA pRthvIkA mAlikako kasama! yo vAcA tyastai satya ho jasto timIharU kurA gardaichau |
(he sandeSTA!) ke timIlAI ibrAhImakA AdaraNIya atithIharUko vRttAnta prApta bhaeko cha?
jaba unIharU ibrAhImakahA~ puge taba unIharUle bhane– “tapAIMlAI salAma hos!” unale uttara die– “tapAIMharUlAI pani salAma hos |” tapAIharu aparicita vyaktiharU hunuhuncha |”
pheri unI suTukka AphnA parivAratarpha gae ra euTA bhuTeko moTo bAccho liera Ae |
ani unIharUsamakSa peza gare ( tara unIharU khAenan taba) sodhe– “ke tapAIMharU khAnu hunna?”
ani unIharubATa unako manamA AzaMkA lAgyo | unIharUle bhane– “naDarAU!" sAthai unIharUle unIkahA~ euTA jJAnI putrako zubhasUcanA die |
yo sunera unakI patnI cicyAu~dai Ain ra Aphno muhAramA hAta hirkAu~dai bhanin– “ (ma ta eka) buDhI, bA~jhI hU~!"
unIharUle bhane– “a~, timrA pAlanakartAle yastai bhanekA chan | nissandeha unI tatvadarzI evaM sarvajJa chan |
ibrAhImale bhane–“he phariztAharU ho! aba timIharUko uddezya ke cha?”
unIharUle javApha die– “hAmIlAI euTA aparAdhI samudAyatarpha paThAieko cha |
tAki hAmI tinIharUmAthi mATole banekA DhuGgA barsAauM |
timrA pAlanakartAkahA~ cinha lagAiekA chan maryAdAhina mAnisaharUkA lAgi |
ani tyahA~ jati pani AsthAvAnaharU thie tI sabailAI hAmIle nikAlyauM |
ra, hAmIle tyahA~ muslimaharUko euTA mAtra ghara pAyauM |
ra, tyasamA hAmIle pIDAdAyI yAtanAsa~ga DarAuneharUkAlAgi nizAnI choDidiyauM |
ra mUsAko vRttAntamA pani (upadeza cha), jaba hAmIle unalAI spaSTa pramANakAsAtha phiraaunakahA~ paThAyauM |
ani tyo Aphno zaktiko bharamA vimukha bhayo ra bhanyo ki ta U jAdUgara ho vA unmAdI |
hAmIle usalAI ra usakA sainyaharUlAI samAtyauM ani sabailAI samudramA phyA~kyauM yasa avasthAmA ki U tiraskRta thiyo |
ra, AdamA (nizAnIcha) jaba hAmIle tinIharUmAthi bA~jho hAvA paThAyau~|
tyo jasamAthi calthyo tyasalAI dhvasta napArikana chADdaina thiyo |
ra, samUdamA pani jaba tinIharUlAI bhaniyo– “eka nizcita samaya avadhikolAgi lAbhAnvita hoU |
taba tinIharUle AphnA pAlanakartAkA Adezako avahelanA gare | antataH tinIharUle herdAherdai tinIharUlAI karkaza dhvanile samAtyo |
ani tinIharUmA na ubhine zakti rahyo na tinIharUle Aphno bacAu nai garna sake |
ra, yinIharUbhandA pahile hAmIle nUhakA samudAyalAI pani (naSTa pAryauM) kinabhane tinIharU avajJAkArI thie |
ra, AkAzalAI hAmIle Aphnai hAtabATa banAyauM ra hAmI tyasalAI nirantara phailAudaichau~ |
ra pRthvIlAI hAmIle bichAekAchauM ra hAmIla kati uttama samatala kartA hau~ |
ra, pratyeka cijalAI hAmIle joDI joDI banAekA chauM AzA cha timIharU (yasabATa) zikSA grahaNa garnechau |
ataH timIharU phurtilo gatimA allAhatarpha nai pharka | ma timIharUkAlAgi unako tarphabATa spaSTa sacetaka hu~ |
ra, allAhabAheka anya kasailAI upAsya nabanAU | nizcaya nai ma unako tarphabATa timIharUkAlAgi spaSTa sacetaka hu~ |
yasarI nai yinIharUbhandA aghikA samudAyasamakSa juna rasUla Ae pani unIharule unalAI jAdUgara vA unmAdI nai bhane |
ke tinIharUle eka–arkAlAI yasai kurAko upadeza diekA chan? baru yinIharU vidrohI samudAya hun |
ataH he sandeSTA! yinIharUko vevAstA gara | timImAthi kunai doSa lAgne chaina |
ra upadeza di~dai gara kinabhane upadezale AsthAvAnaharUlAI avazya lAbhAnvita tulyAu~cha |
ra, maile jinna tathA mAnavalAI kevala Aphno upAsanAkolAgi sRSTi gareko hu~ |
ma tinIharUbATa kunai jIvikA cAha~dina; na yo cAhanchu ki tinIharUle malAI khuvAUn |
nissaMdeha allAha svayaM mahAn jIvikA pradAnakartA tathA ati zaktizAli chan |
ataH atyAcArIharUko bhAgamA pani tyahi cha jasto tinIharUkA sAthIharUlAI prApta bhaeko thiyo | ataH tinIharUle yasakolAgi masa~ga hatAra nagarUn |
ataH sarvanAza cha kAphiraharUkAlAgi tyasa dinamA jasabATa tinIharUlAI Dara dekhAi~daicha |
tUrako kasama!
ra, lekhieko granthako kasama |
khullA pAnAmA |
ra, AbAda gharako kasama!
ra, ucca chAnAko kasama!
ra, taraGgita samudrako kasama!
timrA pAlanakartAko prakopa avazya Aunecha |
yasalAI kasaile haTAuna sakdaina |
juna dina AkAza thara thara kAmnecha |
ra, parvataharU calirahane cha |
ataH sarvanAza cha tyasadina mithyA Thahara garneharUkolAgi |
jo vyartha kurAharUmA lAgera kheldaichan |
juna dina tinIharUlAI dhakeldai narakako Agotarpha laginecha ‌|
(tinIharulAI bhaninecha)– “yo tyahI Ago ho jasalAI timIharU mithyA Thahara garne garthyau |”
(aba batAU)– “ke yo jAdU ho? vA timIharU dekhirahekA chainau?”
timIharu tyasamA DaDha | aba timIharU cAhe dhairya gara vA nagara barAbara cha | timIharUlAI tyastai badalA diIMdaicha jasto karma timIharU garne garthyau |
nissandeha dharmaniSTha mAnisaharU bagaiMcA tathA vaibhavamA hunechan |
AphnA pAlanakartAle pradAna garekA cijaharUbATa Ananda liirahekA hunechan, ra unakA pAlanakartAle unalAI dankado AgobATa bacAunechan |
(unIharUlAI bhaninecha)– “Anandale khAU ra piU tI kAryaharUko pratidAnasvarUpa juna timIharU garne garthyau |
Amunne–sAmunne bichyAekA gaddIharUmAthi sirAnI lagAera DhalkiekA hunechan ra hAmIle unIharUko vivAha ThUlA–ThUlA AMkhA bhaekI apsarAharusita garidinechauM |

juna mAnisaharUle ImAna lyAe ra unIharUkA santAnaharUle pani ImAnako avasthAmA unIharUko padacinhako anusaraNa gare hAmI unIharUkA santAnaharU lAI unIharUsa~ga milAunechauM, ra unIharUkA karmaharUmA pani kunai kamI garne chainauM | pratyeka vyakti Aphnai karmako saTTAmA bandhaka cha |
ra, juna phalaphUla tathA mAsu unIharU mana parAu~chan tyo hAmI prazasta mAtrAmA pradAna garnechauM |
unIharU tyahA~ paraspara madya–pAtra liirahekA hunechan, jasamA na apazabda hunecha na duzcaritratA nai |
unIharUko varipari unIharUko sevAkonimti unIharUkolAgi vizeSa sundara bAlakaharU ghumirahekA hunechan, mAnauM tI chopera rAkhiekA motI hun |
unIharU eka arkAtira pharkiera paraspara sodhapucha garirahekA hunechan |
unIharUle bhannechan– “yasaaghi hAmI AphnA parivArabhitra DarAu~dai jIvanayApana gardathyauM |
ataH allAhale hAmImAthi kRpA gare ra hAmIlAI lUko yAtanAbATa bacAe |
pachillo jIvanamA pani hAmI unailAI pukArne garthyau~ | unI vAstavamA atyanta upakArI evaM parama dayAlu chan |
ataH he muhammada sa.! upadeza diMdai gara | timI AphnA pAlanakartAko kRpAle na jyotiSI hau ra na kunai unmAdI nai |
ke yI kAphiraharU bhanchan– “yo kavi ho | hAmI yasamAthi samayako kAlacakra ko pratIkSA gardaichauM |”
bhanideU– “pratIkSA gara, ma pani timIharUsa~ga pratIkSA gardachu |”
ke yinIharUko buddhile yinIharUlAI yahI kurA sikAu~cha vA yinIharU vAstavamA sImo ullaGghanakArI nai hun?
ke yinIharU yasale kuraAna AphaiM raceko ho bhanera bhanchan? vAstavika kurA ke ho bhane yinIharU ImAna lyAuna cAha~dainan |
yadi yinIharU Aphno kathanamA saccA chan bhane yastai kisimako euTA vANI banAera lyAUn |
ke yinIharUko sRSTi vinA AdhAra nai bhaeko? vA yinIharU AphaiM sraSTA hun?
vA AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIlAI yinIharUle sRSTi garekA hun? baru yinIharU vizvAsa nai rAkhdainan |
ke timrA pAlanakartAko khajAnA yinIharUko niyantraNamA cha? vA yinIharU nai niyantraka hun?
ke yinIharUsa~ga yasto bharyAGga cha jasako mAdhyamabATa (mAthillo lokako kurA) kAna thApera sunne garchan? ho bhane sunne vyaktile spaSTa pramANa lyAos |
ke unako (allAhako lAgi) chorIharU chan ra timIharUkA lAgi chorAharU?
(he sandeSTA!) ke timI yinIharUbATa kunai pratidAna mAgchau ki yinIharU tyasa jarivAnAko bhArImuni dabina pugekA chan?
ke yinIharUlAI parokSako jJAna prApta cha jasalAI yinIharU lekhne gardachan?
ke yinIharU kunai SaDyantra garna cAhanchan? ho bhane, yI kAphiraharU svayaM SaDyantrakA zikAra hunechan |
ke yinIharU allAbAheka anya kunai upAsya rAkhdachan? allAha pavitra chan tyasa zirkabATa juna yinIharUle garchan |
yinIharUle AkAzabATa prakopako kunai TukrA khasiraheko dekhe pani yahI bhanchan ki yo tahai–taha pareko bAdala ho |
ataH (he sandeSTA!) yinIharUlAI yinIharukai avasthAmA choDideU | yahA~samma ki yinIharU tyasa dinalAI dekhUn juna dina yinIharU behosa hunechan |
juna dina na yinIharUko juktile yinIharUlAI kunai lAbha puryAunecha ra na yinIharUko kunai sahayoga nai garinecha |
ra atyAcArIharUkAlAgi yasabAheka arU yAtanA pani cha tara yinIharUmadhye adhikAMza jAndainan |

(he muhammada sa.!) AphnA pAlanakartAko Adeza AuJjelasamma dhairya dhAraNa gara, kinabhane timI hAmro A~khA sAmunne chau | ani jaba timI ubhinchau AphnA pAlanakartAko prazaMsAkAsAtha mahimAgAna gara |
ra rAtamA pani unako mahimAgAna gara ra tArAharU astAune samayamA pani |
tArAko kasama jaba tyo astAuMcha |
timIharUkA sAthI na pathabhraSTa bhaekA chan na bahakiekA chan |
ra unI Aphno icchAle boldainan |
yo ta prakAzanA ho juna avatIrNa garincha |
unalAI sikAe atyanta zaktizAlIle
zaktimAna (jibraIla), ani unI (praSTa rupamA) sIdhA khaDA bhae |
jaba unI mAthillo kSitijamA thie |,
pheri unI najika puge ani jhuNDie |
yahA~samma ki unI duI dhanuSa barAbara vA tyasabhandA pani kama dUrImA rahe |
taba unale allAhakA bhaktalAI tyo prakAzanA (vahya) puryAe juna unale puryAunu thiyo |
je unale dekhe hRdayale tyasalAI jhUTho Thahara garena |
aba, ke timIharU tyasa kurAmA unIsita vAdavivAda garchau juna unI dekhchan?
jabaki unalAI ta ajha ekapaTaka dekhekA thie |
‘sidratulamuntahA’ ( aMtima bayarako vRkSa) najika |
jahA~ jannatulamaavA avasthita cha |
jabaki bayarako vRkSalAI euTA DhAkne cijale DhAkiraheko thiyo |
na A~khA bhramamA paryo, ra na sImA ullaMghana nai garyo |
ra vAstavamA unale AphnA pAlanakartAkA ThUlA nizAnIharU dekhe |
“ke timIharUle ‘lAta’ tathA ‘ujajA’ kA bAremA vicAra garyau?
arko tesro manAtako bAremA pani |
ke timIharUkAlAgi chorAharU chan ra unakA (allAhakA) lAgi cAhi~ chorIharU?
yo banDA ta dherai anyAyapUrNa bhayo |

vAstavamA yI timIharUle ra timIharUkA purkhAharUle rAkhekA kehI nAma mAtra hun | yasabAremA allAhale kunai pramANa avatarita garekA chainan | yinIharU kevala anumAna tathA manokAMkSAharuko anusaraNa gardaichan jabaki tinIharukA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa tinIharUsamakSa mArgadarzana Aipugeko cha |
ke mAnisa je kAmanA garcha tyo usalAI prApta huncha ra?
allAha nai paraloka ra lokako pani svAmI hun |

ra, AkAzaharUmA aMginta phariztAharU chan jasako siphArizale kunai phAidA puryAuna sakdaina | tara allAhako AjJApachi mAtra, ra jasakA lAgi unI cAhanchan ra (juna siphArisa kartAbATa) prasanna hunchan |
tara juna mAnisaharU AkhiratalAI mAndainan, tinIharU phariztAharUlAI strIko saMjJA dinchan |
jaba ki yasa bAremA tinIharUlAI kunai jJAna prApta chaina | tinIharU kevala anumAnako anusaraNa gardaichan ra anumAnale nitAnta satyabATa nispRha pArna sakne chaina |
(he muhammada sa.!) tI mAnisaharUlAI bevAstA gara jo hAmro smaraNabATa vimukha hunchan ra jo sAMsArika jIvanabAheka anya kunai pani kurAko abhilASI hoinan |
yo tinIharUko jJAnako antima sImA ho | timrA pAlanakartA Aphno pathabATa bhraSTa bhaekAlAI rAmrarI jAndachan ra Aphno mArgamA rahekAlAI pani |
ra, allAhakai hun jejati AkAzaharUmAchan ra jejati pRthvImAchan, tAki allAhale duSkarma garneharUlAI tinIharukA karmaharUko badalA diUn ra puNyakarma garneharUlAI uttama pratidAna pradAna garUn |

juna mAnisaharU ThUlA pApaharU ra nirlajjatAko kurAbATa bacne garchan, sAnAtinA bhUlacUkako kurAharu bAheka | nizcaya nai (tinIharukAlAgi) kSamAdAnamA timrA pAlanakartA ati udAra chan | unI timIharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan | jaba unale timIharUlAI dhartIbATa sRSTi gare ra jaba timIharU A–AphnA AmAharUkA garbhamA bhrUNa thiyau | ataH timI svayaM AphailAI pavitra naThAna | unI Izabhaya rAkhneharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |
ke timIle tyasa vyaktilAI dekhyau jo vimukha bhayo?
ani, alikati diyo ra rokyo?
