ani, ke timIharUle vicAra garyau juna khetI timIharU lagAuMchau...
tyasalAI timIharU umArchau vA hAmI umArnevAlA hauM?
hAmIle cAhemA yasalAI bhusamA pariNata garna sakchauM ani timIharU chakka parnechau |
(hAya!) hAmI ta jarivAnAmA paryauM |
baru hAmI ta vaJcita pAriyau~ |
ke timIharUle vicAra garyau, juna pAnI timIharU khAnchau...
ke tyasalAI bAdalabATa timIharU barsAu~chau vA tyasalAI barsAune hAmI hauM?
hAmIle cAhemA yasalAI bilakula nunilo banAuna sakchauM pheri pani timIharU kina kRtajJa bandainau |
a~, ke timIharUle bicAra garyau, juna Ago timIharU bAlchau...
ke tyasako rukha timIharUle sRSTi garekA chau vA tyasako sRSTikartA hAmI hauM?
hAmIle tyasa (vRkSa) lAI upadeza tathA yAtrIharUko lAgi asthAyI sAdhana banAekA chauM |
ataH he sandeSTA! AphnA mahAn pAlanakartAko nAmako mahimAgAna gara |
ataH hoina, ma tArAharUko sthAnaharUko kasama khAnchu!
ra, yo euTA ThUlo kasama ho yadi timIharUlAI thAhA bhae |
nissandeha yo pratiSThita kuraAna ho |
euTA surakSita granthamA aGkita |
jasalAI pavitra(phariztA)harUbAheka arU kasaile chunasakdaina |
ra, sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartAko tarphabATa avataraNa garieko ho |
ani ke timIharU yasa vANIko upekSA gardachau?
ra, timIharUle mithyA Thahara garnu nai Aphno aMza banAekA chau |
yadi yasto chaina bhane, jaba prANa ghA~TIsamma Aipugcha...
ra tyatikhera timIharU dekhirahekA hunchau...
ra, hAmI timIharUko tulanAmA tyasa vyaktiko baDhI nikaTa hunchauM tara timIharU (hAmIlAI) dekhdainau |
pheri yasto kina hu~daina, yadi timIharU kasaiko adhinamA chainau bhane...
ki tyasa prANalAI pharkAU yadi yasa kurAmA timIharU saccA hau bhane |
ani, yadi U (allAhako) nikaTatA prApta vyaktiharUmadhye cha bhane...
(usako lAgi) Ananda, sugandha ra vaibhavapUrNa svarga rahekocha |
ra, yadi U dAyA~ hAtavAlAharUmadhye Thahara huncha bhane...
(usako svAgata huncha) “salAma hos timImAthi, he dAyA~ hAtavAlA |”
ra, yadi U mithyAvAdIharU pathabhraSTaharUmadhye Thahara bhayo bhane...
usako Atithya satkAra umla~do pAnI...
ra narakamA hominu ho |
nizcaya nai yo parama satya ho |
ataH he sandeSTA! AphnA mahAn pAlanakartAko nAmako mahimAgAna gara |
allAhako tasbIha (mahimAgAna) gardachan tI sabai cijaharU jo AkAzaharU tathA dhartImA chan | ra, unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA mAlika unai hun | unaile jIvana pradAna garchan ra mRtyu dinchan | ra, unalAI pratyeka cijako sAmarthya prApta cha |
unai prathama pani hun ra antima pani | ra, dRzya pani chan evaM adRzya pani | ra, unalAI pratyeka cijako jJAna cha |

unai hun jasale AkAzaharU ra pRthvIlAI cha dinamA sRSTi gare ani siMhAsanamA virAjamAna bhae | jejati pRthvImA praveza garcha ra jejati tyasabATa bAhira niskancha ra jejati AkAzabATa avatIrNa huncha ani jejati tyasatarpha Arohita huncha tI sabaiko unalAI jJAna cha | timIharU jahA~ rahe pani unI timIharUkA sAtha hunchan | ra, timIharU juna kArya garchau tyasalAI allAha herirahanchan |
AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko zAsana unaikolAgi ho | ra, sabai kAryaharU unaitarpha pharkAinchan |
unale nai rAtalAI dinamA praveza garAu~chan ra dinalAI rAtamA | ra, unI hRdayakA bhedaharUsameta jAndachan |

ataH ImAna lyAU allAhamAthi ra unakA rasUlamAthi, ani kharca gara tyasa dhanamadhye jasako uttarAdhikArI allAhale timIharUlAI banAekA chan | ataH timIharUmadhye jasale ImAna lyAunecha ra kharca garnecha usakolAgi ThUlo puNya rahekocha |

ani timIharU allAhamAthi ImAna kina lyAu~dainau jabaki svayaM rasUla timIharUlAI timIharUko pAlanakartAmAthi ImAna lyAuna AhvAna garirahekA chan? ra, timIharUlAI vizvAsa cha bhane unale timIharUsita dRDha pratijJA pani garisakekA chan |
unai hun jo AphnA bhaktamAthi spaSTa AyataharU avatarita garchan tAki timIharUlAI andhakArabATa prakAzamA lyAUn ra allAha timIharUprati ati namra evaM parama dayAlu chan |

timIharUlAI ke bhaeko cha ki timIharU allAhako mArgamA kharca gardainau jabaki AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIko Adhipatya allAhakai raheko cha? timIharU makkAko vijayaaghi kharca ra yuddha garneharUsa~ga barAbara huna sakdainau | tinIharU ta makkAko vijayapachi kharca tathA yuddha garneharUbhandA ati ucca darjAmA chan tara uttama pratidAnako vAcA ta sabaisita raheko cha | ra jejati timIharU garirahekA chau tI sabaibAre allAha avagata chan |
ko cha jasale allAhalAI uttama RNa deos tAki unale tyasalAI kaiyauM guNA baDhAera pradAna garUn? ra, yasto vyaktikolAgi mahAn pratidAna cha |

mahApralayako dina timIle momina puruSaharU tathA momina mahilAharUlAI dekhnechau unakA agADi ra unakA dAyA~tarpha prakAza dauDirahekocha | (unIharUlAI bhaninecha)– Aja timIharUlAI yasto jannatako zubhasUcanA cha jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan jasamA timIharU sadA rahanechau | yo nai ho mahAn saphalatA |

tyasa dina munAphika puruSa evaM mahilAharUle AsthAvAnaharUlAI bhannechan– “hAmro pratIkSA gara tAki hAmI pani timIharUko prakAzabATa lAbhAnvita hoauM |” javApha diinecha–timIharU pachADi pharka ra prakAzako khojI gara | pheri yI duvaibIca euTA aglo parkhAla khaDA garinecha, jasamA DhokA pani hunecha, jasako bhitrI bhAgamA dayA hunecha, ra sAmunnebATa bAhirI bhAgamA yAtanA |

munAphikaharUle karAera mominaharUlAI bhannechan– “ke hAmI timIharUkA sAthamA thienauM?” unIharUle bhannechan– “ho thiyau tara timIharUle svayaMlAI utpIDanamA pha~sAekA thiyau ra pratIkSAmA ra sandehagrasta rahyau | ra, timIharUlAI jhUTho AkAMkSAharUle dhokAmai rAkhyau yahA~samma ki allAhako Adeza Aipugyo ra timIharUlAI dhokA dinele allAhako bAremA dhokAmai rAkhyo |
ataH Aja kunai ‘phidayA’ (artha–daNDa) kabula garine chaina; na timIharUko na kAphiraharUko | ra, timIharUko bAsasthAna naraka ho | yahI timIharUko saMrakSaka ho ra yo kati nikRSTa bAsasthAna ho |

ke AsthAnavAnaharUkA lAgi allAhako smaraNa tathA avatarita bhaeko nitAnta satyaprati unIharUko hRdaya namra hune samaya Aipugeko chaina ra? ra, yinIharU tI vyaktiharUjasto nahoUn jasalAI yasaaghi grantha pradAna gariyo ani tinIharUmAthi jaba euTA lAmo samaya bityo taba tinIharUko hRdayaharu kaThora bhae | ra, tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza avajJAkArI chan |
jAni rAkha! bhUmilAI tyasako mRtyupachi allAhale nai jIvita pArchan | hAmIle timIharUkAlAgi AphnA AyataharU praSTa pArisakekA chauM tAki timIharU bujha |
nissandeha sadkA dine puruSa tathA mahilA ra jo allAhalAI uttama RNa dinchan tI sabaikAlAgi yo kaiyauM guNA baDhAinecha ra unIharUkAlAgi sammAnajanaka pratidAna rahekocha |

allAha evaM unakA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna rAkhne vyaktiharU nai AphnA pAlanakartAkahA~ atyanta saccA evaM sAkSI chan | unIharUkAlAgi unako pratidAna evaM prakAza rahekocha | ra, juna vyaktiharU kuphra garchan ra hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara garchan tinIharU narakabAsI hun |

jAnirAkha ki sAMsArika jIvana kevala khelakuda, manoraJjana, taDakabhaDaka, paraspara sekhI jhArna ra sampatti tathA santAna baDhAunakolAgi paraspara pratispardhA garnu mAtra ho | yasako udAharaNa tyasa barSA jasto cha jasabATa umrekA bAlInAlIle kisAnaharUlAI khuzI pArcha | pheri tyo sukcha ra timI tyasalAI paheMlo bhaeko dekhchau | tyasapachi tyo curacura huncha | ra, paralokamA kaThora yAtanA rahekocha ra allAhako tarphabATa kSamAdAna evaM prasannatA sameta raheko cha | ra, sAMsArika jIvana ta dhokApUrNa kSaNika sukhabhoga mAtra ho |

pratispardhA gara AphnA pAlanakartAko kSamAdAna tathA tyasa svargatarpha jasako vistAra AkAza evaM pRthvIko vistAra jhaiM cha | yo tI vyaktiharUkAlAgi banAieko cha jo allAha evaM unakA rasUlaharUmAthi ImAna rAkhdachan | yo allAhako varadAna ho | unI jasalAI cAhanchan pradAna gardachan ra allAha apAra kRpAlu chan |
pRthvImA vA svayaM timIharUmAthi je saGkaTa Au~cha tyasalAI hAmIle prakaTa garnu bhandA pahile nai euTA vizeSa pustakamA tyo aGkita cha | yo allAhakolAgi ekadamai sahaja cha |

(yaso garnuko uddezya yo cha) ki timIharU AphUle gumAeko vastuprati duHkhita nahoU ra allAhale timIharUlAI pradAna garekA vastuharUprati ghamaNDa nagara | ra, allAha yastA ghamaNDI evaM sekhI vyaktilAI mana parAu~dainan...
jo svayaM kaJjusyAIM garchan ra anya mAnisaharUlAI pani kaJjusyAIMko sallAha dinchan | ra, jo vimukha hunchan allAha pUrNa Atmanirbhara evaM atyanta prazaMsanIya rahekA chan |

nissandeha hAmIle AphnA rasUlaharUlAI spaSTa pramANaharU diera paThAyauM, ra tinIharukA sAthamA grantha evaM tarAju avataraNa garyauM tAki mAnisaharU nisAphamA kAyama rahUn | ra, hAmIle phalAma avataraNa garyauM jasamA dherai zakti evaM mAnisaharUkAlAgi phAidAharU chan | ra, yasakAraNale pani ki allAhale yo jAnUn ki nadekhikana kasale unako ra unakA rasUlako maddata garchan | nissandeha allAha zaktizAlI evaM prabhutvazAlI chan |

nissandeha hAmIle nUha evaM ibrAhImalAI paThAyauM ra duvaikA santAnaharUmA IzadUtatva evaM Izagrantha jArI rAkhyauM | ani tinIharUmadhye kehI satmArgamA rahe, tara adhikAMza mAnisaharU avajJAkArI bhae |

ra, unIharUpazcAt pani hAmIle lagAtAra AphnA rasUlaharU paThAi rahyauM ra unIpachi maryama–putra IsAlAI paThAyauM ra unalAI injIla pradAna garyauM, ani unakA anuyAyIharUkA hRdayamA dayA ra karUNA utpanna garyauM | ra, ‘rahbAniyata’ (sanyAsa–pantha) ta tinIharUle svayaM AviSkAra gare | hAmIle tinIharUmAthi kevala allAhako prasannatA prApti anivArya garekA thiyauM | tara tinIharUle tyasako yathocita pAlanA garenan | ataH hAmIle tinIharUmadhyekA AsthAvAna vyaktiharUlAI uttama pratidAna pradAna garyau~, ra tinIharUmadhye adhikAMza mAnisaharU avajJAkArI chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhako bhaya gara ra unakA rasUlamAthi ImAna lyAU | unale Aphno kRpAko duIguNA aMza pradAna garnechan | ani, unale timIharUlAI prakAza pradAna garnechan jasako ujyAlomA timIharU hiMDaDuula garnechau ra timIharUkA pApaharU mApha garnechan | allAha kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

yo yasakAraNale ki ahle kitAbaharUle jAnUn ki tinIharUlAI allAhako kunai pani kRpAko kunai aMzamAthi adhikAra chaina | ra, yI sampUrNa varadAnaharU allAhakai hAtamA chan | unI jasalAI cAhanchan pradAna garchan | ra, allAha atyanta kRpAlu chan |

(he sandeSTA!) allAhale, timIsa~ga Aphno lognebAre vAdavivAda garne ra allAhasita zikAyata garne mahilAko, kurA sunisake | ra allAha timIharU duvaikA kurAkAnI sunirahekA thie | nissandeha allAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvadraSTA hun |

timIharUmadhye jo AphnA patnIharUsita jihAra (patnIlAI AmA saraha bhanne) garchan tinIharU unIharukA AmA hoinan | tinIharUkA AmAharU unIharU hun jasale tinIharUlAI janma die | nissandeha tinIharU praSTa rUpamA ghRNita evaM asatya kurA bhanchan | nissandeha allAha mApha garnevAlA evaM kSamAzIla chan |

tI vyaktiharU jo AphnA patnIharUsa~ga jihAra garchan pheri Aphno kurAlAI phirtA linchan tinIharUle eka arkAlAI chunu aghi euTA dAsalAI mukta garnuparnecha | timIharUlAI yasai kurAko upadeza diincha ra allAha timIharUkA sabai karmaharUsita rAmrarI avagatachan |

tara josa~ga dAsa hu~daina usale eka arkAlAI sparza garnuaghi lagAtAra duI mahinAko rojA rAkhnuparcha | ani jo rojA rAkhne sAmarthya rAkhdaina usale sAThI janA garibalAI bhojana garAunuparcha | yo yasakAraNale ki timIharU allAha evaM unakA rasUlamAthi ImAna rAkhchau | ra, yI allAhakA sImAharU hun | ra, kAphiraharUkAlAgi kaThora yAtanA rahekocha |

tI vyaktiharU jo allAha evaM unakA rasUlako virodha garchan tinIharU tyasarI nai apamAnita garinechan jasarI tinIharUbhandA pahilekA vyaktiharU apamAnita bhae jabaki hAmIle spaSTa AyataharU avataraNa garisakekA chauM | ra, anAsthAvAdIharUkAlAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA rahekocha |

juna dina allAhale tinIharU sabailAI pUnarjIvita garnechan tyasadina sabailAI tinIharUle garekA karmaharUbAre avagata garAunechan | allAhale tyasalAI ganera rAkhekA chan ra tinIharUle cAhi~ tyasalAI birsekA chan | ra, allAha pratyeka kurAkA sAkSI chan |

ke timIharUle dekhenau ki allAha AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA hareka kurA jAndachan? kunai sthAnamA tInajanA vyaktibIca kunai yasto gopya kAnekhusI hu~daina jahA~ cauthokA rUpamA unI hu~dainan; na kahI~ pA~cajanAko bIcamA unI chaiThauMkorUpamA rahekA nahun | na tyobhandA kama vA tyobhandA baDhI parantu unI tinIharUkA sAtha rahanchan, cAhe tinIharU jahA~sukai rahUn | pheri unale mahApralayako dina tinIharUle garne garekA karmaharUbAre avagata garAunechan | nissandeha allAha pratyeka kurAbATa avagata chan |

ke timIle tI vyaktiharUlAI dekhenau jasalAI kAnekhusI garna manAhI garieko thiyo taipani tinIharU manAhI gariekA kArya dohoryAu~chan ra paraspara pApa, atyAcAra evaM rasUlako avajJAbAre gopya sarasallAha garchan? tinIharU timIkahA~ Au~dA timIlAI yasto tarIkAle salAma garchan juna tarIkAle allAhale timIlAI salAma garekA chainan | ra, manamanai bhanchan– “allAha hAmIle bhaneko kurAle gardA hAmIlAI kina sajAya~ diMdainan ta? tinIharUkAlAgi naraka nai paryApta cha jasamA tinIharU hominechan | ani kati narAmro bAsasthAna ho tyo!

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! paraspara gopya sallAha gardA pApa, atyAcAra ra rasUlako avajJAbAre kadApi gopya sallAha nagara, baru puNya evaM IzabhayabAre sarasallAha gara | ra, tyasa allAhako bhayarAkha jasatarpha timIharU sabailAI ekatrita garI laginecha |

kAnekhusI ta zaitAnako tarphabATa huncha tAki AsthAvAnaharU cintAgrasta hoUn | tara allAhako AdezabinA unIharUlAI yasale katti pani hAni puryAuna sakdaina, ra AsthAvAnaharUle kevala allAhamAthi nai bharosA garnu pardacha |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! jaba timIharUlAI sabhAmA sthAna pharAkilo pArna bhanincha taba timIharu ThAu~ pharAkilo pAra, allAha timIharukolAgi sthAna pharAkilo pArnecha | ra, jaba timIharUlAI uThna bhanincha bhane timIharU uThihAla | allAhale timIharUmadhye ImAna lyAekA ra jJAna pradAna gariekA vyaktiharUko darjA ucca pArnechan, ra allAha timIharUkA hareka kAryasa~ga rAmrarI avagata chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timIharU rasUlasita gopya sarasallAha garna cAhanchau bhane gopya sarasallAha garnuaghi kehI sadkA (puNya–dAna) dine gara | yo timIharUkAlAgi ati uttama ra ati pavitra tarikA ho | tara kasaile (sadakA dinakA lAgi kehI) pAena bhane allAha vAstavamA ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

ke timIharU Aphno gopya sarasallAha garnu aghi sadkA dinabATa DarAyau ra? yadi timIharUle yaso garna sakenau ra allAhale timIharUlAI kSamA garidie bhane timIharU namAja kAyama gara, jakAta deU ra allAha evaM unakA rasUlako AjJApAlana gara | ra, jejati timIharU garchau tyasasa~ga allAha pUrNa avagata chan |

ke timIle tI vyaktiharUlAI dekhenau jasale yastA mAnisaharUsita mitratA gA~schan jasamAthi allAhako abhizApa avatIrNa bhaeko cha? unIharU na timIharUmadhye rahekA hun, na tinIharUmadhyekai | yinIharU jAnI jAnI jhUThakolAgi kasama khAirahekA chan |
allAhale yinIharUkAlAgi kaThora yAtanA tayAra pArekA chan | tinIharU je gardaichan vAstavamA narAmro gardaichan |
yinIharUle AphnA kasamaharUlAI DhAla banAekA chan, ra mAnisaharUlAI allAhako mArgabATa rokdachan | ataH yinIharUkA lAgi apamAnajanaka yAtanA cha |
tinIharUlAI tinIharUkA dhana–sampatti tathA santAnaharUle allAhakahA~ kunai lAbha puryAuna sakdainan | tinIharU narakabAsI hun | tinIharU sadA tyasaimA rahanechan |

tyasa dina allAhale tinIharU sabailAI jIvita pArI uThAunechan ani tinIharU jasarI timIsamakSa kasama khAnchan tyasarI allAhasamakSa pani kasama khAnechan yo ThAndai ki tinIharU pani kunai AdhAramA chan | nizcita rUpamA jAnI rAkha ki tinIharU nai jhUThA hun |
zaitAnale yinIharUmAthi prabhutva jamAeko cha, ra yinIharUlAI allAhako smaraNalAI vismRta pArekAe cha | yinIharU zaitAnakA samUha hun | jAnIrAkha ki zaitAnako samUha nai ghATAgrasta raheko cha |
vAstavamA juna vyaktiharU allAha evaM unakA rasUlako virodha garchan tinIharU nai sababhandA apamAnita vyaktiharUmadhye hun |
allAhale lekhidiekA chan “ma ra merA rasUla nai vAstavamA vijayI rahanechauM |” nissandeha allAha zaktizAlI evaM prabhutvazAlI chan |

allAha ra antima dinamAthi ImAna rAkhne kunai vyaktilAI timIle allAha evaM unakA rasUlakA virodhIharUlAI prema gareko kadApi pAune chainau, cAhe tI virodhIharu unakA pitA vA chorA vA unakA bhAi vA unakA nAtedAra nai kina nahoUn | yinai hun jasakA hRdayamA allAhale ImAna lekhidiekA chan ra jasalAI Aphno tarphako euTA AtmAdvArA sudRDha tulyAekA chan | yinIharUlAI yastA bagai~cAharUmA praveza garAinecha jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan jasamA yinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | allAha yinIharUsita prasanna ra yinIharU allAhasita prasanna chan | yinIharU nai hun allAhako samUha | jAnIrAkha! allAhako samUha nai saphala hunechan |
AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sampUrNa cijaharU allAhakai mahimAgAna garchan ra unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

unai hun jasale granthavAhakaharUmadhyekA kAphiraharUlAI tinIharUkA gharaharUbATa pahilo bhelAmA nai nikAle | tinIharU niskanechan bhanera timIharUle ThAnekA thienau | ra, tinIharUkA killAharUle tinIharUlAI allAhako dAMjomA surakSita rAkhnechan bhanI tinIharUlAI vizvAsa thiyo | tara allAha tinIharUsamakSa tyasa dizAbATa Ae jasabAre tinIharUle socekA pani thienan ra unale tinIharUkA hRdayamA bhaya utpanna gare | phalasvarUpa tinIharU Aphnai hAtale ra mominaharUkA hAtale Aphno gharabAra dhvasta pArdai thie | ataH he netravAna mAnisaharU ho! zikSA grahaNa gara |
ra, yadi allAhale tinIharUmAthi tinIharUkAnimti nirvAsana nalekhidiekA bhae vAstavamA allAhale tinIharUlAI saMsAramai yAtanA dine thie ra tinIharUkA lAgi AkhiratamA narakako yAtanA ta cha~dai cha |
yo yasa kAraNale ki tinIharUle allAha tathA unakA rasUlako virodha gare ra jasale allAhako virodha garcha tyasale thAhA pAunu parcha ki allAha kaThora daNDadAtA hun |

khajUrakA juna rukhaharUlAI timIharUle kATyau vA juna rukhaharUlAI tinIharukai mUlamA khaDA rahana diyau tI sabai allAhakai AjJAle bhaekA thie ra yasa kAraNale ki allAha avajJAkArIharUlAI apamAnita garUn |

allAhale tinIharUbATa AphnA rasUlalAI jejati pradAna gare tyasakolAgi na ta timIharUle na ghoDAharU dauDAyau na U~TaharU nai | baru allAha jasamAthi cAhanchan AphnA rasUlaharUlAI vijaya pradAna garchan ra allAha pratyeka cijamAthi sAmarthya rAkhdachan |

nagarabAsIharUkA juna sampattiharU allAhale AphnA rasUlalAI pradAna gare, tI allAhakA, rasUlakA, (rasUlakA) nAtedAraharUkA, anAthaharUkA, nirdhanaharUkA ra baTuvAharUkA lAgi hun, tAki yI sampattiharU timIharUmadhyekA dhanIharUkai hAtamA naghumirahUn | rasUlale timIharUlAI jejati pradAna garchan tyasalAI grahaNa gara ra juna kurAbATa unale timIharUlAI rokchan tyasabATa rokine gara, ra allAhako bhaya gara | nissandeha allAha kaThora daNDadAtA hun |

tI nirdhana zaraNArthIharUkolAgi pani ho jasalAI unIharUkA gharabAra ra sampattibATa bedakhala garI nikAlieko cha | unIharU allAhako varadAna evaM unako prasannatA prApta garne ceSTA garchan | ra unIharU allAha evaM unakA rasUlako maddata garchan | yinIharU nai saccA vyaktiharU hun |

ra (tinIharUkA lAgi pani) jasale yasa saharamA basobAsa gardachana ra imAnamA unIharUbhandA pahile Aphno ThAu~ banAisakekA chan, ra AphUtarpha hijarata garI AuneharUlAI mAyA garchan ra jejati unIharUlAI pradAna gariyo tyasaprati Aphno hRdayamA saMkoca mahasUsa gardainan | baru Aphu abhAva grasta bhaetApani, svayaMmAthi unIharUlAI prAthamikatA dinchan | vAstavikatA ke cha bhane juna vyaktiharU Aphno hRdayako kRpaNatAbATa mukta gariekA chan unIharU nai saphala chan |

ra, tI vyaktiharUkA lAgi pani jo unIharUbhandA pachi Ae; jasale prArthanA garchan–“he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmI ra hAmrA tI dAjubhAIlAI mApha garideU jo ImAna lyAunamA hAmI bhandA agrasara rahe, ra ImAnavAlAharUprati hAmrA hRdayamA kunai kisimako dveSa utpanna nagara | he hAmrA pAlanakartA! nissandeha timI atyanta komala hRdayI evaM parama dayAlu chau |”

ke timIle munAphikaharUlAI dekhenau jo AphnA granthavAhaka kAphira bandhuharUlAI bhanchan– “yadi timIharU niSkAsita gariyau bhane hAmI timIharUsa~gai niskera jAnechauM ra timIharUbAre hAmI kadApi kasaiko kurA mAnne chainauM | ra, yadi timIharUsa~ga yuddha gariemA hAmI avazya timIharUlAI sahayoga garnechau~ |” ra, allAha sAkSI chan ki tinIharU mithyAvAdI hun |

yadi tinIharU niSkAsita garie bhane munAphikaharU kadApi tinIharUsa~ga niskane chainan, ra yadi tinIharUsa~ga yuddha gariemA unIharUle kadApi tinIharUko sahayoga garne chainan | ani unIharU maddatakolAgi Ae bhane pani piThyU~ pharkAera bhAgnechan, ani tinIharUlAI kunai sahayoga prApta hune chaina |
(he muslimaharU ho!) tinIharUkA hRdayamA allAhako sATo timIharUkai baDhI Dara baseko cha | yasakAraNale ki tinIharU abujha vyaktiharU hun |

tinIharU milera pani timIharUsa~ga yuddha garna sakdainan | yo arkai kurA ho ki tinIharU killA banda sthAnaharUbhitra rahI vA kunai parkhAlakopachADi rahera yuddha garUn | tinIharUko pArasparika jhagaDA bhayanakara cha | tinIharUlAI ekajuTa ThAnchau jabaki tinIharUkA hRdaya vibhAjita chan kinabhane tinIharU buddhihIna vyaktiharU hun |
tI vyaktiharUjhai~ jo tinIharUbhandA kehI aghi nai Aphno karmako duSpariNAma cAkhisakekA chan ra yinIharUkAlAgi pIDAdAyI yAtanA tayAra cha |

ra zaitAnajhai~ jasale mAnisalAI bhanyo– (allAhako) "inkAra gara |” jaba mAnisale inkAra garyo taba zaitAnale bhanyo– “timIsita mero kunai sarokAra chaina | ma sampUrNa jagatkA pAlanakartA allAhako bhayarAkhcha |”
ataH tI duvaiko pariNAma yo cha ki duvai sadAkAlAgi narakamA jAne chan, ra atyAcArIharUkAlAgi yahi sajAya~ raheko cha |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhako bhayarAkha, ra pratyeka vyaktile bholikAnimti ke agADi paThAeko cha bhanne kurAko samIkSA gara | ra, allAhako bhaya rAkha; allAha timIharUkA sabai kAryaharUsita avagata chan |
ra, timIharU tI vyaktiharUjhai~ nabana jasale allAhalAI birse | ani allAhale tinIharUlAI svayaMbATa nai bhulAidie | tinIharU nai avajJAkArI hun |
naraka bAsIharu ra svarga bAsIharu samAna chainan | svargakA bAsIharU nai saphala hunechan |

yadi hAmIle yasa kuraAnalAI kunai parvatamAthi avataraNa gareko bhae timIharUle tyasa parvatalAI allAhako bhayale gardA vinamra ra TukrA–TukrA hu~dai gareko dekhnethyau | hAmI yI kurAharU manuSyakolAgi bayAna gardachauM tAki tinIharUle cintana manan garUn |
unai allAha hun jasabAheka anya kohI upAsya chaina | unI adRzya evaM dRzya sabai kurAharUkA jJAtA hun | unI atyanta karuNAmaya evaM parama dayAlu chan |

unai allAha hun jasabAheka anya kohI pujya chaina | unI samrAT hun atyanta pavitra, sarvathA zAnta, nizcintatA pradAnakartA, saMrakSaka, prabhutvazAlI, prabhAvazAlI ra mahAn banera rahanevAlA | pavitra chan allAha tyasa sAjhedArIbATa juna yI mAnisaharU banAu~daichan |

unai allAha hun saMracanAkA prArUpakAra, astitva pradAnakartA, rUpa pradAnakartA | unakAlAgi uttama nAmaharU chan | AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIkA sArA cijaharU unaiko mahimAgAna garchan ra unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yadi timIharu mero bATomA jihAda garna ra mero khuzI prAptIko lAgi niskanchau bhane, mero tathA Aphno zatrulAI saMrakSaka mitra nabanAU | timIharU tinIharUtarpha mitratAko hAta baDhAu~chau jabaki tinIharUle timIsamakSa Aeko satyalAI mAnna inkAra garisakekA chan | tinIharU rasUlalAI ra timIharUlAI kevala yasa doSamA nikAlirahekA chan ki timIharUle AphnA pAlanakartA allAhamAthi ImAna lyAekA chau | timIharU gopya rUpamA tinIharUlAI mitratAko sandeza paThAu~chau jabaki juna kArya timIharU gopyarUpamA gardachau ra juna kArya khullamakhullA gardachau tI sabai ma rAmrarI jAndachu | timIharUmadhye jasale yasto garyo U vAstavamA satmArgabATa nai vicalita bhayo |

yadi tinIharule timIharUmAthi prabhutva kAyama gare bhane timIharuko khulA zatru bannechan ra timIharulAI duHkha dinakolAgi AphnA hAta tathA mukhale prahAra garnechan | ra yinIharu cAhanchan ki jasarI bhae pani timIharu kAphira banihAla |

mahApralayako dina na timIharUko nAtedAra kAma lAgnechan ra na timIharUkA santAna nai | allAhale timIharUbIca phaisalA garnechan ra jejati timIharU gardachau tI sabai allAha rAmrarI dekhirahekA chan |

timIharUkAlAgi ibrAhIma tathA unakA anuyAyIharUmA uttama namunA raheko cha | jaba unale AphnA jAtibandhuharulAI spaSTa rUpamA bhanidie– “timIharUsita ra allAhabAhekakA timIharUkA pUjyaharUsita hAmro kunai sarokAra chaina | hAmI timIharUko inkAra garchauM | timIharUle eka allAhamAthi ImAna nalyAunjela sadAkolAgi hAmI ra timIharUko bIcamA zatrutA ra ghRNA utpanna bhaeko cha | tara ibrAhImale Aphno buvAlAI bhaneko yo kurA bAheka ki ma tapAIMko lAgi avazya kSamAyAcanA garnechu, ra tapAIMko lAgi allAhasAmU kehI garnu mero vazamA chaina |” he hAmrA pAlanakartA! timImAthi nai hAmIle pUrNa bharosA garyauM ra timItarpha nai hAmI pharkiyau~ ra antima gantavya pani timItarpha nai raheko cha |
he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmIlAI kAphiraharUkAlAgi phitnA (sAstIko sAdhana) nabanAU ra he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmrA galtIharUlAI mApha garideU | nissandeha timI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chau |

timIharUkAlAgi unIharUmA uttama namUnA raheko cha; tI vyaktiharUkA lAgi jo allAha tathA antima dinako AzA rAkhchan | ra, jo vimukha huncha usale jAnIrAkhos ki allAha nispRha evaM svayaMmA prazaMsanIya chan |
sambhava cha ki allAhale timIharU tathA timrA zatruharUkA bIcamA prema bandhana utpanna garidiUn | allAha sAmarthyavAna chan ra allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |

jasale timIharUsita dharmako mAmalAmA yuddha garenan ra timIharUlAI timIharUkA gharabATa niSkAsita garenan tyastA vyaktiharUsita rAmro vyavahAra garna ra nyAya garna allAha rokdainan | vAstavamA allAha nyAya garne vyaktiharUlArI prema garchan |

allAhale ta yastA vyaktiharUsita mitratA gA~sna rokchan jasale timIharUsita dharmako viSayamA yuddha gare ra timIharUlAI timIharUkA gharabATa niSkAsita gare ra timIharUko niSkAsanamA paraspara sahayoga gare | tinIharUsita mitratA gA~sne vyaktiharU nai atyAcArI hun |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! jaba timIharUsamakSa AsthAvAna mahilAharU hijrata garera Au~chan taba timIharU tinIharUlAI jA~cabujha gara | vAstavamA unIharUko ImAnabAre baDhI jAnakArI allAhalAI cha | timIharUle unIharUlAI saccA momina pAemA unIharUlAI kAphiraharUtarpha napharkAU | unIharU kAphiraharUkAlAgi vaidha chainan, ra na kAphiraharU nai yI (muslima) mahilAharUkAlAgi vaidha hunechan | unIharUlAI phirtA deU jejati unIharUle kharca gare | ra yI mahilAharUlAI mahara cuktA garera bihe gardA kunai Apatti chaina | timIharU pani kAphira mahilAharUlAI (vaivAhika bandhanamA) rokera narAkha | timIharUle (yI kAphira mahilAharUmAthi) jejati kharca garekA chau tI (phirtA) mAga, ra kAphiraharUle (muslima mahilAharUmAthi) jejati kharca gare tinIharUle pani (phirtA) mAgUn | yI sabai allAhakA Adeza hun | unI timIharUbIca nirNaya garchan | ra, allAha sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra, yadi timIharUkA patnIharU vApata kAphiraharUkahA~ kehI rakama bA~kI rahyo ani timIharUlAI avasara prApta bhayo (tinIharUko patnIharUmadhye muslima bhaera Ain) bhane timIharUmadhyekA jasakI patnI gaekI chin unIharUlAI unIharUle (AphnI patnIharU mAthi) kharca gareko barAbara rakama deU | ra, tyasa allAhako bhayarAkha jasamAthi timIharUle ImAna lyAekA chau |

he sandeSTA! jaba momina mahilAharU timIsamakSa yo baiat (zapatha) lina Au~chan ki unIharUle kunai cijalAI allAhako sAjhedAra banAune chainan, corI garne chainan, vyabhicAra garne chainan, AphnA santAnako hatyA garne chainan ra AphnA hAtakhuTTA bIca raceko mithyA doSa lagAune chainan ra kunai pani rAmro kAmamA timro avajJA garne chainan taba unIharUsa~ga zapatha leU ra unIharUkAlAgi allAha– sita kSamA mAga | nissandeha allAha atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |,

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! yastA vyaktiharUlAI mitra nabanAU jasamAthi allAhako prakopa bhaeko cha | tinIharU AkhiratabATa tyasarI nai nirAza bhaekA chan jasarI kAphiraharU cihAnamA parekAharUsita nirAza bhaekA chan |
AkAzaharU evaM pRthvIkA sampUrNa cijaharU allAhako mahimAgAna garchan | ra, unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharU tyo kurA kina bhanchau juna timIharU gardainau?
juna kArya timIharU gardainau tyo kurA bhannu allAhako dRSTimA atyanta apriya ho |
vAstavamA allAha tI vyaktiharUlAI mana parAu~chan jo unako mArgamA yasarI paMktibaddha bhaI yuddha garchan mAnauM unIharU sisAdvArA nirmita parkhAla hun |

ra, smaraNa gara mUsAko kurA juna unale Aphno jAtibandhulAI bhanekA thie– “he merA jAtibandhuharU ho! timIharU malAI kina satAu~daichau jabaki timIharUlAI rAmrarI thAhA cha ki ma timIharUtarpha allAhako rasUla hu~ |” pheri jaba tinIharU TeDhina puge taba allAhale pani tinIharUkA hRdayalAI bAGgo pAridie | ra, allAha avajJAkArIharUlAI sidhA mArga dekhAu~dainan |

ra, smaraNa gara jaba maryama–putra IsAle bhane– “he isrAIlakA santAnaharU ho! ma timIharUtarpha allAhale paThAeko rasUla hu~; tyasa taurAtako puSTi garnevAlA hU~ juna mabhandA pahile Aeko thiyo ani zubhasUcanA dinevAlA hu~ tyasa rasUlako jo mapachi Aunechan ra jasako nAma ahamada hunecha |” tara jaba unI (ahamada) tinIharUkahA~ khullA nizAnIharU liera Ae taba tinIharUle bhane– “yo ta spaSTa jAdU ho |”
ra, tyo vyaktibhandA baDhI atyAcArI arU ko huna sakcha jasale allAhamAthi mithyAropaNa garcha jabaki tyasalAI islAmatarpha AhvAna garincha? allAha atyAcArIharUlAI sIdhA mArga dekhAu~dainan |
yinIharU AphnA mukhale allAhako jyotilAI nibhAuna cAhanchan tara allAha Aphno prakAzalAI pUrNa garerai chADnechan cAhe kAphiraharUlAI yo jatisukai apriya kina nahos |

unai hun jasale AphnA rasUlalAI mArgadarzana evaM satya dharmakAsAtha paThAe tAki tyasalAI unale sampUrNa dharmaharUmAthi prabhutva pradAna garUn cAhe bahudevavAdIharUlAI yo jatisukai apriya kina nahos |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! ke ma timIharUlAI yasto vyApAra batAU~ jasale timIharUlAI pIDAdAyaka yAtanAbATa bacAunecha?
ImAna lyAU allAhamAthi tathA unakA rasUlamAthi, ra jihAda gara allAhako mArgamA Aphno dhanale ra Aphno jIujyAnale | yadi timIharU jJAnI chau bhane yahI timIharUkAlAgi uttama cha |

allAhale timIharUkA pApaharU mApha garidinechan ra yastA bagaiMcAharUmA timIharUlAI praveza garAunechan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan ra sadA rahane bagaiMcAharUmA timIharUlAI uttama ghara pradAna garnechan | yo ho mahAn saphalatA |,
ra arko vastu jo timIharU mana parAu~chau, allAhako tarphabATa sahayoga ra chiTai prApta hune vijaya | ra (he nabI sa.!) mominaharUlAI yasako zubha sandeza deU |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhako sahayogI bana, jasarI maryama–putra IsAle havArIharUlAI sambodhana gardai bhanekA thie– “ko cha allAhatarpha bolAune kAryamA mero sahayogI?” havArIharUle bhane– “hAmI chau~ allAhako sahayogI!” tyatikhera isrAIlakA santAnako eka samUhale ImAna lyAyo tara arko samUhale kuphra pradarzana garyo | pheri hAmIle ImAna lyAuneharUlAI unakA zatruko mukAbilAmA sahayoga garyau~ | ataH unIharU nai vijayI bhae |
AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA sabai vastuharUle samrAT, atyanta pavitra, prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI allAhako mahimAgAna garirahekA chan |

unai hun jasale ummIharU bIca eka rasUla svayaM unIharU madhyebATa nai paThAe jo unIharUlAI una (allAha) kA AyataharU pATha garera sunAu~chana; unIharUlAI zuddhikaraNa garchan ra unIharUlAI kitAba tathA tatvadarzitAko zikSA dinchan yadyapi yasaaghi unIharU prasTa pathabhraSTatAmA thie |
ra, unIharUmadhyekA anya vyaktiharUkA lAgi pani jo ahile unIharUsa~ga milekA chainan | ra, unI prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |
yo allAhako varadAna ho | unI jasalAI cAhanchan pradAna garchan ra unI mahAna anugrahI chan |

juna mAnisaharUlAI taurAtako vAhaka banAieko thiyo ani tinIharUle tyasako bhAra uThAenan, tinIharUko udAharaNa tyasa gadhAko jasto cha jasamAthi kitAbaharU lAdieko huncha | kati nikRSTa udAharaNa tI vyaktiharUko cha jasale hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare | ra, allAha atyAcArI vyaktiharUlAI mArgadarzana gardainan |,

bhanideU– “he mAnisaharU ho jo yahUdI banekA chau! yadi timIharUlAI yo ghamaNDa cha ki anya mAnisaharUbAheka timIharU nai allAhakA parama priya hau bhane mRtyuko kAmanA gara, yadi timIharU saccA chau bhane |”
tara tinIharUle kadApi yasako kAmanA garne chainan, AphnA tI karmaharUle gardA juna tinIharUkA hAtale agADi paThAisakekA chan | ra, allAha atyAcArIharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan |

bhanideU– “tyo mRtyu jasabATa timIharU bhAgdachau tyasale timIharUlAI a~ThyAerai choDnecha | pheri timIharUlAI adRzya evaM dRzyakA jJAtA (allAha) samakSa peza garinecha | ani unale timIharUlAI batAunechan ki timIharU ke garirahekA thiyau |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUlAI zukrabArako dina namAjako– lAgi pukAri~dA allAhako smaraNatarpha dauDa ra vyApAra choDideU | yadi timIharU jJAna rAkhchau bhane, yahI timIharUkAlAgi uttama cha |,
pheri jaba namAja pUrA huncha taba dhartImA phaila ra allAhako varadAnako khojI gara | ra, allAhalAI khuba smaraNa gara tAki timIharU saphala huna saka |

ra, jaba unIharUla vyApAra evaM khela tamAsA bhairaheko dekhchan taba tyasatarpha dauDanchan | ra, timIlAI ubhieko choDidinchan | bhanideU– “allAhakahA~ jejati chan khela tamAsA evaM vyApArabhandA uttama rahekA chan | ra, allAha sarvottama jIvikA pradAnakartA hun |”

(he nabI sa.!) yI munAphikaharU timIsamakSa Au~dA bhanchan– “hAmI sAkSI baschauM ki tapAIM allAhakA rasUla hunuhuncha |” a~ allAha jAndachan ki timI avazyai unakA rasUla hau | ra, allAha sAkSI dinchan ki yI munAphikaharU bilakula jhUThA chan |
tinIharUle AphnA kasamaharUlAI DhAla banAekA chan | yasarI tinIharU allAhako mArgabATa rokdachan | vAstavamA yinIharU nikRSTa kAryaharU garne garchan |
yo yasa kAraNale bhaeko cha ki tinIharUle ImAna lyAepachi pheri kuphra gare | tasartha tinIharUkA hRdayamAthi mohara lagAiyo | aba tinIharU bujhdainan |

ra timIle tinIharUlAI herdA tinIharukA DhA~cAkA~cAle timIlAI Azcaryacakita tulyAu~cha ra tinIharU boeldA timI suneko sunai hunechau, mAnauM yinIharU kAThakA takhtA hun juna parkhAlamA TA~siekA chan | pratyeka ThUlo AvAjalAI tinIharU Aphnai virUddha ThAnchan | tinIharU pakkA zatru hun | ataH tinIharUsita sAvadhAna rahane gara | allAha yinIharUko sarvanAza garUn! tinIharU kahA~ bahakAi~daichan!

ra, jaba tinIharUlAI bhanincha ki AU, tAki allAhakA rasUlale timIharUkAlAgi kSamA yAcanA garUn, taba tinIharU Aphno TAuko ekAtarpha ghumAu~chan ra timI dekhchau ki tinIharU ghamaNDale gardA Auna rokinchan |

he nabI sa.! timIle tinIharUkA lAgi kSamAyAcanA gara vA nagara tinIharUko lAgi eka samAna cha | allAhale kadApi tinIharUlAI kSamA garne chainan | nissandeha allAhale avajJAkArI mAnisaharUlAI kahilyai mArgadarzana gardainan |

tinIharU nai hun jo bhanchan ki allAhakA rasUlakA sAthIharUmAthi, yinIharU kSatavikSata nahunjela, kharca garna bandagara, baki AkAzaharU tathA dhartIkA khajAnAharU allAhakai hun | tara munAphikaharU bujhdainan |

yinIharU bhanchan ki yadi hAmI madInA pugyauM bhane pratiSThitale avazya nai tyahA~bATa hInatam vyaktilAI niSkAsita garnecha, jabaki pratiSThA ta allAha, unakA rasUla ra AsthAvAnaharUko lAgi rahekocha | tara munAphikaharU cAhi~ jAndainan |
he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUko sampatti evaM santAnaharUle timIharUlAI allAhako smaraNabATa vismRta natulyAUn | jasale yasto garnechan unIharU nai ghATA behorneharU hun |

ra juna jIvikA hAmIle timIharUlAI pradAna garekA chauM tyasa madhyebATa kharca gara, yasa aghi ki timIharUmadhye kasaiko mRtyu Aos taba usale bhanos– “he merA raba! kina malAI ali thapa avasara nadieko tAki ma dAna dine thie~ ra satkarmIharUmA sAmela hune thie~ |
jaba kasaiko mRtyuko samaya Aipugcha taba allAha usalAI alikati pani avasara didainan, ra jejati timIharU garchau tyo allAhalAI rAmrarI thAhA cha |
allAhako mahimAgAna garirahekA chan tI sabai cijaharU juna AkAzaharUmA chan ra juna dhartImA chan | unaiko zAsana cha ra unaiko prazaMsA pani | ra, unI hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
unai hun jasale timIharUlAI sRSTi gare, ani timIharUmadhye kohI kAphira cha, ra kohI momina | ra allAhale timIharUle garne garekA kAryaharU dekhirahekA chan |
unale AkAzaharU tathA pRthvIlAI satyakAsAtha sRSTi gare, ra timIharUko rUpa banAe ani kati rAmro rUpa banAe! ra, unaitarpha pharkera jAnucha |

unalAI jJAna cha tI sabai cijaharUko juna AkAzaharU ra pRthvImA chan | ra, unI jAndachan tI kurAharU pani jo timIharU lukAu~chau ra juna prakaTa garchau, ra allAha hRdayako hAlako pani jJAna rAkhdachan |
ke timIharUlAI tI vyaktiharUko khabara pugena jasale yasaaghi kuphra gare ani Aphno karatutako duSpariNAma cAkhe | ra, tinIharUkAlAgi pIDAdAyaka yAtanA rahekocha |

yasa pariNAmako kAraNa yo thiyo ki tinIharUsamakSa tinIharukA rasUlaharU khullA pramANa evaM nizAnIharUkAsAtha Ae | tara tinIharUle bhane– “ke kunai manuSyale hAmIlAI mArgadarzana garna sakcha?” ata: tinIharUle mAnna inkAra gare ra vimukha bhae | ra, allAhale pani tinIharUlAI vAstA garenan | ra, allAha nispRha evaM prazaMsanIya chan |

kAphiraharUle mRtyupazcAt kadApi uThAine chaina bhanI ThAnekA chan | bhanideU– “kina nauThAinu, merA rabako kasama! timIharU avazya uThAinechau | ani timIharUlAI timIharUle garekA kAryaharUbAre batAinecha ra yo allAhako lAgi sarala cha |ya
ani ImAna lyAU allAha ra unakA rasUlamAthi ani tyasa prakAzamAthi juna hAmIle avatarita garekA chauM ra allAha tI kAryaharUko khabara rAkhdachan juna timIharUle garne garchau |

juna dina timIharUlAI bhelA hune dinamA jammA garinecha tyahI dina ho hArajItako | ra, jasale ImAna lyAera satkarma garnecha, allAhale tyasako nikRSTatAharU samApta pArnechan | ra tyasalAI yastA bagaiMcAharumA praveza garAunechan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan, jasamA unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | yahI ho mahAn saphalatA |
ra, jasale kuphra gare ani hAmrA AyataharUlAI mithyA Thahara gare, tinIharU nai hun narakabAsI jahA~ tinIharU sadA rahanechan | ra, tyo ati nikRSTa bAsasthAna ho |
kunai pani saGkaTa allAhako anumatibinA Auna sakdaina | ra, jasale allAhamAthi ImAna lyAu~cha, allAha tyasako hRdayalAI mArgadarzana garchan | ra, allAha pratyeka cija rAmrarI jAndachan |
ra timIharU allAhako AjJApAlana gara ra rasUlako AjJApAlana gara | yadi timIharU vimukha bhayau bhane hAmrA rasUlako dAyitva spaSTa sandeza puryAunu mAtra ho |
allAha– unIbAheka kohI pUjya chaina | ra mominaharUle kevala allAhamAthi bharosA garnuparcha |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! timIharUkA kehI patnIharU ra kehI santAnaharU timIharUkA zatru hun | ani tinIharUkAsAtha sAvadhAnIsa~ga basa | ra, yadi timIharU tinIharUlAI mApha garchau, bevAstA garchau ra kSamA garchau bhane allAha atyanta kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
timIharUkA sampatti evaM santAna parIkSA sAmagrI hun, ra allAhakahA~ mahAn pratidAna rahekocha |
ataH yathAsambhava allAhako bhayarAkha, ra sundai tathA mAndai jAU | ani Aphnai lAgi dhana–sampatti kharca garne gara | ra, jo Aphno manako kRpaNatAbATa jogAie unIharU nai saphala huneharU hun |
yadi timIharU allAhalAI rAmro RNa dinchau bhane unale tyasalAI timIharUkAlAgi kaiyauM guNA baDhAunechan, ra timIharUlAI kSamA garnechan | ra, allAha ati kadara garnevAlA ra sahanazIla chan |
unI adRzya evaM dRzyakA jJAtA hun; prabhutvazAlI evaM tatvadarzI chan |

he nabI! (bhanideU!) jaba timIharU AphnA patnIharUlAI talAka (pArapAcuke) dinchau taba tinIharUlAI tinIharuko iddatako lAgi talAka deU ra iddatako gantI rAkha | ra, AphnA pAlanakartA allAhako bhayarAkha | na timIharU tinIharUlAI tinIharukA gharabATa nikAla na tinIharU svayaM niskiun | a~, yo beglai kurA ho ki tinIharU khullA azlila kArya garUn | yI allAhale nirdhArita garekA sImAharU hun ra jasale allAhakA sImAharUko ullaGghana garcha usale vAstavamA AphaiMmAthi atyAcAra garcha | timIlAI thAhA chaina zAyada ki allAhale tyasapachi kunai nikAsa nikAllAn |

pheri jaba unIharU Aphno iddata (nizcita avadhi) ko antamA pugchan taba ki ta unIharUlAI rAmro tarikAle (dAmtapatyamai) rokI rAkha ki ta rAmro tarIkAle bidA gara, ra Aphno mAnisaharumadhye duIjanA nisApha garnevAlAlAI sAkSI banAU | ra, timIharU allAhakAlAgi gavAhI khaDA gara | yI kurAharU hun jasako upadeza diincha, pratyeka tyo vyaktikolAgi jo allAha evaM Akhiratako dinamAthi AsthA rAkhcha | jasale allAhako bhaya rAkhnecha unale tyasakolAgi kunai nikAsa nikAlnechan |

ra, usalAI tyahA~bATa jIvikA pradAna garnechan jasako bAremA usale soceko pani hune chaina | ra, jasale allAhamAthi bharosA garnecha unI tyasakolAgi paryApta hunechan | allAha Aphno kArya pUrA garerai chADchan | allAhale hareka cijakolAgi euTA mApadaNDa nirdhArita garidiekA chan |

ra, timIharUkA strIharUmadhye jo rajasvalAbATa mukta bhaisakekA chan tinIharUko bAremA yadi timIharUlAI kunai sandeha cha bhane tinIharUko iddata tIna mahinA cha | ra, yahI iddata rajasvalA zurU nabhaekA strIharUkAlAgi pani rahekocha | ra garbhavatI mahilAharUko ‘iddata’ tinIharUle baccA janmAuna samma raheko cha | ra, jasale allAhako bhaya rAkhcha, allAhale tyasako mAmalA sahaja pAridinchan |
yo allAhako Adeza ho juna unale timIharUmAthi avatarita garekA chan | ra, jasale allAhako bhaya garnecha, allAhale tyasakA pApaharUlAI samApta pArnechan ra usako pratidAnalAI baDhAunechan |

unIharUlAI (iddatasamma) Aphno haisiyata anusAra timIharU svayaM jahA~ baschau tyahI~ rAkha | ra, unIharUlAI dikka pArnako lAgi nasatAU | ra, yadi unIharU garbhavatI chan bhane zizu janmesamma unIharUmAthi kharca gara | pheri yadi unIharU timrAlAgi (zizulAI) stanapAna garAu~chan bhane unIharUlAI tyasako pArizramika deU ra (yasako lAgi) ucita tarikAle ApasamA sarasallAha gara | ra, yadi timIharUlAI kaThinAi bhayo bhane zizulAI kunai anya strIle dUdha khuvAunechin |

sampanna vyaktile Aphno sampannatA anusAra nai kharca garos, ra jasalAI simita jIvikA diieko cha tyasale tyasai dhanabATa kharca garos juna allAhale usalAI pradAna garekA chan | allAhale kunai vyaktimAthi unale pradAna garekobhandA adhika jimmevArIko bojha didainan | allAhale cA~Dai nai kaThinAIpachi sahajatA pradAna garnechan |
katipaya nagaraharU (yastA) chan jasale AphnA pAlanakartA evaM unakA rasUlaharUko Adezako avahelanA gare | ani hAmIle tinIharUsita kaDA hisAba liyauM ra tinIharUlAI ati nikRSTa sajAya~ diyauM |
ani tinIharU svayaMle gareko karmako svAda cAkhe ra tinIharUkA kAryako pariNAma ghATA nai ghATA bhayo |
allAhale tinIharUkAlAgi kaDA sajAya~ tayAra pArekA chan | ataH he ImAna lyAekA jJAnavAn vyaktiharU ho! allAhako bhayarAkha | allAhale timIharUtarpha euTA pUrNa upadeza avataraNa garidiekA chan |

arthAt yastA rasUla, jasale timIharUsamakSa allAhakA spaSTa pArne AyataharUko pATha garchan tAki unale AsthAvAnaharU tathA satkarmIharUlAI andhakAraharUbATa nikAlera prakAzatarpha lyAUn | ani, jasale allAhamAthi ImAna lyAunecha ra satkarma garnecha allAhale usalAI yastA bagai~cAharUmA praveza garAunechan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan jasamA unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | allAhale yasto vyaktikolAgi uttama jIvikA pradAna garekA chan |

allAha nai hun jasale sRSTi gare sAtavaTA AkAzaharU ra tyastai nai pRthvI pani | yinIharUbIca Adezaharu avataraNa hunchan tAki timIharU jAna ki allAha hareka kurAko sAmarthya rAkhdachan | allAhale pratyeka cijalAI Aphno jJAnako paridhimA liekA chan |
he nabI sa.! timI tyasa cijalAI AphnA patnIharUko prasannatA cAhera kina avaidha garchau jasalAI allAhale timro lAgi vaidha garekA chan? ra allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
allAhale timIharUmAthi Aphno kasamalAI unmukta garnu anivArya garekA chan | allAha timIharUkA saMrakSaka rahekA chan, ra unI sarvajJa evaM tatvadarzI chan |

ra (smaraNa gara) jaba nabIle euTA kurA AphnI euTI patnIlAI gopya rUpamA bhane | pheri jaba tI patnIle tyo rahasya kholin ra allAhale sandeSTAlAI yasako sUcanA die taba sandeSTAle kehI aMza tI patnIlAI batAe ra kehI aMza batAenan | ani jaba sandeSTAle unalAI yo kurA batAe taba unale sodhin– “tapAIMlAI yasako bAremA kasale bhanyo?” sandeSTAle bhane– “malAI sarvajJa evaM susUcita (allAha) le batAe |

yadi timIharU duvai allAhasamakSa prAyazcita garchau bhane yasako artha ho ki timIharUkA hRdaya (allAhatarpha) jhukisakekA chan ra sandeSTAko dA~jomA yadi timIharUle guTabandI ra sandeSTAko virUddhamA timI duImadhye ekale arkAko sahayoga garchau bhane jAnIrAkha ki allAha unakA saMrakSaka hun ra unI bAheka jibraIla ra sabai satkarmI AsthAvAnaharU pani ra tyasa pachi sabai phariztAharU unakA sahAyaka chan |

yadi nabIle timIharUlAI talAka diemA unakA rabale unalAI timIharUbhandA uttama muslima, momina, AjJAkArI, prAyazcita garne, upAsanA garne, (allAhako mArgamA) prayAsarata, vivAhitA vA kumArI anya patnIharU pradAna garchan bhanne kurA asambhava chaina |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! bacAU svayaMlAI ra AphnA parivAralAI narakako AgobATa jasako Indhana mAnava evaM DhuGgA hunechan, jasamAthi kaThora, prabala phariztAharU niyukta chan; jo allAhale je Adeza diekA chan tyasako avajJA gardainan ra je Adeza unIharUlAI diincha tyasako pAlanA garchan |
he kAphiraharU ho! Aja bahAnA nagara | timIharUlAI tyasaiko badalA diinecha juna karma timIharU garthyau |

he AsthAvAnaharU ho! allAhasita vizuddha prAyazcita gara! AzA cha ki allAhale timIharUkA pApatAharU samApta pAridinechan ra timIharUlAI yastA bagai~cAharUmA praveza garAunechan jasako talatirabATa nadIharU bagirahekA hunechan | tyasa dina allAhale nabI evaM unakA AsthAvAna sAthIharUlAI apamAna garne chainan | unIharUko prakAza unako agADi agADi, unako dAhinetarpha daguriraheko hunecha ra unIharU bhanirahekA hunechan– “he hAmrA pAlanakartA! hAmro prakAzalAI hAmrolAgi pUrNa garideU ra hAmIlAI kSamA pradAna | nissandeha timI hareka kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachau |
he nabI sa.! kAphiraharU tathA munAphikaharUsa~ga jihAda gara, ra tinIharUsa~ga kaDA vyavahAra gara | ra, tinIharUko bAsasthAna ta naraka hunecha | ra, tyo ati nai nikRSTa bAsasthAna ho |

allAha kAphiraharUkA lAgi nUha ra lUtakA patnIharUko udAharaNa peza garchan | tinIharU duvai hAmrA duI satkarmI bhaktaharUko dAmpatyamA thie tara tinIharU duvaile AphnA patikAsAtha vizvAsaghAta gare | ra, duvaile allAhako dA~jomA AphnA tI duI (patnI) lAI alikati pani maddata garna sakenan | ra bhaniyo– “jAU, AgomA jAneharUsa~ga timIharU duvai pani jAU |”,

ra, allAha AsthAvAnaharUkA lAgi phiraaunakI patnIko udAharaNa peza garchan | jaba unale prArthanA garin– “he merA raba! merolAgi AphUkahA~ svargamA euTA ghara banAideU ra malAI phiraauna tathA usako karmabATa surakSita rAkha ra malAI atyAcArI vyaktiharUbATa mukti pradAna gara |”

ra, imarAnakI putrI maryamako udAharaNa pani (peza garchan) jasale Aphno satItvartI thiin | pheri hAmIle tyasabhitra Aphno tarphabATa AtmA phu~kidiyauM | ra unale AphnA pAlanakartAkA vANIharU tathA granthaharUko puSTi garin, ra unI AjJAkArI vyaktiharUmadhyekI thiin |
atyanta barakatavAlA (maGgalamaya) chan unI, jasako hAtamA samprabhUtA raheko cha | ra, unI sampUrNa kAryako sAmarthya rAkhdachan |
jasale mRtyu tathA jIvanako sRSTi gare, tAki timIharUlAI parIkSA liun ki kasale rAmro kAma garcha, ra unI prabhutvazAlI evaM kSamAzIla chan |
jasale tahataha garI sAtavaTA AkAza sRSTi gare | timI param dayAlu (allAha) ko sRSTimA kunai kisimako visaGgati pAune chainau | pheri pharkera hera ta kahI~ AkAzamA pvAla dekhchau?
ani dohoryAI dohoryAI hera | timro dRSTi thakita bhaI asaphala pharkanecha |
hAmIle timIharUko najikako AkAzalAI bhavya dIpaharUle susajjita pArekA chauM, ra tyasamA zaitAna dhapAune sAdhana banAekA chauM | ra, tI zaitAnaharUkAlAgi dankido Ago tayAra pArekA chauM |
ra juna mAnisaharUle AphnA rabako avajJA gare tinIharUkAlAgi narakako yAtanA rahekocha, ra tyo ati narAmro bAsasthAna ho |
tinIharU tyasamA homiepachi tyasako bhayAvaha AvAja sunnechan ra tyo dankiraheko hunecha |
atyanta krodhale gardA phuTna lAgnecha | jaba jaba tyasamA kunai samUhalAI hominecha taba taba tyasakA dArogAharUle tinIharUsita sodhnechan– “ke timIharUsamakSa kunai sacetaka Aeko thiena ra?”

tinIharUle javApha dinechan– “ho, sacetaka ta AekA thie tara hAmIle unIharUlAI jhUTho ThaharyAekA thiyauM ra bhanekA thiyauM– “allAhale kehI pani avataraNa garekA chainan; timIharU ThUlo pathabhraSTatAmA parekA chau |”
ra, bhannechan– “hAmIle sunekA ra bujhekA bhae Aja hAmI narakabAsIharUmA hune thienauM |”
yasarI tinIharUle Aphno galtI AphaiM svIkAra garnechan | tasartha yI narakabAsIharUmAthi dhikkAra cha!
nissandeha tI vyaktiharU jo AphnA pAlanakartAsita unalAI nadekhikanai DarAu~chan, tinIharUkAlAgi kSamAdAna ra mahAna pratiphala raheko cha |
timIharU gupta rupamA kurA gara vA ThUlo svaramA; nissandeha unI manako kurA pani jAndachan |
ke jasale sRSTi garekA chan unaile jAnne chainan ta? unI ta sukSmadarzI evaM susUcita chan |
unai hun jasale pRthvIlAI timIharUkAlAgi vazIbhUta garidiekA chan | ataH hi~Da tyasako chAtImAthi ra khAU allAhako jIvikA! ra, unaitarpha timIharUle pharkera jAnucha |
ke timIharU unIbATa nizcinta chau jo AkAzamA chan ki unale timIharUlAI dhartImA dhaMsAidiun ra akasmAt yo pRthvI bessarI hallinecha |
ke timIharU unIbATa nizcinta chau jo AkAzamA chan, unale timIharUmAthi DhuGgAmuDhA barsAune chainan, ani mero cetAvanI kasto hunecha bhanne kurA timIharUlAI thAhA hunecha |
yasaaghi bitekA mAnisaharUle pani mithyA Thahara gare | ani (hera) kasto bhayo malAI jhuTho ThaharyAuneharuko pariNAma |

ke yinIharU AphUmAthi paMkSIharUlAI pakheTA phailAu~dai ra sameTdai (uDiraheko) dekhdainan? karUNAmaya (allAha) bAheka arU kohI chaina jasale tyasalAI thAmeko hoos | nissandeha unI hareka cIjalAI dekhirahekA chan |
(bhana!) Akhira tyo timIharUko tyo kuna sainyadala ho jasale karuNAmaya (allAha) ko tulanAmA timIharUlAI sahayoga garos, vAstavamA kAphiraharU ta dhokAmA chan |
vA (bhana!) yadi karuNAmaya (allAha) le timIharUko jIvikA roke bhane kasale timIharUlAI jIvikA dina sakcha | baru yinIharU satyatAko ghRNA evaM uddaNDatAmA aDiga chan |
ke anuhArako bharamA hi~Dne vyakti gantabsayamma baDhI mArgadarzana pAuna sakcha vA sIdhAmArgamA sojho hi~Dne vyakti?
bhanideU! allAha nai hun jasale timIharUlAI sRSTi gare ra timIharUlAI kAna, A~khA tathA hRdaya pradAna gare | tara timIharU kamai kRtajJa banchau |
bhanideU! allAha nai hun jasale timIharUlAI dhartImA phailAe ra unaitarpha timIharU bhelA garinechau |
ra, yinIharU bhanchan– “yadi timIharU saccA chau bhane yo vAcA kahile pUrA hunecha?”
bhanideU! yasako jJAna ta allAhalAI cha, ra ma spaSTa sacetaka mAtra hu~ |
pheri jaba yinIharUle tyasa (mahApralaya) lAI najika dekhnechan taba yI sabai kAphiraharUko muhAra bigrinecha ra yinIharUlAI bhaninecha– “yahI ho tyo jasako timIharU mAga gardai thiyau |”
bhanideU! ke timIharUle vicAra garyau, yadi allAhale malAI ra merA sAthIharUlAI mAridiemA vA hAmImAthi dayA nai garemA kAphiraharUlAI kasale pIDAdAyI yAtanAbATa bacAuna sakcha?”
bhanideU! unI ‘rahamAna’ (karUNAmaya) hun | unaimAthi hAmIle ImAna lyAekA chauM ra unaimAthi hAmro bharosA cha | prasTa pathabhraSTatAmA ko cha bhanne kurA timIharUle cA~Dai nai jAnnechau |”
bhanideU! ke timIharUle vicAra garyau ki timIharUko pAnI sukemA kasale timIharUkAlAgi sadA bagne srotaharU nikAlera dina sakcha?
nUn; kalamako kasama ra tyasa kurAko (kasama) jasalAI tinI (phariztA) harU lekhchan |
(he muhammada sa.!) timI AphnA rabako kRpAle unmAdI hoinau |
ra, sA~ccikai timrolAgi kahilyai samApta nahune pratidAna raheko cha |
ra (he nabI!) nizcaya nai timI naitikatAko ucca zikharamA chau |
cA~Dai nai timIle pani dekhnechau ra tinIharUle pani dekhnechan |
ki timIharUmadhye ko utpIDanamA pAriyo?
timrA raba Aphno mArgabATa bhraSTa bhaekAharUlAI rAmrarI jAndachan ra satmArgamA rahekAharUlAI pani |
ataH mithyA Thahara garneharUko kurA namAna |
yinIharU cAhanchan– yadi timIle namratA dekhAyau bhane yinIharUle pani namratA dekhAunechan |
kunai pani dherai kasama khAne ra hIna vyaktiko kurA namAna |
ati vyaGgya garne, jyAdai cuklI lagAune
bhalAibATa manAhI garne, sImA ullaGghanakArI pApI
atyAcArI, yI sabai pachi harAmI pani |
yI avaguNaharu hunuko kAraNa ke cha ki tyo vyakti dhanavAna tathA saMtAnavAna cha|
jaba hAmrA AyataharU tinIharUlAI sunAincha taba bhanchan– “yI ta atItakA kathAharU hun |”
cA~Dai nai hAmI tyasako sU~Da (aglo nAka) lAI DAmnechauM |
hAmIle yinIharUko parIkSA tyasarI nai liyauM jasarI bagai~cAvAlAharUko parIkSA liekA thiyauM, jaba tinIharUle kasama khAe ki unIharu avazya nai bihAnai Aphno bagai~cAko phala Tipera lyAunechan...
ra kehI choDane chainan |
tara rAti tinIharU sutirahekai avasthAmA timrA rabako prakopa tyasa bagaiMcAmAthi Aipugyo |
ra tyo bagaiMcA purai kATieko jasto banna pugyo |
tinIharUle bihAnai ekaarkAlAI AvAja die |
yadi phala Tipnucha bhane bihAnai hiMDa |
tinIharU yo kAnekhusI gardai hiMDe ki...
Aja kunai garIbale timIharuko najika bagaiMcAmA chirna napAos |
unIharU bihAnai baDo saMkalpa tathA sAmarthyavAna bhaI hiMDe |
ani jaba tinIharUle bagai~cA dekhe, bhanna thAle– “oho! hAmI ta bATo nai birAechauM!
hoina, baru hAmI ta baJcita po huna pugechauM |”
tinIharUmadhyekA asala vyaktile bhanyo– “timIharU allAhako pavitratA bayAna kina gardainau bhanI hAmIle bhanekA thienauM ra?”
tinIharUle pukAre– “pavitra chan hAmrA raba! vAstavamA hAmI po atyAcArI rahechauM |”
ani tinIharUmadhye pratyekale eka–arkAlAI doSI ThaharyAuna thAle |
tinIharUle bhane– “hAya, hAmro barbAdI! vAstavamA hAmI nai sImA ullaGghanakArI hau~ |
AzA cha, hAmrA rabale hAmIlAI yasako saTTAmA yobhandA rAmro bagai~cA pradAna garnechan | hAmI Aphno rabatarpha pharkanchauM |"
yasto huncha prakopa! Akhiratako prakopa ta yasabhandA pani bhayAnaka hunecha | kati rAmro hune thiyo yinIharUle yasa kurAlAI jAnekA bhae!
nissandeha Izabhaya rAkhne vyaktiharUkAlAgi unIharUkA rabakahA~ vaibhavazAlI bagaiMcA hunecha |
ani ke hAmIle AjJAkArIharU aparAdhIharUjhaiM banAunechau~ ta?
Akhira ke bhaeko cha timIharUlAI? timIharU kasto nirNaya garda rahechau?
ke timIharUsa~ga kunai kitAba cha jasamA timIharU paDhne garchau...
ki vAstavamA tyasamA timIharUkA lAgi timIharUle cAhekai kurAharU chan |
vA ke timIharUle hAmIsaMga mahApralayako dinasamma kasama liekA chau ki timIharUlAI tyahI prApta hunecha jasako timIharU nirNaya garchau?
tinIharUlAI sodha! tinIharUmadhye kasale yasako jamAnata lincha?
vA yinIharUkAlAgi kehI sAjhedAraharU chan? yinIharU saccA hun bhane AphnA sAjhedAraharUlAI lyAUn?
juna dina piDauMlA kholinecha ra mAnisaharUlAI sajdA garna bolAinecha tyasa dina tinIharUle sajdA garna sakne chainan |
yinIharUkA A~khA tala jhukeko avasthAmA yinIharU apamAnita bhairahanechan | jabaki yinIharU svastha raheko avasthAmA sajdAkA bolAinthe |
ataH, he nabI sa.! yasa vANIlAI mithyA Thahara garneharUko mAmalA mamAthi choDideU | hAmI yinIharUlAI kramazaH barbAdItarpha laginechau~ yasarI ki yinIharUlAI thAhA pani hune chaina |
ra, ma yinIharUlAI avasara dinechu| vAstavamA mero yojanA ati zaktizAlI cha |
ke timI yinIharUsita kunai pArizramika mAgdaichau ki yinIharU jaribAnAko bhArImunI dabiMdaichan?
vA yinIharulAI parokSako jJAna prApta cha jasalAI yinIharu lekhirahakAchan?
ataH AphnA rabako AdezalAI dhairyakAsAtha pratIkSA gara, ra mAchAvAlA ( yUnusa a.) jasto nahoU, jaba unale pIDAmA grasita avasthAmA pukArekA thie |
yadi unakA rabako kRpA unImAthi nabhaeko bhae unI nindita bhaera bA~jho maidAnamA phyA~kine thie |
pheri unakA rabale unalAI cayana gare ra satkarmI bhaktaharUmA sammilita gare |
yI jaba kAphiraharU upadeza (kuraAna) sunchan taba yasto A~khAle herchan mAnauM timro pAu ukhelnechan ra bhanchan– yo avazya nai unmAdI rahecha |
jabaki yo sampUrNa saMsAra bAsIharUkA lAgi euTA upadeza ho |
avazyambhAvI!
ke ho tyo avazyambhAvI!?
ra, timIlAI ke thAhA tyo avazyambhAvI ke ho?
samUda ra Adale khaTakhaTAune tyasa ApadAlAI jhUTho ThaharyAekA thie |
samUda ta euTA tikSNa dhvanidvArA naSTa pArie |
ra, AdalAI euTA ati bhayaGkara A~dhIbeharIdvArA vinAza gariyo |
allAhale tyasalAI nirantara sAta rAta ATha dinasamma tinIharUmAthi sthApita rAkhe | timIle tinIharUlAI yasarI pachArieko dekhne thiyau, mAnauM tinIharU khajUrakA kuhiekA rUkhaharU hun |
ke aba tinIharUko kunai smRtilAI dekhchau ta?
phiraauna, tyasa aghikA mAnisaharU ra sarvanAza bhaekA (nagarabAsI) harUle pani pApa garekA thie |
tinIharUle AphnA rabakA rasUlako avajJA gare ani unale tinIharUlAI kaDAIkAsAtha samAte |
jaba pAnI baDhera mAthi caDhna pugyo taba hAmIle timIharUlAI DuGgAmA savAra garAyauM...
tAki hAmI tyasa ghaTanAlAI timIharUkAlAgi zikSAprada smRti banAauM ra sajaga rahane kAnale tyasalAI surakSita rAkhUn |
pheri jaba narasiGgAmA eka coTI phukinecha...
ani pRthvI evam pahADaharUlAI mAthi uThAinecha ra ekaipaTakamA TukrA–TukrA pArinecha...
tyasa dina tyo ghaTanA (mahApralaya) hunecha |
ani, AkAza phATnecha ra tyasa dina tyo ati nai kamajora hunecha |
phariztAharU tyasako kinArAmA hunechan ra AThavaTA phariztAle timrA rabako siMhAsanalAI AphUmAthi uThAekA hunechan |
tyasa dina timIharU peza garinechau | timIharUko kunai pani rahasya gupta rahane chaina |
ani jasalAI dAhine hAtamA karmapatra diinecha, usale bhannecha– “lau hera, paDha mero karmapatra |
ma mero hisAba avazya pAunechu bhanne malAI pUrNa vizvAsa thiyo |
ataH, U ati nai aiza–ArAmamA hunecha |
ucca svargamA...
jasakA phalaharUkA jhuppAharu najikai hunechan |
majjAle khAnapIna gara AphnA tI karmaharUko pratidAnasvarUpa juna timIharUle bigatakA dinaharUmA agADi paThAisakekA thiyau |
ra, jasako karmapatra tyasako debre hAtamA diinecha tyasale bhannecha– “hAya! mero karmapatra mero hAtamA nadiieko bhae...
ra maile ke ho mero hisAba, najAneko bhae!
hAya! mero tyahI mRtyu nai (malAI) khatama pAreko bhae!
mero dhanale malAI kunai kAma diena!
mabATa mero sattA pani barbAda bhayo |”
samAta yasalAI ra yasako gardhanamA nela lagAideU |
ani usalAI narakamA homideU |
ani sattarI hAta lAmo jaJjIramA jakaDideU |
nizcaya nai U mahAn allAhamAthi AsthA rAkhdainathyo...
ra garibalAI khAnA khuvAuna protsAhita gardainathyo |
tyasaile Aja yahA~ yasako kohI dayA garne mitra chaina...
ra na pIpabAheka kunai khAnA nai...
juna aparAdhIharUbAheka kohI khA~daina |
hoina, ma kasama khAnchu tI cijaharUko juna timIharU dekhchau...
ra tI cijaharUko pani juna timIharU dekhdainau |
nizcaya nai yo eka pratiSThita rasUlako kathana ho |
kunai kaviko kathana hoina | timIharU kamai ImAna lyAu~chau |
ra, na yo kunai bhaviSyavettAko kathana ho | timIharU kamai vicAra garchau |
yo ta sampUrNa jagatkA rabako tarphabATa avataraNa bhaeko cha |
ra, yadi rasUlale svayaM racera kunai kurA lyAeko bhae..
hAmI tyasako dAhine hAta samAtne thiyauM...
ra unako muTuko nasA (mahAdhamanI) nai kATne thiyauM |
ani timIharUmadhye kasaile pani malAI yasa kAryabATa rokna sakne thiena |
ra vAstavamA yo Izabhaya rAkhneharUkA lAgi euTA upadeza ho |
ra, timIharUmadhye kehI vyaktiharU jhuTho ThaharyAune hun bhanne kurA hAmI rAmrarI jAndachauM |
ra yo inkAra garneharUkAlAgi avazya nai pazcAtApa ho |
ra, yo ati vizvAsanIya satya ho |
ataH, (he nabI sa.!) AphnA mahAn rabako nAmako pavitratA varNana garne gara |
eka mAgnele nizcita Aune prakopa mAgyo...
juna kAphiraharUkAlAgi ho | yasalAI kasaile TArna sakne chaina...
juna tyasa allAhako tarphabATa raheko cha jo bharyAGgaharUkA mAlika hun |
phariztAharU tathA rUha (jibraIla) unIkahA~ caDhera jAnchan euTA yasto dinamA jasako mApa pacAsa hajAra varSa raheko cha |
ataH he nabI sa.! dhairya gara uttama dhairya |
yinIharU tyasalAI TADhA ThAnchan...
jabaki hAmI tyasalAI najika dekhdachauM |
tyasa dina AkAza pagleko dhAtujhaiM hunecha |
ra, pahADaharU bibhinna ra~gako Una samAna hunechan |
ra, kunai pani mitrale kunai mitralAI sodhne chaina...
jabaki tinIharU eka arkAlAI dekhAinechan | aparAdhIle tyasadinako yAtanAbATa bacnalAI Aphno santAna dina cAhanecha;
AphnI patnIlAI; Aphno dAjubhAilAI;
ra Aphno khAndAnalAI jo usalAI Azraya dincha |
ra sabai dhartIbAsIlAI pani, ani yasa (mukti pratidAna) le usalAI mukti pradAna garos |
kadApi hoina; tyo Agoko jvAlA ho...
jasale mAsu ra tvacAlAI kADhnecha |
pratyeka yasto vyaktilAI AphUtira bolAunecha jasale piThyU~ pharkAyo ra vimukha bhayo...
dhana–sampatti jammA garyo ra ganera rAkhyo |
nissandeha mAnava adhIra sRSTi garieko cha |
usamAthi saGkaTa Au~dA bicalita huna thAlcha |
ra, sukha sampannatA prApta hu~dA kanjusyAIM garna thAlcha...
sivAya yastA namAjIharUko,
jo niyamita namAja paDhachan
ra jasakA dhana–sampattimA nizcita haka huncha
magante ra vaJcita vyaktiharUkAlAgi
ra jo badalA diine dinalAI satya mAnchan
jo AphnA rabakA yAtanAsita DarAu~chan
vAstavamA tinIharUkA rabako yAtanA nizcinta rahane cija hoina |
ra jasale AphnA guptAGgaharUko rakSA garchana
sivAya AphnI patnI vA dAsIsita, (yinIharUbAre) unIharU nirdoSa chan |
a~ jasale yasabAheka arU kasaiko cAhanA garchan unIharU nai sImA ullaGghanakArI hun |
jo AphnA nAsoharUko rakSA garchan ra Aphno vacanako dhyAna rAkhchan |
ra Aphno gavAhImA aDiga rahanchan |
ra jo Aphno namAjako rakSA garchan |
unIharU svargamA sammAnapUrvaka rahanechan |
ataH (he nabI!) yI kAphiraharU ke bhayo ki timItira kina dauDdai Au~daichan
hulakA hula dAhine evaM debretirabATa?
ke yinIharUmadhye pratyekale usalAI vaibhavapUrNa bagaiMcAharUmA praveza garAine lobha garcha?
kadApi hoina, hAmIle juna tatvabATa tinIharUlAI sRSTi garekA chauM tyo tinIharU rAmrarI jAndachan |
ataH hoina, ma kasama khAnchu pUrvaharU evaM pazcimaharUkA rabako! hAmIlAI yasako sAmarthya prApta cha
ki yinIharUko sthAnamA yinIharUbhandA uttama mAnisaharUlAI lyAauM ra hAmI (yaso garnumA) vivaza chainauM |
ataH (he nabI sa.!) yinIharUlAI choDideU ki yinIharU kurAkAnImA magna rahun ra khelaThaTTA garUn yahA~samma ki yinIharU tyasa dinalAI bheTnechan jasako yinIharUsita vAcA garincha |
tyasadina yinIharU cihAnabATa Aphno nizAnatira teja gatimA bhAgnechan |
yinIharUko A~khA jhukirahanecha, yinIharU apamAnamA Dubnechan | yo tyahI dina ho jasako vAcA yinIharUsita garinthyo |
nissandeha hAmIle nUhalAI unako samudAyatarpha paThAyauM yo AdezakAsAtha ki "Aphno samudAyalAI Dara dekhAu unIharusamma pIDAdAyI yAtanA Aunuaghi nai |”
unale bhane– “he merA jAtibandhu ho! ma timIharUkAlAgi khullamakhullA sacetaka hu~ |”
(yo kurAbAremA ki) allAhako upAsanA gara ra unako bhayarAkha ani mero AjJA pAlana gara |

allAhale timIharUkA pApaharUlAI kSamA garnechan ra timIharUlAI euTA nizcita samayasamma avasara pradAna garnechan | nizcaya nai jaba allAhale nirdhArita gareko samaya Aipugcha taba tyo TArine chaina | (kati besa hunthyo!) timIharUlAI yasako jJAna bhaeko bhae!
unale bhane, “he merA raba! maile AphnA jAtibandhuharUlAI rAtadina pukAreM |
tara mero AhvAnale tinIharUko pharAramA nai abhivRddhi garyo |
ra, maile jaba jaba tinIharUlAI bolAe~ tAki timI tinIharUlAI kSamA gara, taba taba tinIharUle kAnamA au~lA ghusAre ani AphnA lugAle (anuhAra) DhAke, haTha gare ra jyAdai ghamaNDa gare |
pheri pani maile tinIharUlAI ThUlo svaramA bolAe~ |
ani maile khullA ra gopyarUpamA pani bolAe~ |
ani maile bhane– “AphnA rabasita kSamAyAcanA gara | nissandeha unI atyanta kSamAzIla chan |
unI timIharUmAthi AkAzabATa khubai pAnI barsAunechan |
timIharUlAI dhana–sampatti tathA santAnalAI baDhAunechan | timIharUkAlAgi bagai~cAharU sRSTi garnechan ra timIharUkAlAgi nadIharU bagAunechan |
timIharUlAI ke bhaeko cha ki timIharU allAhako gaurava svIkArdainau |
jabaki unale timIharUlAI vibhinna avasthAmA sRSTi gare |
ke timIharUle dekhenau allAhale kasarI talamAthi sAtavaTA AkAzaharU banAekA chan?
ra, tinamA candramAlAI ujyAlo evaM sUryalAI dIpa banAe |
ra, allAhale timIharUlAI dhartIbATa viziSTa prakArale vikasita gare |
pheri unale timIharU lAI yasai dhartImA phirtA laijAnechan, ra pheri timIharUlAI yasabATa nikAlnechan |
ra, allAhale timIharUkAlAgi dhartIlAI vistAra garekAchan
tAki timIharU tyasako khullA bATomA hiMDaDula gara |
nUhale bhane– “he merA raba! tinIharUle mero avajJA gare ra yastA vyaktiharUko anusaraNa gare jasako dhana tathA santAnale tinIharUko noksAnImai abhivRddhi gare |
ra tinIharUle ati nai ThUlo SaDyantra race |
ra, bhane– “kadApi nachoDa AphnA pUjyaharUlAI ra nachoDa vadda tathA suvAalAI na yagUsa, yaUka ra nasralAI |
tinIharUle dherai mAnisaharUlAI pathabhraSTa garekA chan ra (he allAha!) timI pani yI atyAcArIharUlAI pathabhraSTatAbAheka kunai kurAmA abhivRddhi nagara |
AphnA galtIharUle gardA nai tinIharU DubAie ra AgomA homie ani tinIharUle AphUlAI allAhabATa bacAune kunai sahAyaka pAenan |
ra, nUhale bhane– “he merA raba! dhartImA basobAsa garne yI kAphiraharUmadhye kasailAI nachoDa |
timIle tinIharUlAI chADyau bhane tinIharUle timrA bhaktaharUlAI pathabhraSTa pArnechan ra tinIharUko vaMzabATa jasale janma lineharu durAcArI tathA ati kRtaghna nai hunchan |

he merA raba! malAI, merA mAtApitAlAI ra mero gharamA AsthAvAnako haisiyatamA praveza garekA hareka vyaktilAI ani sabai momina puruSa tathA mahilAharUlAI kSamA gara | ra, atyAcArIharUkAlAgi barabAdIbAheka kunai kurAmA abhivRddhi nagara |
(he nabI sa.!) bhanideU matira vahya (prakAzanA) garieko cha ki jinnako euTA TolIle dhyAnapUrvaka (kuraAna) sunyo ra bhanyo– “hAmIle Azcaryajanaka kuraAna sunekA chauM |
jasale sIdhAmArgatarpha mArgadarzana garcha | tyasaile hAmIle tyasamAthi ImAna lyAekA chauM | ra, hAmI kadApi AphnA rabasa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAudainauM |
ra, yo ki nissandeha hAmrA rabako zAna ati ucca cha | unale kasailAI pani patnI ra santAna banAekA chainan |
ra, yo ki hAmrA mUrkhaharUle allAhako sambandhamA ati mithyA kurAharU garne garthe |
ra, yo ki hAmIle yo ThAnekA thiyauM ki manuSya evaM jinna allAhako viSayamA kahilyai jhUTha boldainan |
ra, yo ki manuSyamadhye kehI vyakti jinnamadhyekA kehI vyaktikahA~ zaraNa cAhanthe jasale gardA jinnaharU Aphno uddaNDatAmA ajha baDhe |
ra, yo ki manuSyaharUko pani tyahI soca thiyo juna timIharUle garthyau ki allAhale kasailAI pUnarjIvita garne chainan |
ra, yo ki hAmIle AkAzalAI chAmachuma gardA tyasalAI kaDA nirIkSakaharU tathA ulkAharUle bharipUrNa pAyauM |
ra, yo ki yasaaghi hAmI (allAhako) kurA sunna AkAzamA vibhinna ThAu~mA basne garthyau~ | aba jasale kAna thApcha usale euTA ulkAlAI Aphno tAkamA pAu~cha |
ra, yo ki hAmro sujhabujhamA yo kurA Airaheko chaina ki dhartIbAsIprati narAmro garine niyata garieko cha vA ki unakA rabale unIharUko lAgi bhalAIko cAhanA garekA chan |
ra, yo ki hAmImadhye kehI satkarmI chauM bhane kehI yasako viparIta pani | hAmIharU beglAbeglai bATomA chauM |
ra, yo ki aba hAmIle allAhalAI na vivaza pArna sakchauM na bhAgera unalAI bAdhya pArna sakchauM bhanne kurAko hAmIlAI vizvAsa bhaisakeko cha |
ra, yo ki hAmIle mArgadarzanako kurA sunne bittikai tyasamAthi ImAna lyAyauM | aba jasale AphnA rabamAthi ImAna lyAunecha usalAI kunai kisimako haka mArine vA atyAcAra garine Dara hune chaina |
ra, yo ki hAmImadhye kehI muslima chauM bhane kehI satyabATa vicalita chauM | ani jasale islAma grahaNa gare unIharUle muktiko mArga roje |
ra, jo satyabATa haTe tinIharU narakako indhana banna puge |”
ra, yo ki (he muhammada sa.!) mAnisaharU yadi sIdhAmArgamA rahekA bhae hAmI unIharUlAI khubai siMcita garne thiyauM |
tAki yasa varadAnadvArA unIharUko jA~ca garau~ | ra jo AphnA rabako smaraNabATa vimukha hunchan tinIharukA rabale tinIharUlAI caDhdo yAtanAmA praviSTa garnechan |
ra, yo ki masjidaharU allAhakA hun | ataH allAhakAsAtha arU kasailAI napukAra |
ra, yo ki jaba allAhakA bhakta unIsita prArthanAko lAgi ubhie taba mAnisaharU unImAthi AkramaNa garna tayAra bhae |
(he nabI sa.!) bhanideU– “ma mAtra AphnA rabalAI pukArchu ra unIsa~ga kasailAI sAjhedAra banAudina |”
bhanideU– “ma timIharUkAlAgi na kunai hAni puryAune sAmarthya rAkhchu na kunai lAbha puryAune nai |”
bhanideU– “malAI allAhabATa kasaile pani bacAuna sakdaina ra na ma unIbAheka aru kunai zaraNa pAuna sakchu |"

a~ (mero jimmevArI) allAhako tarphabATa mAtra puryAu~nu ra unako sandezaharU sunAunu ho | aba jasale allAha evaM unako rasUlako AdezalAI mAnne chaina usakolAgi narakako Ago cha jasamA tinIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan |”
yahA~ samma jaba tinIharUle tyasa kurAlAI dekhnechan jasako tinIharUsita vAcA garieko cha | taba tinIharUlAI thAhA hunecha ki kasakA sahAyakaharU durbala chan ra kasako saMkhyA kama cha |
bhanideU– “malAI thAhA chaina ki juna kurAko vAcA timIharUsita gariMdaicha tyo najikai cha, vA merA rabale tyasakolAgi lAmo avadhi nizcita garne chan |”
unI parokSakA jJAtA hun ani Aphno parokSalAI kasaimAthi prakaTa gardainan |
tara, tI mAnisaharU jasalAI unI rasUla cayana gardachan, unako agADi pachADibATa saMrakSaka lagAu~chan |
tAki unI (allAha) jAnUn ki unIharule AphnA rabako sandeza puryAidiekA chan | ra, allAhale sampUrNa cijalAI Aphno paridhimA liekA chan | ra, unale eka eka cijako gaNanA surakSita rAkhekA chan |
he khAsTo berI sutiraheko vyakti!
rAtako kehI paharabAheka ubhine gara |
AdhA rAta vA tyobhandA ali kama |
vA tyobhandA ali baDhI | ra, bistArai kuraAna paDhne gara |
hAmI timImAthi euTA bhArI vANI avatarita garnechauM |
nissandeha rAtako jAgrAmale manalAI khubai niyantraNamA rAkhcha ra kurAlAI sudRDha tulyAu~cha |
dinako samayamA timro vyastatA dherai huncha |
ra AphnA rabako nAma japa ra sabaibATa alaga bhaI unaitarpha ekAgra hoU |
unI pUrva evaM pazcimakA raba hun | unIbAheka kohI pUjya chaina | ataH unailAI Aphno kAryasAdhaka banAU |
ra, tinIharUle garekA kurAharUlAI dhairyatApUrvaka sahana gara, ra ziSTatAkAsAtha tinIharUbATa alaga rahane gara |
ra malAI ra mithyA Thahara garne sukhI sampanna vyaktiharUlAI choDideU, ra tinIharUlAI kehI avasara deU |
nissandeha hAmIkahA~ nelaharU ra danka~do Ago chan |
ra, ghA~TImA aDkane bhojana tathA pIDAdAyI yAtanA pani |
tyasadina jaba jamIna tathA pahADa kA~pna thAlchan, ra pahADaharU bAluvAko thumkA banna pugchan |
vAstavamA hAmIle timIharUmAthi sAkSI dine eka rasUla tyasarI nai paThAyauM jasarI hAmIle phiraaunatarpha rasUla paThAekA thiyauM |
ani phiraaunale rasUlako kurA mAnena, ta hAmIle tyasalAI kaDA rupamA samAtyauM |
yadi timIharUle kuphra garyau bhane tyasa dinabATa kasarI bacna sakchau juna dinale baccAlAI vRddha banAidinecha?
tyasako kAraNale AkAza phuTnecha?” allAhako vAcA pUrA bhaerai chADcha |
yo ta euTA upadeza ho | aba jo cAhancha Aphno rabatarpha jAne mArga grahaNa garos |

(he nabI sa.!) timrA raba jAndachan ki timI lagabhaga duItihAi vA AdhA rAta vA eka tihAi rAta ubhine garchau | ra, timrA sAthIharUmadhye euTA samUha pani timIsa~ga huncha | allAha nai rAta tathA dinako hisAba rAkhdachan | unalAI thAhA cha ki timIharU samayako ThIka gaNanA garna sakne chainau | ataH unale timIharUmAthi dayA gare | tasartha aba Aphno suvidhA anusAra kuraAna jati paDhna sakchau tyati nai paDhne gara | unalAI thAhA cha ki timIharUmadhye kohI birAmI hunchan, kohI allAhako varadAnako khojImA yAtrA garchan ra kohI allAhako mArgamA yuddha garchan | ataH kuraAna jati paDhna sakchau, paDha | ani, namAja kAyama gara, jakAta deU ra allAhalAI uttama RNa deU | jejati puNyakarma AphnolAgi agADi paThAunechau tyo allAhakahA~ avazya pAunechau, juna ati uttama ra mahAna pratidAna hunecha | ataH allAhasita kSamAyAcanA gara | nissandeha allAha ati kSamAzIla evaM parama dayAlu chan |
he lugA berera suteko mAnche!
uTha ra sAvadhAna gara!
ra, AphnA rabako mahAnatA varNana gara |
ra, AphnA vastraharU pavitra rAkha |
ra, apavitratAlAI tyAga |
ra, adhika ThAnI (Aphno kAryalAI) naroka |
ra, AphnA rabakAlAgi dhairyadhAraNa gara |
jaba sUra phukinecha
tyo ati kaThina dina hunecha |
kAphiraharUkAlAgi sahaja hune chaina |
choDa malAI ra tyasa vyaktilAI jasalAI maile sRSTi gareM ekalai |

eka likhita abhilekha |

eka likhita abhilekha!

ucca AsanamA basera unIharU avalokana garirahanechan |

a~, jo vimukha huncha ra kuphra garcha

jasale timro DhADa bhA~ciraheko thiyo |
ra, timrolAgi hAmIle timro kIrti ucdica pAridiyau~ |
ataH nizcaya nai kaThinAipachi saralatA cha |
ho, kaThinAi lagattai saralatA cha |
ataH phursada pAu~dA upAsanAmA juTne gara |
ra, AphnA rabatarpha mohita hoU |
aJjIra evaM jaitUnako kasama
ra tUre sInAko
ra, yasa zAnta nagarako
nizcaya nai hAmIle manuSyalAI sarvottama saMracanAmA sRSTi garyauM |
tyasapachi hAmIle usalAI nIcabhandA nIca staramA jhAridiyauM |
sivAya tI vyaktiharU jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare, unIharUkAlAgi apAra pratidAna raheko cha |
ataH (he mAnava!) timIlAI ke le badalA diine dinalAI jhuTho Thahara garna prerita garcha?
ke allAha samasta zAsakaharUbhandA ThUlo zAsaka hoinan ra?
(he muhammada sa.!) paDha; AphnA pAlanakartAko nAmabATa jasale sirjanA gare |
sirjanA gare manuSyalAI ragatako DallobATa |
paDha! timrA raba sababhandA udAra chan |
jasale kalamadvArA zikSA pradAna gare |
manuSyalAI tyo kurA sikAe juna kurAko jJAna usalAI thiena |
kadApI hoina, manuSya ta uddaNDa huna pugcha |
yasa kAraNale ki U AphUlAI paripUrNa pAu~cha |
nizcita rUpamA timrA rabatarpha nai pharkanucha |
ke timIle dekhyau tyasa vyaktilAI jo rokdacha
eka bhaktalAI jaba unI namAja paDhchan?
ke timIle socyau yadi unI (rokine vyakti) satmArgamA chan
vA unI Izabhayako Adeza dinchan?
timro ke vicAra cha yadi usa (rokne vyakti) le mithyA Thahara garyo ra U vimukha bhayo bhane?
allAhale dekhirahekA chan bhanne kurA tyasalAI thAhA chaina ra?
kina nadekhinu, yadi U rokiena bhane hAmI tyasako nAsiyaha (julphI) a~ThyAera ghisArnechauM |
jhUTho ra pApI nAsiyahlAI |
ani bolAos Aphno samUhalAI |
hAmI narakakA phariztAharUlAI DAknechauM |
kadApi hoina; namAna usakA kurA, baru sajdA gara tathA (allAhako) nikaTa bhaihAla |
nissandeha hAmIle yasa (kuraAna) lAI kadrako rAtamA avataraNa garyauM |
ra kadrako rAta ke ho timIlAI ke thAhA?
kadrako rAta hajAra mahinAbhandA pani uttama cha |
yasamA phariztAharU evaM AtmA (jibraila) AphnA pAlanakartAko Adezale hareka kArya sampAdanakolAgi orlane garchan |
yo (rAta) prAtaHkAlako Agamanasamma zAnti nai zAnti huncha |
ahle–kitAba evaM muzrikaharUmadhye kuphra garne vyaktiharUle tinIharUkahA~ pratyakSa pramANa naAuJjela Aphno kuphra tyAgnevAlA thienan |
(arthAt) allAhakA rasUla jasale pavitra pAnAharU pATha garera sunAUn |
jasamA Thosa AdezaharU aGkita chan |
ra, ahle–kitAbaharU pratyakSa pramANa pAepachi mAtra vibhAjita bhae |
Adeza ta tinIharUlAI yahI thiyo ki Aphno dharmalAI allAhakolAgi zuddha pArera ekAgra bhaI unako upAsanA garUn; namAja kAyama garUn ra jakAta cuktA garUn ra yahI nai sidhA dharma ho |
nissandeha ahle–kitAba ra muzrikaharUmadhye kuphra garne vyaktiharU narakako AgomA hominechan jahA~ tinIharU sadA rahanechan | tinIharU nai hun duSTatama prANI |
nissandeha jasale ImAna lyAe ra satkarma gare unIharU nai sarvazreSTha prANI hun |

yastA vyaktiharUko pratidAna unakA pAlanakartAsamakSa sadA rahane bagaiMcAharU hun, jasako talatirabATa naharaharU bagirahekA hunechan, jahA~ unIharU sadAsarvadA rahanechan | allAha unIharUsita prasanna bhae ra unIharU allAhasita khuzI bhae | yo usako nimti ho jo AphnA pAlanakartAsita DarAune garcha |
jaba pRthvIlAI pUrNarUpale hallAinecha
ra dhartIle Aphno (bhitrako) bojha nikAlera phyA~kidinecha |
ra, manuSyale bhannecha– “yasalAI ke bhayo?”
tyo dina pRthvIle sampUrNa khabaraharU batAunecha
kinabhane timrA pAlanakartAle tyasalAI yasto garne Adeza diekA hunchan |
mAnisaharU tyasa dina eklA eklai Aunechan tAki tinIharUlAI tinIharukA karma dekhAiyos |
ani, jasale kaNabhara pani satkarma gareko huncha usale tyasalAI dekhnecha |
ra, jasale kaNabhara pani duSkarma gareko huncha usale tyasalAI dekhnecha |
kasama hasyAGphasyAG gardai dauDne tI ghoDAharUko
jo khurabATa agnikA jhilkAharU nikAlchana
ra ekA bihAnai chApA mArchan
ra tyahA~ dhUlo uDAu~chan |
ani zatrukA sainya–dalabhitra paschan |
nizcaya nai manuSya AphnA pAlanakartAprati kRtaghna raheko cha |
ra, U svayaM yasako sAkSI ho |
U sampattiko mohamA dherai nai lipta cha |
ke usalAI thAhA chaina jaba cihAnabATa sabai nikAlinechan?
ra, chAtIbhitra je cha tyo pani bAhira nakAlinecha |
nizcaya nai unIharUkA raba tyasa dina unIharUko avasthAsa~ga pUrNa avagata rahanechan |
bhayAvaha ghaTanA!
ke ho tyo bhayAvaha ghaTanA?
timIlAI ke thAhA ke ho tyo bhayAvaha ghaTanA?
tyasa dina manuSyaharU chariekA kIrA phaTyAGgrA jastA hunechan |
ra, pahADaharU dhunekA raGgina UnajhaiM hunechan |
ani jasako pallA bhArI huncha
usale rucAeko jIvana pAunecha |
ra, jasako pallA haluGgo huncha
usako bAsasthAna hAviyah hunecha |
hAviyah ke ho timIlAI ke thAhA?
danka~do Ago |
(he mAnava!) atyadhika cAhanAle timIharUlAI bhulAirAkheko cha
yahA~samma ki timIharU cihAnasamma pugchau |
kadApi hoina, timIharU cA~Dai jAnnechau |
ani kadApi hoina, timIharU cA~Dai jAnnechau |
kadApi hoina, yadi timIharUlAI vizvasanIya jJAna bhaeko bhae
ki timIharUle avazya naraka dekhnechau |
pheri timIharU avazya dekhnechau vAstavika netrale |
ani tyasa dina timIharUlAI prApta sukha–sAmagrIbAre avazya sodhinecha |
yugako kasama
nizcaya nai mAnavajAti ghATAmA chan
tI mAnisaharUbAheka jasale ImAna lyAe, satkarma gare tathA paraspara nitAnta satyako artI ra dhairyako upadeza diirahe |
yasto pratyeka vyaktiko sarvanAza hos jo vyaGgya ra helA garcha |
jo dhana–sampatti thupArcha ra gantI gardai thankyAu~cha |
usako sampattile usalAI amara banAunecha bhanne kurA ThAndacha |
kadApi hoina, nizcaya nai usalAI hutamahmA hominecha |
hutamah ke ho timIlAI ke thAhA?
allAhako danka~do agni
juna muTusamma pugnecha |
nissandeha tyasalAI tinIharUmAthi cAraitirabATa chopera banda garinecha |
aglA–aglA stambhaharUmA |
ke timIle dekhenauM ki timrA rabale hAttIvAlAharUsita kasto vyavahAra gare?
ke unale tinIharUko yojanA viphala tulyAidienan?
ra tinIharUmAthi hulakA hula paMkSIharU pani paThAidie
jo tinIharUlAI maTyAGgrAle hirkAirahanthe |
antataH unale tinIharUlAI khAeko biruvAjhaiM banAidie |
kuraizako helamelako kAraNale
jADo ra garmIko yAtrAsita helamela hunuko kAraNale
tinIharUle yasa gharakA mAlikako upAsanA garUn
jasale tinIharUlAI bhokamarIbATa bacAera khAnA khuvAe ra bhayabATa bacAera zAnti pradAna gare |
ke timIle nyAyako dinalAI mithyA Thahara garne vyaktilAI dekhyau?
uhI ta ho jo anAthalAI galahatyAu~cha
ra dIna–duHkhIlAI khuvAuna protsAhita gardaina |
sarvanAza hos yastA namAjIharUko
jo AphnA namAjaprati lAparavAhI garchan
jo dekhAvaTI garchan
ra sAnotino vastu pani (kasailAI) dinabATa rokchan |
(he muhammada sa.!) nissandeha hAmIle timIlAI al–kausara pradAna garekA chauM |
ataH AphnA pAlanakartAkai nimti namAja paDha ra balidAna diu |
nizcaya nai timrA zatru nai jarA kATieko hunecha |
(he sandeSTA!) bhanideU– “he kAphiraharU ho!
timIharUle pujdai garekA (devIdevatA) ko pujA ma gardina |
ra, na timIharU nai maile upAsanA gardai garekA (allAha) ko upAsanA garchau |
ra, ma usako bhakti garnevAlA chaina jasako bhakti timIharUle garyau |
ra, na timIharU bhakti garnevAlA hau jasako bhakti ma garchu |
timIharUkAnimti timrai dharma, ra meronimti merai dharma |
jaba allAhako sahAyatA ra vijaya Aipugcha |
ra, timIle mAnisaharUlAI allAhako dharmamA hUlakA hUla pasiraheko dekhchau |
taba AphnA pAlanakartAko prazaMsAkAsAtha mahimAgAna gara ra unIsita kSamAyAcanA gara | nissandeha unI mahAna pazcAtApa svIkArakartA hun |
bhA~cciyo abU–lahabako hAta | ra, barabAda bhayo U |
usako sampatti ra jejati usale kamAeko thiyo tyo usalAI kAma lAgena |
avazya nai U danka~do AgomA hominecha |
ra, Usa~ga usakI patnI jo indhana bokne garthin |
usako gardhanamA khajUrakA rezAko DorI hunecha |
(he nabI sa.) bhanideU! unI allAha eklA chan |
allAha nirapekSa chan |
unako kohI santAna chaina; na unI kasaikA santAna hun |
ta, kohI unako samakakSa pani chaina |
bhanideU! ma zaraNa parchu prAtaHkAlakA mAlikako |
hareka vastuko duSTatAbATa (joginako lAgi) juna unale sRSTi garekA chan |
ra, andhakAramaya rAtriko duSTatAbATa (bacna) jaba tyo phailincha |
ra, gA~ThomA jhAraphuka garneharUko duSTatAbATa |
ra, IrSyAluko duSTatAbATa jaba tyo IrSyA garcha |
bhanideU! ma zaraNa parchu mAnavakA pAlanakartAko
mAnavakA vAstavika samrATko
mAnavakA pUjyako
bhrama utpanna garne ra suTukka niskane (zaitAna) ko duSTatAbATa (joginako lAgi)
jasale mAnava hRdayamA bhrama utpanna garcha
(juna) jinna tathA mAnava madhyeko (huncha)|
